FROM (

    bap.b1_per_id1,
    bap.b1_per_id2,
    bap.b1_per_id3,
    bap.ROW_INDEX, 
	bap.COLUMN_NAME , 
	bap.ATTRIBUTE_VALUE 
from BAPPSPECTABLE_VALUE bap 
WHERE 1=1
and bap.TABLE_NAME ='WARDENS' 
) AS SOURCE 
PIVOT (MIN(ATTRIBUTE_VALUE)
FOR COLUMN_NAME IN (
	[Warden Type],
	[Assignment Location],
	[Regular Work Days and Hours],
	[Telephone Number], 
	[Floor],
	[Name],
	[Other Contact Information],
	[Title])
) as pvt
  WHERE 
     TITLE = 'Warden'

"3","811_Unmatched_Report.sql","C:\FIRESSQLSVR\811_Unmatched_Report.sql","
WITH alpha_pfx AS (
    SELECT
        x.serv_prov_code,
        x.b1_per_id1,
        x.b1_per_id2,
        x.b1_per_id3,

        MAX(CASE WHEN x.b1_checkbox_desc = 'D.O.' THEN x.b1_checklist_comment END) AS ACTDO,
        MAX(CASE WHEN x.b1_checkbox_desc = 'Application Type' THEN x.b1_checklist_comment END) AS UNIT,
        MAX(CASE WHEN x.b1_checkbox_desc = 'Alpha Prefix' THEN x.b1_checklist_comment END) AS ALPHAPREFIX,
        MAX(CASE WHEN x.b1_checkbox_desc = 'Account Type' THEN x.b1_checklist_comment END) AS ACTTYPE,
        MAX(CASE WHEN x.b1_checkbox_desc = 'Are you a City Agency or State Agency Employee?' THEN x.b1_checklist_comment END) AS EXEMPT_AGENCY,
        MAX(CASE WHEN x.b1_checkbox_desc = 'Exemption Recommendation' THEN x.b1_checklist_comment END) AS EXEMPT_RECOMMEND,
        MAX(CASE WHEN x.b1_checkbox_desc = 'Exemption Recommendation Date' THEN x.b1_checklist_comment END) AS EXEMPT_RECOMMEND_DATE,
        MAX(CASE WHEN x.b1_checkbox_desc = 'Additional Information' THEN x.b1_checklist_comment END) AS ADDL_INFO,
        MAX(CASE WHEN x.b1_checkbox_desc = 'No Fee' THEN x.b1_checklist_comment END) AS NO_FEE,
        MAX(CASE WHEN x.b1_checkbox_desc = 'No Fee Date' THEN x.b1_checklist_comment END) AS NO_FEE_DATE
    FROM bchckbox x
    WHERE x.b1_checkbox_desc IN (
        'Alpha Prefix','D.O.','Account Type','Application Type',
        'No Fee','No Fee Date','Exemption Recommendation',
        'Exemption Recommendation Date','Additional Information',
        'Are you a City Agency or State Agency Employee?'
    )
    AND x.b1_checkbox_type IN (
        'PLAN INFORMATION','PERMIT REPORT INFO',
        'FEE EXEMPTION INFORMATION','LETTER OF APPROVAL INFO'
    )
    GROUP BY
        x.serv_prov_code,
        x.b1_per_id1,
        x.b1_per_id2,
        x.b1_per_id3
),

contact AS (
    SELECT
        serv_prov_code,
        b1_per_id1,
        b1_per_id2,
        b1_per_id3,
        contact_name,
        rec_date,
        b1_contact_type
    FROM (
        SELECT
            b.serv_prov_code,
            b.b1_per_id1,
            b.b1_per_id2,
            b.b1_per_id3,
            COALESCE(b.b1_full_name, b.b1_business_name, CONCAT(b.b1_fname,' ',b.b1_lname)) AS contact_name,
            b.rec_date,
            b.b1_contact_type,
            ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
                PARTITION BY b.serv_prov_code, b.b1_per_id1, b.b1_per_id2, b.b1_per_id3
                ORDER BY b.rec_date DESC
            ) rn
        FROM b3contact b
        WHERE b.b1_contact_type IN (
            'Business Contact','Business Owner','Authorized Person In charge',
            'Building Representative','Building Owner'
        )
    ) dd
    WHERE rn = 1
),

addr AS (
    SELECT
        serv_prov_code,
        b1_per_id1,
        b1_per_id2,
        b1_per_id3,
        b1_hse_nbr_alpha_start,
        b1_str_name,
        b1_situs_city,
        b1_situs_state,
        b1_situs_zip
    FROM (
        SELECT
            b.serv_prov_code,
            b.b1_per_id1,
            b.b1_per_id2,
            b.b1_per_id3,
            b.b1_hse_nbr_alpha_start,
            b.b1_str_name,
            b.b1_situs_city,
            b.b1_situs_state,
            b.b1_situs_zip,
            ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
                PARTITION BY b.serv_prov_code, b.b1_per_id1, b.b1_per_id2, b.b1_per_id3
                ORDER BY b.b1_primary_addr_flg DESC
            ) rn
        FROM b3addres b
    ) dd
    WHERE rn = 1
),

fitem as (
SELECT
        bp.serv_prov_code,
        bp.b1_per_id1,
        bp.b1_per_id2,
        bp.b1_per_id3,
 x4.invoice_nbr,
    x4.gf_des as fee_item,
    x4.gf_unit as qty,    
    x4.gf_fee as fees,
    x4.feeitem_invoice_status  as status,
    x4.gf_fee_apply_date  as date_accessed,
    f4.balance_due,
    f4.invoice_amount,
    f4.invoice_date,
    f4.rec_ful_nam,
--    f4.rec_status         AS rec_status2,
    at.gf_cod,
--    at.gf_des,
    at.gf_fee,
    at.action_type,
    at.reason,
	at.fee_notes
    
FROM
         b1permit bp
    INNER JOIN x4feeitem_invoice x4 ON bp.serv_prov_code = x4.serv_prov_code
                                           AND bp.b1_per_id1 = x4.b1_per_id1
                                           AND bp.b1_per_id2 = x4.b1_per_id2                                           
                                           AND bp.b1_per_id3 = x4.b1_per_id3                                           
    INNER JOIN f4invoice f4 ON x4.invoice_nbr = f4.invoice_nbr
    INNER JOIN f4feeitem_audit_trail at ON x4.feeitem_seq_nbr = at.feeitem_seq_nbr

WHERE
--        bp.b1_alt_id = '&b1_alt_id'
    bp.b1_per_type = 'Common'
    AND bp.b1_per_sub_type = 'Inspection'
    AND x4.feeitem_invoice_status = 'CREDITED'
    AND at.action_type = 'V'
    AND at.reason = '811 - Unmatched'
)

SELECT
    RIGHT('0' + ap.ACTDO, 2) AS DONUM,
    ap.UNIT,
    ap.ALPHAPREFIX AS APFX,
    ap.ACTTYPE AS ATYP,
    bp.b1_alt_id AS ACCOUNT#,
    bp.b1_appl_status,
    pd.app_status,
    pd.disposition,
    pd.balance,
    pd.total_fee,
    pd.total_pay,

    cn.contact_name AS OWNER_NAME,
--    REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(COALESCE(ap.ADDL_INFO,' '), CHAR(13)+CHAR(10),' '), CHAR(10),' '), CHAR(13),' ') AS Addl_Info,
--   ad.b1_hse_nbr_alpha_start AS str_num,
--    ad.b1_str_name AS str_name,
--    ad.b1_situs_city AS str_city,
--    ad.b1_situs_state AS str_state,
--    ad.b1_situs_zip AS str_zip,
    fi.invoice_nbr,
    fi.fee_item,
    fi.qty,    
    fi.fees,
    fi.status,
    fi.date_accessed,
    fi.balance_due,
    fi.invoice_amount,
    fi.invoice_date,
    fi.rec_ful_nam,
--    f4.rec_status         AS rec_status2,
---    fi.gf_cod,
--    at.gf_des,
---    fi.gf_fee,
    fi.action_type,
    fi.reason
---	fi.fee_notes


FROM b1permit bp
LEFT JOIN alpha_pfx ap ON ap.serv_prov_code = bp.serv_prov_code
                      AND ap.b1_per_id1 = bp.b1_per_id1
                      AND ap.b1_per_id2 = bp.b1_per_id2
                      AND ap.b1_per_id3 = bp.b1_per_id3
LEFT JOIN contact cn   ON cn.serv_prov_code = bp.serv_prov_code
                      AND cn.b1_per_id1 = bp.b1_per_id1
                      AND cn.b1_per_id2 = bp.b1_per_id2
                      AND cn.b1_per_id3 = bp.b1_per_id3
LEFT JOIN addr ad      ON ad.serv_prov_code = bp.serv_prov_code
                      AND ad.b1_per_id1 = bp.b1_per_id1
                      AND ad.b1_per_id2 = bp.b1_per_id2
                      AND ad.b1_per_id3 = bp.b1_per_id3
JOIN fitem fi      ON fi.serv_prov_code = bp.serv_prov_code
                      AND fi.b1_per_id1 = bp.b1_per_id1
                      AND fi.b1_per_id2 = bp.b1_per_id2
                      AND fi.b1_per_id3 = bp.b1_per_id3
LEFT JOIN bpermit_detail pd      ON pd.serv_prov_code = bp.serv_prov_code
                      AND pd.b1_per_id1 = bp.b1_per_id1
                      AND pd.b1_per_id2 = bp.b1_per_id2
                      AND pd.b1_per_id3 = bp.b1_per_id3

WHERE bp.b1_per_type = 'Common'
  AND bp.b1_per_sub_type = 'Inspection'
  AND bp.b1_appl_status <> 'Inactive'

ORDER BY
    fi.invoice_date DESC,
--    RIGHT('0' + ap.ACTDO, 2),
    bp.b1_alt_id;

"5","AI_Assist_Bill_Report.sql","C:\FIRESSQLSVR\AI_Assist_Bill_Report.sql","/*
    Billing Summary Report (FDNY Accela)
    - Parameters: @BillDateStart, @BillDateEnd, @BillType (nullable)
    - Summary columns: Unit, Bill Date, Bill Type, Count
    - Sources:
        B1PERMIT       -> Account / keys
        BASPECT_VALUE  -> Billing attributes (Cycle Number, Bill Date, Bill Type)
        G6ACTION       -> Inspection sequence / number
        BCHCKBOX       -> Unit (Application Type), D.O.
    - Rules:
        * Join first 7 chars of G6ACTION.G6_ACTNUM to first 7 chars of Cycle Number.
        * If multiple bills exist for the same account & same day, keep the highest priority:
            2nd Penalty > 1st Penalty > New Account > (others)
*/

DECLARE @BillDateStart DATE = '2026-04-23';  
DECLARE @BillDateEnd   DATE = '2026-04-23';  
WITH do_unit AS (
    SELECT
        bc.serv_prov_code,
        bc.b1_per_id1,
        bc.b1_per_id2,
        bc.b1_per_id3,
        -- D.O. is often stored as text; normalize to 2 digits if needed
        RIGHT('0' + MAX(CASE WHEN bc.b1_checkbox_desc = 'D.O.'           THEN bc.b1_checklist_comment END), 2) AS DO,
        MAX(CASE WHEN bc.b1_checkbox_desc = 'Alpha Prefix'   THEN bc.b1_checklist_comment END) AS AlphaPrefix,
        MAX(CASE WHEN bc.b1_checkbox_desc = 'Account Type'   THEN bc.b1_checklist_comment END) AS AccountType,
        MAX(CASE WHEN bc.b1_checkbox_desc = 'Application Type' THEN bc.b1_checklist_comment END) AS Unit
    FROM BCHCKBOX bc
    WHERE bc.b1_checkbox_desc IN ('Alpha Prefix','D.O.','Account Type','Application Type')
      -- Optional: restrict to FDNY; uncomment if desired:
      -- AND bc.serv_prov_code = 'FDNY'
    GROUP BY bc.serv_prov_code, bc.b1_per_id1, bc.b1_per_id2, bc.b1_per_id3
),

-- === Extract Billing attributes from BASPECT_VALUE ===
billing AS (
    SELECT
        bv.serv_prov_code,
        bv.b1_per_id1,
        bv.b1_per_id2,
        bv.b1_per_id3,
        bv.row_index,
        MAX(CASE WHEN bv.column_name = 'Cycle Number' THEN bv.attribute_value END) AS cycle_num,
        MAX(CASE WHEN bv.column_name = 'Bill Date'    THEN bv.attribute_value END) AS bill_date_raw,
        MAX(CASE WHEN bv.column_name = 'Bill Amount'    THEN bv.attribute_value END) AS bill_amount_raw,
        MAX(CASE WHEN bv.column_name = 'Bill Type'    THEN bv.attribute_value END) AS bill_type_raw
    FROM bappspectable_value bv
    WHERE bv.table_name IN ('BILLING INFORMATION') -- adjust if your table_name differs
      AND bv.column_name IN ('Cycle Number','Bill Date','Bill Amount','Bill Type')
      AND bv.serv_prov_code = 'FDNY'
    GROUP BY
        bv.serv_prov_code, bv.b1_per_id1, bv.b1_per_id2, bv.b1_per_id3, bv.row_index
),

-- === Inspection actions (sequence / number) ===
ins AS (
    SELECT
        ga.serv_prov_code,
        ga.b1_per_id1,
        ga.b1_per_id2,
        ga.b1_per_id3,
        ga.g6_act_num,          -- e.g., '0123456-XX...'; first 7 chars define cycle number family
        ga.g6_compl_dd,
        ga.g6_status

    FROM G6ACTION ga
    WHERE ga.rec_status = 'A'
      -- Optional: restrict to inspections only; uncomment if your data needs it:
      -- AND ga.g6_action_group = 'Inspection'
),

-- === Join permit, unit/DO, billing, inspection by 7-char cycle ===
joined AS (
    SELECT
        bp.serv_prov_code,
        bp.b1_per_id1, bp.b1_per_id2, bp.b1_per_id3,
        bp.b1_alt_id AS account_num,

        du.Unit,
        du.DO,
        du.AccountType,
        du.AlphaPrefix,

        b.cycle_num,
        TRY_CONVERT(date, b.bill_date_raw) AS bill_date,    -- robust date conversion
        TRY_CONVERT(float, b.bill_amount_raw) AS bill_amount,
        b.bill_type_raw,

        i.g6_act_num,
        i.g6_compl_dd,
        i.g6_status


    FROM B1PERMIT bp
    INNER JOIN billing b
        ON bp.serv_prov_code = b.serv_prov_code
       AND bp.b1_per_id1    = b.b1_per_id1
       AND bp.b1_per_id2    = b.b1_per_id2
       AND bp.b1_per_id3    = b.b1_per_id3
    LEFT JOIN do_unit du
        ON bp.serv_prov_code = du.serv_prov_code
       AND bp.b1_per_id1    = du.b1_per_id1
       AND bp.b1_per_id2    = du.b1_per_id2
       AND bp.b1_per_id3    = du.b1_per_id3
    LEFT JOIN ins i
        ON i.serv_prov_code = b.serv_prov_code
       AND i.b1_per_id1     = b.b1_per_id1
       AND i.b1_per_id2     = b.b1_per_id2
       AND i.b1_per_id3     = b.b1_per_id3
       AND ISNULL(SUBSTRING(TRY_CAST(i.g6_act_num AS VARCHAR(50)), 1, 7), '') = ISNULL(SUBSTRING(TRY_CAST(b.cycle_num AS VARCHAR(50)), 1, 7), '')
 ---      AND SUBSTRING(i.g6_act_num, 1, 7) = SUBSTRING(b.cycle_num, 1, 7)  -- required 7-char join
),

-- === Filter duplicates: same account & bill_date -> keep top priority ===
dedup AS (
    SELECT *
    FROM (
        SELECT
            j.*,
            ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
                PARTITION BY j.serv_prov_code, j.b1_per_id1, j.b1_per_id2, j.b1_per_id3, j.bill_date
                ORDER BY  j.bill_type_raw ASC
            ) AS rn
        FROM joined j
        WHERE j.bill_date IS NOT NULL
          -- Optional FDNY & record status filters commonly used in your scripts:
          -- AND j.serv_prov_code = 'FDNY'
          -- AND bp.b1_appl_status <> 'Inactive'
    ) s
    WHERE s.rn = 1
      AND (
            s.bill_date >= @BillDateStart
          )
      AND (
            s.bill_date <= @BillDateEnd
          )

)

SELECT
    d.do,
    d.Unit,
    d.bill_date,
    d.bill_type_raw AS BillType,
    COUNT(*) AS BillsCount,
    SUM(d.Bill_Amount) AS BillsTotal
FROM dedup d
GROUP BY d.do,d.Unit, d.bill_date, d.bill_type_raw
ORDER BY d.bill_date, d.do, d.Unit, d.bill_type_raw;","6/16/2026 10:33:27 AM"

function mainProcess()
{
    var invoices = getLiensInvoices();
    logDebug(""Returned invoices: "" + invoices.length);

    for (var i in invoices){
        if (limit && i >= parseInt(limit)){
            logDebug(""Processing limit reached. Stopping..."");
            break;
        }
        var altId = invoices[i].get(""B1_ALT_ID"");
        var invoiceNbr = invoices[i].get(""INVOICE_NBR"");
        var UDF1 = invoices[i].get(""F4INVOICE_UDF1"");
        var UDF2 = invoices[i].get(""F4INVOICE_UDF2"");
        var UDF3 = invoices[i].get(""F4INVOICE_UDF3"");
        var UDF4 = invoices[i].get(""F4INVOICE_UDF4"");
        var invoiceComment = invoices[i].get(""INVOICE_COMMENT"");

        if (excludeIdMap.get(altId)) {
            logDebug(altId + "": present in exclude list, skipping..."");
            continue;
        }

        var invoiceData = new invoiceMetaData(invoiceComment);
        if (processRecords.length() > 0){
            if (!exists(altId, recordsArray))
                continue;
        }
        if (invoiceData.doNotProcess)
        {
            logDebug(altId + ""-"" + invoiceNbr + "": Marked as do not process, skipping..."");
            continue;
        }
        else if (invoiceData.lienAdded)
        {
            logDebug(altId + ""-"" + invoiceNbr + "": has a later bill, skipping..."");
            continue;
        }
        var itemCap = aa.cap.getCapID(altId).getOutput();
        if (itemCap) { 
            if (matches(getAppSpecific(""D.O."",itemCap),""25"",""33"")) {
                logDebug(altId + ""-"" + invoiceNbr + "": has DO of 25 or 33, skipping..."");
                continue;
            }
        }
        var accType = """";
        var cycleNum = """";
        if (UDF1.indexOf(""-"") != -1){
            var parseUDF1 = UDF1.split(""-"");
            accType = parseUDF1[1];
            cycleNum = parseUDF1[0];
            logDebug(altId + "" Account type:"" + accType);
            logDebug(altId + "": Cycle number is "" + cycleNum);
        }

        var isPermitAccount = getIsPermitAccount(accType, itemCap);
        var doNumber = getAppSpecific(""D.O."", itemCap);
        var appType = getAppSpecific(""Application Type"", itemCap);

        if (doNumber == ""19"" && appType == ""CDA"") {
            isPermitAccount = false;
            //editAppSpecific(""Lien Exempt"", ""CHECKED"", itemCap);
        }

        var processPermitAccounts = matches(""Y"", ""Yes"", aa.env.getValue(""PermitRecords""));
        if (isPermitAccount && !processPermitAccounts)
        {
            logDebug(altId + ""-"" + invoiceNbr + "": PermitRecords flag is set to N and this is a permit record("" + accType + ""), skipping..."");
            continue;
        }

        //Get Clock date (UDF2) and add allowedDays to Clock date. If Clock Date + allowed >= today's date then add to set
        if (UDF2 != null){
            if (""Invalid Date"".equals(new Date(UDF2)))
            {
                logDebug(altId + ""-"" + invoiceNbr + "" has a non date in UDF2 ("" + UDF2 + ""), skipping..."");
                continue;
            }
            var dueDate = null;
            if (isPermitAccount)
                dueDate = dateAdd(UDF2, allowedDays);
            else
                dueDate = dateAdd(UDF2, allowedDaysNonPermit);

            logDebug(altId + "" now comparing due date:"" + dueDate + "" with today's date"");

            if(dateDiff(new Date(), dueDate) <= 0 && getAppSpecific(""Lien Exempt"", itemCap) != ""CHECKED"" && isEligibleInvoice(invoiceNbr,itemCap))
            {
                addStdCondition(""Lien"",""Lien"",itemCap);
                var condResultCurr = aa.capCondition.getCapConditions(itemCap);
                if (condResultCurr.getSuccess()){
                    var capConditionChk = condResultCurr.getOutput();
                    capConditionChk.sort(function (a, b) {
                        return parseInt(b.getConditionNumber()) - parseInt(a.getConditionNumber());
                    });
                    logDebug(altId+"" Updating ASI Field for Condition number :""+capConditionChk[0].getConditionNumber());
                    var chargeNum = getChargeNumber();
                    logDebug(altId+"" Charge Number generated: ""+chargeNum);
                    editStdConditionASI(capConditionChk[0].getConditionNumber(), ""Charge Number"", chargeNum, itemCap);
                    editStdConditionASI(capConditionChk[0].getConditionNumber(), ""Cycle Number"", UDF1, itemCap);
                }

                invoiceData.lienAdded = true;
                setInvoiceComment(itemCap, invoiceNbr, JSON.stringify(invoiceData));
            }
        }
    }
}

function getChargeNumber() {
    var agencySeqBiz = aa.proxyInvoker.newInstance(""com.accela.sg.AgencySeqNextBusiness"").getOutput();
    var params = aa.proxyInvoker.newInstance(""com.accela.domain.AgencyMaskDefCriteria"").getOutput();
    params.setAgencyID(aa.getServiceProviderCode());
    params.setMaskName(""BFP_IR"");
    params.setRecStatus(""A"");
    params.setSeqType(""Agency"");
    var seq = agencySeqBiz.getNextMaskedSeq(""ADMIN"", params, null, null);
    return seq;
}

function isEligibleInvoice(invoiceNo)
{
    var itemCap = capId;
    if (arguments.length > 1 && arguments[1] != null)
    {
        itemCap = arguments[1]
    }

    var invoiceFees = aa.finance.getFeeItemInvoiceByInvoiceNbr(itemCap,invoiceNo,null).getOutput();
    for (var i in invoiceFees)
    {
        if(""1ST_PENALTY"".equals(invoiceFees[i].getFeeCode()) || ""2ND_PENALTY"".equals(invoiceFees[i].getFeeCode()))
        {
            logDebug(itemCap.getCustomID()+""-""+invoiceNo+"" Lien Condition is not adding on - ""+invoiceFees[i].getFeeCode()+"" invoice"");
            return false;
        }
    }
    return true;
}

function getScriptText(vScriptName, servProvCode, useProductScripts) {
    if (!servProvCode)
        servProvCode = aa.getServiceProviderCode();
    vScriptName = vScriptName.toUpperCase();
    var emseBiz = aa.proxyInvoker.newInstance(""com.accela.aa.emse.emse.EMSEBusiness"").getOutput();
    try {
        if (useProductScripts) {
            var emseScript = emseBiz.getMasterScript(aa.getServiceProviderCode(), vScriptName);
        } else {
            var emseScript = emseBiz.getScriptByPK(aa.getServiceProviderCode(), vScriptName, ""ADMIN"");
        }
        return emseScript.getScriptText() + """";
    } catch (err) {
        return """";
    }
}

                                  AND ln.b1_per_id3 = bp.b1_per_id3

       AND bp.b1_appl_status <> 'Inactive'
	   AND ISDATE(li.F4INVOICE_UDF2) = 1

WITH Returned_Values AS(

FROM
(

   x.SERV_PROV_CODE,

   X.B1_PER_ID2,
   X.B1_PER_ID3,   
   F.INVOICE_NBR,

   F.F4INVOICE_UDF2,

   F.F4INVOICE_UDF4,
   F.REC_DATE,
   F.INVOICE_COMMENT 
FROM
   F4INVOICE F 
   INNER JOIN
      X4FEEITEM_INVOICE X 
      ON X.INVOICE_NBR = F.INVOICE_NBR 
WHERE
       F.BALANCE_DUE > 0 
   AND F.F4INVOICE_UDF1 IS NOT NULL 
   AND F.F4INVOICE_UDF2 IS NOT NULL 
   AND F.F4INVOICE_UDF3 IS NOT NULL 
   AND 
(F.INVOICE_COMMENT LIKE CONCAT('%""%','secondReminder','""',':true','%')
      AND F.INVOICE_COMMENT NOT LIKE CONCAT('%""%','doNotProcess','""',':true','%')
      AND F.INVOICE_COMMENT NOT LIKE CONCAT('%""%','lienAdded','""',':true','%')

   )

   AND ISDATE(F.F4INVOICE_UDF2) = 1
   AND DATEADD(day,120,try_convert(DATE,F.F4INVOICE_UDF2)) <= GETDATE()
GROUP BY

   X.B1_PER_ID1,
   X.B1_PER_ID2,
   X.B1_PER_ID3,   
   F.INVOICE_NBR,
   F.BALANCE_DUE,
   F.INVOICE_AMOUNT,
   F.F4INVOICE_UDF1,
   F.F4INVOICE_UDF2,
   F.F4INVOICE_UDF3,

   F.REC_DATE,
   F.INVOICE_COMMENT 
   ) TR

WITH do_unit AS (

       B1_PER_ID1,

	   [Account Type] as ACTTYPE,
	   [No Fee] as NO_FEE,
	   [No Fee Date] as NO_FEE_DATE,
	   [Application Type] as UNIT 
 from 
(
SELECT
    bc.serv_prov_code AS SERV_PROV_CODE,
    bc.b1_per_id1 AS B1_PER_ID1,
    bc.b1_per_id2 AS B1_PER_ID2,
    bc.b1_per_id3 AS B1_PER_ID3,
    
    bc.b1_checkbox_desc,
    bc.b1_checklist_comment
 FROM
         bchckbox bc
JOIN #TMP_Returned_Values rv ON bc.SERV_PROV_CODE = rv.SERV_PROV_CODE
	AND bc.B1_PER_ID1 = rv.B1_PER_ID1
	AND bc.B1_PER_ID2 = rv.B1_PER_ID2
	AND bc.B1_PER_ID3 = rv.B1_PER_ID3
WHERE
    bc.b1_checkbox_desc IN ( 'Alpha Prefix', 'D.O.','Account Type','Application Type','No Fee','No Fee Date' )

    ) pvia

                                        AND b6.b1_per_id3 = reason.entity_key3
                                        AND reason.entity_type = '11'
                                        AND reason.field_name = 'Reason'
    LEFT JOIN gtmpl_attribute     pstatus ON b6.b1_con_nbr = pstatus.entity_seq1
                                         AND b6.b1_per_id1 = pstatus.entity_key1
                                         AND b6.b1_per_id2 = pstatus.entity_key2
                                         AND b6.b1_per_id3 = pstatus.entity_key3
                                         AND pstatus.entity_type = '11'

WITH APO AS (
select SERV_PROV_CODE,
		B1_PER_ID1,
		B1_PER_ID2,
		B1_PER_ID3,
		[BIN] as BIN,
		[BLOCK] as BLOCK,
		[LOT] as LOT
from 
(
SELECT
    apo.serv_prov_code AS SERV_PROV_CODE,
    apo.b1_per_id1 AS B1_PER_ID1,
	apo.b1_per_id2 AS B1_PER_ID2,

	AND APO.B1_PER_ID2 = rv.B1_PER_ID2
	AND APO.B1_PER_ID3 = rv.B1_PER_ID3

WHERE

    AND apo.b1_apo_type IN ('ADDRESS')
    ) pva
PIVOT ( 
	MAX(b1_attribute_value) 
	for b1_attribute_name
       IN(
			[BIN],
			[BLOCK],
			[LOT]
		) 
	) pvb
)

WITH result_data AS (
SELECT 
	RIGHT('0' + du.ACTDO, 2) AS DO,
    du.ALPHAPREFIX AS APFX, 
    du.ACTTYPE AS ACTTYP, 
    PERMITGRP = CASE 
	WHEN du.ACTTYPE IN ('10', '15', '20', '25') AND du.ACTDO  <> '19'  THEN 'PERMIT' 
	ELSE 
	'NONPERMIT' 
	END ,
	DUEDATE =CASE 
	WHEN du.ACTTYPE IN ('10', '15', '20', '25')  AND du.ACTDO  <> '19' THEN DATEADD(day,455,CONVERT(DATE,li.F4INVOICE_UDF2)) 
	ELSE 
	DATEADD(day,120,CONVERT(DATE,li.F4INVOICE_UDF2)) 
	END,
    du.UNIT,
    bp.b1_alt_id AS RECORD_ID,
--    bp.b1_per_type AS per_type,
--    bp.b1_per_sub_type AS per_sub_type,
    bp.b1_appl_status AS STATUS, 
    bp.b1_appl_status_date AS STATUS_DATE,
--    bp.b1_file_dd AS file_date,                    
    cn.contact_name       AS OWNER_NAME,
--    cn.b1_contact_type AS contact_type,
    ba.b1_hse_nbr_alpha_start AS STR_NUM,
    ba.b1_str_name AS STR_NAME,
    ba.b1_situs_city AS STR_CITY,
    ba.b1_situs_state AS STR_STATE,
    ba.b1_situs_zip AS STR_ZIP,
	ap.BIN,
    ap.BLOCK, 
    ap.LOT,
    du.NO_FEE,
    du.NO_FEE_DATE,
    li.INVOICE_NBR,
    li.BALANCE_DUE,
    li.INVOICE_AMOUNT,
    li.F4INVOICE_UDF1 as CYCLE,
    li.F4INVOICE_UDF2 AS CYCLE_CLOCK,
    li.F4INVOICE_UDF3 AS FIRST_DUNNING_DATE,
    li.F4INVOICE_UDF4 AS FIRST_LIEN_NOTICE_DATE,
    li.REC_DATE,
    li.INVOICE_COMMENT 

FROM
         b1permit bp

    LEFT OUTER JOIN #TMP_contact         cn ON cn.serv_prov_code = bp.serv_prov_code
                                  AND cn.b1_per_id1 = bp.b1_per_id1
                                  AND cn.b1_per_id2 = bp.b1_per_id2
                                  AND cn.b1_per_id3 = bp.b1_per_id3
    LEFT OUTER JOIN #TMP_addr ba ON ba.serv_prov_code = bp.serv_prov_code
                                  AND ba.b1_per_id1 = bp.b1_per_id1
                                  AND ba.b1_per_id2 = bp.b1_per_id2
                                  AND ba.b1_per_id3 = bp.b1_per_id3

    INNER JOIN #TMP_APO ap      ON ap.serv_prov_code = bp.serv_prov_code
                                  AND ap.b1_per_id1 = bp.b1_per_id1
                                  AND ap.b1_per_id2 = bp.b1_per_id2
                                  AND ap.b1_per_id3 = bp.b1_per_id3

    INNER JOIN #TMP_do_unit du ON bp.serv_prov_code = du.serv_prov_code
                                   AND bp.b1_per_id1 = du.b1_per_id1
                                   AND bp.b1_per_id2 = du.b1_per_id2                                   
                                   AND bp.b1_per_id3 = du.b1_per_id3   
    INNER JOIN #TMP_Returned_Values li ON bp.serv_prov_code = li.serv_prov_code
                                   AND bp.b1_per_id1 = li.b1_per_id1
                                   AND bp.b1_per_id2 = li.b1_per_id2                                   
                                   AND bp.b1_per_id3 = li.b1_per_id3  
		
WHERE

       bp.b1_per_type = 'Common' 
       AND  bp.b1_per_sub_type = 'Inspection'
       AND bp.b1_appl_status <> 'Inactive'
	   AND ISDATE(li.F4INVOICE_UDF2) = 1
) 

select 
 DO,
 APFX, 
 ACTTYP, 
 PERMITGRP,
 DUEDATE,
 UNIT,
 RECORD_ID,
 STATUS, 
 STATUS_DATE,
 OWNER_NAME,
 STR_NUM,
 STR_NAME,
 STR_CITY,
 STR_STATE,
 STR_ZIP,
 BIN,
 BLOCK, 
 LOT,
 INVOICE_NBR,
 BALANCE_DUE,
 INVOICE_AMOUNT,
 CYCLE,
 CYCLE_CLOCK,
 FIRST_DUNNING_DATE,
 FIRST_LIEN_NOTICE_DATE,
 REC_DATE,
 INVOICE_COMMENT

 from result_data
WHERE
   PERMITGRP = 'NONPERMIT'
   AND DO NOT IN ('25','33')
   AND try_convert(DATE,DUEDATE)  <= GETDATE()
   AND NOT exists 
   (
   select * 
   from #TMP_lien 
   WHERE 
     acct_num = RECORD_ID and CYCLE = ISNULL(CYCLE_NUM,'0000000-00')
	)
ORDER BY DO

FROM
(

   x.SERV_PROV_CODE,
   X.B1_PER_ID1,
   X.B1_PER_ID2,
   X.B1_PER_ID3,   
   F.INVOICE_NBR,
   F.BALANCE_DUE,
   F.INVOICE_AMOUNT,
   F.F4INVOICE_UDF1,
   F.F4INVOICE_UDF2,
   F.F4INVOICE_UDF3,
   F.F4INVOICE_UDF4,
   F.REC_DATE,
   F.INVOICE_COMMENT 
FROM
   F4INVOICE F 
   INNER JOIN
      X4FEEITEM_INVOICE X 
      ON X.INVOICE_NBR = F.INVOICE_NBR 
   INNER JOIN
      B1PERMIT B 
      ON B.B1_PER_ID1 = X.B1_PER_ID1 
      AND B.B1_PER_ID2 = X.B1_PER_ID2 
      AND B.B1_PER_ID3 = X.B1_PER_ID3 
      AND B.SERV_PROV_CODE = X.SERV_PROV_CODE 
WHERE
       F.BALANCE_DUE > 0 
   AND F.F4INVOICE_UDF1 IS NOT NULL 
   AND F.F4INVOICE_UDF2 IS NOT NULL 
   AND F.F4INVOICE_UDF3 IS NOT NULL 
   AND 
(F.INVOICE_COMMENT LIKE CONCAT('%""%','secondReminder','""',':true','%')
      AND F.INVOICE_COMMENT NOT LIKE CONCAT('%""%','doNotProcess','""',':true','%')
---TEST      AND F.INVOICE_COMMENT NOT LIKE CONCAT('%""%','lienAdded','""',':true','%')
   )
   AND F.SERV_PROV_CODE = 'FDNY' 
   AND ISDATE(F.F4INVOICE_UDF2) = 1
   AND DATEADD(day,120,try_convert(DATE,F.F4INVOICE_UDF2)) <= DATEADD(day,10,GETDATE())
   AND B.B1_ALT_ID IN ('34169045','34170282','34175786','34176032','34266197','35081991','35145465')
GROUP BY
   x.SERV_PROV_CODE,
   X.B1_PER_ID1,
   X.B1_PER_ID2,

WITH APO AS (
select SERV_PROV_CODE,
		B1_PER_ID1,
		B1_PER_ID2,
		B1_PER_ID3,
		[BIN] as BIN,
		[BLOCK] as BLOCK,
		[LOT] as LOT
from 
(
SELECT
    apo.serv_prov_code AS SERV_PROV_CODE,
    apo.b1_per_id1 AS B1_PER_ID1,
	apo.b1_per_id2 AS B1_PER_ID2,
    apo.b1_per_id3 AS B1_PER_ID3,
    apo.b1_attribute_name,
    apo.b1_attribute_value
FROM
	b3apo_attribute apo
JOIN #TMP_Returned_Values2 rv ON APO.SERV_PROV_CODE = rv.SERV_PROV_CODE
	AND APO.B1_PER_ID1 = rv.B1_PER_ID1
	AND APO.B1_PER_ID2 = rv.B1_PER_ID2
	AND APO.B1_PER_ID3 = rv.B1_PER_ID3

WHERE
    apo.b1_attribute_name IN ( 'BIN', 'BLOCK','LOT' )
    AND apo.b1_apo_type IN ('ADDRESS')
	AND apo.serv_prov_code = 'FDNY'
    ) pva
PIVOT ( 
	MAX(b1_attribute_value) 
	for b1_attribute_name
       IN(
			[BIN],
			[BLOCK],
			[LOT]
		) 
	) pvb
)
select * INTO #TMP_APO2 from APO;
WITH result_data2 AS (
SELECT 
	RIGHT('0' + du.ACTDO, 2) AS DO,
--    du.ALPHAPREFIX AS APFX, 
    du.ACTTYPE AS ACTTYP, 
    PERMITGRP = CASE 
	WHEN du.ACTTYPE IN ('10', '15', '20', '25') AND du.ACTDO  <> '19'  THEN 'PERMIT' 
	ELSE 
	'NONPERMIT' 
	END ,
	DUEDATE =CASE 
	WHEN du.ACTTYPE IN ('10', '15', '20', '25')  AND du.ACTDO  <> '19' THEN DATEADD(day,455,CONVERT(DATE,li.F4INVOICE_UDF2)) 
	ELSE 
	DATEADD(day,120,CONVERT(DATE,li.F4INVOICE_UDF2)) 
	END,
    du.UNIT,
    bp.b1_alt_id AS RECORD_ID,
--    bp.b1_per_type AS per_type,
--    bp.b1_per_sub_type AS per_sub_type,
--    bp.b1_appl_status AS STATUS, 
--    bp.b1_appl_status_date AS STATUS_DATE,
--    bp.b1_file_dd AS file_date,                    
    cn.contact_name       AS OWNER_NAME,
--    cn.b1_contact_type AS contact_type,
    ba.b1_hse_nbr_alpha_start AS STR_NUM,
    ba.b1_str_name AS STR_NAME,
    ba.b1_situs_city AS STR_CITY,
    ba.b1_situs_state AS STR_STATE,
    ba.b1_situs_zip AS STR_ZIP,
--	ap.BIN,
    ap.BLOCK, 
    ap.LOT,
	bal.balance,
    du.NO_FEE,
    du.NO_FEE_DATE,
--    li.INVOICE_NBR,
--    li.BALANCE_DUE,
--    li.INVOICE_AMOUNT,
    li.F4INVOICE_UDF1 as CYCLE,
    li.F4INVOICE_UDF2 AS CYCLE_CLOCK
--    li.F4INVOICE_UDF3 AS FIRST_DUNNING_DATE,
--    li.F4INVOICE_UDF4 AS FIRST_LIEN_NOTICE_DATE,
--    li.REC_DATE,
--    li.INVOICE_COMMENT 

FROM
         b1permit bp

    LEFT OUTER JOIN #TMP_contact2         cn ON cn.serv_prov_code = bp.serv_prov_code
                                  AND cn.b1_per_id1 = bp.b1_per_id1
                                  AND cn.b1_per_id2 = bp.b1_per_id2
                                  AND cn.b1_per_id3 = bp.b1_per_id3
    LEFT OUTER JOIN #TMP_addr2 ba ON ba.serv_prov_code = bp.serv_prov_code
                                  AND ba.b1_per_id1 = bp.b1_per_id1
                                  AND ba.b1_per_id2 = bp.b1_per_id2
                                  AND ba.b1_per_id3 = bp.b1_per_id3

    INNER JOIN #TMP_APO2 ap      ON ap.serv_prov_code = bp.serv_prov_code
                                  AND ap.b1_per_id1 = bp.b1_per_id1
                                  AND ap.b1_per_id2 = bp.b1_per_id2
                                  AND ap.b1_per_id3 = bp.b1_per_id3

    INNER JOIN #TMP_do_unit2 du ON bp.serv_prov_code = du.serv_prov_code
                                   AND bp.b1_per_id1 = du.b1_per_id1
                                   AND bp.b1_per_id2 = du.b1_per_id2                                   
                                   AND bp.b1_per_id3 = du.b1_per_id3   
    INNER JOIN #TMP_balance2 bal ON bp.serv_prov_code = bal.serv_prov_code
                                   AND bp.b1_per_id1 = bal.b1_per_id1
                                   AND bp.b1_per_id2 = bal.b1_per_id2                                   
                                   AND bp.b1_per_id3 = bal.b1_per_id3 
    INNER JOIN #TMP_Returned_Values2 li ON bp.serv_prov_code = li.serv_prov_code
                                   AND bp.b1_per_id1 = li.b1_per_id1
                                   AND bp.b1_per_id2 = li.b1_per_id2                                   
                                   AND bp.b1_per_id3 = li.b1_per_id3  
		
WHERE

       bp.b1_per_type = 'Common' 
       AND  bp.b1_per_sub_type = 'Inspection'
       AND bp.b1_appl_status <> 'Inactive'
	   AND ISDATE(li.F4INVOICE_UDF2) = 1
	   and bp.serv_prov_code = 'FDNY'
	   AND (du.NO_FEE <> 'CHECKED' OR du.NO_FEE is null)
--	   AND bp.b1_alt_id = @ACCOUNTID
) 
select distinct
	record_id,
	do,
	owner_name,
	str_num,
	str_name,
	str_city,
	str_state,
	str_zip,
	block,
	lot,
	balance,
	acttyp,
	cycle,
	cycle_clock
INTO #TMP_result_data2 from result_data2
WHERE
   PERMITGRP = 'NONPERMIT'
   AND DO NOT IN ('25','33')
   AND try_convert(DATE,DUEDATE)  <= DATEADD(day,10,GETDATE())
   AND NOT exists 
   (
   select * 
   from #TMP_lien2 
   WHERE 
     acct_num = RECORD_ID and CYCLE = ISNULL(CYCLE_NUM,'0000000-00')
	);
WITH all_data as (
select * FROM #TMP_result_data2
)
select * from all_data order by owner_name, record_id;

WITH Returned_Values AS(
SELECT *
FROM
(
SELECT
   x.SERV_PROV_CODE,
   X.B1_PER_ID1,
   X.B1_PER_ID2,
   X.B1_PER_ID3,   
   F.INVOICE_NBR,
   F.BALANCE_DUE,
   F.INVOICE_AMOUNT,
   F.F4INVOICE_UDF1,
   F.F4INVOICE_UDF2,
   F.F4INVOICE_UDF3,
   F.F4INVOICE_UDF4,
   F.REC_DATE,
   F.INVOICE_COMMENT 
FROM
   F4INVOICE F 
   INNER JOIN
      X4FEEITEM_INVOICE X 
      ON X.INVOICE_NBR = F.INVOICE_NBR 
   INNER JOIN
      B1PERMIT B 
      ON B.B1_PER_ID1 = X.B1_PER_ID1 
      AND B.B1_PER_ID2 = X.B1_PER_ID2 
      AND B.B1_PER_ID3 = X.B1_PER_ID3 
      AND B.SERV_PROV_CODE = X.SERV_PROV_CODE 
WHERE
       F.BALANCE_DUE > 0 
   AND F.F4INVOICE_UDF1 IS NOT NULL 
   AND F.F4INVOICE_UDF2 IS NOT NULL 
   AND F.F4INVOICE_UDF3 IS NOT NULL 
   AND 
(F.INVOICE_COMMENT LIKE CONCAT('%""%','secondReminder','""',':true','%')
      AND F.INVOICE_COMMENT NOT LIKE CONCAT('%""%','doNotProcess','""',':true','%')
      AND F.INVOICE_COMMENT NOT LIKE CONCAT('%""%','lienAdded','""',':true','%')
   )
   AND F.SERV_PROV_CODE = 'FDNY' 
   AND ISDATE(F.F4INVOICE_UDF2) = 1
   AND DATEADD(day,120,try_convert(DATE,F.F4INVOICE_UDF2)) <= DATEADD(day,10,GETDATE())
   AND B.B1_ALT_ID IN ('34169045','34170282','34175786','34176032','34266197','35081991','35145465')
GROUP BY
   x.SERV_PROV_CODE,
   X.B1_PER_ID1,
   X.B1_PER_ID2,
   X.B1_PER_ID3,   
   F.INVOICE_NBR,
   F.BALANCE_DUE,
   F.INVOICE_AMOUNT,
   F.F4INVOICE_UDF1,
   F.F4INVOICE_UDF2,
   F.F4INVOICE_UDF3,
   F.F4INVOICE_UDF4,
   F.REC_DATE,
   F.INVOICE_COMMENT 
   ) TR
--   WHERE
--           try_convert(DATE,F4INVOICE_UDF2)  <= GETDATE()
) 
   select * INTO #TMP_Returned_Values2 from Returned_Values;
-- select * from #TMP_Returned_Values2

WITH do_unit AS (
select SERV_PROV_CODE,
       B1_PER_ID1,
	   B1_PER_ID2,
	   B1_PER_ID3,
	   [D.O.] as ACTDO,
	   [Alpha Prefix] as ALPHAPREFIX,
	   [Account Type] as ACTTYPE,
	   [No Fee] as NO_FEE,
	   [No Fee Date] as NO_FEE_DATE,
	   [Application Type] as UNIT 
 from 
(
SELECT
    bc.serv_prov_code AS SERV_PROV_CODE,
    bc.b1_per_id1 AS B1_PER_ID1,
    bc.b1_per_id2 AS B1_PER_ID2,
    bc.b1_per_id3 AS B1_PER_ID3,
    
    bc.b1_checkbox_desc,
    bc.b1_checklist_comment
 FROM
         bchckbox bc
JOIN #TMP_Returned_Values2 rv ON bc.SERV_PROV_CODE = rv.SERV_PROV_CODE
	AND bc.B1_PER_ID1 = rv.B1_PER_ID1
	AND bc.B1_PER_ID2 = rv.B1_PER_ID2
	AND bc.B1_PER_ID3 = rv.B1_PER_ID3
WHERE
    bc.b1_checkbox_desc IN ( 'Alpha Prefix', 'D.O.','Account Type','Application Type','No Fee','No Fee Date' )
    AND bc.b1_checkbox_type IN ('PLAN INFORMATION', 'PERMIT REPORT INFO','FEE EXEMPTION INFORMATION')
	AND bC.serv_prov_code = 'FDNY'
    ) pvia
PIVOT ( MAX(b1_checklist_comment) for b1_checkbox_desc
            IN([D.O.],
			[Alpha Prefix],
			[Account Type],
			[No Fee],
			[No Fee Date],

			[Application Type])) pvib
)
   select * INTO #TMP_do_unit2 from do_unit;
--    select * from #TMP_do_unit2
WITH balance AS (
	SELECT
    pd.serv_prov_code AS SERV_PROV_CODE,
    pd.b1_per_id1 AS B1_PER_ID1,
    pd.b1_per_id2 AS B1_PER_ID2,
    pd.b1_per_id3 AS B1_PER_ID3,
    pd.balance
 FROM
         bpermit_detail pd
JOIN #TMP_Returned_Values2 rv ON pd.SERV_PROV_CODE = rv.SERV_PROV_CODE
	AND pd.B1_PER_ID1 = rv.B1_PER_ID1
	AND pd.B1_PER_ID2 = rv.B1_PER_ID2
	AND pd.B1_PER_ID3 = rv.B1_PER_ID3
WHERE 1=1
	AND pd.SERV_PROV_CODE = 'FDNY' 
)
select * INTO #TMP_balance2 from balance;

WITH lien AS (
SELECT 
    serv_prov_code,
	b1_per_id1,
	b1_per_id2,
	b1_per_id3,
	acct_num,
	con_typ,
    con_nbr,
	charge_num,
    reason,
    payment_status,
	cycle_num,
    con_iss_dd,
    con_eff_dd
FROM
(
SELECT
    b6.serv_prov_code,
	b6.b1_per_id1,
	b6.b1_per_id2,
	b6.b1_per_id3,
	bp.b1_alt_id AS acct_num,
    b6.b1_con_typ AS con_typ,
    b6.b1_con_nbr AS con_nbr,
	RIGHT('0' + charge.field_value, 6) charge_num,
    reason.field_value   AS   reason,
    pstatus.field_value   AS  payment_status,
    cycstatus.field_value   AS  cycle_num,
    CONVERT(DATE,ISNULL(b6.b1_con_iss_dd,'1970-01-01')) AS con_iss_dd,
    CONVERT(DATE,ISNULL(b6.b1_con_eff_dd1,'1970-01-01'))  AS con_eff_dd

FROM
         b6condit b6
JOIN #TMP_Returned_Values2 rv ON b6.SERV_PROV_CODE = rv.SERV_PROV_CODE
	AND b6.B1_PER_ID1 = rv.B1_PER_ID1
	AND b6.B1_PER_ID2 = rv.B1_PER_ID2
	AND b6.B1_PER_ID3 = rv.B1_PER_ID3
JOIN b1permit bp ON b6.SERV_PROV_CODE = bp.SERV_PROV_CODE
	AND b6.B1_PER_ID1 = bp.B1_PER_ID1
	AND b6.B1_PER_ID2 = bp.B1_PER_ID2
	AND b6.B1_PER_ID3 = bp.B1_PER_ID3

    LEFT JOIN gtmpl_attribute     charge ON b6.b1_con_nbr = charge.entity_seq1
                                        AND b6.b1_per_id1 = charge.entity_key1
                                        AND b6.b1_per_id2 = charge.entity_key2
                                        AND b6.b1_per_id3 = charge.entity_key3
                                        AND charge.entity_type = '11'
                                        AND charge.field_name = 'Charge Number'
    LEFT JOIN gtmpl_attribute     reason ON b6.b1_con_nbr = reason.entity_seq1
                                        AND b6.b1_per_id1 = reason.entity_key1
                                        AND b6.b1_per_id2 = reason.entity_key2
                                        AND b6.b1_per_id3 = reason.entity_key3
                                        AND reason.entity_type = '11'
                                        AND reason.field_name = 'Reason'
    LEFT JOIN gtmpl_attribute     pstatus ON b6.b1_con_nbr = pstatus.entity_seq1
                                         AND b6.b1_per_id1 = pstatus.entity_key1
                                         AND b6.b1_per_id2 = pstatus.entity_key2
                                         AND b6.b1_per_id3 = pstatus.entity_key3
                                         AND pstatus.entity_type = '11'
                                         AND pstatus.field_name = 'Payment Status'
    LEFT JOIN gtmpl_attribute     cycstatus ON b6.b1_con_nbr = cycstatus.entity_seq1
                                         AND b6.b1_per_id1 = cycstatus.entity_key1
                                         AND b6.b1_per_id2 = cycstatus.entity_key2
                                         AND b6.b1_per_id3 = cycstatus.entity_key3
                                         AND cycstatus.entity_type = '11'
                                         AND cycstatus.field_name = 'Cycle Number'
WHERE
        b6.b1_con_typ = 'Lien'
    AND b6.rec_status = 'A'
    AND b6.serv_prov_code = 'FDNY'
) tr where charge_num is not null

)
select * INTO #TMP_lien2 from lien;

            var doNumber = getAppSpecific(""D.O."", itemCap);
            var appType = getAppSpecific(""Application Type"", itemCap);
            if (doNumber == ""19"" && appType == ""CDA"") {
                logDebug(altId + ""-"" + invoiceNbr + "": has DO 19 and apptype CDA, skipping..."");
                continue;
            }

            if (matches(doNumber,""25"",""33"")) {
                logDebug(altId + ""-"" + invoiceNbr + "": has DO of 25 or 33, skipping..."");
                continue;
            }
        }					   
        var isPermitAccount = getIsPermitAccount(accType, itemCap);
        var processPermitAccounts = matches(""Y"", ""Yes"", aa.env.getValue(""PermitRecords""));
        if (isPermitAccount && !processPermitAccounts)
        {
            logDebug(altId + ""-"" + invoiceNbr + "": PermitRecords flag is set to N and this is a permit record("" + accType + ""), skipping..."");
            continue;
        }

        //logDebug(""TEST ""+String(rulesTable[accType][""PRT LL4 SW""]));
        //check if allowed days have passed since original clock date (udf2)
        if (""Invalid Date"".equals(new Date(UDF2)))
        {
            logDebug(altId + ""-"" + invoiceNbr + "" has a non date in UDF2 ("" + UDF2 + ""), skipping..."");
            continue;
        }
        if(rulesTable[accType] == null){
            logDebug(altId +"" Entry Not found for accType : ""+accType+"" in PROCESSING RULES TABLE, skipping..."");
            continue;
        }
        if (isPermitAccount)
        {
            logDebug(altId + ""-"" + invoiceNbr + "": Start processing permit"");

            var lienNoticeDueDate = dateAdd(UDF2, allowedDaysForPermits);
            var passedDays = dateDiff(new Date(), lienNoticeDueDate);
            if (passedDays <= 0)
            {
                logDebug(altId + ""-"" + invoiceNbr + "": has passed more than allowed number of days: "" + allowedDaysForPermits + "" days since original bill. Adding to set..."");
                setInvoiceUDF(itemCap, invoiceNbr, null, null, null, sysDateMMDDYYYY);
                var bill = new Object();
                bill.billNumber = String(invoiceNbr);
                bill.billType = ""Lien Notice"";
                bill.billAmount = String(getCycleBalance(UDF1, itemCap));
                bill.cycleNumber = String(UDF1);
                bill.clockDate = UDF2;
                bill.accountType = String(accType);
                bill.lienNotice = sysDateMMDDYYYY;
                bill.billDate = sysDateMMDDYYYY;
                addUpdateBillingInfo(bill, itemCap);
                var envParameters = aa.util.newHashMap();
                envParameters.put(""capId"", itemCap);
                aa.runAsyncScript(""GENERATE_LIEN_NOTICE_ASYNC"", envParameters);

                if (!isCapExists(capSet.setId, itemCap))
                    capSet.add(itemCap);

            }
        }
        else
        {
            logDebug(altId + "" - "" + invoiceNbr + "": setting UDF4 to 'LIEN NOTICE' for Non permit record"");
            setInvoiceUDF(itemCap, invoiceNbr, null, null, null, ""LIEN NOTICE"");
        }
    }
    capSet.update();
}
//#endregion

//#region Private Functions

function elapsed() {
    var thisDate = new Date();
    var thisTime = thisDate.getTime();
    return ((thisTime - startTime) / 1000)
}

    b6.b1_con_nbr AS con_nbr,
	RIGHT('0' + charge.field_value, 6) charge_num,
    reason.field_value   AS   reason,
    pstatus.field_value   AS  payment_status,
    cycstatus.field_value   AS  cycle_num,
    CONVERT(DATE,ISNULL(b6.b1_con_iss_dd,'1970-01-01')) AS con_iss_dd,
    CONVERT(DATE,ISNULL(b6.b1_con_eff_dd1,'1970-01-01'))  AS con_eff_dd

	AND b6.B1_PER_ID1 = rv.B1_PER_ID1
	AND b6.B1_PER_ID2 = rv.B1_PER_ID2
	AND b6.B1_PER_ID3 = rv.B1_PER_ID3
JOIN b1permit bp ON b6.SERV_PROV_CODE = bp.SERV_PROV_CODE
	AND b6.B1_PER_ID1 = bp.B1_PER_ID1
	AND b6.B1_PER_ID2 = bp.B1_PER_ID2
	AND b6.B1_PER_ID3 = bp.B1_PER_ID3

    LEFT JOIN gtmpl_attribute     charge ON b6.b1_con_nbr = charge.entity_seq1
                                        AND b6.b1_per_id1 = charge.entity_key1

                                        AND b6.b1_per_id3 = charge.entity_key3
                                        AND charge.entity_type = '11'
                                        AND charge.field_name = 'Charge Number'
    LEFT JOIN gtmpl_attribute     reason ON b6.b1_con_nbr = reason.entity_seq1
                                        AND b6.b1_per_id1 = reason.entity_key1
                                        AND b6.b1_per_id2 = reason.entity_key2
                                        AND b6.b1_per_id3 = reason.entity_key3
                                        AND reason.entity_type = '11'
                                        AND reason.field_name = 'Reason'
    LEFT JOIN gtmpl_attribute     pstatus ON b6.b1_con_nbr = pstatus.entity_seq1
                                         AND b6.b1_per_id1 = pstatus.entity_key1
                                         AND b6.b1_per_id2 = pstatus.entity_key2
                                         AND b6.b1_per_id3 = pstatus.entity_key3
                                         AND pstatus.entity_type = '11'
                                         AND pstatus.field_name = 'Payment Status'
    LEFT JOIN gtmpl_attribute     cycstatus ON b6.b1_con_nbr = cycstatus.entity_seq1
                                         AND b6.b1_per_id1 = cycstatus.entity_key1
                                         AND b6.b1_per_id2 = cycstatus.entity_key2
                                         AND b6.b1_per_id3 = cycstatus.entity_key3
                                         AND cycstatus.entity_type = '11'
                                         AND cycstatus.field_name = 'Cycle Number'
WHERE
        b6.b1_con_typ = 'Lien'
    AND b6.rec_status = 'A'
    AND b6.serv_prov_code = 'FDNY'
) tr where charge_num is not null

WITH APO AS (
select SERV_PROV_CODE,
		B1_PER_ID1,
		B1_PER_ID2,
		B1_PER_ID3,
		[BIN] as BIN,
		[BLOCK] as BLOCK,
		[LOT] as LOT
from 
(
SELECT
    apo.serv_prov_code AS SERV_PROV_CODE,
    apo.b1_per_id1 AS B1_PER_ID1,
	apo.b1_per_id2 AS B1_PER_ID2,
    apo.b1_per_id3 AS B1_PER_ID3,
    apo.b1_attribute_name,
    apo.b1_attribute_value
FROM
	b3apo_attribute apo
JOIN #TMP_Returned_Values rv ON APO.SERV_PROV_CODE = rv.SERV_PROV_CODE
	AND APO.B1_PER_ID1 = rv.B1_PER_ID1
	AND APO.B1_PER_ID2 = rv.B1_PER_ID2
	AND APO.B1_PER_ID3 = rv.B1_PER_ID3

WHERE
    apo.b1_attribute_name IN ( 'BIN', 'BLOCK','LOT' )
    AND apo.b1_apo_type IN ('ADDRESS')
    ) pva
PIVOT ( 
	MAX(b1_attribute_value) 
	for b1_attribute_name
       IN(
			[BIN],
			[BLOCK],
			[LOT]
		) 
	) pvb
)
select * INTO #TMP_APO from APO;
WITH result_data AS (
SELECT 
	RIGHT('0' + du.ACTDO, 2) AS DO,
    du.ALPHAPREFIX AS APFX, 
    du.ACTTYPE AS ACTTYP, 
    CASE WHEN du.ACTTYPE IN ('10', '15', '20', '25') THEN 'PERMIT' 
	ELSE 
	'NONPERMIT' 
	END AS PERMITGRP,
	CASE WHEN du.ACTTYPE IN ('10', '15', '20', '25') THEN DATEADD(day,455,CONVERT(DATE,li.F4INVOICE_UDF2)) 
	ELSE 
	DATEADD(day,120,CONVERT(DATE,li.F4INVOICE_UDF2)) 
	END AS DUEDATE,
    du.UNIT,
    bp.b1_alt_id AS RECORD_ID,
--    bp.b1_per_type AS per_type,
--    bp.b1_per_sub_type AS per_sub_type,
    bp.b1_appl_status AS STATUS, 
    bp.b1_appl_status_date AS STATUS_DATE,
--    bp.b1_file_dd AS file_date,                    
    cn.contact_name       AS OWNER_NAME,
--    cn.b1_contact_type AS contact_type,
    ba.b1_hse_nbr_alpha_start AS STR_NUM,
    ba.b1_str_name AS STR_NAME,
    ba.b1_situs_city AS STR_CITY,
    ba.b1_situs_state AS STR_STATE,
    ba.b1_situs_zip AS STR_ZIP,
	ap.BIN,
    ap.BLOCK, 
    ap.LOT,
    du.NO_FEE,
    du.NO_FEE_DATE,
    li.INVOICE_NBR,
    li.BALANCE_DUE,
    li.INVOICE_AMOUNT,
    li.F4INVOICE_UDF1 as CYCLE,
    li.F4INVOICE_UDF2 AS CYCLE_CLOCK,
    li.F4INVOICE_UDF3 AS FIRST_DUNNING_DATE,
    li.F4INVOICE_UDF4 AS FIRST_LIEN_NOTICE_DATE,
    li.REC_DATE,
    li.INVOICE_COMMENT 

FROM
         b1permit bp

    LEFT OUTER JOIN #TMP_contact         cn ON cn.serv_prov_code = bp.serv_prov_code
                                  AND cn.b1_per_id1 = bp.b1_per_id1
                                  AND cn.b1_per_id2 = bp.b1_per_id2
                                  AND cn.b1_per_id3 = bp.b1_per_id3
    LEFT OUTER JOIN #TMP_addr ba ON ba.serv_prov_code = bp.serv_prov_code
                                  AND ba.b1_per_id1 = bp.b1_per_id1
                                  AND ba.b1_per_id2 = bp.b1_per_id2
                                  AND ba.b1_per_id3 = bp.b1_per_id3

    INNER JOIN #TMP_APO ap      ON ap.serv_prov_code = bp.serv_prov_code
                                  AND ap.b1_per_id1 = bp.b1_per_id1
                                  AND ap.b1_per_id2 = bp.b1_per_id2
                                  AND ap.b1_per_id3 = bp.b1_per_id3

    INNER JOIN #TMP_do_unit du ON bp.serv_prov_code = du.serv_prov_code
                                   AND bp.b1_per_id1 = du.b1_per_id1
                                   AND bp.b1_per_id2 = du.b1_per_id2                                   
                                   AND bp.b1_per_id3 = du.b1_per_id3   
    INNER JOIN #TMP_Returned_Values li ON bp.serv_prov_code = li.serv_prov_code
                                   AND bp.b1_per_id1 = li.b1_per_id1
                                   AND bp.b1_per_id2 = li.b1_per_id2                                   
                                   AND bp.b1_per_id3 = li.b1_per_id3  
		
WHERE

       bp.b1_per_type = 'Common' 
       AND  bp.b1_per_sub_type = 'Inspection'
       AND bp.b1_appl_status <> 'Inactive'
	   AND ISDATE(li.F4INVOICE_UDF2) = 1
) 

select 
 DO,
 APFX, 
 ACTTYP, 
 PERMITGRP,
 DUEDATE,
 UNIT,
 RECORD_ID,
 STATUS, 
 STATUS_DATE,
 OWNER_NAME,
 STR_NUM,
 STR_NAME,
 STR_CITY,
 STR_STATE,
 STR_ZIP,
 BIN,
 BLOCK, 
 LOT,
 INVOICE_NBR,
 BALANCE_DUE,
 INVOICE_AMOUNT,
 CYCLE,
 CYCLE_CLOCK,
 FIRST_DUNNING_DATE,
 FIRST_LIEN_NOTICE_DATE,
 REC_DATE,
 INVOICE_COMMENT

 from result_data
WHERE
   PERMITGRP = 'PERMIT'
   AND DO NOT IN ('25','33')
   AND try_convert(DATE,DUEDATE)  <= GETDATE()
   AND NOT exists 
   (
   select * 
   from #TMP_lien 
   WHERE 
     acct_num = RECORD_ID and CYCLE = ISNULL(CYCLE_NUM,'0000000-00')
	)

WITH Returned_Values AS(
SELECT *
FROM
(
SELECT
   x.SERV_PROV_CODE,
   X.B1_PER_ID1,
   X.B1_PER_ID2,
   X.B1_PER_ID3,   
   F.INVOICE_NBR,
   F.BALANCE_DUE,
   F.INVOICE_AMOUNT,
   F.F4INVOICE_UDF1,
   F.F4INVOICE_UDF2,
   F.F4INVOICE_UDF3,
   F.F4INVOICE_UDF4,
   F.REC_DATE,
   F.INVOICE_COMMENT 
FROM
   F4INVOICE F 
   INNER JOIN
      X4FEEITEM_INVOICE X 
      ON X.INVOICE_NBR = F.INVOICE_NBR 
WHERE
       F.BALANCE_DUE > 0 
   AND F.F4INVOICE_UDF1 IS NOT NULL 
   AND F.F4INVOICE_UDF2 IS NOT NULL 
   AND F.F4INVOICE_UDF3 IS NOT NULL 
   AND 
(F.INVOICE_COMMENT LIKE CONCAT('%""%','secondReminder','""',':true','%')
      AND F.INVOICE_COMMENT NOT LIKE CONCAT('%""%','doNotProcess','""',':true','%')
      AND F.INVOICE_COMMENT NOT LIKE CONCAT('%""%','lienAdded','""',':true','%')
	  AND F.INVOICE_COMMENT LIKE CONCAT('%""%','secondPenAdded','""',':true','%')
   )
   AND F.SERV_PROV_CODE = 'FDNY' 
   AND ISDATE(F.F4INVOICE_UDF2) = 1
   AND DATEADD(day,120,try_convert(DATE,F.F4INVOICE_UDF2)) <= GETDATE()
GROUP BY
   x.SERV_PROV_CODE,
   X.B1_PER_ID1,
   X.B1_PER_ID2,
   X.B1_PER_ID3,   
   F.INVOICE_NBR,
   F.BALANCE_DUE,
   F.INVOICE_AMOUNT,
   F.F4INVOICE_UDF1,
   F.F4INVOICE_UDF2,
   F.F4INVOICE_UDF3,
   F.F4INVOICE_UDF4,
   F.REC_DATE,
   F.INVOICE_COMMENT 
   ) TR
--   WHERE
--           try_convert(DATE,F4INVOICE_UDF2)  <= GETDATE()
)

   F.INVOICE_AMOUNT,
   F.F4INVOICE_UDF1,
   F.F4INVOICE_UDF2,
   F.F4INVOICE_UDF3,
   F.F4INVOICE_UDF4,
   F.REC_DATE,
   F.INVOICE_COMMENT 
   ) TR
--   WHERE
--           try_convert(DATE,F4INVOICE_UDF2)  <= GETDATE()
) 
   select * INTO #TMP_Returned_Values from Returned_Values;

WITH do_unit AS (
select SERV_PROV_CODE,
       B1_PER_ID1,
	   B1_PER_ID2,
	   B1_PER_ID3,
	   [D.O.] as ACTDO,
	   [Alpha Prefix] as ALPHAPREFIX,
	   [Account Type] as ACTTYPE,
	   [No Fee] as NO_FEE,
	   [No Fee Date] as NO_FEE_DATE,
	   [Application Type] as UNIT 
 from 
(
SELECT
    bc.serv_prov_code AS SERV_PROV_CODE,
    bc.b1_per_id1 AS B1_PER_ID1,
    bc.b1_per_id2 AS B1_PER_ID2,
    bc.b1_per_id3 AS B1_PER_ID3,
    
    bc.b1_checkbox_desc,
    bc.b1_checklist_comment
 FROM
         bchckbox bc
JOIN #TMP_Returned_Values rv ON bc.SERV_PROV_CODE = rv.SERV_PROV_CODE
	AND bc.B1_PER_ID1 = rv.B1_PER_ID1
	AND bc.B1_PER_ID2 = rv.B1_PER_ID2
	AND bc.B1_PER_ID3 = rv.B1_PER_ID3
WHERE
    bc.b1_checkbox_desc IN ( 'Alpha Prefix', 'D.O.','Account Type','Application Type','No Fee','No Fee Date' )
    AND bc.b1_checkbox_type IN ('PLAN INFORMATION', 'PERMIT REPORT INFO','FEE EXEMPTION INFORMATION')
	AND bc.SERV_PROV_CODE = 'FDNY' 
    ) pvia
PIVOT ( MAX(b1_checklist_comment) for b1_checkbox_desc
            IN([D.O.],
			[Alpha Prefix],
			[Account Type],
			[No Fee],
			[No Fee Date],

			[Application Type])) pvib
)
select * INTO #TMP_do_unit from do_unit;
WITH balance AS (
SELECT
    pd.serv_prov_code AS SERV_PROV_CODE,
    pd.b1_per_id1 AS B1_PER_ID1,
    pd.b1_per_id2 AS B1_PER_ID2,
    pd.b1_per_id3 AS B1_PER_ID3,
    pd.balance
 FROM
         bpermit_detail pd
left JOIN #TMP_Returned_Values rv ON pd.SERV_PROV_CODE = rv.SERV_PROV_CODE
	AND pd.B1_PER_ID1 = rv.B1_PER_ID1
	AND pd.B1_PER_ID2 = rv.B1_PER_ID2
	AND pd.B1_PER_ID3 = rv.B1_PER_ID3
WHERE 1=1
	AND pd.SERV_PROV_CODE = 'FDNY' 
)
select * INTO #TMP_balance from balance;

WITH lien AS (
SELECT 
    serv_prov_code,
	b1_per_id1,
	b1_per_id2,
	b1_per_id3,
	acct_num,
	con_typ,
    con_nbr,
	charge_num,
    reason,
    payment_status,
	cycle_num,
    con_iss_dd,
    con_eff_dd
FROM
(
SELECT
    b6.serv_prov_code,
	b6.b1_per_id1,
	b6.b1_per_id2,
	b6.b1_per_id3,
	bp.b1_alt_id AS acct_num,
    b6.b1_con_typ AS con_typ,
    b6.b1_con_nbr AS con_nbr,
	RIGHT('0' + charge.field_value, 6) charge_num,
    reason.field_value   AS   reason,
    pstatus.field_value   AS  payment_status,
    cycstatus.field_value   AS  cycle_num,
    CONVERT(DATE,ISNULL(b6.b1_con_iss_dd,'1970-01-01')) AS con_iss_dd,
    CONVERT(DATE,ISNULL(b6.b1_con_eff_dd1,'1970-01-01'))  AS con_eff_dd

FROM
         b6condit b6
JOIN #TMP_Returned_Values rv ON b6.SERV_PROV_CODE = rv.SERV_PROV_CODE
	AND b6.B1_PER_ID1 = rv.B1_PER_ID1
	AND b6.B1_PER_ID2 = rv.B1_PER_ID2
	AND b6.B1_PER_ID3 = rv.B1_PER_ID3
JOIN b1permit bp ON b6.SERV_PROV_CODE = bp.SERV_PROV_CODE
	AND b6.B1_PER_ID1 = bp.B1_PER_ID1
	AND b6.B1_PER_ID2 = bp.B1_PER_ID2
	AND b6.B1_PER_ID3 = bp.B1_PER_ID3

    LEFT JOIN gtmpl_attribute     charge ON b6.b1_con_nbr = charge.entity_seq1
                                        AND b6.b1_per_id1 = charge.entity_key1
                                        AND b6.b1_per_id2 = charge.entity_key2
                                        AND b6.b1_per_id3 = charge.entity_key3
                                        AND charge.entity_type = '11'
                                        AND charge.field_name = 'Charge Number'
    LEFT JOIN gtmpl_attribute     reason ON b6.b1_con_nbr = reason.entity_seq1
                                        AND b6.b1_per_id1 = reason.entity_key1
                                        AND b6.b1_per_id2 = reason.entity_key2
                                        AND b6.b1_per_id3 = reason.entity_key3
                                        AND reason.entity_type = '11'
                                        AND reason.field_name = 'Reason'
    LEFT JOIN gtmpl_attribute     pstatus ON b6.b1_con_nbr = pstatus.entity_seq1
                                         AND b6.b1_per_id1 = pstatus.entity_key1
                                         AND b6.b1_per_id2 = pstatus.entity_key2
                                         AND b6.b1_per_id3 = pstatus.entity_key3
                                         AND pstatus.entity_type = '11'
                                         AND pstatus.field_name = 'Payment Status'
    LEFT JOIN gtmpl_attribute     cycstatus ON b6.b1_con_nbr = cycstatus.entity_seq1
                                         AND b6.b1_per_id1 = cycstatus.entity_key1
                                         AND b6.b1_per_id2 = cycstatus.entity_key2
                                         AND b6.b1_per_id3 = cycstatus.entity_key3
                                         AND cycstatus.entity_type = '11'
                                         AND cycstatus.field_name = 'Cycle Number'
WHERE
        b6.b1_con_typ = 'Lien'
    AND b6.rec_status = 'A'
    AND b6.serv_prov_code = 'FDNY'
) tr where charge_num is not null

)
select * INTO #TMP_lien from lien;
 --select * from #TMP_lien
WITH addr AS (
    SELECT
                serv_prov_code,
                b1_per_id1,
                b1_per_id2,
                b1_per_id3,
                b1_hse_nbr_alpha_start,
                b1_str_name,
                b1_situs_city,
                b1_situs_state,
                b1_situs_zip
    FROM
        (
            SELECT
                b.serv_prov_code,
                b.b1_per_id1,
                b.b1_per_id2,
                b.b1_per_id3,
                b.b1_hse_nbr_alpha_start,
                b.b1_str_name,
                b.b1_situs_city,
                b.b1_situs_state,
                b.b1_situs_zip,

                ROW_NUMBER()
                OVER(PARTITION BY b.serv_prov_code, b.b1_per_id1, b.b1_per_id2, b.b1_per_id3
                     ORDER BY
                         b.b1_primary_addr_flg DESC 
                ) rn
            FROM
                b3addres b
JOIN #TMP_Returned_Values rv ON b.SERV_PROV_CODE = rv.SERV_PROV_CODE
	AND b.B1_PER_ID1 = rv.B1_PER_ID1
	AND b.B1_PER_ID2 = rv.B1_PER_ID2
	AND b.B1_PER_ID3 = rv.B1_PER_ID3
WHERE
	 b.serv_prov_code = 'FDNY'
        ) tr
    WHERE  rn = 1
)
select * INTO #TMP_addr from addr;

WITH contact AS (
    SELECT
        serv_prov_code,
        b1_per_id1,
        b1_per_id2,
        b1_per_id3,
        contact_name,
        rec_date,
        b1_contact_type
    FROM
        (
            SELECT
            b.serv_prov_code,
            b.b1_per_id1,
            b.b1_per_id2,
            b.b1_per_id3,
               ISNULL(b1_business_name,CONCAT(b1_fname,' ',b1_lname)) as contact_name,
                b.rec_date,
                b.b1_contact_type,
                ROW_NUMBER()
                OVER(PARTITION BY b.serv_prov_code, b.b1_per_id1, b.b1_per_id2, b.b1_per_id3
                     ORDER BY
                         b.rec_date DESC 
                ) rn
            FROM
                b3contact b	
JOIN #TMP_Returned_Values rv ON b.SERV_PROV_CODE = rv.SERV_PROV_CODE
	AND b.B1_PER_ID1 = rv.B1_PER_ID1
	AND b.B1_PER_ID2 = rv.B1_PER_ID2
	AND b.B1_PER_ID3 = rv.B1_PER_ID3

            WHERE
                b.b1_contact_type IN 
				('Billing Contact') 
				AND b.SERV_PROV_CODE = 'FDNY'

        ) tr
    WHERE
        rn = 1
) 
select * INTO #TMP_contact from contact;
--select * from contact
WITH APO AS (
select SERV_PROV_CODE,
		B1_PER_ID1,
		B1_PER_ID2,
		B1_PER_ID3,
		[BIN] as BIN,
		[BLOCK] as BLOCK,
		[LOT] as LOT
from 
(
SELECT
    apo.serv_prov_code AS SERV_PROV_CODE,
    apo.b1_per_id1 AS B1_PER_ID1,
	apo.b1_per_id2 AS B1_PER_ID2,
    apo.b1_per_id3 AS B1_PER_ID3,
    apo.b1_attribute_name,
    apo.b1_attribute_value
FROM
	b3apo_attribute apo
JOIN #TMP_Returned_Values rv ON APO.SERV_PROV_CODE = rv.SERV_PROV_CODE
	AND APO.B1_PER_ID1 = rv.B1_PER_ID1
	AND APO.B1_PER_ID2 = rv.B1_PER_ID2
	AND APO.B1_PER_ID3 = rv.B1_PER_ID3

WHERE
    apo.b1_attribute_name IN ( 'BIN', 'BLOCK','LOT' )
    AND apo.b1_apo_type IN ('ADDRESS')
	and apo.serv_prov_code = 'FDNY'
    ) pva
PIVOT ( 
	MAX(b1_attribute_value) 
	for b1_attribute_name
       IN(
			[BIN],
			[BLOCK],
			[LOT]
		) 
	) pvb
)
select * INTO #TMP_APO from APO;
WITH result_data AS (
SELECT 
	RIGHT('0' + du.ACTDO, 2) AS DO,
--    du.ALPHAPREFIX AS APFX, 
    du.ACTTYPE AS ACTTYP, 
    PERMITGRP = CASE 
	WHEN du.ACTTYPE IN ('10', '15', '20', '25') AND du.ACTDO  <> '19'  THEN 'PERMIT' 
	ELSE 
	'NONPERMIT' 
	END ,
	DUEDATE =CASE 
	WHEN du.ACTTYPE IN ('10', '15', '20', '25')  AND du.ACTDO  <> '19' THEN DATEADD(day,455,CONVERT(DATE,li.F4INVOICE_UDF2)) 
	ELSE 
	DATEADD(day,120,CONVERT(DATE,li.F4INVOICE_UDF2)) 
	END,
    du.UNIT,
    bp.b1_alt_id AS RECORD_ID,
--    bp.b1_per_type AS per_type,
--    bp.b1_per_sub_type AS per_sub_type,
--    bp.b1_appl_status AS STATUS, 
--    bp.b1_appl_status_date AS STATUS_DATE,
--    bp.b1_file_dd AS file_date,                    
    cn.contact_name       AS OWNER_NAME,
--    cn.b1_contact_type AS contact_type,
    ba.b1_hse_nbr_alpha_start AS STR_NUM,
    ba.b1_str_name AS STR_NAME,
    ba.b1_situs_city AS STR_CITY,
    ba.b1_situs_state AS STR_STATE,
    ba.b1_situs_zip AS STR_ZIP,
--	ap.BIN,
    ap.BLOCK, 
    ap.LOT,
	bal.balance,
    du.NO_FEE,
    du.NO_FEE_DATE,
--    li.INVOICE_NBR,
--    li.BALANCE_DUE,
--    li.INVOICE_AMOUNT,
    li.F4INVOICE_UDF1 as CYCLE,
    li.F4INVOICE_UDF2 AS CYCLE_CLOCK
--    li.F4INVOICE_UDF3 AS FIRST_DUNNING_DATE,
--    li.F4INVOICE_UDF4 AS FIRST_LIEN_NOTICE_DATE,
--    li.REC_DATE,
--    li.INVOICE_COMMENT 

FROM
         b1permit bp

    LEFT OUTER JOIN #TMP_contact         cn ON cn.serv_prov_code = bp.serv_prov_code
                                  AND cn.b1_per_id1 = bp.b1_per_id1
                                  AND cn.b1_per_id2 = bp.b1_per_id2
                                  AND cn.b1_per_id3 = bp.b1_per_id3
    LEFT OUTER JOIN #TMP_addr ba ON ba.serv_prov_code = bp.serv_prov_code
                                  AND ba.b1_per_id1 = bp.b1_per_id1
                                  AND ba.b1_per_id2 = bp.b1_per_id2
                                  AND ba.b1_per_id3 = bp.b1_per_id3

    INNER JOIN #TMP_APO ap      ON ap.serv_prov_code = bp.serv_prov_code
                                  AND ap.b1_per_id1 = bp.b1_per_id1
                                  AND ap.b1_per_id2 = bp.b1_per_id2
                                  AND ap.b1_per_id3 = bp.b1_per_id3

    INNER JOIN #TMP_do_unit du ON bp.serv_prov_code = du.serv_prov_code
                                   AND bp.b1_per_id1 = du.b1_per_id1
                                   AND bp.b1_per_id2 = du.b1_per_id2                                   
                                   AND bp.b1_per_id3 = du.b1_per_id3  
    INNER JOIN #TMP_balance bal ON bp.serv_prov_code = bal.serv_prov_code
                                   AND bp.b1_per_id1 = bal.b1_per_id1
                                   AND bp.b1_per_id2 = bal.b1_per_id2                                   
                                   AND bp.b1_per_id3 = bal.b1_per_id3  								   
    INNER JOIN #TMP_Returned_Values li ON bp.serv_prov_code = li.serv_prov_code
                                   AND bp.b1_per_id1 = li.b1_per_id1
                                   AND bp.b1_per_id2 = li.b1_per_id2                                   
                                   AND bp.b1_per_id3 = li.b1_per_id3  
		
WHERE

       bp.b1_per_type = 'Common' 
       AND  bp.b1_per_sub_type = 'Inspection'
       AND bp.b1_appl_status <> 'Inactive'
	   AND ISDATE(li.F4INVOICE_UDF2) = 1
	   AND bp.serv_prov_code = 'FDNY'
	   AND (du.NO_FEE <> 'CHECKED' OR du.NO_FEE is null)
---	   AND bp.b1_alt_id = @ACCOUNTId
)
select distinct
	record_id,
	do,
	owner_name,
	str_num,
	str_name,
	str_city,
	str_state,
	str_zip,
	block,
	lot,
	balance,
	acttyp,
	cycle,
	cycle_clock

INTO #TMP_result_data from result_data
WHERE
   PERMITGRP = 'PERMIT'
   AND DO NOT IN ('25','33')
   AND try_convert(DATE,DUEDATE)  <=  @START_DATE
   AND NOT exists 
   (
   select * 
   from #TMP_lien 
   WHERE 
     acct_num = RECORD_ID and CYCLE = ISNULL(CYCLE_NUM,'0000000-00')
	);

WITH Returned_Values AS(
SELECT *
FROM
(
SELECT
   x.SERV_PROV_CODE,
   X.B1_PER_ID1,
   X.B1_PER_ID2,
   X.B1_PER_ID3,   
   F.INVOICE_NBR,
   F.BALANCE_DUE,
   F.INVOICE_AMOUNT,
   F.F4INVOICE_UDF1,
   F.F4INVOICE_UDF2,
   F.F4INVOICE_UDF3,
   F.F4INVOICE_UDF4,
   F.REC_DATE,
   F.INVOICE_COMMENT 
FROM
   F4INVOICE F 
   INNER JOIN
      X4FEEITEM_INVOICE X 
      ON X.INVOICE_NBR = F.INVOICE_NBR 
WHERE
       F.BALANCE_DUE > 0 
   AND F.F4INVOICE_UDF1 IS NOT NULL 
   AND F.F4INVOICE_UDF2 IS NOT NULL 
   AND F.F4INVOICE_UDF3 IS NOT NULL 
   AND 
(F.INVOICE_COMMENT LIKE CONCAT('%""%','secondReminder','""',':true','%')
      AND F.INVOICE_COMMENT NOT LIKE CONCAT('%""%','doNotProcess','""',':true','%')
      AND F.INVOICE_COMMENT NOT LIKE CONCAT('%""%','lienAdded','""',':true','%')
--	  AND F.INVOICE_COMMENT LIKE CONCAT('%""%','secondPenAdded','""',':true','%')
   )
   AND F.SERV_PROV_CODE = 'FDNY' 
   AND ISDATE(F.F4INVOICE_UDF2) = 1
   AND DATEADD(day,120,try_convert(DATE,F.F4INVOICE_UDF2)) <=  @START_DATE
GROUP BY
   x.SERV_PROV_CODE,
   X.B1_PER_ID1,
   X.B1_PER_ID2,
   X.B1_PER_ID3,   
   F.INVOICE_NBR,
   F.BALANCE_DUE,
   F.INVOICE_AMOUNT,
   F.F4INVOICE_UDF1,
   F.F4INVOICE_UDF2,
   F.F4INVOICE_UDF3,
   F.F4INVOICE_UDF4,
   F.REC_DATE,
   F.INVOICE_COMMENT 
   ) TR
--   WHERE
--           try_convert(DATE,F4INVOICE_UDF2)  <= GETDATE()
) 
   select * INTO #TMP_Returned_Values2 from Returned_Values;
-- select * from Returned_Values

WITH APO AS (
select SERV_PROV_CODE,
		B1_PER_ID1,
		B1_PER_ID2,
		B1_PER_ID3,
		[BIN] as BIN,
		[BLOCK] as BLOCK,
		[LOT] as LOT
from 
(
SELECT
    apo.serv_prov_code AS SERV_PROV_CODE,
    apo.b1_per_id1 AS B1_PER_ID1,
	apo.b1_per_id2 AS B1_PER_ID2,
    apo.b1_per_id3 AS B1_PER_ID3,
    apo.b1_attribute_name,
    apo.b1_attribute_value
FROM
	b3apo_attribute apo
JOIN #TMP_Returned_Values2 rv ON APO.SERV_PROV_CODE = rv.SERV_PROV_CODE
	AND APO.B1_PER_ID1 = rv.B1_PER_ID1
	AND APO.B1_PER_ID2 = rv.B1_PER_ID2
	AND APO.B1_PER_ID3 = rv.B1_PER_ID3

WHERE
    apo.b1_attribute_name IN ( 'BIN', 'BLOCK','LOT' )
    AND apo.b1_apo_type IN ('ADDRESS')
	AND apo.serv_prov_code = 'FDNY'
    ) pva
PIVOT ( 
	MAX(b1_attribute_value) 
	for b1_attribute_name
       IN(
			[BIN],
			[BLOCK],
			[LOT]
		) 
	) pvb
)

WITH result_data2 AS (
SELECT 
	RIGHT('0' + du.ACTDO, 2) AS DO,
--    du.ALPHAPREFIX AS APFX, 
    du.ACTTYPE AS ACTTYP, 
    PERMITGRP = CASE 
	WHEN du.ACTTYPE IN ('10', '15', '20', '25') AND du.ACTDO  <> '19'  THEN 'PERMIT' 
	ELSE 
	'NONPERMIT' 
	END ,
	DUEDATE =CASE 
	WHEN du.ACTTYPE IN ('10', '15', '20', '25')  AND du.ACTDO  <> '19' THEN DATEADD(day,455,CONVERT(DATE,li.F4INVOICE_UDF2)) 
	ELSE 
	DATEADD(day,120,CONVERT(DATE,li.F4INVOICE_UDF2)) 
	END,
    du.UNIT,
    bp.b1_alt_id AS RECORD_ID,
--    bp.b1_per_type AS per_type,
--    bp.b1_per_sub_type AS per_sub_type,
--    bp.b1_appl_status AS STATUS, 
--    bp.b1_appl_status_date AS STATUS_DATE,
--    bp.b1_file_dd AS file_date,                    
    cn.contact_name       AS OWNER_NAME,
--    cn.b1_contact_type AS contact_type,
    ba.b1_hse_nbr_alpha_start AS STR_NUM,
    ba.b1_str_name AS STR_NAME,
    ba.b1_situs_city AS STR_CITY,
    ba.b1_situs_state AS STR_STATE,
    ba.b1_situs_zip AS STR_ZIP,
--	ap.BIN,
    ap.BLOCK, 
    ap.LOT,
	bal.balance,
    du.NO_FEE,
    du.NO_FEE_DATE,
--    li.INVOICE_NBR,
--    li.BALANCE_DUE,
--    li.INVOICE_AMOUNT,
    li.F4INVOICE_UDF1 as CYCLE,
    li.F4INVOICE_UDF2 AS CYCLE_CLOCK
--    li.F4INVOICE_UDF3 AS FIRST_DUNNING_DATE,
--    li.F4INVOICE_UDF4 AS FIRST_LIEN_NOTICE_DATE,
--    li.REC_DATE,
--    li.INVOICE_COMMENT 

FROM
         b1permit bp

    LEFT OUTER JOIN #TMP_contact2         cn ON cn.serv_prov_code = bp.serv_prov_code
                                  AND cn.b1_per_id1 = bp.b1_per_id1
                                  AND cn.b1_per_id2 = bp.b1_per_id2
                                  AND cn.b1_per_id3 = bp.b1_per_id3
    LEFT OUTER JOIN #TMP_addr2 ba ON ba.serv_prov_code = bp.serv_prov_code
                                  AND ba.b1_per_id1 = bp.b1_per_id1
                                  AND ba.b1_per_id2 = bp.b1_per_id2
                                  AND ba.b1_per_id3 = bp.b1_per_id3

    INNER JOIN #TMP_APO2 ap      ON ap.serv_prov_code = bp.serv_prov_code
                                  AND ap.b1_per_id1 = bp.b1_per_id1
                                  AND ap.b1_per_id2 = bp.b1_per_id2
                                  AND ap.b1_per_id3 = bp.b1_per_id3

    INNER JOIN #TMP_do_unit2 du ON bp.serv_prov_code = du.serv_prov_code
                                   AND bp.b1_per_id1 = du.b1_per_id1
                                   AND bp.b1_per_id2 = du.b1_per_id2                                   
                                   AND bp.b1_per_id3 = du.b1_per_id3   
    INNER JOIN #TMP_balance2 bal ON bp.serv_prov_code = bal.serv_prov_code
                                   AND bp.b1_per_id1 = bal.b1_per_id1
                                   AND bp.b1_per_id2 = bal.b1_per_id2                                   
                                   AND bp.b1_per_id3 = bal.b1_per_id3 
    INNER JOIN #TMP_Returned_Values2 li ON bp.serv_prov_code = li.serv_prov_code
                                   AND bp.b1_per_id1 = li.b1_per_id1
                                   AND bp.b1_per_id2 = li.b1_per_id2                                   
                                   AND bp.b1_per_id3 = li.b1_per_id3  
		
WHERE

       bp.b1_per_type = 'Common' 
       AND  bp.b1_per_sub_type = 'Inspection'
       AND bp.b1_appl_status <> 'Inactive'
	   AND ISDATE(li.F4INVOICE_UDF2) = 1
	   and bp.serv_prov_code = 'FDNY'
	   AND (du.NO_FEE <> 'CHECKED' OR du.NO_FEE is null)
---	   AND bp.b1_alt_id = @ACCOUNTID
) 
select distinct
	record_id,
	do,
	owner_name,
	str_num,
	str_name,
	str_city,
	str_state,
	str_zip,
	block,
	lot,
	balance,
	acttyp,
	cycle,
	cycle_clock
INTO #TMP_result_data2 from result_data2
WHERE
   PERMITGRP = 'NONPERMIT'
   AND DO NOT IN ('25','33')
   AND try_convert(DATE,DUEDATE)  <=  @START_DATE
   AND NOT exists 
   (
   select * 
   from #TMP_lien2 
   WHERE 
     acct_num = RECORD_ID and CYCLE = ISNULL(CYCLE_NUM,'0000000-00')
	);

select * FROM #TMP_result_data
 UNION

)

WITH Returned_Values AS(
SELECT *
FROM
(
SELECT
   x.SERV_PROV_CODE,
   X.B1_PER_ID1,
   X.B1_PER_ID2,
   X.B1_PER_ID3,   
   F.INVOICE_NBR,
   F.BALANCE_DUE,
   F.INVOICE_AMOUNT,
   F.F4INVOICE_UDF1,
   F.F4INVOICE_UDF2,
   F.F4INVOICE_UDF3,
   F.F4INVOICE_UDF4,
   F.REC_DATE,
   F.INVOICE_COMMENT 
FROM
   F4INVOICE F 
   INNER JOIN
      X4FEEITEM_INVOICE X 
      ON X.INVOICE_NBR = F.INVOICE_NBR 
WHERE
       F.BALANCE_DUE > 0 
   AND F.F4INVOICE_UDF1 IS NOT NULL 
   AND F.F4INVOICE_UDF2 IS NOT NULL 
   AND F.F4INVOICE_UDF3 IS NOT NULL 
   AND 
(F.INVOICE_COMMENT LIKE CONCAT('%""%','secondReminder','""',':true','%')
      AND F.INVOICE_COMMENT NOT LIKE CONCAT('%""%','doNotProcess','""',':true','%')
      AND F.INVOICE_COMMENT NOT LIKE CONCAT('%""%','lienAdded','""',':true','%')
	  AND F.INVOICE_COMMENT LIKE CONCAT('%""%','secondPenAdded','""',':true','%')
   )
   AND F.SERV_PROV_CODE = 'FDNY' 
   AND ISDATE(F.F4INVOICE_UDF2) = 1
   AND DATEADD(day,120,try_convert(DATE,F.F4INVOICE_UDF2)) <= GETDATE()
GROUP BY
   x.SERV_PROV_CODE,
   X.B1_PER_ID1,
   X.B1_PER_ID2,
   X.B1_PER_ID3,   
   F.INVOICE_NBR,
   F.BALANCE_DUE,
   F.INVOICE_AMOUNT,
   F.F4INVOICE_UDF1,
   F.F4INVOICE_UDF2,
   F.F4INVOICE_UDF3,
   F.F4INVOICE_UDF4,
   F.REC_DATE,
   F.INVOICE_COMMENT 
   ) TR
--   WHERE
--           try_convert(DATE,F4INVOICE_UDF2)  <= GETDATE()
) 
   select * INTO #TMP_Returned_Values from Returned_Values;
-- select * from Returned_Values

WITH do_unit AS (
select SERV_PROV_CODE,
       B1_PER_ID1,
	   B1_PER_ID2,
	   B1_PER_ID3,
	   [D.O.] as ACTDO,
	   [Alpha Prefix] as ALPHAPREFIX,
	   [Account Type] as ACTTYPE,
	   [No Fee] as NO_FEE,
	   [No Fee Date] as NO_FEE_DATE,
	   [Application Type] as UNIT 
 from 
(
SELECT
    bc.serv_prov_code AS SERV_PROV_CODE,
    bc.b1_per_id1 AS B1_PER_ID1,
    bc.b1_per_id2 AS B1_PER_ID2,
    bc.b1_per_id3 AS B1_PER_ID3,
    
    bc.b1_checkbox_desc,
    bc.b1_checklist_comment
 FROM
         bchckbox bc
JOIN #TMP_Returned_Values rv ON bc.SERV_PROV_CODE = rv.SERV_PROV_CODE
	AND bc.B1_PER_ID1 = rv.B1_PER_ID1
	AND bc.B1_PER_ID2 = rv.B1_PER_ID2
	AND bc.B1_PER_ID3 = rv.B1_PER_ID3
WHERE
    bc.b1_checkbox_desc IN ( 'Alpha Prefix', 'D.O.','Account Type','Application Type','No Fee','No Fee Date' )
    AND bc.b1_checkbox_type IN ('PLAN INFORMATION', 'PERMIT REPORT INFO','FEE EXEMPTION INFORMATION')
	AND bc.SERV_PROV_CODE = 'FDNY' 
    ) pvia
PIVOT ( MAX(b1_checklist_comment) for b1_checkbox_desc
            IN([D.O.],
			[Alpha Prefix],
			[Account Type],
			[No Fee],
			[No Fee Date],

			[Application Type])) pvib
)
   select * INTO #TMP_do_unit from do_unit;
WITH lien AS (
SELECT 
    serv_prov_code,
	b1_per_id1,
	b1_per_id2,
	b1_per_id3,
	acct_num,
	con_typ,
    con_nbr,
	charge_num,
    reason,
    payment_status,
	cycle_num,
    con_iss_dd,
    con_eff_dd
FROM
(
SELECT
    b6.serv_prov_code,
	b6.b1_per_id1,
	b6.b1_per_id2,
	b6.b1_per_id3,
	bp.b1_alt_id AS acct_num,
    b6.b1_con_typ AS con_typ,
    b6.b1_con_nbr AS con_nbr,
	RIGHT('0' + charge.field_value, 6) charge_num,
    reason.field_value   AS   reason,
    pstatus.field_value   AS  payment_status,
    cycstatus.field_value   AS  cycle_num,
    CONVERT(DATE,ISNULL(b6.b1_con_iss_dd,'1970-01-01')) AS con_iss_dd,
    CONVERT(DATE,ISNULL(b6.b1_con_eff_dd1,'1970-01-01'))  AS con_eff_dd

FROM
         b6condit b6
JOIN #TMP_Returned_Values rv ON b6.SERV_PROV_CODE = rv.SERV_PROV_CODE
	AND b6.B1_PER_ID1 = rv.B1_PER_ID1
	AND b6.B1_PER_ID2 = rv.B1_PER_ID2
	AND b6.B1_PER_ID3 = rv.B1_PER_ID3
JOIN b1permit bp ON b6.SERV_PROV_CODE = bp.SERV_PROV_CODE
	AND b6.B1_PER_ID1 = bp.B1_PER_ID1
	AND b6.B1_PER_ID2 = bp.B1_PER_ID2
	AND b6.B1_PER_ID3 = bp.B1_PER_ID3

    LEFT JOIN gtmpl_attribute     charge ON b6.b1_con_nbr = charge.entity_seq1
                                        AND b6.b1_per_id1 = charge.entity_key1
                                        AND b6.b1_per_id2 = charge.entity_key2
                                        AND b6.b1_per_id3 = charge.entity_key3
                                        AND charge.entity_type = '11'
                                        AND charge.field_name = 'Charge Number'
    LEFT JOIN gtmpl_attribute     reason ON b6.b1_con_nbr = reason.entity_seq1
                                        AND b6.b1_per_id1 = reason.entity_key1
                                        AND b6.b1_per_id2 = reason.entity_key2
                                        AND b6.b1_per_id3 = reason.entity_key3
                                        AND reason.entity_type = '11'
                                        AND reason.field_name = 'Reason'
    LEFT JOIN gtmpl_attribute     pstatus ON b6.b1_con_nbr = pstatus.entity_seq1
                                         AND b6.b1_per_id1 = pstatus.entity_key1
                                         AND b6.b1_per_id2 = pstatus.entity_key2
                                         AND b6.b1_per_id3 = pstatus.entity_key3
                                         AND pstatus.entity_type = '11'
                                         AND pstatus.field_name = 'Payment Status'
    LEFT JOIN gtmpl_attribute     cycstatus ON b6.b1_con_nbr = cycstatus.entity_seq1
                                         AND b6.b1_per_id1 = cycstatus.entity_key1
                                         AND b6.b1_per_id2 = cycstatus.entity_key2
                                         AND b6.b1_per_id3 = cycstatus.entity_key3
                                         AND cycstatus.entity_type = '11'
                                         AND cycstatus.field_name = 'Cycle Number'
WHERE
        b6.b1_con_typ = 'Lien'
    AND b6.rec_status = 'A'
    AND b6.serv_prov_code = 'FDNY'
) tr where charge_num is not null

)
select * INTO #TMP_lien from lien;

                                   AND bp.b1_per_id3 = li.b1_per_id3

       AND bp.b1_appl_status <> 'Inactive'
	   AND ISDATE(li.F4INVOICE_UDF2) = 1
	   AND bp.serv_prov_code = 'FDNY'

	AND b6.B1_PER_ID3 = rv.B1_PER_ID3

	AND b6.B1_PER_ID3 = bp.B1_PER_ID3

                                        AND charge.entity_type = '11'
                                        AND charge.field_name = 'Charge Number'
    LEFT JOIN gtmpl_attribute     reason ON b6.b1_con_nbr = reason.entity_seq1
                                        AND b6.b1_per_id1 = reason.entity_key1
                                        AND b6.b1_per_id2 = reason.entity_key2
                                        AND b6.b1_per_id3 = reason.entity_key3
                                        AND reason.entity_type = '11'
                                        AND reason.field_name = 'Reason'
    LEFT JOIN gtmpl_attribute     pstatus ON b6.b1_con_nbr = pstatus.entity_seq1
                                         AND b6.b1_per_id1 = pstatus.entity_key1
                                         AND b6.b1_per_id2 = pstatus.entity_key2
                                         AND b6.b1_per_id3 = pstatus.entity_key3
                                         AND pstatus.entity_type = '11'
                                         AND pstatus.field_name = 'Payment Status'
    LEFT JOIN gtmpl_attribute     cycstatus ON b6.b1_con_nbr = cycstatus.entity_seq1
                                         AND b6.b1_per_id1 = cycstatus.entity_key1
                                         AND b6.b1_per_id2 = cycstatus.entity_key2
                                         AND b6.b1_per_id3 = cycstatus.entity_key3
                                         AND cycstatus.entity_type = '11'
                                         AND cycstatus.field_name = 'Cycle Number'
WHERE
        b6.b1_con_typ = 'Lien'
    AND b6.rec_status = 'A'
    AND b6.serv_prov_code = 'FDNY'
) tr where charge_num is not null

)

	b3apo_attribute apo

	AND APO.B1_PER_ID1 = rv.B1_PER_ID1

       IN(

			[LOT]
		) 
	) pvb

                                  AND cn.b1_per_id1 = bp.b1_per_id1
                                  AND cn.b1_per_id2 = bp.b1_per_id2
                                  AND cn.b1_per_id3 = bp.b1_per_id3
    LEFT OUTER JOIN #TMP_addr2 ba ON ba.serv_prov_code = bp.serv_prov_code
                                  AND ba.b1_per_id1 = bp.b1_per_id1
                                  AND ba.b1_per_id2 = bp.b1_per_id2
                                  AND ba.b1_per_id3 = bp.b1_per_id3

    INNER JOIN #TMP_APO2 ap      ON ap.serv_prov_code = bp.serv_prov_code
                                  AND ap.b1_per_id1 = bp.b1_per_id1
                                  AND ap.b1_per_id2 = bp.b1_per_id2
                                  AND ap.b1_per_id3 = bp.b1_per_id3

    INNER JOIN #TMP_do_unit2 du ON bp.serv_prov_code = du.serv_prov_code
                                   AND bp.b1_per_id1 = du.b1_per_id1
                                   AND bp.b1_per_id2 = du.b1_per_id2                                   
                                   AND bp.b1_per_id3 = du.b1_per_id3   
    INNER JOIN #TMP_Returned_Values2 li ON bp.serv_prov_code = li.serv_prov_code
                                   AND bp.b1_per_id1 = li.b1_per_id1
                                   AND bp.b1_per_id2 = li.b1_per_id2                                   
                                   AND bp.b1_per_id3 = li.b1_per_id3
