	b6.b1_per_id2,
	b6.b1_per_id3,
	bp.b1_alt_id AS acct_num,
    b6.b1_con_typ AS con_typ,
    b6.b1_con_nbr AS con_nbr,
	RIGHT('0' + charge.field_value, 6) charge_num,
    reason.field_value   AS   reason,
    pstatus.field_value   AS  payment_status,
    cycstatus.field_value   AS  cycle_num,
    CONVERT(DATE,ISNULL(b6.b1_con_iss_dd,'1970-01-01')) AS con_iss_dd,
    CONVERT(DATE,ISNULL(b6.b1_con_eff_dd1,'1970-01-01'))  AS con_eff_dd

FROM
         b6condit b6
JOIN #TMP_Returned_Values rv ON b6.SERV_PROV_CODE = rv.SERV_PROV_CODE
	AND b6.B1_PER_ID1 = rv.B1_PER_ID1
	AND b6.B1_PER_ID2 = rv.B1_PER_ID2
	AND b6.B1_PER_ID3 = rv.B1_PER_ID3
JOIN b1permit bp ON b6.SERV_PROV_CODE = bp.SERV_PROV_CODE
	AND b6.B1_PER_ID1 = bp.B1_PER_ID1
	AND b6.B1_PER_ID2 = bp.B1_PER_ID2
	AND b6.B1_PER_ID3 = bp.B1_PER_ID3

    LEFT JOIN gtmpl_attribute     charge ON b6.b1_con_nbr = charge.entity_seq1
                                        AND b6.b1_per_id1 = charge.entity_key1
                                        AND b6.b1_per_id2 = charge.entity_key2
                                        AND b6.b1_per_id3 = charge.entity_key3
                                        AND charge.entity_type = '11'
                                        AND charge.field_name = 'Charge Number'
    LEFT JOIN gtmpl_attribute     reason ON b6.b1_con_nbr = reason.entity_seq1
                                        AND b6.b1_per_id1 = reason.entity_key1
                                        AND b6.b1_per_id2 = reason.entity_key2
                                        AND b6.b1_per_id3 = reason.entity_key3
                                        AND reason.entity_type = '11'
                                        AND reason.field_name = 'Reason'
    LEFT JOIN gtmpl_attribute     pstatus ON b6.b1_con_nbr = pstatus.entity_seq1
                                         AND b6.b1_per_id1 = pstatus.entity_key1
                                         AND b6.b1_per_id2 = pstatus.entity_key2
                                         AND b6.b1_per_id3 = pstatus.entity_key3
                                         AND pstatus.entity_type = '11'
                                         AND pstatus.field_name = 'Payment Status'
    LEFT JOIN gtmpl_attribute     cycstatus ON b6.b1_con_nbr = cycstatus.entity_seq1
                                         AND b6.b1_per_id1 = cycstatus.entity_key1
                                         AND b6.b1_per_id2 = cycstatus.entity_key2
                                         AND b6.b1_per_id3 = cycstatus.entity_key3
                                         AND cycstatus.entity_type = '11'
                                         AND cycstatus.field_name = 'Cycle Number'
WHERE
        b6.b1_con_typ = 'Lien'
    AND b6.rec_status = 'A'
    AND b6.serv_prov_code = 'FDNY'
) tr where charge_num is not null

)
select * INTO #TMP_lien from lien;
 --select * from #TMP_lien
WITH addr AS (
    SELECT
                serv_prov_code,
                b1_per_id1,
                b1_per_id2,
                b1_per_id3,
                b1_hse_nbr_alpha_start,
                b1_str_name,
                b1_situs_city,
                b1_situs_state,

	AND b.B1_PER_ID1 = rv.B1_PER_ID1

        serv_prov_code,

        b1_per_id3,
        contact_name,
        rec_date,

    FROM

            b.serv_prov_code,

               ISNULL(b1_business_name,CONCAT(b1_fname,' ',b1_lname)) as contact_name,
                b.rec_date,
                b.b1_contact_type,
                ROW_NUMBER()
                OVER(PARTITION BY b.serv_prov_code, b.b1_per_id1, b.b1_per_id2, b.b1_per_id3
                     ORDER BY
                         b.rec_date DESC 
                ) rn
            FROM
                b3contact b	
JOIN #TMP_Returned_Values rv ON b.SERV_PROV_CODE = rv.SERV_PROV_CODE
	AND b.B1_PER_ID1 = rv.B1_PER_ID1
	AND b.B1_PER_ID2 = rv.B1_PER_ID2
	AND b.B1_PER_ID3 = rv.B1_PER_ID3

            WHERE
                b.b1_contact_type IN 
				('Billing Contact') 
				AND b.SERV_PROV_CODE = 'FDNY'

        ) tr
    WHERE
        rn = 1

select * INTO #TMP_contact from contact;
--select * from contact
WITH APO AS (
select SERV_PROV_CODE,
		B1_PER_ID1,
		B1_PER_ID2,
		B1_PER_ID3,
		[BIN] as BIN,
		[BLOCK] as BLOCK,
		[LOT] as LOT
from 
(
SELECT
    apo.serv_prov_code AS SERV_PROV_CODE,
    apo.b1_per_id1 AS B1_PER_ID1,
	apo.b1_per_id2 AS B1_PER_ID2,
    apo.b1_per_id3 AS B1_PER_ID3,
    apo.b1_attribute_name,
    apo.b1_attribute_value
FROM
	b3apo_attribute apo
JOIN #TMP_Returned_Values rv ON APO.SERV_PROV_CODE = rv.SERV_PROV_CODE
	AND APO.B1_PER_ID1 = rv.B1_PER_ID1
	AND APO.B1_PER_ID2 = rv.B1_PER_ID2
	AND APO.B1_PER_ID3 = rv.B1_PER_ID3

WHERE
    apo.b1_attribute_name IN ( 'BIN', 'BLOCK','LOT' )
    AND apo.b1_apo_type IN ('ADDRESS')
	and apo.serv_prov_code = 'FDNY'
    ) pva
PIVOT ( 
	MAX(b1_attribute_value) 
	for b1_attribute_name
       IN(
			[BIN],
			[BLOCK],
			[LOT]
		) 
	) pvb
)
select * INTO #TMP_APO from APO;
WITH result_data AS (
SELECT 
	RIGHT('0' + du.ACTDO, 2) AS DO,
--    du.ALPHAPREFIX AS APFX, 
    du.ACTTYPE AS ACTTYP, 
    PERMITGRP = CASE 
	WHEN du.ACTTYPE IN ('10', '15', '20', '25') AND du.ACTDO  <> '19'  THEN 'PERMIT' 
	ELSE 
	'NONPERMIT' 
	END ,
	DUEDATE =CASE 
	WHEN du.ACTTYPE IN ('10', '15', '20', '25')  AND du.ACTDO  <> '19' THEN DATEADD(day,455,CONVERT(DATE,li.F4INVOICE_UDF2)) 
	ELSE 
	DATEADD(day,120,CONVERT(DATE,li.F4INVOICE_UDF2)) 
	END,
    du.UNIT,
    bp.b1_alt_id AS RECORD_ID,
--    bp.b1_per_type AS per_type,
--    bp.b1_per_sub_type AS per_sub_type,
--    bp.b1_appl_status AS STATUS, 
--    bp.b1_appl_status_date AS STATUS_DATE,
--    bp.b1_file_dd AS file_date,                    
    cn.contact_name       AS OWNER_NAME,
--    cn.b1_contact_type AS contact_type,
    ba.b1_hse_nbr_alpha_start AS STR_NUM,
    ba.b1_str_name AS STR_NAME,
    ba.b1_situs_city AS STR_CITY,
    ba.b1_situs_state AS STR_STATE,
    ba.b1_situs_zip AS STR_ZIP,
--	ap.BIN,
    ap.BLOCK, 
    ap.LOT,
    du.NO_FEE,
    du.NO_FEE_DATE,
--    li.INVOICE_NBR,
--    li.BALANCE_DUE,
--    li.INVOICE_AMOUNT,
    li.F4INVOICE_UDF1 as CYCLE,
    li.F4INVOICE_UDF2 AS CYCLE_CLOCK
--    li.F4INVOICE_UDF3 AS FIRST_DUNNING_DATE,
--    li.F4INVOICE_UDF4 AS FIRST_LIEN_NOTICE_DATE,
--    li.REC_DATE,
--    li.INVOICE_COMMENT 

FROM
         b1permit bp

    LEFT OUTER JOIN #TMP_contact         cn ON cn.serv_prov_code = bp.serv_prov_code
                                  AND cn.b1_per_id1 = bp.b1_per_id1
                                  AND cn.b1_per_id2 = bp.b1_per_id2
                                  AND cn.b1_per_id3 = bp.b1_per_id3
    LEFT OUTER JOIN #TMP_addr ba ON ba.serv_prov_code = bp.serv_prov_code
                                  AND ba.b1_per_id1 = bp.b1_per_id1
                                  AND ba.b1_per_id2 = bp.b1_per_id2
                                  AND ba.b1_per_id3 = bp.b1_per_id3

    INNER JOIN #TMP_APO ap      ON ap.serv_prov_code = bp.serv_prov_code
                                  AND ap.b1_per_id1 = bp.b1_per_id1
                                  AND ap.b1_per_id2 = bp.b1_per_id2
                                  AND ap.b1_per_id3 = bp.b1_per_id3

    INNER JOIN #TMP_do_unit du ON bp.serv_prov_code = du.serv_prov_code
                                   AND bp.b1_per_id1 = du.b1_per_id1
                                   AND bp.b1_per_id2 = du.b1_per_id2                                   
                                   AND bp.b1_per_id3 = du.b1_per_id3   
    INNER JOIN #TMP_Returned_Values li ON bp.serv_prov_code = li.serv_prov_code
                                   AND bp.b1_per_id1 = li.b1_per_id1
                                   AND bp.b1_per_id2 = li.b1_per_id2                                   
                                   AND bp.b1_per_id3 = li.b1_per_id3  
		
WHERE

       bp.b1_per_type = 'Common' 
       AND  bp.b1_per_sub_type = 'Inspection'
       AND bp.b1_appl_status <> 'Inactive'
	   AND ISDATE(li.F4INVOICE_UDF2) = 1
	   AND bp.serv_prov_code = 'FDNY'
	   and du.NO_FEE is null
---	   AND bp.b1_alt_id = @ACCOUNTId
)
select distinct
	record_id,
	do,
	unit,
	owner_name,
	str_num,
	str_name,
	str_city,
	str_state,
	str_zip,
	block,
	lot,
	acttyp,
	cycle,
	cycle_clock

INTO #TMP_result_data from result_data
WHERE
   PERMITGRP = 'PERMIT'
   AND DO NOT IN ('25','33')
   AND try_convert(DATE,DUEDATE)  <= GETDATE()
   AND NOT exists 
   (
   select * 
   from #TMP_lien 
   WHERE 
     acct_num = RECORD_ID and CYCLE = ISNULL(CYCLE_NUM,'0000000-00')
	);

WITH Returned_Values AS(
SELECT *
FROM
(
SELECT
   x.SERV_PROV_CODE,
   X.B1_PER_ID1,
   X.B1_PER_ID2,
   X.B1_PER_ID3,   
   F.INVOICE_NBR,
   F.BALANCE_DUE,
   F.INVOICE_AMOUNT,
   F.F4INVOICE_UDF1,
   F.F4INVOICE_UDF2,
   F.F4INVOICE_UDF3,
   F.F4INVOICE_UDF4,
   F.REC_DATE,
   F.INVOICE_COMMENT 
FROM
   F4INVOICE F 
   INNER JOIN
      X4FEEITEM_INVOICE X 
      ON X.INVOICE_NBR = F.INVOICE_NBR 
WHERE
       F.BALANCE_DUE > 0 
   AND F.F4INVOICE_UDF1 IS NOT NULL 
   AND F.F4INVOICE_UDF2 IS NOT NULL 
   AND F.F4INVOICE_UDF3 IS NOT NULL 
   AND 
(F.INVOICE_COMMENT LIKE CONCAT('%""%','secondReminder','""',':true','%')
      AND F.INVOICE_COMMENT NOT LIKE CONCAT('%""%','doNotProcess','""',':true','%')
      AND F.INVOICE_COMMENT NOT LIKE CONCAT('%""%','lienAdded','""',':true','%')
--	  AND F.INVOICE_COMMENT LIKE CONCAT('%""%','secondPenAdded','""',':true','%')
   )
   AND F.SERV_PROV_CODE = 'FDNY' 
   AND ISDATE(F.F4INVOICE_UDF2) = 1
   AND DATEADD(day,120,try_convert(DATE,F.F4INVOICE_UDF2)) <= GETDATE()
GROUP BY
   x.SERV_PROV_CODE,
   X.B1_PER_ID1,
   X.B1_PER_ID2,
   X.B1_PER_ID3,   
   F.INVOICE_NBR,
   F.BALANCE_DUE,
   F.INVOICE_AMOUNT,
   F.F4INVOICE_UDF1,
   F.F4INVOICE_UDF2,
   F.F4INVOICE_UDF3,
   F.F4INVOICE_UDF4,
   F.REC_DATE,
   F.INVOICE_COMMENT 
   ) TR
--   WHERE
--           try_convert(DATE,F4INVOICE_UDF2)  <= GETDATE()
) 
   select * INTO #TMP_Returned_Values2 from Returned_Values;
-- select * from Returned_Values

WITH do_unit AS (
select SERV_PROV_CODE,
       B1_PER_ID1,
	   B1_PER_ID2,
	   B1_PER_ID3,
	   [D.O.] as ACTDO,
	   [Alpha Prefix] as ALPHAPREFIX,
	   [Account Type] as ACTTYPE,
	   [No Fee] as NO_FEE,
	   [No Fee Date] as NO_FEE_DATE,
	   [Application Type] as UNIT 
 from 
(
SELECT
    bc.serv_prov_code AS SERV_PROV_CODE,
    bc.b1_per_id1 AS B1_PER_ID1,
    bc.b1_per_id2 AS B1_PER_ID2,
    bc.b1_per_id3 AS B1_PER_ID3,
    
    bc.b1_checkbox_desc,
    bc.b1_checklist_comment
 FROM
         bchckbox bc
JOIN #TMP_Returned_Values2 rv ON bc.SERV_PROV_CODE = rv.SERV_PROV_CODE
	AND bc.B1_PER_ID1 = rv.B1_PER_ID1
	AND bc.B1_PER_ID2 = rv.B1_PER_ID2
	AND bc.B1_PER_ID3 = rv.B1_PER_ID3
WHERE
    bc.b1_checkbox_desc IN ( 'Alpha Prefix', 'D.O.','Account Type','Application Type','No Fee','No Fee Date' )
    AND bc.b1_checkbox_type IN ('PLAN INFORMATION', 'PERMIT REPORT INFO','FEE EXEMPTION INFORMATION')
	AND bC.serv_prov_code = 'FDNY'
    ) pvia
PIVOT ( MAX(b1_checklist_comment) for b1_checkbox_desc
            IN([D.O.],
			[Alpha Prefix],
			[Account Type],
			[No Fee],
			[No Fee Date],

			[Application Type])) pvib
)
   select * INTO #TMP_do_unit2 from do_unit;

WITH Returned_Values AS(
SELECT *
FROM
(
SELECT
   x.SERV_PROV_CODE,
   X.B1_PER_ID1,
   X.B1_PER_ID2,
   X.B1_PER_ID3,   
   F.INVOICE_NBR,
   F.BALANCE_DUE,
   F.INVOICE_AMOUNT,
   F.F4INVOICE_UDF1,
   F.F4INVOICE_UDF2,
   F.F4INVOICE_UDF3,
   F.F4INVOICE_UDF4,
   F.REC_DATE,
   F.INVOICE_COMMENT 
FROM
   F4INVOICE F 
   INNER JOIN
      X4FEEITEM_INVOICE X 
      ON X.INVOICE_NBR = F.INVOICE_NBR 
WHERE
       F.BALANCE_DUE > 0 
   AND F.F4INVOICE_UDF1 IS NOT NULL 
   AND F.F4INVOICE_UDF2 IS NOT NULL 
   AND F.F4INVOICE_UDF3 IS NOT NULL 
   AND 
(F.INVOICE_COMMENT LIKE CONCAT('%""%','secondReminder','""',':true','%')
      AND F.INVOICE_COMMENT NOT LIKE CONCAT('%""%','doNotProcess','""',':true','%')
      AND F.INVOICE_COMMENT NOT LIKE CONCAT('%""%','lienAdded','""',':true','%')
	  AND F.INVOICE_COMMENT LIKE CONCAT('%""%','secondPenAdded','""',':true','%')
   )
   AND F.SERV_PROV_CODE = 'FDNY' 
   AND ISDATE(F.F4INVOICE_UDF2) = 1
   AND DATEADD(day,120,try_convert(DATE,F.F4INVOICE_UDF2)) <= GETDATE()
GROUP BY
   x.SERV_PROV_CODE,
   X.B1_PER_ID1,
   X.B1_PER_ID2,
   X.B1_PER_ID3,   
   F.INVOICE_NBR,
   F.BALANCE_DUE,
   F.INVOICE_AMOUNT,
   F.F4INVOICE_UDF1,
   F.F4INVOICE_UDF2,
   F.F4INVOICE_UDF3,
   F.F4INVOICE_UDF4,
   F.REC_DATE,
   F.INVOICE_COMMENT 
   ) TR
--   WHERE
--           try_convert(DATE,F4INVOICE_UDF2)  <= GETDATE()
) 
   select * INTO #TMP_Returned_Values from Returned_Values;
-- select * from Returned_Values

WITH do_unit AS (
select SERV_PROV_CODE,
       B1_PER_ID1,
	   B1_PER_ID2,
	   B1_PER_ID3,
	   [D.O.] as ACTDO,
	   [Alpha Prefix] as ALPHAPREFIX,
	   [Account Type] as ACTTYPE,
	   [No Fee] as NO_FEE,
	   [No Fee Date] as NO_FEE_DATE,
	   [Application Type] as UNIT 
 from 
(
SELECT
    bc.serv_prov_code AS SERV_PROV_CODE,
    bc.b1_per_id1 AS B1_PER_ID1,
    bc.b1_per_id2 AS B1_PER_ID2,
    bc.b1_per_id3 AS B1_PER_ID3,
    
    bc.b1_checkbox_desc,
    bc.b1_checklist_comment
 FROM
         bchckbox bc
JOIN #TMP_Returned_Values rv ON bc.SERV_PROV_CODE = rv.SERV_PROV_CODE
	AND bc.B1_PER_ID1 = rv.B1_PER_ID1
	AND bc.B1_PER_ID2 = rv.B1_PER_ID2
	AND bc.B1_PER_ID3 = rv.B1_PER_ID3
WHERE
    bc.b1_checkbox_desc IN ( 'Alpha Prefix', 'D.O.','Account Type','Application Type','No Fee','No Fee Date' )
    AND bc.b1_checkbox_type IN ('PLAN INFORMATION', 'PERMIT REPORT INFO','FEE EXEMPTION INFORMATION')
	AND bc.SERV_PROV_CODE = 'FDNY' 
    ) pvia
PIVOT ( MAX(b1_checklist_comment) for b1_checkbox_desc
            IN([D.O.],
			[Alpha Prefix],
			[Account Type],
			[No Fee],
			[No Fee Date],

			[Application Type])) pvib
)
select * INTO #TMP_do_unit from do_unit;
WITH balance AS (
SELECT
    pd.serv_prov_code AS SERV_PROV_CODE,
    pd.b1_per_id1 AS B1_PER_ID1,
    pd.b1_per_id2 AS B1_PER_ID2,
    pd.b1_per_id3 AS B1_PER_ID3,
    pd.balance
 FROM
         bpermit_detail pd
left JOIN #TMP_Returned_Values rv ON pd.SERV_PROV_CODE = rv.SERV_PROV_CODE
	AND pd.B1_PER_ID1 = rv.B1_PER_ID1
	AND pd.B1_PER_ID2 = rv.B1_PER_ID2
	AND pd.B1_PER_ID3 = rv.B1_PER_ID3
WHERE 1=1
	AND pd.SERV_PROV_CODE = 'FDNY' 
)
select * INTO #TMP_balance from balance;

WITH lien AS (
SELECT 
    serv_prov_code,
	b1_per_id1,
	b1_per_id2,
	b1_per_id3,
	acct_num,
	con_typ,
    con_nbr,
	charge_num,
    reason,
    payment_status,
	cycle_num,
    con_iss_dd,
    con_eff_dd
FROM
(
SELECT
    b6.serv_prov_code,
	b6.b1_per_id1,
	b6.b1_per_id2,
	b6.b1_per_id3,
	bp.b1_alt_id AS acct_num,
    b6.b1_con_typ AS con_typ,
    b6.b1_con_nbr AS con_nbr,
	RIGHT('0' + charge.field_value, 6) charge_num,
    reason.field_value   AS   reason,
    pstatus.field_value   AS  payment_status,
    cycstatus.field_value   AS  cycle_num,
    CONVERT(DATE,ISNULL(b6.b1_con_iss_dd,'1970-01-01')) AS con_iss_dd,
    CONVERT(DATE,ISNULL(b6.b1_con_eff_dd1,'1970-01-01'))  AS con_eff_dd

FROM
         b6condit b6
JOIN #TMP_Returned_Values rv ON b6.SERV_PROV_CODE = rv.SERV_PROV_CODE
	AND b6.B1_PER_ID1 = rv.B1_PER_ID1
	AND b6.B1_PER_ID2 = rv.B1_PER_ID2
	AND b6.B1_PER_ID3 = rv.B1_PER_ID3
JOIN b1permit bp ON b6.SERV_PROV_CODE = bp.SERV_PROV_CODE
	AND b6.B1_PER_ID1 = bp.B1_PER_ID1
	AND b6.B1_PER_ID2 = bp.B1_PER_ID2
	AND b6.B1_PER_ID3 = bp.B1_PER_ID3

    LEFT JOIN gtmpl_attribute     charge ON b6.b1_con_nbr = charge.entity_seq1
                                        AND b6.b1_per_id1 = charge.entity_key1
                                        AND b6.b1_per_id2 = charge.entity_key2
                                        AND b6.b1_per_id3 = charge.entity_key3
                                        AND charge.entity_type = '11'
                                        AND charge.field_name = 'Charge Number'
    LEFT JOIN gtmpl_attribute     reason ON b6.b1_con_nbr = reason.entity_seq1
                                        AND b6.b1_per_id1 = reason.entity_key1
                                        AND b6.b1_per_id2 = reason.entity_key2
                                        AND b6.b1_per_id3 = reason.entity_key3
                                        AND reason.entity_type = '11'
                                        AND reason.field_name = 'Reason'
    LEFT JOIN gtmpl_attribute     pstatus ON b6.b1_con_nbr = pstatus.entity_seq1
                                         AND b6.b1_per_id1 = pstatus.entity_key1
                                         AND b6.b1_per_id2 = pstatus.entity_key2
                                         AND b6.b1_per_id3 = pstatus.entity_key3
                                         AND pstatus.entity_type = '11'
                                         AND pstatus.field_name = 'Payment Status'
    LEFT JOIN gtmpl_attribute     cycstatus ON b6.b1_con_nbr = cycstatus.entity_seq1
                                         AND b6.b1_per_id1 = cycstatus.entity_key1
                                         AND b6.b1_per_id2 = cycstatus.entity_key2
                                         AND b6.b1_per_id3 = cycstatus.entity_key3
                                         AND cycstatus.entity_type = '11'
                                         AND cycstatus.field_name = 'Cycle Number'
WHERE
        b6.b1_con_typ = 'Lien'
    AND b6.rec_status = 'A'
    AND b6.serv_prov_code = 'FDNY'
) tr where charge_num is not null

)
select * INTO #TMP_lien from lien;
 --select * from #TMP_lien
WITH addr AS (

	 b.serv_prov_code = 'FDNY'
        ) tr
    WHERE  rn = 1

WITH contact AS (
    SELECT
        serv_prov_code,
        b1_per_id1,
        b1_per_id2,
        b1_per_id3,
        contact_name,
        rec_date,
        b1_contact_type
    FROM
        (
            SELECT
            b.serv_prov_code,
            b.b1_per_id1,
            b.b1_per_id2,
            b.b1_per_id3,
            b.b1_full_name as contact_name,
                b.rec_date,
                b.b1_contact_type,
                ROW_NUMBER()
                OVER(PARTITION BY b.serv_prov_code, b.b1_per_id1, b.b1_per_id2, b.b1_per_id3
                     ORDER BY
                         b.rec_date DESC 
                ) rn
            FROM
                b3contact b	
JOIN #TMP_Returned_Values rv ON b.SERV_PROV_CODE = rv.SERV_PROV_CODE
	AND b.B1_PER_ID1 = rv.B1_PER_ID1
	AND b.B1_PER_ID2 = rv.B1_PER_ID2
	AND b.B1_PER_ID3 = rv.B1_PER_ID3

            WHERE
                b.b1_contact_type IN 
				('Billing Contact') 
				AND b.SERV_PROV_CODE = 'FDNY'

        ) tr
    WHERE
        rn = 1
) 
select * INTO #TMP_contact from contact;

WITH APO AS (
select SERV_PROV_CODE,
		B1_PER_ID1,
		B1_PER_ID2,
		B1_PER_ID3,
		[BIN] as BIN,
		[BLOCK] as BLOCK,
		[LOT] as LOT
from 
(
SELECT
    apo.serv_prov_code AS SERV_PROV_CODE,
    apo.b1_per_id1 AS B1_PER_ID1,
	apo.b1_per_id2 AS B1_PER_ID2,
    apo.b1_per_id3 AS B1_PER_ID3,
    apo.b1_attribute_name,
    apo.b1_attribute_value
FROM
	b3apo_attribute apo
JOIN #TMP_Returned_Values rv ON APO.SERV_PROV_CODE = rv.SERV_PROV_CODE
	AND APO.B1_PER_ID1 = rv.B1_PER_ID1
	AND APO.B1_PER_ID2 = rv.B1_PER_ID2
	AND APO.B1_PER_ID3 = rv.B1_PER_ID3

WHERE
    apo.b1_attribute_name IN ( 'BIN', 'BLOCK','LOT' )
    AND apo.b1_apo_type IN ('ADDRESS')
	and apo.serv_prov_code = 'FDNY'
    ) pva
PIVOT ( 
	MAX(b1_attribute_value) 
	for b1_attribute_name
       IN(
			[BIN],
			[BLOCK],
			[LOT]
		) 
	) pvb
)
select * INTO #TMP_APO from APO;

                                  AND cn.b1_per_id1 = bp.b1_per_id1
                                  AND cn.b1_per_id2 = bp.b1_per_id2
                                  AND cn.b1_per_id3 = bp.b1_per_id3
    LEFT OUTER JOIN #TMP_addr ba ON ba.serv_prov_code = bp.serv_prov_code
                                  AND ba.b1_per_id1 = bp.b1_per_id1
                                  AND ba.b1_per_id2 = bp.b1_per_id2
                                  AND ba.b1_per_id3 = bp.b1_per_id3

    INNER JOIN #TMP_APO ap      ON ap.serv_prov_code = bp.serv_prov_code
                                  AND ap.b1_per_id1 = bp.b1_per_id1
                                  AND ap.b1_per_id2 = bp.b1_per_id2
                                  AND ap.b1_per_id3 = bp.b1_per_id3

    INNER JOIN #TMP_do_unit du ON bp.serv_prov_code = du.serv_prov_code
                                   AND bp.b1_per_id1 = du.b1_per_id1
                                   AND bp.b1_per_id2 = du.b1_per_id2                                   
                                   AND bp.b1_per_id3 = du.b1_per_id3  
    INNER JOIN #TMP_balance bal ON bp.serv_prov_code = bal.serv_prov_code
                                   AND bp.b1_per_id1 = bal.b1_per_id1
                                   AND bp.b1_per_id2 = bal.b1_per_id2                                   
                                   AND bp.b1_per_id3 = bal.b1_per_id3  								   
    INNER JOIN #TMP_Returned_Values li ON bp.serv_prov_code = li.serv_prov_code
                                   AND bp.b1_per_id1 = li.b1_per_id1
                                   AND bp.b1_per_id2 = li.b1_per_id2                                   
                                   AND bp.b1_per_id3 = li.b1_per_id3  
		
WHERE

       bp.b1_per_type = 'Common' 
       AND  bp.b1_per_sub_type = 'Inspection'
       AND bp.b1_appl_status <> 'Inactive'
	   AND ISDATE(li.F4INVOICE_UDF2) = 1
	   AND bp.serv_prov_code = 'FDNY'
	   AND (du.NO_FEE <> 'CHECKED' OR du.NO_FEE is null)

WITH lien AS (
SELECT 
    serv_prov_code,
	b1_per_id1,
	b1_per_id2,
	b1_per_id3,
	acct_num,
	con_typ,
    con_nbr,
	charge_num,
    reason,
    payment_status,
	cycle_num,
    con_iss_dd,
    con_eff_dd
FROM
(
SELECT
    b6.serv_prov_code,
	b6.b1_per_id1,
	b6.b1_per_id2,
	b6.b1_per_id3,
	bp.b1_alt_id AS acct_num,
    b6.b1_con_typ AS con_typ,
    b6.b1_con_nbr AS con_nbr,
	RIGHT('0' + charge.field_value, 6) charge_num,
    reason.field_value   AS   reason,
    pstatus.field_value   AS  payment_status,
    cycstatus.field_value   AS  cycle_num,
    CONVERT(DATE,ISNULL(b6.b1_con_iss_dd,'1970-01-01')) AS con_iss_dd,
    CONVERT(DATE,ISNULL(b6.b1_con_eff_dd1,'1970-01-01'))  AS con_eff_dd

FROM
         b6condit b6
JOIN #TMP_Returned_Values2 rv ON b6.SERV_PROV_CODE = rv.SERV_PROV_CODE
	AND b6.B1_PER_ID1 = rv.B1_PER_ID1
	AND b6.B1_PER_ID2 = rv.B1_PER_ID2
	AND b6.B1_PER_ID3 = rv.B1_PER_ID3
JOIN b1permit bp ON b6.SERV_PROV_CODE = bp.SERV_PROV_CODE
	AND b6.B1_PER_ID1 = bp.B1_PER_ID1
	AND b6.B1_PER_ID2 = bp.B1_PER_ID2
	AND b6.B1_PER_ID3 = bp.B1_PER_ID3

    LEFT JOIN gtmpl_attribute     charge ON b6.b1_con_nbr = charge.entity_seq1
                                        AND b6.b1_per_id1 = charge.entity_key1
                                        AND b6.b1_per_id2 = charge.entity_key2
                                        AND b6.b1_per_id3 = charge.entity_key3
                                        AND charge.entity_type = '11'
                                        AND charge.field_name = 'Charge Number'
    LEFT JOIN gtmpl_attribute     reason ON b6.b1_con_nbr = reason.entity_seq1
                                        AND b6.b1_per_id1 = reason.entity_key1
                                        AND b6.b1_per_id2 = reason.entity_key2
                                        AND b6.b1_per_id3 = reason.entity_key3
                                        AND reason.entity_type = '11'
                                        AND reason.field_name = 'Reason'
    LEFT JOIN gtmpl_attribute     pstatus ON b6.b1_con_nbr = pstatus.entity_seq1
                                         AND b6.b1_per_id1 = pstatus.entity_key1
                                         AND b6.b1_per_id2 = pstatus.entity_key2
                                         AND b6.b1_per_id3 = pstatus.entity_key3
                                         AND pstatus.entity_type = '11'
                                         AND pstatus.field_name = 'Payment Status'
    LEFT JOIN gtmpl_attribute     cycstatus ON b6.b1_con_nbr = cycstatus.entity_seq1
                                         AND b6.b1_per_id1 = cycstatus.entity_key1
                                         AND b6.b1_per_id2 = cycstatus.entity_key2
                                         AND b6.b1_per_id3 = cycstatus.entity_key3
                                         AND cycstatus.entity_type = '11'
                                         AND cycstatus.field_name = 'Cycle Number'
WHERE
        b6.b1_con_typ = 'Lien'
    AND b6.rec_status = 'A'
    AND b6.serv_prov_code = 'FDNY'
) tr where charge_num is not null

)
select * INTO #TMP_lien2 from lien;

WITH APO AS (
select SERV_PROV_CODE,
		B1_PER_ID1,
		B1_PER_ID2,
		B1_PER_ID3,
		[BIN] as BIN,
		[BLOCK] as BLOCK,
		[LOT] as LOT
from 
(

    apo.serv_prov_code AS SERV_PROV_CODE,
    apo.b1_per_id1 AS B1_PER_ID1,
	apo.b1_per_id2 AS B1_PER_ID2,

    apo.b1_attribute_name,
    apo.b1_attribute_value
FROM
	b3apo_attribute apo

	AND APO.B1_PER_ID1 = rv.B1_PER_ID1
	AND APO.B1_PER_ID2 = rv.B1_PER_ID2
	AND APO.B1_PER_ID3 = rv.B1_PER_ID3

WHERE

    AND apo.b1_apo_type IN ('ADDRESS')
	AND apo.serv_prov_code = 'FDNY'
    ) pva

	MAX(b1_attribute_value)

       IN(
			[BIN],
			[BLOCK],
			[LOT]
		) 
	) pvb
)

WITH result_data2 AS (
SELECT 
	RIGHT('0' + du.ACTDO, 2) AS DO,
--    du.ALPHAPREFIX AS APFX, 
    du.ACTTYPE AS ACTTYP, 
    PERMITGRP = CASE 
	WHEN du.ACTTYPE IN ('10', '15', '20', '25') AND du.ACTDO  <> '19'  THEN 'PERMIT' 
	ELSE 
	'NONPERMIT' 
	END ,
	DUEDATE =CASE 
	WHEN du.ACTTYPE IN ('10', '15', '20', '25')  AND du.ACTDO  <> '19' THEN DATEADD(day,455,CONVERT(DATE,li.F4INVOICE_UDF2)) 
	ELSE 
	DATEADD(day,120,CONVERT(DATE,li.F4INVOICE_UDF2)) 
	END,
    du.UNIT,
    bp.b1_alt_id AS RECORD_ID,
--    bp.b1_per_type AS per_type,
--    bp.b1_per_sub_type AS per_sub_type,
--    bp.b1_appl_status AS STATUS, 
--    bp.b1_appl_status_date AS STATUS_DATE,
--    bp.b1_file_dd AS file_date,                    
    cn.contact_name       AS OWNER_NAME,
--    cn.b1_contact_type AS contact_type,
    ba.b1_hse_nbr_alpha_start AS STR_NUM,
    ba.b1_str_name AS STR_NAME,
    ba.b1_situs_city AS STR_CITY,
    ba.b1_situs_state AS STR_STATE,
    ba.b1_situs_zip AS STR_ZIP,
--	ap.BIN,
    ap.BLOCK, 
    ap.LOT,
	bal.balance,
    du.NO_FEE,
    du.NO_FEE_DATE,
--    li.INVOICE_NBR,
--    li.BALANCE_DUE,
--    li.INVOICE_AMOUNT,
    li.F4INVOICE_UDF1 as CYCLE,
    li.F4INVOICE_UDF2 AS CYCLE_CLOCK
--    li.F4INVOICE_UDF3 AS FIRST_DUNNING_DATE,
--    li.F4INVOICE_UDF4 AS FIRST_LIEN_NOTICE_DATE,
--    li.REC_DATE,
--    li.INVOICE_COMMENT 

FROM
         b1permit bp

    LEFT OUTER JOIN #TMP_contact2         cn ON cn.serv_prov_code = bp.serv_prov_code
                                  AND cn.b1_per_id1 = bp.b1_per_id1
                                  AND cn.b1_per_id2 = bp.b1_per_id2
                                  AND cn.b1_per_id3 = bp.b1_per_id3
    LEFT OUTER JOIN #TMP_addr2 ba ON ba.serv_prov_code = bp.serv_prov_code
                                  AND ba.b1_per_id1 = bp.b1_per_id1
                                  AND ba.b1_per_id2 = bp.b1_per_id2
                                  AND ba.b1_per_id3 = bp.b1_per_id3

    INNER JOIN #TMP_APO2 ap      ON ap.serv_prov_code = bp.serv_prov_code
                                  AND ap.b1_per_id1 = bp.b1_per_id1
                                  AND ap.b1_per_id2 = bp.b1_per_id2
                                  AND ap.b1_per_id3 = bp.b1_per_id3

    INNER JOIN #TMP_do_unit2 du ON bp.serv_prov_code = du.serv_prov_code
                                   AND bp.b1_per_id1 = du.b1_per_id1
                                   AND bp.b1_per_id2 = du.b1_per_id2                                   
                                   AND bp.b1_per_id3 = du.b1_per_id3   
    INNER JOIN #TMP_balance2 bal ON bp.serv_prov_code = bal.serv_prov_code
                                   AND bp.b1_per_id1 = bal.b1_per_id1
                                   AND bp.b1_per_id2 = bal.b1_per_id2                                   
                                   AND bp.b1_per_id3 = bal.b1_per_id3 
    INNER JOIN #TMP_Returned_Values2 li ON bp.serv_prov_code = li.serv_prov_code
                                   AND bp.b1_per_id1 = li.b1_per_id1
                                   AND bp.b1_per_id2 = li.b1_per_id2                                   
                                   AND bp.b1_per_id3 = li.b1_per_id3  
		
WHERE

       bp.b1_per_type = 'Common' 
       AND  bp.b1_per_sub_type = 'Inspection'
       AND bp.b1_appl_status <> 'Inactive'
	   AND ISDATE(li.F4INVOICE_UDF2) = 1
	   and bp.serv_prov_code = 'FDNY'
	   AND (du.NO_FEE <> 'CHECKED' OR du.NO_FEE is null)
--	   AND bp.b1_alt_id = @ACCOUNTID
) 
select distinct
	record_id,
	do,
	owner_name,
	str_num,
	str_name,
	str_city,
	str_state,
	str_zip,
	block,
	lot,
	balance,
	acttyp,
	cycle,
	cycle_clock
INTO #TMP_result_data2 from result_data2
WHERE
   PERMITGRP = 'NONPERMIT'
   AND DO NOT IN ('25','33')
   AND try_convert(DATE,DUEDATE)  <= GETDATE()
   AND NOT exists 
   (
   select * 
   from #TMP_lien2 
   WHERE 
     acct_num = RECORD_ID and CYCLE = ISNULL(CYCLE_NUM,'0000000-00')
	);
WITH all_data as (
select * FROM #TMP_result_data
 UNION
select * FROM #TMP_result_data2
)
select * from all_data order by owner_name, record_id;

WITH Returned_Values AS(
SELECT *
FROM
(
SELECT
   x.SERV_PROV_CODE,
   X.B1_PER_ID1,
   X.B1_PER_ID2,
   X.B1_PER_ID3,   
   F.INVOICE_NBR,
   F.BALANCE_DUE,
   F.INVOICE_AMOUNT,
   F.F4INVOICE_UDF1,
   F.F4INVOICE_UDF2,
   F.F4INVOICE_UDF3,
   F.F4INVOICE_UDF4,
   F.REC_DATE,
   F.INVOICE_COMMENT 
FROM
   F4INVOICE F 
   INNER JOIN
      X4FEEITEM_INVOICE X 
      ON X.INVOICE_NBR = F.INVOICE_NBR 
WHERE
       F.BALANCE_DUE > 0 
   AND F.F4INVOICE_UDF1 IS NOT NULL 
   AND F.F4INVOICE_UDF2 IS NOT NULL 
   AND F.F4INVOICE_UDF3 IS NOT NULL 
   AND 
(F.INVOICE_COMMENT LIKE CONCAT('%""%','secondReminder','""',':true','%')
      AND F.INVOICE_COMMENT NOT LIKE CONCAT('%""%','doNotProcess','""',':true','%')
      AND F.INVOICE_COMMENT NOT LIKE CONCAT('%""%','lienAdded','""',':true','%')
	  AND F.INVOICE_COMMENT LIKE CONCAT('%""%','secondPenAdded','""',':true','%')
   )
   AND F.SERV_PROV_CODE = 'FDNY' 
   AND ISDATE(F.F4INVOICE_UDF2) = 1
   AND DATEADD(day,455,try_convert(DATE,F.F4INVOICE_UDF2)) <= GETDATE()
GROUP BY
   x.SERV_PROV_CODE,
   X.B1_PER_ID1,
   X.B1_PER_ID2,
   X.B1_PER_ID3,   
   F.INVOICE_NBR,
   F.BALANCE_DUE,
   F.INVOICE_AMOUNT,
   F.F4INVOICE_UDF1,
   F.F4INVOICE_UDF2,
   F.F4INVOICE_UDF3,
   F.F4INVOICE_UDF4,
   F.REC_DATE,
   F.INVOICE_COMMENT 
   ) TR
--   WHERE
--           try_convert(DATE,F4INVOICE_UDF2)  <= GETDATE()
) 
   select * INTO #TMP_Returned_Values from Returned_Values;

	AND b6.B1_PER_ID2 = rv.B1_PER_ID2
	AND b6.B1_PER_ID3 = rv.B1_PER_ID3
JOIN b1permit bp ON b6.SERV_PROV_CODE = bp.SERV_PROV_CODE
	AND b6.B1_PER_ID1 = bp.B1_PER_ID1
	AND b6.B1_PER_ID2 = bp.B1_PER_ID2
	AND b6.B1_PER_ID3 = bp.B1_PER_ID3

    LEFT JOIN gtmpl_attribute     charge ON b6.b1_con_nbr = charge.entity_seq1
                                        AND b6.b1_per_id1 = charge.entity_key1
                                        AND b6.b1_per_id2 = charge.entity_key2
                                        AND b6.b1_per_id3 = charge.entity_key3
                                        AND charge.entity_type = '11'
                                        AND charge.field_name = 'Charge Number'
    LEFT JOIN gtmpl_attribute     reason ON b6.b1_con_nbr = reason.entity_seq1
                                        AND b6.b1_per_id1 = reason.entity_key1
                                        AND b6.b1_per_id2 = reason.entity_key2
                                        AND b6.b1_per_id3 = reason.entity_key3
                                        AND reason.entity_type = '11'
                                        AND reason.field_name = 'Reason'
    LEFT JOIN gtmpl_attribute     pstatus ON b6.b1_con_nbr = pstatus.entity_seq1
                                         AND b6.b1_per_id1 = pstatus.entity_key1
                                         AND b6.b1_per_id2 = pstatus.entity_key2
                                         AND b6.b1_per_id3 = pstatus.entity_key3
                                         AND pstatus.entity_type = '11'
                                         AND pstatus.field_name = 'Payment Status'
    LEFT JOIN gtmpl_attribute     cycstatus ON b6.b1_con_nbr = cycstatus.entity_seq1
                                         AND b6.b1_per_id1 = cycstatus.entity_key1
                                         AND b6.b1_per_id2 = cycstatus.entity_key2
                                         AND b6.b1_per_id3 = cycstatus.entity_key3
                                         AND cycstatus.entity_type = '11'
                                         AND cycstatus.field_name = 'Cycle Number'
WHERE
        b6.b1_con_typ = 'Lien'
    AND b6.rec_status = 'A'
    AND b6.serv_prov_code = 'FDNY'
) tr where charge_num is not null

)
select * INTO #TMP_lien from lien;
 --select * from #TMP_lien
WITH addr AS (
    SELECT
                serv_prov_code,
                b1_per_id1,
                b1_per_id2,

                b1_str_name,

WITH contact AS (
    SELECT
        serv_prov_code,
        b1_per_id1,
        b1_per_id2,
        b1_per_id3,
        contact_name,
        rec_date,
        b1_contact_type
    FROM
        (
            SELECT
            b.serv_prov_code,
            b.b1_per_id1,
            b.b1_per_id2,
            b.b1_per_id3,
			CASE
				WHEN b.b1_business_name IS NOT NULL THEN b.b1_business_name
				WHEN b.b1_business_name IS NULL AND b.b1_business_name IS NOT NULL THEN b.b1_business_name
				ELSE CONCAT(b1_fname,' ',b1_lname)
			END  as contact_name,
                b.rec_date,
                b.b1_contact_type,
                ROW_NUMBER()
                OVER(PARTITION BY b.serv_prov_code, b.b1_per_id1, b.b1_per_id2, b.b1_per_id3
                     ORDER BY
                         b.rec_date DESC 
                ) rn
            FROM
                b3contact b	
JOIN #TMP_Returned_Values rv ON b.SERV_PROV_CODE = rv.SERV_PROV_CODE
	AND b.B1_PER_ID1 = rv.B1_PER_ID1
	AND b.B1_PER_ID2 = rv.B1_PER_ID2
	AND b.B1_PER_ID3 = rv.B1_PER_ID3

            WHERE
                b.b1_contact_type IN 
				('Billing Contact') 
				AND b.SERV_PROV_CODE = 'FDNY'

        ) tr
    WHERE
        rn = 1
) 
select * INTO #TMP_contact from contact;
--select * from contact
WITH APO AS (
select SERV_PROV_CODE,
		B1_PER_ID1,
		B1_PER_ID2,
		B1_PER_ID3,
		[BIN] as BIN,
		[BLOCK] as BLOCK,
		[LOT] as LOT
from 
(
SELECT
    apo.serv_prov_code AS SERV_PROV_CODE,
    apo.b1_per_id1 AS B1_PER_ID1,
	apo.b1_per_id2 AS B1_PER_ID2,
    apo.b1_per_id3 AS B1_PER_ID3,
    apo.b1_attribute_name,
    apo.b1_attribute_value
FROM
	b3apo_attribute apo
JOIN #TMP_Returned_Values rv ON APO.SERV_PROV_CODE = rv.SERV_PROV_CODE
	AND APO.B1_PER_ID1 = rv.B1_PER_ID1
	AND APO.B1_PER_ID2 = rv.B1_PER_ID2
	AND APO.B1_PER_ID3 = rv.B1_PER_ID3

WHERE
    apo.b1_attribute_name IN ( 'BIN', 'BLOCK','LOT' )
    AND apo.b1_apo_type IN ('ADDRESS')
	and apo.serv_prov_code = 'FDNY'
    ) pva
PIVOT ( 
	MAX(b1_attribute_value) 
	for b1_attribute_name
       IN(
			[BIN],
			[BLOCK],
			[LOT]
		) 
	) pvb
)
select * INTO #TMP_APO from APO;
WITH result_data AS (
SELECT 
	RIGHT('0' + du.ACTDO, 2) AS DO,
--    du.ALPHAPREFIX AS APFX, 
    du.ACTTYPE AS ACTTYP, 
    PERMITGRP = CASE 
	WHEN du.ACTTYPE IN ('10', '15', '20', '25') AND du.ACTDO  <> '19'  THEN 'PERMIT' 
	ELSE 
	'NONPERMIT' 
	END ,
	DUEDATE =CASE 
	WHEN du.ACTTYPE IN ('10', '15', '20', '25')  AND du.ACTDO  <> '19' THEN DATEADD(day,455,CONVERT(DATE,li.F4INVOICE_UDF2)) 
	ELSE 
	DATEADD(day,120,CONVERT(DATE,li.F4INVOICE_UDF2)) 
	END,
    du.UNIT,
    bp.b1_alt_id AS RECORD_ID,
--    bp.b1_per_type AS per_type,
--    bp.b1_per_sub_type AS per_sub_type,
--    bp.b1_appl_status AS STATUS, 
--    bp.b1_appl_status_date AS STATUS_DATE,
--    bp.b1_file_dd AS file_date,                    
    cn.contact_name       AS OWNER_NAME,
--    cn.b1_contact_type AS contact_type,
    ba.b1_hse_nbr_alpha_start AS STR_NUM,
    ba.b1_str_name AS STR_NAME,
    ba.b1_situs_city AS STR_CITY,
    ba.b1_situs_state AS STR_STATE,
    ba.b1_situs_zip AS STR_ZIP,
--	ap.BIN,
    ap.BLOCK, 
    ap.LOT,
	bal.balance,
    du.NO_FEE,
    du.NO_FEE_DATE,
--    li.INVOICE_NBR,
--    li.BALANCE_DUE,
--    li.INVOICE_AMOUNT,
    li.F4INVOICE_UDF1 as CYCLE,
    li.F4INVOICE_UDF2 AS CYCLE_CLOCK
--    li.F4INVOICE_UDF3 AS FIRST_DUNNING_DATE,
--    li.F4INVOICE_UDF4 AS FIRST_LIEN_NOTICE_DATE,
--    li.REC_DATE,
--    li.INVOICE_COMMENT 

FROM
         b1permit bp

    LEFT OUTER JOIN #TMP_contact         cn ON cn.serv_prov_code = bp.serv_prov_code
                                  AND cn.b1_per_id1 = bp.b1_per_id1
                                  AND cn.b1_per_id2 = bp.b1_per_id2
                                  AND cn.b1_per_id3 = bp.b1_per_id3
    LEFT OUTER JOIN #TMP_addr ba ON ba.serv_prov_code = bp.serv_prov_code
                                  AND ba.b1_per_id1 = bp.b1_per_id1
                                  AND ba.b1_per_id2 = bp.b1_per_id2
                                  AND ba.b1_per_id3 = bp.b1_per_id3

    INNER JOIN #TMP_APO ap      ON ap.serv_prov_code = bp.serv_prov_code
                                  AND ap.b1_per_id1 = bp.b1_per_id1
                                  AND ap.b1_per_id2 = bp.b1_per_id2
                                  AND ap.b1_per_id3 = bp.b1_per_id3

    INNER JOIN #TMP_do_unit du ON bp.serv_prov_code = du.serv_prov_code
                                   AND bp.b1_per_id1 = du.b1_per_id1
                                   AND bp.b1_per_id2 = du.b1_per_id2                                   
                                   AND bp.b1_per_id3 = du.b1_per_id3  
    INNER JOIN #TMP_balance bal ON bp.serv_prov_code = bal.serv_prov_code
                                   AND bp.b1_per_id1 = bal.b1_per_id1
                                   AND bp.b1_per_id2 = bal.b1_per_id2                                   
                                   AND bp.b1_per_id3 = bal.b1_per_id3  								   
    INNER JOIN #TMP_Returned_Values li ON bp.serv_prov_code = li.serv_prov_code
                                   AND bp.b1_per_id1 = li.b1_per_id1
                                   AND bp.b1_per_id2 = li.b1_per_id2                                   
                                   AND bp.b1_per_id3 = li.b1_per_id3  
		
WHERE

       bp.b1_per_type = 'Common' 
       AND  bp.b1_per_sub_type = 'Inspection'
       AND bp.b1_appl_status <> 'Inactive'
	   AND ISDATE(li.F4INVOICE_UDF2) = 1
	   AND bp.serv_prov_code = 'FDNY'
	   AND (du.NO_FEE <> 'CHECKED' OR du.NO_FEE is null)
--	   AND bp.b1_alt_id = @ACCOUNTId
)
select distinct
	record_id,
	do,
	owner_name,
	str_num,
	str_name,
	str_city,
	str_state,
	str_zip,
	block,
	lot,
	balance,
	acttyp,
	cycle,
	cycle_clock

INTO #TMP_result_data from result_data
WHERE
   PERMITGRP = 'PERMIT'
   AND DO NOT IN ('25','33')
   AND try_convert(DATE,DUEDATE)  <= GETDATE()
   AND NOT exists 
   (
   select * 
   from #TMP_lien 
   WHERE 
     acct_num = RECORD_ID and CYCLE = ISNULL(CYCLE_NUM,'0000000-00')
	);

WITH Returned_Values AS(
SELECT *
FROM
(
SELECT
   x.SERV_PROV_CODE,
   X.B1_PER_ID1,
   X.B1_PER_ID2,
   X.B1_PER_ID3,   
   F.INVOICE_NBR,
   F.BALANCE_DUE,
   F.INVOICE_AMOUNT,
   F.F4INVOICE_UDF1,
   F.F4INVOICE_UDF2,
   F.F4INVOICE_UDF3,
   F.F4INVOICE_UDF4,
   F.REC_DATE,
   F.INVOICE_COMMENT 
FROM
   F4INVOICE F 
   INNER JOIN
      X4FEEITEM_INVOICE X 
      ON X.INVOICE_NBR = F.INVOICE_NBR 
WHERE
       F.BALANCE_DUE > 0 
   AND F.F4INVOICE_UDF1 IS NOT NULL 
   AND F.F4INVOICE_UDF2 IS NOT NULL 
   AND F.F4INVOICE_UDF3 IS NOT NULL 
   AND 
(F.INVOICE_COMMENT LIKE CONCAT('%""%','secondReminder','""',':true','%')
      AND F.INVOICE_COMMENT NOT LIKE CONCAT('%""%','doNotProcess','""',':true','%')
      AND F.INVOICE_COMMENT NOT LIKE CONCAT('%""%','lienAdded','""',':true','%')
--	  AND F.INVOICE_COMMENT LIKE CONCAT('%""%','secondPenAdded','""',':true','%')
   )
   AND F.SERV_PROV_CODE = 'FDNY' 
   AND ISDATE(F.F4INVOICE_UDF2) = 1
   AND DATEADD(day,120,try_convert(DATE,F.F4INVOICE_UDF2)) <= GETDATE()
GROUP BY
   x.SERV_PROV_CODE,
   X.B1_PER_ID1,
   X.B1_PER_ID2,
   X.B1_PER_ID3,   
   F.INVOICE_NBR,
   F.BALANCE_DUE,
   F.INVOICE_AMOUNT,
   F.F4INVOICE_UDF1,
   F.F4INVOICE_UDF2,
   F.F4INVOICE_UDF3,
   F.F4INVOICE_UDF4,
   F.REC_DATE,
   F.INVOICE_COMMENT 
   ) TR
--   WHERE
--           try_convert(DATE,F4INVOICE_UDF2)  <= GETDATE()
) 
   select * INTO #TMP_Returned_Values2 from Returned_Values;
-- select * from Returned_Values

WITH do_unit AS (
select SERV_PROV_CODE,
       B1_PER_ID1,
	   B1_PER_ID2,
	   B1_PER_ID3,
	   [D.O.] as ACTDO,
	   [Alpha Prefix] as ALPHAPREFIX,
	   [Account Type] as ACTTYPE,
	   [No Fee] as NO_FEE,
	   [No Fee Date] as NO_FEE_DATE,
	   [Application Type] as UNIT 
 from 
(
SELECT
    bc.serv_prov_code AS SERV_PROV_CODE,
    bc.b1_per_id1 AS B1_PER_ID1,
    bc.b1_per_id2 AS B1_PER_ID2,
    bc.b1_per_id3 AS B1_PER_ID3,
    
    bc.b1_checkbox_desc,
    bc.b1_checklist_comment
 FROM
         bchckbox bc
JOIN #TMP_Returned_Values2 rv ON bc.SERV_PROV_CODE = rv.SERV_PROV_CODE
	AND bc.B1_PER_ID1 = rv.B1_PER_ID1
	AND bc.B1_PER_ID2 = rv.B1_PER_ID2
	AND bc.B1_PER_ID3 = rv.B1_PER_ID3
WHERE
    bc.b1_checkbox_desc IN ( 'Alpha Prefix', 'D.O.','Account Type','Application Type','No Fee','No Fee Date' )
    AND bc.b1_checkbox_type IN ('PLAN INFORMATION', 'PERMIT REPORT INFO','FEE EXEMPTION INFORMATION')
	AND bC.serv_prov_code = 'FDNY'
    ) pvia
PIVOT ( MAX(b1_checklist_comment) for b1_checkbox_desc
            IN([D.O.],
			[Alpha Prefix],
			[Account Type],
			[No Fee],
			[No Fee Date],

			[Application Type])) pvib
)
   select * INTO #TMP_do_unit2 from do_unit;
WITH balance AS (
	SELECT
    pd.serv_prov_code AS SERV_PROV_CODE,
    pd.b1_per_id1 AS B1_PER_ID1,
    pd.b1_per_id2 AS B1_PER_ID2,
    pd.b1_per_id3 AS B1_PER_ID3,
    pd.balance
 FROM
         bpermit_detail pd
left JOIN #TMP_Returned_Values2 rv ON pd.SERV_PROV_CODE = rv.SERV_PROV_CODE
	AND pd.B1_PER_ID1 = rv.B1_PER_ID1
	AND pd.B1_PER_ID2 = rv.B1_PER_ID2
	AND pd.B1_PER_ID3 = rv.B1_PER_ID3
WHERE 1=1
	AND pd.SERV_PROV_CODE = 'FDNY' 
)
select * INTO #TMP_balance2 from balance;
WITH lien AS (
SELECT 
    serv_prov_code,
	b1_per_id1,
	b1_per_id2,
	b1_per_id3,
	acct_num,
	con_typ,
    con_nbr,
	charge_num,
    reason,
    payment_status,
	cycle_num,
    con_iss_dd,
    con_eff_dd
FROM
(
SELECT
    b6.serv_prov_code,
	b6.b1_per_id1,
	b6.b1_per_id2,
	b6.b1_per_id3,
	bp.b1_alt_id AS acct_num,
    b6.b1_con_typ AS con_typ,
    b6.b1_con_nbr AS con_nbr,
	RIGHT('0' + charge.field_value, 6) charge_num,
    reason.field_value   AS   reason,
    pstatus.field_value   AS  payment_status,
    cycstatus.field_value   AS  cycle_num,
    CONVERT(DATE,ISNULL(b6.b1_con_iss_dd,'1970-01-01')) AS con_iss_dd,
    CONVERT(DATE,ISNULL(b6.b1_con_eff_dd1,'1970-01-01'))  AS con_eff_dd

FROM
         b6condit b6
JOIN #TMP_Returned_Values2 rv ON b6.SERV_PROV_CODE = rv.SERV_PROV_CODE
	AND b6.B1_PER_ID1 = rv.B1_PER_ID1
	AND b6.B1_PER_ID2 = rv.B1_PER_ID2
	AND b6.B1_PER_ID3 = rv.B1_PER_ID3
JOIN b1permit bp ON b6.SERV_PROV_CODE = bp.SERV_PROV_CODE
	AND b6.B1_PER_ID1 = bp.B1_PER_ID1
	AND b6.B1_PER_ID2 = bp.B1_PER_ID2
	AND b6.B1_PER_ID3 = bp.B1_PER_ID3

    LEFT JOIN gtmpl_attribute     charge ON b6.b1_con_nbr = charge.entity_seq1
                                        AND b6.b1_per_id1 = charge.entity_key1
                                        AND b6.b1_per_id2 = charge.entity_key2
                                        AND b6.b1_per_id3 = charge.entity_key3
                                        AND charge.entity_type = '11'
                                        AND charge.field_name = 'Charge Number'
    LEFT JOIN gtmpl_attribute     reason ON b6.b1_con_nbr = reason.entity_seq1
                                        AND b6.b1_per_id1 = reason.entity_key1
                                        AND b6.b1_per_id2 = reason.entity_key2
                                        AND b6.b1_per_id3 = reason.entity_key3
                                        AND reason.entity_type = '11'
                                        AND reason.field_name = 'Reason'
    LEFT JOIN gtmpl_attribute     pstatus ON b6.b1_con_nbr = pstatus.entity_seq1
                                         AND b6.b1_per_id1 = pstatus.entity_key1
                                         AND b6.b1_per_id2 = pstatus.entity_key2
                                         AND b6.b1_per_id3 = pstatus.entity_key3
                                         AND pstatus.entity_type = '11'
                                         AND pstatus.field_name = 'Payment Status'
    LEFT JOIN gtmpl_attribute     cycstatus ON b6.b1_con_nbr = cycstatus.entity_seq1
                                         AND b6.b1_per_id1 = cycstatus.entity_key1
                                         AND b6.b1_per_id2 = cycstatus.entity_key2
                                         AND b6.b1_per_id3 = cycstatus.entity_key3
                                         AND cycstatus.entity_type = '11'
                                         AND cycstatus.field_name = 'Cycle Number'
WHERE
        b6.b1_con_typ = 'Lien'
    AND b6.rec_status = 'A'
    AND b6.serv_prov_code = 'FDNY'
) tr where charge_num is not null

)
select * INTO #TMP_lien2 from lien;

    PERMITGRP = CASE 
	WHEN du.ACTTYPE IN ('10', '15', '20', '25') AND du.ACTDO  <> '19'  THEN 'PERMIT'

	END ,

	ELSE 
	DATEADD(day,120,CONVERT(DATE,li.F4INVOICE_UDF2)) 
	END,
    du.UNIT,
    bp.b1_alt_id AS RECORD_ID,
--    bp.b1_per_type AS per_type,
--    bp.b1_per_sub_type AS per_sub_type,
--    bp.b1_appl_status AS STATUS, 
--    bp.b1_appl_status_date AS STATUS_DATE,
--    bp.b1_file_dd AS file_date,                    
    cn.contact_name       AS OWNER_NAME,
--    cn.b1_contact_type AS contact_type,
    ba.b1_hse_nbr_alpha_start AS STR_NUM,
    ba.b1_str_name AS STR_NAME,
    ba.b1_situs_city AS STR_CITY,
    ba.b1_situs_state AS STR_STATE,
    ba.b1_situs_zip AS STR_ZIP,
--	ap.BIN,
    ap.BLOCK, 
    ap.LOT,
	bal.balance,
    du.NO_FEE,
    du.NO_FEE_DATE,
--    li.INVOICE_NBR,
--    li.BALANCE_DUE,
--    li.INVOICE_AMOUNT,
    li.F4INVOICE_UDF1 as CYCLE,
    li.F4INVOICE_UDF2 AS CYCLE_CLOCK

--    li.F4INVOICE_UDF4 AS FIRST_LIEN_NOTICE_DATE,
--    li.REC_DATE,
--    li.INVOICE_COMMENT 

FROM
         b1permit bp

    LEFT OUTER JOIN #TMP_contact2         cn ON cn.serv_prov_code = bp.serv_prov_code
                                  AND cn.b1_per_id1 = bp.b1_per_id1
                                  AND cn.b1_per_id2 = bp.b1_per_id2
                                  AND cn.b1_per_id3 = bp.b1_per_id3
    LEFT OUTER JOIN #TMP_addr2 ba ON ba.serv_prov_code = bp.serv_prov_code
                                  AND ba.b1_per_id1 = bp.b1_per_id1
                                  AND ba.b1_per_id2 = bp.b1_per_id2
                                  AND ba.b1_per_id3 = bp.b1_per_id3

    INNER JOIN #TMP_APO2 ap      ON ap.serv_prov_code = bp.serv_prov_code
                                  AND ap.b1_per_id1 = bp.b1_per_id1
                                  AND ap.b1_per_id2 = bp.b1_per_id2
                                  AND ap.b1_per_id3 = bp.b1_per_id3

    INNER JOIN #TMP_do_unit2 du ON bp.serv_prov_code = du.serv_prov_code
                                   AND bp.b1_per_id1 = du.b1_per_id1
                                   AND bp.b1_per_id2 = du.b1_per_id2                                   
                                   AND bp.b1_per_id3 = du.b1_per_id3   
    INNER JOIN #TMP_balance2 bal ON bp.serv_prov_code = bal.serv_prov_code
                                   AND bp.b1_per_id1 = bal.b1_per_id1
                                   AND bp.b1_per_id2 = bal.b1_per_id2                                   
                                   AND bp.b1_per_id3 = bal.b1_per_id3 
    INNER JOIN #TMP_Returned_Values2 li ON bp.serv_prov_code = li.serv_prov_code
                                   AND bp.b1_per_id1 = li.b1_per_id1
                                   AND bp.b1_per_id2 = li.b1_per_id2                                   
                                   AND bp.b1_per_id3 = li.b1_per_id3  
		
WHERE

       bp.b1_per_type = 'Common' 
       AND  bp.b1_per_sub_type = 'Inspection'
       AND bp.b1_appl_status <> 'Inactive'
	   AND ISDATE(li.F4INVOICE_UDF2) = 1
	   and bp.serv_prov_code = 'FDNY'
	   AND (du.NO_FEE <> 'CHECKED' OR du.NO_FEE is null)
--	   AND bp.b1_alt_id = @ACCOUNTID
) 
select distinct

WITH Returned_Values AS(
SELECT *
FROM
(
SELECT
   x.SERV_PROV_CODE,
   X.B1_PER_ID1,
   X.B1_PER_ID2,
   X.B1_PER_ID3,   
   F.INVOICE_NBR,
   F.BALANCE_DUE,
   F.INVOICE_AMOUNT,
   F.F4INVOICE_UDF1,
   F.F4INVOICE_UDF2,
   F.F4INVOICE_UDF3,
   F.F4INVOICE_UDF4,
   F.REC_DATE,
   F.INVOICE_COMMENT 
FROM
   F4INVOICE F 
   INNER JOIN
      X4FEEITEM_INVOICE X 
      ON X.INVOICE_NBR = F.INVOICE_NBR 
WHERE
       F.BALANCE_DUE > 0 
   AND F.F4INVOICE_UDF1 IS NOT NULL 
   AND F.F4INVOICE_UDF2 IS NOT NULL 
   AND F.F4INVOICE_UDF3 IS NOT NULL 
   AND 
(F.INVOICE_COMMENT LIKE CONCAT('%""%','secondReminder','""',':true','%')
      AND F.INVOICE_COMMENT NOT LIKE CONCAT('%""%','doNotProcess','""',':true','%')
      AND F.INVOICE_COMMENT NOT LIKE CONCAT('%""%','lienAdded','""',':true','%')
	  AND F.INVOICE_COMMENT LIKE CONCAT('%""%','secondPenAdded','""',':true','%')
   )
   AND F.SERV_PROV_CODE = 'FDNY' 
   AND ISDATE(F.F4INVOICE_UDF2) = 1
   AND DATEADD(day,455,try_convert(DATE,F.F4INVOICE_UDF2)) <= DATEADD(day,10,GETDATE())
GROUP BY
   x.SERV_PROV_CODE,
   X.B1_PER_ID1,
   X.B1_PER_ID2,
   X.B1_PER_ID3,   
   F.INVOICE_NBR,
   F.BALANCE_DUE,
   F.INVOICE_AMOUNT,
   F.F4INVOICE_UDF1,
   F.F4INVOICE_UDF2,
   F.F4INVOICE_UDF3,
   F.F4INVOICE_UDF4,
   F.REC_DATE,
   F.INVOICE_COMMENT 
   ) TR
--   WHERE
--           try_convert(DATE,F4INVOICE_UDF2)  <= GETDATE()
) 
   select * INTO #TMP_Returned_Values from Returned_Values;
-- select * from Returned_Values

WITH do_unit AS (
select SERV_PROV_CODE,
       B1_PER_ID1,
	   B1_PER_ID2,
	   B1_PER_ID3,
	   [D.O.] as ACTDO,
	   [Alpha Prefix] as ALPHAPREFIX,
	   [Account Type] as ACTTYPE,
	   [No Fee] as NO_FEE,
	   [No Fee Date] as NO_FEE_DATE,
	   [Application Type] as UNIT 
 from 
(
SELECT
    bc.serv_prov_code AS SERV_PROV_CODE,
    bc.b1_per_id1 AS B1_PER_ID1,
    bc.b1_per_id2 AS B1_PER_ID2,
    bc.b1_per_id3 AS B1_PER_ID3,
    
    bc.b1_checkbox_desc,
    bc.b1_checklist_comment
 FROM
         bchckbox bc
JOIN #TMP_Returned_Values rv ON bc.SERV_PROV_CODE = rv.SERV_PROV_CODE
	AND bc.B1_PER_ID1 = rv.B1_PER_ID1
	AND bc.B1_PER_ID2 = rv.B1_PER_ID2
	AND bc.B1_PER_ID3 = rv.B1_PER_ID3
WHERE
    bc.b1_checkbox_desc IN ( 'Alpha Prefix', 'D.O.','Account Type','Application Type','No Fee','No Fee Date' )
    AND bc.b1_checkbox_type IN ('PLAN INFORMATION', 'PERMIT REPORT INFO','FEE EXEMPTION INFORMATION')
	AND bc.SERV_PROV_CODE = 'FDNY' 
    ) pvia
PIVOT ( MAX(b1_checklist_comment) for b1_checkbox_desc
            IN([D.O.],
			[Alpha Prefix],
			[Account Type],
			[No Fee],
			[No Fee Date],

			[Application Type])) pvib
)
select * INTO #TMP_do_unit from do_unit;
WITH balance AS (
SELECT
    pd.serv_prov_code AS SERV_PROV_CODE,
    pd.b1_per_id1 AS B1_PER_ID1,
    pd.b1_per_id2 AS B1_PER_ID2,
    pd.b1_per_id3 AS B1_PER_ID3,
    pd.balance
 FROM
         bpermit_detail pd
left JOIN #TMP_Returned_Values rv ON pd.SERV_PROV_CODE = rv.SERV_PROV_CODE
	AND pd.B1_PER_ID1 = rv.B1_PER_ID1
	AND pd.B1_PER_ID2 = rv.B1_PER_ID2
	AND pd.B1_PER_ID3 = rv.B1_PER_ID3
WHERE 1=1
	AND pd.SERV_PROV_CODE = 'FDNY' 
)
select * INTO #TMP_balance from balance;

WITH lien AS (
SELECT 
    serv_prov_code,
	b1_per_id1,
	b1_per_id2,
	b1_per_id3,
	acct_num,
	con_typ,
    con_nbr,
	charge_num,
    reason,
    payment_status,
	cycle_num,
    con_iss_dd,
    con_eff_dd
FROM
(
SELECT
    b6.serv_prov_code,
	b6.b1_per_id1,
	b6.b1_per_id2,
	b6.b1_per_id3,
	bp.b1_alt_id AS acct_num,
    b6.b1_con_typ AS con_typ,
    b6.b1_con_nbr AS con_nbr,
	RIGHT('0' + charge.field_value, 6) charge_num,
    reason.field_value   AS   reason,
    pstatus.field_value   AS  payment_status,
    cycstatus.field_value   AS  cycle_num,
    CONVERT(DATE,ISNULL(b6.b1_con_iss_dd,'1970-01-01')) AS con_iss_dd,
    CONVERT(DATE,ISNULL(b6.b1_con_eff_dd1,'1970-01-01'))  AS con_eff_dd

FROM
         b6condit b6
JOIN #TMP_Returned_Values rv ON b6.SERV_PROV_CODE = rv.SERV_PROV_CODE
	AND b6.B1_PER_ID1 = rv.B1_PER_ID1
	AND b6.B1_PER_ID2 = rv.B1_PER_ID2
	AND b6.B1_PER_ID3 = rv.B1_PER_ID3
JOIN b1permit bp ON b6.SERV_PROV_CODE = bp.SERV_PROV_CODE
	AND b6.B1_PER_ID1 = bp.B1_PER_ID1
	AND b6.B1_PER_ID2 = bp.B1_PER_ID2
	AND b6.B1_PER_ID3 = bp.B1_PER_ID3

    LEFT JOIN gtmpl_attribute     charge ON b6.b1_con_nbr = charge.entity_seq1
                                        AND b6.b1_per_id1 = charge.entity_key1
                                        AND b6.b1_per_id2 = charge.entity_key2
                                        AND b6.b1_per_id3 = charge.entity_key3
                                        AND charge.entity_type = '11'
                                        AND charge.field_name = 'Charge Number'
    LEFT JOIN gtmpl_attribute     reason ON b6.b1_con_nbr = reason.entity_seq1
                                        AND b6.b1_per_id1 = reason.entity_key1
                                        AND b6.b1_per_id2 = reason.entity_key2
                                        AND b6.b1_per_id3 = reason.entity_key3
                                        AND reason.entity_type = '11'
                                        AND reason.field_name = 'Reason'
    LEFT JOIN gtmpl_attribute     pstatus ON b6.b1_con_nbr = pstatus.entity_seq1
                                         AND b6.b1_per_id1 = pstatus.entity_key1
                                         AND b6.b1_per_id2 = pstatus.entity_key2
                                         AND b6.b1_per_id3 = pstatus.entity_key3
                                         AND pstatus.entity_type = '11'
                                         AND pstatus.field_name = 'Payment Status'
    LEFT JOIN gtmpl_attribute     cycstatus ON b6.b1_con_nbr = cycstatus.entity_seq1
                                         AND b6.b1_per_id1 = cycstatus.entity_key1
                                         AND b6.b1_per_id2 = cycstatus.entity_key2
                                         AND b6.b1_per_id3 = cycstatus.entity_key3
                                         AND cycstatus.entity_type = '11'
                                         AND cycstatus.field_name = 'Cycle Number'
WHERE
        b6.b1_con_typ = 'Lien'
    AND b6.rec_status = 'A'
    AND b6.serv_prov_code = 'FDNY'
) tr where charge_num is not null

)
select * INTO #TMP_lien from lien;
 --select * from #TMP_lien
WITH addr AS (
    SELECT
                serv_prov_code,
                b1_per_id1,
                b1_per_id2,
                b1_per_id3,

                b.b1_str_name,

                b.b1_situs_state,
                b.b1_situs_zip,

                ROW_NUMBER()
                OVER(PARTITION BY b.serv_prov_code, b.b1_per_id1, b.b1_per_id2, b.b1_per_id3
                     ORDER BY
                         b.b1_primary_addr_flg DESC 
                ) rn
            FROM
                b3addres b

	AND b.B1_PER_ID1 = rv.B1_PER_ID1
	AND b.B1_PER_ID2 = rv.B1_PER_ID2
	AND b.B1_PER_ID3 = rv.B1_PER_ID3
WHERE
	 b.serv_prov_code = 'FDNY'
        ) tr
    WHERE  rn = 1
)
select * INTO #TMP_addr from addr;

WITH contact AS (
    SELECT
        serv_prov_code,
        b1_per_id1,
        b1_per_id2,
        b1_per_id3,
        contact_name,
        rec_date,
        b1_contact_type
    FROM
        (
            SELECT
            b.serv_prov_code,
            b.b1_per_id1,
            b.b1_per_id2,
            b.b1_per_id3,
			COALESCE(b.b1_full_name,b.b1_business_name,CONCAT(b1_fname,' ',b1_lname)) as contact_name,
                b.rec_date,
                b.b1_contact_type,
                ROW_NUMBER()
                OVER(PARTITION BY b.serv_prov_code, b.b1_per_id1, b.b1_per_id2, b.b1_per_id3
                     ORDER BY
                         b.rec_date DESC 
                ) rn
            FROM
                b3contact b	
JOIN #TMP_Returned_Values rv ON b.SERV_PROV_CODE = rv.SERV_PROV_CODE
	AND b.B1_PER_ID1 = rv.B1_PER_ID1
	AND b.B1_PER_ID2 = rv.B1_PER_ID2
	AND b.B1_PER_ID3 = rv.B1_PER_ID3

            WHERE
                b.b1_contact_type IN 
				('Billing Contact') 
				AND b.SERV_PROV_CODE = 'FDNY'

        ) tr
    WHERE
        rn = 1
) 
select * INTO #TMP_contact from contact;

WITH APO AS (
select SERV_PROV_CODE,
		B1_PER_ID1,
		B1_PER_ID2,
		B1_PER_ID3,
		[BIN] as BIN,
		[BLOCK] as BLOCK,
		[LOT] as LOT
from 
(
SELECT
    apo.serv_prov_code AS SERV_PROV_CODE,
    apo.b1_per_id1 AS B1_PER_ID1,
	apo.b1_per_id2 AS B1_PER_ID2,
    apo.b1_per_id3 AS B1_PER_ID3,
    apo.b1_attribute_name,
    apo.b1_attribute_value
FROM
	b3apo_attribute apo
JOIN #TMP_Returned_Values rv ON APO.SERV_PROV_CODE = rv.SERV_PROV_CODE
	AND APO.B1_PER_ID1 = rv.B1_PER_ID1
	AND APO.B1_PER_ID2 = rv.B1_PER_ID2
	AND APO.B1_PER_ID3 = rv.B1_PER_ID3

WHERE
    apo.b1_attribute_name IN ( 'BIN', 'BLOCK','LOT' )
    AND apo.b1_apo_type IN ('ADDRESS')
	and apo.serv_prov_code = 'FDNY'
    ) pva
PIVOT ( 
	MAX(b1_attribute_value) 
	for b1_attribute_name
       IN(
			[BIN],
			[BLOCK],
			[LOT]
		) 
	) pvb
)
select * INTO #TMP_APO from APO;

WITH lien AS (
SELECT 
    serv_prov_code,
	b1_per_id1,
	b1_per_id2,
	b1_per_id3,
	acct_num,
	con_typ,
    con_nbr,
	charge_num,
    reason,
    payment_status,
	cycle_num,
    con_iss_dd,
    con_eff_dd
FROM
(
SELECT
    b6.serv_prov_code,
	b6.b1_per_id1,
	b6.b1_per_id2,
	b6.b1_per_id3,
	bp.b1_alt_id AS acct_num,
    b6.b1_con_typ AS con_typ,
    b6.b1_con_nbr AS con_nbr,
	RIGHT('0' + charge.field_value, 6) charge_num,
    reason.field_value   AS   reason,
    pstatus.field_value   AS  payment_status,
    cycstatus.field_value   AS  cycle_num,
    CONVERT(DATE,ISNULL(b6.b1_con_iss_dd,'1970-01-01')) AS con_iss_dd,
    CONVERT(DATE,ISNULL(b6.b1_con_eff_dd1,'1970-01-01'))  AS con_eff_dd

FROM
         b6condit b6
JOIN #TMP_Returned_Values2 rv ON b6.SERV_PROV_CODE = rv.SERV_PROV_CODE
	AND b6.B1_PER_ID1 = rv.B1_PER_ID1
	AND b6.B1_PER_ID2 = rv.B1_PER_ID2
	AND b6.B1_PER_ID3 = rv.B1_PER_ID3
JOIN b1permit bp ON b6.SERV_PROV_CODE = bp.SERV_PROV_CODE
	AND b6.B1_PER_ID1 = bp.B1_PER_ID1
	AND b6.B1_PER_ID2 = bp.B1_PER_ID2
	AND b6.B1_PER_ID3 = bp.B1_PER_ID3

    LEFT JOIN gtmpl_attribute     charge ON b6.b1_con_nbr = charge.entity_seq1
                                        AND b6.b1_per_id1 = charge.entity_key1
                                        AND b6.b1_per_id2 = charge.entity_key2
                                        AND b6.b1_per_id3 = charge.entity_key3
                                        AND charge.entity_type = '11'
                                        AND charge.field_name = 'Charge Number'
    LEFT JOIN gtmpl_attribute     reason ON b6.b1_con_nbr = reason.entity_seq1
                                        AND b6.b1_per_id1 = reason.entity_key1
                                        AND b6.b1_per_id2 = reason.entity_key2
                                        AND b6.b1_per_id3 = reason.entity_key3
                                        AND reason.entity_type = '11'
                                        AND reason.field_name = 'Reason'
    LEFT JOIN gtmpl_attribute     pstatus ON b6.b1_con_nbr = pstatus.entity_seq1
                                         AND b6.b1_per_id1 = pstatus.entity_key1
                                         AND b6.b1_per_id2 = pstatus.entity_key2
                                         AND b6.b1_per_id3 = pstatus.entity_key3
                                         AND pstatus.entity_type = '11'
                                         AND pstatus.field_name = 'Payment Status'
    LEFT JOIN gtmpl_attribute     cycstatus ON b6.b1_con_nbr = cycstatus.entity_seq1
                                         AND b6.b1_per_id1 = cycstatus.entity_key1
                                         AND b6.b1_per_id2 = cycstatus.entity_key2
                                         AND b6.b1_per_id3 = cycstatus.entity_key3
                                         AND cycstatus.entity_type = '11'
                                         AND cycstatus.field_name = 'Cycle Number'
WHERE
        b6.b1_con_typ = 'Lien'
    AND b6.rec_status = 'A'
    AND b6.serv_prov_code = 'FDNY'
) tr where charge_num is not null

)
select * INTO #TMP_lien2 from lien;

                b.rec_date,
                b.b1_contact_type,
                ROW_NUMBER()

	AND b.B1_PER_ID3 = rv.B1_PER_ID3

                b.b1_contact_type IN 
				('Billing Contact')

WITH APO AS (
select SERV_PROV_CODE,
		B1_PER_ID1,
		B1_PER_ID2,
		B1_PER_ID3,
		[BIN] as BIN,
		[BLOCK] as BLOCK,
		[LOT] as LOT
from 
(

    apo.serv_prov_code AS SERV_PROV_CODE,
    apo.b1_per_id1 AS B1_PER_ID1,
	apo.b1_per_id2 AS B1_PER_ID2,
    apo.b1_per_id3 AS B1_PER_ID3,
    apo.b1_attribute_name,
    apo.b1_attribute_value
FROM
	b3apo_attribute apo
JOIN #TMP_Returned_Values2 rv ON APO.SERV_PROV_CODE = rv.SERV_PROV_CODE
	AND APO.B1_PER_ID1 = rv.B1_PER_ID1
	AND APO.B1_PER_ID2 = rv.B1_PER_ID2
	AND APO.B1_PER_ID3 = rv.B1_PER_ID3

WHERE

    AND apo.b1_apo_type IN ('ADDRESS')
	AND apo.serv_prov_code = 'FDNY'
    ) pva
PIVOT ( 
	MAX(b1_attribute_value)

       IN(
			[BIN],
			[BLOCK],
			[LOT]
		) 
	) pvb
)

WITH result_data2 AS (
SELECT 
	RIGHT('0' + du.ACTDO, 2) AS DO,
--    du.ALPHAPREFIX AS APFX, 
    du.ACTTYPE AS ACTTYP, 
    PERMITGRP = CASE 
	WHEN du.ACTTYPE IN ('10', '15', '20', '25') AND du.ACTDO  <> '19'  THEN 'PERMIT' 
	ELSE 
	'NONPERMIT' 
	END ,
	DUEDATE =CASE 
	WHEN du.ACTTYPE IN ('10', '15', '20', '25')  AND du.ACTDO  <> '19' THEN DATEADD(day,455,CONVERT(DATE,li.F4INVOICE_UDF2)) 
	ELSE 
	DATEADD(day,120,CONVERT(DATE,li.F4INVOICE_UDF2)) 
	END,
    du.UNIT,
    bp.b1_alt_id AS RECORD_ID,
--    bp.b1_per_type AS per_type,
--    bp.b1_per_sub_type AS per_sub_type,
--    bp.b1_appl_status AS STATUS, 
--    bp.b1_appl_status_date AS STATUS_DATE,
--    bp.b1_file_dd AS file_date,                    
    cn.contact_name       AS OWNER_NAME,
--    cn.b1_contact_type AS contact_type,
    ba.b1_hse_nbr_alpha_start AS STR_NUM,
    ba.b1_str_name AS STR_NAME,
    ba.b1_situs_city AS STR_CITY,
    ba.b1_situs_state AS STR_STATE,
    ba.b1_situs_zip AS STR_ZIP,
--	ap.BIN,
    ap.BLOCK, 
    ap.LOT,
	bal.balance,
    du.NO_FEE,
    du.NO_FEE_DATE,
--    li.INVOICE_NBR,
--    li.BALANCE_DUE,
--    li.INVOICE_AMOUNT,
    li.F4INVOICE_UDF1 as CYCLE,
    li.F4INVOICE_UDF2 AS CYCLE_CLOCK
--    li.F4INVOICE_UDF3 AS FIRST_DUNNING_DATE,
--    li.F4INVOICE_UDF4 AS FIRST_LIEN_NOTICE_DATE,
--    li.REC_DATE,
--    li.INVOICE_COMMENT 

FROM
         b1permit bp

    LEFT OUTER JOIN #TMP_contact2         cn ON cn.serv_prov_code = bp.serv_prov_code
                                  AND cn.b1_per_id1 = bp.b1_per_id1
                                  AND cn.b1_per_id2 = bp.b1_per_id2
                                  AND cn.b1_per_id3 = bp.b1_per_id3
    LEFT OUTER JOIN #TMP_addr2 ba ON ba.serv_prov_code = bp.serv_prov_code
                                  AND ba.b1_per_id1 = bp.b1_per_id1
                                  AND ba.b1_per_id2 = bp.b1_per_id2
                                  AND ba.b1_per_id3 = bp.b1_per_id3

    INNER JOIN #TMP_APO2 ap      ON ap.serv_prov_code = bp.serv_prov_code
                                  AND ap.b1_per_id1 = bp.b1_per_id1
                                  AND ap.b1_per_id2 = bp.b1_per_id2
                                  AND ap.b1_per_id3 = bp.b1_per_id3

    INNER JOIN #TMP_do_unit2 du ON bp.serv_prov_code = du.serv_prov_code
                                   AND bp.b1_per_id1 = du.b1_per_id1
                                   AND bp.b1_per_id2 = du.b1_per_id2                                   
                                   AND bp.b1_per_id3 = du.b1_per_id3   
    INNER JOIN #TMP_balance2 bal ON bp.serv_prov_code = bal.serv_prov_code
                                   AND bp.b1_per_id1 = bal.b1_per_id1
                                   AND bp.b1_per_id2 = bal.b1_per_id2                                   
                                   AND bp.b1_per_id3 = bal.b1_per_id3 
    INNER JOIN #TMP_Returned_Values2 li ON bp.serv_prov_code = li.serv_prov_code
                                   AND bp.b1_per_id1 = li.b1_per_id1
                                   AND bp.b1_per_id2 = li.b1_per_id2                                   
                                   AND bp.b1_per_id3 = li.b1_per_id3  
		
WHERE

       bp.b1_per_type = 'Common' 
       AND  bp.b1_per_sub_type = 'Inspection'
       AND bp.b1_appl_status <> 'Inactive'
	   AND ISDATE(li.F4INVOICE_UDF2) = 1
	   and bp.serv_prov_code = 'FDNY'
	   AND (du.NO_FEE <> 'CHECKED' OR du.NO_FEE is null)
--	   AND bp.b1_alt_id = @ACCOUNTID
) 
select distinct
	record_id,
	do,
	owner_name,
	str_num,
	str_name,
	str_city,
	str_state,
	str_zip,
	block,
	lot,
	balance,
	acttyp,
	cycle,
	cycle_clock
INTO #TMP_result_data2 from result_data2
WHERE
   PERMITGRP = 'NONPERMIT'
   AND DO NOT IN ('25','33')
   AND try_convert(DATE,DUEDATE)  <= DATEADD(day,10,GETDATE())
   AND NOT exists 
   (
   select * 
   from #TMP_lien2 
   WHERE 
     acct_num = RECORD_ID and CYCLE = ISNULL(CYCLE_NUM,'0000000-00')
	);
WITH all_data as (
select * FROM #TMP_result_data
 UNION
select * FROM #TMP_result_data2
)
select * from all_data order by owner_name, record_id;
