SELECT
    b6.serv_prov_code,
	b6.b1_per_id1,
	b6.b1_per_id2,
	b6.b1_per_id3,
	bp.b1_alt_id AS acct_num,
    b6.b1_con_typ AS con_typ,
    b6.b1_con_nbr AS con_nbr,
	RIGHT('0' + charge.field_value, 6) charge_num,
    reason.field_value   AS   reason,
    pstatus.field_value   AS  payment_status,
    cycstatus.field_value   AS  cycle_num,
    CONVERT(DATE,ISNULL(b6.b1_con_iss_dd,'1970-01-01')) AS con_iss_dd,
    CONVERT(DATE,ISNULL(b6.b1_con_eff_dd1,'1970-01-01'))  AS con_eff_dd

FROM
         b6condit b6
JOIN #TMP_Returned_Values rv ON b6.SERV_PROV_CODE = rv.SERV_PROV_CODE
	AND b6.B1_PER_ID1 = rv.B1_PER_ID1
	AND b6.B1_PER_ID2 = rv.B1_PER_ID2
	AND b6.B1_PER_ID3 = rv.B1_PER_ID3
JOIN b1permit bp ON b6.SERV_PROV_CODE = bp.SERV_PROV_CODE
	AND b6.B1_PER_ID1 = bp.B1_PER_ID1
	AND b6.B1_PER_ID2 = bp.B1_PER_ID2
	AND b6.B1_PER_ID3 = bp.B1_PER_ID3

    LEFT JOIN gtmpl_attribute     charge ON b6.b1_con_nbr = charge.entity_seq1
                                        AND b6.b1_per_id1 = charge.entity_key1
                                        AND b6.b1_per_id2 = charge.entity_key2
                                        AND b6.b1_per_id3 = charge.entity_key3
                                        AND charge.entity_type = '11'
                                        AND charge.field_name = 'Charge Number'
    LEFT JOIN gtmpl_attribute     reason ON b6.b1_con_nbr = reason.entity_seq1
                                        AND b6.b1_per_id1 = reason.entity_key1
                                        AND b6.b1_per_id2 = reason.entity_key2
                                        AND b6.b1_per_id3 = reason.entity_key3
                                        AND reason.entity_type = '11'
                                        AND reason.field_name = 'Reason'
    LEFT JOIN gtmpl_attribute     pstatus ON b6.b1_con_nbr = pstatus.entity_seq1
                                         AND b6.b1_per_id1 = pstatus.entity_key1
                                         AND b6.b1_per_id2 = pstatus.entity_key2
                                         AND b6.b1_per_id3 = pstatus.entity_key3
                                         AND pstatus.entity_type = '11'
                                         AND pstatus.field_name = 'Payment Status'
    LEFT JOIN gtmpl_attribute     cycstatus ON b6.b1_con_nbr = cycstatus.entity_seq1
                                         AND b6.b1_per_id1 = cycstatus.entity_key1
                                         AND b6.b1_per_id2 = cycstatus.entity_key2
                                         AND b6.b1_per_id3 = cycstatus.entity_key3
                                         AND cycstatus.entity_type = '11'
                                         AND cycstatus.field_name = 'Cycle Number'
WHERE
        b6.b1_con_typ = 'Lien'
    AND b6.rec_status = 'A'
    AND b6.serv_prov_code = 'FDNY'
) tr where charge_num is not null

)
select * INTO #TMP_lien from lien;
 --select * from #TMP_lien
WITH addr AS (
    SELECT
                serv_prov_code,
                b1_per_id1,
                b1_per_id2,
                b1_per_id3,
                b1_hse_nbr_alpha_start,
                b1_str_name,
                b1_situs_city,
                b1_situs_state,
                b1_situs_zip
    FROM
        (
            SELECT
                b.serv_prov_code,
                b.b1_per_id1,
                b.b1_per_id2,
                b.b1_per_id3,
                b.b1_hse_nbr_alpha_start,
                b.b1_str_name,
                b.b1_situs_city,
                b.b1_situs_state,
                b.b1_situs_zip,

                ROW_NUMBER()
                OVER(PARTITION BY b.serv_prov_code, b.b1_per_id1, b.b1_per_id2, b.b1_per_id3
                     ORDER BY
                         b.b1_primary_addr_flg DESC 
                ) rn
            FROM
                b3addres b
JOIN #TMP_Returned_Values rv ON b.SERV_PROV_CODE = rv.SERV_PROV_CODE
	AND b.B1_PER_ID1 = rv.B1_PER_ID1
	AND b.B1_PER_ID2 = rv.B1_PER_ID2
	AND b.B1_PER_ID3 = rv.B1_PER_ID3
WHERE
	 b.serv_prov_code = 'FDNY'
        ) tr
    WHERE  rn = 1
)
select * INTO #TMP_addr from addr;

WITH contact AS (
    SELECT
        serv_prov_code,
        b1_per_id1,
        b1_per_id2,
        b1_per_id3,
        contact_name,
        rec_date,
        b1_contact_type
    FROM
        (
            SELECT
            b.serv_prov_code,
            b.b1_per_id1,
            b.b1_per_id2,
            b.b1_per_id3,
			COALESCE(b.b1_full_name,b.b1_business_name,CONCAT(b1_fname,' ',b1_lname)) as contact_name,
                b.rec_date,
                b.b1_contact_type,
                ROW_NUMBER()
                OVER(PARTITION BY b.serv_prov_code, b.b1_per_id1, b.b1_per_id2, b.b1_per_id3
                     ORDER BY
                         b.rec_date DESC 
                ) rn
            FROM
                b3contact b	
JOIN #TMP_Returned_Values rv ON b.SERV_PROV_CODE = rv.SERV_PROV_CODE
	AND b.B1_PER_ID1 = rv.B1_PER_ID1
	AND b.B1_PER_ID2 = rv.B1_PER_ID2
	AND b.B1_PER_ID3 = rv.B1_PER_ID3

            WHERE
                b.b1_contact_type IN 
				('Billing Contact') 
				AND b.SERV_PROV_CODE = 'FDNY'

        ) tr
    WHERE
        rn = 1
) 
select * INTO #TMP_contact from contact;
--select * from contact
WITH APO AS (
select SERV_PROV_CODE,
		B1_PER_ID1,
		B1_PER_ID2,
		B1_PER_ID3,
		[BIN] as BIN,
		[BLOCK] as BLOCK,
		[LOT] as LOT
from 
(
SELECT
    apo.serv_prov_code AS SERV_PROV_CODE,
    apo.b1_per_id1 AS B1_PER_ID1,
	apo.b1_per_id2 AS B1_PER_ID2,
    apo.b1_per_id3 AS B1_PER_ID3,
    apo.b1_attribute_name,
    apo.b1_attribute_value
FROM
	b3apo_attribute apo
JOIN #TMP_Returned_Values rv ON APO.SERV_PROV_CODE = rv.SERV_PROV_CODE
	AND APO.B1_PER_ID1 = rv.B1_PER_ID1
	AND APO.B1_PER_ID2 = rv.B1_PER_ID2
	AND APO.B1_PER_ID3 = rv.B1_PER_ID3

WHERE
    apo.b1_attribute_name IN ( 'BIN', 'BLOCK','LOT' )
    AND apo.b1_apo_type IN ('ADDRESS')
	and apo.serv_prov_code = 'FDNY'
    ) pva
PIVOT ( 
	MAX(b1_attribute_value) 
	for b1_attribute_name
       IN(
			[BIN],
			[BLOCK],
			[LOT]
		) 
	) pvb
)
select * INTO #TMP_APO from APO;
WITH result_data AS (
SELECT 
	RIGHT('0' + du.ACTDO, 2) AS DO,
--    du.ALPHAPREFIX AS APFX, 
    du.ACTTYPE AS ACTTYP, 
    PERMITGRP = CASE 
	WHEN du.ACTTYPE IN ('10', '15', '20', '25') AND du.ACTDO  <> '19'  THEN 'PERMIT' 
	ELSE 
	'NONPERMIT' 
	END ,
	DUEDATE =CASE 
	WHEN du.ACTTYPE IN ('10', '15', '20', '25')  AND du.ACTDO  <> '19' THEN DATEADD(day,455,CONVERT(DATE,li.F4INVOICE_UDF2)) 
	ELSE 
	DATEADD(day,120,CONVERT(DATE,li.F4INVOICE_UDF2)) 
	END,
    du.UNIT,
    bp.b1_alt_id AS RECORD_ID,
--    bp.b1_per_type AS per_type,
--    bp.b1_per_sub_type AS per_sub_type,
--    bp.b1_appl_status AS STATUS, 
--    bp.b1_appl_status_date AS STATUS_DATE,
--    bp.b1_file_dd AS file_date,                    
    cn.contact_name       AS OWNER_NAME,
--    cn.b1_contact_type AS contact_type,
    ba.b1_hse_nbr_alpha_start AS STR_NUM,
    ba.b1_str_name AS STR_NAME,
    ba.b1_situs_city AS STR_CITY,
    ba.b1_situs_state AS STR_STATE,
    ba.b1_situs_zip AS STR_ZIP,
--	ap.BIN,
    ap.BLOCK, 
    ap.LOT,
	bal.balance,
    du.NO_FEE,
    du.NO_FEE_DATE,
--    li.INVOICE_NBR,
--    li.BALANCE_DUE,
--    li.INVOICE_AMOUNT,
    li.F4INVOICE_UDF1 as CYCLE,
    li.F4INVOICE_UDF2 AS CYCLE_CLOCK
--    li.F4INVOICE_UDF3 AS FIRST_DUNNING_DATE,
--    li.F4INVOICE_UDF4 AS FIRST_LIEN_NOTICE_DATE,
--    li.REC_DATE,
--    li.INVOICE_COMMENT 

FROM
         b1permit bp

    LEFT OUTER JOIN #TMP_contact         cn ON cn.serv_prov_code = bp.serv_prov_code
                                  AND cn.b1_per_id1 = bp.b1_per_id1
                                  AND cn.b1_per_id2 = bp.b1_per_id2
                                  AND cn.b1_per_id3 = bp.b1_per_id3
    LEFT OUTER JOIN #TMP_addr ba ON ba.serv_prov_code = bp.serv_prov_code
                                  AND ba.b1_per_id1 = bp.b1_per_id1
                                  AND ba.b1_per_id2 = bp.b1_per_id2
                                  AND ba.b1_per_id3 = bp.b1_per_id3

    INNER JOIN #TMP_APO ap      ON ap.serv_prov_code = bp.serv_prov_code
                                  AND ap.b1_per_id1 = bp.b1_per_id1
                                  AND ap.b1_per_id2 = bp.b1_per_id2
                                  AND ap.b1_per_id3 = bp.b1_per_id3

    INNER JOIN #TMP_do_unit du ON bp.serv_prov_code = du.serv_prov_code
                                   AND bp.b1_per_id1 = du.b1_per_id1
                                   AND bp.b1_per_id2 = du.b1_per_id2                                   
                                   AND bp.b1_per_id3 = du.b1_per_id3  
    INNER JOIN #TMP_balance bal ON bp.serv_prov_code = bal.serv_prov_code
                                   AND bp.b1_per_id1 = bal.b1_per_id1
                                   AND bp.b1_per_id2 = bal.b1_per_id2                                   
                                   AND bp.b1_per_id3 = bal.b1_per_id3  								   
    INNER JOIN #TMP_Returned_Values li ON bp.serv_prov_code = li.serv_prov_code
                                   AND bp.b1_per_id1 = li.b1_per_id1
                                   AND bp.b1_per_id2 = li.b1_per_id2                                   
                                   AND bp.b1_per_id3 = li.b1_per_id3  
		
WHERE

       bp.b1_per_type = 'Common' 
       AND  bp.b1_per_sub_type = 'Inspection'
       AND bp.b1_appl_status <> 'Inactive'
	   AND ISDATE(li.F4INVOICE_UDF2) = 1
	   AND bp.serv_prov_code = 'FDNY'
	   AND (du.NO_FEE <> 'CHECKED' OR du.NO_FEE is null)
--	   AND bp.b1_alt_id = @ACCOUNTId
)
select distinct
	record_id,
	do,
	owner_name,
	str_num,
	str_name,
	str_city,
	str_state,
	str_zip,
	block,
	lot,
	balance,
	acttyp,
	cycle,
	cycle_clock

INTO #TMP_result_data from result_data
WHERE
   PERMITGRP = 'PERMIT'
   AND DO NOT IN ('25','33')
   AND try_convert(DATE,DUEDATE)  <= DATEADD(day,10,GETDATE())
   AND NOT exists 
   (
   select * 
   from #TMP_lien 
   WHERE 
     acct_num = RECORD_ID and CYCLE = ISNULL(CYCLE_NUM,'0000000-00')
	);

WITH Returned_Values AS(
SELECT *
FROM
(
SELECT
   x.SERV_PROV_CODE,
   X.B1_PER_ID1,
   X.B1_PER_ID2,
   X.B1_PER_ID3,   
   F.INVOICE_NBR,
   F.BALANCE_DUE,
   F.INVOICE_AMOUNT,
   F.F4INVOICE_UDF1,
   F.F4INVOICE_UDF2,
   F.F4INVOICE_UDF3,
   F.F4INVOICE_UDF4,
   F.REC_DATE,
   F.INVOICE_COMMENT 
FROM
   F4INVOICE F 
   INNER JOIN
      X4FEEITEM_INVOICE X 
      ON X.INVOICE_NBR = F.INVOICE_NBR 
WHERE
       F.BALANCE_DUE > 0 
   AND F.F4INVOICE_UDF1 IS NOT NULL 
   AND F.F4INVOICE_UDF2 IS NOT NULL 
   AND F.F4INVOICE_UDF3 IS NOT NULL 
   AND 
(F.INVOICE_COMMENT LIKE CONCAT('%""%','secondReminder','""',':true','%')
      AND F.INVOICE_COMMENT NOT LIKE CONCAT('%""%','doNotProcess','""',':true','%')
      AND F.INVOICE_COMMENT NOT LIKE CONCAT('%""%','lienAdded','""',':true','%')
--	  AND F.INVOICE_COMMENT LIKE CONCAT('%""%','secondPenAdded','""',':true','%')
   )
   AND F.SERV_PROV_CODE = 'FDNY' 
   AND ISDATE(F.F4INVOICE_UDF2) = 1
   AND DATEADD(day,120,try_convert(DATE,F.F4INVOICE_UDF2)) <= DATEADD(day,10,GETDATE())
GROUP BY
   x.SERV_PROV_CODE,
   X.B1_PER_ID1,
   X.B1_PER_ID2,
   X.B1_PER_ID3,   
   F.INVOICE_NBR,
   F.BALANCE_DUE,
   F.INVOICE_AMOUNT,
   F.F4INVOICE_UDF1,
   F.F4INVOICE_UDF2,
   F.F4INVOICE_UDF3,
   F.F4INVOICE_UDF4,
   F.REC_DATE,
   F.INVOICE_COMMENT 
   ) TR
--   WHERE
--           try_convert(DATE,F4INVOICE_UDF2)  <= GETDATE()
) 
   select * INTO #TMP_Returned_Values2 from Returned_Values;
-- select * from Returned_Values

WITH do_unit AS (
select SERV_PROV_CODE,
       B1_PER_ID1,
	   B1_PER_ID2,
	   B1_PER_ID3,
	   [D.O.] as ACTDO,
	   [Alpha Prefix] as ALPHAPREFIX,
	   [Account Type] as ACTTYPE,
	   [No Fee] as NO_FEE,
	   [No Fee Date] as NO_FEE_DATE,
	   [Application Type] as UNIT 
 from 
(
SELECT
    bc.serv_prov_code AS SERV_PROV_CODE,
    bc.b1_per_id1 AS B1_PER_ID1,
    bc.b1_per_id2 AS B1_PER_ID2,
    bc.b1_per_id3 AS B1_PER_ID3,
    
    bc.b1_checkbox_desc,
    bc.b1_checklist_comment
 FROM
         bchckbox bc
JOIN #TMP_Returned_Values2 rv ON bc.SERV_PROV_CODE = rv.SERV_PROV_CODE
	AND bc.B1_PER_ID1 = rv.B1_PER_ID1
	AND bc.B1_PER_ID2 = rv.B1_PER_ID2
	AND bc.B1_PER_ID3 = rv.B1_PER_ID3
WHERE
    bc.b1_checkbox_desc IN ( 'Alpha Prefix', 'D.O.','Account Type','Application Type','No Fee','No Fee Date' )
    AND bc.b1_checkbox_type IN ('PLAN INFORMATION', 'PERMIT REPORT INFO','FEE EXEMPTION INFORMATION')
	AND bC.serv_prov_code = 'FDNY'
    ) pvia
PIVOT ( MAX(b1_checklist_comment) for b1_checkbox_desc
            IN([D.O.],
			[Alpha Prefix],
			[Account Type],
			[No Fee],
			[No Fee Date],

			[Application Type])) pvib
)
   select * INTO #TMP_do_unit2 from do_unit;
WITH balance AS (
	SELECT
    pd.serv_prov_code AS SERV_PROV_CODE,
    pd.b1_per_id1 AS B1_PER_ID1,
    pd.b1_per_id2 AS B1_PER_ID2,
    pd.b1_per_id3 AS B1_PER_ID3,
    pd.balance
 FROM
         bpermit_detail pd
 JOIN #TMP_Returned_Values2 rv ON pd.SERV_PROV_CODE = rv.SERV_PROV_CODE
	AND pd.B1_PER_ID1 = rv.B1_PER_ID1
	AND pd.B1_PER_ID2 = rv.B1_PER_ID2
	AND pd.B1_PER_ID3 = rv.B1_PER_ID3
WHERE 1=1
	AND pd.SERV_PROV_CODE = 'FDNY' 
)
select * INTO #TMP_balance2 from balance;
WITH lien AS (
SELECT 
    serv_prov_code,
	b1_per_id1,
	b1_per_id2,
	b1_per_id3,
	acct_num,
	con_typ,
    con_nbr,
	charge_num,
    reason,
    payment_status,
	cycle_num,
    con_iss_dd,
    con_eff_dd
FROM
(
SELECT
    b6.serv_prov_code,
	b6.b1_per_id1,
	b6.b1_per_id2,
	b6.b1_per_id3,
	bp.b1_alt_id AS acct_num,
    b6.b1_con_typ AS con_typ,
    b6.b1_con_nbr AS con_nbr,
	RIGHT('0' + charge.field_value, 6) charge_num,
    reason.field_value   AS   reason,
    pstatus.field_value   AS  payment_status,
    cycstatus.field_value   AS  cycle_num,
    CONVERT(DATE,ISNULL(b6.b1_con_iss_dd,'1970-01-01')) AS con_iss_dd,
    CONVERT(DATE,ISNULL(b6.b1_con_eff_dd1,'1970-01-01'))  AS con_eff_dd

FROM
         b6condit b6
JOIN #TMP_Returned_Values2 rv ON b6.SERV_PROV_CODE = rv.SERV_PROV_CODE
	AND b6.B1_PER_ID1 = rv.B1_PER_ID1
	AND b6.B1_PER_ID2 = rv.B1_PER_ID2
	AND b6.B1_PER_ID3 = rv.B1_PER_ID3
JOIN b1permit bp ON b6.SERV_PROV_CODE = bp.SERV_PROV_CODE
	AND b6.B1_PER_ID1 = bp.B1_PER_ID1
	AND b6.B1_PER_ID2 = bp.B1_PER_ID2
	AND b6.B1_PER_ID3 = bp.B1_PER_ID3

    LEFT JOIN gtmpl_attribute     charge ON b6.b1_con_nbr = charge.entity_seq1
                                        AND b6.b1_per_id1 = charge.entity_key1
                                        AND b6.b1_per_id2 = charge.entity_key2
                                        AND b6.b1_per_id3 = charge.entity_key3
                                        AND charge.entity_type = '11'
                                        AND charge.field_name = 'Charge Number'
    LEFT JOIN gtmpl_attribute     reason ON b6.b1_con_nbr = reason.entity_seq1
                                        AND b6.b1_per_id1 = reason.entity_key1
                                        AND b6.b1_per_id2 = reason.entity_key2
                                        AND b6.b1_per_id3 = reason.entity_key3
                                        AND reason.entity_type = '11'
                                        AND reason.field_name = 'Reason'
    LEFT JOIN gtmpl_attribute     pstatus ON b6.b1_con_nbr = pstatus.entity_seq1
                                         AND b6.b1_per_id1 = pstatus.entity_key1
                                         AND b6.b1_per_id2 = pstatus.entity_key2
                                         AND b6.b1_per_id3 = pstatus.entity_key3
                                         AND pstatus.entity_type = '11'
                                         AND pstatus.field_name = 'Payment Status'
    LEFT JOIN gtmpl_attribute     cycstatus ON b6.b1_con_nbr = cycstatus.entity_seq1
                                         AND b6.b1_per_id1 = cycstatus.entity_key1
                                         AND b6.b1_per_id2 = cycstatus.entity_key2
                                         AND b6.b1_per_id3 = cycstatus.entity_key3
                                         AND cycstatus.entity_type = '11'
                                         AND cycstatus.field_name = 'Cycle Number'
WHERE
        b6.b1_con_typ = 'Lien'
    AND b6.rec_status = 'A'
    AND b6.serv_prov_code = 'FDNY'
) tr where charge_num is not null

)
select * INTO #TMP_lien2 from lien;

WITH APO AS (
select SERV_PROV_CODE,
		B1_PER_ID1,
		B1_PER_ID2,
		B1_PER_ID3,
		[BIN] as BIN,
		[BLOCK] as BLOCK,
		[LOT] as LOT
from 
(
SELECT
    apo.serv_prov_code AS SERV_PROV_CODE,
    apo.b1_per_id1 AS B1_PER_ID1,
	apo.b1_per_id2 AS B1_PER_ID2,
    apo.b1_per_id3 AS B1_PER_ID3,
    apo.b1_attribute_name,
    apo.b1_attribute_value
FROM
	b3apo_attribute apo
JOIN #TMP_Returned_Values2 rv ON APO.SERV_PROV_CODE = rv.SERV_PROV_CODE
	AND APO.B1_PER_ID1 = rv.B1_PER_ID1
	AND APO.B1_PER_ID2 = rv.B1_PER_ID2

FROM
         b1permit bp

    LEFT OUTER JOIN #TMP_contact2         cn ON cn.serv_prov_code = bp.serv_prov_code
                                  AND cn.b1_per_id1 = bp.b1_per_id1
                                  AND cn.b1_per_id2 = bp.b1_per_id2
                                  AND cn.b1_per_id3 = bp.b1_per_id3
    LEFT OUTER JOIN #TMP_addr2 ba ON ba.serv_prov_code = bp.serv_prov_code
                                  AND ba.b1_per_id1 = bp.b1_per_id1
                                  AND ba.b1_per_id2 = bp.b1_per_id2
                                  AND ba.b1_per_id3 = bp.b1_per_id3

    INNER JOIN #TMP_APO2 ap      ON ap.serv_prov_code = bp.serv_prov_code
                                  AND ap.b1_per_id1 = bp.b1_per_id1
                                  AND ap.b1_per_id2 = bp.b1_per_id2
                                  AND ap.b1_per_id3 = bp.b1_per_id3

    INNER JOIN #TMP_do_unit2 du ON bp.serv_prov_code = du.serv_prov_code
                                   AND bp.b1_per_id1 = du.b1_per_id1
                                   AND bp.b1_per_id2 = du.b1_per_id2                                   
                                   AND bp.b1_per_id3 = du.b1_per_id3   
    INNER JOIN #TMP_balance2 bal ON bp.serv_prov_code = bal.serv_prov_code
                                   AND bp.b1_per_id1 = bal.b1_per_id1
                                   AND bp.b1_per_id2 = bal.b1_per_id2                                   
                                   AND bp.b1_per_id3 = bal.b1_per_id3 
    INNER JOIN #TMP_Returned_Values2 li ON bp.serv_prov_code = li.serv_prov_code
                                   AND bp.b1_per_id1 = li.b1_per_id1
                                   AND bp.b1_per_id2 = li.b1_per_id2                                   
                                   AND bp.b1_per_id3 = li.b1_per_id3  
		
WHERE

       bp.b1_per_type = 'Common' 
       AND  bp.b1_per_sub_type = 'Inspection'
       AND bp.b1_appl_status <> 'Inactive'
	   AND ISDATE(li.F4INVOICE_UDF2) = 1
	   and bp.serv_prov_code = 'FDNY'
	   AND (du.NO_FEE <> 'CHECKED' OR du.NO_FEE is null)

WITH Returned_Values AS(
SELECT *
FROM
(
SELECT
   x.SERV_PROV_CODE,
   X.B1_PER_ID1,
   X.B1_PER_ID2,
   X.B1_PER_ID3,   
   F.INVOICE_NBR,
   F.BALANCE_DUE,
   F.INVOICE_AMOUNT,
   F.F4INVOICE_UDF1,
   F.F4INVOICE_UDF2,
   F.F4INVOICE_UDF3,
   F.F4INVOICE_UDF4,
   F.REC_DATE,
   F.INVOICE_COMMENT 
FROM
   F4INVOICE F 
   INNER JOIN
      X4FEEITEM_INVOICE X 
      ON X.INVOICE_NBR = F.INVOICE_NBR 
WHERE
       F.BALANCE_DUE > 0 
   AND F.F4INVOICE_UDF1 IS NOT NULL 
   AND F.F4INVOICE_UDF2 IS NOT NULL 
   AND F.F4INVOICE_UDF3 IS NOT NULL 
   AND 
(F.INVOICE_COMMENT LIKE CONCAT('%""%','secondReminder','""',':true','%')
      AND F.INVOICE_COMMENT NOT LIKE CONCAT('%""%','doNotProcess','""',':true','%')
      AND F.INVOICE_COMMENT NOT LIKE CONCAT('%""%','lienAdded','""',':true','%')
	  AND F.INVOICE_COMMENT LIKE CONCAT('%""%','secondPenAdded','""',':true','%')
   )
   AND F.SERV_PROV_CODE = 'FDNY' 
   AND ISDATE(F.F4INVOICE_UDF2) = 1
   AND DATEADD(day,455,try_convert(DATE,F.F4INVOICE_UDF2)) <= DATEADD(day,10,GETDATE())
GROUP BY
   x.SERV_PROV_CODE,
   X.B1_PER_ID1,
   X.B1_PER_ID2,
   X.B1_PER_ID3,   
   F.INVOICE_NBR,
   F.BALANCE_DUE,
   F.INVOICE_AMOUNT,
   F.F4INVOICE_UDF1,
   F.F4INVOICE_UDF2,
   F.F4INVOICE_UDF3,
   F.F4INVOICE_UDF4,
   F.REC_DATE,
   F.INVOICE_COMMENT 
   ) TR
--   WHERE
--           try_convert(DATE,F4INVOICE_UDF2)  <= GETDATE()
) 
   select * INTO #TMP_Returned_Values from Returned_Values;
-- select * from Returned_Values

WITH do_unit AS (
select SERV_PROV_CODE,
       B1_PER_ID1,
	   B1_PER_ID2,
	   B1_PER_ID3,
	   [D.O.] as ACTDO,
	   [Alpha Prefix] as ALPHAPREFIX,
	   [Account Type] as ACTTYPE,
	   [No Fee] as NO_FEE,
	   [No Fee Date] as NO_FEE_DATE,
	   [Application Type] as UNIT 
 from 
(
SELECT
    bc.serv_prov_code AS SERV_PROV_CODE,
    bc.b1_per_id1 AS B1_PER_ID1,
    bc.b1_per_id2 AS B1_PER_ID2,
    bc.b1_per_id3 AS B1_PER_ID3,
    
    bc.b1_checkbox_desc,
    bc.b1_checklist_comment
 FROM
         bchckbox bc
JOIN #TMP_Returned_Values rv ON bc.SERV_PROV_CODE = rv.SERV_PROV_CODE
	AND bc.B1_PER_ID1 = rv.B1_PER_ID1
	AND bc.B1_PER_ID2 = rv.B1_PER_ID2
	AND bc.B1_PER_ID3 = rv.B1_PER_ID3
WHERE
    bc.b1_checkbox_desc IN ( 'Alpha Prefix', 'D.O.','Account Type','Application Type','No Fee','No Fee Date' )
    AND bc.b1_checkbox_type IN ('PLAN INFORMATION', 'PERMIT REPORT INFO','FEE EXEMPTION INFORMATION')
	AND bc.SERV_PROV_CODE = 'FDNY' 
    ) pvia
PIVOT ( MAX(b1_checklist_comment) for b1_checkbox_desc
            IN([D.O.],
			[Alpha Prefix],
			[Account Type],
			[No Fee],
			[No Fee Date],

			[Application Type])) pvib
)
select * INTO #TMP_do_unit from do_unit;
WITH balance AS (
SELECT
    pd.serv_prov_code AS SERV_PROV_CODE,
    pd.b1_per_id1 AS B1_PER_ID1,
    pd.b1_per_id2 AS B1_PER_ID2,
    pd.b1_per_id3 AS B1_PER_ID3,
    pd.balance
 FROM
         bpermit_detail pd
 JOIN #TMP_Returned_Values rv ON pd.SERV_PROV_CODE = rv.SERV_PROV_CODE
	AND pd.B1_PER_ID1 = rv.B1_PER_ID1
	AND pd.B1_PER_ID2 = rv.B1_PER_ID2
	AND pd.B1_PER_ID3 = rv.B1_PER_ID3
WHERE 1=1
	AND pd.SERV_PROV_CODE = 'FDNY' 
)
select * INTO #TMP_balance from balance;

WITH lien AS (
SELECT 
    serv_prov_code,
	b1_per_id1,
	b1_per_id2,
	b1_per_id3,
	acct_num,
	con_typ,
    con_nbr,
	charge_num,
    reason,
    payment_status,
	cycle_num,
    con_iss_dd,
    con_eff_dd
FROM
(
SELECT
    b6.serv_prov_code,
	b6.b1_per_id1,
	b6.b1_per_id2,
	b6.b1_per_id3,
	bp.b1_alt_id AS acct_num,
    b6.b1_con_typ AS con_typ,
    b6.b1_con_nbr AS con_nbr,
	RIGHT('0' + charge.field_value, 6) charge_num,
    reason.field_value   AS   reason,
    pstatus.field_value   AS  payment_status,
    cycstatus.field_value   AS  cycle_num,
    CONVERT(DATE,ISNULL(b6.b1_con_iss_dd,'1970-01-01')) AS con_iss_dd,
    CONVERT(DATE,ISNULL(b6.b1_con_eff_dd1,'1970-01-01'))  AS con_eff_dd

FROM
         b6condit b6
JOIN #TMP_Returned_Values rv ON b6.SERV_PROV_CODE = rv.SERV_PROV_CODE
	AND b6.B1_PER_ID1 = rv.B1_PER_ID1
	AND b6.B1_PER_ID2 = rv.B1_PER_ID2
	AND b6.B1_PER_ID3 = rv.B1_PER_ID3
JOIN b1permit bp ON b6.SERV_PROV_CODE = bp.SERV_PROV_CODE
	AND b6.B1_PER_ID1 = bp.B1_PER_ID1
	AND b6.B1_PER_ID2 = bp.B1_PER_ID2
	AND b6.B1_PER_ID3 = bp.B1_PER_ID3

    LEFT JOIN gtmpl_attribute     charge ON b6.b1_con_nbr = charge.entity_seq1
                                        AND b6.b1_per_id1 = charge.entity_key1
                                        AND b6.b1_per_id2 = charge.entity_key2
                                        AND b6.b1_per_id3 = charge.entity_key3
                                        AND charge.entity_type = '11'
                                        AND charge.field_name = 'Charge Number'
    LEFT JOIN gtmpl_attribute     reason ON b6.b1_con_nbr = reason.entity_seq1
                                        AND b6.b1_per_id1 = reason.entity_key1
                                        AND b6.b1_per_id2 = reason.entity_key2
                                        AND b6.b1_per_id3 = reason.entity_key3
                                        AND reason.entity_type = '11'
                                        AND reason.field_name = 'Reason'
    LEFT JOIN gtmpl_attribute     pstatus ON b6.b1_con_nbr = pstatus.entity_seq1
                                         AND b6.b1_per_id1 = pstatus.entity_key1
                                         AND b6.b1_per_id2 = pstatus.entity_key2
                                         AND b6.b1_per_id3 = pstatus.entity_key3
                                         AND pstatus.entity_type = '11'
                                         AND pstatus.field_name = 'Payment Status'
    LEFT JOIN gtmpl_attribute     cycstatus ON b6.b1_con_nbr = cycstatus.entity_seq1
                                         AND b6.b1_per_id1 = cycstatus.entity_key1
                                         AND b6.b1_per_id2 = cycstatus.entity_key2
                                         AND b6.b1_per_id3 = cycstatus.entity_key3
                                         AND cycstatus.entity_type = '11'
                                         AND cycstatus.field_name = 'Cycle Number'
WHERE
        b6.b1_con_typ = 'Lien'
    AND b6.rec_status = 'A'
    AND b6.serv_prov_code = 'FDNY'
) tr where charge_num is not null

)
select * INTO #TMP_lien from lien;
 --select * from #TMP_lien
WITH addr AS (

                b1_per_id1,
                b1_per_id2,

                ROW_NUMBER()

                     ORDER BY

            FROM

	AND b.B1_PER_ID3 = rv.B1_PER_ID3
WHERE
	 b.serv_prov_code = 'FDNY'
        ) tr
    WHERE  rn = 1
)

WITH contact AS (
    SELECT
        serv_prov_code,
        b1_per_id1,
        b1_per_id2,
        b1_per_id3,
        contact_name,
        rec_date,
        b1_contact_type
    FROM
        (
            SELECT
            b.serv_prov_code,
            b.b1_per_id1,
            b.b1_per_id2,
            b.b1_per_id3,
			COALESCE(b.b1_full_name,b.b1_business_name,CONCAT(b1_fname,' ',b1_lname)) as contact_name,
                b.rec_date,
                b.b1_contact_type,
                ROW_NUMBER()
                OVER(PARTITION BY b.serv_prov_code, b.b1_per_id1, b.b1_per_id2, b.b1_per_id3
                     ORDER BY
                         b.rec_date DESC 
                ) rn
            FROM
                b3contact b	
JOIN #TMP_Returned_Values rv ON b.SERV_PROV_CODE = rv.SERV_PROV_CODE
	AND b.B1_PER_ID1 = rv.B1_PER_ID1
	AND b.B1_PER_ID2 = rv.B1_PER_ID2
	AND b.B1_PER_ID3 = rv.B1_PER_ID3

            WHERE
                b.b1_contact_type IN 
				('Billing Contact') 
				AND b.SERV_PROV_CODE = 'FDNY'

        ) tr
    WHERE
        rn = 1
)

WITH lien AS (
SELECT 
    serv_prov_code,
	b1_per_id1,
	b1_per_id2,
	b1_per_id3,
	acct_num,
	con_typ,
    con_nbr,
	charge_num,
    reason,
    payment_status,
	cycle_num,
    con_iss_dd,
    con_eff_dd
FROM
(
SELECT
    b6.serv_prov_code,
	b6.b1_per_id1,
	b6.b1_per_id2,
	b6.b1_per_id3,
	bp.b1_alt_id AS acct_num,
    b6.b1_con_typ AS con_typ,
    b6.b1_con_nbr AS con_nbr,
	RIGHT('0' + charge.field_value, 6) charge_num,
    reason.field_value   AS   reason,
    pstatus.field_value   AS  payment_status,
    cycstatus.field_value   AS  cycle_num,
    CONVERT(DATE,ISNULL(b6.b1_con_iss_dd,'1970-01-01')) AS con_iss_dd,
    CONVERT(DATE,ISNULL(b6.b1_con_eff_dd1,'1970-01-01'))  AS con_eff_dd

         b6condit b6

	AND b6.B1_PER_ID1 = rv.B1_PER_ID1
	AND b6.B1_PER_ID2 = rv.B1_PER_ID2
	AND b6.B1_PER_ID3 = rv.B1_PER_ID3
JOIN b1permit bp ON b6.SERV_PROV_CODE = bp.SERV_PROV_CODE
	AND b6.B1_PER_ID1 = bp.B1_PER_ID1
	AND b6.B1_PER_ID2 = bp.B1_PER_ID2
	AND b6.B1_PER_ID3 = bp.B1_PER_ID3

    LEFT JOIN gtmpl_attribute     charge ON b6.b1_con_nbr = charge.entity_seq1
                                        AND b6.b1_per_id1 = charge.entity_key1
                                        AND b6.b1_per_id2 = charge.entity_key2
                                        AND b6.b1_per_id3 = charge.entity_key3
                                        AND charge.entity_type = '11'
                                        AND charge.field_name = 'Charge Number'
    LEFT JOIN gtmpl_attribute     reason ON b6.b1_con_nbr = reason.entity_seq1
                                        AND b6.b1_per_id1 = reason.entity_key1
                                        AND b6.b1_per_id2 = reason.entity_key2
                                        AND b6.b1_per_id3 = reason.entity_key3
                                        AND reason.entity_type = '11'
                                        AND reason.field_name = 'Reason'
    LEFT JOIN gtmpl_attribute     pstatus ON b6.b1_con_nbr = pstatus.entity_seq1
                                         AND b6.b1_per_id1 = pstatus.entity_key1
                                         AND b6.b1_per_id2 = pstatus.entity_key2
                                         AND b6.b1_per_id3 = pstatus.entity_key3
                                         AND pstatus.entity_type = '11'
                                         AND pstatus.field_name = 'Payment Status'
    LEFT JOIN gtmpl_attribute     cycstatus ON b6.b1_con_nbr = cycstatus.entity_seq1
                                         AND b6.b1_per_id1 = cycstatus.entity_key1
                                         AND b6.b1_per_id2 = cycstatus.entity_key2
                                         AND b6.b1_per_id3 = cycstatus.entity_key3
                                         AND cycstatus.entity_type = '11'
                                         AND cycstatus.field_name = 'Cycle Number'
WHERE
        b6.b1_con_typ = 'Lien'
    AND b6.rec_status = 'A'
    AND b6.serv_prov_code = 'FDNY'
) tr where charge_num is not null

)
select * INTO #TMP_lien2 from lien;

		B1_PER_ID1,

    apo.b1_per_id1 AS B1_PER_ID1,

    apo.b1_attribute_value

	b3apo_attribute apo

	AND APO.B1_PER_ID1 = rv.B1_PER_ID1
	AND APO.B1_PER_ID2 = rv.B1_PER_ID2
	AND APO.B1_PER_ID3 = rv.B1_PER_ID3

    AND apo.b1_apo_type IN ('ADDRESS')
	AND apo.serv_prov_code = 'FDNY'
    ) pva

       IN(
			[BIN],
			[BLOCK],
			[LOT]
		) 
	) pvb
)

WITH result_data2 AS (
SELECT 
	RIGHT('0' + du.ACTDO, 2) AS DO,
--    du.ALPHAPREFIX AS APFX, 
    du.ACTTYPE AS ACTTYP, 
    PERMITGRP = CASE 
	WHEN du.ACTTYPE IN ('10', '15', '20', '25') AND du.ACTDO  <> '19'  THEN 'PERMIT' 
	ELSE 
	'NONPERMIT' 
	END ,
	DUEDATE =CASE 
	WHEN du.ACTTYPE IN ('10', '15', '20', '25')  AND du.ACTDO  <> '19' THEN DATEADD(day,455,CONVERT(DATE,li.F4INVOICE_UDF2)) 
	ELSE 
	DATEADD(day,120,CONVERT(DATE,li.F4INVOICE_UDF2)) 
	END,
    du.UNIT,
    bp.b1_alt_id AS RECORD_ID,
--    bp.b1_per_type AS per_type,
--    bp.b1_per_sub_type AS per_sub_type,
--    bp.b1_appl_status AS STATUS, 
--    bp.b1_appl_status_date AS STATUS_DATE,
--    bp.b1_file_dd AS file_date,                    
    cn.contact_name       AS OWNER_NAME,
--    cn.b1_contact_type AS contact_type,
    ba.b1_hse_nbr_alpha_start AS STR_NUM,
    ba.b1_str_name AS STR_NAME,
    ba.b1_situs_city AS STR_CITY,
    ba.b1_situs_state AS STR_STATE,
    ba.b1_situs_zip AS STR_ZIP,
--	ap.BIN,
    ap.BLOCK, 
    ap.LOT,
	bal.balance,
    du.NO_FEE,
    du.NO_FEE_DATE,
--    li.INVOICE_NBR,
--    li.BALANCE_DUE,
--    li.INVOICE_AMOUNT,
    li.F4INVOICE_UDF1 as CYCLE,
    li.F4INVOICE_UDF2 AS CYCLE_CLOCK
--    li.F4INVOICE_UDF3 AS FIRST_DUNNING_DATE,
--    li.F4INVOICE_UDF4 AS FIRST_LIEN_NOTICE_DATE,
--    li.REC_DATE,
--    li.INVOICE_COMMENT 

FROM
         b1permit bp

    LEFT OUTER JOIN #TMP_contact2         cn ON cn.serv_prov_code = bp.serv_prov_code
                                  AND cn.b1_per_id1 = bp.b1_per_id1
                                  AND cn.b1_per_id2 = bp.b1_per_id2
                                  AND cn.b1_per_id3 = bp.b1_per_id3
    LEFT OUTER JOIN #TMP_addr2 ba ON ba.serv_prov_code = bp.serv_prov_code
                                  AND ba.b1_per_id1 = bp.b1_per_id1
                                  AND ba.b1_per_id2 = bp.b1_per_id2
                                  AND ba.b1_per_id3 = bp.b1_per_id3

    INNER JOIN #TMP_APO2 ap      ON ap.serv_prov_code = bp.serv_prov_code
                                  AND ap.b1_per_id1 = bp.b1_per_id1
                                  AND ap.b1_per_id2 = bp.b1_per_id2
                                  AND ap.b1_per_id3 = bp.b1_per_id3

    INNER JOIN #TMP_do_unit2 du ON bp.serv_prov_code = du.serv_prov_code
                                   AND bp.b1_per_id1 = du.b1_per_id1
                                   AND bp.b1_per_id2 = du.b1_per_id2                                   
                                   AND bp.b1_per_id3 = du.b1_per_id3   
    INNER JOIN #TMP_balance2 bal ON bp.serv_prov_code = bal.serv_prov_code
                                   AND bp.b1_per_id1 = bal.b1_per_id1
                                   AND bp.b1_per_id2 = bal.b1_per_id2                                   
                                   AND bp.b1_per_id3 = bal.b1_per_id3 
    INNER JOIN #TMP_Returned_Values2 li ON bp.serv_prov_code = li.serv_prov_code
                                   AND bp.b1_per_id1 = li.b1_per_id1
                                   AND bp.b1_per_id2 = li.b1_per_id2                                   
                                   AND bp.b1_per_id3 = li.b1_per_id3  
		
WHERE

       bp.b1_per_type = 'Common' 
       AND  bp.b1_per_sub_type = 'Inspection'
       AND bp.b1_appl_status <> 'Inactive'
	   AND ISDATE(li.F4INVOICE_UDF2) = 1
	   and bp.serv_prov_code = 'FDNY'
	   AND (du.NO_FEE <> 'CHECKED' OR du.NO_FEE is null)
--	   AND bp.b1_alt_id = @ACCOUNTID
) 
select distinct
	record_id,
	do,
	owner_name,

	str_name,
	str_city,

    b6.b1_con_typ AS con_typ,
    b6.b1_con_nbr AS con_nbr,
	RIGHT('0' + charge.field_value, 6) charge_num,
    reason.field_value   AS   reason,
    pstatus.field_value   AS  payment_status,
    cycstatus.field_value   AS  cycle_num,
    CONVERT(DATE,ISNULL(b6.b1_con_iss_dd,'1970-01-01')) AS con_iss_dd,
    CONVERT(DATE,ISNULL(b6.b1_con_eff_dd1,'1970-01-01'))  AS con_eff_dd

FROM
         b6condit b6
JOIN #TMP_Returned_Values rv ON b6.SERV_PROV_CODE = rv.SERV_PROV_CODE
	AND b6.B1_PER_ID1 = rv.B1_PER_ID1
	AND b6.B1_PER_ID2 = rv.B1_PER_ID2
	AND b6.B1_PER_ID3 = rv.B1_PER_ID3
JOIN b1permit bp ON b6.SERV_PROV_CODE = bp.SERV_PROV_CODE
	AND b6.B1_PER_ID1 = bp.B1_PER_ID1
	AND b6.B1_PER_ID2 = bp.B1_PER_ID2
	AND b6.B1_PER_ID3 = bp.B1_PER_ID3

    LEFT JOIN gtmpl_attribute     charge ON b6.b1_con_nbr = charge.entity_seq1
                                        AND b6.b1_per_id1 = charge.entity_key1
                                        AND b6.b1_per_id2 = charge.entity_key2
                                        AND b6.b1_per_id3 = charge.entity_key3
                                        AND charge.entity_type = '11'
                                        AND charge.field_name = 'Charge Number'
    LEFT JOIN gtmpl_attribute     reason ON b6.b1_con_nbr = reason.entity_seq1
                                        AND b6.b1_per_id1 = reason.entity_key1
                                        AND b6.b1_per_id2 = reason.entity_key2
                                        AND b6.b1_per_id3 = reason.entity_key3
                                        AND reason.entity_type = '11'
                                        AND reason.field_name = 'Reason'
    LEFT JOIN gtmpl_attribute     pstatus ON b6.b1_con_nbr = pstatus.entity_seq1
                                         AND b6.b1_per_id1 = pstatus.entity_key1
                                         AND b6.b1_per_id2 = pstatus.entity_key2
                                         AND b6.b1_per_id3 = pstatus.entity_key3
                                         AND pstatus.entity_type = '11'
                                         AND pstatus.field_name = 'Payment Status'
    LEFT JOIN gtmpl_attribute     cycstatus ON b6.b1_con_nbr = cycstatus.entity_seq1
                                         AND b6.b1_per_id1 = cycstatus.entity_key1
                                         AND b6.b1_per_id2 = cycstatus.entity_key2
                                         AND b6.b1_per_id3 = cycstatus.entity_key3
                                         AND cycstatus.entity_type = '11'
                                         AND cycstatus.field_name = 'Cycle Number'
WHERE
        b6.b1_con_typ = 'Lien'
    AND b6.rec_status = 'A'
    AND b6.serv_prov_code = 'FDNY'
) tr where charge_num is not null

)
select * INTO #TMP_lien from lien;
 --select * from #TMP_lien
WITH addr AS (
    SELECT
                serv_prov_code,
                b1_per_id1,
                b1_per_id2,

                b1_str_name,
                b1_situs_city,
                b1_situs_state,

        (
            SELECT

                     ORDER BY

	AND b.B1_PER_ID1 = rv.B1_PER_ID1
	AND b.B1_PER_ID2 = rv.B1_PER_ID2
	AND b.B1_PER_ID3 = rv.B1_PER_ID3

select * INTO #TMP_contact from contact;
WITH APO AS (
select SERV_PROV_CODE,
		B1_PER_ID1,
		B1_PER_ID2,
		B1_PER_ID3,
		[BIN] as BIN,
		[BLOCK] as BLOCK,
		[LOT] as LOT
from 
(
SELECT
    apo.serv_prov_code AS SERV_PROV_CODE,
    apo.b1_per_id1 AS B1_PER_ID1,
	apo.b1_per_id2 AS B1_PER_ID2,
    apo.b1_per_id3 AS B1_PER_ID3,
    apo.b1_attribute_name,
    apo.b1_attribute_value
FROM
	b3apo_attribute apo
JOIN #TMP_Returned_Values rv ON APO.SERV_PROV_CODE = rv.SERV_PROV_CODE
	AND APO.B1_PER_ID1 = rv.B1_PER_ID1
	AND APO.B1_PER_ID2 = rv.B1_PER_ID2
	AND APO.B1_PER_ID3 = rv.B1_PER_ID3

WHERE
    apo.b1_attribute_name IN ( 'BIN', 'BLOCK','LOT' )
    AND apo.b1_apo_type IN ('ADDRESS')
    ) pva
PIVOT ( 
	MAX(b1_attribute_value) 
	for b1_attribute_name
       IN(
			[BIN],
			[BLOCK],
			[LOT]
		) 
	) pvb
)
select * INTO #TMP_APO from APO;
WITH result_data AS (
SELECT 
	RIGHT('0' + du.ACTDO, 2) AS DO,
    du.ALPHAPREFIX AS APFX, 
    du.ACTTYPE AS ACTTYP, 
    PERMITGRP = CASE 
	WHEN du.ACTTYPE IN ('10', '15', '20', '25') AND du.ACTDO  <> '19'  THEN 'PERMIT' 
	ELSE 
	'NONPERMIT' 
	END ,
	DUEDATE =CASE 
	WHEN du.ACTTYPE IN ('10', '15', '20', '25')  AND du.ACTDO  <> '19' THEN DATEADD(day,455,CONVERT(DATE,li.F4INVOICE_UDF2)) 
	ELSE 
	DATEADD(day,120,CONVERT(DATE,li.F4INVOICE_UDF2)) 
	END,
    du.UNIT,
    bp.b1_alt_id AS RECORD_ID,
--    bp.b1_per_type AS per_type,
--    bp.b1_per_sub_type AS per_sub_type,
    bp.b1_appl_status AS STATUS, 
    bp.b1_appl_status_date AS STATUS_DATE,
--    bp.b1_file_dd AS file_date,                    
    cn.contact_name       AS OWNER_NAME,
--    cn.b1_contact_type AS contact_type,
    ba.b1_hse_nbr_alpha_start AS STR_NUM,
    ba.b1_str_name AS STR_NAME,
    ba.b1_situs_city AS STR_CITY,
    ba.b1_situs_state AS STR_STATE,
    ba.b1_situs_zip AS STR_ZIP,
	ap.BIN,
    ap.BLOCK, 
    ap.LOT,
    du.NO_FEE,
    du.NO_FEE_DATE,
    li.INVOICE_NBR,
    li.BALANCE_DUE,
    li.INVOICE_AMOUNT,
    li.F4INVOICE_UDF1 as CYCLE,
    li.F4INVOICE_UDF2 AS CYCLE_CLOCK,
    li.F4INVOICE_UDF3 AS FIRST_DUNNING_DATE,
    li.F4INVOICE_UDF4 AS FIRST_LIEN_NOTICE_DATE,
    li.REC_DATE,
    li.INVOICE_COMMENT 

FROM
         b1permit bp

    LEFT OUTER JOIN #TMP_contact         cn ON cn.serv_prov_code = bp.serv_prov_code
                                  AND cn.b1_per_id1 = bp.b1_per_id1
                                  AND cn.b1_per_id2 = bp.b1_per_id2
                                  AND cn.b1_per_id3 = bp.b1_per_id3
    LEFT OUTER JOIN #TMP_addr ba ON ba.serv_prov_code = bp.serv_prov_code
                                  AND ba.b1_per_id1 = bp.b1_per_id1
                                  AND ba.b1_per_id2 = bp.b1_per_id2
                                  AND ba.b1_per_id3 = bp.b1_per_id3

    INNER JOIN #TMP_APO ap      ON ap.serv_prov_code = bp.serv_prov_code
                                  AND ap.b1_per_id1 = bp.b1_per_id1
                                  AND ap.b1_per_id2 = bp.b1_per_id2
                                  AND ap.b1_per_id3 = bp.b1_per_id3

    INNER JOIN #TMP_do_unit du ON bp.serv_prov_code = du.serv_prov_code
                                   AND bp.b1_per_id1 = du.b1_per_id1
                                   AND bp.b1_per_id2 = du.b1_per_id2                                   
                                   AND bp.b1_per_id3 = du.b1_per_id3   
    INNER JOIN #TMP_Returned_Values li ON bp.serv_prov_code = li.serv_prov_code
                                   AND bp.b1_per_id1 = li.b1_per_id1
                                   AND bp.b1_per_id2 = li.b1_per_id2                                   
                                   AND bp.b1_per_id3 = li.b1_per_id3  
		
WHERE

       bp.b1_per_type = 'Common' 
       AND  bp.b1_per_sub_type = 'Inspection'
       AND bp.b1_appl_status <> 'Inactive'
	   AND ISDATE(li.F4INVOICE_UDF2) = 1
--	   AND bp.b1_alt_id = @ACCOUNTID
)
select * INTO #TMP_result_data from result_data
WHERE
   PERMITGRP = 'PERMIT'
   AND DO NOT IN ('25','33')
   AND try_convert(DATE,DUEDATE)  <= GETDATE()
   AND NOT exists 
   (
   select * 
   from #TMP_lien 
   WHERE 
     acct_num = RECORD_ID and CYCLE = ISNULL(CYCLE_NUM,'0000000-00')
	);

WITH Returned_Values AS(
SELECT *
FROM
(
SELECT
   x.SERV_PROV_CODE,
   X.B1_PER_ID1,
   X.B1_PER_ID2,
   X.B1_PER_ID3,   
   F.INVOICE_NBR,
   F.BALANCE_DUE,
   F.INVOICE_AMOUNT,
   F.F4INVOICE_UDF1,
   F.F4INVOICE_UDF2,
   F.F4INVOICE_UDF3,
   F.F4INVOICE_UDF4,
   F.REC_DATE,
   F.INVOICE_COMMENT 
FROM
   F4INVOICE F 
   INNER JOIN
      X4FEEITEM_INVOICE X 
      ON X.INVOICE_NBR = F.INVOICE_NBR 
WHERE
       F.BALANCE_DUE > 0 
   AND F.F4INVOICE_UDF1 IS NOT NULL 
   AND F.F4INVOICE_UDF2 IS NOT NULL 
   AND F.F4INVOICE_UDF3 IS NOT NULL 
   AND 
(F.INVOICE_COMMENT LIKE CONCAT('%""%','secondReminder','""',':true','%')
      AND F.INVOICE_COMMENT NOT LIKE CONCAT('%""%','doNotProcess','""',':true','%')
      AND F.INVOICE_COMMENT NOT LIKE CONCAT('%""%','lienAdded','""',':true','%')
--	  AND F.INVOICE_COMMENT LIKE CONCAT('%""%','secondPenAdded','""',':true','%')
   )
   AND F.SERV_PROV_CODE = 'FDNY' 
   AND ISDATE(F.F4INVOICE_UDF2) = 1
   AND DATEADD(day,120,try_convert(DATE,F.F4INVOICE_UDF2)) <= GETDATE()
GROUP BY
   x.SERV_PROV_CODE,
   X.B1_PER_ID1,
   X.B1_PER_ID2,
   X.B1_PER_ID3,   
   F.INVOICE_NBR,
   F.BALANCE_DUE,
   F.INVOICE_AMOUNT,
   F.F4INVOICE_UDF1,
   F.F4INVOICE_UDF2,
   F.F4INVOICE_UDF3,
   F.F4INVOICE_UDF4,
   F.REC_DATE,
   F.INVOICE_COMMENT 
   ) TR
--   WHERE
--           try_convert(DATE,F4INVOICE_UDF2)  <= GETDATE()
) 
   select * INTO #TMP_Returned_Values2 from Returned_Values;
-- select * from Returned_Values

WITH do_unit AS (
select SERV_PROV_CODE,
       B1_PER_ID1,
	   B1_PER_ID2,
	   B1_PER_ID3,
	   [D.O.] as ACTDO,
	   [Alpha Prefix] as ALPHAPREFIX,
	   [Account Type] as ACTTYPE,
	   [No Fee] as NO_FEE,
	   [No Fee Date] as NO_FEE_DATE,
	   [Application Type] as UNIT 
 from 
(
SELECT
    bc.serv_prov_code AS SERV_PROV_CODE,
    bc.b1_per_id1 AS B1_PER_ID1,
    bc.b1_per_id2 AS B1_PER_ID2,
    bc.b1_per_id3 AS B1_PER_ID3,
    
    bc.b1_checkbox_desc,
    bc.b1_checklist_comment
 FROM
         bchckbox bc
JOIN #TMP_Returned_Values2 rv ON bc.SERV_PROV_CODE = rv.SERV_PROV_CODE
	AND bc.B1_PER_ID1 = rv.B1_PER_ID1
	AND bc.B1_PER_ID2 = rv.B1_PER_ID2
	AND bc.B1_PER_ID3 = rv.B1_PER_ID3
WHERE
    bc.b1_checkbox_desc IN ( 'Alpha Prefix', 'D.O.','Account Type','Application Type','No Fee','No Fee Date' )
    AND bc.b1_checkbox_type IN ('PLAN INFORMATION', 'PERMIT REPORT INFO','FEE EXEMPTION INFORMATION')
    ) pvia
PIVOT ( MAX(b1_checklist_comment) for b1_checkbox_desc
            IN([D.O.],
			[Alpha Prefix],
			[Account Type],
			[No Fee],
			[No Fee Date],

			[Application Type])) pvib
)
   select * INTO #TMP_do_unit2 from do_unit;
WITH lien AS (
SELECT 
    serv_prov_code,
	b1_per_id1,
	b1_per_id2,
	b1_per_id3,
	acct_num,
	con_typ,
    con_nbr,
	charge_num,
    reason,
    payment_status,
	cycle_num,
    con_iss_dd,
    con_eff_dd
FROM
(
SELECT
    b6.serv_prov_code,
	b6.b1_per_id1,
	b6.b1_per_id2,
	b6.b1_per_id3,

    b6.b1_con_typ AS con_typ,

	RIGHT('0' + charge.field_value, 6) charge_num,
    reason.field_value   AS   reason,
    pstatus.field_value   AS  payment_status,
    cycstatus.field_value   AS  cycle_num,
    CONVERT(DATE,ISNULL(b6.b1_con_iss_dd,'1970-01-01')) AS con_iss_dd,
    CONVERT(DATE,ISNULL(b6.b1_con_eff_dd1,'1970-01-01'))  AS con_eff_dd

FROM
         b6condit b6
JOIN #TMP_Returned_Values2 rv ON b6.SERV_PROV_CODE = rv.SERV_PROV_CODE
	AND b6.B1_PER_ID1 = rv.B1_PER_ID1
	AND b6.B1_PER_ID2 = rv.B1_PER_ID2
	AND b6.B1_PER_ID3 = rv.B1_PER_ID3
JOIN b1permit bp ON b6.SERV_PROV_CODE = bp.SERV_PROV_CODE
	AND b6.B1_PER_ID1 = bp.B1_PER_ID1
	AND b6.B1_PER_ID2 = bp.B1_PER_ID2
	AND b6.B1_PER_ID3 = bp.B1_PER_ID3

    LEFT JOIN gtmpl_attribute     charge ON b6.b1_con_nbr = charge.entity_seq1
                                        AND b6.b1_per_id1 = charge.entity_key1
                                        AND b6.b1_per_id2 = charge.entity_key2

                                        AND charge.entity_type = '11'

    LEFT JOIN gtmpl_attribute     reason ON b6.b1_con_nbr = reason.entity_seq1

                                        AND b6.b1_per_id2 = reason.entity_key2
                                        AND b6.b1_per_id3 = reason.entity_key3
                                        AND reason.entity_type = '11'
                                        AND reason.field_name = 'Reason'
    LEFT JOIN gtmpl_attribute     pstatus ON b6.b1_con_nbr = pstatus.entity_seq1
                                         AND b6.b1_per_id1 = pstatus.entity_key1
                                         AND b6.b1_per_id2 = pstatus.entity_key2
                                         AND b6.b1_per_id3 = pstatus.entity_key3
                                         AND pstatus.entity_type = '11'
                                         AND pstatus.field_name = 'Payment Status'
    LEFT JOIN gtmpl_attribute     cycstatus ON b6.b1_con_nbr = cycstatus.entity_seq1
                                         AND b6.b1_per_id1 = cycstatus.entity_key1
                                         AND b6.b1_per_id2 = cycstatus.entity_key2
                                         AND b6.b1_per_id3 = cycstatus.entity_key3
                                         AND cycstatus.entity_type = '11'
                                         AND cycstatus.field_name = 'Cycle Number'
WHERE
        b6.b1_con_typ = 'Lien'
    AND b6.rec_status = 'A'
    AND b6.serv_prov_code = 'FDNY'
) tr where charge_num is not null

)

WITH Returned_Values AS(
SELECT *
FROM
(
SELECT
   x.SERV_PROV_CODE,
   X.B1_PER_ID1,
   X.B1_PER_ID2,
   X.B1_PER_ID3,   
   F.INVOICE_NBR,
   F.BALANCE_DUE,
   F.INVOICE_AMOUNT,
   F.F4INVOICE_UDF1,
   F.F4INVOICE_UDF2,
   F.F4INVOICE_UDF3,
   F.F4INVOICE_UDF4,
   F.REC_DATE,
   F.INVOICE_COMMENT 
FROM
   F4INVOICE F 
   INNER JOIN
      X4FEEITEM_INVOICE X 
      ON X.INVOICE_NBR = F.INVOICE_NBR 
WHERE
       F.BALANCE_DUE > 0 
   AND F.F4INVOICE_UDF1 IS NOT NULL 
   AND F.F4INVOICE_UDF2 IS NOT NULL 
   AND F.F4INVOICE_UDF3 IS NOT NULL 
   AND 
(F.INVOICE_COMMENT LIKE CONCAT('%""%','secondReminder','""',':true','%')
      AND F.INVOICE_COMMENT NOT LIKE CONCAT('%""%','doNotProcess','""',':true','%')
      AND F.INVOICE_COMMENT NOT LIKE CONCAT('%""%','lienAdded','""',':true','%')
	  AND F.INVOICE_COMMENT LIKE CONCAT('%""%','secondPenAdded','""',':true','%')
   )
   AND F.SERV_PROV_CODE = 'FDNY' 
   AND ISDATE(F.F4INVOICE_UDF2) = 1
   AND DATEADD(day,120,try_convert(DATE,F.F4INVOICE_UDF2)) <= GETDATE()
GROUP BY
   x.SERV_PROV_CODE,
   X.B1_PER_ID1,
   X.B1_PER_ID2,
   X.B1_PER_ID3,   
   F.INVOICE_NBR,
   F.BALANCE_DUE,
   F.INVOICE_AMOUNT,
   F.F4INVOICE_UDF1,
   F.F4INVOICE_UDF2,
   F.F4INVOICE_UDF3,
   F.F4INVOICE_UDF4,
   F.REC_DATE,
   F.INVOICE_COMMENT 
   ) TR
--   WHERE
--           try_convert(DATE,F4INVOICE_UDF2)  <= GETDATE()
) 
   select * INTO #TMP_Returned_Values from Returned_Values;
-- select * from Returned_Values

WITH do_unit AS (
select SERV_PROV_CODE,
       B1_PER_ID1,
	   B1_PER_ID2,
	   B1_PER_ID3,
	   [D.O.] as ACTDO,
	   [Alpha Prefix] as ALPHAPREFIX,
	   [Account Type] as ACTTYPE,
	   [No Fee] as NO_FEE,
	   [No Fee Date] as NO_FEE_DATE,
	   [Application Type] as UNIT 
 from 
(
SELECT
    bc.serv_prov_code AS SERV_PROV_CODE,
    bc.b1_per_id1 AS B1_PER_ID1,
    bc.b1_per_id2 AS B1_PER_ID2,
    bc.b1_per_id3 AS B1_PER_ID3,
    
    bc.b1_checkbox_desc,
    bc.b1_checklist_comment
 FROM
         bchckbox bc
JOIN #TMP_Returned_Values rv ON bc.SERV_PROV_CODE = rv.SERV_PROV_CODE
	AND bc.B1_PER_ID1 = rv.B1_PER_ID1
	AND bc.B1_PER_ID2 = rv.B1_PER_ID2
	AND bc.B1_PER_ID3 = rv.B1_PER_ID3
WHERE
    bc.b1_checkbox_desc IN ( 'Alpha Prefix', 'D.O.','Account Type','Application Type','No Fee','No Fee Date' )
    AND bc.b1_checkbox_type IN ('PLAN INFORMATION', 'PERMIT REPORT INFO','FEE EXEMPTION INFORMATION')
	AND bc.SERV_PROV_CODE = 'FDNY' 
    ) pvia
PIVOT ( MAX(b1_checklist_comment) for b1_checkbox_desc
            IN([D.O.],
			[Alpha Prefix],
			[Account Type],
			[No Fee],
			[No Fee Date],

			[Application Type])) pvib
)
   select * INTO #TMP_do_unit from do_unit;
WITH lien AS (
SELECT 
    serv_prov_code,
	b1_per_id1,
	b1_per_id2,
	b1_per_id3,
	acct_num,
	con_typ,
    con_nbr,
	charge_num,
    reason,
    payment_status,
	cycle_num,
    con_iss_dd,
    con_eff_dd
FROM
(
SELECT
    b6.serv_prov_code,
	b6.b1_per_id1,
	b6.b1_per_id2,
	b6.b1_per_id3,
	bp.b1_alt_id AS acct_num,
    b6.b1_con_typ AS con_typ,
    b6.b1_con_nbr AS con_nbr,
	RIGHT('0' + charge.field_value, 6) charge_num,
    reason.field_value   AS   reason,
    pstatus.field_value   AS  payment_status,
    cycstatus.field_value   AS  cycle_num,
    CONVERT(DATE,ISNULL(b6.b1_con_iss_dd,'1970-01-01')) AS con_iss_dd,
    CONVERT(DATE,ISNULL(b6.b1_con_eff_dd1,'1970-01-01'))  AS con_eff_dd

FROM
         b6condit b6
JOIN #TMP_Returned_Values rv ON b6.SERV_PROV_CODE = rv.SERV_PROV_CODE
	AND b6.B1_PER_ID1 = rv.B1_PER_ID1
	AND b6.B1_PER_ID2 = rv.B1_PER_ID2
	AND b6.B1_PER_ID3 = rv.B1_PER_ID3
JOIN b1permit bp ON b6.SERV_PROV_CODE = bp.SERV_PROV_CODE
	AND b6.B1_PER_ID1 = bp.B1_PER_ID1
	AND b6.B1_PER_ID2 = bp.B1_PER_ID2
	AND b6.B1_PER_ID3 = bp.B1_PER_ID3

    LEFT JOIN gtmpl_attribute     charge ON b6.b1_con_nbr = charge.entity_seq1
                                        AND b6.b1_per_id1 = charge.entity_key1
                                        AND b6.b1_per_id2 = charge.entity_key2
                                        AND b6.b1_per_id3 = charge.entity_key3
                                        AND charge.entity_type = '11'
                                        AND charge.field_name = 'Charge Number'
    LEFT JOIN gtmpl_attribute     reason ON b6.b1_con_nbr = reason.entity_seq1
                                        AND b6.b1_per_id1 = reason.entity_key1
                                        AND b6.b1_per_id2 = reason.entity_key2
                                        AND b6.b1_per_id3 = reason.entity_key3
                                        AND reason.entity_type = '11'
                                        AND reason.field_name = 'Reason'
    LEFT JOIN gtmpl_attribute     pstatus ON b6.b1_con_nbr = pstatus.entity_seq1
                                         AND b6.b1_per_id1 = pstatus.entity_key1
                                         AND b6.b1_per_id2 = pstatus.entity_key2
                                         AND b6.b1_per_id3 = pstatus.entity_key3
                                         AND pstatus.entity_type = '11'
                                         AND pstatus.field_name = 'Payment Status'
    LEFT JOIN gtmpl_attribute     cycstatus ON b6.b1_con_nbr = cycstatus.entity_seq1
                                         AND b6.b1_per_id1 = cycstatus.entity_key1
                                         AND b6.b1_per_id2 = cycstatus.entity_key2
                                         AND b6.b1_per_id3 = cycstatus.entity_key3
                                         AND cycstatus.entity_type = '11'
                                         AND cycstatus.field_name = 'Cycle Number'
WHERE
        b6.b1_con_typ = 'Lien'
    AND b6.rec_status = 'A'
    AND b6.serv_prov_code = 'FDNY'
) tr where charge_num is not null

)
select * INTO #TMP_lien from lien;
 --select * from #TMP_lien

WITH APO AS (
select SERV_PROV_CODE,
		B1_PER_ID1,
		B1_PER_ID2,
		B1_PER_ID3,
		[BIN] as BIN,
		[BLOCK] as BLOCK,
		[LOT] as LOT
from 
(
SELECT
    apo.serv_prov_code AS SERV_PROV_CODE,
    apo.b1_per_id1 AS B1_PER_ID1,
	apo.b1_per_id2 AS B1_PER_ID2,
    apo.b1_per_id3 AS B1_PER_ID3,
    apo.b1_attribute_name,
    apo.b1_attribute_value
FROM
	b3apo_attribute apo
JOIN #TMP_Returned_Values rv ON APO.SERV_PROV_CODE = rv.SERV_PROV_CODE
	AND APO.B1_PER_ID1 = rv.B1_PER_ID1
	AND APO.B1_PER_ID2 = rv.B1_PER_ID2
	AND APO.B1_PER_ID3 = rv.B1_PER_ID3

WHERE
    apo.b1_attribute_name IN ( 'BIN', 'BLOCK','LOT' )
    AND apo.b1_apo_type IN ('ADDRESS')
	and apo.serv_prov_code = 'FDNY'
    ) pva
PIVOT ( 
	MAX(b1_attribute_value) 
	for b1_attribute_name
       IN(
			[BIN],
			[BLOCK],
			[LOT]
		) 
	) pvb
)

	ELSE

WITH APO AS (
select SERV_PROV_CODE,
		B1_PER_ID1,
		B1_PER_ID2,
		B1_PER_ID3,
		[BIN] as BIN,
		[BLOCK] as BLOCK,
		[LOT] as LOT
from 
(
SELECT
    apo.serv_prov_code AS SERV_PROV_CODE,
    apo.b1_per_id1 AS B1_PER_ID1,
	apo.b1_per_id2 AS B1_PER_ID2,
    apo.b1_per_id3 AS B1_PER_ID3,
    apo.b1_attribute_name,
    apo.b1_attribute_value
FROM
	b3apo_attribute apo
JOIN #TMP_Returned_Values2 rv ON APO.SERV_PROV_CODE = rv.SERV_PROV_CODE
	AND APO.B1_PER_ID1 = rv.B1_PER_ID1
	AND APO.B1_PER_ID2 = rv.B1_PER_ID2
	AND APO.B1_PER_ID3 = rv.B1_PER_ID3

WHERE
    apo.b1_attribute_name IN ( 'BIN', 'BLOCK','LOT' )
    AND apo.b1_apo_type IN ('ADDRESS')
	AND apo.serv_prov_code = 'FDNY'
    ) pva
PIVOT ( 
	MAX(b1_attribute_value) 
	for b1_attribute_name
       IN(
			[BIN],
			[BLOCK],
			[LOT]
		) 
	) pvb
)

WITH result_data2 AS (
SELECT 
	RIGHT('0' + du.ACTDO, 2) AS DO,
    du.ALPHAPREFIX AS APFX, 
    du.ACTTYPE AS ACTTYP, 
    PERMITGRP = CASE 
	WHEN du.ACTTYPE IN ('10', '15', '20', '25') AND du.ACTDO  <> '19'  THEN 'PERMIT' 
	ELSE 
	'NONPERMIT' 
	END ,
	DUEDATE =CASE 
	WHEN du.ACTTYPE IN ('10', '15', '20', '25')  AND du.ACTDO  <> '19' THEN DATEADD(day,455,CONVERT(DATE,li.F4INVOICE_UDF2)) 
	ELSE 
	DATEADD(day,120,CONVERT(DATE,li.F4INVOICE_UDF2)) 
	END,
    du.UNIT,
    bp.b1_alt_id AS RECORD_ID,
--    bp.b1_per_type AS per_type,
--    bp.b1_per_sub_type AS per_sub_type,
    bp.b1_appl_status AS STATUS, 
    bp.b1_appl_status_date AS STATUS_DATE,
--    bp.b1_file_dd AS file_date,                    
    cn.contact_name       AS OWNER_NAME,
--    cn.b1_contact_type AS contact_type,
    ba.b1_hse_nbr_alpha_start AS STR_NUM,
    ba.b1_str_name AS STR_NAME,
    ba.b1_situs_city AS STR_CITY,
    ba.b1_situs_state AS STR_STATE,
    ba.b1_situs_zip AS STR_ZIP,
	ap.BIN,
    ap.BLOCK, 
    ap.LOT,
    du.NO_FEE,
    du.NO_FEE_DATE,
--    li.INVOICE_NBR,
    li.BALANCE_DUE,
    li.INVOICE_AMOUNT,
    li.F4INVOICE_UDF1 as CYCLE,
    li.F4INVOICE_UDF2 AS CYCLE_CLOCK,
    li.F4INVOICE_UDF3 AS FIRST_DUNNING_DATE,
    li.F4INVOICE_UDF4 AS FIRST_LIEN_NOTICE_DATE,
    li.REC_DATE,
    li.INVOICE_COMMENT 

FROM
         b1permit bp

    LEFT OUTER JOIN #TMP_contact2         cn ON cn.serv_prov_code = bp.serv_prov_code
                                  AND cn.b1_per_id1 = bp.b1_per_id1
                                  AND cn.b1_per_id2 = bp.b1_per_id2
                                  AND cn.b1_per_id3 = bp.b1_per_id3
    LEFT OUTER JOIN #TMP_addr2 ba ON ba.serv_prov_code = bp.serv_prov_code
                                  AND ba.b1_per_id1 = bp.b1_per_id1
                                  AND ba.b1_per_id2 = bp.b1_per_id2
                                  AND ba.b1_per_id3 = bp.b1_per_id3

    INNER JOIN #TMP_APO2 ap      ON ap.serv_prov_code = bp.serv_prov_code
                                  AND ap.b1_per_id1 = bp.b1_per_id1
                                  AND ap.b1_per_id2 = bp.b1_per_id2
                                  AND ap.b1_per_id3 = bp.b1_per_id3

    INNER JOIN #TMP_do_unit2 du ON bp.serv_prov_code = du.serv_prov_code
                                   AND bp.b1_per_id1 = du.b1_per_id1
                                   AND bp.b1_per_id2 = du.b1_per_id2                                   
                                   AND bp.b1_per_id3 = du.b1_per_id3   
    INNER JOIN #TMP_Returned_Values2 li ON bp.serv_prov_code = li.serv_prov_code
                                   AND bp.b1_per_id1 = li.b1_per_id1
                                   AND bp.b1_per_id2 = li.b1_per_id2                                   
                                   AND bp.b1_per_id3 = li.b1_per_id3  
		
WHERE

       bp.b1_per_type = 'Common' 
       AND  bp.b1_per_sub_type = 'Inspection'
       AND bp.b1_appl_status <> 'Inactive'
	   AND ISDATE(li.F4INVOICE_UDF2) = 1
	   and bp.serv_prov_code = 'FDNY'
--	   AND bp.b1_alt_id = @ACCOUNTID
) 
select * INTO #TMP_result_data2 from result_data2
WHERE
   PERMITGRP = 'NONPERMIT'
   AND DO NOT IN ('25','33')
   AND try_convert(DATE,DUEDATE)  <= GETDATE()
   AND NOT exists 
   (
   select * 
   from #TMP_lien2 
   WHERE 
     acct_num = RECORD_ID and CYCLE = ISNULL(CYCLE_NUM,'0000000-00')
	);

WITH Returned_Values AS(
SELECT *
FROM
(
SELECT
   x.SERV_PROV_CODE,
   X.B1_PER_ID1,
   X.B1_PER_ID2,
   X.B1_PER_ID3,   
   F.INVOICE_NBR,
   F.BALANCE_DUE,
   F.INVOICE_AMOUNT,
   F.F4INVOICE_UDF1,
   F.F4INVOICE_UDF2,
   F.F4INVOICE_UDF3,
   F.F4INVOICE_UDF4,
   F.REC_DATE,
   F.INVOICE_COMMENT 
FROM
   F4INVOICE F 
   INNER JOIN
      X4FEEITEM_INVOICE X 
      ON X.INVOICE_NBR = F.INVOICE_NBR 
WHERE
       F.BALANCE_DUE > 0 
   AND F.F4INVOICE_UDF1 IS NOT NULL 
   AND F.F4INVOICE_UDF2 IS NOT NULL 
   AND F.F4INVOICE_UDF3 IS NOT NULL 
   AND 
(F.INVOICE_COMMENT LIKE CONCAT('%""%','secondReminder','""',':true','%')
      AND F.INVOICE_COMMENT NOT LIKE CONCAT('%""%','doNotProcess','""',':true','%')
      AND F.INVOICE_COMMENT NOT LIKE CONCAT('%""%','lienAdded','""',':true','%')
	  AND F.INVOICE_COMMENT LIKE CONCAT('%""%','secondPenAdded','""',':true','%')
   )
   AND F.SERV_PROV_CODE = 'FDNY' 
   AND ISDATE(F.F4INVOICE_UDF2) = 1
   AND DATEADD(day,120,try_convert(DATE,F.F4INVOICE_UDF2)) <= GETDATE()
GROUP BY
   x.SERV_PROV_CODE,
   X.B1_PER_ID1,
   X.B1_PER_ID2,
   X.B1_PER_ID3,   
   F.INVOICE_NBR,
   F.BALANCE_DUE,
   F.INVOICE_AMOUNT,
   F.F4INVOICE_UDF1,
   F.F4INVOICE_UDF2,
   F.F4INVOICE_UDF3,
   F.F4INVOICE_UDF4,
   F.REC_DATE,
   F.INVOICE_COMMENT 
   ) TR
--   WHERE
--           try_convert(DATE,F4INVOICE_UDF2)  <= GETDATE()
)

WITH APO AS (
select SERV_PROV_CODE,
		B1_PER_ID1,
		B1_PER_ID2,
		B1_PER_ID3,
		[BIN] as BIN,
		[BLOCK] as BLOCK,
		[LOT] as LOT
from 
(
SELECT
    apo.serv_prov_code AS SERV_PROV_CODE,
    apo.b1_per_id1 AS B1_PER_ID1,
	apo.b1_per_id2 AS B1_PER_ID2,
    apo.b1_per_id3 AS B1_PER_ID3,
    apo.b1_attribute_name,
    apo.b1_attribute_value
FROM
	b3apo_attribute apo
JOIN #TMP_Returned_Values rv ON APO.SERV_PROV_CODE = rv.SERV_PROV_CODE
	AND APO.B1_PER_ID1 = rv.B1_PER_ID1
	AND APO.B1_PER_ID2 = rv.B1_PER_ID2
	AND APO.B1_PER_ID3 = rv.B1_PER_ID3

WHERE
    apo.b1_attribute_name IN ( 'BIN', 'BLOCK','LOT' )
    AND apo.b1_apo_type IN ('ADDRESS')
	and apo.serv_prov_code = 'FDNY'
    ) pva
PIVOT ( 
	MAX(b1_attribute_value) 
	for b1_attribute_name
       IN(
			[BIN],
			[BLOCK],
			[LOT]
		) 
	) pvb
)
select * INTO #TMP_APO from APO;
WITH result_data AS (
SELECT 
	RIGHT('0' + du.ACTDO, 2) AS DO,
    du.ALPHAPREFIX AS APFX, 
    du.ACTTYPE AS ACTTYP, 
    PERMITGRP = CASE 
	WHEN du.ACTTYPE IN ('10', '15', '20', '25') AND du.ACTDO  <> '19'  THEN 'PERMIT' 
	ELSE 
	'NONPERMIT' 
	END ,
	DUEDATE =CASE 
	WHEN du.ACTTYPE IN ('10', '15', '20', '25')  AND du.ACTDO  <> '19' THEN DATEADD(day,455,CONVERT(DATE,li.F4INVOICE_UDF2)) 
	ELSE 
	DATEADD(day,120,CONVERT(DATE,li.F4INVOICE_UDF2)) 
	END,
    du.UNIT,
    bp.b1_alt_id AS RECORD_ID,
--    bp.b1_per_type AS per_type,
--    bp.b1_per_sub_type AS per_sub_type,
    bp.b1_appl_status AS STATUS, 
    bp.b1_appl_status_date AS STATUS_DATE,
--    bp.b1_file_dd AS file_date,                    
    cn.contact_name       AS OWNER_NAME,
--    cn.b1_contact_type AS contact_type,
    ba.b1_hse_nbr_alpha_start AS STR_NUM,
    ba.b1_str_name AS STR_NAME,
    ba.b1_situs_city AS STR_CITY,
    ba.b1_situs_state AS STR_STATE,
    ba.b1_situs_zip AS STR_ZIP,
	ap.BIN,
    ap.BLOCK, 
    ap.LOT,
    du.NO_FEE,
    du.NO_FEE_DATE,
--    li.INVOICE_NBR,
    li.BALANCE_DUE,
    li.INVOICE_AMOUNT,
    li.F4INVOICE_UDF1 as CYCLE,
    li.F4INVOICE_UDF2 AS CYCLE_CLOCK,
    li.F4INVOICE_UDF3 AS FIRST_DUNNING_DATE,
    li.F4INVOICE_UDF4 AS FIRST_LIEN_NOTICE_DATE,
    li.REC_DATE,
    li.INVOICE_COMMENT 

FROM
         b1permit bp

    LEFT OUTER JOIN #TMP_contact         cn ON cn.serv_prov_code = bp.serv_prov_code
                                  AND cn.b1_per_id1 = bp.b1_per_id1
                                  AND cn.b1_per_id2 = bp.b1_per_id2
                                  AND cn.b1_per_id3 = bp.b1_per_id3
    LEFT OUTER JOIN #TMP_addr ba ON ba.serv_prov_code = bp.serv_prov_code
                                  AND ba.b1_per_id1 = bp.b1_per_id1
                                  AND ba.b1_per_id2 = bp.b1_per_id2
                                  AND ba.b1_per_id3 = bp.b1_per_id3

    INNER JOIN #TMP_APO ap      ON ap.serv_prov_code = bp.serv_prov_code
                                  AND ap.b1_per_id1 = bp.b1_per_id1
                                  AND ap.b1_per_id2 = bp.b1_per_id2
                                  AND ap.b1_per_id3 = bp.b1_per_id3

    INNER JOIN #TMP_do_unit du ON bp.serv_prov_code = du.serv_prov_code
                                   AND bp.b1_per_id1 = du.b1_per_id1
                                   AND bp.b1_per_id2 = du.b1_per_id2                                   
                                   AND bp.b1_per_id3 = du.b1_per_id3   
    INNER JOIN #TMP_Returned_Values li ON bp.serv_prov_code = li.serv_prov_code
                                   AND bp.b1_per_id1 = li.b1_per_id1
                                   AND bp.b1_per_id2 = li.b1_per_id2                                   
                                   AND bp.b1_per_id3 = li.b1_per_id3  
		
WHERE

       bp.b1_per_type = 'Common' 
       AND  bp.b1_per_sub_type = 'Inspection'
       AND bp.b1_appl_status <> 'Inactive'
	   AND ISDATE(li.F4INVOICE_UDF2) = 1
	   AND bp.serv_prov_code = 'FDNY'
--	   AND bp.b1_alt_id = @ACCOUNTID
)

WITH Returned_Values AS(
SELECT *
FROM
(
SELECT
   x.SERV_PROV_CODE,
   X.B1_PER_ID1,
   X.B1_PER_ID2,
   X.B1_PER_ID3,   
   F.INVOICE_NBR,
   F.BALANCE_DUE,
   F.INVOICE_AMOUNT,
   F.F4INVOICE_UDF1,
   F.F4INVOICE_UDF2,
   F.F4INVOICE_UDF3,
   F.F4INVOICE_UDF4,
   F.REC_DATE,
   F.INVOICE_COMMENT 
FROM
   F4INVOICE F 
   INNER JOIN
      X4FEEITEM_INVOICE X 
      ON X.INVOICE_NBR = F.INVOICE_NBR 
WHERE
       F.BALANCE_DUE > 0 
   AND F.F4INVOICE_UDF1 IS NOT NULL 
   AND F.F4INVOICE_UDF2 IS NOT NULL 
   AND F.F4INVOICE_UDF3 IS NOT NULL 
   AND 
(F.INVOICE_COMMENT LIKE CONCAT('%""%','secondReminder','""',':true','%')
      AND F.INVOICE_COMMENT NOT LIKE CONCAT('%""%','doNotProcess','""',':true','%')
      AND F.INVOICE_COMMENT NOT LIKE CONCAT('%""%','lienAdded','""',':true','%')
--	  AND F.INVOICE_COMMENT LIKE CONCAT('%""%','secondPenAdded','""',':true','%')
   )
   AND F.SERV_PROV_CODE = 'FDNY' 
   AND ISDATE(F.F4INVOICE_UDF2) = 1
   AND DATEADD(day,120,try_convert(DATE,F.F4INVOICE_UDF2)) <= GETDATE()
GROUP BY
   x.SERV_PROV_CODE,
   X.B1_PER_ID1,
   X.B1_PER_ID2,
   X.B1_PER_ID3,   
   F.INVOICE_NBR,
   F.BALANCE_DUE,
   F.INVOICE_AMOUNT,
   F.F4INVOICE_UDF1,
   F.F4INVOICE_UDF2,
   F.F4INVOICE_UDF3,
   F.F4INVOICE_UDF4,
   F.REC_DATE,
   F.INVOICE_COMMENT 
   ) TR
--   WHERE
--           try_convert(DATE,F4INVOICE_UDF2)  <= GETDATE()
) 
   select * INTO #TMP_Returned_Values2 from Returned_Values;

    cycstatus.field_value   AS  cycle_num,

	AND b6.B1_PER_ID2 = rv.B1_PER_ID2
	AND b6.B1_PER_ID3 = rv.B1_PER_ID3
JOIN b1permit bp ON b6.SERV_PROV_CODE = bp.SERV_PROV_CODE
	AND b6.B1_PER_ID1 = bp.B1_PER_ID1
	AND b6.B1_PER_ID2 = bp.B1_PER_ID2
	AND b6.B1_PER_ID3 = bp.B1_PER_ID3

    LEFT JOIN gtmpl_attribute     charge ON b6.b1_con_nbr = charge.entity_seq1
                                        AND b6.b1_per_id1 = charge.entity_key1
                                        AND b6.b1_per_id2 = charge.entity_key2
                                        AND b6.b1_per_id3 = charge.entity_key3
                                        AND charge.entity_type = '11'
                                        AND charge.field_name = 'Charge Number'
    LEFT JOIN gtmpl_attribute     reason ON b6.b1_con_nbr = reason.entity_seq1
                                        AND b6.b1_per_id1 = reason.entity_key1
                                        AND b6.b1_per_id2 = reason.entity_key2
                                        AND b6.b1_per_id3 = reason.entity_key3
                                        AND reason.entity_type = '11'
                                        AND reason.field_name = 'Reason'
    LEFT JOIN gtmpl_attribute     pstatus ON b6.b1_con_nbr = pstatus.entity_seq1
                                         AND b6.b1_per_id1 = pstatus.entity_key1
                                         AND b6.b1_per_id2 = pstatus.entity_key2
                                         AND b6.b1_per_id3 = pstatus.entity_key3
                                         AND pstatus.entity_type = '11'
                                         AND pstatus.field_name = 'Payment Status'
    LEFT JOIN gtmpl_attribute     cycstatus ON b6.b1_con_nbr = cycstatus.entity_seq1
                                         AND b6.b1_per_id1 = cycstatus.entity_key1
                                         AND b6.b1_per_id2 = cycstatus.entity_key2
                                         AND b6.b1_per_id3 = cycstatus.entity_key3
                                         AND cycstatus.entity_type = '11'
                                         AND cycstatus.field_name = 'Cycle Number'
WHERE
        b6.b1_con_typ = 'Lien'
    AND b6.rec_status = 'A'
    AND b6.serv_prov_code = 'FDNY'
) tr where charge_num is not null

)

            ROW_NUMBER () OVER ( PARTITION BY C.SERV_PROV_CODE, C.B1_PER_ID1, C.B1_PER_ID2, C.B1_PER_ID3 
         ORDER BY C.B1_CONTACT_TYPE DESC, C.REC_DATE DESC) RN 
         FROM
                B3CONTACT C

	AND C.B1_PER_ID1 = rv.B1_PER_ID1
	AND C.B1_PER_ID2 = rv.B1_PER_ID2
	AND C.B1_PER_ID3 = rv.B1_PER_ID3

         WHERE
            C.SERV_PROV_CODE = 'FDNY' 
            AND C.REC_STATUS = 'A' 
            AND C.B1_CONTACT_TYPE IN 
            (
               'Permit / LOA Contact',
               'Building Owner',
               'Business Owner'
            )
      )  AS TR 
   WHERE
      RN = 1
)

	AND I.B1_PER_ID3 = ad.B1_PER_ID3

               'Pending Review',
               'Pending Routing Approval',
               'Rescheduled',
               'Scheduled',
               'Scheduling Pending',
               'Satisfactory',
               'Unsatisfactory'
            )
            AND I.G6_COMPL_DD IS NOT NULL
      )

      CASE

            LEN(TRIM([Comments 1])) > 0 
            AND [Comments 1] IS NOT NULL 
         THEN
            [Comments 1]

            '' 
      END
      + 
      CASE
         WHEN
            LEN(TRIM([Comments 2])) > 0

         THEN
            CHAR(13) + CHAR(10) + [Comments 2] 
         ELSE
            '' 
      END
      + 
      CASE
         WHEN
            LEN(TRIM([Comments 3])) > 0

         THEN
            CHAR(13) + CHAR(10) + [Comments 3] 
         ELSE
            '' 
      END
      AS COV_COMMENT

            BC.SERV_PROV_CODE AS SERV_PROV_CODE,

	AND BC.B1_PER_ID2 = rv.B1_PER_ID2
	AND BC.B1_PER_ID3 = rv.B1_PER_ID3

            BC.SERV_PROV_CODE = 'FDNY' 
            AND BC.REC_STATUS = 'A' 
            AND BC.B1_ACT_STATUS = 'BFP_COM_INSP' 
            AND BC.B1_PER_SUB_TYPE = 'Inspection' 
            AND BC.B1_CHECKBOX_TYPE IN 
            (
               'PLAN INFORMATION',
               'COVERAGE COMMENTS'
            )
            AND BC.B1_CHECKBOX_DESC IN 
            (

               'Comments 1',
               'Comments 2',

      )

WITH Returned_Values AS(

	apo.B1_PER_ID1,

	B.B1_ALT_ID AS ACCT_NUM,

FROM
	b3apo_attribute apo
JOIN b1permit b ON b.SERV_PROV_CODE = apo.SERV_PROV_CODE
	AND b.B1_PER_ID1 = apo.B1_PER_ID1
	AND b.B1_PER_ID2 = apo.B1_PER_ID2
	AND b.B1_PER_ID3 = apo.B1_PER_ID3
WHERE
    apo.b1_attribute_name IN ( 'BIN')
    AND apo.b1_apo_type IN ('ADDRESS')
	AND apo.B1_ATTRIBUTE_VALUE = @BIN_TEXT
--	AND apo.B1_ATTRIBUTE_VALUE IS NOT NULL
	AND b.SERV_PROV_CODE = 'FDNY' 
	AND b.b1_per_type = 'Common' 
    AND  b.b1_per_sub_type = 'Inspection'
    AND b.b1_appl_status NOT IN ('Inactive','Undefined')
	AND b.REC_STATUS = 'A'
	AND  b.B1_PER_CATEGORY = 'Process'
) 
   select * INTO #TMP_Returned_Values from Returned_Values;

WITH LAST_INSP AS (
SELECT
   CONVERT(VARCHAR, G6_COMPL_DD, 101) LAST_INSP_DATE,
   G6_STATUS LAST_INSP_STATUS,
   BIN,
   ACCT_NUM 
FROM
   (
      SELECT
         SERV_PROV_CODE,
         B1_PER_ID1,
         B1_PER_ID2,
         B1_PER_ID3,
         G6_COMPL_DD,
         G6_STATUS,
         BIN,
         ACCT_NUM,
         ROW_NUMBER () OVER (PARTITION BY BIN 
      ORDER BY
         G6_COMPL_DD DESC) RN2 
      FROM
         (
            SELECT
               I.SERV_PROV_CODE,
               I.B1_PER_ID1,
               I.B1_PER_ID2,
               I.B1_PER_ID3,
               I.G6_COMPL_DD,
               I.G6_STATUS,
               RV.BIN,
               RV.ACCT_NUM,
               ROW_NUMBER () OVER ( PARTITION BY I.SERV_PROV_CODE, I.B1_PER_ID1, I.B1_PER_ID2, I.B1_PER_ID3 
            ORDER BY
               I.G6_COMPL_DD DESC, I.G6_ACT_NUM DESC) RN 
            FROM
                  G6ACTION I 
JOIN #TMP_Returned_Values rv ON I.SERV_PROV_CODE = rv.SERV_PROV_CODE
	AND I.B1_PER_ID1 = rv.B1_PER_ID1
	AND I.B1_PER_ID2 = rv.B1_PER_ID2
	AND I.B1_PER_ID3 = rv.B1_PER_ID3         
            WHERE
               I.SERV_PROV_CODE = 'FDNY' 
               AND I.REC_STATUS = 'A' 
               AND I.G6_STATUS NOT IN 
               (
                  'Assignment Complete',
                  'Cancelled',
                  'Issue Progress',
                  'Pending',
                  'Pending Review',
                  'Pending Routing Approval',
                  'Rescheduled',
                  'Scheduled',
                  'Satisfactory'
               )
               AND I.G6_COMPL_DD IS NOT NULL
         )  AS T 
      WHERE
         RN = 1
   ) AS T1 
WHERE
   RN2 = 1
   )

   select * INTO #TMP_LAST_INSP from LAST_INSP;
--   select * from #TMP_LAST_INSP;

SELECT
   B.ACCT_NUM,
   B.BIN,
   B.LAST_INSP_DATE,
   B.LAST_INSP_STATUS 
FROM
   #TMP_LAST_INSP B 
ORDER BY
   B.LAST_INSP_DATE DESC;
DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #TMP_Returned_Values;

DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #TMP_Returned_Values;

DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #TMP_NEW_INFRACTION;

WITH Returned_Values AS(
SELECT 
	apo.SERV_PROV_CODE,
	apo.B1_PER_ID1,
	apo.B1_PER_ID2,
	apo.B1_PER_ID3,
	B.B1_ALT_ID AS ACCT_NUM,
	apo.B1_ATTRIBUTE_VALUE AS BIN,
	b.B1_FILE_DD
FROM
	b3apo_attribute apo
JOIN b1permit b ON b.SERV_PROV_CODE = apo.SERV_PROV_CODE
	AND b.B1_PER_ID1 = apo.B1_PER_ID1
	AND b.B1_PER_ID2 = apo.B1_PER_ID2
	AND b.B1_PER_ID3 = apo.B1_PER_ID3
WHERE
    apo.b1_attribute_name IN ( 'BIN')
    AND apo.b1_apo_type IN ('ADDRESS')
	AND apo.B1_ATTRIBUTE_VALUE = @BIN_TEXT
--	AND apo.B1_ATTRIBUTE_VALUE IS NOT NULL
	AND b.SERV_PROV_CODE = 'FDNY' 
	AND b.b1_per_type = 'Enforcement' 
    AND  b.b1_per_sub_type = 'FDNY Summons'
    AND b.b1_appl_status NOT IN ('Inactive','Undefined')
	AND b.REC_STATUS = 'A'
    AND B.B1_APPL_STATUS NOT IN 
      (
         'Voided - No Hearing Required',
         'Abated - No Hearing Required',
         'Corrected - Hearing Required',
         'Cure Letter Issued-No hearing',
         'Withdrawn',
         'Written Off',
		 'Inactive',
		 'Undefined',
		 'Voided - No Hearing Required',
		 'Abated - No Hearing Required'
      )
) 
   select * INTO #TMP_Returned_Values from Returned_Values;
--   select * from #TMP_Returned_Values
WITH CONTACT AS 
(
         SELECT
            C.SERV_PROV_CODE,
            C.B1_PER_ID1,
            C.B1_PER_ID2,
            C.B1_PER_ID3,
            ISNULL(CONCAT(C.B1_FNAME,' ',C.B1_MNAME,' ',C.B1_LNAME), C.B1_BUSINESS_NAME) OWNER_NAME
         FROM
                B3CONTACT C 
JOIN #TMP_Returned_Values rv ON C.SERV_PROV_CODE = rv.SERV_PROV_CODE
	AND C.B1_PER_ID1 = rv.B1_PER_ID1
	AND C.B1_PER_ID2 = rv.B1_PER_ID2
	AND C.B1_PER_ID3 = rv.B1_PER_ID3

         WHERE
            C.SERV_PROV_CODE = 'FDNY' 
            AND C.REC_STATUS = 'A' 
            AND C.B1_CONTACT_TYPE IN 
            (
               'Respondent'
            )
)
select * INTO #TMP_contact from contact;

WITH ASI AS 
(
   SELECT
      SERV_PROV_CODE,
      B1_PER_ID1,
      B1_PER_ID2,
      B1_PER_ID3,
      CAST([Creation Date / TIME] AS DATE) SUMMONS_DATE,
      [FDNY] FDNY_CHK,
      [Oath] OATH_CHK,
      [FDNY Written Off] FDNY_OFF,
      B1_FILE_DD,
      ACCT_NUM,
      BIN 
   FROM
      (
         SELECT
            BC.SERV_PROV_CODE AS SERV_PROV_CODE,
            BC.B1_PER_ID1 AS B1_PER_ID1,
            BC.B1_PER_ID2 AS B1_PER_ID2,
            BC.B1_PER_ID3 AS B1_PER_ID3,
            BC.B1_CHECKBOX_DESC,
            BC.B1_CHECKLIST_COMMENT,
            rv.B1_FILE_DD,
            rv.ACCT_NUM,
            rv.BIN 
         FROM
            BCHCKBOX BC 
JOIN #TMP_Returned_Values rv ON BC.SERV_PROV_CODE = rv.SERV_PROV_CODE
	AND BC.B1_PER_ID1 = rv.B1_PER_ID1
	AND BC.B1_PER_ID2 = rv.B1_PER_ID2
	AND BC.B1_PER_ID3 = rv.B1_PER_ID3
         WHERE
            BC.SERV_PROV_CODE = 'FDNY' 
            AND BC.REC_STATUS = 'A' 
            AND BC.B1_ACT_STATUS = 'BFP_FSUM' 
            AND BC.B1_PER_SUB_TYPE = 'FDNY Summons' 
            AND BC.B1_CHECKBOX_TYPE IN 
            (
               'SUMMONS INFORMATION',
               'COMPLIANCE INFORMATION',
               'FDNY WRITTEN OFF'
            )
            AND BC.B1_CHECKBOX_DESC IN 
            (
               'Creation Date/TIME',
               'FDNY',
               'Oath',
               'FDNY Written Off'
            )
      )
      PVIA PIVOT ( MAX(B1_CHECKLIST_COMMENT) FOR B1_CHECKBOX_DESC IN 
      (
         [Creation Date / TIME],
         [FDNY],
         [Oath],
         [FDNY Written Off] 
      )
) PVIB 
   WHERE
      [FDNY] IS NULL 
      AND [Oath] IS NULL 
      AND [FDNY Written Off] IS NULL 
)
select * INTO #TMP_ASI from ASI;

WITH LEGACY_INFRACTION AS 
(
   SELECT
      SERV_PROV_CODE,
      B1_PER_ID1,
      B1_PER_ID2,
      B1_PER_ID3,
      STRING_AGG(ISNULL(INFRACTION, '') + ': ' + ISNULL(INFRACTIONDESC, ''), CHAR(13)) WITHIN GROUP (
   ORDER BY
      ROW_INDEX) AS INFRA_DESC 
   FROM
      (
         SELECT
            * 
         FROM
            (
               SELECT
                  A.SERV_PROV_CODE,
                  A.B1_PER_ID1,
                  A.B1_PER_ID2,
                  A.B1_PER_ID3,
                  A.TABLE_NAME,
                  A.COLUMN_NAME,
                  A.ROW_INDEX,
                  A.ATTRIBUTE_VALUE 
               FROM
                  BAPPSPECTABLE_VALUE A 
                  INNER JOIN
                     #TMP_ASI S 
                     ON A.SERV_PROV_CODE = S.SERV_PROV_CODE 
                     AND A.B1_PER_ID1 = S.B1_PER_ID1 
                     AND A.B1_PER_ID2 = S.B1_PER_ID2 
                     AND A.B1_PER_ID3 = S.B1_PER_ID3 
               WHERE
                  A.SERV_PROV_CODE = 'FDNY' 
                  AND A.GROUP_NAME = 'BFP_FSUM' 
                  AND A.TABLE_NAME = 'INFRACTION DISPOSITION DETAILS' 
                  AND A.REC_STATUS = 'A'
            )
            T PIVOT (MAX ( ATTRIBUTE_VALUE) FOR COLUMN_NAME IN 
            (
               [Infraction],
               [INFRACTIONDESC] 
            )
) T1
      )
      T2 
   GROUP BY
      SERV_PROV_CODE,
      B1_PER_ID1,
      B1_PER_ID2,
      B1_PER_ID3 
)
select * INTO #TMP_LEGACY_INFRACTION from LEGACY_INFRACTION;
WITH NEW_INFRACTION AS 
(
   SELECT
      SERV_PROV_CODE,
      B1_PER_ID1,
      B1_PER_ID2,
      B1_PER_ID3,
      STRING_AGG(ISNULL([Violation Category], '') + ': ' + ISNULL([Infraction Description], ''), CHAR(13) + CHAR(10)) WITHIN GROUP (
   ORDER BY
      ROW_INDEX) AS INFRA_DESC 
   FROM
      (
         SELECT
            * 
         FROM
            (
               SELECT
                  A.SERV_PROV_CODE,
                  A.B1_PER_ID1,
                  A.B1_PER_ID2,
                  A.B1_PER_ID3,
                  A.TABLE_NAME,
                  A.COLUMN_NAME,
                  A.ROW_INDEX,
                  A.ATTRIBUTE_VALUE 
               FROM
                  BAPPSPECTABLE_VALUE A 
                  INNER JOIN
                     #TMP_ASI S 
                     ON A.SERV_PROV_CODE = S.SERV_PROV_CODE 
                     AND A.B1_PER_ID1 = S.B1_PER_ID1 
                     AND A.B1_PER_ID2 = S.B1_PER_ID2 
                     AND A.B1_PER_ID3 = S.B1_PER_ID3 
               WHERE
                  A.SERV_PROV_CODE = 'FDNY' 
                  AND A.GROUP_NAME = 'BFP_FSUM' 
                  AND A.TABLE_NAME = 'LIST OF VIOLATION CODES' 
                  AND A.REC_STATUS = 'A'
            )
            T PIVOT (MAX ( ATTRIBUTE_VALUE) FOR COLUMN_NAME IN 
            (
               [Violation Category],
               [Infraction Description] 
            )
) T1
      )
      T2 
   GROUP BY
      SERV_PROV_CODE,
      B1_PER_ID1,
      B1_PER_ID2,
      B1_PER_ID3 
)
select * INTO #TMP_NEW_INFRACTION from NEW_INFRACTION;
WITH RESULT_DATA AS (
SELECT DISTINCT
   ACCT_NUM,
   C.OWNER_NAME,
   CONVERT(VARCHAR, ISNULL(SUMMONS_DATE, B1_FILE_DD), 101) SUMMONS_DATE,
   B.BIN,
   UPPER(ISNULL(N.INFRA_DESC, L.INFRA_DESC)) INFRA_DESC 
FROM
   #TMP_ASI B 
   LEFT OUTER JOIN
      #TMP_LEGACY_INFRACTION L 
      ON B.SERV_PROV_CODE = L.SERV_PROV_CODE 
      AND B.B1_PER_ID1 = L.B1_PER_ID1 
      AND B.B1_PER_ID2 = L.B1_PER_ID2 
      AND B.B1_PER_ID3 = L.B1_PER_ID3 
   LEFT OUTER JOIN
      #TMP_NEW_INFRACTION N 
      ON B.SERV_PROV_CODE = N.SERV_PROV_CODE 
      AND B.B1_PER_ID1 = N.B1_PER_ID1 
      AND B.B1_PER_ID2 = N.B1_PER_ID2 
      AND B.B1_PER_ID3 = N.B1_PER_ID3 
   LEFT OUTER JOIN
      #TMP_CONTACT C 
      ON B.SERV_PROV_CODE = C.SERV_PROV_CODE 
      AND B.B1_PER_ID1 = C.B1_PER_ID1 
      AND B.B1_PER_ID2 = C.B1_PER_ID2 
      AND B.B1_PER_ID3 = C.B1_PER_ID3 
--GROUP BY
--   ACCT_NUM,
--   C.OWNER_NAME,
--   CONVERT(VARCHAR, ISNULL(SUMMONS_DATE, B1_FILE_DD), 101),
--   B.BIN,
--   UPPER(ISNULL(N.INFRA_DESC, L.INFRA_DESC))

--ORDER BY
--   ISNULL(SUMMONS_DATE, B1_FILE_DD) DESC,
--   C.OWNER_NAME
)
SELECT * FROM RESULT_DATA 
ORDER BY
   SUMMONS_DATE DESC,
   OWNER_NAME;
