WITH SPK_STD AS 
(
   SELECT
      SERV_PROV_CODE,
      B1_PER_ID1,
      B1_PER_ID2,
      B1_PER_ID3,
      GROUP_NAME,
      TABLE_NAME,
      ROW_INDEX,
      [Type Inspection] INSP_TYPE,
      [Sprinkler or Standpipe Type] SYS_TYPE,
      [Number of Siamese] NUM_SIAM 
   FROM
      (
         SELECT
            T.SERV_PROV_CODE,
            T.B1_PER_ID1,
            T.B1_PER_ID2,
            T.B1_PER_ID3,
            T.GROUP_NAME,
            T.TABLE_NAME,
            T.COLUMN_NAME,
            T.ROW_INDEX,
            T.ATTRIBUTE_VALUE 
         FROM
               BAPPSPECTABLE_VALUE T 
 JOIN #TMP_Returned_Values rv ON T.SERV_PROV_CODE = rv.SERV_PROV_CODE
	AND T.B1_PER_ID1 = rv.B1_PER_ID1
	AND T.B1_PER_ID2 = rv.B1_PER_ID2
	AND T.B1_PER_ID3 = rv.B1_PER_ID3
         WHERE
            T.GROUP_NAME = 'BFP_COM_INSP' 
            AND T.TABLE_NAME = 'SPRINKLER OR STANDPIPE INFO' 
            AND T.REC_STATUS = 'A'
			AND T.SERV_PROV_CODE = 'FDNY' 
      )
      T PIVOT (MAX (ATTRIBUTE_VALUE) FOR COLUMN_NAME IN 
      (
         [Sprinkler or Standpipe Type],
         [Number of Siamese],
         [Type Inspection],
         [Sprinkler 
         or Standpipe Location]
      )
) S 
   WHERE
      [Sprinkler or Standpipe Type] IS NOT NULL 
)
   select * INTO #TMP_SPK_STD from SPK_STD;
--   select * from #TMP_SPK_STD
SELECT
   TOP (1) SERV_PROV_CODE,
   B1_PER_ID1,
   B1_PER_ID2,
   B1_PER_ID3,
   MAX(STD_TYPE) STD_TYPE,
   MAX(SPK_TYPE) SPK_TYPE,
   SUM(CAST(NUM_STD AS INT)) NUM_STD,
   SUM(CAST(NUM_SPK AS INT)) NUM_SPK 
FROM
   (
      SELECT
         SERV_PROV_CODE,
         B1_PER_ID1,
         B1_PER_ID2,
         B1_PER_ID3,
         --GROUP_NAME,
         --TABLE_NAME,
         --ROW_INDEX,
         NULL STD_TYPE,
         NULL SPK_TYPE,
         [Standpipe (ST)] NUM_STD,
         [Sprinkler (SP)] NUM_SPK 
      FROM
         (
            SELECT
               * 
            FROM
               #TMP_SPK_STD
         )
         S PIVOT ( MAX(NUM_SIAM) FOR INSP_TYPE IN 
         (
            [Standpipe (ST)],
            [Sprinkler (SP)] 
         )
) P 
      UNION ALL
      SELECT
         SERV_PROV_CODE,
         B1_PER_ID1,
         B1_PER_ID2,
         B1_PER_ID3,
         --GROUP_NAME,
         --TABLE_NAME,
         --ROW_INDEX,
         [Standpipe (ST)] STD_TYPE,
         [Sprinkler (SP)] SPK_TYPE,
         NULL NUM_STD,
         NULL NUM_SPK 
      FROM
         (
            SELECT
               * 
            FROM
               #TMP_SPK_STD
         )
         S PIVOT( MAX(SYS_TYPE) FOR INSP_TYPE IN 
         (
            [Standpipe (ST)],
            [Sprinkler (SP)] 
         )
) P 
   )
   T 
GROUP BY
   SERV_PROV_CODE,
   B1_PER_ID1,
   B1_PER_ID2,
   B1_PER_ID3 ;

      SERV_PROV_CODE AS SERV_PROV_CODE,
      B1_PER_ID1 AS B1_PER_ID1,
      B1_PER_ID2 AS B1_PER_ID2,
      B1_PER_ID3 AS B1_PER_ID3,
      TRY_CAST([INSPECTION DATE] AS DATE) INSP_DATE,
      CONCAT(ISNULL([Infraction Code], ''),': ',ISNULL([Infraction Description], '')) INFRA_DESC 
    FROM
      (
         SELECT
            BC.SERV_PROV_CODE AS SERV_PROV_CODE,
            BC.B1_PER_ID1 AS B1_PER_ID1,
            BC.B1_PER_ID2 AS B1_PER_ID2,
            BC.B1_PER_ID3 AS B1_PER_ID3,
            BC.B1_CHECKBOX_DESC,
            BC.B1_CHECKLIST_COMMENT 
         FROM
            BCHCKBOX BC 
JOIN #TMP_Returned_Values rv ON BC.SERV_PROV_CODE = rv.SERV_PROV_CODE
	AND BC.B1_PER_ID1 = rv.B1_PER_ID1
	AND BC.B1_PER_ID2 = rv.B1_PER_ID2
	AND BC.B1_PER_ID3 = rv.B1_PER_ID3
         WHERE
            BC.SERV_PROV_CODE = 'FDNY' 
            AND BC.REC_STATUS = 'A' 
            AND BC.B1_ACT_STATUS = 'BFP_VO_DET' 
            AND BC.B1_PER_SUB_TYPE = 'VO Details' 
            AND BC.B1_CHECKBOX_TYPE IN 
            (
               'INSPECTION INFO',
               'INFRACTION INFORMATION'
            )
            AND BC.B1_CHECKBOX_DESC IN 
            (
               'INSPECTION DATE',
               'Infraction Code',
               'Infraction Description'
            )
      )
      PVIA PIVOT ( MAX(B1_CHECKLIST_COMMENT) FOR B1_CHECKBOX_DESC IN 
      (
         [INSPECTION DATE],
         [Infraction Code],
         [Infraction Description] 
      )
) PVIB 
)
select * INTO #TMP_ASI from ASI;

(
   SELECT
      A.SERV_PROV_CODE,
      A.B1_PER_ID1,
      A.B1_PER_ID2,
      A.B1_PER_ID3,
      MIN(CAST(A.ATTRIBUTE_VALUE AS DATE)) VIO_DATE 
   FROM
      BAPPSPECTABLE_VALUE A 
JOIN #TMP_Returned_Values rv ON A.SERV_PROV_CODE = rv.SERV_PROV_CODE
	AND A.B1_PER_ID1 = rv.B1_PER_ID1
	AND A.B1_PER_ID2 = rv.B1_PER_ID2
	AND A.B1_PER_ID3 = rv.B1_PER_ID3
   WHERE
      A.SERV_PROV_CODE = 'FDNY' 
      AND A.GROUP_NAME = 'BFP_VO_DET' 
      AND A.TABLE_NAME = 'FPIMS_VIOLATIONS' 
      AND A.COLUMN_NAME = 'VIO_DT' 
      AND A.REC_STATUS = 'A' 
   GROUP BY
      A.SERV_PROV_CODE,
      A.B1_PER_ID1,
      A.B1_PER_ID2,
      A.B1_PER_ID3 
)

TM_GP_HIST_EXAM AS 
(
   SELECT
      SERV_PROV_CODE,
      B1_PER_ID1,
      B1_PER_ID2,
      B1_PER_ID3,
      SD_APP_DES,
      WF_CAT,
      SD_PRO_DES,
      CAST(SD_APP_DD AS DATE) SD_APP_DD,
      REC_DATE,
      GPROCESS_HISTORY_SEQ_NBR 
   FROM
      (
         SELECT
            CASE
               WHEN
                  LAG(WF_CAT, 1) OVER (PARTITION BY SERV_PROV_CODE, B1_PER_ID1, B1_PER_ID2, B1_PER_ID3 
         ORDER BY
            RN) = WF_CAT 
         THEN
            'N' 
         ELSE
            'Y' 
            END
            FLAG, T.* 
         FROM
            (
               SELECT
                  ROW_NUMBER () OVER (PARTITION BY G.SERV_PROV_CODE, G.B1_PER_ID1, G.B1_PER_ID2, G.B1_PER_ID3 
               ORDER BY
                  G.SD_APP_DD, G.GPROCESS_HISTORY_SEQ_NBR) RN,
                  CASE
                     WHEN
                        G.SD_APP_DES IN 
                        (
                           'Additional Info Requested',
                           'Additional Information Requested',
                           'Proposed Draft COA',
                           'Revision Required'
                        )
                     THEN
                        'Requested' 
                     WHEN
                        G.SD_APP_DES IN 
                        (
                           'Additional Info Received', 'Additional Information Received', 'Proposed Draft COA Received', 'Revision Received'
                        )
                     THEN
                        'Received' 
                  END
                  WF_CAT, G.* 
               FROM
                  GPROCESS_HISTORY G 
                  INNER JOIN
                     TM_GP_HIST_LAST L 
                     ON L.SERV_PROV_CODE = G.SERV_PROV_CODE 
                     AND L.B1_PER_ID1 = G.B1_PER_ID1 
                     AND L.B1_PER_ID2 = G.B1_PER_ID2 
                     AND L.B1_PER_ID3 = G.B1_PER_ID3 
               WHERE
                  G.SERV_PROV_CODE = 'FDNY' 
                  AND G.SD_PRO_DES = 'Plan Review' 
                  AND G.SD_APP_DES IN 
                  (
                     'Additional Info Requested', 'Additional Information Requested', 'Proposed Draft COA', 'Revision Required', 'Additional Info Received', 'Additional Information Received', 'Proposed Draft COA Received', 'Revision Received'
                  )
                  AND G.REC_STATUS = 'A' 						--and b1_per_id1 = 'REC20' and b1_per_id3 = '002F6'
            )
            T 
      )
      T1 
   WHERE
      FLAG = 'Y' 
)

   GHS.B1_ALT_ID,
   GHS.B1_APPL_STATUS,
   GHS.APPL_TYPE,
   GHS.SD_PRO_DES,
   GHS.SD_APP_DES,
   GHS.SD_APP_DD,
   GHS.G6_ISS_LNAME,
   GHS.G6_ISS_MNAME,
   GHS.B1_DUE_DD,
   GHS.G6_ASGN_DD

	
   FROM
      (
         SELECT
            P.B1_ALT_ID,
            P.B1_APPL_STATUS,
            B1_CHECKLIST_COMMENT APPL_TYPE,
            G.*,
            ROW_NUMBER () OVER (PARTITION BY P.SERV_PROV_CODE, P.B1_PER_ID1, P.B1_PER_ID2, P.B1_PER_ID3 
         ORDER BY
            G.REC_DATE, G.GPROCESS_HISTORY_SEQ_NBR) RN 
         FROM
            B1PERMIT P 
            INNER JOIN
               GPROCESS_HISTORY G 
               ON P.SERV_PROV_CODE = G.SERV_PROV_CODE 
               AND P.B1_PER_ID1 = G.B1_PER_ID1 
               AND P.B1_PER_ID2 = G.B1_PER_ID2 
               AND P.B1_PER_ID3 = G.B1_PER_ID3 
            INNER JOIN
               BCHCKBOX C 
               ON P.SERV_PROV_CODE = C.SERV_PROV_CODE 
               AND P.B1_PER_ID1 = C.B1_PER_ID1 
               AND P.B1_PER_ID2 = C.B1_PER_ID2 
               AND P.B1_PER_ID3 = C.B1_PER_ID3 
         WHERE
            G.SERV_PROV_CODE = 'FDNY' 
            AND 
            ((G.SD_PRO_DES = 'Administrative Review' 
               AND G.SD_APP_DES = 'Application Received') 
               OR 
               (
                  G.SD_PRO_DES = 'Application Intake' 
                  AND G.SD_APP_DES = 'Application Accepted'
               )
            )
            AND G.REC_STATUS = 'A' 
            AND P.SERV_PROV_CODE = 'FDNY' 
            AND P.B1_PER_TYPE = 'Common' 
            AND P.B1_PER_SUB_TYPE = 'Plan' 
            AND P.B1_PER_CATEGORY = 'Intake' 
            AND P.REC_STATUS = 'A' 
            AND 
            (
               P.B1_APPL_CLASS NOT LIKE 'INCOMPLETE%' 
               OR P.B1_APPL_CLASS IS NULL
            )
            --AND DATEDIFF(week, M.SD_APP_DD, A.SD_APP_DD) <= 100 
            --AND P.B1_FILE_DD >= '2020-06-01'
            AND P.B1_FILE_DD between '2022-01-01' and '2023-12-31' 				
            --'2021-TMFALM-000004-PLAN',
            --'2021-TMFALM-000005-PLAN',
            --'2021-TMFALM-000006-PLAN',
            --'2021-TMFALM-000007-PLAN',
            --'2021-TMRFTP-000008-VRNC',
            --'2021-TMRGHD-000009-PLAN',
            --'2021-TMFALM-000010-PLAN',
            --'2021-TMFALM-000011-PLAN',
            --'2021-TMENGR-000012-PLAN')
            AND 
            (
               CASE
                  WHEN
                     C.B1_CHECKLIST_COMMENT = 'ARCS' 
                  THEN
                     'Auxiliary Radio Communications System Application' 
                  ELSE
                     C.B1_CHECKLIST_COMMENT 
               END
            )
            = 'Fire Alarm Application' 				


            AND C.SERV_PROV_CODE = 'FDNY' 
            AND C.B1_CHECKBOX_DESC = 'Application Type' 
            AND TRIM(C.B1_CHECKLIST_COMMENT) IS NOT NULL 
            AND C.B1_PER_TYPE = 'Common' 
            AND C.B1_ACT_STATUS = 'BFP_COM_PLAN' 
            AND C.REC_STATUS = 'A' 
      )
      GHS 
   WHERE
      RN = 1 		
)

with TM_GP_HIST_EXAM AS 
(

      WF_CAT,
      SD_PRO_DES,
      CAST(SD_APP_DD AS DATE) SD_APP_DD,
      REC_DATE,
      GPROCESS_HISTORY_SEQ_NBR 
   FROM
      (
         SELECT
            CASE
               WHEN
                  LAG(WF_CAT, 1) OVER (PARTITION BY SERV_PROV_CODE, B1_PER_ID1, B1_PER_ID2, B1_PER_ID3 
         ORDER BY
            RN) = WF_CAT 
         THEN
            'N' 
         ELSE
            'Y' 
            END
            FLAG, T.* 
         FROM
            (
               SELECT
                  ROW_NUMBER () OVER (PARTITION BY G.SERV_PROV_CODE, G.B1_PER_ID1, G.B1_PER_ID2, G.B1_PER_ID3 
               ORDER BY
                  G.SD_APP_DD, G.GPROCESS_HISTORY_SEQ_NBR) RN,
                  CASE
                     WHEN
                        G.SD_APP_DES IN 
                        (
                           'Additional Info Requested',
                           'Additional Information Requested',
                           'Proposed Draft COA',
                           'Revision Required'
                        )
                     THEN
                        'Requested' 
                     WHEN
                        G.SD_APP_DES IN 
                        (
                           'Additional Info Received', 'Additional Information Received', 'Proposed Draft COA Received', 'Revision Received'
                        )
                     THEN
                        'Received' 
                  END
                  WF_CAT, G.* 
               FROM
                  GPROCESS_HISTORY G 
                  INNER JOIN
                     #TMP_GP_HIST_LAST L 
                     ON L.SERV_PROV_CODE = G.SERV_PROV_CODE 
                     AND L.B1_PER_ID1 = G.B1_PER_ID1 
                     AND L.B1_PER_ID2 = G.B1_PER_ID2 
                     AND L.B1_PER_ID3 = G.B1_PER_ID3 
               WHERE
                  G.SERV_PROV_CODE = 'FDNY' 
                  AND G.SD_PRO_DES = 'Plan Review' 
                  AND G.SD_APP_DES IN 
                  (
                     'Additional Info Requested', 'Additional Information Requested', 'Proposed Draft COA', 'Revision Required', 'Additional Info Received', 'Additional Information Received', 'Proposed Draft COA Received', 'Revision Received'
                  )
                  AND G.REC_STATUS = 'A' 						--and b1_per_id1 = 'REC20' and b1_per_id3 = '002F6'
            )
            T 
      )
      T1 
   WHERE
      FLAG = 'Y' 
)

SELECT SERV_PROV_CODE, B1_PER_ID1, B1_PER_ID2, B1_PER_ID3,
       [FDNY] FDNY_CHK,
       [Oath] OATH_CHK,
       [FDNY Written Off] FDNY_OFF,
       [Division FP Unit]   FP_UNIT
       INTO #ASI
FROM 
(
SELECT
    BC.SERV_PROV_CODE AS SERV_PROV_CODE,
    BC.B1_PER_ID1 AS B1_PER_ID1,
    BC.B1_PER_ID2 AS B1_PER_ID2,
    BC.B1_PER_ID3 AS B1_PER_ID3,    
    BC.B1_CHECKBOX_DESC,
    BC.B1_CHECKLIST_COMMENT
FROM #B1P A INNER JOIN BCHCKBOX BC
ON A.SERV_PROV_CODE = BC.SERV_PROV_CODE
AND A.B1_PER_ID1 = BC.B1_PER_ID1
AND A.B1_PER_ID2 = BC.B1_PER_ID2
AND A.B1_PER_ID3 = BC.B1_PER_ID3
WHERE BC.SERV_PROV_CODE = 'FDNY'
    AND BC.B1_ACT_STATUS IN ('BFP_VO_DET','BFP_FSUM')
       AND BC.B1_PER_SUB_TYPE IN ('VO Details','FDNY Summons')
    AND BC.B1_CHECKBOX_TYPE IN (
                                  'COMPLIANCE INFORMATION',
                                  'FDNY WRITTEN OFF',
                                  'INSPECTION INFO'
                           )
                           AND BC.B1_CHECKBOX_DESC IN (
                                  'FDNY',
                                  'Oath',
                                  'FDNY Written Off',
                                  'Division FP Unit'
                           )
              ) PVIA PIVOT (
                     MAX(B1_CHECKLIST_COMMENT) FOR B1_CHECKBOX_DESC IN (
                           [FDNY],
                           [Oath],
                           [FDNY Written Off],
                           [Division FP Unit]
                     )
              ) PVIB

              B.HOUSE_NUM, B.STNAME, B.BORO, B.ZIP_CODE, B.BIN,
              CASE WHEN B.B1_PER_SUB_TYPE = 'FDNY Summons' AND (FDNY_CHK = 'CHECKED' OR OATH_CHK = 'CHECKED' OR FDNY_OFF = 'CHECKED' OR B.B1_APPL_STATUS IN (
                           'Voided - No Hearing Required',
                           'Abated - No Hearing Required',
                           'Corrected - Hearing Required',
                           'Cure Letter Issued-No hearing',
                           'Withdrawn',
                           'Written Off'))
              THEN 'CORRECTED'
              WHEN B.B1_PER_SUB_TYPE = 'VO Details' AND B.B1_APPL_STATUS = 'Dismissed' THEN 'DISMISSED' ELSE 'COMPLIANCE DUE' END COMPLIANCE_STATUS
              INTO #MQUERY

               ON M.SERV_PROV_CODE = X.SERV_PROV_CODE
                 AND M.B1_PER_ID1 = X.B1_MASTER_ID1
                 AND M.B1_PER_ID2 = X.B1_MASTER_ID2
                 AND M.B1_PER_ID3 = X.B1_MASTER_ID3   
              LEFT OUTER JOIN BCHCKBOX U ON M.SERV_PROV_CODE = U.SERV_PROV_CODE
                     AND M.B1_PER_ID1 = U.B1_PER_ID1
                     AND M.B1_PER_ID2 = U.B1_PER_ID2
                     AND M.B1_PER_ID3 = U.B1_PER_ID3
                     AND U.SERV_PROV_CODE = 'FDNY'
                     AND U.B1_CHECKBOX_TYPE = 'PLAN INFORMATION'
                     AND U.B1_CHECKBOX_DESC = 'Application Type'
                     AND U.B1_ACT_STATUS = 'BFP_COM_INSP'
              LEFT OUTER JOIN #ENF_CONTACT AS C ON B.SERV_PROV_CODE = C.SERV_PROV_CODE
              AND B.B1_PER_ID1 = C.B1_PER_ID1
              AND B.B1_PER_ID2 = C.B1_PER_ID2
              AND B.B1_PER_ID3 = C.B1_PER_ID3
              AND C.SERV_PROV_CODE = 'FDNY'
              LEFT OUTER JOIN #ASI S
              ON     S.SERV_PROV_CODE = B.SERV_PROV_CODE
            AND S.B1_PER_ID1 = B.B1_PER_ID1
            AND S.B1_PER_ID2 = B.B1_PER_ID2
            AND S.B1_PER_ID3 = B.B1_PER_ID3

WITH B1P AS (
       SELECT
              M.B1_PER_ID1 M_B1_PER_ID1,
              M.B1_PER_ID2 M_B1_PER_ID2,
              M.B1_PER_ID3 M_B1_PER_ID3,
              M.B1_ALT_ID AS ACCT_NUM,
              B.B1_ALT_ID,
              B.B1_PER_GROUP,
              B.SERV_PROV_CODE,
              B.B1_PER_TYPE,
              B.B1_PER_SUB_TYPE,
              B.B1_PER_CATEGORY,
              B.B1_PER_ID1,
              B.B1_PER_ID2,
              B.B1_PER_ID3,
              B.B1_APPL_STATUS,
              A.B1_HSE_NBR_ALPHA_START AS HOUSE_NUM,
              A.B1_STR_NAME AS STNAME,
              TRIM(UPPER(A.B1_SITUS_CITY)) AS BORO,
              LEFT(TRIM(A.B1_SITUS_ZIP), 5) AS ZIP_CODE,
              P.B1_ATTRIBUTE_VALUE AS BIN
       FROM
              B1PERMIT AS B
              INNER JOIN B3ADDRES AS A ON A.SERV_PROV_CODE = B.SERV_PROV_CODE
              AND A.B1_PER_ID1 = B.B1_PER_ID1
              AND A.B1_PER_ID2 = B.B1_PER_ID2
              AND A.B1_PER_ID3 = B.B1_PER_ID3
              LEFT OUTER JOIN B3APO_ATTRIBUTE AS P ON A.SERV_PROV_CODE = P.SERV_PROV_CODE
              AND A.B1_PER_ID1 = P.B1_PER_ID1
              AND A.B1_PER_ID2 = P.B1_PER_ID2
              AND A.B1_PER_ID3 = P.B1_PER_ID3
              AND A.B1_ADDRESS_NBR = P.B1_APO_NBR
              AND P.SERV_PROV_CODE = 'FDNY'
              AND P.B1_APO_TYPE = 'ADDRESS'
              AND P.B1_ATTRIBUTE_NAME = 'BIN'
              LEFT OUTER JOIN XAPP2REF X ON B.SERV_PROV_CODE = X.SERV_PROV_CODE
              AND B.B1_PER_ID1 = X.B1_PER_ID1
              AND B.B1_PER_ID2 = X.B1_PER_ID2
              AND B.B1_PER_ID3 = X.B1_PER_ID3
              AND X.B1_RELATIONSHIP = 'R'
              LEFT OUTER JOIN B1PERMIT M ON M.SERV_PROV_CODE = X.SERV_PROV_CODE
              AND M.B1_PER_ID1 = X.B1_MASTER_ID1
              AND M.B1_PER_ID2 = X.B1_MASTER_ID2
              AND M.B1_PER_ID3 = X.B1_MASTER_ID3
       WHERE
              B.B1_PER_GROUP = 'BFP'
              AND B.SERV_PROV_CODE = 'FDNY'
              AND B.B1_PER_TYPE = 'Enforcement'
              AND B.B1_PER_SUB_TYPE IN ('FDNY Summons', 'VO Details')
              AND B.B1_PER_CATEGORY = 'NA'
              AND B.REC_STATUS = 'A'
              AND (B.B1_APPL_CLASS IN ('COMPLETE', 'EDITABLE') OR B.B1_APPL_CLASS IS NULL)
			  AND (M.B1_ALT_ID = @ACCT_NUM OR @ACCT_NUM IS NULL)
			  AND (B.B1_ALT_ID = @VIOKEY OR @VIOKEY IS NULL)

)

WITH ASI AS (
              SELECT
                     SERV_PROV_CODE,
                     B1_PER_ID1,
                     B1_PER_ID2,
                     B1_PER_ID3,
                     [FDNY] FDNY_CHK,
                     [Oath] OATH_CHK,
                     [FDNY Written Off] FDNY_OFF,
                     [Division FP Unit] FP_UNIT
              FROM
                     (
                            SELECT
                                   BC.SERV_PROV_CODE AS SERV_PROV_CODE,
                                   BC.B1_PER_ID1 AS B1_PER_ID1,
                                   BC.B1_PER_ID2 AS B1_PER_ID2,
                                   BC.B1_PER_ID3 AS B1_PER_ID3,
                                   BC.B1_CHECKBOX_DESC,
                                   BC.B1_CHECKLIST_COMMENT
                            FROM
                                   #B1P A INNER JOIN BCHCKBOX BC
                                   ON A.SERV_PROV_CODE = BC.SERV_PROV_CODE
                                   AND A.B1_PER_ID1 = BC.B1_PER_ID1
                                   AND A.B1_PER_ID2 = BC.B1_PER_ID2
                                   AND A.B1_PER_ID3 = BC.B1_PER_ID3
                            WHERE
                                   BC.SERV_PROV_CODE = 'FDNY'
                                   AND BC.B1_ACT_STATUS IN ('BFP_VO_DET', 'BFP_FSUM')
                                   AND BC.B1_PER_SUB_TYPE IN ('VO Details', 'FDNY Summons')
                                   AND BC.B1_CHECKBOX_TYPE IN (
                                          'COMPLIANCE INFORMATION',
                                          'FDNY WRITTEN OFF',
                                          'INSPECTION INFO'
                                   )
                                   AND BC.B1_CHECKBOX_DESC IN (
                                          'FDNY',
                                          'Oath',
                                          'FDNY Written Off',
                                          'Division FP Unit'
                                   )
                     ) PVIA PIVOT (
                            MAX(B1_CHECKLIST_COMMENT) FOR B1_CHECKBOX_DESC IN (
                                   [FDNY],
                                   [Oath],
                                   [FDNY Written Off],
                                   [Division FP Unit]
                            )
                     ) PVIB
       )

WITH MQUERY AS (
              SELECT
                     B.SERV_PROV_CODE,
                     B.ACCT_NUM,
                     B.B1_ALT_ID ENF_KEY,
                     ISNULL(U.B1_CHECKLIST_COMMENT, S.FP_UNIT) UNIT_NAME,
                     B.B1_APPL_STATUS,
                     B.OWNER_NAME,
                     B.HOUSE_NUM,
                     B.STNAME,
                     B.BORO,
                     B.ZIP_CODE,
                     B.BIN,
                     CASE
                            WHEN B.B1_PER_SUB_TYPE = 'FDNY Summons'
                            AND (
                                   FDNY_CHK = 'CHECKED'
                                   OR OATH_CHK = 'CHECKED'
                                   OR FDNY_OFF = 'CHECKED'
                                   OR B.B1_APPL_STATUS IN (
                                          'Voided - No Hearing Required',
                                          'Abated - No Hearing Required',
                                          'Corrected - Hearing Required',
                                          'Cure Letter Issued-No hearing',
                                          'Withdrawn',
                                          'Written Off'
                                   )
                            ) THEN 'CORRECTED'
                            WHEN B.B1_PER_SUB_TYPE = 'VO Details'
                            AND B.B1_APPL_STATUS = 'Dismissed' THEN 'DISMISSED'
                            ELSE 'COMPLIANCE DUE'
                     END COMPLIANCE_STATUS
              FROM
                     #B1P B 
                     LEFT OUTER JOIN BCHCKBOX U ON B.SERV_PROV_CODE = U.SERV_PROV_CODE
                     AND B.M_B1_PER_ID1 = U.B1_PER_ID1
                     AND B.M_B1_PER_ID2 = U.B1_PER_ID2
                     AND B.M_B1_PER_ID3 = U.B1_PER_ID3
                     AND U.SERV_PROV_CODE = 'FDNY'
                     AND U.B1_CHECKBOX_TYPE = 'PLAN INFORMATION'
                     AND U.B1_CHECKBOX_DESC = 'Application Type'
                     AND U.B1_ACT_STATUS = 'BFP_COM_INSP'
                     LEFT OUTER JOIN #ASI S
                     ON S.SERV_PROV_CODE = B.SERV_PROV_CODE
                     AND S.B1_PER_ID1 = B.B1_PER_ID1
                     AND S.B1_PER_ID2 = B.B1_PER_ID2
                     AND S.B1_PER_ID3 = B.B1_PER_ID3
                     AND S.SERV_PROV_CODE = 'FDNY'
       )
select  * INTO #MQUERY from MQUERY;

WITH B1P AS (
       SELECT
              M.B1_PER_ID1 M_B1_PER_ID1,
              M.B1_PER_ID2 M_B1_PER_ID2,
              M.B1_PER_ID3 M_B1_PER_ID3,

              B.B1_PER_ID3,

              P.B1_ATTRIBUTE_VALUE AS BIN
       FROM
              B1PERMIT AS B

              AND A.B1_PER_ID1 = B.B1_PER_ID1
              AND A.B1_PER_ID2 = B.B1_PER_ID2
              AND A.B1_PER_ID3 = B.B1_PER_ID3
              LEFT OUTER JOIN B3APO_ATTRIBUTE AS P ON A.SERV_PROV_CODE = P.SERV_PROV_CODE
              AND A.B1_PER_ID1 = P.B1_PER_ID1
              AND A.B1_PER_ID2 = P.B1_PER_ID2
              AND A.B1_PER_ID3 = P.B1_PER_ID3
              AND A.B1_ADDRESS_NBR = P.B1_APO_NBR
              AND P.SERV_PROV_CODE = 'FDNY'
              AND P.B1_APO_TYPE = 'ADDRESS'
              AND P.B1_ATTRIBUTE_NAME = 'BIN'
              LEFT OUTER JOIN XAPP2REF X ON B.SERV_PROV_CODE = X.SERV_PROV_CODE
              AND B.B1_PER_ID1 = X.B1_PER_ID1
              AND B.B1_PER_ID2 = X.B1_PER_ID2
              AND B.B1_PER_ID3 = X.B1_PER_ID3
              AND X.B1_RELATIONSHIP = 'R'
              LEFT OUTER JOIN B1PERMIT M ON M.SERV_PROV_CODE = X.SERV_PROV_CODE
              AND M.B1_PER_ID1 = X.B1_MASTER_ID1
              AND M.B1_PER_ID2 = X.B1_MASTER_ID2
              AND M.B1_PER_ID3 = X.B1_MASTER_ID3
       WHERE
              B.B1_PER_GROUP = 'BFP'
              AND B.SERV_PROV_CODE = 'FDNY'
              AND B.B1_PER_TYPE = 'Enforcement'
              AND B.B1_PER_SUB_TYPE IN ('FDNY Summons', 'VO Details')
              AND B.B1_PER_CATEGORY = 'NA'
              AND B.REC_STATUS = 'A'
              AND (B.B1_APPL_CLASS IN ('COMPLETE', 'EDITABLE') OR B.B1_APPL_CLASS IS NULL)
			  AND (M.B1_ALT_ID = @ACCT_NUM OR @ACCT_NUM IS NULL)

			  AND (P.B1_ATTRIBUTE_VALUE = @BIN OR @BIN IS NULL)

WITH ENF_CONTACT AS (
              SELECT
                     B1_ALT_ID,
                     SERV_PROV_CODE,
                     B1_PER_ID1,
                     B1_PER_ID2,
                     B1_PER_ID3,
                     OWNER_NAME

                            FROM

                                                 B.B1_ALT_ID,

                                                        )
                                                        WHEN B1_PREFERRED_CHANNEL IN ('2', '3') THEN C.B1_BUSINESS_NAME
                                                 END AS OWNER_NAME
                                          FROM

                            ALL

                                   SERV_PROV_CODE,
                                   B1_PER_ID1,
                                   B1_PER_ID2,
                                   B1_PER_ID3,
                                   OWNER_NAME
                            FROM
                                   (
                                          SELECT
                                                 B.B1_ALT_ID,
                                                 B.SERV_PROV_CODE,
                                                 B.B1_PER_ID1,
                                                 B.B1_PER_ID2,
                                                 B.B1_PER_ID3,
                                                 CASE
                                                        WHEN B1_PREFERRED_CHANNEL = '1' THEN TRIM(
                                                               ISNULL(C.B1_FNAME, '') + ' ' + ISNULL(C.B1_MNAME, '') + ' ' + ISNULL(C.B1_LNAME, '')
                                                        )
                                                        WHEN B1_PREFERRED_CHANNEL IN ('2', '3') THEN C.B1_BUSINESS_NAME
                                                 END AS OWNER_NAME,
                                                 ROW_NUMBER () OVER (
                                                        PARTITION BY B.SERV_PROV_CODE,
                                                        B.B1_PER_ID1,
                                                        B.B1_PER_ID2,
                                                        B.B1_PER_ID3
                                                        ORDER BY
                                                               C.B1_CONTACT_TYPE DESC,
                                                               C.REC_DATE DESC
                                                 ) RN
                                          FROM
                                                 #B1P AS B INNER JOIN B3CONTACT AS C ON  C.SERV_PROV_CODE = B.SERV_PROV_CODE
                                                 AND C.B1_PER_ID1 = B.B1_PER_ID1
                                                 AND C.B1_PER_ID2 = B.B1_PER_ID2
                                                 AND C.B1_PER_ID3 = B.B1_PER_ID3
                                          WHERE
                                                 B.B1_PER_GROUP = 'BFP'
                                                 AND B.SERV_PROV_CODE = 'FDNY'
                                                 AND B.B1_PER_TYPE = 'Enforcement'
                                                 AND B.B1_PER_SUB_TYPE = 'VO Details'
                                                 AND B.B1_PER_CATEGORY = 'NA'
                                                 AND C.SERV_PROV_CODE = 'FDNY'
                                                 AND C.B1_CONTACT_TYPE IN ('Building Owner', 'Business Owner')
                                   ) T1

WITH ASI AS (
              SELECT
                     SERV_PROV_CODE,
                     B1_PER_ID1,
                     B1_PER_ID2,
                     B1_PER_ID3,
                     [FDNY] FDNY_CHK,
                     [Oath] OATH_CHK,
                     [FDNY Written Off] FDNY_OFF,
                     [Division FP Unit] FP_UNIT
              FROM
                     (
                            SELECT
                                   BC.SERV_PROV_CODE AS SERV_PROV_CODE,
                                   BC.B1_PER_ID1 AS B1_PER_ID1,
                                   BC.B1_PER_ID2 AS B1_PER_ID2,
                                   BC.B1_PER_ID3 AS B1_PER_ID3,
                                   BC.B1_CHECKBOX_DESC,
                                   BC.B1_CHECKLIST_COMMENT
                            FROM
                                   #B1P A INNER JOIN BCHCKBOX BC
                                   ON A.SERV_PROV_CODE = BC.SERV_PROV_CODE
                                   AND A.B1_PER_ID1 = BC.B1_PER_ID1
                                   AND A.B1_PER_ID2 = BC.B1_PER_ID2
                                   AND A.B1_PER_ID3 = BC.B1_PER_ID3
                            WHERE
                                   BC.SERV_PROV_CODE = 'FDNY'
                                   AND BC.B1_ACT_STATUS IN ('BFP_VO_DET', 'BFP_FSUM')
                                   AND BC.B1_PER_SUB_TYPE IN ('VO Details', 'FDNY Summons')
                                   AND BC.B1_CHECKBOX_TYPE IN (
                                          'COMPLIANCE INFORMATION',
                                          'FDNY WRITTEN OFF',
                                          'INSPECTION INFO'
                                   )
                                   AND BC.B1_CHECKBOX_DESC IN (
                                          'FDNY',
                                          'Oath',
                                          'FDNY Written Off',
                                          'Division FP Unit'
                                   )
                     ) PVIA PIVOT (
                            MAX(B1_CHECKLIST_COMMENT) FOR B1_CHECKBOX_DESC IN (
                                   [FDNY],
                                   [Oath],
                                   [FDNY Written Off],
                                   [Division FP Unit]
                            )
                     ) PVIB
       )

WITH MQUERY AS (
              SELECT
                     B.SERV_PROV_CODE,
                     B.ACCT_NUM,
                     B.B1_ALT_ID ENF_KEY,
                     ISNULL(U.B1_CHECKLIST_COMMENT, S.FP_UNIT) UNIT_NAME,
                     B.B1_APPL_STATUS,
					 FORMAT(B.B1_APPL_STATUS_DATE,'MM/dd/yyyy') APPL_DATE,
                     C.OWNER_NAME,
                     B.HOUSE_NUM,
                     B.STNAME,
                     B.BORO,
                     B.ZIP_CODE,
                     B.BIN,
                     CASE
                            WHEN B.B1_PER_SUB_TYPE = 'FDNY Summons'
                            AND (
                                   FDNY_CHK = 'CHECKED'
                                   OR OATH_CHK = 'CHECKED'
                                   OR FDNY_OFF = 'CHECKED'
                                   OR B.B1_APPL_STATUS IN (
                                          'Voided - No Hearing Required',
                                          'Abated - No Hearing Required',
                                          'Corrected - Hearing Required',
                                          'Cure Letter Issued-No hearing',
                                          'Withdrawn',
                                          'Written Off'
                                   )
                            ) THEN 'CORRECTED'
                            WHEN B.B1_PER_SUB_TYPE = 'VO Details'
                            AND B.B1_APPL_STATUS = 'Dismissed' THEN 'DISMISSED'
                            ELSE 'COMPLIANCE DUE'
                     END COMPLIANCE_STATUS
              FROM
                     #B1P B 
                     LEFT OUTER JOIN BCHCKBOX U ON B.SERV_PROV_CODE = U.SERV_PROV_CODE
                     AND B.M_B1_PER_ID1 = U.B1_PER_ID1
                     AND B.M_B1_PER_ID2 = U.B1_PER_ID2
                     AND B.M_B1_PER_ID3 = U.B1_PER_ID3
                     AND U.SERV_PROV_CODE = 'FDNY'
                     AND U.B1_CHECKBOX_TYPE = 'PLAN INFORMATION'
                     AND U.B1_CHECKBOX_DESC = 'Application Type'
                     AND U.B1_ACT_STATUS = 'BFP_COM_INSP'
                     LEFT OUTER JOIN #ENF_CONTACT AS C ON B.SERV_PROV_CODE = C.SERV_PROV_CODE
                     AND B.B1_PER_ID1 = C.B1_PER_ID1
                     AND B.B1_PER_ID2 = C.B1_PER_ID2
                     AND B.B1_PER_ID3 = C.B1_PER_ID3
                     AND C.SERV_PROV_CODE = 'FDNY'
                     LEFT OUTER JOIN #ASI S
                     ON S.SERV_PROV_CODE = B.SERV_PROV_CODE
                     AND S.B1_PER_ID1 = B.B1_PER_ID1
                     AND S.B1_PER_ID2 = B.B1_PER_ID2
                     AND S.B1_PER_ID3 = B.B1_PER_ID3
                     AND S.SERV_PROV_CODE = 'FDNY'
       )
select  * INTO #MQUERY from MQUERY;

WITH B1P AS (
       SELECT
              M.B1_PER_ID1 M_B1_PER_ID1,
              M.B1_PER_ID2 M_B1_PER_ID2,
              M.B1_PER_ID3 M_B1_PER_ID3,
              M.B1_ALT_ID AS ACCT_NUM,
              B.B1_ALT_ID,
              B.B1_PER_GROUP,
              B.SERV_PROV_CODE,
              B.B1_PER_TYPE,
              B.B1_PER_SUB_TYPE,
              B.B1_PER_CATEGORY,
              B.B1_PER_ID1,
              B.B1_PER_ID2,
              B.B1_PER_ID3,
              B.B1_APPL_STATUS,
			  B.B1_APPL_STATUS_DATE,
              A.B1_HSE_NBR_ALPHA_START AS HOUSE_NUM,
              A.B1_STR_NAME AS STNAME,
              TRIM(UPPER(A.B1_SITUS_CITY)) AS BORO,
              LEFT(TRIM(A.B1_SITUS_ZIP), 5) AS ZIP_CODE,
              P.B1_ATTRIBUTE_VALUE AS BIN
       FROM
              B1PERMIT AS B
              INNER JOIN B3ADDRES AS A ON A.SERV_PROV_CODE = B.SERV_PROV_CODE
              AND A.B1_PER_ID1 = B.B1_PER_ID1
              AND A.B1_PER_ID2 = B.B1_PER_ID2
              AND A.B1_PER_ID3 = B.B1_PER_ID3
              LEFT OUTER JOIN B3APO_ATTRIBUTE AS P ON A.SERV_PROV_CODE = P.SERV_PROV_CODE
              AND A.B1_PER_ID1 = P.B1_PER_ID1
              AND A.B1_PER_ID2 = P.B1_PER_ID2
              AND A.B1_PER_ID3 = P.B1_PER_ID3
              AND A.B1_ADDRESS_NBR = P.B1_APO_NBR
              AND P.SERV_PROV_CODE = 'FDNY'
              AND P.B1_APO_TYPE = 'ADDRESS'
              AND P.B1_ATTRIBUTE_NAME = 'BIN'
              LEFT OUTER JOIN XAPP2REF X ON B.SERV_PROV_CODE = X.SERV_PROV_CODE
              AND B.B1_PER_ID1 = X.B1_PER_ID1
              AND B.B1_PER_ID2 = X.B1_PER_ID2
              AND B.B1_PER_ID3 = X.B1_PER_ID3
              AND X.B1_RELATIONSHIP = 'R'
              LEFT OUTER JOIN B1PERMIT M ON M.SERV_PROV_CODE = X.SERV_PROV_CODE
              AND M.B1_PER_ID1 = X.B1_MASTER_ID1
              AND M.B1_PER_ID2 = X.B1_MASTER_ID2
              AND M.B1_PER_ID3 = X.B1_MASTER_ID3
       WHERE
              B.B1_PER_GROUP = 'BFP'
              AND B.SERV_PROV_CODE = 'FDNY'
              AND B.B1_PER_TYPE = 'Enforcement'
              AND B.B1_PER_SUB_TYPE IN ('FDNY Summons', 'VO Details')
              AND B.B1_PER_CATEGORY = 'NA'
              AND B.REC_STATUS = 'A'
              AND (B.B1_APPL_CLASS IN ('COMPLETE', 'EDITABLE') OR B.B1_APPL_CLASS IS NULL)
			  AND (M.B1_ALT_ID = @ACCT_NUM OR @ACCT_NUM IS NULL)
			  AND (B.B1_ALT_ID = @VIOKEY OR @VIOKEY IS NULL)
			  AND (B.B1_APPL_STATUS IN (@APPL_STATUS) OR @APPL_STATUS IS NULL)
			  AND (A.B1_HSE_NBR_ALPHA_START = @PREM_HOUSE_NUM OR @PREM_HOUSE_NUM IS NULL)
			  AND (A.B1_STR_NAME LIKE CONCAT(@PREM_STNAME,'%') OR @PREM_STNAME IS NULL)
			  AND (A.B1_SITUS_CITY LIKE CONCAT(@PREM_CITY,'%') OR @PREM_CITY IS NULL)
			  AND (P.B1_ATTRIBUTE_VALUE = @BIN OR @BIN IS NULL)
			  AND try_convert(DATE,B.B1_APPL_STATUS_DATE) BETWEEN @START_DATE AND @END_DATE
---			  AND NOT (@ACCT_NUM IS NULL AND @PREM_STNAME IS NULL AND @BIN IS NULL AND @VIOKEY IS NULL)
               
)

WITH ASI AS (
              SELECT
                     SERV_PROV_CODE,
                     B1_PER_ID1,
                     B1_PER_ID2,
                     B1_PER_ID3,
                     [FDNY] FDNY_CHK,
                     [Oath] OATH_CHK,
                     [FDNY Written Off] FDNY_OFF,
                     [Division FP Unit] FP_UNIT
              FROM
                     (
                            SELECT
                                   BC.SERV_PROV_CODE AS SERV_PROV_CODE,
                                   BC.B1_PER_ID1 AS B1_PER_ID1,
                                   BC.B1_PER_ID2 AS B1_PER_ID2,
                                   BC.B1_PER_ID3 AS B1_PER_ID3,
                                   BC.B1_CHECKBOX_DESC,
                                   BC.B1_CHECKLIST_COMMENT
                            FROM
                                   #B1P A INNER JOIN BCHCKBOX BC
                                   ON A.SERV_PROV_CODE = BC.SERV_PROV_CODE
                                   AND A.B1_PER_ID1 = BC.B1_PER_ID1
                                   AND A.B1_PER_ID2 = BC.B1_PER_ID2
                                   AND A.B1_PER_ID3 = BC.B1_PER_ID3
                            WHERE
                                   BC.SERV_PROV_CODE = 'FDNY'
                                   AND BC.B1_ACT_STATUS IN ('BFP_VO_DET', 'BFP_FSUM')
                                   AND BC.B1_PER_SUB_TYPE IN ('VO Details', 'FDNY Summons')
                                   AND BC.B1_CHECKBOX_TYPE IN (
                                          'COMPLIANCE INFORMATION',
                                          'FDNY WRITTEN OFF',
                                          'INSPECTION INFO'
                                   )
                                   AND BC.B1_CHECKBOX_DESC IN (
                                          'FDNY',
                                          'Oath',
                                          'FDNY Written Off',
                                          'Division FP Unit'
                                   )
                     ) PVIA PIVOT (
                            MAX(B1_CHECKLIST_COMMENT) FOR B1_CHECKBOX_DESC IN (
                                   [FDNY],
                                   [Oath],
                                   [FDNY Written Off],
                                   [Division FP Unit]
                            )
                     ) PVIB
       )
select * INTO #ASI from ASI;

WITH MQUERY AS (
              SELECT
                     B.SERV_PROV_CODE,
                     B.ACCT_NUM,
                     B.B1_ALT_ID ENF_KEY,
                     ISNULL(U.B1_CHECKLIST_COMMENT, S.FP_UNIT) UNIT_NAME,
                     B.B1_APPL_STATUS,
                     B.OWNER_NAME,
                     B.HOUSE_NUM,
                     B.STNAME,
                     B.BORO,
                     B.ZIP_CODE,
                     B.BIN,
                     CASE
                            WHEN B.B1_PER_SUB_TYPE = 'FDNY Summons'
                            AND (
                                   FDNY_CHK = 'CHECKED'
                                   OR OATH_CHK = 'CHECKED'
                                   OR FDNY_OFF = 'CHECKED'
                                   OR B.B1_APPL_STATUS IN (
                                          'Voided - No Hearing Required',
                                          'Abated - No Hearing Required',
                                          'Corrected - Hearing Required',
                                          'Cure Letter Issued-No hearing',
                                          'Withdrawn',
                                          'Written Off'
                                   )
                            ) THEN 'CORRECTED'
                            WHEN B.B1_PER_SUB_TYPE = 'VO Details'
                            AND B.B1_APPL_STATUS = 'Dismissed' THEN 'DISMISSED'
                            ELSE 'COMPLIANCE DUE'
                     END COMPLIANCE_STATUS
              FROM
                     #B1P B 
                     LEFT OUTER JOIN BCHCKBOX U ON B.SERV_PROV_CODE = U.SERV_PROV_CODE
                     AND B.M_B1_PER_ID1 = U.B1_PER_ID1
                     AND B.M_B1_PER_ID2 = U.B1_PER_ID2
                     AND B.M_B1_PER_ID3 = U.B1_PER_ID3
                     AND U.SERV_PROV_CODE = 'FDNY'
                     AND U.B1_CHECKBOX_TYPE = 'PLAN INFORMATION'
                     AND U.B1_CHECKBOX_DESC = 'Application Type'
                     AND U.B1_ACT_STATUS = 'BFP_COM_INSP'
                     LEFT OUTER JOIN #ASI S
                     ON S.SERV_PROV_CODE = B.SERV_PROV_CODE
                     AND S.B1_PER_ID1 = B.B1_PER_ID1
                     AND S.B1_PER_ID2 = B.B1_PER_ID2
                     AND S.B1_PER_ID3 = B.B1_PER_ID3
                     AND S.SERV_PROV_CODE = 'FDNY'
       )

              M.B1_PER_ID1 M_B1_PER_ID1,

			  C.OWNER_NAME,
              A.B1_HSE_NBR_ALPHA_START AS HOUSE_NUM,
              A.B1_STR_NAME AS STNAME,
              TRIM(UPPER(A.B1_SITUS_CITY)) AS BORO,
              LEFT(TRIM(A.B1_SITUS_ZIP), 5) AS ZIP_CODE,

       FROM
              B1PERMIT AS B
              INNER JOIN B3ADDRES AS A ON A.SERV_PROV_CODE = B.SERV_PROV_CODE
              AND A.B1_PER_ID1 = B.B1_PER_ID1
              AND A.B1_PER_ID2 = B.B1_PER_ID2
              AND A.B1_PER_ID3 = B.B1_PER_ID3

				AND b.B1_PER_ID1 = rv.B1_PER_ID1
				AND b.B1_PER_ID2 = rv.B1_PER_ID2
				AND b.B1_PER_ID3 = rv.B1_PER_ID3

              LEFT OUTER JOIN XAPP2REF X ON B.SERV_PROV_CODE = X.SERV_PROV_CODE

              AND B.B1_PER_ID2 = X.B1_PER_ID2
              AND B.B1_PER_ID3 = X.B1_PER_ID3
              AND X.B1_RELATIONSHIP = 'R'
              LEFT OUTER JOIN B1PERMIT M ON M.SERV_PROV_CODE = X.SERV_PROV_CODE

              AND M.B1_PER_ID2 = X.B1_MASTER_ID2
              AND M.B1_PER_ID3 = X.B1_MASTER_ID3
              LEFT OUTER JOIN ENF_CONTACT AS C ON B.SERV_PROV_CODE = C.SERV_PROV_CODE
               AND B.B1_PER_ID1 = C.B1_PER_ID1
               AND B.B1_PER_ID2 = C.B1_PER_ID2
               AND B.B1_PER_ID3 = C.B1_PER_ID3
               AND C.SERV_PROV_CODE = 'FDNY'
       WHERE
              B.B1_PER_GROUP = 'BFP'
              AND B.SERV_PROV_CODE = 'FDNY'
              AND B.B1_PER_TYPE = 'Enforcement'
              AND B.B1_PER_SUB_TYPE IN ('FDNY Summons', 'VO Details')
              AND B.B1_PER_CATEGORY = 'NA'
              AND B.REC_STATUS = 'A'
              AND (B.B1_APPL_CLASS IN ('COMPLETE', 'EDITABLE') OR B.B1_APPL_CLASS IS NULL)

			  AND (B.B1_ALT_ID = @VIOKEY OR @VIOKEY IS NULL)

WITH MQUERY AS (
              SELECT
                     B.SERV_PROV_CODE,
                     B.ACCT_NUM,
                     B.B1_ALT_ID ENF_KEY,
                     ISNULL(U.B1_CHECKLIST_COMMENT, S.FP_UNIT) UNIT_NAME,
                     B.B1_APPL_STATUS,
					 FORMAT(B.B1_APPL_STATUS_DATE,'MM/dd/yyyy') APPL_DATE,
                     B.OWNER_NAME,
                     B.HOUSE_NUM,
                     B.STNAME,
                     B.BORO,
                     B.ZIP_CODE,
                     B.BIN,
                     CASE
                            WHEN B.B1_PER_SUB_TYPE = 'FDNY Summons'
                            AND (
                                   FDNY_CHK = 'CHECKED'
                                   OR OATH_CHK = 'CHECKED'
                                   OR FDNY_OFF = 'CHECKED'
                                   OR B.B1_APPL_STATUS IN (
                                          'Voided - No Hearing Required',
                                          'Abated - No Hearing Required',
                                          'Corrected - Hearing Required',
                                          'Cure Letter Issued-No hearing',
                                          'Withdrawn',
                                          'Written Off'
                                   )
                            ) THEN 'CORRECTED'
                            WHEN B.B1_PER_SUB_TYPE = 'VO Details'
                            AND B.B1_APPL_STATUS = 'Dismissed' THEN 'DISMISSED'
                            ELSE 'COMPLIANCE DUE'
                     END COMPLIANCE_STATUS
              FROM
                     #B1P B 
                     LEFT OUTER JOIN BCHCKBOX U ON B.SERV_PROV_CODE = U.SERV_PROV_CODE
                     AND B.M_B1_PER_ID1 = U.B1_PER_ID1
                     AND B.M_B1_PER_ID2 = U.B1_PER_ID2
                     AND B.M_B1_PER_ID3 = U.B1_PER_ID3
                     AND U.SERV_PROV_CODE = 'FDNY'
                     AND U.B1_CHECKBOX_TYPE = 'PLAN INFORMATION'
                     AND U.B1_CHECKBOX_DESC = 'Application Type'
                     AND U.B1_ACT_STATUS = 'BFP_COM_INSP'
                     LEFT OUTER JOIN #ASI S
                     ON S.SERV_PROV_CODE = B.SERV_PROV_CODE
                     AND S.B1_PER_ID1 = B.B1_PER_ID1
                     AND S.B1_PER_ID2 = B.B1_PER_ID2
                     AND S.B1_PER_ID3 = B.B1_PER_ID3
                     AND S.SERV_PROV_CODE = 'FDNY'
       )
select  * INTO #MQUERY from MQUERY;

              AND M.B1_PER_ID3 = X.B1_MASTER_ID3

WITH ASI AS (
              SELECT
                     SERV_PROV_CODE,
                     B1_PER_ID1,
                     B1_PER_ID2,
                     B1_PER_ID3,
                     [FDNY] FDNY_CHK,
                     [Oath] OATH_CHK,
                     [FDNY Written Off] FDNY_OFF,
                     [Division FP Unit] FP_UNIT
              FROM
                     (
                            SELECT
                                   BC.SERV_PROV_CODE AS SERV_PROV_CODE,
                                   BC.B1_PER_ID1 AS B1_PER_ID1,
                                   BC.B1_PER_ID2 AS B1_PER_ID2,
                                   BC.B1_PER_ID3 AS B1_PER_ID3,
                                   BC.B1_CHECKBOX_DESC,
                                   BC.B1_CHECKLIST_COMMENT
                            FROM
                                   #B1P A INNER JOIN BCHCKBOX BC
                                   ON A.SERV_PROV_CODE = BC.SERV_PROV_CODE
                                   AND A.B1_PER_ID1 = BC.B1_PER_ID1
                                   AND A.B1_PER_ID2 = BC.B1_PER_ID2
                                   AND A.B1_PER_ID3 = BC.B1_PER_ID3
                            WHERE
                                   BC.SERV_PROV_CODE = 'FDNY'
                                   AND BC.B1_ACT_STATUS IN ('BFP_VO_DET', 'BFP_FSUM')
                                   AND BC.B1_PER_SUB_TYPE IN ('VO Details', 'FDNY Summons')
                                   AND BC.B1_CHECKBOX_TYPE IN (
                                          'COMPLIANCE INFORMATION',
                                          'FDNY WRITTEN OFF',
                                          'INSPECTION INFO'
                                   )
                                   AND BC.B1_CHECKBOX_DESC IN (
                                          'FDNY',
                                          'Oath',
                                          'FDNY Written Off',
                                          'Division FP Unit'
                                   )
                     ) PVIA PIVOT (
                            MAX(B1_CHECKLIST_COMMENT) FOR B1_CHECKBOX_DESC IN (
                                   [FDNY],
                                   [Oath],
                                   [FDNY Written Off],
                                   [Division FP Unit]
                            )
                     ) PVIB
       )
select * INTO #ASI from ASI;

WITH MQUERY AS (
              SELECT
                     B.SERV_PROV_CODE,
                     B.ACCT_NUM,
                     B.B1_ALT_ID ENF_KEY,
                     ISNULL(U.B1_CHECKLIST_COMMENT, S.FP_UNIT) UNIT_NAME,
                     B.B1_APPL_STATUS,
					 FORMAT(B.B1_APPL_STATUS_DATE,'MM/dd/yyyy') APPL_DATE,
                     C.OWNER_NAME,
                     B.HOUSE_NUM,
                     B.STNAME,
                     B.BORO,
                     B.ZIP_CODE,
                     B.BIN,
                     CASE
                            WHEN B.B1_PER_SUB_TYPE = 'FDNY Summons'
                            AND (
                                   FDNY_CHK = 'CHECKED'
                                   OR OATH_CHK = 'CHECKED'
                                   OR FDNY_OFF = 'CHECKED'
                                   OR B.B1_APPL_STATUS IN (
                                          'Voided - No Hearing Required',
                                          'Abated - No Hearing Required',
                                          'Corrected - Hearing Required',
                                          'Cure Letter Issued-No hearing',
                                          'Withdrawn',
                                          'Written Off'
                                   )
                            ) THEN 'CORRECTED'
                            WHEN B.B1_PER_SUB_TYPE = 'VO Details'
                            AND B.B1_APPL_STATUS = 'Dismissed' THEN 'DISMISSED'
                            ELSE 'COMPLIANCE DUE'
                     END COMPLIANCE_STATUS
              FROM
                     #B1P B 
                     LEFT OUTER JOIN BCHCKBOX U ON B.SERV_PROV_CODE = U.SERV_PROV_CODE
                     AND B.M_B1_PER_ID1 = U.B1_PER_ID1
                     AND B.M_B1_PER_ID2 = U.B1_PER_ID2
                     AND B.M_B1_PER_ID3 = U.B1_PER_ID3
                     AND U.SERV_PROV_CODE = 'FDNY'
                     AND U.B1_CHECKBOX_TYPE = 'PLAN INFORMATION'
                     AND U.B1_CHECKBOX_DESC = 'Application Type'
                     AND U.B1_ACT_STATUS = 'BFP_COM_INSP'
                     LEFT OUTER JOIN #ENF_CONTACT AS C ON B.SERV_PROV_CODE = C.SERV_PROV_CODE
                     AND B.B1_PER_ID1 = C.B1_PER_ID1
                     AND B.B1_PER_ID2 = C.B1_PER_ID2
                     AND B.B1_PER_ID3 = C.B1_PER_ID3
                     AND C.SERV_PROV_CODE = 'FDNY'
                     LEFT OUTER JOIN #ASI S
                     ON S.SERV_PROV_CODE = B.SERV_PROV_CODE
                     AND S.B1_PER_ID1 = B.B1_PER_ID1
                     AND S.B1_PER_ID2 = B.B1_PER_ID2
                     AND S.B1_PER_ID3 = B.B1_PER_ID3
                     AND S.SERV_PROV_CODE = 'FDNY'
       )
select  * INTO #MQUERY from MQUERY;

WITH MQUERY AS (
              SELECT
                     B.SERV_PROV_CODE,
                     B.ACCT_NUM,
                     B.B1_ALT_ID ENF_KEY,
                     ISNULL(U.B1_CHECKLIST_COMMENT, S.FP_UNIT) UNIT_NAME,
                     B.B1_APPL_STATUS,
					 FORMAT(B.B1_APPL_STATUS_DATE,'MM/dd/yyyy') APPL_DATE,
                     C.OWNER_NAME,
                     B.HOUSE_NUM,
                     B.STNAME,
                     B.BORO,
                     B.ZIP_CODE,
                     B.BIN,
                     CASE
                            WHEN B.B1_PER_SUB_TYPE = 'FDNY Summons'
                            AND (
                                   FDNY_CHK = 'CHECKED'
                                   OR OATH_CHK = 'CHECKED'
                                   OR FDNY_OFF = 'CHECKED'
                                   OR B.B1_APPL_STATUS IN (
                                          'Voided - No Hearing Required',
                                          'Abated - No Hearing Required',
                                          'Corrected - Hearing Required',
                                          'Cure Letter Issued-No hearing',
                                          'Withdrawn',
                                          'Written Off'
                                   )
                            ) THEN 'CORRECTED'
                            WHEN B.B1_PER_SUB_TYPE = 'VO Details'
                            AND B.B1_APPL_STATUS = 'Dismissed' THEN 'DISMISSED'
                            ELSE 'COMPLIANCE DUE'
                     END COMPLIANCE_STATUS
              FROM
                     #B1P B 
                     LEFT OUTER JOIN BCHCKBOX U ON B.SERV_PROV_CODE = U.SERV_PROV_CODE
                     AND B.M_B1_PER_ID1 = U.B1_PER_ID1
                     AND B.M_B1_PER_ID2 = U.B1_PER_ID2
                     AND B.M_B1_PER_ID3 = U.B1_PER_ID3
                     AND U.SERV_PROV_CODE = 'FDNY'
                     AND U.B1_CHECKBOX_TYPE = 'PLAN INFORMATION'
                     AND U.B1_CHECKBOX_DESC = 'Application Type'
                     AND U.B1_ACT_STATUS = 'BFP_COM_INSP'
                     LEFT OUTER JOIN #ENF_CONTACT AS C ON B.SERV_PROV_CODE = C.SERV_PROV_CODE
                     AND B.B1_PER_ID1 = C.B1_PER_ID1
                     AND B.B1_PER_ID2 = C.B1_PER_ID2
                     AND B.B1_PER_ID3 = C.B1_PER_ID3
                     AND C.SERV_PROV_CODE = 'FDNY'
                     LEFT OUTER JOIN #ASI S
                     ON S.SERV_PROV_CODE = B.SERV_PROV_CODE
                     AND S.B1_PER_ID1 = B.B1_PER_ID1
                     AND S.B1_PER_ID2 = B.B1_PER_ID2
                     AND S.B1_PER_ID3 = B.B1_PER_ID3
                     AND S.SERV_PROV_CODE = 'FDNY'
       )

WITH B1P AS (
       SELECT
              M.B1_PER_ID1 M_B1_PER_ID1,
              M.B1_PER_ID2 M_B1_PER_ID2,
              M.B1_PER_ID3 M_B1_PER_ID3,
              M.B1_ALT_ID AS ACCT_NUM,
              B.B1_ALT_ID,
              B.B1_PER_GROUP,
              B.SERV_PROV_CODE,
              B.B1_PER_TYPE,
              B.B1_PER_SUB_TYPE,
              B.B1_PER_CATEGORY,
              B.B1_PER_ID1,
              B.B1_PER_ID2,
              B.B1_PER_ID3,
              B.B1_APPL_STATUS,
			  B.B1_APPL_STATUS_DATE,
              A.B1_HSE_NBR_ALPHA_START AS HOUSE_NUM,
              A.B1_STR_NAME AS STNAME,
              TRIM(UPPER(A.B1_SITUS_CITY)) AS BORO,
              LEFT(TRIM(A.B1_SITUS_ZIP), 5) AS ZIP_CODE,
              P.B1_ATTRIBUTE_VALUE AS BIN
       FROM
              B1PERMIT AS B
              INNER JOIN B3ADDRES AS A ON A.SERV_PROV_CODE = B.SERV_PROV_CODE
              AND A.B1_PER_ID1 = B.B1_PER_ID1
              AND A.B1_PER_ID2 = B.B1_PER_ID2
              AND A.B1_PER_ID3 = B.B1_PER_ID3
			  JOIN #TMP_Returned_Values rv ON b.SERV_PROV_CODE = rv.SERV_PROV_CODE
				AND b.B1_PER_ID1 = rv.B1_PER_ID1
				AND b.B1_PER_ID2 = rv.B1_PER_ID2
				AND b.B1_PER_ID3 = rv.B1_PER_ID3

              LEFT OUTER JOIN B3APO_ATTRIBUTE AS P ON A.SERV_PROV_CODE = P.SERV_PROV_CODE
              AND A.B1_PER_ID1 = P.B1_PER_ID1
              AND A.B1_PER_ID2 = P.B1_PER_ID2
              AND A.B1_PER_ID3 = P.B1_PER_ID3
              AND A.B1_ADDRESS_NBR = P.B1_APO_NBR
              AND P.SERV_PROV_CODE = 'FDNY'
              AND P.B1_APO_TYPE = 'ADDRESS'
              AND P.B1_ATTRIBUTE_NAME = 'BIN'
              LEFT OUTER JOIN XAPP2REF X ON B.SERV_PROV_CODE = X.SERV_PROV_CODE
              AND B.B1_PER_ID1 = X.B1_PER_ID1
              AND B.B1_PER_ID2 = X.B1_PER_ID2
              AND B.B1_PER_ID3 = X.B1_PER_ID3
              AND X.B1_RELATIONSHIP = 'R'
              LEFT OUTER JOIN B1PERMIT M ON M.SERV_PROV_CODE = X.SERV_PROV_CODE
              AND M.B1_PER_ID1 = X.B1_MASTER_ID1
              AND M.B1_PER_ID2 = X.B1_MASTER_ID2
              AND M.B1_PER_ID3 = X.B1_MASTER_ID3
       WHERE
              B.B1_PER_GROUP = 'BFP'
              AND B.SERV_PROV_CODE = 'FDNY'
              AND B.B1_PER_TYPE = 'Enforcement'
              AND B.B1_PER_SUB_TYPE IN ('FDNY Summons', 'VO Details')
              AND B.B1_PER_CATEGORY = 'NA'
              AND B.REC_STATUS = 'A'
              AND (B.B1_APPL_CLASS IN ('COMPLETE', 'EDITABLE') OR B.B1_APPL_CLASS IS NULL)
			  AND (A.B1_HSE_NBR_ALPHA_START = @PREM_HOUSE_NUM OR @PREM_HOUSE_NUM IS NULL)
			  AND (A.B1_STR_NAME LIKE CONCAT(@PREM_STNAME,'%') OR @PREM_STNAME IS NULL)
			  AND (A.B1_SITUS_CITY LIKE CONCAT(@PREM_CITY,'%') OR @PREM_CITY IS NULL)
			  AND (P.B1_ATTRIBUTE_VALUE = @BIN OR @BIN IS NULL)
               
)
select * INTO #B1P from B1P;

WITH ENF_CONTACT AS (
              SELECT
                     B1_ALT_ID,
                     SERV_PROV_CODE,
                     B1_PER_ID1,
                     B1_PER_ID2,
                     B1_PER_ID3,
                     OWNER_NAME
              FROM
                     (
                            SELECT
                                   B1_ALT_ID,
                                   SERV_PROV_CODE,
                                   B1_PER_ID1,
                                   B1_PER_ID2,
                                   B1_PER_ID3,
                                   OWNER_NAME
                            FROM
                                   (
                                          SELECT
                                                 B.B1_ALT_ID,
                                                 B.SERV_PROV_CODE,
                                                 B.B1_PER_ID1,
                                                 B.B1_PER_ID2,
                                                 B.B1_PER_ID3,
                                                 CASE
                                                        WHEN B1_PREFERRED_CHANNEL = '1' THEN TRIM(
                                                               ISNULL(C.B1_FNAME, '') + ' ' + ISNULL(C.B1_MNAME, '') + ' ' + ISNULL(C.B1_LNAME, '')
                                                        )
                                                        WHEN B1_PREFERRED_CHANNEL IN ('2', '3') THEN C.B1_BUSINESS_NAME
                                                 END AS OWNER_NAME
                                          FROM
                                                 #B1P AS B INNER JOIN B3CONTACT AS C ON  C.SERV_PROV_CODE = B.SERV_PROV_CODE

                                                 AND C.B1_PER_ID2 = B.B1_PER_ID2
                                                 AND C.B1_PER_ID3 = B.B1_PER_ID3
                                          WHERE
                                                 B.B1_PER_GROUP = 'BFP'
                                                 AND B.SERV_PROV_CODE = 'FDNY'
                                                 AND B.B1_PER_TYPE = 'Enforcement'
                                                 AND B.B1_PER_SUB_TYPE = 'FDNY Summons'
                                                 AND B.B1_PER_CATEGORY = 'NA'
                                                 AND C.SERV_PROV_CODE = 'FDNY'
                                                 AND C.B1_CONTACT_TYPE = 'Respondent'
                                   ) T
                            WHERE
                                   SERV_PROV_CODE = 'FDNY'
                                   AND (OWNER_NAME LIKE CONCAT(@OWNER_NAME,'%') OR @OWNER_NAME IS NULL)
                                   
                            UNION
                            ALL
                            SELECT
                                   B1_ALT_ID,
                                   SERV_PROV_CODE,
                                   B1_PER_ID1,
                                   B1_PER_ID2,
                                   B1_PER_ID3,
                                   OWNER_NAME
                            FROM
                                   (
                                          SELECT
                                                 B.B1_ALT_ID,
                                                 B.SERV_PROV_CODE,
                                                 B.B1_PER_ID1,
                                                 B.B1_PER_ID2,
                                                 B.B1_PER_ID3,
                                                 CASE
                                                        WHEN B1_PREFERRED_CHANNEL = '1' THEN TRIM(
                                                               ISNULL(C.B1_FNAME, '') + ' ' + ISNULL(C.B1_MNAME, '') + ' ' + ISNULL(C.B1_LNAME, '')
                                                        )
                                                        WHEN B1_PREFERRED_CHANNEL IN ('2', '3') THEN C.B1_BUSINESS_NAME
                                                 END AS OWNER_NAME,
                                                 ROW_NUMBER () OVER (
                                                        PARTITION BY B.SERV_PROV_CODE,
                                                        B.B1_PER_ID1,
                                                        B.B1_PER_ID2,
                                                        B.B1_PER_ID3
                                                        ORDER BY
                                                               C.B1_CONTACT_TYPE DESC,
                                                               C.REC_DATE DESC
                                                 ) RN
                                          FROM
                                                 #B1P AS B INNER JOIN B3CONTACT AS C ON  C.SERV_PROV_CODE = B.SERV_PROV_CODE
                                                 AND C.B1_PER_ID1 = B.B1_PER_ID1
                                                 AND C.B1_PER_ID2 = B.B1_PER_ID2
                                                 AND C.B1_PER_ID3 = B.B1_PER_ID3
                                          WHERE
                                                 B.B1_PER_GROUP = 'BFP'
                                                 AND B.SERV_PROV_CODE = 'FDNY'
                                                 AND B.B1_PER_TYPE = 'Enforcement'
                                                 AND B.B1_PER_SUB_TYPE = 'VO Details'
                                                 AND B.B1_PER_CATEGORY = 'NA'
                                                 AND C.SERV_PROV_CODE = 'FDNY'
                                                 AND C.B1_CONTACT_TYPE IN ('Building Owner', 'Business Owner')
                                   ) T1
                            WHERE
                                   SERV_PROV_CODE = 'FDNY'
                                   AND RN = 1
                                   AND (OWNER_NAME LIKE CONCAT(@OWNER_NAME,'%') OR @OWNER_NAME IS NULL)
                     ) T2
       )

WITH ASI AS (
              SELECT
                     SERV_PROV_CODE,
                     B1_PER_ID1,
                     B1_PER_ID2,
                     B1_PER_ID3,
                     [FDNY] FDNY_CHK,
                     [Oath] OATH_CHK,
                     [FDNY Written Off] FDNY_OFF,
                     [Division FP Unit] FP_UNIT
              FROM
                     (
                            SELECT
                                   BC.SERV_PROV_CODE AS SERV_PROV_CODE,
                                   BC.B1_PER_ID1 AS B1_PER_ID1,
                                   BC.B1_PER_ID2 AS B1_PER_ID2,
                                   BC.B1_PER_ID3 AS B1_PER_ID3,
                                   BC.B1_CHECKBOX_DESC,
                                   BC.B1_CHECKLIST_COMMENT
                            FROM
                                   #B1P A INNER JOIN BCHCKBOX BC
                                   ON A.SERV_PROV_CODE = BC.SERV_PROV_CODE
                                   AND A.B1_PER_ID1 = BC.B1_PER_ID1
                                   AND A.B1_PER_ID2 = BC.B1_PER_ID2
                                   AND A.B1_PER_ID3 = BC.B1_PER_ID3
                            WHERE
                                   BC.SERV_PROV_CODE = 'FDNY'
                                   AND BC.B1_ACT_STATUS IN ('BFP_VO_DET', 'BFP_FSUM')
                                   AND BC.B1_PER_SUB_TYPE IN ('VO Details', 'FDNY Summons')
                                   AND BC.B1_CHECKBOX_TYPE IN (
                                          'COMPLIANCE INFORMATION',
                                          'FDNY WRITTEN OFF',
                                          'INSPECTION INFO'
                                   )
                                   AND BC.B1_CHECKBOX_DESC IN (
                                          'FDNY',
                                          'Oath',
                                          'FDNY Written Off',
                                          'Division FP Unit'
                                   )
                     ) PVIA PIVOT (
                            MAX(B1_CHECKLIST_COMMENT) FOR B1_CHECKBOX_DESC IN (
                                   [FDNY],
                                   [Oath],
                                   [FDNY Written Off],
                                   [Division FP Unit]
                            )
                     ) PVIB
       )
select * INTO #ASI from ASI;
--select * from #ASI
WITH MQUERY AS (
              SELECT
                     B.SERV_PROV_CODE,
                     B.ACCT_NUM,
                     B.B1_ALT_ID ENF_KEY,
                     ISNULL(U.B1_CHECKLIST_COMMENT, S.FP_UNIT) UNIT_NAME,
                     B.B1_APPL_STATUS,
					 FORMAT(B.B1_APPL_STATUS_DATE,'MM/dd/yyyy') APPL_DATE,
                     C.OWNER_NAME,
                     B.HOUSE_NUM,
                     B.STNAME,
                     B.BORO,
                     B.ZIP_CODE,
                     B.BIN,
                     CASE
                            WHEN B.B1_PER_SUB_TYPE = 'FDNY Summons'
                            AND (
                                   FDNY_CHK = 'CHECKED'
                                   OR OATH_CHK = 'CHECKED'
                                   OR FDNY_OFF = 'CHECKED'
                                   OR B.B1_APPL_STATUS IN (
                                          'Voided - No Hearing Required',
                                          'Abated - No Hearing Required',
                                          'Corrected - Hearing Required',
                                          'Cure Letter Issued-No hearing',
                                          'Withdrawn',
                                          'Written Off'
                                   )
                            ) THEN 'CORRECTED'
                            WHEN B.B1_PER_SUB_TYPE = 'VO Details'
                            AND B.B1_APPL_STATUS = 'Dismissed' THEN 'DISMISSED'
                            ELSE 'COMPLIANCE DUE'
                     END COMPLIANCE_STATUS
              FROM
                     #B1P B 
                     LEFT OUTER JOIN BCHCKBOX U ON B.SERV_PROV_CODE = U.SERV_PROV_CODE
                     AND B.M_B1_PER_ID1 = U.B1_PER_ID1
                     AND B.M_B1_PER_ID2 = U.B1_PER_ID2
                     AND B.M_B1_PER_ID3 = U.B1_PER_ID3
                     AND U.SERV_PROV_CODE = 'FDNY'
                     AND U.B1_CHECKBOX_TYPE = 'PLAN INFORMATION'
                     AND U.B1_CHECKBOX_DESC = 'Application Type'
                     AND U.B1_ACT_STATUS = 'BFP_COM_INSP'
                     LEFT OUTER JOIN #ENF_CONTACT AS C ON B.SERV_PROV_CODE = C.SERV_PROV_CODE
                     AND B.B1_PER_ID1 = C.B1_PER_ID1
                     AND B.B1_PER_ID2 = C.B1_PER_ID2
                     AND B.B1_PER_ID3 = C.B1_PER_ID3
                     AND C.SERV_PROV_CODE = 'FDNY'
                     LEFT OUTER JOIN #ASI S
                     ON S.SERV_PROV_CODE = B.SERV_PROV_CODE
                     AND S.B1_PER_ID1 = B.B1_PER_ID1
                     AND S.B1_PER_ID2 = B.B1_PER_ID2
                     AND S.B1_PER_ID3 = B.B1_PER_ID3
                     AND S.SERV_PROV_CODE = 'FDNY'
       )
select  * INTO #MQUERY from MQUERY;

WHERE  1 = 1

	AND MQ.SERV_PROV_CODE = 'FDNY'

	AND (MQ.STNAME LIKE CONCAT(@PREM_STNAME,'%') OR @PREM_STNAME IS NULL)
	AND (MQ.BORO LIKE CONCAT(@PREM_CITY,'%') OR @PREM_CITY IS NULL)
	AND (MQ.BIN = @BIN OR @BIN IS NULL)
	AND (MQ.COMPLIANCE_STATUS IN (@APPL_STATUS) OR @APPL_STATUS IS NULL);

                                                        WHEN B1_PREFERRED_CHANNEL IN ('2', '3') THEN C.B1_BUSINESS_NAME
                                                 END AS OWNER_NAME
                                          FROM

                                                 AND C.B1_PER_ID1 = B.B1_PER_ID1

                                                 AND C.B1_PER_ID3 = B.B1_PER_ID3

                                                 AND B.B1_PER_TYPE = 'Enforcement'

WITH ASI AS (
              SELECT
                     SERV_PROV_CODE,
                     B1_PER_ID1,
                     B1_PER_ID2,
                     B1_PER_ID3,
                     [FDNY] FDNY_CHK,
                     [Oath] OATH_CHK,
                     [FDNY Written Off] FDNY_OFF,
                     [Division FP Unit] FP_UNIT
              FROM
                     (
                            SELECT
                                   BC.SERV_PROV_CODE AS SERV_PROV_CODE,
                                   BC.B1_PER_ID1 AS B1_PER_ID1,
                                   BC.B1_PER_ID2 AS B1_PER_ID2,
                                   BC.B1_PER_ID3 AS B1_PER_ID3,
                                   BC.B1_CHECKBOX_DESC,
                                   BC.B1_CHECKLIST_COMMENT
                            FROM
                                   #TMP_Returned_Values A INNER JOIN BCHCKBOX BC
                                   ON A.SERV_PROV_CODE = BC.SERV_PROV_CODE
                                   AND A.B1_PER_ID1 = BC.B1_PER_ID1
                                   AND A.B1_PER_ID2 = BC.B1_PER_ID2
                                   AND A.B1_PER_ID3 = BC.B1_PER_ID3
                            WHERE
                                   BC.SERV_PROV_CODE = 'FDNY'
                                   AND BC.B1_ACT_STATUS IN ('BFP_VO_DET', 'BFP_FSUM')
                                   AND BC.B1_PER_SUB_TYPE IN ('VO Details', 'FDNY Summons')
                                   AND BC.B1_CHECKBOX_TYPE IN (
                                          'COMPLIANCE INFORMATION',
                                          'FDNY WRITTEN OFF',
                                          'INSPECTION INFO'
                                   )
                                   AND BC.B1_CHECKBOX_DESC IN (
                                          'FDNY',
                                          'Oath',
                                          'FDNY Written Off',
                                          'Division FP Unit'
                                   )
                     ) PVIA PIVOT (
                            MAX(B1_CHECKLIST_COMMENT) FOR B1_CHECKBOX_DESC IN (
                                   [FDNY],
                                   [Oath],
                                   [FDNY Written Off],
                                   [Division FP Unit]
                            )
                     ) PVIB
       )

WITH MQUERY AS (
              SELECT
                     B.SERV_PROV_CODE,
                     M.B1_ALT_ID AS ACCT_NUM,
                     B.B1_ALT_ID ENF_KEY,
                     ISNULL(U.B1_CHECKLIST_COMMENT, S.FP_UNIT) UNIT_NAME,
                     B.B1_APPL_STATUS,
					 FORMAT(B.B1_APPL_STATUS_DATE,'MM/dd/yyyy') APPL_DATE,
                     C.OWNER_NAME,
                     B.HOUSE_NUM,
                     B.STNAME,
                     B.BORO,
                     B.ZIP_CODE,
                     B.BIN,
                     CASE
                            WHEN B.B1_PER_SUB_TYPE = 'FDNY Summons'
                            AND (
                                   FDNY_CHK = 'CHECKED'
                                   OR OATH_CHK = 'CHECKED'
                                   OR FDNY_OFF = 'CHECKED'
                                   OR B.B1_APPL_STATUS IN (
                                          'Voided - No Hearing Required',
                                          'Abated - No Hearing Required',
                                          'Corrected - Hearing Required',
                                          'Cure Letter Issued-No hearing',
                                          'Withdrawn',
                                          'Written Off'
                                   )
                            ) THEN 'CORRECTED'
                            WHEN B.B1_PER_SUB_TYPE = 'VO Details'
                            AND B.B1_APPL_STATUS = 'Dismissed' THEN 'DISMISSED'
                            ELSE 'COMPLIANCE DUE'
                     END COMPLIANCE_STATUS
              FROM
                     #B1P B 
                     LEFT OUTER JOIN XAPP2REF X ON B.SERV_PROV_CODE = X.SERV_PROV_CODE
                     AND B.B1_PER_ID1 = X.B1_PER_ID1
                     AND B.B1_PER_ID2 = X.B1_PER_ID2
                     AND B.B1_PER_ID3 = X.B1_PER_ID3
                     AND X.B1_RELATIONSHIP = 'R'
                     LEFT OUTER JOIN B1PERMIT M ON M.SERV_PROV_CODE = X.SERV_PROV_CODE
                     AND M.B1_PER_ID1 = X.B1_MASTER_ID1
                     AND M.B1_PER_ID2 = X.B1_MASTER_ID2
                     AND M.B1_PER_ID3 = X.B1_MASTER_ID3
                     LEFT OUTER JOIN BCHCKBOX U ON M.SERV_PROV_CODE = U.SERV_PROV_CODE
                     AND M.B1_PER_ID1 = U.B1_PER_ID1
                     AND M.B1_PER_ID2 = U.B1_PER_ID2
                     AND M.B1_PER_ID3 = U.B1_PER_ID3
                     AND U.SERV_PROV_CODE = 'FDNY'
                     AND U.B1_CHECKBOX_TYPE = 'PLAN INFORMATION'
                     AND U.B1_CHECKBOX_DESC = 'Application Type'
                     AND U.B1_ACT_STATUS = 'BFP_COM_INSP'
                     LEFT OUTER JOIN #ENF_CONTACT AS C ON B.SERV_PROV_CODE = C.SERV_PROV_CODE
                     AND B.B1_PER_ID1 = C.B1_PER_ID1
                     AND B.B1_PER_ID2 = C.B1_PER_ID2
                     AND B.B1_PER_ID3 = C.B1_PER_ID3
                     AND C.SERV_PROV_CODE = 'FDNY'
                     LEFT OUTER JOIN #ASI S
                     ON S.SERV_PROV_CODE = B.SERV_PROV_CODE
                     AND S.B1_PER_ID1 = B.B1_PER_ID1
                     AND S.B1_PER_ID2 = B.B1_PER_ID2
                     AND S.B1_PER_ID3 = B.B1_PER_ID3
                     AND S.SERV_PROV_CODE = 'FDNY'
       )
select  * INTO #MQUERY from MQUERY;

              rv.B1_PER_ID3 M_B1_PER_ID3,

              rv.SERV_PROV_CODE,

              rv.B1_PER_SUB_TYPE,

              rv.B1_PER_ID2,

              rv.B1_APPL_STATUS,
			  rv.B1_APPL_STATUS_DATE,
              A.B1_HSE_NBR_ALPHA_START AS HOUSE_NUM,
              A.B1_STR_NAME AS STNAME,
              TRIM(UPPER(A.B1_SITUS_CITY)) AS BORO,
              LEFT(TRIM(A.B1_SITUS_ZIP), 5) AS ZIP_CODE,
              P.B1_ATTRIBUTE_VALUE AS BIN
       FROM
              B1PERMIT AS B
              INNER JOIN B3ADDRES AS A ON A.SERV_PROV_CODE = B.SERV_PROV_CODE
              AND A.B1_PER_ID1 = B.B1_PER_ID1
              AND A.B1_PER_ID2 = B.B1_PER_ID2
              AND A.B1_PER_ID3 = B.B1_PER_ID3
			  JOIN #TMP_Returned_Values rv ON b.SERV_PROV_CODE = rv.SERV_PROV_CODE
				AND b.B1_PER_ID1 = rv.B1_PER_ID1
				AND b.B1_PER_ID2 = rv.B1_PER_ID2
				AND b.B1_PER_ID3 = rv.B1_PER_ID3
              LEFT OUTER JOIN B3APO_ATTRIBUTE AS P ON A.SERV_PROV_CODE = P.SERV_PROV_CODE
              AND A.B1_PER_ID1 = P.B1_PER_ID1
              AND A.B1_PER_ID2 = P.B1_PER_ID2
              AND A.B1_PER_ID3 = P.B1_PER_ID3
              AND A.B1_ADDRESS_NBR = P.B1_APO_NBR
              AND P.SERV_PROV_CODE = 'FDNY'
              AND P.B1_APO_TYPE = 'ADDRESS'
              AND P.B1_ATTRIBUTE_NAME = 'BIN'
       WHERE
              B.B1_PER_GROUP = 'BFP'
              AND B.SERV_PROV_CODE = 'FDNY'
              AND B.B1_PER_TYPE = 'Enforcement'
              AND B.B1_PER_SUB_TYPE IN ('FDNY Summons', 'VO Details')
              AND B.B1_PER_CATEGORY = 'NA'
              AND B.REC_STATUS = 'A'

)

WITH B1P AS (

              M.B1_PER_ID1 M_B1_PER_ID1,
              M.B1_PER_ID2 M_B1_PER_ID2,

              AND A.B1_PER_ID3 = P.B1_PER_ID3

              AND B.B1_PER_ID1 = X.B1_PER_ID1
              AND B.B1_PER_ID2 = X.B1_PER_ID2
              AND B.B1_PER_ID3 = X.B1_PER_ID3
              AND X.B1_RELATIONSHIP = 'R'
              LEFT OUTER JOIN B1PERMIT M ON M.SERV_PROV_CODE = X.SERV_PROV_CODE
              AND M.B1_PER_ID1 = X.B1_MASTER_ID1
              AND M.B1_PER_ID2 = X.B1_MASTER_ID2
              AND M.B1_PER_ID3 = X.B1_MASTER_ID3
       WHERE
              B.B1_PER_GROUP = 'BFP'
              AND B.SERV_PROV_CODE = 'FDNY'
              AND B.B1_PER_TYPE = 'Enforcement'
              AND B.B1_PER_SUB_TYPE IN ('FDNY Summons', 'VO Details')
              AND B.B1_PER_CATEGORY = 'NA'
