WITH ASI AS (
              SELECT
                     SERV_PROV_CODE,
                     B1_PER_ID1,
                     B1_PER_ID2,
                     B1_PER_ID3,
                     [FDNY] FDNY_CHK,
                     [Oath] OATH_CHK,
                     [FDNY Written Off] FDNY_OFF,
                     [Division FP Unit] FP_UNIT
              FROM
                     (
                            SELECT
                                   BC.SERV_PROV_CODE AS SERV_PROV_CODE,
                                   BC.B1_PER_ID1 AS B1_PER_ID1,
                                   BC.B1_PER_ID2 AS B1_PER_ID2,
                                   BC.B1_PER_ID3 AS B1_PER_ID3,
                                   BC.B1_CHECKBOX_DESC,
                                   BC.B1_CHECKLIST_COMMENT
                            FROM
                                   #B1P A INNER JOIN BCHCKBOX BC
                                   ON A.SERV_PROV_CODE = BC.SERV_PROV_CODE
                                   AND A.B1_PER_ID1 = BC.B1_PER_ID1
                                   AND A.B1_PER_ID2 = BC.B1_PER_ID2
                                   AND A.B1_PER_ID3 = BC.B1_PER_ID3
                            WHERE
                                   BC.SERV_PROV_CODE = 'FDNY'
                                   AND BC.B1_ACT_STATUS IN ('BFP_VO_DET', 'BFP_FSUM')
                                   AND BC.B1_PER_SUB_TYPE IN ('VO Details', 'FDNY Summons')
                                   AND BC.B1_CHECKBOX_TYPE IN (
                                          'COMPLIANCE INFORMATION',
                                          'FDNY WRITTEN OFF',
                                          'INSPECTION INFO'
                                   )
                                   AND BC.B1_CHECKBOX_DESC IN (
                                          'FDNY',
                                          'Oath',
                                          'FDNY Written Off',
                                          'Division FP Unit'
                                   )
                     ) PVIA PIVOT (
                            MAX(B1_CHECKLIST_COMMENT) FOR B1_CHECKBOX_DESC IN (
                                   [FDNY],
                                   [Oath],
                                   [FDNY Written Off],
                                   [Division FP Unit]
                            )
                     ) PVIB
       )
select * INTO #ASI from ASI;

                                   BC.SERV_PROV_CODE = 'FDNY'
                                   AND BC.B1_ACT_STATUS IN ('BFP_VO_DET', 'BFP_FSUM')

                                          'Oath',
                                          'FDNY Written Off',

                                   )

                            MAX(B1_CHECKLIST_COMMENT) FOR B1_CHECKBOX_DESC IN (
                                   [FDNY],

WITH MQUERY AS (
              SELECT
                     B.SERV_PROV_CODE,
                     M.B1_ALT_ID AS ACCT_NUM,

                     B.BORO,

                            WHEN B.B1_PER_SUB_TYPE = 'FDNY Summons'
                            AND (
                                   FDNY_CHK = 'CHECKED'
                                   OR OATH_CHK = 'CHECKED'
                                   OR FDNY_OFF = 'CHECKED'
                                   OR B.B1_APPL_STATUS IN (
                                          'Voided - No Hearing Required',
                                          'Abated - No Hearing Required',
                                          'Corrected - Hearing Required',
                                          'Cure Letter Issued-No hearing',
                                          'Withdrawn',
                                          'Written Off'
                                   )
                            ) THEN 'CORRECTED'
                            WHEN B.B1_PER_SUB_TYPE = 'VO Details'
                            AND B.B1_APPL_STATUS = 'Dismissed' THEN 'DISMISSED'
                            ELSE 'COMPLIANCE DUE'
                     END COMPLIANCE_STATUS

                     #B1P B

                     AND B.B1_PER_ID1 = X.B1_PER_ID1
                     AND B.B1_PER_ID2 = X.B1_PER_ID2
                     AND B.B1_PER_ID3 = X.B1_PER_ID3
                     AND X.B1_RELATIONSHIP = 'R'

                     AND M.B1_PER_ID1 = X.B1_MASTER_ID1
                     AND M.B1_PER_ID2 = X.B1_MASTER_ID2
                     AND M.B1_PER_ID3 = X.B1_MASTER_ID3

                     AND M.B1_PER_ID2 = U.B1_PER_ID2

                     AND U.SERV_PROV_CODE = 'FDNY'
                     AND U.B1_CHECKBOX_TYPE = 'PLAN INFORMATION'
                     AND U.B1_CHECKBOX_DESC = 'Application Type'
                     AND U.B1_ACT_STATUS = 'BFP_COM_INSP'
                     LEFT OUTER JOIN #ASI S
                     ON S.SERV_PROV_CODE = B.SERV_PROV_CODE
                     AND S.B1_PER_ID1 = B.B1_PER_ID1
                     AND S.B1_PER_ID2 = B.B1_PER_ID2
                     AND S.B1_PER_ID3 = B.B1_PER_ID3
                     AND S.SERV_PROV_CODE = 'FDNY'
       )

WITH do_unit AS (
select 
	SERV_PROV_CODE,
	B1_PER_ID1,
	B1_PER_ID2,
	B1_PER_ID3,
	[D.O.] as ACTDO
from 
(
SELECT
    bc.serv_prov_code AS SERV_PROV_CODE,
    bc.b1_per_id1 AS B1_PER_ID1,
    bc.b1_per_id2 AS B1_PER_ID2,
    bc.b1_per_id3 AS B1_PER_ID3,    
    bc.b1_checkbox_desc,
    bc.b1_checklist_comment
 FROM
    bchckbox bc
JOIN #TMP_Returned_Values rv ON bc.SERV_PROV_CODE = rv.SERV_PROV_CODE
	AND bc.B1_PER_ID1 = rv.B1_PER_ID1
	AND bc.B1_PER_ID2 = rv.B1_PER_ID2
	AND bc.B1_PER_ID3 = rv.B1_PER_ID3
WHERE
    bc.b1_checkbox_desc IN ('D.O.' )
    AND bc.b1_checkbox_type IN ('PERMIT REPORT INFO')
	AND bc.SERV_PROV_CODE = 'FDNY'
    ) pvia
PIVOT ( 
		MAX(b1_checklist_comment) 
		for b1_checkbox_desc
            IN(
			[D.O.]
		)
	) pvib
)
   select * INTO #TMP_do_unit from do_unit;

	AND xr.B1_PER_ID1 = rv.B1_PER_ID1
	AND xr.B1_PER_ID2 = rv.B1_PER_ID2
	AND xr.B1_PER_ID3 = rv.B1_PER_ID3

                                  AND ebp.b1_per_id1 = xr.b1_per_id1

    INNER JOIN b1permit abp ON abp.serv_prov_code = xr.serv_prov_code
                                            AND abp.b1_per_id1 = xr.b1_master_id1

                                            AND abp.b1_per_id3 = xr.b1_master_id3

                                   AND abp.b1_per_id1 = du.b1_per_id1
                                   AND abp.b1_per_id2 = du.b1_per_id2                                   
                                   AND abp.b1_per_id3 = du.b1_per_id3

       abp.b1_per_type = 'Common' 
       AND  abp.b1_per_sub_type = 'Inspection'

       AND abp.b1_appl_status NOT IN ('Inactive','Undefined')

	   AND ebp.b1_appl_status NOT IN ('Inactive','Undefined','Voided - No Hearing Required','Abated - No Hearing Required')

WITH contact AS (

                     ORDER BY
                         b.rec_date DESC

        rn = 1

PIVOT (

        * 
    FROM

                SERV_PROV_CODE,
                B1_PER_ID1,
                B1_PER_ID2,
                B1_PER_ID3,
                ROW_INDEX,
                TABLE_NAME,
                [Permit Expiration Date] AS PERMIT_EXP_DATE,

                    B1_PER_ID1,
                    B1_PER_ID2,
                    B1_PER_ID3
                    ORDER BY
                        [Permit Expiration Date] DESC,
                        ROW_INDEX DESC
                ) RN 
            FROM
                (
                    SELECT
                        A.SERV_PROV_CODE,
                        A.B1_PER_ID1,
                        A.B1_PER_ID2,
                        A.B1_PER_ID3,
                        A.COLUMN_NAME,
                        A.ROW_INDEX,
                        A.ATTRIBUTE_VALUE,
                        A.TABLE_NAME 
                    FROM
                        BAPPSPECTABLE_VALUE A 
                    WHERE
                        A.SERV_PROV_CODE = 'FDNY'
                        AND A.REC_STATUS = 'A'
                        AND A.TABLE_NAME = 'PERMIT EXPIRATION'
                ) AS T  PIVOT (
                    MAX (ATTRIBUTE_VALUE) FOR COLUMN_NAME IN (
                        [Permit Expiration Date],
                        [Permit Start Date],
                        [Permit Issuance Date],
                        [Inspection ID] 
                    )
                ) AS T2
        ) AS T3
    WHERE
        RN = 1
),
PERMIT_EXPIRATION AS  (
    SELECT
        E.SERV_PROV_CODE,
        E.B1_PER_ID1,
        E.B1_PER_ID2,
        E.B1_PER_ID3,
        TABLE_NAME,
        ISNULL(I.PERMIT_EXP_DATE, E.EXPIRATION_DATE) EXPIRATION_DATE,
        PERMIT_START_DATE,
        PERMIT_ISSUANCE_DATE,
        INSPECTION_ID 
    FROM
        B1_EXPIRATION E
        LEFT OUTER JOIN PERMIT_INFO I ON E.SERV_PROV_CODE = I.SERV_PROV_CODE
        AND E.B1_PER_ID1 = I.B1_PER_ID1
        AND E.B1_PER_ID2 = I.B1_PER_ID2
        AND E.B1_PER_ID3 = I.B1_PER_ID3
) 
SELECT
    B.B1_ALT_ID AS ATLID,
    B1_APPL_STATUS,
    CONVERT(DATE, B1E.EXPIRATION_DATE, 101) EXPIRATION_DATE 
FROM
    B1PERMIT B
    INNER JOIN  PERMIT_EXPIRATION B1E ON B.SERV_PROV_CODE = B1E.SERV_PROV_CODE
    AND B.B1_PER_ID1 = B1E.B1_PER_ID1
    AND B.B1_PER_ID2 = B1E.B1_PER_ID2
    AND B.B1_PER_ID3 = B1E.B1_PER_ID3 
    INNER JOIN BCHCKBOX BC ON B.SERV_PROV_CODE = BC.SERV_PROV_CODE
    AND B.B1_PER_ID1 = BC.B1_PER_ID1
    AND B.B1_PER_ID2 = BC.B1_PER_ID2
    AND B.B1_PER_ID3 = BC.B1_PER_ID3 
    LEFT OUTER JOIN G6ACTION S ON S.SERV_PROV_CODE = B.SERV_PROV_CODE
    AND S.B1_PER_ID1 = B.B1_PER_ID1
    AND S.B1_PER_ID2 = B.B1_PER_ID2
    AND S.B1_PER_ID3 = B.B1_PER_ID3 
    AND S.REC_STATUS = 'A'
    AND S.G6_STATUS IN (
        'Rescheduled',
        'Scheduled',
        'Assignment Complete',
        'Pending Routing Approval'
    ) 
WHERE
    B.SERV_PROV_CODE = 'FDNY'
    AND B.B1_PER_GROUP = 'BFP'
    AND B.B1_PER_TYPE = 'Common'
    AND B.B1_PER_SUB_TYPE = 'Inspection'
    AND B.B1_PER_CATEGORY = 'Process' 
    AND B.REC_STATUS = 'A'
    AND BC.B1_CHECKBOX_TYPE = 'PLAN INFORMATION'
    AND BC.B1_CHECKBOX_DESC = 'Application Type'
    AND BC.B1_CHECKLIST_COMMENT = 'Rangehood' 
    AND CONVERT(DATE, B1E.EXPIRATION_DATE, 101) <= DATEADD(DAY, 90, CONVERT(DATE, GETDATE(), 101)) 
    AND B1_APPL_STATUS NOT IN (
        'Abandoned',
        'Inactive',
        'Business Owner Changed',
        'Scheduling Pending',
        'Inspection/Test Scheduled'
    )
    AND S.G6_ACT_NUM IS NULL 
ORDER BY
    1

                               AND b.b1_per_id2 = f4p.b1_per_id2
                               AND b.b1_per_id3 = f4p.b1_per_id3

                               AND f4p.payment_seq_nbr = aat.payment_seq_nbr
                               AND f4p.rec_status = 'A'
WHERE
        b.b1_per_group = 'BFP'
    AND b.rec_status = 'A'
    AND b.b1_per_type = 'Certificate'
    AND b.b1_per_sub_type = 'Fitness'
    AND isnull(b.b1_appl_class, 'COMPLETE') NOT LIKE '%INCOMPLETE%'
    AND b.b1_per_category IN ( 'Application', 'Renew', 'Renewal', 'Duplicate or Update' )
    AND ( b.b1_per_category IN ( 'Application', 'Renewal', 'Duplicate or Update' )
          OR ( b.b1_per_category = 'Renew'
               AND b.b1_relationship = 'R' ) )
		AND DATEADD(dd, 0, DATEDIFF(dd, 0,isnull(f4p.payment_date, b.rec_date))) BETWEEN @START_DATE AND @END_DATE
		AND isnull(f4p.cashier_id, b.rec_ful_nam) LIKE concat(@cashier_id,'%');

-- 1 BILL DATE FILTER 
----------------------------------------------------
DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #BillDate;
SELECT
B1P.SERV_PROV_CODE,
B1P.B1_PER_ID1,
B1P.B1_PER_ID2,
B1P.B1_PER_ID3,
B1P.B1_ALT_ID Record_ID,
BD.ROW_INDEX,
TRY_CONVERT(date,BD.ATTRIBUTE_VALUE,101) BillDate
INTO #BillDate
FROM B1PERMIT B1P

INNER JOIN BAPPSPECTABLE_VALUE BD
ON BD.SERV_PROV_CODE = B1P.SERV_PROV_CODE
AND BD.B1_PER_ID1 = B1P.B1_PER_ID1
AND BD.B1_PER_ID2 = B1P.B1_PER_ID2
AND BD.B1_PER_ID3 = B1P.B1_PER_ID3
WHERE B1P.SERV_PROV_CODE= @SERV_PROV_CODE
AND GROUP_NAME='BFP_COM_INSP'
AND TABLE_NAME='BILLING INFORMATION'
AND COLUMN_NAME='Bill Date'
AND TRY_CONVERT(date,ATTRIBUTE_VALUE,101) >= @FDate
AND TRY_CONVERT(date,ATTRIBUTE_VALUE,101) < DATEADD(DAY,1,@TDate)
--AND B1P.B1_ALT_ID ='99052235'

----------------------------------------------------
-- 2 BILLING INFO 
----------------------------------------------------
DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #BillingInfo;
SELECT
D.SERV_PROV_CODE,
D.Record_ID RECORD_ID,
D.B1_PER_ID1,
D.B1_PER_ID2,
D.B1_PER_ID3,
FORMAT(D.BillDate,'MM/dd/yy') BillDate,
D.ROW_INDEX,
BillNo.ATTRIBUTE_VALUE AS BillNumber,
UPPER(BillType.ATTRIBUTE_VALUE) BillType,
BillAmount.ATTRIBUTE_VALUE BillAmount ,
LEFT(BCN.ATTRIBUTE_VALUE, CHARINDEX('-', BCN.ATTRIBUTE_VALUE) - 1) InspectionNum,
SUBSTRING(BCN.ATTRIBUTE_VALUE, CHARINDEX('-', BCN.ATTRIBUTE_VALUE) + 1, LEN(BCN.ATTRIBUTE_VALUE)) AccountNo,
BDI.ATTRIBUTE_VALUE DocumentID

INTO #BillingInfo

FROM #BillDate D

INNER JOIN BAPPSPECTABLE_VALUE BillNo
ON BillNo.SERV_PROV_CODE = D.SERV_PROV_CODE
AND BillNo.B1_PER_ID1 = D.B1_PER_ID1
AND BillNo.B1_PER_ID2 = D.B1_PER_ID2
AND BillNo.B1_PER_ID3 = D.B1_PER_ID3
AND BillNo.GROUP_NAME = 'BFP_COM_INSP'
AND BillNo.TABLE_NAME = 'BILLING INFORMATION'
AND BillNo.COLUMN_NAME = 'Bill Number'
AND BillNo.ROW_INDEX = D.ROW_INDEX

LEFT JOIN BAPPSPECTABLE_VALUE BillDate
ON BillDate.SERV_PROV_CODE = D.SERV_PROV_CODE
AND BillDate.B1_PER_ID1 = D.B1_PER_ID1
AND BillDate.B1_PER_ID2 = D.B1_PER_ID2
AND BillDate.B1_PER_ID3 = D.B1_PER_ID3
AND BillDate.GROUP_NAME = 'BFP_COM_INSP'
AND BillDate.TABLE_NAME = 'BILLING INFORMATION'
AND BillDate.COLUMN_NAME = 'Bill Date'
AND BillDate.ROW_INDEX = BillNo.ROW_INDEX

LEFT JOIN BAPPSPECTABLE_VALUE BillType
ON BillType.SERV_PROV_CODE = D.SERV_PROV_CODE
AND BillType.B1_PER_ID1 = D.B1_PER_ID1
AND BillType.B1_PER_ID2 = D.B1_PER_ID2
AND BillType.B1_PER_ID3 = D.B1_PER_ID3
AND BillType.GROUP_NAME = 'BFP_COM_INSP'
AND BillType.TABLE_NAME = 'BILLING INFORMATION'
AND BillType.COLUMN_NAME = 'Bill Type'
AND BillType.ROW_INDEX = BillNo.ROW_INDEX

LEFT JOIN BAPPSPECTABLE_VALUE BillAmount
ON BillAmount.SERV_PROV_CODE = D.SERV_PROV_CODE
AND BillAmount.B1_PER_ID1 = D.B1_PER_ID1
AND BillAmount.B1_PER_ID2 = D.B1_PER_ID2
AND BillAmount.B1_PER_ID3 = D.B1_PER_ID3
AND BillAmount.GROUP_NAME = 'BFP_COM_INSP'
AND BillAmount.TABLE_NAME = 'BILLING INFORMATION'
AND BillAmount.COLUMN_NAME = 'Bill Amount'
AND BillAmount.ROW_INDEX = BillNo.ROW_INDEX

LEFT JOIN BAPPSPECTABLE_VALUE BCN
ON BCN.SERV_PROV_CODE = D.SERV_PROV_CODE
AND BCN.B1_PER_ID1 = D.B1_PER_ID1
AND BCN.B1_PER_ID2 = D.B1_PER_ID2
AND BCN.B1_PER_ID3 = D.B1_PER_ID3
AND BCN.GROUP_NAME = 'BFP_COM_INSP'
AND BCN.TABLE_NAME = 'BILLING INFORMATION'
AND BCN.COLUMN_NAME = 'Cycle Number'
AND BCN.ROW_INDEX = BillNo.ROW_INDEX

LEFT JOIN BAPPSPECTABLE_VALUE BDI
ON BDI.SERV_PROV_CODE = D.SERV_PROV_CODE
AND BDI.B1_PER_ID1 = D.B1_PER_ID1
AND BDI.B1_PER_ID2 = D.B1_PER_ID2
AND BDI.B1_PER_ID3 = D.B1_PER_ID3
AND BDI.GROUP_NAME = 'BFP_COM_INSP'
AND BDI.TABLE_NAME = 'BILLING INFORMATION'
AND BDI.COLUMN_NAME = 'Document ID'
AND BDI.ROW_INDEX = BillNo.ROW_INDEX

WHERE D.SERV_PROV_CODE = @SERV_PROV_CODE
AND D.BillDate >= @FDate
AND D.BillDate < DATEADD(DAY,1,@FDate);

----------------------------------------------------
-- 3 RECORD DATA
----------------------------------------------------
DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #Record;
SELECT DISTINCT
B1P.SERV_PROV_CODE,
B1P.B1_PER_ID1,
B1P.B1_PER_ID2,
B1P.B1_PER_ID3,
B1P.B1_ALT_ID RECORD_ID,
B1P.B1_ALT_ID AccountNO,

RIGHT('00'+ISNULL(BCB.[D.O.],''),2) DO,

CASE
WHEN EX.EXPIRATION_DATE IS NOT NULL
THEN CONVERT(char(10),ex.EXPIRATION_DATE,101)
ELSE 'N/A'
END PermitExpirationDate,

'ON RECEIPT' PaymentDue,

PD.BALANCE PayThisAmount,

'HTTPS://FIRES.FDNYCLOUD.ORG' PayOnLine,

CONVERT(char(10),GETDATE(),101) BillingDate,
BCB.BLOCK AS AddBlock,
BCB.LOT AS LOT,
BCB.[Permit Coverage Comments] AS PermitCoverageComments,
BCB.[Floor(s)] AS PremFloor,
BCB.[Additional Address] AS PremAdditionalAddress,

	  B1P.B1_ALT_ID + ' ' + COALESCE(FORMAT(EX.EXPIRATION_DATE, 'yyMM'), '0000') + ' ' + 
      COALESCE(CASE WHEN LEN(BCB.[D.O.])<2 THEN '0'+ BCB.[D.O.] ELSE BCB.[D.O.] END,'00')+ ' ' + 
      RIGHT('0000000' + REPLACE(CONVERT(VARCHAR(30), BALANCE), '.', ''), 7) AS BillingScanLine,
	  CASE WHEN EX.EXPIRATION_DATE IS NOT NULL THEN FORMAT(EX.EXPIRATION_DATE, 'MM/yy') + '-' +FORMAT(DATEADD(YEAR, 1, EX.EXPIRATION_DATE), 'MM/yy') ELSE 'N/A' END AS BillingPeriod

INTO #Record
FROM #BillingInfo BI

JOIN B1PERMIT B1P
ON B1P.B1_ALT_ID=BI.RECORD_ID
AND B1P.SERV_PROV_CODE=BI.SERV_PROV_CODE

JOIN BPERMIT_DETAIL PD
ON PD.SERV_PROV_CODE=B1P.SERV_PROV_CODE
AND PD.B1_PER_ID1=B1P.B1_PER_ID1
AND PD.B1_PER_ID2=B1P.B1_PER_ID2
AND PD.B1_PER_ID3=B1P.B1_PER_ID3
AND PD.REC_STATUS='A'

LEFT JOIN B3ADDRES B3A
ON B3A.SERV_PROV_CODE = B1P.SERV_PROV_CODE
AND B3A.B1_PER_ID1 = B1P.B1_PER_ID1
AND B3A.B1_PER_ID2 = B1P.B1_PER_ID2
AND B3A.B1_PER_ID3 = B1P.B1_PER_ID3
AND UPPER(B1_ADDR_SOURCE_FLG)='ADR'
AND B1_PRIMARY_ADDR_FLG='Y'
AND B3A.REC_STATUS = 'A'

LEFT JOIN B1_EXPIRATION EX
ON EX.SERV_PROV_CODE=B1P.SERV_PROV_CODE
AND EX.B1_PER_ID1=B1P.B1_PER_ID1
AND EX.B1_PER_ID2=B1P.B1_PER_ID2
AND EX.B1_PER_ID3=B1P.B1_PER_ID3
AND EX.REC_STATUS='A'



OUTER APPLY (
    SELECT *
    FROM (
        SELECT 
            BCB.B1_CHECKBOX_DESC,
            BCB.B1_CHECKLIST_COMMENT
        FROM BCHCKBOX BCB
        WHERE BCB.SERV_PROV_CODE = B1P.SERV_PROV_CODE
          AND BCB.B1_PER_ID1 = B1P.B1_PER_ID1
          AND BCB.B1_PER_ID2 = B1P.B1_PER_ID2
          AND BCB.B1_PER_ID3 = B1P.B1_PER_ID3
		  AND BCB.REC_STATUS ='A'
    ) SRC
    PIVOT (
        MAX(B1_CHECKLIST_COMMENT)
        FOR B1_CHECKBOX_DESC IN ([LOT], [BLOCK], [D.O.],[Permit Coverage Comments],[Floor(s)],[Additional Address])
    ) p
) BCB
;

-- 4 RECORD ADDRESS
----------------------------------------------------
DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #RECORD_ADDRESS
SELECT B1P.SERV_PROV_CODE, B1P.RECORD_ID,

       CASE
           WHEN NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(B1P.PremFloor)),'') IS NOT NULL
                AND NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(B1P.PremAdditionalAddress)),'') IS NOT NULL
           THEN LTRIM(RTRIM(B1P.PremFloor)) + ' ' + LTRIM(RTRIM(B1P.PremAdditionalAddress)) +CHAR(10)+CHAR(13)
           WHEN NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(B1P.PremFloor)),'') IS NOT NULL
           THEN LTRIM(RTRIM(B1P.PremFloor)) +CHAR(10)+CHAR(13)
           WHEN NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(B1P.PremAdditionalAddress)),'') IS NOT NULL
           THEN LTRIM(RTRIM(B1P.PremAdditionalAddress)) +CHAR(10)+CHAR(13)
           ELSE ''
       END +
       COALESCE(CAST(B3A.B1_HSE_NBR_START AS NVARCHAR(10)),B3A.B1_HSE_NBR_ALPHA_START ,'')+' '+ COALESCE(B3A.B1_STR_NAME,'') +CHAR(10)+CHAR(13)+
       COALESCE(B3A.B1_SITUS_CITY,'') + ' ' +COALESCE(B1_SITUS_STATE,'')+' ' +
	   CASE
           WHEN CHARINDEX('-', TRY_CAST(B1_SITUS_ZIP AS NVARCHAR(50))) > 0
               THEN TRY_CAST(B1_SITUS_ZIP AS NVARCHAR(50))

           WHEN LEN(TRY_CAST(B1_SITUS_ZIP AS NVARCHAR(50))) <= 5
               THEN TRY_CAST(B1_SITUS_ZIP AS NVARCHAR(50))

           ELSE
               STUFF(TRY_CAST(B1_SITUS_ZIP AS NVARCHAR(50)), 6, 0, '-')
       END AS  PREMISES_ADDRESS,

	   B3C.B1_BUSINESS_NAME AdditionalBillingAddress,

	   COALESCE(B3C.B1_BUSINESS_NAME,'') + CHAR(10)+CHAR(13)+
	   COALESCE(CAST(BillAdd.G7_HSE_NBR_START AS NVARCHAR(10)),BillAdd.G7_HSE_NBR_ALPHA_START,'' )+' '+ COALESCE(BillAdd.G7_STR_NAME,'') +CHAR(10)+CHAR(13)+
       COALESCE(BillAdd.G7_CITY,'') + ' ' +COALESCE(BillAdd.G7_STATE,'')+' ' +
	   CASE 
           WHEN CHARINDEX('-', TRY_CAST(BillAdd.G7_ZIP AS NVARCHAR(50))) > 0 
               THEN TRY_CAST(BillAdd.G7_ZIP AS NVARCHAR(50))
               
           WHEN LEN(TRY_CAST(BillAdd.G7_ZIP AS NVARCHAR(50))) <= 5 
               THEN TRY_CAST(BillAdd.G7_ZIP AS NVARCHAR(50))
               
           ELSE 
               STUFF(TRY_CAST(BillAdd.G7_ZIP AS NVARCHAR(50)), 6, 0, '-')
       END AS BillingAddress

INTO #RECORD_ADDRESS

FROM #Record B1P
OUTER APPLY (
    SELECT TOP 1 *
	FROM B3ADDRES B3A
    WHERE B3A.SERV_PROV_CODE = B1P.SERV_PROV_CODE
    AND B3A.B1_PER_ID1 = B1P.B1_PER_ID1
    AND B3A.B1_PER_ID2 = B1P.B1_PER_ID2
    AND B3A.B1_PER_ID3 = B1P.B1_PER_ID3
	AND B3A.REC_STATUS='A'
	AND UPPER(B3A.B1_ADDR_SOURCE_FLG)='ADR'
	AND B3A.B1_PRIMARY_ADDR_FLG='Y' 

	ORDER BY B3A.REC_DATE DESC
	) B3A

OUTER APPLY (
    SELECT TOP 1 *
    FROM B3CONTACT B3C
    WHERE B3C.SERV_PROV_CODE = B1P.SERV_PROV_CODE
      AND B3C.B1_PER_ID1 = B1P.B1_PER_ID1
      AND B3C.B1_PER_ID2 = B1P.B1_PER_ID2
      AND B3C.B1_PER_ID3 = B1P.B1_PER_ID3
      AND B3C.B1_CONTACT_TYPE = 'Billing Contact'
	  AND B3C.REC_STATUS = 'A'
      --AND ISNULL(B3C.B1_FLAG,'Y') <> 'N'
    ORDER BY B3C.REC_DATE DESC
) B3C

OUTER APPLY (
    SELECT TOP 1 G7CA5.* 
	        FROM
            XRECORD_CONTACT_ENTITY XRCE5

            INNER JOIN G7CONTACT_ADDRESS G7CA5 ON 1 = 1
                AND G7CA5.SERV_PROV_CODE = XRCE5.SERV_PROV_CODE
                AND G7CA5.RES_ID = XRCE5.ENT_ID1
                AND G7CA5.G7_ENTITY_TYPE = XRCE5.ENT_TYPE
                AND G7CA5.REC_STATUS = 'A'
				AND XRCE5.REC_STATUS = 'A'
				AND G7CA5.G7_ADDRESS_TYPE = 'Billing Address'

			WHERE 1 = 1
            AND XRCE5.SERV_PROV_CODE = B3C.SERV_PROV_CODE
            AND XRCE5.B1_PER_ID1 = B3C.B1_PER_ID1
            AND XRCE5.B1_PER_ID2 = B3C.B1_PER_ID2
            AND XRCE5.B1_PER_ID3 = B3C.B1_PER_ID3
            AND XRCE5.B1_CONTACT_NBR = B3C.B1_CONTACT_NBR
            AND XRCE5.ENT_TYPE = 
                                 CASE
                                     WHEN NULLIF(B3C.G1_CONTACT_NBR,'') IS NULL
                                     THEN 'CAP_CONTACT'
                                     ELSE 'CONTACT'
                                 END
			ORDER BY XRCE5.REC_DATE ASC
        ) BillAdd
WHERE  B1P.SERV_PROV_CODE  = @SERV_PROV_CODE;

-- 5 FEE INFO
----------------------------------------------------
DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #FeeInfo;
SELECT
BILL.RECORD_ID,BILL.B1_PER_ID1,BILL.B1_PER_ID2,BILL.B1_PER_ID3,BILL.SERV_PROV_CODE,
F.GF_COD,
F.GF_L3,
LEFT(F.GF_L3,3) ItemCode,
RIGHT(F.GF_L3,2) SUBCODE,
F.GF_DES ITEMDESCRIPTION,
F.GF_FEE,
F.GF_ITEM_STATUS_FLAG,
INV.INVOICE_CUSTOMIZED_NBR,
INV.INVOICE_NBR,
INV.BALANCE_DUE InvoiceBalance,
FEE_NOTES 
INTO #FeeInfo
FROM #BillingInfo BILL

JOIN F4FEEITEM F
ON F.SERV_PROV_CODE=BILL.SERV_PROV_CODE
AND F.B1_PER_ID1=BILL.B1_PER_ID1
AND F.B1_PER_ID2=BILL.B1_PER_ID2
AND F.B1_PER_ID3=BILL.B1_PER_ID3
AND F.GF_ITEM_STATUS_FLAG='INVOICED'

JOIN X4FEEITEM_INVOICE X
ON X.SERV_PROV_CODE=F.SERV_PROV_CODE
AND X.FEEITEM_SEQ_NBR=F.FEEITEM_SEQ_NBR

JOIN F4INVOICE INV
ON INV.SERV_PROV_CODE=X.SERV_PROV_CODE
AND INV.INVOICE_NBR=X.INVOICE_NBR
AND INV.INVOICE_CUSTOMIZED_NBR =  BillNumber

WHERE F.FEE_NOTES IS NOT NULL
AND INV.INVOICE_NBR NOT IN (SELECT INVOICE_NBR FROM X4PAYMENT_INVOICE WHERE SERV_PROV_CODE =@SERV_PROV_CODE)
;
----------------------------------------------------
-- 6 FEE PENALTY
----------------------------------------------------
DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #Penalty;
SELECT
BILL.RECORD_ID,BILL.B1_PER_ID1,BILL.B1_PER_ID2,BILL.B1_PER_ID3,BILL.SERV_PROV_CODE,
SUM(INV.BALANCE_DUE) InvoiceBalance
INTO #Penalty
FROM #BillingInfo BILL

JOIN F4FEEITEM F
ON F.SERV_PROV_CODE=BILL.SERV_PROV_CODE
AND F.B1_PER_ID1=BILL.B1_PER_ID1
AND F.B1_PER_ID2=BILL.B1_PER_ID2
AND F.B1_PER_ID3=BILL.B1_PER_ID3
AND F.GF_ITEM_STATUS_FLAG='INVOICED'

JOIN X4FEEITEM_INVOICE X
ON X.SERV_PROV_CODE=F.SERV_PROV_CODE
AND X.FEEITEM_SEQ_NBR=F.FEEITEM_SEQ_NBR

JOIN F4INVOICE INV
ON INV.SERV_PROV_CODE=X.SERV_PROV_CODE
AND INV.INVOICE_NBR=X.INVOICE_NBR
WHERE F.FEE_NOTES = BILL.InspectionNum
AND GF_COD LIKE '%PENALTY%'
AND INV.INVOICE_NBR NOT IN (SELECT INVOICE_NBR FROM X4PAYMENT_INVOICE WHERE SERV_PROV_CODE =@SERV_PROV_CODE)
GROUP BY BILL.RECORD_ID,BILL.B1_PER_ID1,BILL.B1_PER_ID2,BILL.B1_PER_ID3,BILL.SERV_PROV_CODE
;

-- 7 COVERAGE
----------------------------------------------------
DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #Coverage;
SELECT
F.SERV_PROV_CODE,
F.RECORD_ID,
COV.ROW_INDEX,
COV.ATTRIBUTE_VALUE CoverageItem,
Q.ATTRIBUTE_VALUE Quantity,
D.ATTRIBUTE_VALUE Details,
I.ATTRIBUTE_VALUE InspectionType,
S.ATTRIBUTE_VALUE CovStatus
INTO #Coverage
FROM #FeeInfo F

JOIN BAPPSPECTABLE_VALUE COV
ON COV.SERV_PROV_CODE=F.SERV_PROV_CODE
AND COV.B1_PER_ID1=F.B1_PER_ID1
AND COV.B1_PER_ID2=F.B1_PER_ID2
AND COV.B1_PER_ID3=F.B1_PER_ID3
AND COV.GROUP_NAME='BFP_COM_INSP'
AND COV.TABLE_NAME='COVERAGE INFORMATION'
AND COV.COLUMN_NAME='Coverage Item'
AND COV.ATTRIBUTE_VALUE=F.ItemDescription

LEFT JOIN BAPPSPECTABLE_VALUE Q
ON Q.SERV_PROV_CODE=COV.SERV_PROV_CODE
AND Q.B1_PER_ID1=COV.B1_PER_ID1
AND Q.B1_PER_ID2=COV.B1_PER_ID2
AND Q.B1_PER_ID3=COV.B1_PER_ID3
AND Q.ROW_INDEX=COV.ROW_INDEX
AND Q.GROUP_NAME='BFP_COM_INSP'
AND Q.TABLE_NAME='COVERAGE INFORMATION'
AND Q.COLUMN_NAME='Quantity'

LEFT JOIN BAPPSPECTABLE_VALUE D
ON D.SERV_PROV_CODE=COV.SERV_PROV_CODE
AND D.B1_PER_ID1=COV.B1_PER_ID1
AND D.B1_PER_ID2=COV.B1_PER_ID2
AND D.B1_PER_ID3=COV.B1_PER_ID3
AND D.ROW_INDEX=COV.ROW_INDEX
AND D.GROUP_NAME='BFP_COM_INSP'
AND D.TABLE_NAME='COVERAGE INFORMATION'
AND D.COLUMN_NAME='Details'

LEFT JOIN BAPPSPECTABLE_VALUE I
ON I.SERV_PROV_CODE=COV.SERV_PROV_CODE
AND I.B1_PER_ID1=COV.B1_PER_ID1
AND I.B1_PER_ID2=COV.B1_PER_ID2
AND I.B1_PER_ID3=COV.B1_PER_ID3
AND I.ROW_INDEX=COV.ROW_INDEX
AND I.GROUP_NAME='BFP_COM_INSP'
AND I.TABLE_NAME='COVERAGE INFORMATION'
AND I.COLUMN_NAME='Inspection Type'

LEFT JOIN BAPPSPECTABLE_VALUE S
ON S.SERV_PROV_CODE=COV.SERV_PROV_CODE
AND S.B1_PER_ID1=COV.B1_PER_ID1
AND S.B1_PER_ID2=COV.B1_PER_ID2
AND S.B1_PER_ID3=COV.B1_PER_ID3
AND S.ROW_INDEX=COV.ROW_INDEX
AND S.GROUP_NAME='BFP_COM_INSP'
AND S.TABLE_NAME='COVERAGE INFORMATION'
AND S.COLUMN_NAME='STATUS'

WHERE S.ATTRIBUTE_VALUE = 'Active';

			WHEN B.AccountNo NOT IN (10,15,20,25) AND B.BillType ='SECOND REMINDER' THEN 'LIEN PROCEEDINGS HAVE BEGUN IN ACCORDANCE'+CHAR(10)+CHAR(13)+
                                                                          'WITH 29 NYC ADMIN CODE SEC FC117.4.'+CHAR(10)+CHAR(13)+
                                                                          'TO STOP THIS LEGAL ACTION- PAY IMMEDIATELY'
	   ELSE '' END MSG2,

	   CASE WHEN B.AccountNo IN (10,15,20,25) THEN  'OPERATION WITHOUT'+CHAR(10)+CHAR(13)+
                                                    'PERMIT IS ILLEGAL'
	   END MSG1,
	   CASE WHEN F.GF_ITEM_STATUS_FLAG = 'INVOICED' AND F.InvoiceBalance > 0 AND F.ItemDescription NOT LIKE '%Penalty%'THEN 1 ELSE 2 END OrderFlag
	   
FROM  #Record R

LEFT JOIN #RECORD_ADDRESS RA
ON  RA.SERV_PROV_CODE = R.SERV_PROV_CODE
AND RA.RECORD_ID = R.RECORD_ID

LEFT JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT  * FROM #BillingInfo) B
ON  B.SERV_PROV_CODE = R.SERV_PROV_CODE
AND B.RECORD_ID = R.RECORD_ID

INNER JOIN #FeeInfo F
ON F.SERV_PROV_CODE = B.SERV_PROV_CODE
AND F.RECORD_ID = B.RECORD_ID
AND F.FEE_NOTES = B.InspectionNum

LEFT JOIN #Penalty Pen
ON Pen.SERV_PROV_CODE = B.SERV_PROV_CODE
AND Pen.RECORD_ID = B.RECORD_ID

LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT DISTINCT *
    FROM #Coverage
) C
ON C.SERV_PROV_CODE = F.SERV_PROV_CODE
AND C.RECORD_ID = F.RECORD_ID
AND C.CoverageItem = F.ITEMDESCRIPTION

WHERE R.SERV_PROV_CODE = @SERV_PROV_CODE
--AND R.RECORD_ID  ='03110798'

ORDER BY B.DocumentID



DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #Coverage;
DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #FeeInfo;
DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #Record;
DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #RECORD_ADDRESS;
DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #BillingInfo;
DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #BillDate;

SET NOCOUNT ON;

DECLARE @SERV_PROV_CODE NVARCHAR(50)='FDNY';
DECLARE @FDate DATE='2026-08-13';
DECLARE @TDate DATE='2026-08-13';

----------------------------------------------------
-- 1 BILL DATE FILTER 
----------------------------------------------------
DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #BillDate;
SELECT
B1P.SERV_PROV_CODE,
B1P.B1_PER_ID1,
B1P.B1_PER_ID2,
B1P.B1_PER_ID3,
B1P.B1_ALT_ID Record_ID,
BD.ROW_INDEX,
TRY_CONVERT(date,BD.ATTRIBUTE_VALUE,101) BillDate
INTO #BillDate
FROM B1PERMIT B1P

INNER JOIN BAPPSPECTABLE_VALUE BD
ON BD.SERV_PROV_CODE = B1P.SERV_PROV_CODE
AND BD.B1_PER_ID1 = B1P.B1_PER_ID1
AND BD.B1_PER_ID2 = B1P.B1_PER_ID2
AND BD.B1_PER_ID3 = B1P.B1_PER_ID3
WHERE B1P.SERV_PROV_CODE= @SERV_PROV_CODE
AND GROUP_NAME='BFP_COM_INSP'
AND TABLE_NAME='BILLING INFORMATION'
AND COLUMN_NAME='Bill Date'
AND TRY_CONVERT(date,ATTRIBUTE_VALUE,101) >= @FDate
AND TRY_CONVERT(date,ATTRIBUTE_VALUE,101) < DATEADD(DAY,1,@TDate)
--AND B1P.B1_ALT_ID ='99052235'

----------------------------------------------------
-- 2 BILLING INFO 
----------------------------------------------------
DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #BillingInfo;
SELECT
D.SERV_PROV_CODE,
D.Record_ID RECORD_ID,
D.B1_PER_ID1,
D.B1_PER_ID2,
D.B1_PER_ID3,
FORMAT(D.BillDate,'MM/dd/yy') BillDate,
D.ROW_INDEX,
BillNo.ATTRIBUTE_VALUE AS BillNumber,
UPPER(BillType.ATTRIBUTE_VALUE) BillType,
BillAmount.ATTRIBUTE_VALUE BillAmount ,
LEFT(BCN.ATTRIBUTE_VALUE, CHARINDEX('-', BCN.ATTRIBUTE_VALUE) - 1) InspectionNum,
SUBSTRING(BCN.ATTRIBUTE_VALUE, CHARINDEX('-', BCN.ATTRIBUTE_VALUE) + 1, LEN(BCN.ATTRIBUTE_VALUE)) AccountNo,
BDI.ATTRIBUTE_VALUE DocumentID

INTO #BillingInfo

FROM #BillDate D

INNER JOIN BAPPSPECTABLE_VALUE BillNo
ON BillNo.SERV_PROV_CODE = D.SERV_PROV_CODE
AND BillNo.B1_PER_ID1 = D.B1_PER_ID1
AND BillNo.B1_PER_ID2 = D.B1_PER_ID2
AND BillNo.B1_PER_ID3 = D.B1_PER_ID3
AND BillNo.GROUP_NAME = 'BFP_COM_INSP'
AND BillNo.TABLE_NAME = 'BILLING INFORMATION'
AND BillNo.COLUMN_NAME = 'Bill Number'
AND BillNo.ROW_INDEX = D.ROW_INDEX

LEFT JOIN BAPPSPECTABLE_VALUE BillDate
ON BillDate.SERV_PROV_CODE = D.SERV_PROV_CODE
AND BillDate.B1_PER_ID1 = D.B1_PER_ID1
AND BillDate.B1_PER_ID2 = D.B1_PER_ID2
AND BillDate.B1_PER_ID3 = D.B1_PER_ID3
AND BillDate.GROUP_NAME = 'BFP_COM_INSP'
AND BillDate.TABLE_NAME = 'BILLING INFORMATION'
AND BillDate.COLUMN_NAME = 'Bill Date'
AND BillDate.ROW_INDEX = BillNo.ROW_INDEX

LEFT JOIN BAPPSPECTABLE_VALUE BillType
ON BillType.SERV_PROV_CODE = D.SERV_PROV_CODE
AND BillType.B1_PER_ID1 = D.B1_PER_ID1
AND BillType.B1_PER_ID2 = D.B1_PER_ID2
AND BillType.B1_PER_ID3 = D.B1_PER_ID3
AND BillType.GROUP_NAME = 'BFP_COM_INSP'
AND BillType.TABLE_NAME = 'BILLING INFORMATION'
AND BillType.COLUMN_NAME = 'Bill Type'
AND BillType.ROW_INDEX = BillNo.ROW_INDEX

LEFT JOIN BAPPSPECTABLE_VALUE BillAmount
ON BillAmount.SERV_PROV_CODE = D.SERV_PROV_CODE
AND BillAmount.B1_PER_ID1 = D.B1_PER_ID1
AND BillAmount.B1_PER_ID2 = D.B1_PER_ID2
AND BillAmount.B1_PER_ID3 = D.B1_PER_ID3
AND BillAmount.GROUP_NAME = 'BFP_COM_INSP'
AND BillAmount.TABLE_NAME = 'BILLING INFORMATION'
AND BillAmount.COLUMN_NAME = 'Bill Amount'
AND BillAmount.ROW_INDEX = BillNo.ROW_INDEX

LEFT JOIN BAPPSPECTABLE_VALUE BCN
ON BCN.SERV_PROV_CODE = D.SERV_PROV_CODE
AND BCN.B1_PER_ID1 = D.B1_PER_ID1
AND BCN.B1_PER_ID2 = D.B1_PER_ID2
AND BCN.B1_PER_ID3 = D.B1_PER_ID3
AND BCN.GROUP_NAME = 'BFP_COM_INSP'
AND BCN.TABLE_NAME = 'BILLING INFORMATION'
AND BCN.COLUMN_NAME = 'Cycle Number'
AND BCN.ROW_INDEX = BillNo.ROW_INDEX

LEFT JOIN BAPPSPECTABLE_VALUE BDI
ON BDI.SERV_PROV_CODE = D.SERV_PROV_CODE
AND BDI.B1_PER_ID1 = D.B1_PER_ID1
AND BDI.B1_PER_ID2 = D.B1_PER_ID2
AND BDI.B1_PER_ID3 = D.B1_PER_ID3
AND BDI.GROUP_NAME = 'BFP_COM_INSP'
AND BDI.TABLE_NAME = 'BILLING INFORMATION'
AND BDI.COLUMN_NAME = 'Document ID'
AND BDI.ROW_INDEX = BillNo.ROW_INDEX

WHERE D.SERV_PROV_CODE = @SERV_PROV_CODE
AND D.BillDate >= @FDate
AND D.BillDate < DATEADD(DAY,1,@FDate);

----------------------------------------------------
-- 3 RECORD DATA
----------------------------------------------------
DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #Record;
SELECT DISTINCT
B1P.SERV_PROV_CODE,
B1P.B1_PER_ID1,
B1P.B1_PER_ID2,
B1P.B1_PER_ID3,
B1P.B1_ALT_ID RECORD_ID,
B1P.B1_ALT_ID AccountNO,

RIGHT('00'+ISNULL(BCB.[D.O.],''),2) DO,

CASE
WHEN EX.EXPIRATION_DATE IS NOT NULL
THEN CONVERT(char(10),ex.EXPIRATION_DATE,101)
ELSE 'N/A'
END PermitExpirationDate,

'ON RECEIPT' PaymentDue,

PD.BALANCE PayThisAmount,

'HTTPS://FIRES.FDNYCLOUD.ORG' PayOnLine,

CONVERT(char(10),GETDATE(),101) BillingDate,
BCB.BLOCK AS AddBlock,
BCB.LOT AS LOT,
BCB.[Permit Coverage Comments] AS PermitCoverageComments,
BCB.[Floor(s)] AS PremFloor,
BCB.[Additional Address] AS PremAdditionalAddress,

	  B1P.B1_ALT_ID + ' ' + COALESCE(FORMAT(EX.EXPIRATION_DATE, 'yyMM'), '0000') + ' ' + 
      COALESCE(CASE WHEN LEN(BCB.[D.O.])<2 THEN '0'+ BCB.[D.O.] ELSE BCB.[D.O.] END,'00')+ ' ' + 
      RIGHT('0000000' + REPLACE(CONVERT(VARCHAR(30), BALANCE), '.', ''), 7) AS BillingScanLine,
	  CASE WHEN EX.EXPIRATION_DATE IS NOT NULL THEN FORMAT(EX.EXPIRATION_DATE, 'MM/yy') + '-' +FORMAT(DATEADD(YEAR, 1, EX.EXPIRATION_DATE), 'MM/yy') ELSE 'N/A' END AS BillingPeriod

INTO #Record
FROM #BillingInfo BI

JOIN B1PERMIT B1P
ON B1P.B1_ALT_ID=BI.RECORD_ID
AND B1P.SERV_PROV_CODE=BI.SERV_PROV_CODE

JOIN BPERMIT_DETAIL PD
ON PD.SERV_PROV_CODE=B1P.SERV_PROV_CODE
AND PD.B1_PER_ID1=B1P.B1_PER_ID1
AND PD.B1_PER_ID2=B1P.B1_PER_ID2
AND PD.B1_PER_ID3=B1P.B1_PER_ID3
AND PD.REC_STATUS='A'

LEFT JOIN B3ADDRES B3A
ON B3A.SERV_PROV_CODE = B1P.SERV_PROV_CODE
AND B3A.B1_PER_ID1 = B1P.B1_PER_ID1
AND B3A.B1_PER_ID2 = B1P.B1_PER_ID2
AND B3A.B1_PER_ID3 = B1P.B1_PER_ID3
AND UPPER(B1_ADDR_SOURCE_FLG)='ADR'
AND B1_PRIMARY_ADDR_FLG='Y'
AND B3A.REC_STATUS = 'A'

LEFT JOIN B1_EXPIRATION EX
ON EX.SERV_PROV_CODE=B1P.SERV_PROV_CODE
AND EX.B1_PER_ID1=B1P.B1_PER_ID1
AND EX.B1_PER_ID2=B1P.B1_PER_ID2
AND EX.B1_PER_ID3=B1P.B1_PER_ID3
AND EX.REC_STATUS='A'



OUTER APPLY (
    SELECT *
    FROM (
        SELECT 
            BCB.B1_CHECKBOX_DESC,
            BCB.B1_CHECKLIST_COMMENT
        FROM BCHCKBOX BCB
        WHERE BCB.SERV_PROV_CODE = B1P.SERV_PROV_CODE
          AND BCB.B1_PER_ID1 = B1P.B1_PER_ID1
          AND BCB.B1_PER_ID2 = B1P.B1_PER_ID2
          AND BCB.B1_PER_ID3 = B1P.B1_PER_ID3
		  AND BCB.REC_STATUS ='A'
    ) SRC
    PIVOT (
        MAX(B1_CHECKLIST_COMMENT)
        FOR B1_CHECKBOX_DESC IN ([LOT], [BLOCK], [D.O.],[Permit Coverage Comments],[Floor(s)],[Additional Address])
    ) p
) BCB
;

----------------------------------------------------
-- 4 RECORD ADDRESS
----------------------------------------------------
DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #RECORD_ADDRESS
SELECT B1P.SERV_PROV_CODE, B1P.RECORD_ID,

       CASE
           WHEN NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(B1P.PremFloor)),'') IS NOT NULL
                AND NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(B1P.PremAdditionalAddress)),'') IS NOT NULL
           THEN LTRIM(RTRIM(B1P.PremFloor)) + ' ' + LTRIM(RTRIM(B1P.PremAdditionalAddress)) +CHAR(10)+CHAR(13)
           WHEN NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(B1P.PremFloor)),'') IS NOT NULL
           THEN LTRIM(RTRIM(B1P.PremFloor)) +CHAR(10)+CHAR(13)
           WHEN NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(B1P.PremAdditionalAddress)),'') IS NOT NULL
           THEN LTRIM(RTRIM(B1P.PremAdditionalAddress)) +CHAR(10)+CHAR(13)
           ELSE ''
       END +
       COALESCE(CAST(B3A.B1_HSE_NBR_START AS NVARCHAR(10)),B3A.B1_HSE_NBR_ALPHA_START ,'')+' '+ COALESCE(B3A.B1_STR_NAME,'') +CHAR(10)+CHAR(13)+
       COALESCE(B3A.B1_SITUS_CITY,'') + ' ' +COALESCE(B1_SITUS_STATE,'')+' ' +
	   CASE
           WHEN CHARINDEX('-', TRY_CAST(B1_SITUS_ZIP AS NVARCHAR(50))) > 0
               THEN TRY_CAST(B1_SITUS_ZIP AS NVARCHAR(50))

           WHEN LEN(TRY_CAST(B1_SITUS_ZIP AS NVARCHAR(50))) <= 5
               THEN TRY_CAST(B1_SITUS_ZIP AS NVARCHAR(50))

           ELSE
               STUFF(TRY_CAST(B1_SITUS_ZIP AS NVARCHAR(50)), 6, 0, '-')
       END AS  PREMISES_ADDRESS,

	   B3C.B1_BUSINESS_NAME AdditionalBillingAddress,

	   COALESCE(B3C.B1_BUSINESS_NAME,'') + CHAR(10)+CHAR(13)+
	   COALESCE(CAST(BillAdd.G7_HSE_NBR_START AS NVARCHAR(10)),BillAdd.G7_HSE_NBR_ALPHA_START,'' )+' '+ COALESCE(BillAdd.G7_STR_NAME,'') +CHAR(10)+CHAR(13)+
       COALESCE(BillAdd.G7_CITY,'') + ' ' +COALESCE(BillAdd.G7_STATE,'')+' ' +
	   CASE 
           WHEN CHARINDEX('-', TRY_CAST(BillAdd.G7_ZIP AS NVARCHAR(50))) > 0 
               THEN TRY_CAST(BillAdd.G7_ZIP AS NVARCHAR(50))
               
           WHEN LEN(TRY_CAST(BillAdd.G7_ZIP AS NVARCHAR(50))) <= 5 
               THEN TRY_CAST(BillAdd.G7_ZIP AS NVARCHAR(50))
               
           ELSE 
               STUFF(TRY_CAST(BillAdd.G7_ZIP AS NVARCHAR(50)), 6, 0, '-')
       END AS BillingAddress

INTO #RECORD_ADDRESS

FROM #Record B1P
OUTER APPLY (
    SELECT TOP 1 *
	FROM B3ADDRES B3A
    WHERE B3A.SERV_PROV_CODE = B1P.SERV_PROV_CODE
    AND B3A.B1_PER_ID1 = B1P.B1_PER_ID1
    AND B3A.B1_PER_ID2 = B1P.B1_PER_ID2
    AND B3A.B1_PER_ID3 = B1P.B1_PER_ID3
	AND B3A.REC_STATUS='A'
	AND UPPER(B3A.B1_ADDR_SOURCE_FLG)='ADR'
	AND B3A.B1_PRIMARY_ADDR_FLG='Y' 

	ORDER BY B3A.REC_DATE DESC
	) B3A

OUTER APPLY (
    SELECT TOP 1 *
    FROM B3CONTACT B3C
    WHERE B3C.SERV_PROV_CODE = B1P.SERV_PROV_CODE
      AND B3C.B1_PER_ID1 = B1P.B1_PER_ID1
      AND B3C.B1_PER_ID2 = B1P.B1_PER_ID2
      AND B3C.B1_PER_ID3 = B1P.B1_PER_ID3
      AND B3C.B1_CONTACT_TYPE = 'Billing Contact'
	  AND B3C.REC_STATUS = 'A'
      --AND ISNULL(B3C.B1_FLAG,'Y') <> 'N'
    ORDER BY B3C.REC_DATE DESC
) B3C

OUTER APPLY (
    SELECT TOP 1 G7CA5.* 
	        FROM
            XRECORD_CONTACT_ENTITY XRCE5

            INNER JOIN G7CONTACT_ADDRESS G7CA5 ON 1 = 1
                AND G7CA5.SERV_PROV_CODE = XRCE5.SERV_PROV_CODE
                AND G7CA5.RES_ID = XRCE5.ENT_ID1
                AND G7CA5.G7_ENTITY_TYPE = XRCE5.ENT_TYPE
                AND G7CA5.REC_STATUS = 'A'
				AND XRCE5.REC_STATUS = 'A'
				AND G7CA5.G7_ADDRESS_TYPE = 'Billing Address'

			WHERE 1 = 1
            AND XRCE5.SERV_PROV_CODE = B3C.SERV_PROV_CODE
            AND XRCE5.B1_PER_ID1 = B3C.B1_PER_ID1
            AND XRCE5.B1_PER_ID2 = B3C.B1_PER_ID2
            AND XRCE5.B1_PER_ID3 = B3C.B1_PER_ID3
            AND XRCE5.B1_CONTACT_NBR = B3C.B1_CONTACT_NBR
            AND XRCE5.ENT_TYPE = 
                                 CASE
                                     WHEN NULLIF(B3C.G1_CONTACT_NBR,'') IS NULL
                                     THEN 'CAP_CONTACT'
                                     ELSE 'CONTACT'
                                 END
			ORDER BY XRCE5.REC_DATE ASC
        ) BillAdd
WHERE  B1P.SERV_PROV_CODE  = @SERV_PROV_CODE;
		
----------------------------------------------------
-- 5 FEE INFO
----------------------------------------------------
DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #FeeInfo;
SELECT
BILL.RECORD_ID,BILL.B1_PER_ID1,BILL.B1_PER_ID2,BILL.B1_PER_ID3,BILL.SERV_PROV_CODE,
F.GF_COD,
F.GF_L3,
LEFT(F.GF_L3,3) ItemCode,
RIGHT(F.GF_L3,2) SUBCODE,
F.GF_DES ITEMDESCRIPTION,
F.GF_FEE,
F.GF_ITEM_STATUS_FLAG,
INV.INVOICE_CUSTOMIZED_NBR,
INV.INVOICE_NBR,
INV.BALANCE_DUE InvoiceBalance,
FEE_NOTES 
INTO #FeeInfo
FROM #BillingInfo BILL

JOIN F4FEEITEM F
ON F.SERV_PROV_CODE=BILL.SERV_PROV_CODE
AND F.B1_PER_ID1=BILL.B1_PER_ID1
AND F.B1_PER_ID2=BILL.B1_PER_ID2
AND F.B1_PER_ID3=BILL.B1_PER_ID3
AND F.GF_ITEM_STATUS_FLAG='INVOICED'

JOIN X4FEEITEM_INVOICE X
ON X.SERV_PROV_CODE=F.SERV_PROV_CODE
AND X.FEEITEM_SEQ_NBR=F.FEEITEM_SEQ_NBR

JOIN F4INVOICE INV
ON INV.SERV_PROV_CODE=X.SERV_PROV_CODE
AND INV.INVOICE_NBR=X.INVOICE_NBR
AND INV.INVOICE_CUSTOMIZED_NBR =  BillNumber

WHERE F.FEE_NOTES IS NOT NULL
AND INV.INVOICE_NBR NOT IN (SELECT INVOICE_NBR FROM X4PAYMENT_INVOICE WHERE SERV_PROV_CODE =@SERV_PROV_CODE)
;
----------------------------------------------------
-- 6 FEE PENALTY
----------------------------------------------------
DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #Penalty;
SELECT
BILL.RECORD_ID,BILL.B1_PER_ID1,BILL.B1_PER_ID2,BILL.B1_PER_ID3,BILL.SERV_PROV_CODE,
SUM(INV.BALANCE_DUE) InvoiceBalance
INTO #Penalty
FROM #BillingInfo BILL

JOIN F4FEEITEM F
ON F.SERV_PROV_CODE=BILL.SERV_PROV_CODE
AND F.B1_PER_ID1=BILL.B1_PER_ID1
AND F.B1_PER_ID2=BILL.B1_PER_ID2
AND F.B1_PER_ID3=BILL.B1_PER_ID3
AND F.GF_ITEM_STATUS_FLAG='INVOICED'

JOIN X4FEEITEM_INVOICE X
ON X.SERV_PROV_CODE=F.SERV_PROV_CODE
AND X.FEEITEM_SEQ_NBR=F.FEEITEM_SEQ_NBR

JOIN F4INVOICE INV
ON INV.SERV_PROV_CODE=X.SERV_PROV_CODE
AND INV.INVOICE_NBR=X.INVOICE_NBR
WHERE F.FEE_NOTES = BILL.InspectionNum
AND GF_COD LIKE '%PENALTY%'
AND INV.INVOICE_NBR NOT IN (SELECT INVOICE_NBR FROM X4PAYMENT_INVOICE WHERE SERV_PROV_CODE =@SERV_PROV_CODE)
GROUP BY BILL.RECORD_ID,BILL.B1_PER_ID1,BILL.B1_PER_ID2,BILL.B1_PER_ID3,BILL.SERV_PROV_CODE
;
----------------------------------------------------
-- 7 COVERAGE
----------------------------------------------------
DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #Coverage;
SELECT
F.SERV_PROV_CODE,
F.RECORD_ID,
COV.ROW_INDEX,
COV.ATTRIBUTE_VALUE CoverageItem,
Q.ATTRIBUTE_VALUE Quantity,
D.ATTRIBUTE_VALUE Details,
I.ATTRIBUTE_VALUE InspectionType,
S.ATTRIBUTE_VALUE CovStatus
INTO #Coverage
FROM #FeeInfo F

JOIN BAPPSPECTABLE_VALUE COV
ON COV.SERV_PROV_CODE=F.SERV_PROV_CODE
AND COV.B1_PER_ID1=F.B1_PER_ID1
AND COV.B1_PER_ID2=F.B1_PER_ID2
AND COV.B1_PER_ID3=F.B1_PER_ID3
AND COV.GROUP_NAME='BFP_COM_INSP'
AND COV.TABLE_NAME='COVERAGE INFORMATION'
AND COV.COLUMN_NAME='Coverage Item'
AND COV.ATTRIBUTE_VALUE=F.ItemDescription

LEFT JOIN BAPPSPECTABLE_VALUE Q
ON Q.SERV_PROV_CODE=COV.SERV_PROV_CODE
AND Q.B1_PER_ID1=COV.B1_PER_ID1
AND Q.B1_PER_ID2=COV.B1_PER_ID2
AND Q.B1_PER_ID3=COV.B1_PER_ID3
AND Q.ROW_INDEX=COV.ROW_INDEX
AND Q.GROUP_NAME='BFP_COM_INSP'
AND Q.TABLE_NAME='COVERAGE INFORMATION'
AND Q.COLUMN_NAME='Quantity'

LEFT JOIN BAPPSPECTABLE_VALUE D
ON D.SERV_PROV_CODE=COV.SERV_PROV_CODE
AND D.B1_PER_ID1=COV.B1_PER_ID1
AND D.B1_PER_ID2=COV.B1_PER_ID2
AND D.B1_PER_ID3=COV.B1_PER_ID3
AND D.ROW_INDEX=COV.ROW_INDEX
AND D.GROUP_NAME='BFP_COM_INSP'
AND D.TABLE_NAME='COVERAGE INFORMATION'
AND D.COLUMN_NAME='Details'

LEFT JOIN BAPPSPECTABLE_VALUE I
ON I.SERV_PROV_CODE=COV.SERV_PROV_CODE
AND I.B1_PER_ID1=COV.B1_PER_ID1
AND I.B1_PER_ID2=COV.B1_PER_ID2
AND I.B1_PER_ID3=COV.B1_PER_ID3
AND I.ROW_INDEX=COV.ROW_INDEX
AND I.GROUP_NAME='BFP_COM_INSP'
AND I.TABLE_NAME='COVERAGE INFORMATION'
AND I.COLUMN_NAME='Inspection Type'

LEFT JOIN BAPPSPECTABLE_VALUE S
ON S.SERV_PROV_CODE=COV.SERV_PROV_CODE
AND S.B1_PER_ID1=COV.B1_PER_ID1
AND S.B1_PER_ID2=COV.B1_PER_ID2
AND S.B1_PER_ID3=COV.B1_PER_ID3
AND S.ROW_INDEX=COV.ROW_INDEX
AND S.GROUP_NAME='BFP_COM_INSP'
AND S.TABLE_NAME='COVERAGE INFORMATION'
AND S.COLUMN_NAME='STATUS'

WHERE S.ATTRIBUTE_VALUE = 'Active';

	   B.BillNumber,B.BillType,	B.BillDate,B.BillDate AS BillingDate,B.BillAmount, B.InspectionNum, B.AccountNo,B.DocumentID,
	   Pen.InvoiceBalance TotalPenalty ,
       CASE WHEN B.AccountNo IN (10,15,20,25) THEN '*LATE PAYMENTS WILL INCUR PENALTIES*' 
	        WHEN B.AccountNo NOT IN (10,15,20,25) AND B.BillType ='FIRST REMINDER' THEN 'FAILURE TO PAY IMMEDIATELY WILL RESULT'+CHAR(10)+CHAR(13)+
                                                                                        'IN LIEN PROCEEDINGS PURSUANT'+CHAR(10)+CHAR(13)+
                                                                                        'TO 29 NYC ADMIN CODE SEC. FC117.4'
			WHEN B.AccountNo NOT IN (10,15,20,25) AND B.BillType ='SECOND REMINDER' THEN 'LIEN PROCEEDINGS HAVE BEGUN IN ACCORDANCE'+CHAR(10)+CHAR(13)+
                                                                          'WITH 29 NYC ADMIN CODE SEC FC117.4.'+CHAR(10)+CHAR(13)+
                                                                          'TO STOP THIS LEGAL ACTION- PAY IMMEDIATELY'
	   ELSE '' END MSG2,

	   CASE WHEN B.AccountNo IN (10,15,20,25) THEN  'OPERATION WITHOUT'+CHAR(10)+CHAR(13)+
                                                    'PERMIT IS ILLEGAL'
	   END MSG1,
	   CASE WHEN F.GF_ITEM_STATUS_FLAG = 'INVOICED' AND F.InvoiceBalance > 0 AND F.ItemDescription NOT LIKE '%Penalty%'THEN 1 ELSE 2 END OrderFlag
	   
FROM  #Record R

LEFT JOIN #RECORD_ADDRESS RA
ON  RA.SERV_PROV_CODE = R.SERV_PROV_CODE
AND RA.RECORD_ID = R.RECORD_ID

LEFT JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT  * FROM #BillingInfo) B
ON  B.SERV_PROV_CODE = R.SERV_PROV_CODE
AND B.RECORD_ID = R.RECORD_ID

INNER JOIN #FeeInfo F
ON F.SERV_PROV_CODE = B.SERV_PROV_CODE
AND F.RECORD_ID = B.RECORD_ID
AND F.FEE_NOTES = B.InspectionNum

LEFT JOIN #Penalty Pen
ON Pen.SERV_PROV_CODE = B.SERV_PROV_CODE
AND Pen.RECORD_ID = B.RECORD_ID

LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT DISTINCT *
    FROM #Coverage
) C
ON C.SERV_PROV_CODE = F.SERV_PROV_CODE
AND C.RECORD_ID = F.RECORD_ID
AND C.CoverageItem = F.ITEMDESCRIPTION

WHERE R.SERV_PROV_CODE = @SERV_PROV_CODE
--AND R.RECORD_ID  ='03110798'

--ORDER BY B.DocumentID
)

select * from results_data order by documentID;



DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #Coverage;
DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #FeeInfo;
DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #Record;
DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #RECORD_ADDRESS;
DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #BillingInfo;
DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #BillDate;

SET NOCOUNT ON;

DECLARE @SERV_PROV_CODE NVARCHAR(50)='FDNY';
DECLARE @FDate DATE='2026-09-17';
DECLARE @TDate DATE='2026-09-17';

----------------------------------------------------
-- 1 BILL DATE FILTER 
----------------------------------------------------
DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #BillDate;
SELECT
B1P.SERV_PROV_CODE,
B1P.B1_PER_ID1,
B1P.B1_PER_ID2,
B1P.B1_PER_ID3,
B1P.B1_ALT_ID Record_ID,
BD.ROW_INDEX,
TRY_CONVERT(date,BD.ATTRIBUTE_VALUE,101) BillDate
INTO #BillDate
FROM B1PERMIT B1P

INNER JOIN BAPPSPECTABLE_VALUE BD
ON BD.SERV_PROV_CODE = B1P.SERV_PROV_CODE
AND BD.B1_PER_ID1 = B1P.B1_PER_ID1
AND BD.B1_PER_ID2 = B1P.B1_PER_ID2
AND BD.B1_PER_ID3 = B1P.B1_PER_ID3
WHERE B1P.SERV_PROV_CODE= @SERV_PROV_CODE
AND GROUP_NAME='BFP_COM_INSP'
AND TABLE_NAME='BILLING INFORMATION'
AND COLUMN_NAME='Bill Date'
AND TRY_CONVERT(date,ATTRIBUTE_VALUE,101) >= @FDate
AND TRY_CONVERT(date,ATTRIBUTE_VALUE,101) < DATEADD(DAY,1,@TDate)
--AND B1P.B1_ALT_ID ='99052235'

----------------------------------------------------
-- 2 BILLING INFO 
----------------------------------------------------
DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #BillingInfo;
SELECT
D.SERV_PROV_CODE,
D.Record_ID RECORD_ID,
D.B1_PER_ID1,
D.B1_PER_ID2,
D.B1_PER_ID3,
FORMAT(D.BillDate,'MM/dd/yy') BillDate,
D.ROW_INDEX,
BillNo.ATTRIBUTE_VALUE AS BillNumber,
UPPER(BillType.ATTRIBUTE_VALUE) BillType,
BillAmount.ATTRIBUTE_VALUE BillAmount ,
LEFT(BCN.ATTRIBUTE_VALUE, CHARINDEX('-', BCN.ATTRIBUTE_VALUE) - 1) InspectionNum,
SUBSTRING(BCN.ATTRIBUTE_VALUE, CHARINDEX('-', BCN.ATTRIBUTE_VALUE) + 1, LEN(BCN.ATTRIBUTE_VALUE)) AccountNo,
BDI.ATTRIBUTE_VALUE DocumentID

INTO #BillingInfo

FROM #BillDate D

INNER JOIN BAPPSPECTABLE_VALUE BillNo
ON BillNo.SERV_PROV_CODE = D.SERV_PROV_CODE
AND BillNo.B1_PER_ID1 = D.B1_PER_ID1
AND BillNo.B1_PER_ID2 = D.B1_PER_ID2
AND BillNo.B1_PER_ID3 = D.B1_PER_ID3
AND BillNo.GROUP_NAME = 'BFP_COM_INSP'
AND BillNo.TABLE_NAME = 'BILLING INFORMATION'
AND BillNo.COLUMN_NAME = 'Bill Number'
AND BillNo.ROW_INDEX = D.ROW_INDEX

LEFT JOIN BAPPSPECTABLE_VALUE BillDate
ON BillDate.SERV_PROV_CODE = D.SERV_PROV_CODE
AND BillDate.B1_PER_ID1 = D.B1_PER_ID1
AND BillDate.B1_PER_ID2 = D.B1_PER_ID2
AND BillDate.B1_PER_ID3 = D.B1_PER_ID3
AND BillDate.GROUP_NAME = 'BFP_COM_INSP'
AND BillDate.TABLE_NAME = 'BILLING INFORMATION'
AND BillDate.COLUMN_NAME = 'Bill Date'
AND BillDate.ROW_INDEX = BillNo.ROW_INDEX

LEFT JOIN BAPPSPECTABLE_VALUE BillType
ON BillType.SERV_PROV_CODE = D.SERV_PROV_CODE
AND BillType.B1_PER_ID1 = D.B1_PER_ID1
AND BillType.B1_PER_ID2 = D.B1_PER_ID2
AND BillType.B1_PER_ID3 = D.B1_PER_ID3
AND BillType.GROUP_NAME = 'BFP_COM_INSP'
AND BillType.TABLE_NAME = 'BILLING INFORMATION'
AND BillType.COLUMN_NAME = 'Bill Type'
AND BillType.ROW_INDEX = BillNo.ROW_INDEX

LEFT JOIN BAPPSPECTABLE_VALUE BillAmount
ON BillAmount.SERV_PROV_CODE = D.SERV_PROV_CODE
AND BillAmount.B1_PER_ID1 = D.B1_PER_ID1
AND BillAmount.B1_PER_ID2 = D.B1_PER_ID2
AND BillAmount.B1_PER_ID3 = D.B1_PER_ID3
AND BillAmount.GROUP_NAME = 'BFP_COM_INSP'
AND BillAmount.TABLE_NAME = 'BILLING INFORMATION'
AND BillAmount.COLUMN_NAME = 'Bill Amount'
AND BillAmount.ROW_INDEX = BillNo.ROW_INDEX

LEFT JOIN BAPPSPECTABLE_VALUE BCN
ON BCN.SERV_PROV_CODE = D.SERV_PROV_CODE
AND BCN.B1_PER_ID1 = D.B1_PER_ID1
AND BCN.B1_PER_ID2 = D.B1_PER_ID2
AND BCN.B1_PER_ID3 = D.B1_PER_ID3
AND BCN.GROUP_NAME = 'BFP_COM_INSP'
AND BCN.TABLE_NAME = 'BILLING INFORMATION'
AND BCN.COLUMN_NAME = 'Cycle Number'
AND BCN.ROW_INDEX = BillNo.ROW_INDEX

LEFT JOIN BAPPSPECTABLE_VALUE BDI
ON BDI.SERV_PROV_CODE = D.SERV_PROV_CODE
AND BDI.B1_PER_ID1 = D.B1_PER_ID1
AND BDI.B1_PER_ID2 = D.B1_PER_ID2
AND BDI.B1_PER_ID3 = D.B1_PER_ID3
AND BDI.GROUP_NAME = 'BFP_COM_INSP'
AND BDI.TABLE_NAME = 'BILLING INFORMATION'
AND BDI.COLUMN_NAME = 'Document ID'
AND BDI.ROW_INDEX = BillNo.ROW_INDEX

WHERE D.SERV_PROV_CODE = @SERV_PROV_CODE
AND D.BillDate >= @FDate
AND D.BillDate < DATEADD(DAY,1,@FDate);

----------------------------------------------------
-- 3 RECORD DATA
----------------------------------------------------
DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #Record;
SELECT DISTINCT
B1P.SERV_PROV_CODE,
B1P.B1_PER_ID1,
B1P.B1_PER_ID2,
B1P.B1_PER_ID3,
B1P.B1_ALT_ID RECORD_ID,
B1P.B1_ALT_ID AccountNO,

RIGHT('00'+ISNULL(BCB.[D.O.],''),2) DO,

CASE
WHEN EX.EXPIRATION_DATE IS NOT NULL
THEN CONVERT(char(10),ex.EXPIRATION_DATE,101)
ELSE 'N/A'
END PermitExpirationDate,

'ON RECEIPT' PaymentDue,

PD.BALANCE PayThisAmount,

'HTTPS://FIRES.FDNYCLOUD.ORG' PayOnLine,

CONVERT(char(10),GETDATE(),101) BillingDate,
BCB.BLOCK AS AddBlock,
BCB.LOT AS LOT,
BCB.[Permit Coverage Comments] AS PermitCoverageComments,
BCB.[Floor(s)] AS PremFloor,
BCB.[Additional Address] AS PremAdditionalAddress,

	  B1P.B1_ALT_ID + ' ' + COALESCE(FORMAT(EX.EXPIRATION_DATE, 'yyMM'), '0000') + ' ' + 
      COALESCE(CASE WHEN LEN(BCB.[D.O.])<2 THEN '0'+ BCB.[D.O.] ELSE BCB.[D.O.] END,'00')+ ' ' + 
      RIGHT('0000000' + REPLACE(CONVERT(VARCHAR(30), BALANCE), '.', ''), 7) AS BillingScanLine,
	  CASE WHEN EX.EXPIRATION_DATE IS NOT NULL THEN FORMAT(EX.EXPIRATION_DATE, 'MM/yy') + '-' +FORMAT(DATEADD(YEAR, 1, EX.EXPIRATION_DATE), 'MM/yy') ELSE 'N/A' END AS BillingPeriod

INTO #Record
FROM #BillingInfo BI

JOIN B1PERMIT B1P
ON B1P.B1_ALT_ID=BI.RECORD_ID
AND B1P.SERV_PROV_CODE=BI.SERV_PROV_CODE

JOIN BPERMIT_DETAIL PD
ON PD.SERV_PROV_CODE=B1P.SERV_PROV_CODE
AND PD.B1_PER_ID1=B1P.B1_PER_ID1
AND PD.B1_PER_ID2=B1P.B1_PER_ID2
AND PD.B1_PER_ID3=B1P.B1_PER_ID3
AND PD.REC_STATUS='A'

LEFT JOIN B3ADDRES B3A
ON B3A.SERV_PROV_CODE = B1P.SERV_PROV_CODE
AND B3A.B1_PER_ID1 = B1P.B1_PER_ID1
AND B3A.B1_PER_ID2 = B1P.B1_PER_ID2
AND B3A.B1_PER_ID3 = B1P.B1_PER_ID3
AND UPPER(B1_ADDR_SOURCE_FLG)='ADR'
AND B1_PRIMARY_ADDR_FLG='Y'
AND B3A.REC_STATUS = 'A'

LEFT JOIN B1_EXPIRATION EX
ON EX.SERV_PROV_CODE=B1P.SERV_PROV_CODE
AND EX.B1_PER_ID1=B1P.B1_PER_ID1
AND EX.B1_PER_ID2=B1P.B1_PER_ID2
AND EX.B1_PER_ID3=B1P.B1_PER_ID3
AND EX.REC_STATUS='A'



OUTER APPLY (
    SELECT *
    FROM (
        SELECT 
            BCB.B1_CHECKBOX_DESC,
            BCB.B1_CHECKLIST_COMMENT
        FROM BCHCKBOX BCB
        WHERE BCB.SERV_PROV_CODE = B1P.SERV_PROV_CODE
          AND BCB.B1_PER_ID1 = B1P.B1_PER_ID1
          AND BCB.B1_PER_ID2 = B1P.B1_PER_ID2
          AND BCB.B1_PER_ID3 = B1P.B1_PER_ID3
		  AND BCB.REC_STATUS ='A'
    ) SRC
    PIVOT (
        MAX(B1_CHECKLIST_COMMENT)
        FOR B1_CHECKBOX_DESC IN ([LOT], [BLOCK], [D.O.],[Permit Coverage Comments],[Floor(s)],[Additional Address])
    ) p
) BCB
;

----------------------------------------------------
-- 4 RECORD ADDRESS
----------------------------------------------------
DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #RECORD_ADDRESS
SELECT B1P.SERV_PROV_CODE, B1P.RECORD_ID,

       CASE
           WHEN NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(B1P.PremFloor)),'') IS NOT NULL
                AND NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(B1P.PremAdditionalAddress)),'') IS NOT NULL
           THEN LTRIM(RTRIM(B1P.PremFloor)) + ' ' + LTRIM(RTRIM(B1P.PremAdditionalAddress)) +CHAR(10)+CHAR(13)
           WHEN NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(B1P.PremFloor)),'') IS NOT NULL
           THEN LTRIM(RTRIM(B1P.PremFloor)) +CHAR(10)+CHAR(13)
           WHEN NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(B1P.PremAdditionalAddress)),'') IS NOT NULL
           THEN LTRIM(RTRIM(B1P.PremAdditionalAddress)) +CHAR(10)+CHAR(13)
           ELSE ''
       END +
       COALESCE(CAST(B3A.B1_HSE_NBR_START AS NVARCHAR(10)),B3A.B1_HSE_NBR_ALPHA_START ,'')+' '+ COALESCE(B3A.B1_STR_NAME,'') +CHAR(10)+CHAR(13)+
       COALESCE(B3A.B1_SITUS_CITY,'') + ' ' +COALESCE(B1_SITUS_STATE,'')+' ' +
	   CASE
           WHEN CHARINDEX('-', TRY_CAST(B1_SITUS_ZIP AS NVARCHAR(50))) > 0
               THEN TRY_CAST(B1_SITUS_ZIP AS NVARCHAR(50))

           WHEN LEN(TRY_CAST(B1_SITUS_ZIP AS NVARCHAR(50))) <= 5
               THEN TRY_CAST(B1_SITUS_ZIP AS NVARCHAR(50))

           ELSE
               STUFF(TRY_CAST(B1_SITUS_ZIP AS NVARCHAR(50)), 6, 0, '-')
       END AS  PREMISES_ADDRESS,

	   B3C.B1_BUSINESS_NAME AdditionalBillingAddress,

	   COALESCE(B3C.B1_BUSINESS_NAME,'') + CHAR(10)+CHAR(13)+
	   COALESCE(CAST(BillAdd.G7_HSE_NBR_START AS NVARCHAR(10)),BillAdd.G7_HSE_NBR_ALPHA_START,'' )+' '+ COALESCE(BillAdd.G7_STR_NAME,'') +CHAR(10)+CHAR(13)+
       COALESCE(BillAdd.G7_CITY,'') + ' ' +COALESCE(BillAdd.G7_STATE,'')+' ' +
	   CASE 
           WHEN CHARINDEX('-', TRY_CAST(BillAdd.G7_ZIP AS NVARCHAR(50))) > 0 
               THEN TRY_CAST(BillAdd.G7_ZIP AS NVARCHAR(50))
               
           WHEN LEN(TRY_CAST(BillAdd.G7_ZIP AS NVARCHAR(50))) <= 5 
               THEN TRY_CAST(BillAdd.G7_ZIP AS NVARCHAR(50))
               
           ELSE 
               STUFF(TRY_CAST(BillAdd.G7_ZIP AS NVARCHAR(50)), 6, 0, '-')
       END AS BillingAddress

INTO #RECORD_ADDRESS

FROM #Record B1P
OUTER APPLY (
    SELECT TOP 1 *
	FROM B3ADDRES B3A
    WHERE B3A.SERV_PROV_CODE = B1P.SERV_PROV_CODE
    AND B3A.B1_PER_ID1 = B1P.B1_PER_ID1
    AND B3A.B1_PER_ID2 = B1P.B1_PER_ID2
    AND B3A.B1_PER_ID3 = B1P.B1_PER_ID3
	AND B3A.REC_STATUS='A'
	AND UPPER(B3A.B1_ADDR_SOURCE_FLG)='ADR'
	AND B3A.B1_PRIMARY_ADDR_FLG='Y' 

	ORDER BY B3A.REC_DATE DESC
	) B3A

OUTER APPLY (
    SELECT TOP 1 *
    FROM B3CONTACT B3C
    WHERE B3C.SERV_PROV_CODE = B1P.SERV_PROV_CODE
      AND B3C.B1_PER_ID1 = B1P.B1_PER_ID1
      AND B3C.B1_PER_ID2 = B1P.B1_PER_ID2
      AND B3C.B1_PER_ID3 = B1P.B1_PER_ID3
      AND B3C.B1_CONTACT_TYPE = 'Billing Contact'
	  AND B3C.REC_STATUS = 'A'
      --AND ISNULL(B3C.B1_FLAG,'Y') <> 'N'
    ORDER BY B3C.REC_DATE DESC
) B3C

OUTER APPLY (
    SELECT TOP 1 G7CA5.* 
	        FROM
            XRECORD_CONTACT_ENTITY XRCE5

            INNER JOIN G7CONTACT_ADDRESS G7CA5 ON 1 = 1
                AND G7CA5.SERV_PROV_CODE = XRCE5.SERV_PROV_CODE
                AND G7CA5.RES_ID = XRCE5.ENT_ID1
                AND G7CA5.G7_ENTITY_TYPE = XRCE5.ENT_TYPE
                AND G7CA5.REC_STATUS = 'A'
				AND XRCE5.REC_STATUS = 'A'
				AND G7CA5.G7_ADDRESS_TYPE = 'Billing Address'

			WHERE 1 = 1
            AND XRCE5.SERV_PROV_CODE = B3C.SERV_PROV_CODE
            AND XRCE5.B1_PER_ID1 = B3C.B1_PER_ID1
            AND XRCE5.B1_PER_ID2 = B3C.B1_PER_ID2
            AND XRCE5.B1_PER_ID3 = B3C.B1_PER_ID3
            AND XRCE5.B1_CONTACT_NBR = B3C.B1_CONTACT_NBR
            AND XRCE5.ENT_TYPE = 
                                 CASE
                                     WHEN NULLIF(B3C.G1_CONTACT_NBR,'') IS NULL
                                     THEN 'CAP_CONTACT'
                                     ELSE 'CONTACT'
                                 END
			ORDER BY XRCE5.REC_DATE ASC
        ) BillAdd
WHERE  B1P.SERV_PROV_CODE  = @SERV_PROV_CODE;
		
----------------------------------------------------
-- 5 FEE INFO
----------------------------------------------------
DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #FeeInfo;
SELECT
BILL.RECORD_ID,BILL.B1_PER_ID1,BILL.B1_PER_ID2,BILL.B1_PER_ID3,BILL.SERV_PROV_CODE,
F.GF_COD,
F.GF_L3,
LEFT(F.GF_L3,3) ItemCode,
RIGHT(F.GF_L3,2) SUBCODE,
F.GF_DES ITEMDESCRIPTION,
F.GF_FEE,
F.GF_ITEM_STATUS_FLAG,
INV.INVOICE_CUSTOMIZED_NBR,
INV.INVOICE_NBR,
INV.BALANCE_DUE InvoiceBalance,
FEE_NOTES 
INTO #FeeInfo
FROM #BillingInfo BILL

JOIN F4FEEITEM F
ON F.SERV_PROV_CODE=BILL.SERV_PROV_CODE
AND F.B1_PER_ID1=BILL.B1_PER_ID1
AND F.B1_PER_ID2=BILL.B1_PER_ID2
AND F.B1_PER_ID3=BILL.B1_PER_ID3
AND F.GF_ITEM_STATUS_FLAG='INVOICED'

JOIN X4FEEITEM_INVOICE X
ON X.SERV_PROV_CODE=F.SERV_PROV_CODE
AND X.FEEITEM_SEQ_NBR=F.FEEITEM_SEQ_NBR

JOIN F4INVOICE INV
ON INV.SERV_PROV_CODE=X.SERV_PROV_CODE
AND INV.INVOICE_NBR=X.INVOICE_NBR
AND INV.INVOICE_CUSTOMIZED_NBR =  BillNumber

WHERE F.FEE_NOTES IS NOT NULL
AND INV.INVOICE_NBR NOT IN (SELECT INVOICE_NBR FROM X4PAYMENT_INVOICE WHERE SERV_PROV_CODE =@SERV_PROV_CODE)
;
----------------------------------------------------
-- 6 FEE PENALTY
----------------------------------------------------
DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #Penalty;
SELECT
BILL.RECORD_ID,BILL.B1_PER_ID1,BILL.B1_PER_ID2,BILL.B1_PER_ID3,BILL.SERV_PROV_CODE,
SUM(INV.BALANCE_DUE) InvoiceBalance
INTO #Penalty
FROM #BillingInfo BILL

JOIN F4FEEITEM F
ON F.SERV_PROV_CODE=BILL.SERV_PROV_CODE
AND F.B1_PER_ID1=BILL.B1_PER_ID1
AND F.B1_PER_ID2=BILL.B1_PER_ID2
AND F.B1_PER_ID3=BILL.B1_PER_ID3
AND F.GF_ITEM_STATUS_FLAG='INVOICED'

JOIN X4FEEITEM_INVOICE X
ON X.SERV_PROV_CODE=F.SERV_PROV_CODE
AND X.FEEITEM_SEQ_NBR=F.FEEITEM_SEQ_NBR

JOIN F4INVOICE INV
ON INV.SERV_PROV_CODE=X.SERV_PROV_CODE
AND INV.INVOICE_NBR=X.INVOICE_NBR
WHERE F.FEE_NOTES = BILL.InspectionNum
AND GF_COD LIKE '%PENALTY%'
AND INV.INVOICE_NBR NOT IN (SELECT INVOICE_NBR FROM X4PAYMENT_INVOICE WHERE SERV_PROV_CODE =@SERV_PROV_CODE)
GROUP BY BILL.RECORD_ID,BILL.B1_PER_ID1,BILL.B1_PER_ID2,BILL.B1_PER_ID3,BILL.SERV_PROV_CODE
;
----------------------------------------------------
-- 7 COVERAGE
----------------------------------------------------
DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #Coverage;
SELECT
F.SERV_PROV_CODE,
F.RECORD_ID,
COV.ROW_INDEX,
COV.ATTRIBUTE_VALUE CoverageItem,
Q.ATTRIBUTE_VALUE Quantity,
D.ATTRIBUTE_VALUE Details,
I.ATTRIBUTE_VALUE InspectionType,
S.ATTRIBUTE_VALUE CovStatus
INTO #Coverage
FROM #FeeInfo F

JOIN BAPPSPECTABLE_VALUE COV
ON COV.SERV_PROV_CODE=F.SERV_PROV_CODE
AND COV.B1_PER_ID1=F.B1_PER_ID1
AND COV.B1_PER_ID2=F.B1_PER_ID2
AND COV.B1_PER_ID3=F.B1_PER_ID3
AND COV.GROUP_NAME='BFP_COM_INSP'
AND COV.TABLE_NAME='COVERAGE INFORMATION'
AND COV.COLUMN_NAME='Coverage Item'
AND COV.ATTRIBUTE_VALUE=F.ItemDescription

LEFT JOIN BAPPSPECTABLE_VALUE Q
ON Q.SERV_PROV_CODE=COV.SERV_PROV_CODE
AND Q.B1_PER_ID1=COV.B1_PER_ID1
AND Q.B1_PER_ID2=COV.B1_PER_ID2
AND Q.B1_PER_ID3=COV.B1_PER_ID3
AND Q.ROW_INDEX=COV.ROW_INDEX
AND Q.GROUP_NAME='BFP_COM_INSP'
AND Q.TABLE_NAME='COVERAGE INFORMATION'
AND Q.COLUMN_NAME='Quantity'

LEFT JOIN BAPPSPECTABLE_VALUE D
ON D.SERV_PROV_CODE=COV.SERV_PROV_CODE
AND D.B1_PER_ID1=COV.B1_PER_ID1
AND D.B1_PER_ID2=COV.B1_PER_ID2
AND D.B1_PER_ID3=COV.B1_PER_ID3
AND D.ROW_INDEX=COV.ROW_INDEX
AND D.GROUP_NAME='BFP_COM_INSP'
AND D.TABLE_NAME='COVERAGE INFORMATION'
AND D.COLUMN_NAME='Details'

LEFT JOIN BAPPSPECTABLE_VALUE I
ON I.SERV_PROV_CODE=COV.SERV_PROV_CODE
AND I.B1_PER_ID1=COV.B1_PER_ID1
AND I.B1_PER_ID2=COV.B1_PER_ID2
AND I.B1_PER_ID3=COV.B1_PER_ID3
AND I.ROW_INDEX=COV.ROW_INDEX
AND I.GROUP_NAME='BFP_COM_INSP'
AND I.TABLE_NAME='COVERAGE INFORMATION'
AND I.COLUMN_NAME='Inspection Type'

LEFT JOIN BAPPSPECTABLE_VALUE S
ON S.SERV_PROV_CODE=COV.SERV_PROV_CODE
AND S.B1_PER_ID1=COV.B1_PER_ID1
AND S.B1_PER_ID2=COV.B1_PER_ID2
AND S.B1_PER_ID3=COV.B1_PER_ID3
AND S.ROW_INDEX=COV.ROW_INDEX
AND S.GROUP_NAME='BFP_COM_INSP'
AND S.TABLE_NAME='COVERAGE INFORMATION'
AND S.COLUMN_NAME='STATUS'

WHERE S.ATTRIBUTE_VALUE = 'Active';

with results_data as (
SELECT 
       R.SERV_PROV_CODE,R.B1_PER_ID1,R.B1_PER_ID2,R.B1_PER_ID3,R.RECORD_ID,R.AccountNO Acct#,	R.DO DO,FORMAT(TRY_CONVERT(DATE,R.PermitExpirationDate,101),'MM/dd/yy')	PermitExpirationDate,

"9","ConsolidatedInvoice_Accela_Optimized.sql","C:\FIRESSQLSVR\ConsolidatedInvoice_Accela_Optimized.sql","--================================================

SET NOCOUNT ON;

DECLARE @SERV_PROV_CODE NVARCHAR(50) = 'FDNY';
DECLARE @FDate DATE = '2026-08-13';
DECLARE @TDate DATE = '2026-08-13';

----------------------------------------------------
-- 1. BILLING INFORMATION (Consolidated Single Scan)
----------------------------------------------------
DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #BillingInfo;

SELECT 
    B1P.SERV_PROV_CODE,
    B1P.B1_PER_ID1,
    B1P.B1_PER_ID2,
    B1P.B1_PER_ID3,
    B1P.B1_ALT_ID AS RECORD_ID,
    BD.ROW_INDEX,
    FORMAT(MAX(CASE WHEN BD.COLUMN_NAME = 'Bill Date' THEN TRY_CONVERT(DATE, BD.ATTRIBUTE_VALUE, 101) END), 'MM/dd/yy') AS BillDate,
    MAX(CASE WHEN BD.COLUMN_NAME = 'Bill Number' THEN BD.ATTRIBUTE_VALUE END) AS BillNumber,
    UPPER(MAX(CASE WHEN BD.COLUMN_NAME = 'Bill Type' THEN BD.ATTRIBUTE_VALUE END)) AS BillType,
    MAX(CASE WHEN BD.COLUMN_NAME = 'Bill Amount' THEN BD.ATTRIBUTE_VALUE END) AS BillAmount,
    MAX(CASE WHEN BD.COLUMN_NAME = 'Document ID' THEN BD.ATTRIBUTE_VALUE END) AS DocumentID,
    -- Safe extraction for Cycle Number (InspectionNum - AccountNo)
    CASE 
        WHEN CHARINDEX('-', MAX(CASE WHEN BD.COLUMN_NAME = 'Cycle Number' THEN BD.ATTRIBUTE_VALUE END)) > 0 
        THEN LEFT(MAX(CASE WHEN BD.COLUMN_NAME = 'Cycle Number' THEN BD.ATTRIBUTE_VALUE END), CHARINDEX('-', MAX(CASE WHEN BD.COLUMN_NAME = 'Cycle Number' THEN BD.ATTRIBUTE_VALUE END)) - 1)
        ELSE MAX(CASE WHEN BD.COLUMN_NAME = 'Cycle Number' THEN BD.ATTRIBUTE_VALUE END)
    END AS InspectionNum,
    CASE 
        WHEN CHARINDEX('-', MAX(CASE WHEN BD.COLUMN_NAME = 'Cycle Number' THEN BD.ATTRIBUTE_VALUE END)) > 0 
        THEN SUBSTRING(MAX(CASE WHEN BD.COLUMN_NAME = 'Cycle Number' THEN BD.ATTRIBUTE_VALUE END), CHARINDEX('-', MAX(CASE WHEN BD.COLUMN_NAME = 'Cycle Number' THEN BD.ATTRIBUTE_VALUE END)) + 1, 100)
        ELSE ''
    END AS AccountNo
INTO #BillingInfo
FROM B1PERMIT B1P
INNER JOIN BAPPSPECTABLE_VALUE BD
    ON BD.SERV_PROV_CODE = B1P.SERV_PROV_CODE
   AND BD.B1_PER_ID1 = B1P.B1_PER_ID1
   AND BD.B1_PER_ID2 = B1P.B1_PER_ID2
   AND BD.B1_PER_ID3 = B1P.B1_PER_ID3
WHERE B1P.SERV_PROV_CODE = @SERV_PROV_CODE
  AND BD.GROUP_NAME = 'BFP_COM_INSP'
  AND BD.TABLE_NAME = 'BILLING INFORMATION'
GROUP BY 
    B1P.SERV_PROV_CODE,
    B1P.B1_PER_ID1,
    B1P.B1_PER_ID2,
    B1P.B1_PER_ID3,
    B1P.B1_ALT_ID,
    BD.ROW_INDEX
HAVING 
    MAX(CASE WHEN BD.COLUMN_NAME = 'Bill Date' THEN TRY_CONVERT(DATE, BD.ATTRIBUTE_VALUE, 101) END) >= @FDate
    AND MAX(CASE WHEN BD.COLUMN_NAME = 'Bill Date' THEN TRY_CONVERT(DATE, BD.ATTRIBUTE_VALUE, 101) END) < DATEADD(DAY, 1, @TDate);

CREATE CLUSTERED INDEX CIX_BillingInfo ON #BillingInfo (SERV_PROV_CODE, B1_PER_ID1, B1_PER_ID2, B1_PER_ID3, ROW_INDEX);

----------------------------------------------------
-- 2. RECORD DATA & ADDRESSES
----------------------------------------------------
DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #Record;

SELECT DISTINCT
    B1P.SERV_PROV_CODE,
    B1P.B1_PER_ID1,
    B1P.B1_PER_ID2,
    B1P.B1_PER_ID3,
    B1P.B1_ALT_ID AS RECORD_ID,
    B1P.B1_ALT_ID AS AccountNO,
    RIGHT('00' + ISNULL(BCB.[D.O.], ''), 2) AS DO,
    ISNULL(CONVERT(CHAR(10), EX.EXPIRATION_DATE, 101), 'N/A') AS PermitExpirationDate,
    'ON RECEIPT' AS PaymentDue,
    PD.BALANCE AS PayThisAmount,
    'HTTPS://FIRES.FDNYCLOUD.ORG' AS PayOnLine,
    CONVERT(CHAR(10), GETDATE(), 101) AS BillingDate,
    BCB.BLOCK AS AddBlock,
    BCB.LOT AS LOT,
    BCB.[Permit Coverage Comments] AS PermitCoverageComments,
    BCB.[Floor(s)] AS PremFloor,
    BCB.[Additional Address] AS PremAdditionalAddress,
    B1P.B1_ALT_ID + ' ' + COALESCE(FORMAT(EX.EXPIRATION_DATE, 'yyMM'), '0000') + ' ' + 
        RIGHT('00' + ISNULL(BCB.[D.O.], ''), 2) + ' ' + 
        RIGHT('0000000' + REPLACE(CONVERT(VARCHAR(30), PD.BALANCE), '.', ''), 7) AS BillingScanLine,
    CASE 
        WHEN EX.EXPIRATION_DATE IS NOT NULL 
        THEN FORMAT(EX.EXPIRATION_DATE, 'MM/yy') + '-' + FORMAT(DATEADD(YEAR, 1, EX.EXPIRATION_DATE), 'MM/yy') 
        ELSE 'N/A' 
    END AS BillingPeriod,
    -- Address Formattings
    ISNULL(NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(BCB.[Floor(s)])), '') + ' ', '') +
    ISNULL(NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(BCB.[Additional Address])), ''), '') +
    CASE WHEN NULLIF(BCB.[Floor(s)], '') IS NOT NULL OR NULLIF(BCB.[Additional Address], '') IS NOT NULL THEN CHAR(13) + CHAR(10) ELSE '' END +
    COALESCE(CAST(B3A.B1_HSE_NBR_START AS NVARCHAR(10)), B3A.B1_HSE_NBR_ALPHA_START, '') + ' ' + COALESCE(B3A.B1_STR_NAME, '') + CHAR(13) + CHAR(10) +
    COALESCE(B3A.B1_SITUS_CITY, '') + ' ' + COALESCE(B3A.B1_SITUS_STATE, '') + ' ' +
    CASE
        WHEN CHARINDEX('-', TRY_CAST(B3A.B1_SITUS_ZIP AS NVARCHAR(50))) > 0 THEN TRY_CAST(B3A.B1_SITUS_ZIP AS NVARCHAR(50))
        WHEN LEN(TRY_CAST(B3A.B1_SITUS_ZIP AS NVARCHAR(50))) <= 5 THEN TRY_CAST(B3A.B1_SITUS_ZIP AS NVARCHAR(50))
        ELSE STUFF(TRY_CAST(B3A.B1_SITUS_ZIP AS NVARCHAR(50)), 6, 0, '-')
    END AS PREMISES_ADDRESS,
    B3C.B1_BUSINESS_NAME AS AdditionalBillingAddress,
    COALESCE(B3C.B1_BUSINESS_NAME, '') + CHAR(13) + CHAR(10) +
    COALESCE(CAST(BillAdd.G7_HSE_NBR_START AS NVARCHAR(10)), BillAdd.G7_HSE_NBR_ALPHA_START, '') + ' ' + COALESCE(BillAdd.G7_STR_NAME, '') + CHAR(13) + CHAR(10) +
    COALESCE(BillAdd.G7_CITY, '') + ' ' + COALESCE(BillAdd.G7_STATE, '') + ' ' +
    CASE 
        WHEN CHARINDEX('-', TRY_CAST(BillAdd.G7_ZIP AS NVARCHAR(50))) > 0 THEN TRY_CAST(BillAdd.G7_ZIP AS NVARCHAR(50))
        WHEN LEN(TRY_CAST(BillAdd.G7_ZIP AS NVARCHAR(50))) <= 5 THEN TRY_CAST(BillAdd.G7_ZIP AS NVARCHAR(50))
        ELSE STUFF(TRY_CAST(BillAdd.G7_ZIP AS NVARCHAR(50)), 6, 0, '-')
    END AS BillingAddress
INTO #Record
FROM #BillingInfo BI
INNER JOIN B1PERMIT B1P
    ON B1P.B1_ALT_ID = BI.RECORD_ID
   AND B1P.SERV_PROV_CODE = BI.SERV_PROV_CODE
INNER JOIN BPERMIT_DETAIL PD
    ON PD.SERV_PROV_CODE = B1P.SERV_PROV_CODE
   AND PD.B1_PER_ID1 = B1P.B1_PER_ID1
   AND PD.B1_PER_ID2 = B1P.B1_PER_ID2
   AND PD.B1_PER_ID3 = B1P.B1_PER_ID3
   AND PD.REC_STATUS = 'A'
LEFT JOIN B1_EXPIRATION EX
    ON EX.SERV_PROV_CODE = B1P.SERV_PROV_CODE
   AND EX.B1_PER_ID1 = B1P.B1_PER_ID1
   AND EX.B1_PER_ID2 = B1P.B1_PER_ID2
   AND EX.B1_PER_ID3 = B1P.B1_PER_ID3
   AND EX.REC_STATUS = 'A'
OUTER APPLY (
    SELECT *
    FROM (
        SELECT BCB.B1_CHECKBOX_DESC, BCB.B1_CHECKLIST_COMMENT
        FROM BCHCKBOX BCB
        WHERE BCB.SERV_PROV_CODE = B1P.SERV_PROV_CODE
          AND BCB.B1_PER_ID1 = B1P.B1_PER_ID1
          AND BCB.B1_PER_ID2 = B1P.B1_PER_ID2
          AND BCB.B1_PER_ID3 = B1P.B1_PER_ID3
          AND BCB.REC_STATUS = 'A'
    ) SRC
    PIVOT (
        MAX(B1_CHECKLIST_COMMENT)
        FOR B1_CHECKBOX_DESC IN ([LOT], [BLOCK], [D.O.], [Permit Coverage Comments], [Floor(s)], [Additional Address])
    ) p
) BCB
OUTER APPLY (
    SELECT TOP 1 *
    FROM B3ADDRES B3A
    WHERE B3A.SERV_PROV_CODE = B1P.SERV_PROV_CODE
      AND B3A.B1_PER_ID1 = B1P.B1_PER_ID1
      AND B3A.B1_PER_ID2 = B1P.B1_PER_ID2
      AND B3A.B1_PER_ID3 = B1P.B1_PER_ID3
      AND B3A.REC_STATUS = 'A'
      AND UPPER(B3A.B1_ADDR_SOURCE_FLG) = 'ADR'
      AND B3A.B1_PRIMARY_ADDR_FLG = 'Y' 
    ORDER BY B3A.REC_DATE DESC
) B3A
OUTER APPLY (
    SELECT TOP 1 *
    FROM B3CONTACT B3C
    WHERE B3C.SERV_PROV_CODE = B1P.SERV_PROV_CODE
      AND B3C.B1_PER_ID1 = B1P.B1_PER_ID1
      AND B3C.B1_PER_ID2 = B1P.B1_PER_ID2
      AND B3C.B1_PER_ID3 = B1P.B1_PER_ID3
      AND B3C.B1_CONTACT_TYPE = 'Billing Contact'
      AND B3C.REC_STATUS = 'A'
    ORDER BY B3C.REC_DATE DESC
) B3C
OUTER APPLY (
    SELECT TOP 1 G7CA5.* 
    FROM XRECORD_CONTACT_ENTITY XRCE5
    INNER JOIN G7CONTACT_ADDRESS G7CA5 
        ON G7CA5.SERV_PROV_CODE = XRCE5.SERV_PROV_CODE
       AND G7CA5.RES_ID = XRCE5.ENT_ID1
       AND G7CA5.G7_ENTITY_TYPE = XRCE5.ENT_TYPE
       AND G7CA5.REC_STATUS = 'A'
       AND G7CA5.G7_ADDRESS_TYPE = 'Billing Address'
    WHERE XRCE5.REC_STATUS = 'A'
      AND XRCE5.SERV_PROV_CODE = B3C.SERV_PROV_CODE
      AND XRCE5.B1_PER_ID1 = B3C.B1_PER_ID1
      AND XRCE5.B1_PER_ID2 = B3C.B1_PER_ID2
      AND XRCE5.B1_PER_ID3 = B3C.B1_PER_ID3
      AND XRCE5.B1_CONTACT_NBR = B3C.B1_CONTACT_NBR
      AND XRCE5.ENT_TYPE = CASE WHEN NULLIF(B3C.G1_CONTACT_NBR, '') IS NULL THEN 'CAP_CONTACT' ELSE 'CONTACT' END
    ORDER BY XRCE5.REC_DATE ASC
) BillAdd;

CREATE CLUSTERED INDEX CIX_Record ON #Record (SERV_PROV_CODE, RECORD_ID);

-- 3. FEE INFO & PENALTIES

DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #FeeInfo;

SELECT
    BILL.RECORD_ID,
    BILL.B1_PER_ID1,
    BILL.B1_PER_ID2,
    BILL.B1_PER_ID3,
    BILL.SERV_PROV_CODE,
    F.GF_COD,
    F.GF_L3,
    LEFT(F.GF_L3, 3) AS ItemCode,
    RIGHT(F.GF_L3, 2) AS SUBCODE,
    F.GF_DES AS ITEMDESCRIPTION,
    F.GF_FEE,
    F.GF_ITEM_STATUS_FLAG,
    INV.INVOICE_CUSTOMIZED_NBR,
    INV.INVOICE_NBR,
    INV.BALANCE_DUE AS InvoiceBalance,
    F.FEE_NOTES

FROM #BillingInfo BILL
INNER JOIN F4FEEITEM F
    ON F.SERV_PROV_CODE = BILL.SERV_PROV_CODE
   AND F.B1_PER_ID1 = BILL.B1_PER_ID1
   AND F.B1_PER_ID2 = BILL.B1_PER_ID2
   AND F.B1_PER_ID3 = BILL.B1_PER_ID3
   AND F.GF_ITEM_STATUS_FLAG = 'INVOICED'
INNER JOIN X4FEEITEM_INVOICE X
    ON X.SERV_PROV_CODE = F.SERV_PROV_CODE
   AND X.FEEITEM_SEQ_NBR = F.FEEITEM_SEQ_NBR
INNER JOIN F4INVOICE INV
    ON INV.SERV_PROV_CODE = X.SERV_PROV_CODE
   AND INV.INVOICE_NBR = X.INVOICE_NBR
   AND INV.INVOICE_CUSTOMIZED_NBR = BILL.BillNumber
WHERE F.FEE_NOTES IS NOT NULL
  AND NOT EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 
      FROM X4PAYMENT_INVOICE PI 
      WHERE PI.SERV_PROV_CODE = @SERV_PROV_CODE 
        AND PI.INVOICE_NBR = INV.INVOICE_NBR
  );

CREATE CLUSTERED INDEX CIX_FeeInfo ON #FeeInfo (SERV_PROV_CODE, RECORD_ID, FEE_NOTES);

-- Penalty Aggregation
DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #Penalty;

SELECT
    BILL.RECORD_ID,
    BILL.SERV_PROV_CODE,
    SUM(INV.BALANCE_DUE) AS InvoiceBalance
INTO #Penalty
FROM #BillingInfo BILL
INNER JOIN F4FEEITEM F
    ON F.SERV_PROV_CODE = BILL.SERV_PROV_CODE
   AND F.B1_PER_ID1 = BILL.B1_PER_ID1
   AND F.B1_PER_ID2 = BILL.B1_PER_ID2
   AND F.B1_PER_ID3 = BILL.B1_PER_ID3
   AND F.GF_ITEM_STATUS_FLAG = 'INVOICED'
INNER JOIN X4FEEITEM_INVOICE X
    ON X.SERV_PROV_CODE = F.SERV_PROV_CODE
   AND X.FEEITEM_SEQ_NBR = F.FEEITEM_SEQ_NBR
INNER JOIN F4INVOICE INV
    ON INV.SERV_PROV_CODE = X.SERV_PROV_CODE
   AND INV.INVOICE_NBR = X.INVOICE_NBR
WHERE F.FEE_NOTES = BILL.InspectionNum
  AND F.GF_COD LIKE '%PENALTY%'
  AND NOT EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 
      FROM X4PAYMENT_INVOICE PI 
      WHERE PI.SERV_PROV_CODE = @SERV_PROV_CODE 
        AND PI.INVOICE_NBR = INV.INVOICE_NBR
  )
GROUP BY BILL.RECORD_ID, BILL.SERV_PROV_CODE;

----------------------------------------------------
-- 4. COVERAGE (Consolidated Single Scan)

DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #Coverage;

SELECT 
    COV.SERV_PROV_CODE,
    F.RECORD_ID,
    COV.ROW_INDEX,

    MAX(CASE WHEN COV.COLUMN_NAME = 'Quantity' THEN COV.ATTRIBUTE_VALUE END) AS Quantity,
    MAX(CASE WHEN COV.COLUMN_NAME = 'Details' THEN COV.ATTRIBUTE_VALUE END) AS Details,
    MAX(CASE WHEN COV.COLUMN_NAME = 'Inspection Type' THEN COV.ATTRIBUTE_VALUE END) AS InspectionType
INTO #Coverage
FROM #FeeInfo F
INNER JOIN BAPPSPECTABLE_VALUE COV
    ON COV.SERV_PROV_CODE = F.SERV_PROV_CODE
   AND COV.B1_PER_ID1 = F.B1_PER_ID1
   AND COV.B1_PER_ID2 = F.B1_PER_ID2
   AND COV.B1_PER_ID3 = F.B1_PER_ID3
   AND COV.GROUP_NAME = 'BFP_COM_INSP'
   AND COV.TABLE_NAME = 'COVERAGE INFORMATION'
GROUP BY 
    COV.SERV_PROV_CODE,
    F.RECORD_ID,
    COV.ROW_INDEX
HAVING 
    MAX(CASE WHEN COV.COLUMN_NAME = 'STATUS' THEN COV.ATTRIBUTE_VALUE END) = 'Active';

----------------------------------------------------
-- 5. FINAL RESULT SET
----------------------------------------------------
SELECT 
    R.SERV_PROV_CODE,
    R.B1_PER_ID1,
    R.B1_PER_ID2,
    R.B1_PER_ID3,
    R.RECORD_ID,
    R.AccountNO AS [Acct#],
    R.DO,
    FORMAT(TRY_CONVERT(DATE, R.PermitExpirationDate, 101), 'MM/dd/yy') AS PermitExpirationDate,
    R.PaymentDue,

    R.PayOnLine,
    R.BillingAddress,
    R.BillingScanLine,
    R.BillingPeriod,
    R.AdditionalBillingAddress,

        THEN CHAR(13) + CHAR(10) + R.AdditionalBillingAddress
        ELSE ''
    END + CHAR(13) + CHAR(10) + R.PREMISES_ADDRESS AS BUSS_PREMISES_ADDRESS,
    R.PREMISES_ADDRESS,
    R.AddBlock,
    R.LOT,
    R.PermitCoverageComments,
    F.GF_COD,
    F.GF_L3,
    F.ItemCode,
    F.SUBCODE,
    F.ITEMDESCRIPTION,
    F.GF_FEE,
    F.GF_ITEM_STATUS_FLAG,
    F.InvoiceBalance,
    F.INVOICE_CUSTOMIZED_NBR,
    B.ROW_INDEX,
    C.CoverageItem,
    C.Quantity,
    C.Details,
    C.InspectionType,
    B.BillNumber,
    B.BillType,
    B.BillDate,
    B.BillDate AS BillingDate,
    B.BillAmount,
    B.InspectionNum,
    B.AccountNo,
    B.DocumentID,
    Pen.InvoiceBalance AS TotalPenalty,
    CASE 
        WHEN B.AccountNo IN ('10', '15', '20', '25') THEN '*LATE PAYMENTS WILL INCUR PENALTIES*' 
        WHEN B.AccountNo NOT IN ('10', '15', '20', '25') AND B.BillType = 'FIRST REMINDER' 
            THEN 'FAILURE TO PAY IMMEDIATELY WILL RESULT' + CHAR(13) + CHAR(10) +
                 'IN LIEN PROCEEDINGS PURSUANT' + CHAR(13) + CHAR(10) +
                 'TO 29 NYC ADMIN CODE SEC. FC117.4'
        WHEN B.AccountNo NOT IN ('10', '15', '20', '25') AND B.BillType = 'SECOND REMINDER' 
            THEN 'LIEN PROCEEDINGS HAVE BEGUN IN ACCORDANCE' + CHAR(13) + CHAR(10) +
                 'WITH 29 NYC ADMIN CODE SEC FC117.4.' + CHAR(13) + CHAR(10) +
                 'TO STOP THIS LEGAL ACTION- PAY IMMEDIATELY'
        ELSE '' 
    END AS MSG2,
    CASE 
        WHEN B.AccountNo IN ('10', '15', '20', '25') 
        THEN 'OPERATION WITHOUT' + CHAR(13) + CHAR(10) + 'PERMIT IS ILLEGAL'
    END AS MSG1,
    CASE 
        WHEN F.GF_ITEM_STATUS_FLAG = 'INVOICED' AND F.InvoiceBalance > 0 AND F.ITEMDESCRIPTION NOT LIKE '%Penalty%' 
        THEN 1 
        ELSE 2 
    END AS OrderFlag
FROM #Record R
INNER JOIN #BillingInfo B
    ON B.SERV_PROV_CODE = R.SERV_PROV_CODE
   AND B.RECORD_ID = R.RECORD_ID
INNER JOIN #FeeInfo F
    ON F.SERV_PROV_CODE = B.SERV_PROV_CODE
   AND F.RECORD_ID = B.RECORD_ID
   AND F.FEE_NOTES = B.InspectionNum
LEFT JOIN #Penalty Pen
    ON Pen.SERV_PROV_CODE = B.SERV_PROV_CODE
   AND Pen.RECORD_ID = B.RECORD_ID
LEFT JOIN #Coverage C
    ON C.SERV_PROV_CODE = F.SERV_PROV_CODE
   AND C.RECORD_ID = F.RECORD_ID
   AND C.CoverageItem = F.ITEMDESCRIPTION
ORDER BY B.DocumentID;

                'Abated - No Hearing Required',
                'Corrected - Hearing Required',
                'Cure Letter Issued-No hearing',
                'Withdrawn',
                'Written Off'
            ) THEN 'Yes'
            ELSE 'No'
        END COMPLIANCE_FLAG
    FROM
        B1PERMIT AS B
        INNER JOIN XAPP2REF AS X ON B.SERV_PROV_CODE = X.SERV_PROV_CODE
        AND B.B1_PER_ID1 = X.B1_MASTER_ID1
        AND B.B1_PER_ID2 = X.B1_MASTER_ID2
        AND B.B1_PER_ID3 = X.B1_MASTER_ID3
        AND X.B1_RELATIONSHIP = 'R'
        INNER JOIN B1PERMIT AS M ON M.SERV_PROV_CODE = X.SERV_PROV_CODE
        AND M.B1_PER_ID1 = X.B1_PER_ID1
        AND M.B1_PER_ID2 = X.B1_PER_ID2
        AND M.B1_PER_ID3 = X.B1_PER_ID3
        LEFT OUTER JOIN ASI AS BC ON BC.SERV_PROV_CODE = B.SERV_PROV_CODE
        AND BC.B1_PER_ID1 = B.B1_PER_ID1
        AND BC.B1_PER_ID2 = B.B1_PER_ID2
        AND BC.B1_PER_ID3 = B.B1_PER_ID3
        LEFT OUTER JOIN status_history H ON M.SERV_PROV_CODE = H.SERV_PROV_CODE
        AND M.B1_PER_ID1 = H.B1_PER_ID1
        AND M.B1_PER_ID2 = H.B1_PER_ID2
        AND M.B1_PER_ID3 = H.B1_PER_ID3
        AND H.STATUS = 'Correction Request Submitted'
    WHERE
        (B.SERV_PROV_CODE = 'FDNY')
        AND (B.B1_PER_GROUP = 'BFP')
        AND (B.B1_PER_TYPE = 'Enforcement')
        AND (B.B1_PER_SUB_TYPE = 'FDNY Summons')
        AND (B.B1_PER_CATEGORY = 'NA')
        AND (M.B1_PER_GROUP = 'BFP')
        AND (M.B1_PER_TYPE = 'Enforcement')
        AND (M.B1_PER_SUB_TYPE = 'FDNY Summons')
        AND (M.B1_PER_CATEGORY = 'Correction Request')
        AND (
            B.B1_APPL_CLASS NOT LIKE 'INCOMPLETE%'
            OR B.B1_APPL_CLASS IS NULL
        )
)

WITH Returned_Values AS(
SELECT 
	apo.SERV_PROV_CODE,
	apo.B1_PER_ID1,
	apo.B1_PER_ID2,
	apo.B1_PER_ID3,
	apo.B1_ATTRIBUTE_VALUE
FROM
	b3apo_attribute apo
WHERE
    apo.b1_attribute_name IN ( 'BIN')
    AND apo.b1_apo_type IN ('ADDRESS')
	AND apo.B1_ATTRIBUTE_VALUE = @BINText
	-- AND apo.B1_ATTRIBUTE_VALUE IS NOT NULL

) --select * from Returned_Values

,do_unit AS 
(
   select
      SERV_PROV_CODE,
      B1_PER_ID1,
      B1_PER_ID2,
      B1_PER_ID3,
      [D.O.] as ACTDO,
      [Alpha Prefix] as ALPHAPREFIX,
	  [Permit Coverage Comments] as COVCOMMENTS


   from
      (
         SELECT
            bc.serv_prov_code AS SERV_PROV_CODE,
            bc.b1_per_id1 AS B1_PER_ID1,
            bc.b1_per_id2 AS B1_PER_ID2,
            bc.b1_per_id3 AS B1_PER_ID3,
            bc.b1_checkbox_desc,
            bc.b1_checklist_comment 
         FROM
            bchckbox bc 
JOIN Returned_Values rv ON  bc.SERV_PROV_CODE = rv.SERV_PROV_CODE
	AND bc.B1_PER_ID1 = rv.B1_PER_ID1
    AND bc.B1_PER_ID2 = rv.B1_PER_ID2
	AND bc.B1_PER_ID3 = rv.B1_PER_ID3
         WHERE
            bc.b1_checkbox_desc IN 
            (
               'Alpha Prefix',
               'D.O.',
			   'Permit Coverage Comments'

            )
            AND bc.b1_checkbox_type IN 
            (
               'PLAN INFORMATION',
               'PERMIT REPORT INFO'
            )
      )
      pvia PIVOT ( MAX(b1_checklist_comment) for b1_checkbox_desc IN
      (
         [D.O.],
         [Alpha Prefix],
		 [Permit Coverage Comments]
      )
) pvib 
)
,COV AS (
select
	serv_prov_code,
	b1_per_id1,
	b1_per_id2,
	b1_per_id3,
    ROW_INDEX,
    [Coverage Item] AS COVERAGE_ITEM,
    [Unit Name] AS Unit,
    [Quantity] AS Quantity, 
    [Floor Number] AS Floor_Number,
	[Details] AS Details,
    [Status] AS STATUS
     FROM (
     SELECT 
	 ba.serv_prov_code,
	 ba.b1_per_id1,
	 ba.b1_per_id2,
	 ba.b1_per_id3,
     ba.ROW_INDEX AS ROW_INDEX,
     ba.COLUMN_NAME,
     ba.attribute_value
    FROM
         bappspectable_value ba
JOIN Returned_Values rv ON  ba.SERV_PROV_CODE = rv.SERV_PROV_CODE
	AND ba.B1_PER_ID1 = rv.B1_PER_ID1
    AND ba.B1_PER_ID2 = rv.B1_PER_ID2
	AND ba.B1_PER_ID3 = rv.B1_PER_ID3
    WHERE
        ba.TABLE_NAME = 'COVERAGE INFORMATION'
         AND ba.COLUMN_NAME IN ( 'Coverage Item', 'Unit Name','Quantity','Floor Number','Status','Details' ))  pva  

    PIVOT (MAX (ATTRIBUTE_VALUE)
                                              FOR COLUMN_NAME
                                              IN  ([Coverage Item],
                                                   [Unit Name],
                                                   [Quantity],
                                                   [Floor Number],
                                                   [Status],
												   [Details])) pvb

  WHERE   Status = 'Active'
)

	apo.b1_per_id2 AS B1_PER_ID2,

    apo.b1_attribute_name,
    apo.b1_attribute_value
 FROM

	AND apo.B1_PER_ID1 = rv.B1_PER_ID1
    AND apo.B1_PER_ID2 = rv.B1_PER_ID2
	AND apo.B1_PER_ID3 = rv.B1_PER_ID3

WHERE
    apo.b1_attribute_name IN ( 'BIN', 'BLOCK','LOT' )
    AND apo.b1_apo_type IN ('ADDRESS')
    ) pva
PIVOT ( MAX(b1_attribute_value) for b1_attribute_name
            IN([BIN],
			[BLOCK],
			[LOT])) pvb
)

			AND bp.b1_per_type = 'Common'
			AND bp.b1_per_sub_type = 'Inspection'
			AND bp.b1_appl_status <> 'Inactive'
			AND ((CONVERT(DATE, bp.b1_appl_status_date) >= @StartDate) OR @StartDate IS NULL)
			AND ((CONVERT(DATE, bp.b1_appl_status_date) <= @EndDate) OR @EndDate IS NULL)
			AND CONVERT(VARCHAR, RIGHT('0' + bc.b1_checklist_comment, 2)) IN (@DONum)
