WITH PERMIT AS
(
select 
    serv_prov_code,
    b1_per_id1,
    b1_per_id2,
    b1_per_id3,
    ROW_INDEX,
    [Control Number] AS CONTROL_NUMBER,
    [Inspection ID] AS INSPECTION_ID,
    [Permit Issuance Date] AS PERM_ISS_DATE,
    [Permit Expiration Date] AS PERM_EXP_DATE, 
    [Permit Start Date] AS PERM_START_DATE,
    [Permit Printed] AS PERM_PRINTED,
    [Is Temporary Permit?] AS IS_TEMP_PERMIT
     FROM (
     SELECT 
    ba.serv_prov_code,
    ba.b1_per_id1,
    ba.b1_per_id2,
    ba.b1_per_id3,
    ROW_INDEX AS ROW_INDEX,
    ba.COLUMN_NAME,
    ba.attribute_value
    FROM
         bappspectable_value ba
JOIN #B1P rv ON ba.SERV_PROV_CODE = rv.SERV_PROV_CODE
	AND ba.B1_PER_ID1 = rv.B1_PER_ID1
	AND ba.B1_PER_ID2 = rv.B1_PER_ID2
	AND ba.B1_PER_ID3 = rv.B1_PER_ID3

    WHERE
          ba.TABLE_NAME = 'PERMIT EXPIRATION'
         AND ba.COLUMN_NAME IN ('Control Number', 'Inspection ID', 'Permit Issuance Date','Permit Expiration Date','Permit Start Date','Permit Printed','Is Temporary Permit?')
    )    pva

    PIVOT (MAX (ATTRIBUTE_VALUE)
                                               FOR COLUMN_NAME
                                               IN ([Control Number],
                                                   [Inspection ID],
                                                   [Permit Issuance Date],
                                                   [Permit Expiration Date],
                                                   [Permit Start Date],
                                                   [Permit Printed],

                OVER(PARTITION BY b.serv_prov_code, b.b1_per_id1, b.b1_per_id2, b.b1_per_id3

WITH PERMIT AS (

    serv_prov_code,

    b1_per_id2,
    b1_per_id3,
    ROW_INDEX,
	RN,
    CONTROL_NUMBER,
    INSPECTION_ID,
    PERM_ISS_DATE,
    PERM_EXP_DATE, 
    PERM_START_DATE,
    PERM_PRINTED,
   IS_TEMP_PERMIT
FROM (

select 
    serv_prov_code,
    b1_per_id1,
    b1_per_id2,
    b1_per_id3,
    ROW_INDEX,
    [Control Number] AS CONTROL_NUMBER,
    [Inspection ID] AS INSPECTION_ID,
    [Permit Issuance Date] AS PERM_ISS_DATE,
    [Permit Expiration Date] AS PERM_EXP_DATE, 
    [Permit Start Date] AS PERM_START_DATE,
    [Permit Printed] AS PERM_PRINTED,
    [Is Temporary Permit?] AS IS_TEMP_PERMIT,
	TRY_CONVERT(DATE,[Permit Expiration Date]) AS PERMIT_EXPIRATION,
	ROW_NUMBER()
          OVER(PARTITION BY serv_prov_code, b1_per_id1, b1_per_id2, b1_per_id3
          ORDER BY
          TRY_CONVERT(DATE,[Permit Expiration Date]) DESC 
          ) rn

     FROM (
     SELECT 
    ba.serv_prov_code,
    ba.b1_per_id1,
    ba.b1_per_id2,
    ba.b1_per_id3,
    ROW_INDEX AS ROW_INDEX,
    ba.COLUMN_NAME,
    ba.attribute_value
    FROM
         bappspectable_value ba
JOIN #B1P rv ON ba.SERV_PROV_CODE = rv.SERV_PROV_CODE
	AND ba.B1_PER_ID1 = rv.B1_PER_ID1
	AND ba.B1_PER_ID2 = rv.B1_PER_ID2
	AND ba.B1_PER_ID3 = rv.B1_PER_ID3
    WHERE
          ba.TABLE_NAME = 'PERMIT EXPIRATION'
         AND ba.COLUMN_NAME IN ('Control Number', 'Inspection ID', 'Permit Issuance Date','Permit Expiration Date','Permit Start Date','Permit Printed','Is Temporary Permit?')
    )    pva

    PIVOT (MAX (ATTRIBUTE_VALUE)
                                               FOR COLUMN_NAME
                                               IN ([Control Number],
                                                   [Inspection ID],
                                                   [Permit Issuance Date],
                                                   [Permit Expiration Date],
                                                   [Permit Start Date],
                                                   [Permit Printed],
                                                   [Is Temporary Permit?])) pvb

        ) tr
    WHERE
	     SERV_PROV_CODE = 'FDNY'
         AND RN = 1
)

--DECLARE  @ACCOUNTID VARCHAR(8)='00000067';
WITH do_unit AS (
select SERV_PROV_CODE,
       B1_PER_ID1,
	   B1_PER_ID2,
	   B1_PER_ID3,
	   [D.O.] as ACTDO,
	   [Alpha Prefix] as ALPHAPREFIX,
	   [Account Type] as ACTTYPE,
	   [No Fee] as NO_FEE,
	   [No Fee Date] as NO_FEE_DATE,
	   [Application Type] as UNIT 
 from 
(
SELECT
    bc.serv_prov_code AS SERV_PROV_CODE,
    bc.b1_per_id1 AS B1_PER_ID1,
    bc.b1_per_id2 AS B1_PER_ID2,
    bc.b1_per_id3 AS B1_PER_ID3,
    
    bc.b1_checkbox_desc,
    bc.b1_checklist_comment
 FROM
         bchckbox bc

WHERE
    bc.b1_checkbox_desc IN ( 'Alpha Prefix', 'D.O.','Account Type','Application Type','No Fee','No Fee Date' )
    AND bc.b1_checkbox_type IN ('PLAN INFORMATION', 'PERMIT REPORT INFO','FEE EXEMPTION INFORMATION')
    ) pvia
PIVOT ( MAX(b1_checklist_comment) for b1_checkbox_desc
            IN([D.O.],
			[Alpha Prefix],
			[Account Type],
			[No Fee],
			[No Fee Date],

			[Application Type])) pvib
),
bill_info AS
(
select 
    serv_prov_code,
    b1_per_id1,
    b1_per_id2,
    b1_per_id3,
    ROW_INDEX,
    [Bill Number] AS BILL_NUMBER,
    [Bill Type] AS BILL_TYPE,
    [Bill Date] AS BILL_DATE,
    [Bill Amount] AS BILL_AMOUNT, 
    [Clock Date] AS CLOCK_DATE,
    [Cycle Number] AS CYCLE_NUMBER,
    [First Reminder] AS FIRST_REMINDER,
    [Lien Notice] AS LIEN_NOTICE,
    [Account Type] AS ACCOUNT_TYPE
     FROM (
     SELECT 
    ba.serv_prov_code,
    ba.b1_per_id1,
    ba.b1_per_id2,
    ba.b1_per_id3,
    ROW_INDEX AS ROW_INDEX,
    ba.COLUMN_NAME,
    ba.attribute_value
    FROM
         bappspectable_value ba

    WHERE
          ba.TABLE_NAME = 'BILLING INFORMATION'
         AND ba.COLUMN_NAME IN ('Bill Number', 'Bill Type', 'Bill Date','Bill Amount','Clock Date','Cycle Number','First Reminder','Lien Notice','Account Type')
    )    pva

    PIVOT (MAX (ATTRIBUTE_VALUE)
                                               FOR COLUMN_NAME
                                               IN ([Bill Number],
                                                   [Bill Type],
                                                   [Bill Date],
                                                   [Bill Amount],
                                                   [Clock Date],
                                                   [Cycle Number],
                                                   [First Reminder],
                                                   [Lien Notice],
                                                   [Account Type])) pvb
),
lien AS (
SELECT
    b6.serv_prov_code,
	b6.b1_per_id1,
	b6.b1_per_id2,
	b6.b1_per_id3,
    b6.b1_con_typ AS con_typ,
    b6.b1_con_nbr AS con_nbr,
	RIGHT('0' + charge.field_value, 6) charge_num,
    reason.field_value   AS   reason,
    pstatus.field_value   AS  payment_status,
    CONVERT(DATE,b6.b1_con_iss_dd)    AS con_iss_dd,
    CONVERT(DATE,b6.b1_con_eff_dd1)    AS con_eff_dd

FROM
         b6condit b6

    LEFT JOIN gtmpl_attribute     charge ON b6.b1_con_nbr = charge.entity_seq1
                                        AND b6.b1_per_id1 = charge.entity_key1
                                        AND b6.b1_per_id2 = charge.entity_key2
                                        AND b6.b1_per_id3 = charge.entity_key3
                                        AND charge.entity_type = '11'
                                        AND charge.field_name = 'Charge Number'
    LEFT JOIN gtmpl_attribute     reason ON b6.b1_con_nbr = reason.entity_seq1
                                        AND b6.b1_per_id1 = reason.entity_key1
                                        AND b6.b1_per_id2 = reason.entity_key2
                                        AND b6.b1_per_id3 = reason.entity_key3
                                        AND reason.entity_type = '11'
                                        AND reason.field_name = 'Reason'
    LEFT JOIN gtmpl_attribute     pstatus ON b6.b1_con_nbr = pstatus.entity_seq1
                                         AND b6.b1_per_id1 = pstatus.entity_key1
                                         AND b6.b1_per_id2 = pstatus.entity_key2
                                         AND b6.b1_per_id3 = pstatus.entity_key3
                                         AND pstatus.entity_type = '11'
                                         AND pstatus.field_name = 'Payment Status'
WHERE
        b6.b1_con_typ = 'Lien'
    AND b6.rec_status = 'A'
    AND b6.serv_prov_code = 'FDNY'

),
APO AS (
select SERV_PROV_CODE,
		B1_PER_ID1,
		B1_PER_ID2,
		B1_PER_ID3,
		[BIN] as BIN,
		[BLOCK] as BLOCK,
		[LOT] as LOT
 from 
(
SELECT
    apo.serv_prov_code AS SERV_PROV_CODE,
    apo.b1_per_id1 AS B1_PER_ID1,
	apo.b1_per_id2 AS B1_PER_ID2,
    apo.b1_per_id3 AS B1_PER_ID3,
    apo.b1_attribute_name,
    apo.b1_attribute_value
 FROM
         b3apo_attribute apo

WHERE
    apo.b1_attribute_name IN ( 'BIN', 'BLOCK','LOT' )
    AND apo.b1_apo_type IN ('ADDRESS')
    ) pva
PIVOT ( MAX(b1_attribute_value) for b1_attribute_name
            IN([BIN],
			[BLOCK],
			[LOT])) pvb
),
contact AS (
    SELECT
        serv_prov_code,
        b1_per_id1,
        b1_per_id2,
        b1_per_id3,
        contact_name,
        rec_date,
        b1_contact_type
    FROM
        (
            SELECT
            b.serv_prov_code,
            b.b1_per_id1,
            b.b1_per_id2,
            b.b1_per_id3,
               ISNULL(b.b1_full_name,b.b1_business_name) as contact_name,
                b.rec_date,
                b.b1_contact_type,
                ROW_NUMBER()
                OVER(PARTITION BY b.serv_prov_code, b.b1_per_id1, b.b1_per_id2, b.b1_per_id3
                     ORDER BY
                         b.rec_date DESC 
                ) rn
            FROM
                b3contact b
            WHERE
                b.b1_contact_type IN ( 
                'Certification of Fitness Applicant', 
                'Respondent', 
                'Business Contact', 
                'Business Owner', 
                'Building Owner', 
                'Permit / LOA Contact', 
                'Billing Contact', 
                'Defendant', 
                'Authorized Person In charge', 
                'Applicant', 
                'Requestor', 
                'Filing Representative/Expeditor') and ISNULL(b.b1_full_name,b.b1_business_name) is not null

        ) tr
    WHERE
        rn = 1

result_data AS (

    ba.b1_str_name AS str_name,

    bi.FIRST_REMINDER,
    bi.LIEN_NOTICE,
    bi.ACCOUNT_TYPE,
    pd.app_status,
    pd.disposition,
    pd.balance,
    pd.total_fee,
    pd.total_pay,
	ln.con_typ,
    ln.con_nbr,
	ln.charge_num,

                                  AND ap.b1_per_id3 = bp.b1_per_id3

    bp.b1_appl_status

    -- Filter early on @DO_Number right at the driving set
    CONCAT(
        RIGHT('0' + MAX(CASE WHEN bc.b1_checkbox_desc = 'D.O.' THEN bc.b1_checklist_comment END), 2),
        ':',
        SUBSTRING(MAX(CASE WHEN bc.b1_checkbox_desc = 'Application Type' THEN bc.b1_checklist_comment END), 1, 30)
    ) IN (SELECT DO_Number FROM @DO_Numbers);

-- Create a clustered index for fast downstream joins
CREATE CLUSTERED INDEX CX_driving_permits 
ON #driving_permits (serv_prov_code, b1_per_id1, b1_per_id2, b1_per_id3);

-- 2. Fetch related data using targeted joins and APPLY
WITH coverage AS (
    SELECT
        bap.serv_prov_code,
        bap.b1_per_id1,
        bap.b1_per_id2,
        bap.b1_per_id3,
        MAX(CASE WHEN bap.column_name = 'Coverage Item' THEN bap.attribute_value END) AS ITEM_CODE,
        ISNULL(TRY_CONVERT(int, NULLIF(MAX(CASE WHEN bap.column_name = 'Quantity' THEN bap.attribute_value END), '')), 0) AS QUANTITY
    FROM BAPPSPECTABLE_VALUE bap
    INNER JOIN #driving_permits dp 
        ON  bap.serv_prov_code = dp.serv_prov_code
        AND bap.b1_per_id1     = dp.b1_per_id1
        AND bap.b1_per_id2     = dp.b1_per_id2
        AND bap.b1_per_id3     = dp.b1_per_id3
    WHERE bap.table_name = 'COVERAGE INFORMATION'
      AND ISNULL(bap.rec_status, 'A') = 'A'
    GROUP BY
        bap.serv_prov_code,
        bap.b1_per_id1,
        bap.b1_per_id2,
        bap.b1_per_id3,
        bap.row_index
    HAVING MAX(CASE WHEN bap.column_name = 'Status' THEN bap.attribute_value END) = 'Active'
),
bin_data AS (
    SELECT
        apo.serv_prov_code,
        apo.b1_per_id1,
        apo.b1_per_id2,
        apo.b1_per_id3,
        MAX(apo.b1_attribute_value) AS [BIN]
    FROM b3apo_attribute apo
    INNER JOIN #driving_permits dp 
        ON  apo.serv_prov_code = dp.serv_prov_code
        AND apo.b1_per_id1     = dp.b1_per_id1
        AND apo.b1_per_id2     = dp.b1_per_id2
        AND apo.b1_per_id3     = dp.b1_per_id3
    WHERE apo.b1_apo_type       = 'ADDRESS'
      AND apo.b1_attribute_name = 'BIN'
    GROUP BY
        apo.serv_prov_code,
        apo.b1_per_id1,
        apo.b1_per_id2,
        apo.b1_per_id3
),
final_set AS (
    SELECT
        dp.[DO#],
        dp.UNIT,
        dp.[ACCT#],
        dp.ACT_STATUS,
        ow.contact_name AS OWNER_NAME,
        ad.ADDRESS,
        ad.BORO,
        ad.ZIP,
        bn.BIN,
        cv.QUANTITY,
        cv.ITEM_CODE,
        COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY dp.[ACCT#]) AS acct_total_count
    FROM #driving_permits dp
    OUTER APPLY (
        SELECT TOP (1)
            COALESCE(
                b.b1_full_name,
                b.b1_business_name,
                CONCAT(b.b1_fname, ' ', b.b1_lname)
            ) AS contact_name
        FROM b3contact b
        WHERE b.serv_prov_code = dp.serv_prov_code
          AND b.b1_per_id1     = dp.b1_per_id1
          AND b.b1_per_id2     = dp.b1_per_id2
          AND b.b1_per_id3     = dp.b1_per_id3
          AND b.b1_contact_type IN ('Business Owner', 'Business Contact', 'Building Owner')
        ORDER BY b.rec_date DESC
    ) ow
    OUTER APPLY (
        SELECT TOP (1)
            CONCAT(a.b1_hse_nbr_alpha_start, ' ', a.b1_str_name) AS ADDRESS,
            a.b1_situs_city AS BORO,
            a.b1_situs_zip  AS ZIP
        FROM b3addres a
        WHERE a.serv_prov_code = dp.serv_prov_code
          AND a.b1_per_id1     = dp.b1_per_id1
          AND a.b1_per_id2     = dp.b1_per_id2
          AND a.b1_per_id3     = dp.b1_per_id3
        ORDER BY a.b1_primary_addr_flg DESC
    ) ad
    LEFT JOIN bin_data bn 
        ON  bn.serv_prov_code = dp.serv_prov_code
        AND bn.b1_per_id1     = dp.b1_per_id1
        AND bn.b1_per_id2     = dp.b1_per_id2
        AND bn.b1_per_id3     = dp.b1_per_id3
    LEFT JOIN coverage cv 
        ON  cv.serv_prov_code = dp.serv_prov_code
        AND cv.b1_per_id1     = dp.b1_per_id1
        AND cv.b1_per_id2     = dp.b1_per_id2
        AND cv.b1_per_id3     = dp.b1_per_id3
)
SELECT
    fs.[DO#],
    fs.UNIT,
    fs.[ACCT#],
    fs.ACT_STATUS,
    fs.OWNER_NAME,
    fs.ADDRESS,
    fs.BORO,
    fs.ZIP,
    fs.BIN,
    ISNULL(fs.QUANTITY, 0) AS QUANTITY,
    fs.ITEM_CODE,
    CASE WHEN fs.acct_total_count > 1 THEN 'Y' ELSE ' ' END AS DUPLICATE
FROM final_set fs
ORDER BY 
    fs.[DO#], 
    fs.UNIT, 
    fs.[ACCT#], 
    fs.ITEM_CODE;

WITH ASI AS
(

            ON A.SERV_PROV_CODE = BC.SERV_PROV_CODE
            AND A.B1_PER_ID1 = BC.B1_PER_ID1
            AND A.B1_PER_ID2 = BC.B1_PER_ID2
            AND A.B1_PER_ID3 = BC.B1_PER_ID3
        WHERE
            BC.SERV_PROV_CODE = 'FDNY'
            AND BC.REC_STATUS = 'A'
            AND BC.B1_ACT_STATUS IN ('BFP_VO_DET', 'BFP_FSUM')
            AND BC.B1_PER_SUB_TYPE IN ('VO Details', 'FDNY Summons')

                'SUMMONS INFORMATION',
                'HEARING DATE',
                'INSPECTION INFO',
                'INFRACTION INFORMATION'
            )
            AND BC.B1_CHECKBOX_DESC IN (
                'Creation Date/Time',

        rn = 1

        B1PERMIT.B1_ALT_ID = @RECORD_ID

WITH alpha_pfx AS (
select SERV_PROV_CODE,
	   B1_PER_ID1,
	   B1_PER_ID2,
	   B1_PER_ID3,
	   [FPIMS Annual Fee] AS FPIMS_ANNUAL_FEE

from 
(
SELECT
    bc.serv_prov_code AS SERV_PROV_CODE,
    bc.b1_per_id1 AS B1_PER_ID1,
    bc.b1_per_id2 AS B1_PER_ID2,
    bc.b1_per_id3 AS B1_PER_ID3,
    bc.b1_checkbox_desc,
    bc.b1_checklist_comment
 FROM
         bchckbox bc

WHERE
    bc.b1_checkbox_desc IN ( 'FPIMS Annual Fee' )
    AND bc.b1_checkbox_type IN ('PLAN INFORMATION')
    ) pva
PIVOT ( MAX(b1_checklist_comment) for b1_checkbox_desc
            IN([FPIMS Annual Fee])) pvb
),
coverage AS (
    SELECT
        serv_prov_code,
        b1_per_id1, b1_per_id2, b1_per_id3,
        row_index,
        LTRIM(RTRIM(SUBSTRING([Coverage Item], 1, 6))) AS coverage_item,
        [Quantity]                   AS quantity_raw,
        [Status]                     AS status
    FROM (
        SELECT
            bap.serv_prov_code,
            bap.b1_per_id1, bap.b1_per_id2, bap.b1_per_id3,
            bap.row_index,
            bap.column_name,
            bap.attribute_value
        FROM BAPPSPECTABLE_VALUE AS bap
        WHERE bap.table_name     = 'COVERAGE INFORMATION'
          AND bap.serv_prov_code = 'FDNY'
          AND ISNULL(bap.rec_status, 'A') = 'A'
    ) src
    PIVOT (
        MAX(attribute_value)
        FOR column_name IN ([Coverage Item], [Quantity], [Status])
    ) p
    WHERE NULLIF([Coverage Item], '') IS NOT NULL
),
fee AS (
    SELECT
        rf.serv_prov_code,
        LTRIM(RTRIM(SUBSTRING(rf.R1_GF_L3, 1, 6))) AS coverage_item_code,
        TRY_CONVERT(decimal(18,4), rf.R1_GF_FORMULA) AS coverage_amount
    FROM RFEEITEM AS rf
    WHERE rf.serv_prov_code = 'FDNY'
),
records AS (
    SELECT
        bp.serv_prov_code,
        bp.b1_per_id1, bp.b1_per_id2, bp.b1_per_id3,
        bp.b1_alt_id AS account_number
    FROM b1permit AS bp
    WHERE bp.serv_prov_code = 'FDNY'
      AND bp.b1_per_type = 'Common'
      AND bp.b1_per_sub_type = 'Inspection'
      AND bp.rec_status = 'A'
      AND (bp.b1_alt_id = @ACCOUNTID)
),
result_data as (
SELECT DISTINCT
  r.account_number,
  ap.FPIMS_ANNUAL_FEE,
  c.quantity_raw,
  f.coverage_item_code,
  f.coverage_amount
 
FROM records r
JOIN coverage c
  ON r.serv_prov_code = c.serv_prov_code
 AND r.b1_per_id1     = c.b1_per_id1
 AND r.b1_per_id2     = c.b1_per_id2
 AND r.b1_per_id3     = c.b1_per_id3

                                   AND r.b1_per_id1 = ap.b1_per_id1
                                   AND r.b1_per_id2 = ap.b1_per_id2
                                   AND r.b1_per_id3 = ap.b1_per_id3 
JOIN fee f
  ON f.serv_prov_code     = c.serv_prov_code
 AND f.coverage_item_code = c.coverage_item
WHERE ISNULL(c.status, 'Active') = 'Active'
   AND r.serv_prov_code = 'FDNY'
      AND (r.account_number = @ACCOUNTID)
)
--select * from result_data
SELECT
  rd.account_number,
  rd.FPIMS_ANNUAL_FEE,
  SUM(CAST(ISNULL(TRY_CONVERT(int, NULLIF(rd.quantity_raw, '')), 0) * ISNULL(rd.coverage_amount, 0) AS decimal(18,2))) AS YEARLY_FEE
FROM result_data rd
WHERE
    rd.FPIMS_ANNUAL_FEE is not null
GROUP BY 
  rd.account_number,
  rd.FPIMS_ANNUAL_FEE

    AND b.b1_per_type = 'Common'
    AND b.b1_per_sub_type = 'Inspection'

    MIN(GF_FEE_APPLY_DATE) AS GF_FEE_APPLY_DATE,
    OWNER_NAME,
    GF_ITEM_STATUS_FLAG,
    FEE_NOTES,
    WORKFLOWTASK,
    WORKFLOWSTATUS,
    INSP_ACCT_TYPE,
    INSP_STATUS,
    NO_FEE

FROM new_status ine

GROUP BY

    UNIT,
    DONUM,
    APPLICATIONSTATUS,
    B1_APP_TYPE_ALIAS,
    OWNER_NAME,
    GF_ITEM_STATUS_FLAG,
    FEE_NOTES,
    WORKFLOWTASK,
    WORKFLOWSTATUS,
    INSP_ACCT_TYPE,
    NO_FEE,
    INSP_STATUS
HAVING SUM(FEEAMOUNT) > 1
ORDER BY 
    UNIT,
    DONUM DESC;

function updateRecordDetails(taskName, taskStatus, taskComment, taskToActivate, taskToDeactivate, appStatusToSet) {
    if (taskName != null) {
        updateTask(taskName, taskStatus, taskComment, """", """", capId);
    }
    if (taskToActivate != null) {
        activateWorkflowTaskByCapId(taskToActivate, capId);
        updateTask(taskToActivate, ""Pending Review"", taskComment, """", """", capId);
        if (taskToActivate == ""Supervisor Review"") {
            updateAppNameTaskCard();
        }
    }
    if (taskToDeactivate != null) {
        if (taskToDeactivate != ""Conduct Inspection"" || (taskToDeactivate == ""Conduct Inspection"" && !reInspectionScheduledFlag)) {
            deactivateWorkflowTaskByCapId(taskToDeactivate, capId);
        }
    }
    if (appStatusToSet != null) {
        updateAppStatus(appStatusToSet, """", capId);
    }
}

function updateAppNameTaskCard() {
    var cap = aa.cap.getCap(capId).getOutput().getCapModel();
    var appName = getInspectorName() + ""; "" + inspType;
    
    if (appName.length > 150) {
        appName = appName.substring(0,146) + "" ..."";
    }
    editAppName(appName, capId);
    aa.print(""Updated Task Card: "" + appName);
}

function closeDBQueryObject(rSet, sStmt, conn) {
    try {
        if (rSet) {
            rSet.close();
            rSet = null;
        }
    } catch (vError) {
        aa.print(""Failed to close the database result set object."" + vError);
    }
    try {
        if (sStmt) {
            sStmt.close();
            sStmt = null;
        }
    } catch (vError) {
        aa.print(""Failed to close the database prepare statement object."" + vError);
    }
    try {
        if (conn) {
            conn.close();
            conn = null;
        }
    } catch (vError) {
        aa.print(""Failed to close the database connection."" + vError);
    }
}

function getInfractionCodeItemsFromDB(vCode, itemText) {
    var result = new Array();
    var sql = ""SELECT TABLE_NAME,COLUMN_INDEX,ROW_INDEX FROM BAPPSPECTABLE_VALUE WHERE SERV_PROV_CODE = 'FDNY' AND GROUP_NAME = 'MAPPING_INFO' AND COLUMN_NAME = 'Infraction Code' AND ATTRIBUTE_VALUE LIKE '"" + vCode + ""'"";
    //aa.print(sql);
    var vError = '';
    var conn = null;
    var sStmt = null;
    var rSet = null;
    try {
        var conn = aa.db.getConnection();

        sStmt = conn.prepareStatement(sql);
        rSet = sStmt.executeQuery();
        while (rSet.next()) {
            var ignoreRow = false;
            var tName = rSet.getString(""TABLE_NAME"");
            var vColIndex = rSet.getString(""COLUMN_INDEX"");
            var vRowIndex = rSet.getString(""ROW_INDEX"");

            //var nextSQL = ""SELECT COLUMN_NAME,ATTRIBUTE_VALUE FROM BAPPSPECTABLE_VALUE WHERE SERV_PROV_CODE = 'FDNY' AND GROUP_NAME = 'MAPPING_INFO' AND TABLE_NAME = '"" + tName + ""' AND COLUMN_INDEX = '"" + vColIndex + ""' AND ROW_INDEX = '"" + vRowIndex + ""' "";
            var nextSQL = ""SELECT COLUMN_NAME,ATTRIBUTE_VALUE FROM BAPPSPECTABLE_VALUE WHERE SERV_PROV_CODE = 'FDNY' AND GROUP_NAME = 'MAPPING_INFO' AND TABLE_NAME = '"" + tName + ""' AND ROW_INDEX = '"" + vRowIndex + ""' "";
            //aa.print(nextSQL);
            var vError = '';
            var vNextconn = null;
            var sNextStmt = null;
            var rNextSet = null;
            try {
                var vNextconn = aa.db.getConnection();
                var mappingObj = new Object();
                mappingObj.checklistStatus = """";
                mappingObj.checklistItem = """";
                mappingObj.infractionCodes = """";
                mappingObj.infractionNames = """";
                mappingObj.remedy = """";
                mappingObj.vcDescription = """";
                mappingObj.voDescription = """";
                mappingObj.violationCategory = """";
                mappingObj.compliancePeriod = """";
                mappingObj.detailFields = """";
                var sNextStmt = vNextconn.prepareStatement(nextSQL);
                var rNextSet = sNextStmt.executeQuery();
                while (rNextSet.next()) {
                    var vColName = rNextSet.getString(""COLUMN_NAME"") + """";
                    var vAttVal = rNextSet.getString(""ATTRIBUTE_VALUE"");
                    switch (vColName) {
                        case ""Checklist Status"":
                            mappingObj.checklistStatus = isNull(rNextSet.getString(""ATTRIBUTE_VALUE""),"""");
                            break;
                        case ""Checklist Item"":
                            mappingObj.checklistItem = itemText;
                            break;
                        case ""Infraction Code"":
                            mappingObj.infractionCodes = isNull(rNextSet.getString(""ATTRIBUTE_VALUE""),"""");
                            if (mappingObj.infractionCodes.indexOf(vCode) == -1) { //Added by Chetan on 2/8/23 to fix FDNY-11820. 
                                //This SQL is probably not ignoring the deleted rows from the Mapping table.
                                ignoreRow = true;
                            }
                            break;
                        case ""Infraction Name"":
                            mappingObj.infractionNames = isNull(rNextSet.getString(""ATTRIBUTE_VALUE""),"""");
                            break;
                        case ""Infraction Description"":
                            mappingObj.infractionNames = isNull(rNextSet.getString(""ATTRIBUTE_VALUE""),"""");
                            break;
                        case ""Remedy"":
                            mappingObj.remedy = isNull(rNextSet.getString(""ATTRIBUTE_VALUE""),"""");
                            break;
                        case ""VC Description"":
                            mappingObj.vcDescription = isNull(rNextSet.getString(""ATTRIBUTE_VALUE""),"""");
                            break;
                        case ""VO Description"":
                            mappingObj.voDescription = isNull(rNextSet.getString(""ATTRIBUTE_VALUE""),"""");
                            break;
                        case ""Violation Category"":
                            mappingObj.violationCategory = isNull(rNextSet.getString(""ATTRIBUTE_VALUE""),"""");
                            break;
                        case ""Compliance Period"":
                            mappingObj.compliancePeriod = isNull(rNextSet.getString(""ATTRIBUTE_VALUE""),"""");
                            break;
                        case ""Detail Fields"":
                            mappingObj.detailFields = isNull(rNextSet.getString(""ATTRIBUTE_VALUE""),"""");
                            break;
                    }
                }

            } catch (vError) {
                aa.print(""nextSQL - Runtime error occurred: "" + vError);
            }
            closeDBQueryObject(rNextSet, sNextStmt, vNextconn);
/*            aa.print(""----------------------------------------------"");
            aa.print(""checklistStatus: ""+mappingObj.checklistStatus);
            aa.print(""checklistItem: ""+mappingObj.checklistItem);
            aa.print(""infractionCodes: ""+mappingObj.infractionCodes);
            aa.print(""infractionNames: ""+mappingObj.infractionNames);
            aa.print(""remedy: ""+mappingObj.remedy);
            aa.print(""vcDescription: ""+mappingObj.vcDescription);
            aa.print(""voDescription: ""+mappingObj.voDescription);
            aa.print(""violationCategory: ""+mappingObj.violationCategory);
            aa.print(""compliancePeriod: ""+mappingObj.compliancePeriod);
            aa.print(""detailFields: ""+mappingObj.detailFields);
            aa.print(""----------------------------------------------"");*/
            if (!ignoreRow) {
                result.push(mappingObj);
            }
        }
    } catch (vError) {
        aa.print(""SQL - Runtime error occurred: "" + vError);
    }
    closeDBQueryObject(rSet, sStmt, conn);
    return result;
}

function createEnforcementsFromGuideSheetResults(inspModel, inspResult) {
    /*
     * Iterate through the Guidesheet items on an Inspection test and return a
     * list of non-compliant Violation order codes @param inspModel - The
     * Inspection Model of the Inspection test @return - Array with the
     * Violation order codes
     */

     var guidesheet = inspModel.getGuideSheets();
     var infractionObjList = new Array();
     var fdnySummonsList = new Array();
     var losfdnySummonsList = new Array();
     var noticeOfDefectList = new Array();
     var isFalseCertification = false;
     var auditInspValues = lookup(""ECB_FALSE_CERTIFICATION_INSPECTIONS"", ""Inspection Type"");
     logDebug(""Inspection type1 : "" + inspModel.getInspectionType());
     if (auditInspValues) {
        var auditInspValuesArray = auditInspValues.split(""|"");
        for (var i in auditInspValuesArray) {
            if (auditInspValuesArray[i] == (inspModel.getInspectionType() + """")) {
                isFalseCertification = true;
                break;
            }
        }
    }
    if (guidesheet) {
        var checklistGroupID = 1;
        guidesheetArray = guidesheet.toArray();
        inspectionChecklistList = guidesheetArray;
        var isNonJurisdictionBuilding = processGeneralInformation(guidesheetArray);
        if (isNonJurisdictionBuilding || inspResult == ""Approved"") {
            populateInspectionInformationASIT();
            return;
        }
        processEnforcementAffidavitInformation(guidesheetArray);
        issuingUnitValue = getIssuingUnit();
        var internalMappingRecord = getInternalMappingRecord();
        var enhancedInternalMapping = populateChecklistMappingsX(internalMappingRecord, ""ENHANCED INSPECTION"");

        for (var x in guidesheetArray) {
            checklistGroupID = getChecklistGroupID(guidesheetArray[x]);
            var guidesheetType = guidesheetArray[x].getGuideType();
            if (matches(guidesheetType, ""RH DRY TEST FES DESGN AND INST"",""RH DRY TEST FES INFO"",""RH DRY TEST FES PERFM TEST"",""RH DRY TEST SPEC HAZD INFO"",
                                        ""DESIGN AND INSTALLATION RH SHT"", ""FES PERFORMANCE TEST RH SHT"")) {
                isRHDryChemicalTest = true;
            }
            var guidesheetItems = guidesheetArray[x].getItems().toArray();
            var mappingASITName = getChecklistASITNameMappingX(guidesheetArray[x]); //lookup(""CHECKLIST_MAPPING_ASIT_MAPPING"", inspType);
            var inspectionInternalMapping = populateChecklistMappingsX(internalMappingRecord, mappingASITName);
            var internalMapping;
            var checklistType = ""INSPECTION"";
            if (guidesheetType == ""Enhanced Inspection Checklist"") {
                internalMapping = enhancedInternalMapping;
                checklistType = ""ENHANCED"";
            } else {
                internalMapping = inspectionInternalMapping;
                checklistType = ""INSPECTION"";
                if (guidesheetType == ""RH CC TEST FES INFO"" || guidesheetType == ""RH DRY TEST FES INFO"" ||
                    guidesheetType == ""ARCS SYSTEM INFORMATION"" || guidesheetType == ""ARCS OPS BLG PROFILE & SYS INF"" ||
                    guidesheetType == ""RH OPS AND MAINT OF FES"" || guidesheetType == ""VEHICLE AND HAZMAT DESCRIPTION"" ||
                    guidesheetType == ""FILING INFORMATION WPA"" ||  guidesheetType == ""CONTRACTORS INFORMATION"" ||
                    guidesheetType == ""LOA COVERAGE WPA"" ||  guidesheetType == ""CONTROLLER INFORMATION"" || 
                    guidesheetType == ""FILING INFORMATION RH"" || guidesheetType == ""REPORT COVERAGE"" ||
                    guidesheetType == ""FES DESCRIPTION"" || guidesheetType == ""04-LOA Coverage"") {
                    processLOAPermitInfo(guidesheetItems);
                }
            }
            for (var loopi in guidesheetItems) {
                var guidesheetItem = guidesheetItems[loopi];
                var itemText = guidesheetItem.getGuideItemText();
                aa.print(""***itemText: "" + itemText);
                var itemStatus = guidesheetItem.getGuideItemStatus();
                var itemComment = guidesheetItem.getGuideItemComment();            
                //var internalMappingObj = internalMapping.get(itemText);
                if (itemText == ""Create separate account(s)?"" && itemStatus != ""N/A"" && guidesheetType == ""FAIU Line of Sight Checklist"") {
                    break;
                }
                var internalMappingObj = null;
                if (inspectionInternalMapping)
                    internalMappingObj = inspectionInternalMapping.get(itemText);
                
                var vIsItemATextBoxX = isItemATextBox(guidesheetItem, internalMappingObj, mappingASITName);
                var checkedInfractionCodes = getCheckedInfractionCodesX(guidesheetItem, internalMappingObj, mappingASITName,vIsItemATextBoxX);
                /*if(mappingASITName == ""DISTRICT OFFICE 2"" && checkedInfractionCodes.length > 1) {
                    internalMappingObj = null;
                }*/
                
                if (internalMappingObj == null || (vIsItemATextBoxX != false && vIsItemATextBoxX != null && vIsItemATextBoxX != """")) {
                    var count = 0;
                    for (var ii in checkedInfractionCodes) {
                        var vCode = String(checkedInfractionCodes[ii]).trim();
                        aa.print(""Values: "" + vCode + ""|"" + itemText);
                        var res = getInfractionCodeItemsFromDB(vCode, itemText);
                        if (res && res.length > 0) {
                            if(count == 0)
                                internalMappingObj = res[0]; //taking first if multiple exists
                            if(count >= 1)
                            {
                                internalMappingObj.infractionCodes += ""|""+ res[0].infractionCodes;
                                internalMappingObj.infractionNames += ""|""+ res[0].infractionNames;
                                internalMappingObj.remedy += ""|""+ res[0].remedy;
                                internalMappingObj.vcDescription += ""|""+ res[0].vcDescription;
                                internalMappingObj.voDescription += ""|""+ res[0].voDescription;
                                internalMappingObj.violationCategory += ""|""+ res[0].violationCategory;
                                internalMappingObj.compliancePeriod += ""|""+ res[0].compliancePeriod;
                                internalMappingObj.detailFields += ""|""+ res[0].detailFields;
                            }
                            count++;
                        }
                    }
                }

                if (itemText != null && itemText != """" && internalMappingObj != null) {
                    var infractionCodes = internalMappingObj.infractionCodes;
                    if (infractionCodes != null) {
                        var violationOrderComplianceCheck = (internalMappingObj.checklistStatus == itemStatus) ? true : false;
                        if (violationOrderComplianceCheck != null && violationOrderComplianceCheck) {
                            var checkedInfractionCodes = getCheckedInfractionCodesX(guidesheetItem, internalMappingObj, mappingASITName,vIsItemATextBoxX);
                            var checkedEnforcements = getCheckedEnforcements(guidesheetItem);
                            if (internalMappingObj.detailFields != null && internalMappingObj.detailFields != """") {
                                internalMappingObj = getAdditionalASIFields(guidesheetItem, internalMappingObj);
                            }
                            internalMappingObj.comment = itemComment;
                            aa.print(""CHECKED INFRACTION CODES: ""+ checkedInfractionCodes);
                            aa.print(""checkedEnforcements: ""+ checkedEnforcements);
                            for (enfIndex in checkedEnforcements) {
                                var enforcementType = checkedEnforcements[enfIndex];
                                for (infIndex in checkedInfractionCodes) {
                                    var infractionCode = String(checkedInfractionCodes[infIndex]).trim();
                                    logDebug(""enforcementType "" + enforcementType);
                                    logDebug(""infractionCode "" + infractionCode);
                                    if (enforcementType == ""FDNY Summons"") {
                                        var fdnySummonsObj = new Object();
                                        fdnySummonsObj.infractionCode = infractionCode;
                                        fdnySummonsObj.checklistType = checklistType;
                                        fdnySummonsObj.internalMappingObj = internalMappingObj;
                                       // aa.print(""internalMappingObj.infractionCodes: ""+ internalMappingObj.remedy);
                                        fdnySummonsObj.infIndex = infIndex;
                                        fdnySummonsObj.isEnhancedInfraction = false;
                                        if (guidesheetType == ""Enhanced Inspection Checklist"" || guidesheetType == ""Suppression Survey"") {
                                            fdnySummonsObj.isEnhancedInfraction = true;
                                            losfdnySummonsList.push(fdnySummonsObj);
                                            enhancedSuppressionViolationIssued = true;
                                        } else {
                                            fdnySummonsList.push(fdnySummonsObj);
                                        }

                                    } else if (enforcementType == ""Notice of Defect"") {
                                        var noticeOfDefectObj = new Object();
                                        noticeOfDefectObj.checklistItem = itemText;
                                        noticeOfDefectObj.sfo = infractionCode;
                                        noticeOfDefectObj.sfoList = internalMappingObj.infractionCodes;
                                        noticeOfDefectObj.description = internalMappingObj.vcDescription;
                                        noticeOfDefectObj.remedy = internalMappingObj.remedy;
                                        noticeOfDefectObj.nodDescription = internalMappingObj.nodDescription;
                                        noticeOfDefectObj.comment = guidesheetItem.getGuideItemComment();
                                        noticeOfDefectList.push(noticeOfDefectObj);
                                    } else {
                                        if (guidesheetType != ""Suppression Survey"") {
                                            nonEnhancedViolationIssued = true;
                                        } else {
                                            enhancedSuppressionViolationIssued = true;
                                        }
                                        createEnforcementRecord(enforcementType, infractionCode, infIndex, internalMappingObj, guidesheetType, checklistGroupID);
                                    }
                                }
                            }
                        }
                    }
                } else {
                    aa.print(""No Mapping Entry for: "" + itemText);
                }
            }
        }
    }
    // scheduleReInspection();
    aa.print(""fdnySummonsList.length: "" + fdnySummonsList.length);
    aa.print(""losfdnySummonsList.length: "" + losfdnySummonsList.length);
    //Updated as per FDNY-10032
    if (fdnySummonsList.length > 0) {
        fdnySummonsList.sort(compare); //Sorting as per FDNY-10065
        CheckAndGenerateSummons(fdnySummonsList, inspModel, isFalseCertification);
        nonEnhancedViolationIssued = true;
    }

    if (losfdnySummonsList.length > 0) {
        losfdnySummonsList.sort(compare); //Sorting as per FDNY-10065      
        CheckAndGenerateSummons(losfdnySummonsList, inspModel, isFalseCertification);
    }

    populateEnforcementInformationASITs();
    populateInspectionInformationASIT();
    populateCoverageInformation();
    if (noticeOfDefectList.length > 0) {
        nonEnhancedViolationIssued = true;
        generateLetterOfDefect(noticeOfDefectList, inspType, true, inspId, false);
    }
    return infractionObjList;
}

function compare(a, b) {
    const vcA = getVCCodeFromFdnySummonsList(a);
    const vcB = getVCCodeFromFdnySummonsList(b)

    var comparison = 0;
    if (vcA > vcB) {
        comparison = 1;
    } else if (vcA < vcB) {
        comparison = -1;
    }
    return comparison;
}

function getVCCodeFromFdnySummonsList(obj) {
    var infractionCode = obj.infractionCode;
    var infractionDetailsObj = obj.internalMappingObj;

    var vcCode = """";
    var infIndex = 0;
    var splitInfractionCodes = (infractionDetailsObj.infractionCodes + """").split(""|"");
    for (var i in splitInfractionCodes) {
        if (splitInfractionCodes[i] == infractionCode) {
            infIndex = i;
            break;
        }
    }
    if (splitInfractionCodes.length > 1) {                
        var splitViolationCategory = (infractionDetailsObj.violationCategory + """").split(""|"");
        if (splitViolationCategory.length > infIndex)
            vcCode = splitViolationCategory[infIndex];
    } else {
        vcCode = infractionDetailsObj.violationCategory;
    }
    return vcCode;
}
//Updated as per FDNY-10032
function CheckAndGenerateSummons(fdnySummonsList, inspModel, isFalseCertification) {
    var fdnyNonRepeatSummonsList = new Array();

    var RepeatAffenderResult = checkRepeatOffenderSummonsCreation(capId, fdnySummonsList, inspModel);
    var repeatVOList = [];

    for (i in RepeatAffenderResult) {
        isSummonExist = false;
        for (x in repeatVOList) {
            if (repeatVOList[x].summonsRecordId == RepeatAffenderResult[i]) {
                isSummonExist = true;
                continue;
            }
        }
        if (!isSummonExist) {
            var repeatVOSummon = {};
            repeatVOSummon.summonsRecordId = RepeatAffenderResult[i];
            repeatVOSummon.fdnyRepeatSummonsList = [];
            repeatVOList.push(repeatVOSummon);
        }
    }

    for (i in fdnySummonsList) {
        if (RepeatAffenderResult[fdnySummonsList[i].internalMappingObj.violationCategory] != null) {
            for (x in repeatVOList) {
                if (repeatVOList[x].summonsRecordId == RepeatAffenderResult[fdnySummonsList[i].internalMappingObj.violationCategory]) {
                    repeatVOList[x].fdnyRepeatSummonsList.push(fdnySummonsList[i]);
                    break;
                }
            }
        } else if (fdnySummonsList[i].internalMappingObj.violationCategory.indexOf(""|"") > -1) {
            var violationCategoryArray = fdnySummonsList[i].internalMappingObj.violationCategory.split(""|"");
            var vcAdded = false;
            for (var n in violationCategoryArray) {
                if (RepeatAffenderResult[violationCategoryArray[n]] != null) {
                    for (x in repeatVOList) {
                        if (repeatVOList[x].summonsRecordId == RepeatAffenderResult[violationCategoryArray[n]]) {
                            if (!vcAdded) {
                                repeatVOList[x].fdnyRepeatSummonsList.push(fdnySummonsList[i]);
                                vcAdded = true;
                                break;
                            }
                        }
                    }

                } else {
                    fdnyNonRepeatSummonsList.push(fdnySummonsList[i]);
                    break;
                }

            }
        } else {
            fdnyNonRepeatSummonsList.push(fdnySummonsList[i]);
        }
    }

    aa.print(""repeatVOList.length: "" + repeatVOList.length);
    aa.print(""fdnyNonRepeatSummonsList.length: "" + fdnyNonRepeatSummonsList.length);

    if (repeatVOList.length > 0) {
        for (x in repeatVOList) {
            generateFDNYSummonsRecord(repeatVOList[x].fdnyRepeatSummonsList, ""repeat"", isFalseCertification, inspModel, repeatVOList[x].summonsRecordId);
            //logDebug(""repeat summon created for "" + repeatVOList[x].summonsRecordId);
        }
    }

    if (fdnyNonRepeatSummonsList.length > 0) {
        generateFDNYSummonsRecord(fdnyNonRepeatSummonsList, ""nonrepeat"", isFalseCertification, inspModel);
    }
}

function populateNoticeOfDefectLetterFromGuideSheet(inspModel) {
    /*
     * Iterate through the Guidesheet items on an Inspection test and return a
     * list of non-compliant Violation order codes @param inspModel - The
     * Inspection Model of the Inspection test @return - Array with the
     * Violation order codes
     */
     var guidesheet = inspModel.getGuideSheets();
     var infractionObjList = new Array();
     var noticeOfDefectList = new Array();
     if (guidesheet) {
        guidesheetArray = guidesheet.toArray();
        inspectionChecklistList = guidesheetArray;
        var internalMappingRecord = getInternalMappingRecord();
        for (var x in guidesheetArray) {
            var mappingASITName = getChecklistASITNameMappingX(guidesheetArray[x]);
            var inspectionInternalMapping = populateChecklistMappingsX(internalMappingRecord, mappingASITName);
            var guidesheetType = guidesheetArray[x].getGuideType();
            var guidesheetItems = guidesheetArray[x].getItems().toArray();
            var internalMapping = inspectionInternalMapping;
            if (internalMapping == null) {
                continue;
            }
            var checklistType = ""INSPECTION"";

            for (var loopi in guidesheetItems) {
                var guidesheetItem = guidesheetItems[loopi];
                var itemText = guidesheetItem.getGuideItemText();
                var itemStatus = guidesheetItem.getGuideItemStatus();
                var itemComment = guidesheetItem.getGuideItemComment();
                var internalMappingObj = internalMapping.get(itemText);

                if (itemText != null && itemText != """" && internalMapping != null && internalMappingObj != null) {
                    var infractionCodes = internalMappingObj.infractionCodes;
                    if (infractionCodes != null) {
                        var complianceCheck = (internalMappingObj.checklistStatus == itemStatus) ? true : false;
                        if (complianceCheck != null && complianceCheck) {
                            /*var checkedEnforcements = getCheckedEnforcements(guidesheetItem);
                            if (checkedEnforcements[""Notice of Defect""] != null) {
                                internalMappingObj.comment = itemComment;
                                var splitInfractionCodes = infractionCodes.split(""|"");
                                for (var i in splitInfractionCodes) {
                                    var noticeOfDefectObj = new Object();
                                    noticeOfDefectObj.checklistItem = itemText;
                                    noticeOfDefectObj.sfo = splitInfractionCodes[i];
                                    noticeOfDefectObj.description = internalMappingObj.vcDescription;
                                    noticeOfDefectObj.remedy = internalMappingObj.remedy;
                                    noticeOfDefectObj.comment = guidesheetItem.getGuideItemComment();
                                    noticeOfDefectList.push(noticeOfDefectObj);
                                }
                            }*/

                            var checkedInfractionCodes = getCheckedInfractionCodes(guidesheetItem, internalMappingObj);
                            var checkedEnforcements = getCheckedEnforcements(guidesheetItem);
                            if (internalMappingObj.detailFields != null && internalMappingObj.detailFields != """") {
                                internalMappingObj = getAdditionalASIFields(guidesheetItem, internalMappingObj);
                            }
                            internalMappingObj.comment = itemComment;
                            for (enfIndex in checkedEnforcements) {
                                var enforcementType = checkedEnforcements[enfIndex];
                                for (infIndex in checkedInfractionCodes) {
                                    var infractionCode = checkedInfractionCodes[infIndex];
                                    if (enforcementType == ""Notice of Defect"") {
                                        var noticeOfDefectObj = new Object();
                                        noticeOfDefectObj.checklistItem = itemText;
                                        noticeOfDefectObj.sfo = infractionCode;
                                        noticeOfDefectObj.sfoList = internalMappingObj.infractionCodes;
                                        noticeOfDefectObj.description = internalMappingObj.vcDescription;
                                        noticeOfDefectObj.remedy = internalMappingObj.remedy;
                                        noticeOfDefectObj.nodDescription = internalMappingObj.nodDescription;
                                        noticeOfDefectObj.comment = guidesheetItem.getGuideItemComment();
                                        noticeOfDefectList.push(noticeOfDefectObj);
                                    }
                                }
                            }
                        }
                    }
                } else {
                    aa.print(""No Mapping Entry for: "" + itemText);
                }
            }
        }

        for (var x in guidesheetArray) {
            var guidesheetType = guidesheetArray[x].getGuideType();
            if (guidesheetType == ""General Information"" || guidesheetType == ""General Information Annual"" || guidesheetType == ""RT GENERAL INFORMATION"") {
                var guidesheetItems = guidesheetArray[x].getItems().toArray();
                for (var loopi in guidesheetItems) {
                    var guidesheetItem = guidesheetItems[loopi];
                    var itemText = guidesheetItem.getGuideItemText();
                    var itemStatus = guidesheetItem.getGuideItemStatus();
                    if (itemText != null && itemText == ""2. General Information"" && itemStatus == ""Complete"") {
                        aa.print(""*** General Information: "" + itemText);
                        peopleASITArr = peopleASITArr.concat(getApplianceASITInformation(guidesheetItem));
                        break;
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }

    return noticeOfDefectList;
}

function generateLetterOfDefect(noticeOfDefectList, inspType, setReTestDate, inspectionID) {
    var reportType = ""Electrical"";
    var asitValue = ""NOTICE OF DEFECT ELECTRICAL"";
    var currDate = new Date();
    var currDatePlusNinety = addDays(currDate, 90);
    var applicationType = getAppSpecific(""Application Type"", capId);

    if (applicationType == ""Rangehood"") {
        editAppSpecific(""ARCS Electrical Test Date"", getFormattedDate(currDatePlusNinety), capId);
        asitValue = ""NOTICE OF DEFECT RANGEHOOD"";
    } else {
        if (inspType.indexOf(""Operational"") > -1) {
            reportType = ""Operational"";
            asitValue = ""NOTICE OF DEFECT OPERATIONAL"";
            editAppSpecific(""ARCS Operational Test Date"", getFormattedDate(currDatePlusNinety), capId);
        } else {
            editAppSpecific(""ARCS Electrical Test Date"", getFormattedDate(currDatePlusNinety), capId);
        }
    }
    editAppSpecific(""NOD Sent to Customer"", ""CHECKED"", capId);

    aa.print(""reportType: "" + reportType);
    aa.print(""asitValue: "" + asitValue);
    if (arguments.length > 4) {
        updateNoticeOfDefectASIT(noticeOfDefectList, asitValue);
        //Sanket
          if (applicationType == ""ARCS"" && (!matches(inspType, ""ARCS 5 Years Recertification Operational Re-Test"", ""ARCS Operational Re-Test"", ""ARCS Operational Test""))) {
            sendLOAEmailAndReport4ArcsFa(capId, inspType, applicationType);
          }

          if (applicationType == ""Fire Alarm"" && (!matches(inspType, ""FA-14 Central Station Affidavit"", ""Extension of PLA"", ""Extension Request of expiration/enforcement"", ""Expedited 5 Day LOA Request"", ""Certification of Electrical defects"", ""Certification of Administrative defects"", ""Central Station Facility Test"", ""Central Station Facility Re-Test""))) {
            sendLOAEmailAndReport4ArcsFa(capId, inspType, applicationType);
          }
          
          if (applicationType == ""Rangehood"" && (matches(inspType, ""Rangehood Acceptance Test"", ""Alternate Agent Test"", ""Removal of Special Hazard Fire Extinguishing System""))) {
            sendLOAEmailAndReport4ArcsFa(capId, inspType, applicationType);
          }
    }
    var scriptName = ""CREATE_REPORT_ASYNC"";
    var envParameters = aa.util.newHashMap();
    envParameters.put(""ServProvCode"", servProvCode);
    envParameters.put(""capCustomId"", capId.getCustomID().toString());
    var supervisorName = """";
    var currentUser = aa.person.getUser(currentUserID);
    if (currentUser.getSuccess()) {
        currentUser = currentUser.getOutput();
        supervisorName = currentUser.getFirstName() + "" "" + currentUser.getLastName();
        aa.print(""supervisorName: "" + supervisorName);
    }

    if (applicationType == ""Rangehood"") {
        envParameters.put(""reportName"", ""Letter of Defect - Rangehood"");
        envParameters.put(""docType"", ""Notice of Defect - Electrical"");
        updateNoticeOfDefectPersonsASIT(""PERSONS ASSISTING - RANGEHOOD"");
        editAppSpecific(""Initial"", ""CHECKED"");
        editAppSpecific(""Supervisor Name - Rangehood"", supervisorName);
        editAppSpecific(""Inspection ID - Rangehood"", inspectionID);
    } else {
        if (reportType == ""Electrical"") {
            if (applicationType == ""Fire Alarm"") {
                envParameters.put(""reportName"", ""Letter of Defect - Fire Alarm"");
            } else {
                envParameters.put(""reportName"", ""Letter of Defect - Electrical"");
            }
            envParameters.put(""docType"", ""Notice of Defect - Electrical"");
            updateNoticeOfDefectPersonsASIT(""PERSONS ASSISTING - ELECTRICAL"");
            editAppSpecific(""Supervisor Name - Electrical"", supervisorName);
            editAppSpecific(""Inspection ID - Electrical"", inspectionID);
        } else {
            if (applicationType == ""Fire Alarm"") {
                envParameters.put(""reportName"", ""Letter of Defect - Fire Alarm"");
            } else {
                envParameters.put(""reportName"", ""Letter of Defect - Operational"");
            }
            envParameters.put(""docType"", ""Notice of Defect - Operational"");
            updateNoticeOfDefectPersonsASIT(""PERSONS ASSISTING - OPS"");
            editAppSpecific(""Supervisor Name - Operational"", supervisorName);
            editAppSpecific(""Inspection ID - Operational"", inspectionID);
        }
    }

    if (arguments.length <= 4) {
        envParameters.put(""docCategory"", ""BFP_COM_INSP"");
        aa.print(""Generating NOD report: "" + envParameters.get(""reportName""));
        aa.runAsyncScript(scriptName, envParameters);
        aa.print(""$$$$$ Called Async Script!"");
    }
}

function updateNoticeOfDefectPersonsASIT(asitValue) {
    aa.print(""peopleASITArr: "" + peopleASITArr);
    if (peopleASITArr != null && peopleASITArr.length > 0) {
        var tableName = asitValue;
        var noticeOfDefectASITArray = new Array();
        for (var i in peopleASITArr) {
            var peopleObj = peopleASITArr[i];
            var asitRow = new Array();
            asitRow[""Name""] = peopleObj[""Name""];
            asitRow[""Affiliation / Job Title""] = peopleObj[""Affiliation / Job Title""];
            asitRow[""Contact Phone""] = peopleObj[""Contact Phone""];
            asitRow[""Email""] = peopleObj[""Email""];
            noticeOfDefectASITArray.push(asitRow);
        }
        removeASITable(tableName, capId);
        addASITable(tableName, noticeOfDefectASITArray, capId);
        aa.print(""Added Rows to ASIT: "" + tableName);
    }
}

function updateNoticeOfDefectASIT(noticeOfDefectList, asitValue) {
    var tableName = asitValue;
    var noticeOfDefectASITArray = new Array();
    for (var i in noticeOfDefectList) {
        var noticeOfDefectObj = noticeOfDefectList[i];
        if (noticeOfDefectObj.sfo == null || noticeOfDefectObj.sfoList == null) {
            continue;
        }
        var asitRow = new Array();
        var infIndex = 0;
        var splitInfractionCodes = noticeOfDefectObj.sfoList.split(""|"");
        for (var j in splitInfractionCodes) {
            if (splitInfractionCodes[j] == noticeOfDefectObj.sfo) {
                infIndex = j;
                break;
            }
        }
        var splitRemedy = String(noticeOfDefectObj.remedy).split(""|"");
        var splitNODDesc = String(noticeOfDefectObj.nodDescription).split(""|"");
        var splitDescription = String(noticeOfDefectObj.description).split(""|"");
        var strChecklistItem = noticeOfDefectObj.checklistItem.toString();
        /*var strLength = strChecklistItem.length();
        var startIndex = strChecklistItem.indexOf(""."");
        if (startIndex == -1) {
            startIndex = 0;
        } else {
            startIndex++;
        }
        var lastIndex = strChecklistItem.lastIndexOf(""("");
        if (lastIndex == -1) {
            lastIndex = strLength;
        }
        if (startIndex < strLength && lastIndex >= 0) {
            strChecklistItem = strChecklistItem.substring(startIndex, lastIndex).trim();
        }*/
        aa.print(""strChecklistItem: "" + strChecklistItem);
        asitRow[""Checklist Item""] = strChecklistItem;
        asitRow[""SFO #""] = noticeOfDefectObj.sfo;
        asitRow[""Detailed Description""] = splitDescription[infIndex];
        asitRow[""Remedy""] = splitRemedy[infIndex];
        asitRow[""Comments""] = noticeOfDefectObj.comment;
        
        if (splitNODDesc.length <= infIndex) {
            asitRow[""NOD Description""] = """";
            aa.print(""No NOD Desc"");
        } else {
            asitRow[""NOD Description""] = splitNODDesc[infIndex];
            aa.print(""NOD Desc: "" + splitNODDesc[infIndex]);
        }
        noticeOfDefectASITArray.push(asitRow);
    }
    removeASITable(tableName, capId);
    addASITable(tableName, noticeOfDefectASITArray, capId);
    aa.print(""Added Rows to ASIT: "" + tableName);
}

function populateRecommendationLetterFromGuideSheet(inspModel) {
    /*
     * Iterate through the Guidesheet items on an Inspection test and return a
     * list of non-compliant Violation order codes @param inspModel - The
     * Inspection Model of the Inspection test @return - Array with the
     * Violation order codes
     */
     var guidesheet = inspModel.getGuideSheets();
     var infractionObjList = new Array();
     var recommendationLetterList = new Array();
     if (guidesheet) {
        guidesheetArray = guidesheet.toArray();
        inspectionChecklistList = guidesheetArray;
        var internalMappingRecord = getInternalMappingRecord();
        var enhancedInternalMapping = populateChecklistMappingsX(internalMappingRecord, ""ENHANCED INSPECTION"");
        for (var x in guidesheetArray) {
            var mappingASITName = getChecklistASITNameMappingX(guidesheetArray[x]);
            var inspectionInternalMapping = populateChecklistMappingsX(internalMappingRecord, mappingASITName);
            var guidesheetType = guidesheetArray[x].getGuideType();
            var guidesheetItems = guidesheetArray[x].getItems().toArray();
            var internalMapping;
            var checklistType = ""INSPECTION"";
            if (guidesheetType == ""Enhanced Inspection Checklist"") {
                internalMapping = enhancedInternalMapping;
                checklistType = ""ENHANCED"";
            } else {
                internalMapping = inspectionInternalMapping;
                checklistType = ""INSPECTION"";
            }

            if (internalMapping == null) {
                continue;
            }
            
            for (var loopi in guidesheetItems) {
                var guidesheetItem = guidesheetItems[loopi];
                var itemText = guidesheetItem.getGuideItemText();
                var itemStatus = guidesheetItem.getGuideItemStatus();
                var itemComment = guidesheetItem.getGuideItemComment();
                var internalMappingObj = internalMapping.get(itemText);
                if (itemText != null && itemText != """" && internalMapping != null && internalMappingObj != null) {
                    var infractionCodes = internalMappingObj.infractionCodes;
                    if (infractionCodes != null) {
                        var recLetterComplianceCheck = (internalMappingObj.checklistStatus == itemStatus) ? true : false;
                        if (recLetterComplianceCheck != null && recLetterComplianceCheck) {
                            /*internalMappingObj.comment = itemComment;
                            var splitInfractionCodes = infractionCodes.split(""|"");
                            for (var i in splitInfractionCodes) {
                                var recLetterObj = new Object();
                                recLetterObj.sfo = splitInfractionCodes[i];
                                recLetterObj.description = internalMappingObj.vcDescription;
                                recLetterObj.remedy = internalMappingObj.remedy;
                                recLetterObj.comment = guidesheetItem.getGuideItemComment();
                                recommendationLetterList.push(recLetterObj);
                            }*/

                            var checkedInfractionCodes = getCheckedInfractionCodesX(guidesheetItem, internalMappingObj);
                            for (infIndex in checkedInfractionCodes) {
                                var infractionCode = checkedInfractionCodes[infIndex];
                                var recLetterObj = new Object();
                                recLetterObj.checklistItem = itemText;
                                recLetterObj.sfo = infractionCode;
                                recLetterObj.sfoList = internalMappingObj.infractionCodes;
                                recLetterObj.description = internalMappingObj.vcDescription;
                                recLetterObj.remedy = internalMappingObj.remedy;
                                recLetterObj.comment = guidesheetItem.getGuideItemComment();
                                recommendationLetterList.push(recLetterObj);
                            }
                        }
                    }
                } else {
                    aa.print(""No Mapping Entry for: "" + itemText);
                }
            }
        }
    }

    return recommendationLetterList;
}

function getFormattedDateCustom(dateVal) {
    /*
     * Converts date to ""MM/DD/YYYY"" format @param dateVal - Date to format
     * @return - Formatted date
     */
     var formattedDate = (dateVal.getMonth() + 1) + ""/"" + dateVal.getDate() + ""/"" + (dateVal.getYear() + 1900);
     return formattedDate;
 }

function processGeneralInformation(guidesheetArray) {
    var isNonJurisdictionBuild = false;
    for (var x in guidesheetArray) {
        var guidesheetType = guidesheetArray[x].getGuideType();
        if (guidesheetType == ""General Information"" || guidesheetType == ""General Information Annual"" || guidesheetType == ""RT GENERAL INFORMATION"") {
            var guidesheetItems = guidesheetArray[x].getItems().toArray();
            for (var loopi in guidesheetItems) {
                var guidesheetItem = guidesheetItems[loopi];
                var itemText = guidesheetItem.getGuideItemText();
                var itemStatus = guidesheetItem.getGuideItemStatus();
                if (itemText != null && itemText == ""3. Is there a change in Business Owner?"" && itemStatus == ""Yes"") {
                    aa.print(""*** Business Owner Change"");
                    businessOwnerChangeObj = getBusinessOwnerChangeObj(guidesheetItem);
                    aa.print(""*** Business Owner First Name: "" + businessOwnerChangeObj.firstName);
                    updateBusinessOwnerChangesThis();
                } else if (itemText != null && itemText == ""1. Is this a Non-Jurisdictional Building?"" && itemStatus == ""Yes"") {
                    aa.print(""*** Non-Jurisdictional Building"");
                    editAppSpecific(""Non-Jurisdictional?"", ""Yes"", capId);
                    isNonJurisdictionBuild = true;
                } else if (itemText != null && itemText == ""2. General Information"" && itemStatus == ""Complete"") {
                    aa.print(""*** General Information"");
                    getGeneralInformation(guidesheetItem);
                    peopleASITArr = peopleASITArr.concat(getApplianceASITInformation(guidesheetItem));
                } else if (itemText != null && itemText == ""3. Recommend Fee Waiver Review"" && itemStatus == ""Yes"") {
                    aa.print(""*** Fee Exemption"");
                    if (feeExemptionAdded == null) {
                        var noFeeVal = getAppSpecific(""No Fee"");
                        // var noFeeDateVal = getAppSpecific(""No Fee Date"");
                        aa.print(""*** Fee Exemption Here: "" + noFeeVal);
                        if (noFeeVal != ""CHECKED"") {
                            editAppSpecific(""Exemption Recommendation"", ""CHECKED"");
                            editAppSpecific(""Exemption Recommendation Date"", sysDateMMDDYYYY);
                        }
                        var isFeeExemptionTaskActive = isAdhocTaskActive(""Inspection Revenue - Fee Exemption"", capId);
                        if (!isFeeExemptionTaskActive) {
                            addAdHocTask(""ADHOC_WORKFLOW"", ""Inspection Revenue - Fee Exemption"", """", ""ADMIN"", capId);
                        }
                        feeExemptionAdded = true;
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }
    return isNonJurisdictionBuild;
}

function getRepeatOffenderValue(inspModel) {
    //var inspModel = aa.inspection.getInspection(capId, inspId).getOutput().getInspection();
    logDebug(""inspModel: "" + inspModel);
    if (inspModel) {
        var guidesheet = inspModel.getGuideSheets();
        logDebug(""guidesheet: "" + guidesheet);
        if (guidesheet) {
            guidesheetArray = guidesheet.toArray();
            for (var x in guidesheetArray) {
                var guidesheetType = guidesheetArray[x].getGuideType();
                if (guidesheetType == ""Repeat Offender"") {
                    var guidesheetItems = guidesheetArray[x].getItems().toArray();
                    for (var loopi in guidesheetItems) {
                        var guidesheetItem = guidesheetItems[loopi];
                        var itemText = guidesheetItem.getGuideItemText();
                        var itemStatus = guidesheetItem.getGuideItemStatus();
                        if (itemText != null && itemText == ""Repeat Offender"") {
                            return itemStatus;
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }
    return null;
}

function getBusinessOwnerChangeObj(guidesheetItem) {
    var detailsObj = new Object();
    var checklistTemplateGroup = guidesheetItem.getItemASISubgroupList();
    var iterator = checklistTemplateGroup.iterator();
    while (iterator.hasNext()) {
        var templateItemObj = iterator.next();
        var templateItemList = templateItemObj.getAsiList();
        var templateIterator = templateItemList.iterator();
        while (templateIterator.hasNext()) {
            var templateItem = templateIterator.next();
            var templateAttributeValue = (templateItem.getAttributeValue() == null) ? """" : templateItem.getAttributeValue();
            if (templateItem.getAsiName() == ""First Name"") {
                detailsObj.firstName = templateAttributeValue;
            } else if (templateItem.getAsiName() == ""Middle Name"") {
                detailsObj.middleName = templateAttributeValue;
            } else if (templateItem.getAsiName() == ""Last Name"") {
                detailsObj.lastName = templateAttributeValue;
            } else if (templateItem.getAsiName() == ""Name of Business"") {
                detailsObj.nameOfBusiness = templateAttributeValue;
            } else if (templateItem.getAsiName() == ""Business Phone"") {
                detailsObj.businessPhone = templateAttributeValue;
            } else if (templateItem.getAsiName() == ""Email"") {
                detailsObj.email = templateAttributeValue;
            } else if (templateItem.getAsiName() == ""Mailing Address- Building No"") {
                detailsObj.buildingNumber = templateAttributeValue;
            } else if (templateItem.getAsiName() == ""Street Name"") {
                detailsObj.streetName = templateAttributeValue;
            } else if (templateItem.getAsiName() == ""Apt/Floor #"") {
                detailsObj.aptFloorNo = templateAttributeValue;
            } else if (templateItem.getAsiName() == "" City/Borough"") {
                detailsObj.city = templateAttributeValue;
            } else if (templateItem.getAsiName() == ""State"") {
                detailsObj.state = templateAttributeValue;
            } else if (templateItem.getAsiName() == ""Zip"") {
                detailsObj.zip = templateAttributeValue;
            }
        }
    }
    return detailsObj;
}

function processDeficiencyReport(inspModel) {
    if (inspModel.getIdNumber()) {
        editAppSpecific(""Deficiency Inspection ID"", inspModel.getIdNumber());
    }
    if (inspModel.getInspector() != null) {
        editAppSpecific(""Inspection Manager"", inspModel.getInspector().getUserID());
        // editAppSpecific(""Deficiency Inspector ID"", inspModel.getInspector().getUserID());
    }
    if (inspModel.getResultComment()) {
        editAppSpecific(""Comments"", inspModel.getResultComment());
    }
    try {
        var parentSeqID = getParentInspectionId(inspId);
        var parentObj = null;
        if (parentSeqID) {
            var parentCurrObj = aa.inspection.getInspection(capId, Number(parentSeqID));
            if (parentCurrObj.getSuccess()) {
                parentObj = parentCurrObj.getOutput();
            }
        } else {
            var parentCurrObj = getLatestResultedInspectionObj(capId);
            if (parentCurrObj) {
                parentObj = parentCurrObj;
            }
        }
        if (parentObj) {
            aa.print(""parentObj: "" + parentObj);
            if (parentObj.getInspector() != null) {
                editAppSpecific(""Deficiency Inspector ID"", parentObj.getInspector().getUserID());
            }
        }
    } catch (asiError) {
        aa.print(""ERROR processDeficiencyReport"");
    }
    aa.print(""ALT ID: "" + capId.getCustomID().toString());
    aa.print(""INSP ID: "" + inspModel.getIdNumber().toString());

    var parameters = aa.util.newHashMap();
    parameters.put(""RECORD_ID"", capId.getCustomID().toString());
    parameters.put(""INSP_ID"", inspModel.getIdNumber().toString());
    runReportAndSendEmail4DefReport(""Deficiency Report"", parameters, ""BFP_COM_INSP"", ""Deficiency Report"", capId);
    
    /*runReportAndSaveToDocTab(""Deficiency Report"", parameters, ""BFP_COM_INSP"", ""Deficiency Report"");*/
    /*var scriptName = ""CREATE_REPORT_ASYNC"";
    var envParameters = aa.util.newHashMap();
    envParameters.put(""ServProvCode"", servProvCode);
    envParameters.put(""capCustomId"", capId.getCustomID().toString());
    envParameters.put(""reportName"", ""Deficiency Report"");
    envParameters.put(""inspId"", inspModel.getIdNumber().toString());
    envParameters.put(""docCategory"", ""BFP_COM_INSP"");
    envParameters.put(""docType"", ""Deficiency Report"");*/
    //aa.runAsyncScript(scriptName, envParameters);
    //aa.print(""$$$$$ Called Async Script!"");
}

function processEnforcementAffidavitInformation(guidesheetArray) {
    for (var x in guidesheetArray) {
        var guidesheetType = guidesheetArray[x].getGuideType();
        if (guidesheetType == ""Enforcement Affidavit Details"") {
            var guidesheetItems = guidesheetArray[x].getItems().toArray();
            var checklistGroupID = getChecklistGroupID(guidesheetArray[x]);
            for (var loopi in guidesheetItems) {
                var guidesheetItem = guidesheetItems[loopi];
                var itemText = guidesheetItem.getGuideItemText();
                var itemStatus = guidesheetItem.getGuideItemStatus();
                if (itemText != null && itemText == ""Enforcement Information"" && itemStatus == ""Complete"") {
                    aa.print(""*** Enforcement Information"");
                    if (checklistGroupID == 1) {
                        getEnforcementInformation(guidesheetItem);
                    } else {
                        getEnforcementInformation2(guidesheetItem);
                    }
                }
                if (itemText != null && itemText == ""Affidavits"" && itemStatus == ""Complete"") {
                    aa.print(""*** Affidavits"");
                    getAffidavitInformation(guidesheetItem);
                }
                /*if (itemText == ""Enhanced Inspection Respondent Details"" && itemStatus == ""Complete"") {
                    getEnhancedRespondentInfo(guidesheetItem);
                }
                if (itemText == ""Enhanced Inspection Affidavits Details"" && itemStatus == ""Complete"") {
                    getEnhancedAffidavitsInfo(guidesheetItem);
                }*/
            }
        }
    }
}

function getChecklistGroupID(gSheetObj) {
    var gSheetID = gSheetObj.getIdentifier();

    if (gSheetID == null || gSheetID == """" || gSheetID.length() <= 1 || gSheetID.charAt(0) == 49) {
        aa.print(gSheetID + "" "" + ""Group 1"");
        return 1;
    } else {
        aa.print(gSheetID + "" "" + ""Group 2"");
        return 2;
    }

    return 1;
}

function getGeneralInformation(guidesheetItem) {
    if (generalInfoObj == null) {
        generalInfoObj = new Object();
    }
    var checklistTemplateGroup = guidesheetItem.getItemASISubgroupList();
    var iterator = checklistTemplateGroup.iterator();
    while (iterator.hasNext()) {
        var templateItemObj = iterator.next();
        var templateItemList = templateItemObj.getAsiList();
        var templateIterator = templateItemList.iterator();
        while (templateIterator.hasNext()) {
            var templateItem = templateIterator.next();
            var templateAttributeValue = (templateItem.getAttributeValue() == null) ? """" :
            templateItem.getAttributeValue();
            if (templateAttributeValue != """") {
                if (templateItem.getAsiName() == ""Operating Hours"") {
                    if (generalInfoObj.operatingHours == null)
                        generalInfoObj.operatingHours = templateAttributeValue;
                    aa.print(""Operating Hours: "" + generalInfoObj.operatingHours);
                } else if (templateItem.getAsiName() == ""Name of Business"") {
                    if (generalInfoObj.nameOfBusiness == null)
                        generalInfoObj.nameOfBusiness = templateAttributeValue;
                } else if (templateItem.getAsiName() == ""Business Name"") {
                    if (generalInfoObj.nameOfBusinessX == null)
                        generalInfoObj.nameOfBusinessX = templateAttributeValue;
                } else if (templateItem.getAsiName() == ""Number of Floors"") {
                    if (generalInfoObj.numberOfFloors == null)
                        generalInfoObj.numberOfFloors = templateAttributeValue;
                } else if (templateItem.getAsiName() == ""Premises Address"") {
                    if (generalInfoObj.premisesAddress == null)
                        generalInfoObj.premisesAddress = templateAttributeValue;
                } else if (templateItem.getAsiName() == ""Premises Borough"") {
                    if (generalInfoObj.premisesBorough == null)
                        generalInfoObj.premisesBorough = templateAttributeValue;
                } else if (templateItem.getAsiName() == ""Premises Zip"") {
                    if (generalInfoObj.premisesZip == null)
                        generalInfoObj.premisesZip = templateAttributeValue;
                } else if (templateItem.getAsiName() == ""Mailing Address"") {
                    if (generalInfoObj.mailingAddress == null)
                        generalInfoObj.mailingAddress = templateAttributeValue;
                } else if (templateItem.getAsiName() == ""Mailing Borough"") {
                    if (generalInfoObj.mailingBorough == null)
                        generalInfoObj.mailingBorough = templateAttributeValue;
                } else if (templateItem.getAsiName() == ""Mailing Zip"") {
                    if (generalInfoObj.mailingZip == null)
                        generalInfoObj.mailingZip = templateAttributeValue;
                } else if (templateItem.getAsiName() == ""Permit Coverage Comments"") {
                    if (generalInfoObj.permitCoverageComments == null) {
                        generalInfoObj.permitCoverageComments = templateAttributeValue;
                    } else {
                        generalInfoObj.permitCoverageComments += ""\n"" + templateAttributeValue;
                    }
                } else if (templateItem.getAsiName() == ""LOA Coverage Comments"") {
                    if (generalInfoObj.loaCoverageComments == null) {
                        generalInfoObj.loaCoverageComments = templateAttributeValue;
                    } else {
                        generalInfoObj.loaCoverageComments += ""\n"" + templateAttributeValue;
                    }
                } else if (templateItem.getAsiName() == ""CHANGE OF OWNER"" && templateAttributeValue == ""CHECKED"") {
                    updateBusinessOwnerChangesThis();
                    aa.print(""*** Business Owner Change"");
                    businessOwnerChangeObj = getBusinessOwnerChangeObj(guidesheetItem);
                    aa.print(""*** Business Owner First Name: "" + businessOwnerChangeObj.firstName);
                    updateBusinessOwnerChangesThis();
                } else if (templateItem.getAsiName() == ""Respondent Type"") {
                    generalInfoObj.respondentType = templateAttributeValue;
                } else if (templateItem.getAsiName() == ""Floor Number(s)"") {
                    aa.print(""Floor Number(s)"" + templateAttributeValue);
                    if (generalInfoObj.floorNumbers == null) {
                        generalInfoObj.floorNumbers = templateAttributeValue;
                    } else {
                        generalInfoObj.floorNumbers += "", "" + templateAttributeValue;
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }
}
