                enhancedRespondentInfoObj.email = templateAttributeValue;
            } else if (templateItem.getAsiName() == ""Contact Number"") {
                enhancedRespondentInfoObj.contactNumber = templateAttributeValue;
            } else if (templateItem.getAsiName() == ""Building Number"") {
                enhancedRespondentInfoObj.buildingNumber = templateAttributeValue;
            } else if (templateItem.getAsiName() == ""Street Name"") {
                enhancedRespondentInfoObj.streetName = templateAttributeValue;
            } else if (templateItem.getAsiName() == ""Apt/Floor #"") {
                enhancedRespondentInfoObj.aptFloorNo = templateAttributeValue;
            } else if (templateItem.getAsiName() == ""City"") {
                enhancedRespondentInfoObj.city = templateAttributeValue;
            } else if (templateItem.getAsiName() == ""State"") {
                enhancedRespondentInfoObj.state = templateAttributeValue;
            } else if (templateItem.getAsiName() == ""Zip"") {
                enhancedRespondentInfoObj.zip = templateAttributeValue;
            }
        }
    }
}

function createEnforcementRecord(enforcementType, infractionCode, infIndex, internalMappingObj, checklistType, checklistGroupID) {
    logDebug(""in createEnforcementRecord"");
    var id = null;
    if (enforcementType == ""Violation Order"") {
        id = createViolationOrderRecord(infractionCode, infIndex, internalMappingObj, checklistType, checklistGroupID);
    } else if (enforcementType == ""Criminal Court Summons"") {
        createCriminalCourtSummonsRecord(infractionCode, infIndex, internalMappingObj, checklistType, id);
    }
}

function createViolationOrderRecord(infractionCode, infIndex, internalMappingObj, checklistType, checklistGroupID) {
    var violationOrderDetailId = createChild(""BFP"", ""Enforcement"", ""VO Details"", ""NA"", null, capId);
    aa.print(""Created Violation Order Detail Record: "" + violationOrderDetailId.getCustomID() + "" SFO: "" + infractionCode);
    updateACACreatedBy(violationOrderDetailId);
    updateAppStatus(""Active"", ""Updated via Script"", violationOrderDetailId);
    activateWorkflowTaskByCapId(""Supervisor Review"", violationOrderDetailId);
    addAdHocTask(""ADHOC_WORKFLOW"", ""Generate Report"", """", ""ADMIN"", violationOrderDetailId);
    // activateWorkflowTaskByCapId(""Violation Status"", violationOrderDetailId);
    //copyAddresses(capId, violationOrderDetailId);
    editASIInfractionDetail(infractionCode, internalMappingObj, violationOrderDetailId, ""VO"");
    if (checklistGroupID == null || checklistGroupID == 1) {
        // editViolationOrderInformationASI(violationOrderDetailId, enforcementInfoObj);
        if (enforcementInfoObj != null) {
            editViolationOrderInformationASI(violationOrderDetailId, enforcementInfoObj);
        } else if (enforcementInfoObj2 != null) {
            editViolationOrderInformationASI(violationOrderDetailId, enforcementInfoObj2);
        }
    } else {
        if (enforcementInfoObj2 == null && enforcementInfoObj != null) {
            editViolationOrderInformationASI(violationOrderDetailId, enforcementInfoObj);
        } else {
            editViolationOrderInformationASI(violationOrderDetailId, enforcementInfoObj2);
        }
    }
    createReportAndSendNotificationAsync(violationOrderDetailId, ""Violation Order"");
    voIssuedArray.push(violationOrderDetailId.getCustomID().toString());
    if (checklistType == ""Enhanced Inspection Checklist"") {
        editAppSpecific(""Enhanced Inspection"", ""CHECKED"", violationOrderDetailId);
        editAppSpecific(""Enhanced Inspection"", ""CHECKED"", capId);
    } else {
        failedTestAnnualChecklist = true;
    }
    editTaskDueDateXXX(""*"", getFormattedDate(new Date()), violationOrderDetailId);
    return violationOrderDetailId;
}

function createDefendantContact(ccsCapID) { //pratik

    /*
     * Create a Defendant Contact on the newly created Criminal Court Summons record.
     * @param ccsCapID - Cap ID of the Criminal Court Summons record. @param
     * enforcementInfoObj - Affidavit Object with the Defendant contact
     * details. @return - NONE
     */
     aa.print(""In createDefendantContact"");
     if (enforcementInfoObj == null || enforcementInfoObj.dn == null ||
        enforcementInfoObj.dn == """") {
        return;
}

aa.print(""In createDefendantContact. enforcementInfoObj.dn: "" + enforcementInfoObj.dn);
aa.print(""In createDefendantContact. enforcementInfoObj.defendantEmail: "" + enforcementInfoObj.defendantEmail);

var contactObj = aa.proxyInvoker.newInstance(""com.accela.aa.aamain.people.CapContactModel"").getOutput();
contactObj.setContactType(""Defendant"");
contactObj.sePreferredChannele(1);
var defendantN = enforcementInfoObj.dn;
defendantN = defendantN.split("" "");
if (defendantN[1] == """" || defendantN[1] == null) {

    contactObj.setFirstName(enforcementInfoObj.dn);
    contactObj.setLastName("""");
} else {
    contactObj.setFirstName(defendantN[0]);
    contactObj.setLastName(defendantN[1]);
}
contactObj.setEmail(enforcementInfoObj.defendantEmail);
contactObj.setPrimaryFlag(""Y"");
contactObj.setCapID(ccsCapID);
  //  contactObj.setRecStatus(""A"");
  var resultContact = aa.people.createCapContactWithAttribute(contactObj);

  if (resultContact.getSuccess()) {
    aa.print(""Added Defendant contact!"");
        //createCapContactAddressFromCapAddress(ccsCapID, ""Defendant"",affidavitInfoObj);
    } else {
        aa.print(""*** Error Adding Respondent Contact: "" +
            resultContact.getErrorMessage());
    }
}
function isNull(pTestValue, pNewValue) {
    if (pTestValue == null || pTestValue == """")
        return pNewValue;
    else
        return pTestValue;
}
function createRespondentContact(summonsCapID, respondentInfoObj) {
    /*
     * Create a Respondent Contact on the newly created FDNY Summons record.
     * @param summonsCapID - Cap ID of the FDNY Summons record. @param
     * enforcementInfoObj - Enforcement Object with the Respondent contact
     * details. @return - NONE
     */
    // var c = getContactObj(summonsCapID,""Applicant"");
    aa.print(""In createRespondentContact"");
    if (respondentInfoObj == null || respondentInfoObj.respondent == null ||
        respondentInfoObj.respondent == """") {
        return;
    }

    aa.print(""In createRespondentContact. respondentInfoObj.respondent: "" + respondentInfoObj.respondent);

    if (respondentInfoObj.respondent == ""Business Owner"" ||
        respondentInfoObj.respondent == ""Building Owner"") {
        copyContactToSummonsRecord(summonsCapID, respondentInfoObj);
    } else if (respondentInfoObj.respondent == ""Other"") {
        var contactObj = aa.proxyInvoker.newInstance(""com.accela.aa.aamain.people.CapContactModel"").getOutput();
        contactObj.setContactType(""Respondent"");
        if (respondentInfoObj.legalBusinessName != null && respondentInfoObj.legalBusinessName != """") {
          contactObj.setBusinessName(respondentInfoObj.legalBusinessName);
          contactObj.sePreferredChannele(2);
        } else {
           contactObj.setFirstName(respondentInfoObj.firstName);
           contactObj.setLastName(respondentInfoObj.lastName);
           contactObj.sePreferredChannele(1);      
        }

        if (respondentInfoObj.doingBusinessAs != null && respondentInfoObj.doingBusinessAs != """") {
            contactObj.setTradeName(respondentInfoObj.doingBusinessAs);
        }
    
        contactObj.setEmail(respondentInfoObj.email);
        contactObj.setPhone3(respondentInfoObj.contactNumber);
        contactObj.setPrimaryFlag(""Y"");
        contactObj.setCapID(summonsCapID);
        var resultContact = aa.people.createCapContactWithAttribute(contactObj);

        if (resultContact.getSuccess()) {
            aa.print(""Added Respondent contact!"");
            createCapContactAddressFromCapAddress(summonsCapID, ""Respondent"", respondentInfoObj);
        } else {
            aa.print(""*** Error Adding Respondent Contact: "" + resultContact.getErrorMessage());
        }
    }
 }

 function createCapContactAddressFromCapAddress(summonsCapID, contactType,
    respondentInfoObj) {
    var cons = aa.people.getCapContactByCapID(summonsCapID).getOutput();
    var conSeqNum = """";

    for (x in cons) {
        aa.print(""Contact Type: "" + cons[x].getPeople().getContactType());

        if (cons[x].getPeople().getContactType().equals(contactType)) {
            conSeqNum = cons[x].getCapContactModel().getPeople()
            .getContactSeqNumber();
        }
    }

    aa.print(""Sequence Number: "" + conSeqNum);

    if (conSeqNum != null && conSeqNum != """") {
        var contactAddressScriptModel = aa.address.createContactAddressModel()
        .getOutput();
        contactAddressScriptModel.setAuditStatus(""A"");
        var contactAddressModel = populateContactAddressModel(
            contactAddressScriptModel, conSeqNum, respondentInfoObj);
        var returnModel = aa.address.createCapContactAddress(summonsCapID,
            contactAddressModel);

        if (returnModel.getSuccess()) {
            aa.print(""Create Contact Address Successfully"");
        } else {
            aa.print(""Create Contact Address Failed:"" +
                returnModel.getErrorMessage());
        }
    }
}

function populateContactAddressModel(contactAddressScriptModel, conSeqNum,
    respondentInfoObj) {
    var contactAddressModel = contactAddressScriptModel
    .getContactAddressModel();
    contactAddressModel.setEntityID(Number(conSeqNum));
    contactAddressModel.setAddressType(""Mailing Address"");
    contactAddressModel
    .setHouseNumberAlphaStart(respondentInfoObj.buildingNumber);
    contactAddressModel.setStreetName(respondentInfoObj.streetName);
    if (respondentInfoObj.aptFloorNo != null && respondentInfoObj.aptFloorNo != """") {
        aa.print(respondentInfoObj.aptFloorNo.toString().length);
        if (respondentInfoObj.aptFloorNo.toString().length() > 10) {
            aa.print(""Trimmed to 10 char"");
            contactAddressModel.setUnitEnd(respondentInfoObj.aptFloorNo.toString().substring(0,10));
        } else {
            contactAddressModel.setUnitEnd(respondentInfoObj.aptFloorNo);
        }
    }
    contactAddressModel.setCity(respondentInfoObj.city);
    contactAddressModel.setState(respondentInfoObj.state);
    contactAddressModel.setZip(respondentInfoObj.zip);
    contactAddressModel.setCountryCode(""US"");
    return contactAddressModel;
}

function copyContactToSummonsRecord(summonsCapID, respondentInfoObj) {
    /*
     * Copies contact (Business Owner or Building Owner) from parent Inspection
     * record to newly created FDNY Summons record. The contact type is changed
     * to ""Respondent"". @param summonsCapID - Cap ID of the FDNY Summons record.
     * @param respondentInfoObj - Enforcement Object with the Respondent
     * contact details. @return - NONE
     */
     var capContactResult = aa.people.getCapContactByCapID(capId);

     if (capContactResult.getSuccess()) {
        var contactsArray = capContactResult.getOutput();

        for (var yy in contactsArray) {
            if (contactsArray[yy].getCapContactModel().getContactType() == respondentInfoObj.respondent) {
                var newContact = contactsArray[yy].getCapContactModel();
                newContact.setCapID(summonsCapID);
                newContact.setContactType(""Respondent"");
                aa.people.createCapContact(newContact);
                logDebug(""Copied Respondent contact from "" +
                    capId.getCustomID() + "" to "" +
                    summonsCapID.getCustomID());
                break;
            }
        }
    } else {
        logMessage(""**ERROR: Failed to get contacts: "" +
            capContactResult.getErrorMessage());
    }
}

        logDebug(""BOROUGH_ID "" + boroughId);

    var ECBrow = getECBCourtDate(service_dateStr,boroughId);
    if (ECBrow == false){

    }
    
        var compl_date = aa.date.parseDate(ECBrow.compliance_date);
        var compl_dateStr = """" + compl_date.getMonth() + ""/"" + compl_date.getDayOfMonth() + ""/"" + compl_date.getYear();
        aa.print(compl_dateStr);
        logDebug(""compl_dateStr "" + compl_dateStr);

        var hearing_date = aa.date.parseDate(ECBrow.hearing_date);
        var hearing_dateStr = """" + hearing_date.getMonth() + ""/"" + hearing_date.getDayOfMonth() + ""/"" + hearing_date.getYear();

        editAppSpecific(""COMPLIANCE DATE"", compl_dateStr, summonsCapId);
        editAppSpecific(""HEARING DATE"", hearing_dateStr, summonsCapId);
        updateHearingTime(hearing_dateStr, borough, summonsCapId);
    } catch (ex) {
        logDebug(""Exception occurred in updating Compliance Date & Hearing Date"");
    }

}

function getECBCourtDate(service_dateStr,boroughId){
  var ECBURL = lookup(""URLs"",""ECB_COURT_INTERFACE_URL"");
  var ECBKey = lookup(""URLs"",""ECB_COURT_API_KEY"");
  if (matches(ECBURL,"""",null,undefined) || matches(ECBURL,"""",null,undefined)){
    logDebug(""ERROR: Configuration for the ECB court interface is missing from the URLs standard choice!"");
    return false;
  }
  try{
    var postParams = aa.httpClient.initPostParameters();
    postParams.put(""apikey"", ECBKey);
    var response = aa.httpClient.get(ECBURL + ""?p_boro_id="" + boroughId + ""&p_service_date="" + service_dateStr,postParams).getOutput();
    try{
      var respObj = JSON.parse(response);
    }
    catch(JSONErr){
      logDebug(""ERROR: Failed to parse JSON from ECB Court web service: ""+ JSONErr);
      logDebug(""response: "" + response);
      return false;
    }
    return respObj.items[0];
  }
  catch(WSErr){
    logDebug(""ERROR: failed to retrieve data from ECB Court web service: ""+ WSErr);
    return false;
  }
}

function updateHearingTime(hearing_dateStr, borough, summonsCapId) {
    try {
        logDebug(""Updating Hearing time"");
        //var hearingDate = getAppSpecific(""HEARING DATE"");
        //var borough =  getAppSpecific(""Borough"");
        var hearingDateAndBorough = hearing_dateStr + ""-"" + borough;
        var hearingCount;
        var hearingTime;
        var hearingCountStr = lookup(""BFP_FSUM_HEARING_TIME"", hearingDateAndBorough);
        if (hearingCountStr != null && hearingCountStr != """") {
            hearingCount = Number(hearingCountStr);
            if (hearingCount < 100) {
                hearingTime = ""08:30"";
            } else {
                hearingTime = ""10:30"";
            }
            hearingCount = hearingCount + 1;
            editAppSpecific(""HEARING TIME"", hearingTime, summonsCapId);
            editLookup(""BFP_FSUM_HEARING_TIME"", hearingDateAndBorough, hearingCount);
        } else {
            aa.print(""values not found "" + hearingDateAndBorough);
            addLookup(""BFP_FSUM_HEARING_TIME"", hearingDateAndBorough, ""1"");
            hearingTime = ""08:30"";
            editAppSpecific(""HEARING TIME"", hearingTime, summonsCapId);
        }

    } catch (ex) {
        editAppSpecific(""HEARING TIME"", ""08:30"", summonsCapId);
        logDebug(""Exception occurred in updating Hearing Time"");
    }
}

//FDNY-8758 Updating Applicant contact on Summon as Respondent
function updateSummonsContact(summonsCapId) {
    try {

        var respAdded = false;
        var capContactResult = aa.people.getCapContactByCapID(summonsCapId);
        if (capContactResult.getSuccess()) {
            Contacts = capContactResult.getOutput();
            for (yy in Contacts) {
                var contact = Contacts[yy].getCapContactModel();

                if (contact.getContactType() == ""Applicant"") {
                    var respContact = contact;
                    respContact.setContactType(""Respondent"");
                    respContact.setPrimaryFlag(""Y"");
                    var result = aa.people.createCapContact(respContact);
                    if (result.getSuccess()) {
                        logDebug(""Respondent Contact added"");
                        respAdded = true;
                        break;
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        if (respAdded) {
            var capContactResultNew = aa.people.getCapContactByCapID(summonsCapId);
            if (capContactResultNew.getSuccess()) {
                var contactsNew = capContactResultNew.getOutput();
                for (yy in contactsNew) {
                    var contactNew = contactsNew[yy].getCapContactModel();
                    if (contactNew.getContactType() == ""Applicant"") {
                        aa.people.removeCapContact(summonsCapId, contactNew.getContactSeqNumber());
                        logDebug(""Applicant Contact removed"");
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    } catch (ex) {
        logDebug(""Exception occurred in updating summons Contact"");
    }

}

function updateACACreatedBy(recordCapID) {
    var vCap = aa.cap.getCap(recordCapID).getOutput().getCapModel();
    var parentCapModel = aa.cap.getCap(capId).getOutput().getCapModel();
    var parentPublicUserId = parentCapModel.getCreatedBy();
    // vCap.setCapClass(""EDITABLE"");
    vCap.setCapClass(""COMPLETE"");
    vCap.setCreatedBy(String(parentPublicUserId));
    vCap.setAccessByACA(""Y"");
    aa.cap.editCapByPK(vCap);
}

function editViolationOrderInformationASI(recordCapID, currEnfInfoObj) {
    if (currEnfInfoObj != null) {
        if (currEnfInfoObj.voNameOfOwner != null)
            editAppSpecific(""Name of Owner"", currEnfInfoObj.voNameOfOwner, recordCapID);
        if (currEnfInfoObj.voNameOfPerson != null)
            editAppSpecific(""Applicant Name"", currEnfInfoObj.voNameOfPerson, recordCapID);
        if (currEnfInfoObj.voTitle != null)
            editAppSpecific(""Title"", currEnfInfoObj.voTitle, recordCapID);
        if (currEnfInfoObj.voPhone != null)

function editFDNYSummonsHearingInformationASI(fdnySummonsRecord) {
    todayDateTime = aa.date.getScriptDateTime(com.accela.aa.util.DateTimeUtil.getAgencyCurrentDate(aa.getServiceProviderCode()));
  if (String(todayDateTime.getSecond()).length==1)
  {
    var seconds = ""0"" + todayDateTime.getSecond();
  }
  else{
    var seconds = todayDateTime.getSecond();
  }
  if (String(todayDateTime.getMinute()).length==1)
  {
    var minutes = ""0"" + todayDateTime.getMinute();
  }
  else{
    var minutes = todayDateTime.getMinute();
  }
  var todayDateTimeFormatted = todayDateTime.getMonth() + ""/""
      + todayDateTime.getDayOfMonth() + ""/"" + todayDateTime.getYear() + "" ""
      + todayDateTime.getHourOfDay() + "":"" + minutes + "":""
      + seconds;    editAppSpecific(""Creation Date/Time"", todayDateTimeFormatted, fdnySummonsRecord);
    editAppSpecific(""Description of Violation"", ""See Supplement Attached"", fdnySummonsRecord);
    var issuingUnit = issuingUnitValue;
    if (issuingUnit == ""RH Inspector"") {
        editAppSpecific(""Division FP Unit"", ""Rangehood"", fdnySummonsRecord);
    } else if (issuingUnit == ""RT Inspector"") {
        editAppSpecific(""Division FP Unit"", ""Rooftop"", fdnySummonsRecord);
    }
    var boroughValue = getAddressCity(capId);
    boroughValue = boroughValue + """";
    aa.print(""boroughValue: "" + boroughValue);

    var boroughValueDropDown = """";
    if (boroughValue && boroughValue.length > 0)
        boroughValueDropDown = boroughValue[0] + boroughValue.substring(1).toLowerCase();
    editAppSpecific(""Borough"", boroughValueDropDown, fdnySummonsRecord);
    aa.print(""boroughValueDropDown is "" + boroughValueDropDown);

    var hearingDetailsObj = getHearingDetails(boroughValue);
    editAppSpecific(""HEARING DATE"", hearingDetailsObj.hearingDate, fdnySummonsRecord);
    if (hearingDetailsObj.complianceDate != null) {
        editAppSpecific(""COMPLIANCE DATE"", hearingDetailsObj.complianceDate, fdnySummonsRecord);
    }
    scheduleSummonsHearing(fdnySummonsRecord, hearingDetailsObj.hearingDate, boroughValue);
    var meetingResults = aa.meeting.getMeetingsByCAP(fdnySummonsRecord, true);
    if (meetingResults.getSuccess()) {
        aa.print(""Hearing scheduled"");
        meetingResultsArr = meetingResults.getOutput();
        var iter = meetingResultsArr.iterator();
        while (iter.hasNext()) {
            var element = iter.next();
            var meeting = element.getMeeting();
            meeting.setMeetingName(fdnySummonsRecord.getCustomID());
            var meetingBiz = aa.proxyInvoker.newInstance(""com.accela.aa.meeting.meeting.MeetingBusiness"").getOutput();
            meetingBiz.updateMeeting(meeting);
        }
        var meetingTime = getMeetingTime(fdnySummonsRecord);
        if (meetingTime != null) {
            editAppSpecific(""HEARING TIME"", meetingTime, fdnySummonsRecord);
        }
    }
}

function editFDNYSummonsInformationASI(isRepeatOffender, isFalseCertification, enforcementId, currAffidavitInfoObj) {
    /* Set the hearing date to 50 days from today */
    /* Set the Compliance Date to 35 days from today */
    aa.print(""In editFDNYSummonsInformationASI"");
    todayDateTime = aa.date.getScriptDateTime(com.accela.aa.util.DateTimeUtil.getAgencyCurrentDate(aa.getServiceProviderCode()));
  if (String(todayDateTime.getSecond()).length==1)
  {
    var seconds = ""0"" + todayDateTime.getSecond();
  }
  else{
    var seconds = todayDateTime.getSecond();
  }
  if (String(todayDateTime.getMinute()).length==1)
  {
    var minutes = ""0"" + todayDateTime.getMinute();
  }
  else{
    var minutes = todayDateTime.getMinute();
  }
  var todayDateTimeFormatted = todayDateTime.getMonth() + ""/""
      + todayDateTime.getDayOfMonth() + ""/"" + todayDateTime.getYear() + "" ""
      + todayDateTime.getHourOfDay() + "":"" + minutes + "":""
      + seconds;
    editAppSpecific(""Creation Date/Time"", todayDateTimeFormatted, enforcementId);
    editAppSpecific(""REPEAT OFFENDER"", (isRepeatOffender ? ""Yes"" : ""No""), enforcementId);
    editAppSpecific(""False Certification"", (isFalseCertification ? ""Yes"" : ""No""), enforcementId);
    editAppSpecific(""Description of Violation"", ""See Supplement Attached"", enforcementId);
    var issuingUnit = issuingUnitValue;
    if (issuingUnit == ""RH Inspector"") {
        editAppSpecific(""Division FP Unit"", ""Rangehood"", enforcementId);
    } else if (issuingUnit == ""RT Inspector"") {
        editAppSpecific(""Division FP Unit"", ""Rooftop"", enforcementId);
    }

    if (generalInfoObj != null) {
        if (generalInfoObj.nameOfBusinessX != null && generalInfoObj.nameOfBusinessX != """") {
            editAppSpecific(""DBA"", generalInfoObj.nameOfBusinessX, enforcementId);
        } else if (generalInfoObj.nameOfBusiness != null && generalInfoObj.nameOfBusinessX != """") {
            editAppSpecific(""DBA"", generalInfoObj.nameOfBusiness, enforcementId);
        }
        logDebug(""generalInfoObj.cityAgency: "" + generalInfoObj.cityAgency);
        logDebug(""generalInfoObj.respondentType: "" + generalInfoObj.respondentType);
        if (generalInfoObj.cityAgency == ""CHECKED"" || generalInfoObj.cityAgency == ""Yes"") {
            editAppSpecific(""City Agency"", ""Yes"", enforcementId);
        } else if (generalInfoObj.respondentType != null && generalInfoObj.respondentType != """" && generalInfoObj.respondentType == ""City Agency"") {
            editAppSpecific(""City Agency"", ""Yes"", enforcementId);
            editAppSpecific(""City Agency"", ""Yes"", capId);
        } else {
            editAppSpecific(""City Agency"", ""No"", enforcementId);
        }
    }
    if (enforcementInfoObj != null && enforcementInfoObj.respondentType != null && enforcementInfoObj.respondentType != """" && enforcementInfoObj.respondentType == ""City Agency"") {
        editAppSpecific(""City Agency"", ""Yes"", enforcementId);
        editAppSpecific(""City Agency"", ""Yes"", capId);
    }
    if (currAffidavitInfoObj != null) {
        aa.print(""In editFDNYSummonsInformationASI: "" + currAffidavitInfoObj.fsumhairColor);
        editAppSpecific(""Service Method"", currAffidavitInfoObj.fdnySummonsServiceMethod, enforcementId);
        editAppSpecific(""Sex"", currAffidavitInfoObj.fsumsex, enforcementId);
        editAppSpecific(""Complexion"", currAffidavitInfoObj.fsumcomplexion, enforcementId);
        editAppSpecific(""Hair Color"", currAffidavitInfoObj.fsumhairColor, enforcementId);
        editAppSpecific(""Approx Weight"", currAffidavitInfoObj.fsumapproxWeight, enforcementId);
        editAppSpecific(""Approx Height"", currAffidavitInfoObj.fsumapproxHeight, enforcementId);
        editAppSpecific(""Approx Age"", currAffidavitInfoObj.fsumapproxAge, enforcementId);
        editAppSpecific(""Other Identifying characteristics"", currAffidavitInfoObj.fsumotherIdentifyingFeatures, enforcementId);
        editAppSpecific(""Copy delivered to: Name"", currAffidavitInfoObj.copyDelName, enforcementId);
        editAppSpecific(""Copy delivered to: Position"", currAffidavitInfoObj.copyDelPosition, enforcementId);
        editAppSpecific(""Advised by: Name"", currAffidavitInfoObj.advisedName, enforcementId);
        editAppSpecific(""Advised by: Position or Relationship to building"", currAffidavitInfoObj.advisedPos, enforcementId);
        editAppSpecific(""Respondent was not present"", currAffidavitInfoObj.respNotPresent, enforcementId);
        editAppSpecific(""Representive of partnership or corporate respondent was not present"", currAffidavitInfoObj.repPartNotPresent, enforcementId);
        editAppSpecific(""Unable to locate anyone within the premises to inform me"", currAffidavitInfoObj.unableToLocate, enforcementId);
        editAppSpecific(""No officer, director, managing agent, agent, or partner of respondent was present"", currAffidavitInfoObj.noDirAgentPartner, enforcementId);
        editAppSpecific(""Affixed Summons at location"", currAffidavitInfoObj.affixedLocation, enforcementId);
    }
    //Updating DBA FDNY-10921
    var capContactResult = aa.people.getCapContactByCapID(enforcementId);
    if (capContactResult.getSuccess()) {
        var contactsArray = capContactResult.getOutput();
        for (var yy in contactsArray) {
            if (contactsArray[yy].getCapContactModel().getContactType() == ""Respondent"") {
                var dba = contactsArray[yy].getCapContactModel().getTradeName();
                editAppSpecific(""DBA"", dba, enforcementId);
                break;
            }
        }
    }
    
}

        var middleName = (businessOwner.getMiddleName() == null || businessOwner.getMiddleName() == """") ? """" : ("" "" + businessOwner.getMiddleName() + "" "");
        var lastName = (businessOwner.getLastName() == null || businessOwner.getLastName() == """") ? """" : ("" "" + businessOwner.getLastName());

function formatDateToString2(dateToFormat) {
    var formattedDate = (dateToFormat.getMonth() + 1) + ""/"" + (dateToFormat.getDate()) + ""/"" + (dateToFormat.getYear() + 1900);
    return formattedDate;
}

function getFormattedDate(dateVal) {
    /*
     * Converts date to ""MM/DD/YYYY"" format @param dateVal - Date to format
     * @return - Formatted date
     */
     var monthVal = dateVal.getMonth() + 1;
     monthVal = monthVal.toString();

     if (monthVal.length == 1) {
        monthVal = ""0"" + monthVal;
    }

    var dayVal = dateVal.getDate();
    dayVal = dayVal.toString();

    if (dayVal.length == 1) {
        dayVal = ""0"" + dayVal;
    }

    var formattedDate = monthVal + ""/"" + dayVal + ""/"" + dateVal.getFullYear();

    return formattedDate;
}

function getHearingDetails(boroughValue) {
    /*
     * Returns an object with the Compliance date and Hearing dates as
     * attributes. This information is retrieved from the ASIT of Mapping
     * record. @returns - Object with the Compliance date and Hearing dates as
     * attributes
     */
     var hearingDetailsObj = new Object();
     hearingDetailsObj.complianceDate = null;
     hearingDetailsObj.hearingDate = null;
     var currentDate = getFormattedDate(new Date());
    // var boroughValue = getAddressCity(capId);
    var mappingRecordCapID = getInternalMappingRecord();
    var hearingDetailsASIT = loadASITable(""HEARING DETAILS"", mappingRecordCapID);
    if (hearingDetailsASIT == null || boroughValue == null) {
        return hearingDetailsObj;
    }
    aa.print(""currentDate: "" + currentDate);
    aa.print(""boroughValue: "" + boroughValue);
    for (var i in hearingDetailsASIT) {
        var row = hearingDetailsASIT[i];
        var serviceDate = row[""Service Date""];
        var boroughID = row[""Borough ID""];
        if (boroughID != null && boroughID.toString().equalsIgnoreCase(boroughValue) && currentDate != null && currentDate.equalsIgnoreCase(serviceDate)) {
            hearingDetailsObj.complianceDate = row[""Compliance Date""];
            hearingDetailsObj.hearingDate = row[""Hearing Date""];
            return hearingDetailsObj;
        }
    }
    return hearingDetailsObj;
}

}

function getMeetingTime(enforcementId) {
    /*
     * Returns the time of scheduled hearing meeting on a Summons record @param
     * enforcementId - Summons record ID @return - Meeting Start time
     */
     var meetingRes = aa.meeting.getMeetingsByCAP(enforcementId, false);

     if (meetingRes.getSuccess()) {
        var meetings = meetingRes.getOutput();
        var iter = meetings.iterator();

        while (iter.hasNext()) {
            var meeting = iter.next();
            var meet = meeting.getMeeting();
            return meet.getStartTime();
        }
    }
}

     if (inspectionModel == null) {

            if (deptCode.equals(inspectorObj.deptOfUser)) {
                return dept.getDeptName();
            }
        }
    }
    return """";
}

function generateFDNYSummonsRecord(fdnySummonsList, repeatType, isFalseCertification, inspModel) {
    aa.print(""Generate FDNY Summons record. fdnySummonsList: "" + fdnySummonsList.length);
    var vcCountArr = new Array();
    var count = 0;
    var vcCount = 0;
    var maxCodeCount = 1;
    var tempArray = new Array();
    var isRepeatOffender = false;
    var repeatedFromRecord = null;
    if (arguments.length == 5) {
        repeatedFromRecord = arguments[4];
    }

    if (repeatType == ""repeat"") {
        maxCodeCount = Number(lookup(""BFP_FSUM_VIOLATION_CODE_INFO"", ""Repeat Max Summons Count""));
        isRepeatOffender = true;
    } else {
        maxCodeCount = Number(lookup(""BFP_FSUM_VIOLATION_CODE_INFO"", ""NonRepeat Max Summons Count""));
    }

    for (var x in fdnySummonsList) {
        var _vc = getVCCodeFromFdnySummonsList(fdnySummonsList[x]);
        if (vcCountArr[_vc] != null) {
            vcCountArr[_vc] = vcCountArr[_vc] + 1;
        } else {
            vcCountArr[_vc] = 1;
        }

    }

    logDebug(""VC Counts"");
    for (var vc in vcCountArr) {
        logDebug(vc + ""  -  "" + vcCountArr[vc]);
    }



    //New logic

    for (var vc in vcCountArr) {
        var balanceSlot = maxCodeCount - tempArray.length;
        if (vcCountArr[vc] <= balanceSlot) {
            for (var i in fdnySummonsList) {
                var _vc1 = new String(vc);
                var _vc2 = new String(getVCCodeFromFdnySummonsList(fdnySummonsList[i]));
                if (_vc2.trim() == _vc1.trim()) {
                    tempArray.push(fdnySummonsList[i]);
                }

            }
        } else {
            if (tempArray.length > 0) {
                createFDNYSummonsRecord(tempArray, isRepeatOffender, isFalseCertification, repeatedFromRecord);
                tempArray = new Array();
            }
            for (var i in fdnySummonsList) {
                var _vc1 = new String(vc);
                var _vc2 = new String(getVCCodeFromFdnySummonsList(fdnySummonsList[i]));
                if (_vc2.trim() == _vc1.trim()) {
                    tempArray.push(fdnySummonsList[i]);
                }
            }
        }

        if (tempArray.length >= maxCodeCount) {
            createFDNYSummonsRecord(tempArray, isRepeatOffender, isFalseCertification, repeatedFromRecord);
            tempArray = new Array();
        }
    }

    if (tempArray.length > 0) {
        createFDNYSummonsRecord(tempArray, isRepeatOffender, isFalseCertification, repeatedFromRecord);
        tempArray = new Array();
    }

}

function checkRepeatOffenderSummonsCreation(parentCapIdValue, currentInfractionObjList, inspModel) {
    /*
     * Check if the applicant of the Inspection is a Repeat Offender. Checks
     * ASIT of every child FDNY Summons record for violations as well as
     * iterates over the currentInfractionObjList to check for repeating
     * violation codes. If VC 12 code is repeated within 6 months or any other
     * code is repeatd within 18 months, applicant is flagges as Repeat Offender
     * @param parentCapIdValue - Cap ID of Inspection record @param
     * currentInfractionObjList - List of violation codes retrieved from
     * Checklist of current Inspection @returns - Empty array if no repeating
     * violation code is found, or list of Repeating violation codes in case of
     * Repeat Offender
     */
     var repeatingCodes = {};
     try {
        var vRepeatoffender = getRepeatOffenderValue(inspModel);
        if (vRepeatoffender && vRepeatoffender != """" && vRepeatoffender != ""N/A"" && vRepeatoffender != ""Yes"") {
            logDebug(""Repeat Offender Flag Overridden to Value :"" + vRepeatoffender);
            if (vRepeatoffender == ""No"")
                repeatingCodes = new Array();
            return repeatingCodes;
        }
    } catch (err) {
        logDebug(""getRepeatOffenderValue: "" + err);
    }
    var codeVC12 = ""VC12"";
    var violationASITName = ""LIST OF VIOLATION CODES"";
    var childCapArray = getChildren(""BFP/Enforcement/FDNY Summons/NA"",
        parentCapIdValue);
    var isRepeatOffender = false;
    var today = new Date();
    var todayMinus6Months = addMonths(today, -6);
    var todayMinus18Months = addMonths(today, -18);
    var violationCodeMap = new Array();

    if (childCapArray != null && childCapArray.length > 0) {
        for (y in childCapArray) {
            var childCapId = childCapArray[y];
            var dispositionDismissedTaskStatus = isTaskStatusCustom(
                ""Disposition"", ""Dismissed"", ""BFP_ENF_FDNYSUM"", childCapId);
            var fdnySummonsAppStatus = getAppStatus(childCapId);
            var inspIdFromSummon = """" + getAppSpecific(""INSPECTION ID"", childCapId);

            if (String(inspId) == inspIdFromSummon) {
                logDebug(""It is from the same inspection"");
                continue;
            }
            if (dispositionDismissedTaskStatus ||
                fdnySummonsAppStatus == ""Voided"" || fdnySummonsAppStatus == ""Voided - No Hearing Required"" || 
                fdnySummonsAppStatus == ""Summons Under Review"" || fdnySummonsAppStatus == ""In Progress"" || 
                fdnySummonsAppStatus == ""Abated - No Hearing Required"") {
                continue;
        }

        var childCapModel = aa.cap.getCap(childCapId);

        if (childCapModel.getSuccess()) {

            childCapModel = childCapModel.getOutput().getCapModel();
            var listViolationCodes = loadASITable(violationASITName,
                childCapId);
            if (listViolationCodes == null || listViolationCodes.length < 1) {
                continue;
            }


            aa.print(""childCapId "" + childCapId.getCustomID());
            var newListViolationCodes = omitDismissedViolationCodes(
                childCapId, listViolationCodes);

            var childFileDate = childCapModel.getFileDate();
            childFileDate = new Date(
                (childFileDate.getYear() < 1900 ? childFileDate
                    .getYear() + 1900 : childFileDate.getYear()),
                childFileDate.getMonth(), childFileDate.getDate());

            if (childFileDate > todayMinus18Months) {
                var violationCode = """";

                for (var thisRow in newListViolationCodes) {
                    violationCode = newListViolationCodes[thisRow];

                    aa.print(""violationCode "" + violationCode);
                    if ((violationCode != codeVC12) || (violationCode == codeVC12 && childFileDate > todayMinus6Months)) {
                        violationCodeMap[violationCode] = childCapId.getCustomID().toString();
                    }
                }
            }
        } else {
            logDebug(""Could not fetch cap model for child record: "" +
                childCapId);
        }
    }
    aa.print(""violationCodeMap items"");
    for (i in violationCodeMap) {
        aa.print(i + "" "" + violationCodeMap[i]);
    }
    for (i in currentInfractionObjList) {
        var violationCategory = currentInfractionObjList[i].internalMappingObj.violationCategory;
        aa.print(""violationCategory checking in violationCodeMap "" + violationCategory);
        if (violationCodeMap[violationCategory] != null) {
            aa.print(""Repeating Violation Category found: "" +
                violationCategory);
            repeatingCodes[violationCategory] = violationCodeMap[violationCategory];
        } else if (violationCategory.indexOf(""|"") > -1) {
            var violationCategoryArray = violationCategory.split(""|"");
            for (var i in violationCategoryArray) {
                if (violationCodeMap[violationCategoryArray[i]] != null) {
                    aa.print(""Repeating Violation Category found: "" +
                        violationCategoryArray[i]);
                    repeatingCodes[violationCategoryArray[i]] = violationCodeMap[violationCategoryArray[i]];
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

return repeatingCodes;
}


function omitDismissedViolationCodes(summonsCapID, listViolationCodes) {
    var listDispositionCodes = loadASITable(""INFRACTION DISPOSITION DETAILS"",
        summonsCapID);
    var dismissedCodeMap = {};
    var nonDismissedVCList = new Array();

    if (listDispositionCodes != null && listDispositionCodes.length > 0) {
        var lastUpdateDate = listDispositionCodes[(listDispositionCodes.length - 1)][""Last Updated On""]
        .toString();

        for (var i in listDispositionCodes) {
            var row = listDispositionCodes[i];

            if (row[""Last Updated On""] == lastUpdateDate) {
                var decDesc = """" + row[""Decision Description""];
                logDebug(""decDesc "" + decDesc);
                if (decDesc != null && decDesc != """") // FDNY-10041
                {
                    if (decDesc.toUpperCase() == ""DISMISSED"") {
                        dismissedCodeMap[row[""Violation Category""]] = true;
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }

    for (var i in listViolationCodes) {
        var row = listViolationCodes[i];
        var violationCode = row[""Violation Category""];
        var corrected = row[""Corrected""];
        if (corrected == ""No"") {
            if (dismissedCodeMap[violationCode] == null) {
                nonDismissedVCList.push(violationCode);
            }
        }

    }

    return nonDismissedVCList;
}


function editASIInfractionDetail(infractionCode, infractionDetailsObj, newRecordCapID, violationType) {
    var infIndex = 0;
    var splitInfractionCodes = String(infractionDetailsObj.infractionCodes).split(""|"");
    for (var i in splitInfractionCodes) {
        if (splitInfractionCodes[i] == infractionCode) {
            infIndex = i;
            break;
        }
    }
    var splitRemedy = String(infractionDetailsObj.remedy).split(""|"");
    var splitVODescription = String(infractionDetailsObj.voDescription).split(""|"");
    var splitCompliancePeriod = String(infractionDetailsObj.compliancePeriod).split(""|"");
    editAppSpecific(""Infraction Code"", infractionCode, newRecordCapID);
    editAppSpecific(""Complied With"", ""No"", newRecordCapID);
    editAppSpecific(""Checklist Item"", infractionDetailsObj.checklistItem, newRecordCapID);
    editAppSpecific(""Comments"", infractionDetailsObj.comment, newRecordCapID);
    editAppSpecific(""Checklist Status"", infractionDetailsObj.checklistStatus, newRecordCapID);
    editAppSpecific(""Infraction Description"", splitVODescription[infIndex], newRecordCapID);
    editAppSpecific(""Remedy"", splitRemedy[infIndex], newRecordCapID);
    editAppSpecific(""Compliance Period"", splitCompliancePeriod[infIndex], newRecordCapID);
    editInspectionInfoASI(newRecordCapID);
    if (violationType == ""VO"") {
        // var valCompliancePeriod = Number(splitCompliancePeriod[infIndex]);
        // aa.print(""valCompliancePeriod: "" + valCompliancePeriod);
        // if (reInspectionDays == null || reInspectionDays > valCompliancePeriod) {
            var compPeriodVal = ""30"";
            if (splitCompliancePeriod[infIndex] != null && splitCompliancePeriod[infIndex] != """") {
                compPeriodVal = splitCompliancePeriod[infIndex];
            }
            if (reInspectionDays == null) {
                reInspectionDays = compPeriodVal;
            } else {
                reInspectionDays = reInspectionDays + "","" + compPeriodVal;
            }
        }
        var asitObj = new Object();
        asitObj.infractionCode = infractionCode;
        asitObj.recordID = newRecordCapID.getCustomID().toString();
        asitObj.checklistItem = infractionDetailsObj.checklistItem;
        asitObj.checklistStatus = infractionDetailsObj.checklistStatus;
        asitObj.inspectionDate = todayDate;
        if (violationType == ""VO"") {
            aa.print(""*** Adding Object to VO ASIT"");
            voIssuedList.push(asitObj);
        } else if (violationType == ""CCS"") {
            aa.print(""*** Adding Object to CCS ASIT"");
            ccsIssuedList.push(asitObj);
        }
    }

    function editInspectionInfoASI(enforcementID) {
        if (inspectionModel != null) {
            editAppSpecific(""INSPECTION NAME"", inspectionModel.getInspectionType(), enforcementID);
            editAppSpecific(""INSPECTION ID"", inspectionModel.getIdNumber(), enforcementID);
        }
        var inspectorName = getInspectorName();
        editAppSpecific(""INSPECTOR NAME"", inspectorName, enforcementID);
        editAppSpecific(""INSPECTION DATE"", getFormattedDate(new Date()), enforcementID);

        var empId = getEmployeeID(currentUserID.toString());
        if (empId == """")
            editAppSpecific(""INSPECTOR ID"", currentUserID.toString(), enforcementID);
        else
            editAppSpecific(""INSPECTOR ID"", getEmployeeID(currentUserID.toString()), enforcementID);

        var applicationType = getAppSpecific(""Application Type"");
        if (applicationType != null) {
            editAppSpecific(""Division FP Unit"", applicationType, enforcementID);
            editAppSpecific(""Type"", applicationType, enforcementID);
        }
    }

//SQL to get the Employee ID from PUSER Table
function getEmployeeID(userID) {
    var empID = """";
    if (userID) {
        try {
            var selectString = ""SELECT PU.EMPLOYEE_ID EMPLOYEE_ID FROM PUSER PU WHERE PU.USER_NAME='"" + String(userID).toUpperCase() + ""'"";
            var conn = aa.db.getConnection();
            var sStmt = conn.prepareStatement(selectString);
            var rSet = sStmt.executeQuery();
            rSet.next();
            var result = rSet.getString(""EMPLOYEE_ID"");
            rSet.close();
            conn.close();
            if (result) {
                empID = String(result);
            }
        } catch (Err) {
            logDebug(""Error in function getEmployeeID "" + Err);
        }
    }
    return empID;
}


function getInspectorName() {
    var inspectorName = """";
    if (inspectionModel != null && inspectionModel.getInspector() != null) {
        inspectorName = inspectionModel.getInspector().getFirstName() + "" "" + inspectionModel.getInspector().getLastName();
    } else {
        var currentUser = aa.person.getUser(currentUserID);
        if (currentUser.getSuccess()) {
            currentUser = currentUser.getOutput();
            inspectorName = currentUser.getFirstName();
            if (currentUser.getLastName() != null) {
                inspectorName = inspectorName + "" "" + currentUser.getLastName();
            }
        }
    }
    return inspectorName;
}

function addASITInfractionCodes(infractionObjList, summonsCapId) {
    /*
     * Adds Violation codes to ASIT of Summons record @param infractionObjList -
     * List of Violation codes to be added to ASIT @param summonsCapId - Cap ID
     * of Summons record
     */
     var infractionCodeArray = new Array();
     aa.print(""##### addASITInfractionCodes: "" + infractionObjList.length);
     for (i in infractionObjList) {
        var obj = infractionObjList[i];
        var infractionCode = obj.infractionCode;

        var infractionDetailsObj = obj.internalMappingObj;
        var checklistItem = infractionDetailsObj.checklistItem;
        var checklistStatus = infractionDetailsObj.checklistStatus;
        var comment = infractionDetailsObj.comment;
        var remedy = """",
        vcCode = """",
        vcDescription = """",
        compliancePeriod = """",
        infractionName = """";
        var infIndex = 0;
        var splitInfractionCodes = String(infractionDetailsObj.infractionCodes).split(""|"");
        for (var i in splitInfractionCodes) {
            if (splitInfractionCodes[i].toUpperCase() == infractionCode.toUpperCase()) {
                infIndex = i;
                break;
            }
        }
        if (splitInfractionCodes.length > 1) {
            var splitRemedy = String(infractionDetailsObj.remedy).split(""|"");
            var splitViolationCategory = String(infractionDetailsObj.violationCategory).split(""|"");
            var splitVCDescription = String(infractionDetailsObj.vcDescription).split(""|"");            
            var splitCompliancePeriod = String(infractionDetailsObj.compliancePeriod).split(""|"");
            var splitInfractionNames = String(infractionDetailsObj.infractionNames).split(""|"");
            if (splitRemedy.length > infIndex)
                remedy = splitRemedy[infIndex];
            if (splitViolationCategory.length > infIndex)
                vcCode = splitViolationCategory[infIndex];
            if (splitVCDescription.length > infIndex)
                vcDescription = splitVCDescription[infIndex];
            if (splitCompliancePeriod.length > infIndex)
                compliancePeriod = splitCompliancePeriod[infIndex];
            if (splitInfractionNames.length > infIndex)
                infractionName = splitInfractionNames[infIndex];
        } else {
            remedy = infractionDetailsObj.remedy;
            vcCode = infractionDetailsObj.violationCategory;
            vcDescription = infractionDetailsObj.vcDescription;
            compliancePeriod = infractionDetailsObj.compliancePeriod;
            infractionName = infractionDetailsObj.infractionNames;
        }
        aa.print(""*** remedy: "" + remedy);
        aa.print(""*** vcCode: "" + vcCode);
        aa.print(""*** vcDescription: "" + vcDescription);
        aa.print(""*** compliancePeriod: "" + compliancePeriod);
        aa.print(""*** infractionName: "" + infractionName);
        var infractionCodeObject = new Array();
        infractionCodeObject[""Infraction Code""] = infractionCode;
        infractionCodeObject[""Violation Category""] = vcCode;
        infractionCodeObject[""Checklist Item""] = checklistItem;
        infractionCodeObject[""Checklist Status""] = checklistStatus;
        infractionCodeObject[""Comments""] = comment;
        infractionCodeObject[""Corrected""] = ""No"";
        infractionCodeObject[""Infraction Name""] = infractionName;
        infractionCodeObject[""Infraction Description""] = vcDescription;
        infractionCodeObject[""Remedy""] = remedy;
        infractionCodeArray.push(infractionCodeObject);
        var fdnySummonsASITObj = new Object();
        fdnySummonsASITObj.infractionCode = infractionCode;
        fdnySummonsASITObj.recordID = summonsCapId.getCustomID().toString();
        fdnySummonsASITObj.checklistItem = checklistItem;
        fdnySummonsASITObj.checklistStatus = checklistStatus;
        fdnySummonsASITObj.inspectionDate = todayDate;
        fdnySummIssuedList.push(fdnySummonsASITObj);
    }
    if (infractionCodeArray.length > 0) {
        addASITable(""LIST OF VIOLATION CODES"", infractionCodeArray, summonsCapId);
        logDebug(""Added to ASIT: LIST OF VIOLATION CODES"");
    }
}

function getCheckedInfractionCodes(guidesheetItem, internalMappingObj) {
    var strInfractionCodes = internalMappingObj.infractionCodes;
    logDebug(""strInfractionCodes "" + strInfractionCodes);
    if (strInfractionCodes != null && strInfractionCodes != """") {
        var splitInfractionCodes = strInfractionCodes.split(""|"");
        if (splitInfractionCodes.length <= 1) {
            return splitInfractionCodes;
        }
        var checkedInfractionCodes = new Array();
        var checklistTemplateGroup = guidesheetItem.getItemASISubgroupList();
        var iterator = checklistTemplateGroup.iterator();
        while (iterator.hasNext()) {
            var templateItemObj = iterator.next();
            var templateItemList = templateItemObj.getAsiList();
            var templateIterator = templateItemList.iterator();
            while (templateIterator.hasNext()) {
                var templateItem = templateIterator.next();
                if (templateItem.getAttributeValue() != null && templateItem.getAttributeValue() == ""CHECKED"") {
                    if (splitInfractionCodes.indexOf(String(templateItem.getAsiName())) !== -1) {
                        checkedInfractionCodes.push(templateItem.getAsiName());
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        return checkedInfractionCodes;
    }
}

function populateChecklistMappings(internalMappingRecord, tableName) {
    var checklistMap = aa.util.newHashMap();
    var columnToBeSearched = ""Checklist Item"";
    if (arguments.length == 3) {
        columnToBeSearched = arguments[2];
    }
    var mappingTable = loadASITable(tableName, internalMappingRecord);
    for (i in mappingTable) {
        var row = mappingTable[i];
        var mappingObj = new Object();
        mappingObj.checklistItem = row[""Checklist Item""].toString();
        mappingObj.checklistStatus = row[""Checklist Status""].toString();
        mappingObj.infractionCodes = row[""Infraction Code""].toString();
        if (row[""Infraction Name""] != undefined)
            mappingObj.infractionNames = row[""Infraction Name""].toString();
        else
            mappingObj.infractionNames = row[""Infraction Description""] != null ? row[""Infraction Description""].toString() : """";
        mappingObj.remedy = row[""Remedy""].toString();
        mappingObj.vcDescription = row[""VC Description""].toString();
        mappingObj.violationCategory = row[""Violation Category""].toString();
        mappingObj.voDescription = row[""VO Description""].toString();
        mappingObj.detailFields = row[""Detail Fields""].toString();
        mappingObj.compliancePeriod = row[""Compliance Period""].toString();
        //aa.print(mappingObj.checklistItem + "": "" + mappingObj.checklistStatus + "", "" + mappingObj.infractionCodes  + "", "" + mappingObj.remedy  + "", "" + mappingObj.vcDescription  + "", "" + mappingObj.voDescription  + "", "" + mappingObj.detailFields  + "", "" + mappingObj.compliancePeriod);
        checklistMap.put(mappingObj.checklistItem, mappingObj);
    }
    return checklistMap;
}

function updateSummonsALTID(enforcementId) {
    /*
     * Updates the Alt ID of the input FDNY summons record. @param enforcementId -
     * Cap ID of input FDNY Summons record. @returns - NONE.
     */
     var updatedEnforcementID = enforcementId.getCustomID().toString();
     if (updatedEnforcementID.endsWith(""00"")) {
        updatedEnforcementID = getNextRecordAltID(servProvCode, enforcementId, ""BFP/Enforcement/FDNY Summons/NA"");
    }
    /*
    var novNumber = getNovNumber(updatedEnforcementID);
    if (novNumber != """" && novNumber != null) {
        var result = aa.cap.updateCapAltID(enforcementId, novNumber);
        if (result.getSuccess()) {
            logDebug(""Updated ALT ID: "" + novNumber);
            return novNumber;
        }
    }*/
    var novNumber = getFDNYSummonsALTID(String(updatedEnforcementID));
    if (novNumber != """" && novNumber != null) {

function generateEnforcementASITArray(enfObjList, enfType) {
    var enfInformationASITArray = new Array();
    for (var i in enfObjList) {
        var enfObj = enfObjList[i];
        var row = new Array();
        row[""Infraction Code""] = enfObj.infractionCode;
        row[""Checklist Item""] = enfObj.checklistItem;
        row[""Checklist Status""] = enfObj.checklistStatus;
        if (enfType == ""Violation Order"") {
            row[""Violation Order Detail Record ID""] = enfObj.recordID;
        } else if (enfType == ""FDNY Summons"") {
            row[""FDNY Summons Record ID""] = enfObj.recordID;
        } else if (enfType == ""CCS"") {
            row[""Criminal Court Summons Record ID""] = enfObj.recordID;
        }
        row[""Date of Inspection""] = enfObj.inspectionDate;
        enfInformationASITArray.push(row);
    }
    if (enfType == ""Violation Order"") {
        aa.print(""$$$ Adding VO Data to ASIT"");
        addASITableCustom(""VIOLATION ORDER INFORMATION"", enfInformationASITArray, capId);
    } else if (enfType == ""FDNY Summons"") {
        aa.print(""$$$ Adding FDNY Summons Data to ASIT"");
        addASITableCustom(""FDNY SUMMONS INFORMATION"", enfInformationASITArray, capId);
    } else if (enfType == ""CCS"") {
        aa.print(""$$$ Adding CCS Data to ASIT"");
        addASITableCustom(""CRIMINAL COURT SUMMONS INFO"", enfInformationASITArray, capId);
    }
}

function addASITableCustom(tableName, tableValueArray) { // optional capId
    // tableName is the name of the ASI table
    // tableValueArray is an array of associative array values. All elements
    // MUST be either a string or asiTableVal object
    var itemCap = capId
    if (arguments.length > 2) itemCap = arguments[2]; // use cap ID specified in args
    var tssmResult = aa.appSpecificTableScript.getAppSpecificTableModel(itemCap, tableName);
    if (!tssmResult.getSuccess()) {
        aa.print(""**WARNING: error retrieving app specific table "" + tableName + "" "" + tssmResult.getErrorMessage());
        return false;
    }
    var tssm = tssmResult.getOutput();
    var tsm = tssm.getAppSpecificTableModel();
    var fld = tsm.getTableField();
    for (thisrow in tableValueArray) {
        var col = tsm.getColumns()
        var coli = col.iterator();
        while (coli.hasNext()) {
            var colname = coli.next();
            if (!tableValueArray[thisrow][colname.getColumnName()]) {
                aa.print(""addToASITable: null or undefined value supplied for column "" + colname.getColumnName() + "", setting to empty string"");
                tableValueArray[thisrow][colname.getColumnName()] = """";
            }
            if (typeof(tableValueArray[thisrow][colname.getColumnName()].fieldValue) != ""undefined"") {
                fld.add(tableValueArray[thisrow][colname.getColumnName()].fieldValue);
            } else { // we are passed a string
                fld.add(tableValueArray[thisrow][colname.getColumnName()]);
            }
        }
        tsm.setTableField(fld);
    }
    var addResult = aa.appSpecificTableScript.editAppSpecificTableInfos(tsm, itemCap, currentUserID);
    if (!addResult.getSuccess()) {
        aa.print(""**WARNING: error adding record to ASI Table:  "" + tableName + "" "" + addResult.getErrorMessage());
        return false;
    } else {
        aa.print(""Successfully added record to ASI Table: "" + tableName);
    }
}

function getReInspectionDays() {
    var inspectionIDVal;
    var result;
    if (arguments.length > 0) {
        inspectionIDVal = arguments[0];
    }
    aa.print(""In getReInspectionDays: "" + inspectionIDVal);
    var inspTable = loadASITable(""INSPECTION INFORMATION"", capId);
    if (inspTable == null || inspTable.length == 0) {
        return null;
    }
    var compliancePeriodVal = 30;
    if (inspectionIDVal != null && inspectionIDVal.toString() != """") {
        for (i in inspTable) {
            var row = inspTable[i];
            aa.print(row[""Inspection ID""]);
            if (inspectionIDVal.toString() == row[""Inspection ID""].toString()) {
                aa.print(""Here 1"");
                if (row[""VO issued?""] != null && row[""VO issued?""] != """") {
                    if (row[""Compliance Period""] != null && row[""Compliance Period""] != """") {
                        compliancePeriodVal = row[""Compliance Period""];
                    }
                    result = new Object();
                    result.reInspectionDays = compliancePeriodVal.toString();
                    result.voIDList = row[""VO issued?""].toString();
                    result.inspectorUserID = row[""Inspector User ID""];
                    result.inspectionID = row[""Inspection ID""];
                    return result;
                }
            }
        }
    } else {
        var row = null;
        if (inspTable.length == 1) {
            row = inspTable[0];
        } else if (inspTable.length > 1) {
            row = inspTable[inspTable.length - 1];
        }

        if (row != null && row[""VO issued?""] != null && row[""VO issued?""] != """") {
            if (row[""Compliance Period""] != null && row[""Compliance Period""] != """") {
                compliancePeriodVal = row[""Compliance Period""];
            }
            result = new Object();
            result.reInspectionDays = compliancePeriodVal.toString();
            result.voIDList = row[""VO issued?""].toString();
            result.inspectorUserID = row[""Inspector User ID""];
            result.inspectionID = row[""Inspection ID""];
        }
    }

    return result;
}

function scheduleInspectCustom(itemCap, iType, DaysAhead, inspectorID, parentInspID, reqComment) {
    // DQ - Added Optional 5th parameter inspComm ex. to call without specifying
    // other options params scheduleInspection(""Type"",5,null,null,""Schedule
    // Comment"");
    var inspTime = ""6:00 PM"";
    var inspComm = ""Scheduled via Script"";
    var inspectorObj = null;
    var newInspectionStatus = ""Assignment Complete"";
    var unitValue = getAppSpecific(""Application Type"", itemCap);
    if (inspectorID != null && inspectorID != """" && (unitValue == ""Hazardous Cargo"" || unitValue == ""CDA"" || unitValue == ""Public Building"")) {
        inspectorObj = getInspectorUserObj(inspectorID);
        newInspectionStatus = ""Pending Routing Approval"";
    } else {
        inspectorObj = getUnassignedInspector();
    }
    aa.print(""In scheduleInspectCustom: "" + reqComment + "" "" + inspectorID + "" "" + newInspectionStatus);
    if (inspectorObj != null) {
        aa.print(""Here"");
        // var schedRes = aa.inspection.scheduleInspection(itemCap, inspectorObj, aa.date.parseDate(dateAdd(null, DaysAhead)), inspTime, iType, inspComm);
        var schedRes = scheduleInspectionWithCustomGroup(itemCap, inspectorObj, aa.date.parseDate(dateAdd(null, DaysAhead)), inspTime, iType, ""Re-Inspection scheduled for VO: "" + reqComment);
        if (schedRes) {
            aa.print(""Successfully scheduled inspection : "" + iType + "" for "" + dateAdd(null, DaysAhead));
            var newInspectionID = schedRes.toString();
            updateInspectionStatusNew(newInspectionID, itemCap, parentInspID, iType, newInspectionStatus);
            reInspectionScheduledFlag = true;
            // var latestPrimaryInspID = getLatestPrimaryInspection(capId);
            aa.print(""parentInspID: "" + parentInspID);
            if (parentInspID != null) {
                createInspectionRelation(parentInspID, newInspectionID, capId);
            }

            var inspVOMappingASITArray = new Array();
            var row = new Array();
            row[""Inspection ID""] = newInspectionID;
            row[""VO Record IDs""] = reqComment.toString();
            inspVOMappingASITArray.push(row);
            addASITableCustom(""REINSPECTION VO MAPPING"", inspVOMappingASITArray, capId);
        } else {
            aa.print(""**ERROR: adding scheduling inspection ("" + iType + "")"");
        }
    }
}

function updateInspectionStatusNew(newInspectionID, inspCapID, parentInspID, iType, newInspStatus) {
    var inspectionScriptModel = aa.inspection.getInspection(inspCapID, newInspectionID);
    if (inspectionScriptModel.getSuccess()) {
        aa.print(""Re-Inspection scheduled"");
        inspectionScriptModel = inspectionScriptModel.getOutput();
        inspectionScriptModel.setInspectionStatus(newInspStatus);
        var scheduledDate = inspectionScriptModel.getScheduledDate();
        var desiredDate = new Date(Number(scheduledDate.getMonth()) + ""/"" + Number(scheduledDate.getDayOfMonth()) + ""/"" + Number(scheduledDate.getYear()));
        inspectionScriptModel.inspection.activity.desiredDate = desiredDate;
        // inspectionScriptModel.inspection.activity.actEndTime1 = ""PM"";
        // inspectionScriptModel.inspection.activity.actEndTime2 = ""9:00"";
        inspectionScriptModel.inspection.activity.time2 = ""06:00:00"";
        inspectionScriptModel.inspection.activity.time1 = ""PM"";
        inspectionScriptModel.inspection.activity.actEndTime2 = ""06:01:00"";
        inspectionScriptModel.inspection.activity.actEndTime1 = ""PM"";
                                     
        inspectionScriptModel.inspection.activity.vehicleID = parentInspID.toString();
        var res = aa.inspection.editInspection(inspectionScriptModel);
        aa.print(""res: "" + res.getSuccess());
        addInspectionToSet(inspectionScriptModel.getInspection(), inspCapID);
        addInspectionStatusRow(newInspectionID, iType, newInspStatus, parentInspID);
        var applicationTypeVal = getAppSpecific(""Application Type"", inspCapID);
        if (matches(applicationTypeVal, ""Rangehood"", ""Rooftop"", ""ARCS"")) {
            addReInspectionChecklists(newInspectionID, parentInspID);
        }
    }
}

function addReInspectionChecklists(inspSeqID, parentInspID) {
    var inspectionScriptModel = getInspectionModelFromRecord(parentInspID);
    var guidesheet = inspectionScriptModel.getGuideSheets();
    if (guidesheet) {
        guidesheetArray = guidesheet.toArray();
        inspectionChecklistList = guidesheetArray;
        for (var x in inspectionChecklistList) {
            var guidesheetType = inspectionChecklistList[x].getGuideType();
            addGuideSheet(capId, Number(inspSeqID), guidesheetType);
            aa.print(""Added new Checklist on ReInspection: "" + guidesheetType);
        }
    }
}

function getViolationOrderMapping(recordID) {
    var voInspMappingASIT = loadASITable(""REINSPECTION VO MAPPING"", recordID);
    var voRecordListVal = """";

    if (voInspMappingASIT != null) {
        for (var i = 0; i < voInspMappingASIT.length; i++) {
            var row = voInspMappingASIT[i];

            if (row[""Inspection ID""].toString() == inspId.toString()) {
                voRecordListVal = row[""VO Record IDs""].toString();
            }
        }
    }
    aa.print(""voRecordListVal: "" + voRecordListVal);
    var mappingRecordMap = aa.util.newHashMap();
    // exploreObject(mappingRecordMap);
    var voRecordList = getChildren(""BFP/Enforcement/VO Details/NA"", recordID);
    if (voRecordList != null && voRecordList != false && voRecordList.length > 0) {
        for (var i in voRecordList) {
            var voRecordID = voRecordList[i];
            var voRecordALTID = voRecordID.getCustomID().toString();
            aa.print(""voRecordALTID: "" + voRecordALTID);
            if (voRecordListVal.indexOf(voRecordALTID) > -1) {
                var checklistItem = getAppSpecific(""Checklist Item"", voRecordID);
                var violationCode = getAppSpecific(""Infraction Code"", voRecordID);
                aa.print(""checklistItem: "" + checklistItem + ""|"" + violationCode);
                if (checklistItem != null && checklistItem != """" && violationCode != null) {
                    var valObj = new Object();
                    valObj.voRecordID = voRecordID;
                    valObj.currentStatus = ""Active"";
                    valObj.newStatus = null;
                    valObj.voRecordList = voRecordListVal;
                    mappingRecordMap.put(checklistItem + ""|"" + violationCode, valObj);
                    aa.print(""Added to map: "" + voRecordALTID);
                }
            }
        }
    }
    return mappingRecordMap;
}

function processChecklistLOAPermit(inspModel) {
    var guidesheet = inspModel.getGuideSheets();
    var infractionObjList = new Array();
    var fdnySummonsList = new Array();
    var losfdnySummonsList = new Array();
    if (guidesheet) {
        guidesheetArray = guidesheet.toArray();
        inspectionChecklistList = guidesheetArray;
        var isNonJurisdictionBuilding = processGeneralInformation(guidesheetArray);
        processEnforcementAffidavitInformation(guidesheetArray);
        var internalMappingRecord = getInternalMappingRecord();
        var enhancedInternalMapping = populateChecklistMappingsX(internalMappingRecord, ""ENHANCED INSPECTION"");
        for (var x in guidesheetArray) {
            var mappingASITName = getChecklistASITNameMappingX(guidesheetArray[x]);
            var inspectionInternalMapping = populateChecklistMappingsX(internalMappingRecord, mappingASITName);
            var guidesheetType = guidesheetArray[x].getGuideType();
            var guidesheetItems = guidesheetArray[x].getItems().toArray();
            var internalMapping;
            var checklistType = ""INSPECTION"";
            if (guidesheetType == ""RH CC TEST FES INFO"" || guidesheetType == ""RH DRY TEST FES INFO"" ||
                guidesheetType == ""ARCS SYSTEM INFORMATION"" || guidesheetType == ""ARCS OPS BLG PROFILE & SYS INF"" ||
                guidesheetType == ""RH OPS AND MAINT OF FES"" || guidesheetType == ""VEHICLE AND HAZMAT DESCRIPTION"" ||
                guidesheetType == ""FILING INFORMATION WPA"" ||  guidesheetType == ""CONTRACTORS INFORMATION"" ||
                guidesheetType == ""LOA COVERAGE WPA"" ||  guidesheetType == ""CONTROLLER INFORMATION"" ||
                guidesheetType == ""FILING INFORMATION RH"" || guidesheetType == ""REPORT COVERAGE"" ||
                guidesheetType == ""FES DESCRIPTION"" || guidesheetType == ""04-LOA Coverage"") {
                processLOAPermitInfo(guidesheetItems);
            }

            if (matches(guidesheetType, ""RH DRY TEST FES DESGN AND INST"",""RH DRY TEST FES INFO"",""RH DRY TEST FES PERFM TEST"",""RH DRY TEST SPEC HAZD INFO"",
                                        ""DESIGN AND INSTALLATION RH SHT"", ""FES PERFORMANCE TEST RH SHT"")) {
                isRHDryChemicalTest = true;
            }
        }
    }
}

function updateCoverageInformation() {
    populateCoverageInformation();
    var deviceDescription = """";

    if (fesInfoObj != null) {
        deviceDescription += populateFESDeviceInfo(fesInfoObj);
        if (fesInfoObj2 != null) {
            deviceDescription += ""\n"" + populateFESDeviceInfo(fesInfoObj2);
            aa.print(""deviceDescription2: "" + deviceDescription);
        }
    }
    if (controllerObj != null) {
        deviceDescription += ""\n"";
        if (controllerObj.manufacturer != null && controllerObj.manufacturer != """") {
            deviceDescription += ""Controller Manufacturer: "" + controllerObj.manufacturer + ""\n"";
        }
        if (controllerObj.model != null && controllerObj.model != """") {
            deviceDescription += ""Controller Model: "" + controllerObj.model + ""\n"";
        }
        if (controllerObj.serialNo != null && controllerObj.serialNo != """") {
            deviceDescription += ""Controller Serial No: "" + controllerObj.serialNo + ""\n"";
        }
        if (controllerObj.listing != null && controllerObj.listing != """") {
            deviceDescription += ""Controller Listing: "" + controllerObj.listing + ""\n"";
        }
    }
    if (fesInfoObj != null) {
        if (fesInfoObj.fesType != null) {
            deviceDescription += fesInfoObj.fesType + ""\n"";
            if (fesInfoObj.fesType == ""Other"" && fesInfoObj.fesSpecifyOther != null) {
                deviceDescription += fesInfoObj.fesSpecifyOther + ""\n"";
            }
        }
        if (fesInfoObj.descriptionOfDeviceEquip != null) {
            deviceDescription += fesInfoObj.descriptionOfDeviceEquip + ""\n"";
        }
    }
    aa.print(""deviceDescription: "" + deviceDescription);
    if (deviceDescription != """") {
        editAppSpecific(""Description of Devices/Equipment"", deviceDescription, capId);
    }

    var coverageItem = lookup(""COVERAGE_ITEM_INSPECTION_MAPPING"", inspType);
    if (coverageItem != null && coverageItem != """") {
        var unitValue = getAppSpecific(""Application Type"");
        if (unitValue == null) {
            unitValue = """";
        }
        var tableName = ""COVERAGE INFORMATION"";
        var inspStatusASITArray = new Array();
        var asitRow = new Array();
        asitRow[""Unit Name""] = unitValue;
        asitRow[""Inspection Type""] = inspType;
        asitRow[""Coverage Item""] = coverageItem;
        asitRow[""Status""] = ""Active"";
        var noOfSystems = getAppSpecific(""RH_Number of Systems"", capId);
        if (noOfSystems != null && noOfSystems != """") {
            asitRow[""Quantity""] = noOfSystems;
        } else {
            asitRow[""Quantity""] = ""1"";
        }
        if (deviceDescription != null && deviceDescription != """") {
            asitRow[""Details""] = deviceDescription;
        } else {
            var detailsText = """";
            if (permitFESInfoObj != null) {
                detailsText += permitFESInfoObj.manufacture + permitFESInfoObj.model;
            }
            if (permitFESInfoObj2 != null) {
                detailsText += permitFESInfoObj2.manufacture + permitFESInfoObj2.model;
            }
            asitRow[""Details""] = detailsText;
        }

        if (generalInfoObj != null && generalInfoObj.floorNumbers != null && generalInfoObj.floorNumbers != """") {
            asitRow[""Floor Number""] = generalInfoObj.floorNumbers;
        }

        inspStatusASITArray.push(asitRow);
        addASITable(tableName, inspStatusASITArray, capId);
        aa.print(""Added Row to Coverage Information ASIT"");
    }
}

function getCoverageInfoArr(recordCapId) {
    var covInfoTable = loadASITable(""COVERAGE INFORMATION"", recordCapId);
    var covInfoArr = new Array();

    if (covInfoTable != null) {
        for (var i in covInfoTable) {
            var row = covInfoTable[i];
            if (row[""Status""] == ""Active"") {
                covInfoArr[row[""Coverage Item""]] = true;
            }
        }
    }

    return covInfoArr;
}

    var applianceTableData = loadASITable(""APPLIANCE INFORMATION"", capId);
    if (applianceTableData != null && applianceTableData != false && applianceTableData.length > 0) {
        return;
    }

    aa.print(""In processApplianceInfo 2"");
    var appASITArr = new Array();
    var guidesheet = inspModel.getGuideSheets();
    if (guidesheet) {
        guidesheetArray = guidesheet.toArray();
        for (var x in guidesheetArray) {
            var guidesheetType = guidesheetArray[x].getGuideType();
            if (guidesheetType == ""RH CC TEST SPECIAL HAZARD INFO"" || guidesheetType == ""HAZARD DESC (COMM KITCHEN)"") {

                    }
                }
            } else if (guidesheetType.toLowerCase().startsWith(""coverage information"")) {
                var guidesheetItems = guidesheetArray[x].getItems().toArray();
                for (var loopi in guidesheetItems) {
                    var guidesheetItem = guidesheetItems[loopi];
                    var itemText = guidesheetItem.getGuideItemText();
                    var itemStatus = guidesheetItem.getGuideItemStatus();
                    if (itemText != null && itemText == ""1. Coverage Item"") {
                        var coverageASITArr = getApplianceASITInformation(guidesheetItem);
                        aa.print(""coverageASITArr: "" + coverageASITArr);
                        if (coverageASITArr != null && coverageASITArr.length > 0) {

                            var tableName = ""COVERAGE INFORMATION"";

                                        aa.print(""Added Row to Coverage Information ASIT"");

                                }

                }
            } else if (guidesheetType == ""DO PERMIT COVERAGE"") {
                var guidesheetItems = guidesheetArray[x].getItems().toArray();

                                        asitRow[""Inspection Type""] = inspType;
                                        asitRow[""Coverage Item""] = covItemVal;

                                        asitRow[""Details""] = coverageRow[""TYPE/DESCRIPTION""] == null ? """" : coverageRow[""TYPE/DESCRIPTION""];
                                        asitRow[""Floor Number""] = coverageRow[""FLOOR #""] == null ? """" : coverageRow[""FLOOR #""];

                                        aa.print(""Added Row to Coverage Information ASIT"");
                                    }
                                }
                            }
                            addASITable(tableName, inspStatusASITArray, capId);

            } else if (guidesheetType == ""VEHICLE AND HAZMAT DESCRIPTION"") {
                var guidesheetItems = guidesheetArray[x].getItems().toArray();
                for (var loopi in guidesheetItems) {

                    asitRow[""Order""] = appASITArr[i][""Order""];
