            addASITable(tableName, asitArray, capId);
            return;
        }
    }
}

function populateFESDeviceInfo(fesInfoObjParam) {
    var deviceDescription = """";
    if (fesInfoObjParam.arcsSysDesc != null && fesInfoObjParam.arcsSysDesc != """") {
        deviceDescription = fesInfoObjParam.arcsSysDesc;
    } else {
        if (fesInfoObjParam.model != null && fesInfoObjParam.model != """") {
            deviceDescription += ""Model: "" + fesInfoObjParam.model + ""\n"";
        }

        if (fesInfoObjParam.noOfCylinders != null && fesInfoObjParam.noOfCylinders != """") {
            deviceDescription += ""No of Cylinders: "" + fesInfoObjParam.noOfCylinders + ""\n"";
        }

        if (fesInfoObjParam.equipManufacture != null && fesInfoObjParam.equipManufacture != """") {
            deviceDescription += ""Manufacture: "" + fesInfoObjParam.equipManufacture + ""\n"";
        }

        if (fesInfoObjParam.type != null && fesInfoObjParam.type != """") {
            if (fesInfoObjParam.type == ""Other"") {
                if (fesInfoObjParam.typeOther != null) {
                    deviceDescription += ""Type: "" + fesInfoObjParam.typeOther + ""\n"";
                }
            } else {
                deviceDescription += ""Type: "" + fesInfoObjParam.type + ""\n"";
            }
        }

        if (fesInfoObjParam.manufacture != null && fesInfoObjParam.manufacture != """") {
            if (fesInfoObjParam.manufacture == ""Other"") {
                if (fesInfoObjParam.manufactureOther != null) {
                    deviceDescription += ""Manufacture: "" + fesInfoObjParam.manufactureOther + ""\n"";
                }
            } else {
                deviceDescription += ""Manufacture: "" + fesInfoObjParam.manufacture + ""\n"";
            }
        }

        if (fesInfoObjParam.transceiver != null && fesInfoObjParam.transceiver != """") {
            if (fesInfoObjParam.transceiver == ""Other"") {
                if (fesInfoObjParam.transceiverOther != null) {
                    deviceDescription += ""Transceiver: "" + fesInfoObjParam.transceiverOther + ""\n"";
                }
            } else {
                deviceDescription += ""Transceiver: "" + fesInfoObjParam.transceiver + ""\n"";
            }
        }

        if (fesInfoObjParam.antenna != null && fesInfoObjParam.antenna != """") {
            if (fesInfoObjParam.antenna == ""Other"") {
                if (fesInfoObjParam.antennaOther != null) {
                    deviceDescription += ""Antenna System: "" + fesInfoObjParam.antennaOther + ""\n"";
                }
            } else {
                deviceDescription += ""Antenna System: "" + fesInfoObjParam.antenna + ""\n"";
            }
        }

        if (fesInfoObjParam.otherInformation != null && fesInfoObjParam.otherInformation != """") {
            deviceDescription += ""Other Information: "" + fesInfoObjParam.otherInformation + ""\n"";
        }
    }

    return deviceDescription;
}

function updatePermitLOAContact(newBusinessNameValue) {
    var capPeoples = getPeople(capId);

    if (capPeoples != null) {
        for (loopk in capPeoples) {
            sourcePeopleModel = capPeoples[loopk];
            var contactType = sourcePeopleModel.getCapContactModel().getPeople().getContactType();

            if (contactType == ""Permit / LOA Contact"") {
                // exploreObject(sourcePeopleModel.getCapContactModel().getPeople());
                var peopleObj = sourcePeopleModel.getCapContactModel().getPeople();
                if (newBusinessNameValue != null && newBusinessNameValue != """") {
                    aa.print(""Update Permit/LOA Contact"");
                    peopleObj.setTradeName(newBusinessNameValue);
                    peopleObj.setBusinessName(newBusinessNameValue);
                }
                sourcePeopleModel.getCapContactModel().setPeople(peopleObj);
                aa.people.editCapContact(sourcePeopleModel.getCapContactModel());
            }
        }
    }
}

function processLOAPermitInfo(guidesheetItems) {
    if (matches(inspType, ""ARCS 5 Years Recertification Operational Re-Test"", ""ARCS Operational Re-Test"", ""ARCS Operational Test"")) {
        return;
    }
    editPermitASI(capId);
    fesASITArr = new Array();

    for (var loopi in guidesheetItems) {
        var guidesheetItem = guidesheetItems[loopi];
        var itemText = guidesheetItem.getGuideItemText();
        var itemStatus = guidesheetItem.getGuideItemStatus();
        if (itemText != null && (itemText == ""1. Filing Information"" || itemText == ""1. Licensed Master Fire Suppression Piping Contractor"") && itemStatus == ""Complete"") {
            filingInfoObj = getFilingInformation(guidesheetItem);
        } else if (itemText != null && (itemText == ""1. Fire Extinguishing System"" || itemText == ""2. Fire Extinguishing System"") && itemStatus == ""Complete"") {
            if (fesInfoObj == null) {
                fesInfoObj = getFESInformation(guidesheetItem);
            } else {
                fesInfoObj2 = getFESInformation(guidesheetItem);
            }
            //fesASITArr = getFesASITInformation(guidesheetItem);
        } else if (itemText != null && itemText == ""1. System Information"" && itemStatus == ""Complete"") {
            filingInfoObj = getFilingInformation(guidesheetItem);
            fesInfoObj = getFESInformation(guidesheetItem);
        } else if (itemText != null && itemText == ""3. ARC System Description"" && itemStatus == ""Complete"") {
            fesInfoObj = getFESInformation(guidesheetItem);
        } else if (itemText != null && itemText == ""2. ARC System Filing Information"" && itemStatus == ""Complete"") {
            filingInfoObj = getFilingInformation(guidesheetItem);
        } else if (itemText != null && itemText == ""1. Is the required fire extinguishing system provided?"") {
            if (permitFESInfoObj == null) {
                permitFESInfoObj = getPermitFESInformation(guidesheetItem);
            } else {
                permitFESInfoObj2 = getPermitFESInformation(guidesheetItem);
            }
        } else if (itemText != null && itemText == ""VEHICLE/EQUIPMENT AND HAZMAT DESCRIPTION"") {
            var vehicleInfoArr = getApplianceASITInformation(guidesheetItem);
            if (vehicleInfoArr.length > 0) {
                vehicleInfoObj = new Object();
                vehicleInfoObj.description = """";

                for (var vR in vehicleInfoArr) {
                    var vRow = vehicleInfoArr[vR];

                    if (vRow[""SERIAL# VIN""] != null) {
                        vehicleInfoObj.description += ""VIN Number: "" + vRow[""SERIAL# VIN""] + ""\n"";
                    }
                    if (vRow[""STICKER NUMBER""] != null) {
                        vehicleInfoObj.description += ""Sticker Number: "" + vRow[""STICKER NUMBER""] + ""\n"";
                    }
                    if (vRow[""STICKER YEAR""] != null) {
                        vehicleInfoObj.description += ""Sticker Year: "" + vRow[""STICKER YEAR""] + ""\n"";
                    }
                    if (vRow[""TRUCK TRAILER EQUIPMENT #""] != null) {
                        vehicleInfoObj.description += ""Truck/Trailer/Equipment Number: "" + vRow[""TRUCK TRAILER EQUIPMENT #""] + ""\n"";
                    }

                    vehicleInfoObj.description += ""\n"";
                }
            }
        } else if (itemText != null && itemText == ""1. Contractors Information"") {
            contractorObj = getContractorsInformation(guidesheetItem);
        } else if (itemText != null && (itemText == ""1. LOA Coverage"" || itemText == ""LOA Coverage"")) {
            fesInfoObj = getFESInformation(guidesheetItem);
        } else if (itemText != null && itemText == ""1. Controller Information"") {
            controllerObj = getControllerInformation(guidesheetItem);
        }
    }
}

function editPermitASI(recordCapID) {
    if (generalInfoObj != null) {
        aa.print(""generalInfoObj.name: "" + generalInfoObj.name);
        if (generalInfoObj.name != null)
            editAppSpecific(""Account Name"", generalInfoObj.name, recordCapID);
        if (generalInfoObj.fdPlanNo != null)
            editAppSpecific(""Control #"", generalInfoObj.fdPlanNo, recordCapID);
        if (generalInfoObj.account != null)
            editAppSpecific(""Account"", generalInfoObj.account, recordCapID);
        editAppSpecific(""Record ID"", capId.getCustomID().toString(), recordCapID);
        var todayDate = getFormattedDate(new Date());
        var currDate = new Date();
        var expirationDate = addDays(currDate, 365);
        expirationDate = getFormattedDate(expirationDate);
        editAppSpecific(""Permit Expiration"", expirationDate, recordCapID);
    }

    /*var districtOffice = getAddressTemplateAttribute(recordCapID, ""COMMUNITY DISCTRICT"");
    if (districtOffice != null) {
        editAppSpecific(""D.O."", districtOffice);
    }*/
    var adminCompany = getAddressTemplateAttribute(recordCapID, ""ADMIN COMPANY"");
    if (adminCompany != null) {
        editAppSpecific(""ADM. CO"", adminCompany);
    }
    useAppSpecificGroupName = true;
    var battalion = getAddressTemplateAttribute(recordCapID, ""BATTALION"");
    if (battalion != null) {
        editAppSpecific(""PERMIT REPORT INFO.Battalion"", battalion, recordCapID);
    }
    var division = getAddressTemplateAttribute(recordCapID, ""DIVISION"");
    if (division != null) {
        editAppSpecific(""PERMIT REPORT INFO.Division"", division);
    }
    useAppSpecificGroupName = false;
}

function getFilingInformation(guidesheetItem) {
    var filingInfoObjCurr = new Object();
    var checklistTemplateGroup = guidesheetItem.getItemASISubgroupList();
    var iterator = checklistTemplateGroup.iterator();
    while (iterator.hasNext()) {
        var templateItemObj = iterator.next();
        var templateItemList = templateItemObj.getAsiList();
        var templateIterator = templateItemList.iterator();
        while (templateIterator.hasNext()) {
            var templateItem = templateIterator.next();
            var templateAttributeValue = (templateItem.getAttributeValue() == null) ? """" : templateItem.getAttributeValue();
            if (templateItem.getAsiName() == ""Installer Name"") {
                if (filingInfoObj == null || filingInfoObj.installerName == null) {
                    filingInfoObjCurr.installerName = templateAttributeValue;
                } else {
                    filingInfoObjCurr.installerName = filingInfoObj.installerName + "", "" + templateAttributeValue;
                }
            } else if (templateItem.getAsiName() == ""FD Plan #"") {
                if (filingInfoObj == null || filingInfoObj.planNo == null) {
                    filingInfoObjCurr.planNo = templateAttributeValue;
                } else {
                    filingInfoObjCurr.planNo = filingInfoObj.planNo + "", "" + templateAttributeValue;
                }
            } else if (templateItem.getAsiName() == ""License No."") {
                if (filingInfoObj == null || filingInfoObj.licenseNo == null) {
                    filingInfoObjCurr.licenseNo = templateAttributeValue;
                } else {
                    filingInfoObjCurr.licenseNo = filingInfoObj.licenseNo + "", "" + templateAttributeValue;
                }
            } else if (templateItem.getAsiName() == ""ARCS Contractor"") {
                filingInfoObjCurr.installerName = templateAttributeValue;
            } else if (templateItem.getAsiName() == ""Record ID/FD Plan No (Electrical)"") {
                filingInfoObjCurr.planNo = templateAttributeValue;
            } else if (templateItem.getAsiName() == ""ARCS Installer"") {
                filingInfoObjCurr.installerName = templateAttributeValue;
            } else if (templateItem.getAsiName() == ""Record ID/FD Plan No"") {
                filingInfoObjCurr.planNo = templateAttributeValue;
            } else if (templateItem.getAsiName() == ""DOB License No."") {
                filingInfoObjCurr.licenseNo = templateAttributeValue;
            } else if (templateItem.getAsiName() == ""DOB/SBS/FPIMS Job Application No"") {
                filingInfoObjCurr.dobJobApplicationNo = templateAttributeValue;
            } else if (templateItem.getAsiName() == ""DOB Alt. II type Application No."") {
                if (filingInfoObj == null || filingInfoObj.licenseNo == null) {
                    filingInfoObjCurr.dobJobApplicationNo = templateAttributeValue;
                } else {
                    filingInfoObjCurr.dobJobApplicationNo = filingInfoObj.dobJobApplicationNo + "", "" + templateAttributeValue;
                }
            } else if (templateItem.getAsiName() == ""DOB/SBS/FPIMS Job Application"") {
                filingInfoObjCurr.dobJobApplicationNo = templateAttributeValue;
            }  else if (templateItem.getAsiName() == ""DOB/DSBS Application"") {
                filingInfoObjCurr.dobJobApplicationNo = templateAttributeValue;
            } else if (templateItem.getAsiName() == ""Effective Floor(s)"") {
                filingInfoObjCurr.effectiveFloors = templateAttributeValue;
            }
        }
    }
    return filingInfoObjCurr;

function getFesASITInformation(guidesheetItem) {
    var fesASITArr = new Array();
    var guideItemASITs = guidesheetItem.getItemASITableSubgroupList();
    if (guideItemASITs != null) {
        for (var j = 0; j < guideItemASITs.size(); j++) {
            var guideItemASIT = guideItemASITs.get(j);
            var columnList = guideItemASIT.getColumnList();
            for (var k = 0; k < columnList.size(); k++) {
                var column = columnList.get(k);
                var values = column.getValueMap().values();
                var iteValues = values.iterator();
                while (iteValues.hasNext()) {
                    var i = iteValues.next();
                    var zeroBasedRowIndex = i.getRowIndex() - 1;
                    if (fesASITArr[zeroBasedRowIndex] == null) fesASITArr[zeroBasedRowIndex] = new Array();
                    fesASITArr[zeroBasedRowIndex][column.getColumnName()] = i.getAttributeValue();
                }
            }
        }
    }
    return fesASITArr;
}

function editTaskDueDateXXX(wfstr, wfdate, vCapID) // optional process name.  if wfstr == ""*"", set for all tasks
{
    var useProcess = false;
    var processName = """";

    var workflowResult = aa.workflow.getTasks(vCapID);
    if (workflowResult.getSuccess())
        wfObj = workflowResult.getOutput();
    else {
        logMessage(""**ERROR: Failed to get workflow object: "" + s_capResult.getErrorMessage());
        return false;
    }

    for (i in wfObj) {
        var fTask = wfObj[i];
        if ((fTask.getTaskDescription().toUpperCase().equals(wfstr.toUpperCase()) || wfstr == ""*"") && (!useProcess || fTask.getProcessCode().equals(processName))) {
            wfObj[i].setDueDate(aa.date.parseDate(wfdate));
            var fTaskModel = wfObj[i].getTaskItem();
            var tResult = aa.workflow.adjustTaskWithNoAudit(fTaskModel);
            if (tResult.getSuccess())
                logDebug(""Set Workflow Task: "" + fTask.getTaskDescription() + "" due Date "" + wfdate);
            else {
                logMessage(""**ERROR: Failed to update due date on workflow: "" + tResult.getErrorMessage());
                return false;
            }
        }
    }
}

function getCheckedInfractionCodesX(guidesheetItem, internalMappingObj, mappingASITName, vIsItemATextBoxX) {
    var checkedInfractionCodes = new Array();
    // if (mappingASITName != ""NO MAPPING"" && mappingASITName != ""DISTRICT OFFICE 2"" && internalMappingObj &&
    if (mappingASITName != ""NO MAPPING"" && internalMappingObj &&
        (vIsItemATextBoxX == false ||
            vIsItemATextBoxX == null ||
            vIsItemATextBoxX == """")) {
        var strInfractionCodes = internalMappingObj.infractionCodes;
        if (strInfractionCodes != null && strInfractionCodes != """") {
            var splitInfractionCodes = strInfractionCodes.split(""|"");
            if (splitInfractionCodes.length <= 1) {
                return splitInfractionCodes;
            }
            var checklistTemplateGroup = guidesheetItem.getItemASISubgroupList();
            if (checklistTemplateGroup) {
                var iterator = checklistTemplateGroup.iterator();
                while (iterator.hasNext()) {
                    var templateItemObj = iterator.next();
                    var templateItemList = templateItemObj.getAsiList();
                    var templateIterator = templateItemList.iterator();
                    while (templateIterator.hasNext()) {
                        var templateItem = templateIterator.next();
                        if (templateItem.checkBoxInd + """" == ""9"") {
                            if (templateItem.getAttributeValue() != null && templateItem.getAttributeValue() == ""CHECKED"") {
                                if (splitInfractionCodes.indexOf(String(templateItem.getAsiName())) !== -1) {
                                    checkedInfractionCodes.push(templateItem.getAsiName());
                                }
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }

            //In case there is only one SFO for the Checklist item
            if (checkedInfractionCodes.length == 0) {
                checkedInfractionCodes.push(splitInfractionCodes[0]);
            }
        }
    }
    /*else if(mappingASITName == ""DISTRICT OFFICE 2"" && internalMappingObj &&
        (vIsItemATextBoxX == false ||
            vIsItemATextBoxX == null ||
            vIsItemATextBoxX == """"))
    {
        var flag = false;
        var strInfractionCodes = internalMappingObj.infractionCodes;
        var checklistTemplateGroup = guidesheetItem.getItemASISubgroupList();
        if (checklistTemplateGroup) {
            var iterator = checklistTemplateGroup.iterator();
            while (iterator.hasNext()) {
                var templateItemObj = iterator.next();
                var templateItemList = templateItemObj.getAsiList();
                var templateIterator = templateItemList.iterator();
                while (templateIterator.hasNext()) {
                    var templateItem = templateIterator.next();
                    if (templateItem.checkBoxInd + """" == ""9"") {
                        if (templateItem.getAttributeValue() != null && templateItem.getAttributeValue() == ""CHECKED""
                            && String(templateItem.getAsiName()).indexOf(""-"") > -1) {
                                checkedInfractionCodes.push(templateItem.getAsiName());
                            flag = true;
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        if(!flag)
        {
            checkedInfractionCodes.push(strInfractionCodes);
        }
    }*/
    else {
        var checklistTemplateGroup = guidesheetItem.getItemASISubgroupList();
        if (checklistTemplateGroup) {
            var iterator = checklistTemplateGroup.iterator();
            while (iterator.hasNext()) {
                var templateItemObj = iterator.next();
                var templateItemList = templateItemObj.getAsiList();
                var templateIterator = templateItemList.iterator();
                while (templateIterator.hasNext()) {
                    var templateItem = templateIterator.next();
                    if (templateItem.checkBoxInd + """" == ""1"") {
                        if (templateItem.getAsiName() == ""Infraction Code"" &&
                            templateItem.getAttributeValue() != null &&
                            templateItem.getAttributeValue() != """") {
                            var sfoStr = String(templateItem.getAttributeValue()).split("","");
                            for (var aa in sfoStr)
                                checkedInfractionCodes.push(String(sfoStr[aa]).trim());
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }
    return checkedInfractionCodes;
}

function isItemATextBox(guidesheetItem, internalMappingObj, mappingASITName) {
    var checkedInfractionCodes = new Array();

    var checklistTemplateGroup = guidesheetItem.getItemASISubgroupList();
    if (checklistTemplateGroup) {
        var iterator = checklistTemplateGroup.iterator();
        while (iterator.hasNext()) {
            var templateItemObj = iterator.next();
            var templateItemList = templateItemObj.getAsiList();
            var templateIterator = templateItemList.iterator();
            while (templateIterator.hasNext()) {
                var templateItem = templateIterator.next();

                if (templateItem.checkBoxInd + """" == ""1"") {
                    if (templateItem.getAsiName() == ""Infraction Code"") {
                        return templateItem.getAttributeValue();
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }


    return false;
}
function populateChecklistMappingsX(internalMappingRecord, tableName) {
    var checklistMap = aa.util.newHashMap();
    var columnToBeSearched = ""Checklist Item"";
    if (arguments.length == 3) {
        columnToBeSearched = arguments[2];
    }
    if (tableName != ""NO MAPPING"") {
        var mappingTable = loadASITable(tableName, internalMappingRecord);
        for (i in mappingTable) {
            var row = mappingTable[i];
            if (row[""Checklist Item""] != null) {
                var currMappingObj = checklistMap.get(row[""Checklist Item""].toString());

                if (currMappingObj == null) {
                    var mappingObj = new Object();
                    mappingObj.checklistItem = row[""Checklist Item""]!= null ? row[""Checklist Item""].toString() : """";
                    mappingObj.checklistStatus = row[""Checklist Status""]!= null ? row[""Checklist Status""].toString() : """";
                    mappingObj.infractionCodes = row[""Infraction Code""]!= null ? row[""Infraction Code""].toString() : """";
                    if (row[""Infraction Name""] != undefined)
                        mappingObj.infractionNames = row[""Infraction Name""]!= null ? row[""Infraction Name""].toString() : """";
                    else
                        mappingObj.infractionNames = row[""Infraction Description""]!= null ? row[""Infraction Description""].toString() : """";
                    mappingObj.remedy = row[""Remedy""]!= null ? row[""Remedy""].toString() : """";
                    mappingObj.vcDescription = row[""VC Description""]!= null ? row[""VC Description""].toString() : """";
                    mappingObj.violationCategory = row[""Violation Category""]!= null ? row[""Violation Category""].toString() : """";
                    mappingObj.voDescription = row[""VO Description""]!= null ? row[""VO Description""].toString() : """";
                    mappingObj.detailFields = row[""Detail Fields""]!= null ? row[""Detail Fields""].toString() : """";
                    mappingObj.compliancePeriod = row[""Compliance Period""]!= null ? row[""Compliance Period""].toString() : """";
                    mappingObj.nodDescription = row[""NOD Description""]!= null ? row[""NOD Description""].toString() : """";
                    // aa.print(""Single: "" + mappingObj.checklistItem + "": "" + mappingObj.checklistStatus + "", "" + mappingObj.infractionCodes  + "", "" + mappingObj.remedy  + "", "" + mappingObj.vcDescription  + "", "" + mappingObj.voDescription  + "", "" + mappingObj.detailFields  + "", "" + mappingObj.compliancePeriod);
                    checklistMap.put(mappingObj.checklistItem, mappingObj);
                } else {
                    var mappingObj = currMappingObj;
                    mappingObj.infractionCodes = mappingObj.infractionCodes + ""|"" + (row[""Infraction Code""]!= null ? row[""Infraction Code""].toString() : """");
                    if (row[""Infraction Name""] != undefined)
                        mappingObj.infractionNames = mappingObj.infractionNames + ""|"" + (row[""Infraction Name""]!= null ? row[""Infraction Name""].toString() : """");
                    else
                        mappingObj.infractionNames = mappingObj.infractionNames + ""|"" + (row[""Infraction Description""]!= null ? row[""Infraction Description""].toString() : """");
                    mappingObj.remedy = mappingObj.remedy + ""|"" + (row[""Remedy""]!= null ? row[""Remedy""].toString() : """");
                    mappingObj.vcDescription = mappingObj.vcDescription + ""|"" + (row[""VC Description""]!= null ? row[""VC Description""].toString() : """");
                    mappingObj.violationCategory = mappingObj.violationCategory + ""|"" + (row[""Violation Category""]!= null ? row[""Violation Category""].toString() : """");
                    mappingObj.voDescription = mappingObj.voDescription + ""|"" + (row[""VO Description""]!= null ? row[""VO Description""].toString() : """");
                    mappingObj.compliancePeriod = mappingObj.compliancePeriod + ""|"" + (row[""Compliance Period""]!= null ? row[""Compliance Period""].toString() : """");
                    mappingObj.nodDescription = mappingObj.nodDescription + ""|"" + (row[""NOD Description""]!= null ? row[""NOD Description""].toString() : """");
                    mappingObj.detailFields = row[""Detail Fields""]!= null ? row[""Detail Fields""].toString() : """";
                    // aa.print(""Multiple: "" + mappingObj.checklistItem + "": "" + mappingObj.checklistStatus + "", "" + mappingObj.infractionCodes  + "", "" + mappingObj.remedy  + "", "" + mappingObj.vcDescription  + "", "" + mappingObj.voDescription  + "", "" + mappingObj.detailFields  + "", "" + mappingObj.compliancePeriod);
                    checklistMap.put(mappingObj.checklistItem, mappingObj);
                }
            }
            
        }
    } else {
        return null;
    }
    return checklistMap;
}

function getChecklistASITNameMappingX(guidesheet) {
    var guidesheetType = guidesheet.getGuideType();
    if (guidesheetType == ""PORTABLE FIRE EXTINGUISHERS"") {
        return ""RANGEHOOD ANNUAL"";
    }
    var mappingASITName = lookup(""CHECKLIST_MAPPING_ASIT_MAPPING"", guidesheetType);
    if (mappingASITName != null && mappingASITName != """") {
        return mappingASITName;
    }
    return ""NO MAPPING"";
}



function runReportAndSendEmail4DefReport(reportName, parameters, docGroup, docCategory, capId) {
    /*
     * Creates report and Saves in capId's cosument tab with given Document
     * group and Category
     */

    var appTypeValue = getAppSpecific(""Application Type"", capId);
    if (appTypeValue != null && appTypeValue != """") {
        var emailTo = getEmailListForDeficiencyReport(appTypeValue);
        emailTo += getLatestResultedEmail4SupOrPostInspection(capId) + ""; "";
        emailTo += ""fitzgerald.jack@fdny.nyc.gov""; //replaced Bini's email on 20240906
        aa.print(""emailTo: "" + emailTo);

        if (emailTo != null && emailTo != """") {
            var altId = capId.getCustomID();
            var report = aa.reportManager.getReportInfoModelByName(reportName);
            if (report.getSuccess()) {
                report = report.getOutput();
                report.setModule(""BFP"");
                report.setCapId(capId);
                report.setReportParameters(parameters);
                var reportResult = aa.reportManager.getReportResult(report);
                if (reportResult.getSuccess()) {
                    reportResult = reportResult.getOutput();
                    if (reportResult != null) {
                        var reportFile = aa.reportManager.storeReportToDisk(reportResult);
                        reportFile = reportFile.getOutput();
                        aa.print(""reportFile: "" + reportFile);
                        aa.sendEmail(""noreply@fdny.nyc.gov"", emailTo, """", ""Deficiency Report for "" + altId, ""Please find the attached Deficiency Report for the Oversight Inspection on record "" + altId, reportFile);
                        aa.print(""Sent"");
                    }

                } else {
                    aa.print(""Could not get report from report manager normally, error message please refer to: "" + reportResult.getErrorMessage())
                }
            } else {
                aa.print(""Invalid Report Name entered in parameter: "" + reportName);
            }
        } else {
            aa.print(""Supervisor Email is blank"");
        }
    } else {
        aa.print(""Application Type field is blank"");
    }
}

function getLatestResultedEmail4SupOrPostInspection(recordCapId) {
    /*
     * Returns the Inspector Email of Oversight Inspections @param - NONE
     * @returns - Inspector Email
     */
    var inspectionObj = aa.inspection.getInspections(recordCapId);
    var latestDate = new Date(0);
    var inspectorEmailAddress = """";
    var currentInspectionType = """";
    if (inspectionObj.getSuccess()) {
        var inspectionList = inspectionObj.getOutput();
        for (i in inspectionList) {
            var inspectionObj = inspectionList[i];
            if (matches(inspectionObj.getInspectionType(), ""Post Inspection Audit"", ""Supervisory Inspection"")) {
                if (matches(inspectionObj.getInspectionStatus(), ""Satisfactory"", ""Unsatisfactory"", ""Unratable"")) {
                    var inspStatusDate = inspectionObj.getInspectionStatusDate();
                    if (inspStatusDate != null) {
                        var inspStatusDateFormatted = new Date(Number(inspStatusDate.getMonth()) + ""/"" + Number(inspStatusDate.getDayOfMonth()) + ""/"" + Number(inspStatusDate.getYear()));
                        if (latestDate.getTime() < inspStatusDateFormatted.getTime()) {
                            var inspUserObj = aa.person.getUser(inspectionObj.getInspector().getFirstName(), inspectionObj.getInspector().getMiddleName(), inspectionObj.getInspector().getLastName()).getOutput();
                            var inspectorUserID = inspUserObj.getUserID();
                            if (inspectorUserID) {
                                currentInspectionType = inspectionObj.getInspectionType();
                                latestDate = inspStatusDateFormatted;
                                inspectorEmailAddress = getUserEmail(inspectorUserID);
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }
    /*aa.print(""Latest email: "" + inspectorEmailAddress);
    aa.print(""Latest Inspection: "" + currentInspectionType);
    aa.print(""Latest Inspection Date: "" + latestDate);*/
    return inspectorEmailAddress;
}

invoice_filtered as
(
select 
    *
FROM
        (
            SELECT *,
                ROW_NUMBER()
                OVER(PARTITION BY bp.serv_prov_code, bp.b1_per_id1, bp.b1_per_id2, bp.b1_per_id3
                     ORDER BY
                         bp.BILLAMOUNT DESC 
                ) rn,
            ( CASE
            WHEN TRIM (UPPER (bp.BILL_TYPE)) IN ('ORIGINAL') THEN '00'
            WHEN TRIM (UPPER (bp.BILL_TYPE)) = 'PRORATED' THEN '01'
            WHEN TRIM (UPPER (bp.BILL_TYPE)) = 'FIRST REMINDER' THEN '02'
            WHEN TRIM (UPPER (bp.BILL_TYPE)) = 'SECOND REMINDER' THEN '03'
            WHEN TRIM (UPPER (bp.BILL_TYPE)) = 'FIRST PENALTY' THEN '04'
            WHEN TRIM (UPPER (bp.BILL_TYPE)) = 'SECOND PENALTY' THEN '05'
            WHEN TRIM (UPPER (bp.BILL_TYPE)) = 'NEW ACCOUNT' THEN '06'
            WHEN TRIM (UPPER (bp.BILL_TYPE)) = 'OWNER CHANGE' THEN '07'
            WHEN TRIM (UPPER (bp.BILL_TYPE)) = 'COV. CHANGE' THEN '08'
            WHEN TRIM (UPPER (bp.BILL_TYPE)) = 'DUPLICATE' THEN '09'
            WHEN TRIM (UPPER (bp.BILL_TYPE)) = 'GLOBAL' THEN '10'
            WHEN TRIM (UPPER (bp.BILL_TYPE)) = 'HISTORY' THEN '11'
            WHEN TRIM (UPPER (bp.BILL_TYPE)) = 'BAL. ADJ.' THEN '12'
            WHEN TRIM (UPPER (bp.BILL_TYPE)) = 'PARTIAL PAYMENT' THEN '13'
            WHEN TRIM (UPPER (bp.BILL_TYPE)) = 'VIOLATION' THEN '14'
            WHEN TRIM (UPPER (bp.BILL_TYPE)) = 'RE-INSPECTION' THEN '15'
            WHEN TRIM (UPPER (bp.BILL_TYPE)) = 'ORIG WITH PREV BAL' THEN '16'
            ELSE  'XX'
            END) BILLTYPE

            FROM 
            invoice_data bp
            WHERE 1=1
            AND bp.BILL_TYPE <> 'Lien Notice'
            AND bp.BILL_DATE IS NOT NULL
            AND bp.BILL_AMOUNT IS NOT NULL
            AND bp.BILLDATE >= CAST(DATEADD(day, 0, @STARTDATE) AS DATE)
            AND bp.BILLDATE <= CAST(DATEADD(day, 0, @ENDDATE) AS DATE)
        ) tr
    WHERE
        rn = 1   
)

from

 FROM

                ORDER BY TRY_CAST(BILL_AMOUNT AS FLOAT) DESC
            ) AS rn,

                WHEN 'ORIGINAL' THEN '00'
                WHEN 'PRORATED' THEN '01'
                WHEN 'FIRST REMINDER' THEN '02'
                WHEN 'SECOND REMINDER' THEN '03'
                WHEN 'FIRST PENALTY' THEN '04'
                WHEN 'SECOND PENALTY' THEN '05'
                WHEN 'NEW ACCOUNT' THEN '06'
                WHEN 'OWNER CHANGE' THEN '07'
                WHEN 'COV. CHANGE' THEN '08'
                WHEN 'DUPLICATE' THEN '09'
                WHEN 'GLOBAL' THEN '10'
                WHEN 'HISTORY' THEN '11'
                WHEN 'BAL. ADJ.' THEN '12'
                WHEN 'PARTIAL PAYMENT' THEN '13'
                WHEN 'VIOLATION' THEN '14'
                WHEN 'RE-INSPECTION' THEN '15'
                WHEN 'ORIG WITH PREV BAL' THEN '16'
                ELSE 'XX'
            END AS BILLTYPE
        FROM invoice_data
        WHERE BILL_TYPE <> 'Lien Notice'
          AND BILL_AMOUNT IS NOT NULL
    ) tr
    WHERE rn = 1
),

    SELECT * FROM (
        SELECT 
            *,
            TRY_CAST(BILL_DATE AS DATE) AS BILLDATE,
            TRY_CAST(BILL_AMOUNT AS FLOAT) AS BILLAMOUNT,
            SUBSTRING(CYCLE_NUMBER, 1, 7) AS BILL_INSP_ID,
            ROW_NUMBER() OVER(
                PARTITION BY serv_prov_code, b1_per_id1, b1_per_id2, b1_per_id3 
                ORDER BY TRY_CAST(BILL_AMOUNT AS FLOAT) DESC
            ) AS rn,
            CASE TRIM(UPPER(BILL_TYPE))
                WHEN 'ORIGINAL' THEN '00'
                WHEN 'PRORATED' THEN '01'
                WHEN 'FIRST REMINDER' THEN '02'
                WHEN 'SECOND REMINDER' THEN '03'
                WHEN 'FIRST PENALTY' THEN '04'
                WHEN 'SECOND PENALTY' THEN '05'
                WHEN 'NEW ACCOUNT' THEN '06'
                WHEN 'OWNER CHANGE' THEN '07'
                WHEN 'COV. CHANGE' THEN '08'
                WHEN 'DUPLICATE' THEN '09'
                WHEN 'GLOBAL' THEN '10'
                WHEN 'HISTORY' THEN '11'
                WHEN 'BAL. ADJ.' THEN '12'
                WHEN 'PARTIAL PAYMENT' THEN '13'
                WHEN 'VIOLATION' THEN '14'
                WHEN 'RE-INSPECTION' THEN '15'
                WHEN 'ORIG WITH PREV BAL' THEN '16'
                ELSE 'XX'
            END AS BILLTYPE
        FROM invoice_data
        WHERE BILL_TYPE <> 'Lien Notice'
          AND BILL_AMOUNT IS NOT NULL
    ) tr
    WHERE rn = 1
),

        MAX(CASE WHEN b1_checkbox_desc = 'Exemption Recommendation Date' THEN b1_checklist_comment END) AS EXEMPT_RECOMMEND_DATE,
        MAX(CASE WHEN b1_checkbox_desc = 'No Fee' THEN b1_checklist_comment END) AS NO_FEE,
        MAX(CASE WHEN b1_checkbox_desc = 'No Fee Date' THEN b1_checklist_comment END) AS NO_FEE_DATE
    FROM bchckbox
    WHERE b1_checkbox_desc IN ('Alpha Prefix', 'D.O.', 'Account Type', 'Application Type', 'No Fee', 'No Fee Date', 'Exemption Recommendation', 'Exemption Recommendation Date', 'Are you a City Agency or State Agency Employee?')

    GROUP BY serv_prov_code, b1_per_id1, b1_per_id2, b1_per_id3

    /*
      Reurns true if thers is any checklist item that has item status ""Select"", else returns false
      @param inspectionModelObj - Inspection Model.
    */
    var guidesheetObjects = getGuideSheetObjects(inspectionModelObj.getIdNumber());

    if (guidesheetObjects) {
        for (var loopi in guidesheetObjects) {
            var guidesheetItem = guidesheetObjects[loopi];
            var itemStatus = guidesheetItem.status;

            if (itemStatus == ""Select"") {
                //return true;
            }
        }
    }

    return false;
}

function blockAndDisplayMessage(commentMessage) {
    /*
      Blocks user from creating the Inspection and displays an error message.
      @param commentMessage - Error message to be displayed.
    */
    cancel = true;
    showMessage = true;
    message = commentMessage;
    popupMessage(commentMessage);
}

function getCurrentUserDepartmentCustom() {
    /*Returns the Email ID of the Public User currently logged in ACA*/
    var currentUserID = aa.env.getValue(""CurrentUserID"");
    var currentUserDepartment = null;
    currentUserDepartment = getDepartmentName(currentUserID);

    return currentUserDepartment;
}

function sendInspectionValidationErrorEmail(capId, templateName, errorMessage) {
    var currentUserID = aa.env.getValue(""CurrentUserID"");
    aa.print(""currentUserID: "" + currentUserID);
    var userObj = aa.person.getUser(currentUserID).getOutput();
    aa.print(""userObj.getEmail(): "" + userObj.getEmail());

    if (userObj.getEmail() != null && userObj.getEmail() != """") {
        var userEmail = userObj.getEmail()
        var fvCapID4Email = aa.cap.createCapIDScriptModel(capId.ID1, capId.ID2, capId.ID3);
        var emailParameters = aa.util.newHashtable();
        addParameter(emailParameters, ""$$altID$$"", String(capId.getCustomID()));
        addParameter(emailParameters, ""$$errorMessage$$"", errorMessage);
        aa.print(""Sending Email"");
        var sendResult = aa.document.sendEmailAndSaveAsDocument(fromEmailAddress, userEmail, """", templateName, emailParameters, fvCapID4Email, null);
    }
}

function getUsersEmailListByDept(userDepartmentString) {
    var emailList = """";
    var peop = aa.people.getSysUserList(null);
    if (peop.getSuccess()) {
        peop = peop.getOutput();
        for (x in peop) {
            if (peop[x].getDeptOfUser() == userDepartmentString) {
                var thisEmail = peop[x].getEmail();
                if (thisEmail != null && thisEmail != """") {
                    emailList += thisEmail + ""; "";
                }
            }
        }
    }
    aa.print(emailList);
    return emailList;
}


function validateApprovalGuideSheetResults(inspModel) {
    var errorMessage = """";
    var guidesheet = inspModel.getGuideSheets();
    var guidesheetItemFailed = new Array();
    var guidesheetItemStatusUpdateMissing = new Array();

    if (guidesheet) {
        var internalMappingRecord = getInternalMappingRecord();
        guidesheetArray = guidesheet.toArray();
        var enhancedInternalMapping = populateChecklistMappings(internalMappingRecord, ""ENHANCED INSPECTION"");
        var mappingASITName = getChecklistASITNameMapping(guidesheetArray); //lookup(""CHECKLIST_MAPPING_ASIT_MAPPING"", inspType);
        var inspectionInternalMapping = populateChecklistMappings(internalMappingRecord, mappingASITName);

        for (var x in guidesheetArray) {
            var guidesheetType = guidesheetArray[x].getGuideType();
            var internalMapping;
            var checklistType = ""INSPECTION"";
            if (guidesheetType == ""Enhanced Inspection Checklist"") {
                internalMapping = enhancedInternalMapping;
                checklistType = ""ENHANCED"";
                aa.print(""Enhanced Checklist"");
            } else if (guidesheetType.startsWith(""COVERAGE INFO"")) {
                aa.print(""Coverage Information Validation"");
                errorMessage += validateCoverageInformation(guidesheetArray[x]);
                continue;
            } else if (guidesheetType == ""PROGRAM PROFILE"") {
                aa.print(""PROGRAM PROFILE Validation"");
                errorMessage += validateProgramProfile(guidesheetArray[x]);
                continue;
            } else {
                internalMapping = inspectionInternalMapping;
                checklistType = ""INSPECTION"";
                aa.print(""Inspection Checklist"");
            }
            var guidesheetItems = guidesheetArray[x].getItems().toArray();
            var currentGuidesheetItemStatusUpdateMissing = new Array();
            var doNotCheckRequiredItems = false;
            var checkOptionalItemValue = lookup(""CHECKLIST_OPTIONAL_ITEMS_MAPPING"", guidesheetType);
            checkOptionalItemValue = (checkOptionalItemValue != null && checkOptionalItemValue != """") ? checkOptionalItemValue : ""NOITEMEXISTS"";
            for (var loopi in guidesheetItems) {
                var guidesheetItem = guidesheetItems[loopi];
                var itemText = guidesheetItem.getGuideItemText();
                var itemStatus = guidesheetItem.getGuideItemStatus();
                if (guidesheetType != ""Enhanced Inspection Checklist"") {
                    if (itemStatus == null || itemStatus == """" || itemStatus == ""Select"") {
                        currentGuidesheetItemStatusUpdateMissing.push(breakVal + ""<b>Checklist Name:</b> "" + guidesheetType.toString() + "" <b>Checklist Item:</b> "" + itemText);
                    } else if (itemStatus == ""N/A"" || itemStatus == ""No"") {
                        if (itemText == checkOptionalItemValue) {
                            doNotCheckRequiredItems = true;
                        }
                    }
                } else {
                    doNotCheckRequiredItems = true;
                }
                var internalMappingObj = internalMapping.get(itemText);

                if (internalMappingObj) {
                    var violationOrderComplianceCheck = (internalMappingObj.checklistStatus == itemStatus) ? true : false;

                    if (violationOrderComplianceCheck) {
                        guidesheetItemFailed.push(breakVal + ""<b>Checklist Name:</b> "" + guidesheetType.toString() + "" <b>Checklist Item:</b> "" + itemText);
                    }
                } else {
                    aa.print(""No Mapping found for: "" + guidesheetType.toString() + "" -> "" + itemText);
                }
            }
            if (!doNotCheckRequiredItems) {
                guidesheetItemStatusUpdateMissing = guidesheetItemStatusUpdateMissing.concat(currentGuidesheetItemStatusUpdateMissing);
            }
        }
        //---------NEW--------------------------------
        if (guidesheetItemStatusUpdateMissing.length > 0) {
            errorMessage += breakVal + breakVal;
            errorMessage += ""<b>The below Checklist item(s) are mandatory for resulting of the Inspection. Please update the status for below Checklist Item(s):</b> "" + breakVal;
            errorMessage += guidesheetItemStatusUpdateMissing.toString();
        }
        //--------------------------------------------
        if (guidesheetItemFailed.length > 0) {
            errorMessage += breakVal + breakVal;
            errorMessage += ""<b>Below Checklist items are marked as failed. Please approve the Checklist items before approving the Inspection-</b> "" + breakVal;
            errorMessage += guidesheetItemFailed.toString();
        }
    }

    aa.print(""Error Message: "" + breakVal + errorMessage);
    return errorMessage;
}

function validateProgramProfile(guidesheetObj) {
    var currErrorMsg = """";
    if (guidesheetObj) {
        var guidesheetItems = guidesheetObj.getItems().toArray();
        for (var loopi in guidesheetItems) {
            var guidesheetItem = guidesheetItems[loopi];
            var itemText = guidesheetItem.getGuideItemText();
            var itemStatus = guidesheetItem.getGuideItemStatus();

            if (itemText == ""PROGRAM PROFILE"" && itemStatus == ""Complete"") {
                var checklistTemplateGroup = guidesheetItem.getItemASISubgroupList();
                var iterator = checklistTemplateGroup.iterator();
                while (iterator.hasNext()) {
                    var templateItemObj = iterator.next();
                    if (templateItemObj.getSubgroupCode() == ""Type of Program"") {
                        var templateItemList = templateItemObj.getAsiList();
                        var templateIterator = templateItemList.iterator();
                        while (templateIterator.hasNext()) {
                            var templateItem = templateIterator.next();
                            if (templateItem.getAttributeValue() == ""CHECKED"") {
                                return currErrorMsg;
                            }
                        }
                        break;
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }

    currErrorMsg = ""Missing 'Type of Program' value in the PROGRAM PROFILE Checklist<br><br>"";
    return currErrorMsg;
}

function validateCoverageInformation(guidesheetObj) {
    var currErrorMsg = """";
    if (guidesheetObj) {
        var guidesheetItems = guidesheetObj.getItems().toArray();
        for (var loopi in guidesheetItems) {
            var guidesheetItem = guidesheetItems[loopi];
            var itemText = guidesheetItem.getGuideItemText();
            var itemStatus = guidesheetItem.getGuideItemStatus();

            if (itemText == ""1. Coverage Item"" && itemStatus == ""Complete"") {
                var covInfoMap = getCoverageInfoArr(capId);
                var coverageASITArr = getApplianceASITInformation(guidesheetItem);
                if (coverageASITArr != null && coverageASITArr.length > 0) {
                    for (var ii in coverageASITArr) {
                        var coverageRow = coverageASITArr[ii];
                        if (coverageRow[""Coverage Item""] != null) {
                            var covItemVal = coverageRow[""Coverage Item""].toString();
                            if (covInfoMap.get(covItemVal) != null) {
                                currErrorMsg += covItemVal + ""<br>"";
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }

    if (currErrorMsg != """") {
        currErrorMsg = ""Duplicate Coverage Items added: <br>"" + currErrorMsg + ""<br>"";
    }
    return currErrorMsg;
}

function getCoverageInfoArr(recordCapId) {
    var covInfoMap = aa.util.newHashMap();
    var covInfoTable = loadASITable(""COVERAGE INFORMATION"", recordCapId);

    if (covInfoTable != null) {
        for (var i in covInfoTable) {
            var row = covInfoTable[i];
            if (row[""Status""] == ""Active"") {
                covInfoMap.put(row[""Coverage Item""].toString(), true);
                // aa.print(""Added to Map: "" + row[""Coverage Item""].toString());
            }
        }
    }

    return covInfoMap;
}

function getApplianceASITInformation(guidesheetItem) {
    var fesASITArr = new Array();
    var guideItemASITs = guidesheetItem.getItemASITableSubgroupList();
    if (guideItemASITs != null) {
        for (var j = 0; j < guideItemASITs.size(); j++) {
            var guideItemASIT = guideItemASITs.get(j);
            var columnList = guideItemASIT.getColumnList();
            for (var k = 0; k < columnList.size(); k++) {
                var column = columnList.get(k);
                var values = column.getValueMap().values();
                var iteValues = values.iterator();
                while (iteValues.hasNext()) {
                    var i = iteValues.next();
                    var zeroBasedRowIndex = i.getRowIndex() - 1;
                    if (fesASITArr[zeroBasedRowIndex] == null) fesASITArr[zeroBasedRowIndex] = new Array();
                    fesASITArr[zeroBasedRowIndex][column.getColumnName()] = i.getAttributeValue();
                }
            }
        }
    }
    return fesASITArr;
}

                if (templateItem.checkBoxInd + """" == ""1"") {
                    if (templateItem.getAsiName() == ""Infraction Code"") {
                        return templateItem.getAttributeValue();
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }


    return false;
}

function getCheckedInfractionCodesX(guidesheetItem, internalMappingObj, mappingASITName, vIsItemATextBoxX) {
    var checkedInfractionCodes = new Array();
    if (mappingASITName != ""NO MAPPING"" && internalMappingObj &&
        (vIsItemATextBoxX == false ||
            vIsItemATextBoxX == null ||
            vIsItemATextBoxX == """")) {
        var strInfractionCodes = internalMappingObj.infractionCodes;
        if (strInfractionCodes != null && strInfractionCodes != """") {
            var splitInfractionCodes = strInfractionCodes.split(""|"");
            if (splitInfractionCodes.length <= 1) {
                return splitInfractionCodes;
            }
            var checklistTemplateGroup = guidesheetItem.getItemASISubgroupList();
            if (checklistTemplateGroup) {
                var iterator = checklistTemplateGroup.iterator();
                while (iterator.hasNext()) {
                    var templateItemObj = iterator.next();
                    var templateItemList = templateItemObj.getAsiList();
                    var templateIterator = templateItemList.iterator();
                    while (templateIterator.hasNext()) {
                        var templateItem = templateIterator.next();
                        if (templateItem.checkBoxInd + """" == ""9"") {
                            if (templateItem.getAttributeValue() != null && templateItem.getAttributeValue() == ""CHECKED"") {
                                if (splitInfractionCodes.indexOf(String(templateItem.getAsiName())) !== -1) {
                                    checkedInfractionCodes.push(templateItem.getAsiName());
                                }
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    } else {
        var checklistTemplateGroup = guidesheetItem.getItemASISubgroupList();
        if (checklistTemplateGroup) {
            var iterator = checklistTemplateGroup.iterator();
            while (iterator.hasNext()) {
                var templateItemObj = iterator.next();
                var templateItemList = templateItemObj.getAsiList();
                var templateIterator = templateItemList.iterator();
                while (templateIterator.hasNext()) {
                    var templateItem = templateIterator.next();
                    if (templateItem.checkBoxInd + """" == ""1"") {
                        if (templateItem.getAsiName() == ""Infraction Code"" &&
                            templateItem.getAttributeValue() != null &&
                            templateItem.getAttributeValue() != """") {
                            var sfoStr = String(templateItem.getAttributeValue()).split("","");
                            for (var aa in sfoStr)
                                checkedInfractionCodes.push(String(sfoStr[aa]).trim());
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }

    }
    return checkedInfractionCodes;
}

function populateChecklistMappingsX(internalMappingRecord, tableName) {
    var checklistMap = aa.util.newHashMap();
    var columnToBeSearched = ""Checklist Item"";
    if (arguments.length == 3) {
        columnToBeSearched = arguments[2];
    }
    if (tableName != ""NO MAPPING"") {
        var mappingTable = loadASITable(tableName, internalMappingRecord);
        for (i in mappingTable) {
            var row = mappingTable[i];
            var mappingObj = new Object();
            mappingObj.checklistItem = row[""Checklist Item""]!= null ? row[""Checklist Item""].toString() : """";
            mappingObj.checklistStatus = row[""Checklist Status""]!= null ? row[""Checklist Status""].toString() : """";
            mappingObj.infractionCodes = row[""Infraction Code""]!= null ? row[""Infraction Code""].toString() : """";
            if (row[""Infraction Name""] != undefined)
                mappingObj.infractionNames = row[""Infraction Name""]!= null ? row[""Infraction Name""].toString() : """";
            else
                mappingObj.infractionNames = row[""Infraction Description""]!= null ? row[""Infraction Description""].toString() : """";
            mappingObj.remedy = row[""Remedy""]!= null ? row[""Remedy""].toString() : """";
            mappingObj.vcDescription = row[""VC Description""]!= null ? row[""VC Description""].toString() : """";
            mappingObj.violationCategory = row[""Violation Category""]!= null ? row[""Violation Category""].toString() : """";
            mappingObj.voDescription = row[""VO Description""]!= null ? row[""VO Description""].toString() : """";
            mappingObj.detailFields = row[""Detail Fields""]!= null ? row[""Detail Fields""].toString() : """";
            mappingObj.compliancePeriod = row[""Compliance Period""]!= null ? row[""Compliance Period""].toString() : """";
            //aa.print(mappingObj.checklistItem + "": "" + mappingObj.checklistStatus + "", "" + mappingObj.infractionCodes  + "", "" + mappingObj.remedy  + "", "" + mappingObj.vcDescription  + "", "" + mappingObj.voDescription  + "", "" + mappingObj.detailFields  + "", "" + mappingObj.compliancePeriod);
            checklistMap.put(mappingObj.checklistItem, mappingObj);
        }
    } else {
        return null;
    }
    return checklistMap;
}

function getChecklistASITNameMappingX(guidesheet) {
    var guidesheetType = guidesheet.getGuideType();
    var mappingASITName = lookup(""CHECKLIST_MAPPING_ASIT_MAPPING"", guidesheetType);
    if (guidesheetType == ""PORTABLE FIRE EXTINGUISHERS"") {

        return mappingASITName;
    }
    return ""NO MAPPING"";
}

function closeDBQueryObject(rSet, sStmt, conn) {
    try {
        if (rSet) {
            rSet.close();
            rSet = null;
        }
    } catch (vError) {
        aa.print(""Failed to close the database result set object."" + vError);
    }
    try {
        if (sStmt) {
            sStmt.close();
            sStmt = null;
        }
    } catch (vError) {
        aa.print(""Failed to close the database prepare statement object."" + vError);
    }
    try {
        if (conn) {
            conn.close();
            conn = null;
        }
    } catch (vError) {
        aa.print(""Failed to close the database connection."" + vError);
    }
}

function getInfractionCodeItemsFromDB(vCode, itemText) {
    var result = new Array();
    var sql = ""SELECT TABLE_NAME,COLUMN_INDEX,ROW_INDEX FROM BAPPSPECTABLE_VALUE WHERE SERV_PROV_CODE = 'FDNY' AND GROUP_NAME = 'MAPPING_INFO' AND COLUMN_NAME = 'Infraction Code' AND ATTRIBUTE_VALUE LIKE '"" + vCode + ""'"";
    //aa.print(sql);
    var vError = '';
    var conn = null;
    var sStmt = null;
    var rSet = null;
    try {
																										  
													 
        var conn = aa.db.getConnection();

        sStmt = conn.prepareStatement(sql);
        rSet = sStmt.executeQuery();
        while (rSet.next()) {
            var tName = rSet.getString(""TABLE_NAME"");
            var vColIndex = rSet.getString(""COLUMN_INDEX"");
            var vRowIndex = rSet.getString(""ROW_INDEX"");

            var nextSQL = ""SELECT COLUMN_NAME,ATTRIBUTE_VALUE FROM BAPPSPECTABLE_VALUE WHERE SERV_PROV_CODE = 'FDNY' AND GROUP_NAME = 'MAPPING_INFO' AND TABLE_NAME = '"" + tName + ""' AND COLUMN_INDEX = '"" + vColIndex + ""' AND ROW_INDEX = '"" + vRowIndex + ""' "";
            //aa.print(nextSQL);
            var vError = '';
            var vNextconn = null;
            var sNextStmt = null;
            var rNextSet = null;
            try {
																													   
																   
                var vNextconn = aa.db.getConnection();
                var mappingObj = new Object();
                mappingObj.checklistStatus = ""No"";
                var sNextStmt = vNextconn.prepareStatement(nextSQL);
                var rNextSet = sNextStmt.executeQuery();
                while (rNextSet.next()) {
                    var vColName = rNextSet.getString(""COLUMN_NAME"") + """";
                    var vAttVal = rNextSet.getString(""ATTRIBUTE_VALUE"");
                    aa.print();
                    switch (vColName) {
                        case ""Checklist Status"":
                            mappingObj.checklistStatus = rNextSet.getString(""ATTRIBUTE_VALUE"");
                            break;
                        case ""Checklist Item"":
                            mappingObj.checklistItem = itemText;
                            break;
                        case ""Infraction Code"":
                            mappingObj.infractionCodes = rNextSet.getString(""ATTRIBUTE_VALUE"");
                            break;
                        case ""Infraction Name"":
                            mappingObj.infractionNames = rNextSet.getString(""ATTRIBUTE_VALUE"");
                            break;
                        case ""Infraction Description"":
                            mappingObj.infractionNames = rNextSet.getString(""ATTRIBUTE_VALUE"");
                            break;
                        case ""Remedy"":
                            mappingObj.remedy = rNextSet.getString(""ATTRIBUTE_VALUE"");
                            break;
                        case ""VC Description"":
                            mappingObj.vcDescription = rNextSet.getString(""ATTRIBUTE_VALUE"");
                            break;
                        case ""VO Description"":
                            mappingObj.violationCategory = rNextSet.getString(""ATTRIBUTE_VALUE"");
                            break;
                        case ""Compliance Period"":
                            mappingObj.compliancePeriod = rNextSet.getString(""ATTRIBUTE_VALUE"");
                            break;
                        case ""Detail Fields"":
                            mappingObj.detailFields = rNextSet.getString(""ATTRIBUTE_VALUE"");
                            break;
                    }
                }
            } catch (vError) {
                aa.print(""nextSQL - Runtime error occurred: "" + vError);
            }
            closeDBQueryObject(rNextSet, sNextStmt, vNextconn);
            result.push(mappingObj);
        }
    } catch (vError) {
        aa.print(""SQL - Runtime error occurred: "" + vError);
    }
    closeDBQueryObject(rSet, sStmt, conn);
    return result;
}

function validateGuideSheetResults(inspModel) {
    var errorMessage = """";
    var guidesheet = inspModel.getGuideSheets();
    var guidesheetItemStatusUpdateMissing = new Array();
    var guidesheetItemEnforcementStatusUpdateMissing = new Array();
    var guidesheetItemEnforcementUpdateMissing = new Array();
    var failedguidesheetItems = new Array();
    var errorMessageX = """";
    var errorMessageXX = """";
    var ignoreRequiredConditionforAllItems = false;
    if (guidesheet) {
        var internalMappingRecord = getInternalMappingRecord();
        guidesheetArray = guidesheet.toArray();
        if (guidesheetArray == null || guidesheetArray == false || guidesheetArray.length == 0) {
            return;
        }
        var enhancedInternalMapping = populateChecklistMappings(internalMappingRecord, ""ENHANCED INSPECTION"");

        for (var x in guidesheetArray) {
            var guidesheetType = guidesheetArray[x].getGuideType();
            var internalMapping;
            var checklistType = ""INSPECTION"";
            if (guidesheetType == ""Enhanced Inspection Checklist"") {
                internalMapping = enhancedInternalMapping;
                checklistType = ""ENHANCED"";
                aa.print(""Enhanced Checklist"");
            } else if (guidesheetType.startsWith(""COVERAGE INFO"")) {
                aa.print(""Coverage Information Validation"");
                errorMessage += validateCoverageInformation(guidesheetArray[x]);
                continue;
            } else if (guidesheetType == ""PROGRAM PROFILE"") {
                aa.print(""PROGRAM PROFILE Validation"");
                errorMessage += validateProgramProfile(guidesheetArray[x]);
                continue;
            } else {
                internalMapping = inspectionInternalMapping;
                checklistType = ""INSPECTION"";
                aa.print(""Inspection Checklist"");
            }
            var guidesheetItems = guidesheetArray[x].getItems().toArray();
            var mappingASITName = getChecklistASITNameMappingX(guidesheetArray[x]); //lookup(""CHECKLIST_MAPPING_ASIT_MAPPING"", inspType);
            var inspectionInternalMapping = populateChecklistMappingsX(internalMappingRecord, mappingASITName);
            var currentGuidesheetItemStatusUpdateMissing = new Array();
            var checkOptionalItemValue = lookup(""CHECKLIST_OPTIONAL_ITEMS_MAPPING"", guidesheetType);
            checkOptionalItemValue = (checkOptionalItemValue != null && checkOptionalItemValue != """") ? checkOptionalItemValue : ""NOITEMEXISTS"";
            var doNotCheckRequiredItems = false;

            if (guidesheetType == ""Enforcement Affidavit Details"") {
                var guidesheetItems = guidesheetArray[x].getItems().toArray();
                for (var loopi in guidesheetItems) {
                    var guidesheetItem = guidesheetItems[loopi];
                    var itemText = guidesheetItem.getGuideItemText();
                    var itemStatus = guidesheetItem.getGuideItemStatus();
                    if (itemText != null && itemText == ""Enforcement Information"" && itemStatus == ""Complete"") {
                        aa.print(""*** Enforcement Information"");
                        getEnforcementInformation(guidesheetItem);
                    }

                    if ((itemText == ""Enforcement Information"" || itemText == ""Affidavits"") && itemStatus == ""Select"") {
                        currentGuidesheetItemStatusUpdateMissing.push(breakVal + ""<b>Checklist Name:</b> "" + guidesheetType.toString() + "" <b>Checklist Item:</b> "" + itemText);
                    } 
                }
                if (!doNotCheckRequiredItems && !ignoreRequiredConditionforAllItems) {
                    guidesheetItemStatusUpdateMissing = guidesheetItemStatusUpdateMissing.concat(currentGuidesheetItemStatusUpdateMissing);
                }
                continue;
            }

            for (var loopi in guidesheetItems) {
                var guidesheetItem = guidesheetItems[loopi];
                var itemText = guidesheetItem.getGuideItemText();
                var itemStatus = guidesheetItem.getGuideItemStatus();

                if (guidesheetType != ""Enhanced Inspection Checklist"" && !ignoreRequiredConditionforAllItems) {
                    if (itemStatus == null || itemStatus == """" || itemStatus == ""Select"") {
                        currentGuidesheetItemStatusUpdateMissing.push(breakVal + ""<b>Checklist Name:</b> "" + guidesheetType.toString() + "" <b>Checklist Item:</b> "" + itemText);
                    } else if (itemStatus == ""N/A"" || itemStatus == ""No"") {
                        if (itemText == checkOptionalItemValue) {
                            doNotCheckRequiredItems = true;
                        }
                    }
                } else {
                    doNotCheckRequiredItems = true;
                }
                var vFound = false;
                //var internalMappingObj = internalMapping.get(itemText);
                var internalMappingObj = null;
                if (inspectionInternalMapping)
                    internalMappingObj = inspectionInternalMapping.get(itemText);

                var vIsItemATextBoxX = isItemATextBox(guidesheetItem, internalMappingObj, mappingASITName);
                var checkedInfractionCodes = getCheckedInfractionCodesX(guidesheetItem, internalMappingObj, mappingASITName, vIsItemATextBoxX);
                var isItemcheckboxX = isItemCheckbox(guidesheetItem, internalMappingObj, mappingASITName);
                var vIsItemATextBoxX = isItemATextBox(guidesheetItem, internalMappingObj, mappingASITName);
                var isAnycheckedX = isAnychecked(guidesheetItem, internalMappingObj, mappingASITName);
                
                if (internalMappingObj == null || (vIsItemATextBoxX != false && vIsItemATextBoxX != null && vIsItemATextBoxX != """")) {
                    for (var ii in checkedInfractionCodes) {
                        var vCode = String(checkedInfractionCodes[ii]).trim();
                        var res = getInfractionCodeItemsFromDB(vCode, itemText);
                        if (res && res.length > 0) {
                            internalMappingObj = res[0]; //taking first if multiple exists                            
                            vFound = true;
                        }
                    }
                }
                aa.print(""itemText: "" + itemText);
                aa.print(""isItemcheckboxX: "" + isItemcheckboxX);
                aa.print(""isAnycheckedX: "" + isAnycheckedX);
                aa.print(""vIsItemATextBoxX: "" + vIsItemATextBoxX);
                aa.print(""----------------------------------------"");
                

                if (internalMappingObj) {
                    var violationOrderComplianceCheck = (internalMappingObj.checklistStatus == itemStatus) ? true : false;
                    var checkedEnforcements = getCheckedEnforcements(guidesheetItem);

                    if (violationOrderComplianceCheck) {
                    
                        if (isItemcheckboxX != false && isAnycheckedX == false && (vIsItemATextBoxX == null || vIsItemATextBoxX == """")) {
                            errorMessageX += ""<b>Checklist Name:</b> "" + guidesheetType.toString() + ""<b>Checklist Item:</b> "" + itemText + "" --> Infraction Codes are missing."";
                            errorMessageX += breakVal;
                        }
                        else if(internalMappingObj == null)
                        {
                          if (isItemcheckboxX == false || isAnycheckedX == false) {
                              if (((vIsItemATextBoxX == null) || (vIsItemATextBoxX == """"))) {
                                  errorMessageX += ""<b>Checklist Name:</b> "" + guidesheetType.toString() + ""<b>Checklist Item:</b> "" + itemText + "" --> Infraction Codes are missing."";
                                  errorMessageX += breakVal;
                              } else if ((vIsItemATextBoxX != null) && (vIsItemATextBoxX != """") && !vFound) {
                                  errorMessageXX += ""<b>Checklist Name:</b> "" + guidesheetType.toString() + ""<b>Checklist Item:</b> "" + itemText + "" --> The entered Infraction Code, "" + vIsItemATextBoxX + "" is NOT VAILD."";
                                  errorMessageXX += breakVal;
                              }
                          }
                        }
                    }
                    if (checkedEnforcements != null && checkedEnforcements.length > 0) {
                        if (applicationType == ""Fire Alarm"") {
                            if (checkedEnforcements.indexOf(""Violation Order"") > -1) {
                                ignoreRequiredConditionforAllItems = true;
                                guidesheetItemStatusUpdateMissing = new Array();
                                aa.print(""**************************** ignoreRequiredConditionforAllItems: "" + ignoreRequiredConditionforAllItems);
                            }
                        }
                        if (!violationOrderComplianceCheck) {
                            guidesheetItemEnforcementStatusUpdateMissing.push(breakVal + ""<b>Checklist Name:</b> "" + guidesheetType.toString() + "" <b>Checklist Item:</b> "" + itemText);
                        }
                    } else {
                        if (violationOrderComplianceCheck) {
                            guidesheetItemEnforcementUpdateMissing.push(breakVal + ""<b>Checklist Name:</b> "" + guidesheetType.toString() + "" <b>Checklist Item:</b> "" + itemText);
                        }
                    }

                    if (violationOrderComplianceCheck) {
                        failedguidesheetItems.push(breakVal + ""<b>Checklist Name:</b> "" + guidesheetType.toString() + "" <b>Checklist Item:</b> "" + itemText);
                    }
                } else {
                    aa.print(""No Mapping found for: "" + guidesheetType.toString() + "" -> "" + itemText);
                }
            }

            if (!doNotCheckRequiredItems && !ignoreRequiredConditionforAllItems) {
                guidesheetItemStatusUpdateMissing = guidesheetItemStatusUpdateMissing.concat(currentGuidesheetItemStatusUpdateMissing);
            }
        }


        if (guidesheetItemStatusUpdateMissing.length > 0) {
            errorMessage += breakVal + breakVal;
            errorMessage += ""<b>The below Checklist item(s) are mandatory for resulting of the Inspection. Please update the status for below Checklist Item(s):</b> "" + breakVal;
            errorMessage += guidesheetItemStatusUpdateMissing.toString();
        }

        if (guidesheetItemEnforcementStatusUpdateMissing.length > 0) {
            errorMessage += breakVal + breakVal;
            errorMessage += ""<b>The below Checklist item(s) are not failed but have an Enforcement Action on them. Please select the Checklist Item status or remove the Enforcement Action:</b> "" + breakVal;
            errorMessage += guidesheetItemEnforcementStatusUpdateMissing.toString();
        }

        if (guidesheetItemEnforcementUpdateMissing.length > 0) {
            errorMessage += breakVal + breakVal;
            errorMessage += ""<b>Please select an Enforcement Action for the below failed Checklist Items:</b> "" + breakVal;
            errorMessage += guidesheetItemEnforcementUpdateMissing.toString();
        }

        if (failedguidesheetItems.length == 0) {
            errorMessage += breakVal + breakVal;
            errorMessage += ""<b>One or more items need to be failed when you update the result to In Violation</b> "" + breakVal;
        }
        if (errorMessageX != """") {
            errorMessage += ""<br><br><b>Infraction Code(s) Missing:</b><br><br>"" + errorMessageX;
        }
        if (errorMessageXX != """") {
            errorMessage += ""<br><br><b>INVALID Infraction Code(s):</b><br><br>"" + errorMessageXX;
        }

        if (enforcementInfoObj != null) {
            var respondentErrorMessage = validateRespondentDetails();
            if (respondentErrorMessage != null) {
                errorMessage += breakVal + breakVal;
                errorMessage += ""<b>"" + respondentErrorMessage + ""</b> "" + breakVal;
            }
        }
    }

    aa.print(""Error Message: "" + breakVal + errorMessage);
    return errorMessage;
}

function populateChecklistMappings(internalMappingRecord, tableName) {
    var checklistMap = aa.util.newHashMap();
    var columnToBeSearched = ""Checklist Item"";

    if (arguments.length == 3) {
        columnToBeSearched = arguments[2];
    }

    var mappingTable = loadASITable(tableName, internalMappingRecord);

    for (i in mappingTable) {
        var row = mappingTable[i];
        var mappingObj = new Object();
        mappingObj.checklistItem = row[""Checklist Item""].toString();
        mappingObj.checklistStatus = row[""Checklist Status""].toString();
        aa.print(""Mapping Added: "" + mappingObj.checklistItem);
        checklistMap.put(mappingObj.checklistItem, mappingObj);
    }

    return checklistMap;
}


function getInspectionModelFromRecord() {
    var inspectionObj = aa.inspection.getInspections(capId);

    if (inspectionObj.getSuccess()) {
        var inspectionList = inspectionObj.getOutput();

        for (i in inspectionList) {
            var inspectionModel = inspectionList[i].getInspection();

            if (String(inspId) == String(inspectionModel.getIdNumber())) {
                return inspectionModel;
            }
        }
    }

    return null;
}

function getEnforcementInformation(guidesheetItem) {
    enforcementInfoObj = new Object();
    var checklistTemplateGroup = guidesheetItem.getItemASISubgroupList();
    aa.print(""getEnforcementInformation"");
    var iterator = checklistTemplateGroup.iterator();

    while (iterator.hasNext()) {
        var templateItemObj = iterator.next();
        var templateItemList = templateItemObj.getAsiList();
        var templateIterator = templateItemList.iterator();

        while (templateIterator.hasNext()) {
            var templateItem = templateIterator.next();
            var templateAttributeValue = (templateItem.getAttributeValue() == null) ? """" : templateItem.getAttributeValue();

            if (templateItem.getAsiName() == ""Respondent"") {
                enforcementInfoObj.respondent = templateAttributeValue;
            } else if (templateItem.getAsiName() == ""Respondent Type"") {
                enforcementInfoObj.respondentType = templateAttributeValue;
            } else if (templateItem.getAsiName() == ""First Name"") {
                enforcementInfoObj.firstName = templateAttributeValue;
            } else if (templateItem.getAsiName() == ""Last Name"") {
                enforcementInfoObj.lastName = templateAttributeValue;
            }
      else if (templateItem.getAsiName() == ""Legal Business Name"") {
                enforcementInfoObj.legalBusinessName = templateAttributeValue;
            } 
      else if (templateItem.getAsiName() == ""E-mail"") {
                enforcementInfoObj.email = templateAttributeValue;
            } else if (templateItem.getAsiName() == ""Contact Number"") {
                enforcementInfoObj.contactNumber = templateAttributeValue;
            } else if (templateItem.getAsiName() == ""Building Number"") {
                enforcementInfoObj.buildingNumber = templateAttributeValue;
            } else if (templateItem.getAsiName() == ""Street Name"") {
                enforcementInfoObj.streetName = templateAttributeValue;
            } else if (templateItem.getAsiName() == ""Apt/Floor #"") {
                enforcementInfoObj.aptFloorNo = templateAttributeValue;
            } else if (templateItem.getAsiName() == ""City"") {
                enforcementInfoObj.city = templateAttributeValue;
            } else if (templateItem.getAsiName() == ""State"") {
                enforcementInfoObj.state = templateAttributeValue;
            } else if (templateItem.getAsiName() == ""Zip"") {
                enforcementInfoObj.zip = templateAttributeValue;
            }
        }
    }
}

function validateRespondentDetails() {
    if (enforcementInfoObj != null) {
        if (enforcementInfoObj.respondent == ""Building Owner"") {
            var contactObj = getContactByType(""Building Owner"", capId);
            if (contactObj == null || contactObj == false) {
                return ""Building Owner is listed as the Respondent. Please add the Building Owner contact on the record before proceeding."";
            }
        } else if (enforcementInfoObj.respondent == ""Business Owner"") {
            var contactObj = getContactByType(""Business Owner"", capId);
            if (contactObj == null || contactObj == false) {
                return ""Business Owner is listed as the Respondent. Please add the Business Owner contact on the record before proceeding."";
            }
        } else if (enforcementInfoObj.respondent == ""Other"") {
            if (enforcementInfoObj.firstName == """" && enforcementInfoObj.lastName == """" && enforcementInfoObj.legalBusinessName == """") {
                return ""Please add all the Respondent contact fields in the Enforcement Affidavits checklist before proceeding."";
            }
        }
    }

    return null;
}


function hasBillingContactAddress() {
  var contact = null;
  var contactResult = aa.people.getCapContactByCapID(capId);
  if (contactResult.getSuccess()) {
    var contactArray = contactResult.getOutput();
    for (i in contactArray) {
      contact = contactArray[i];
      var contAdd = contact.getCapContactModel();
      if (contAdd.getContactType() == ""Billing Contact"") {
        var addressList = aa.address.getContactAddressListByCapContact(contAdd).getOutput();
        if (addressList) {
          for (add in addressList) {
            var contactAddressModel = addressList[add].getContactAddressModel();
            if (contactAddressModel.getAddressType() == ""Billing Address"") {
              return true;
            }
          }
        }
      }
    }
  }
  aa.print(""No Billing contact"");
  return false;
}

                                        AND b6.b1_per_id1 = charge.entity_key1
                                        AND b6.b1_per_id2 = charge.entity_key2

                                         AND b6.b1_per_id3 = pstatus.entity_key3

                                         AND b6.b1_per_id2 = cycstatus.entity_key2

WITH APO AS (
select SERV_PROV_CODE,
		B1_PER_ID1,
		B1_PER_ID2,
		B1_PER_ID3,
		[BIN] as BIN,
		[BLOCK] as BLOCK,
		[LOT] as LOT
from 
(
SELECT
    apo.serv_prov_code AS SERV_PROV_CODE,
    apo.b1_per_id1 AS B1_PER_ID1,
	apo.b1_per_id2 AS B1_PER_ID2,
    apo.b1_per_id3 AS B1_PER_ID3,
    apo.b1_attribute_name,
    apo.b1_attribute_value
FROM
	b3apo_attribute apo
JOIN #TMP_Returned_Values rv ON APO.SERV_PROV_CODE = rv.SERV_PROV_CODE
	AND APO.B1_PER_ID1 = rv.B1_PER_ID1
	AND APO.B1_PER_ID2 = rv.B1_PER_ID2
	AND APO.B1_PER_ID3 = rv.B1_PER_ID3
INNER JOIN b1permit bp ON bp.SERV_PROV_CODE = rv.SERV_PROV_CODE
	AND bp.B1_PER_ID1 = rv.B1_PER_ID1
	AND bp.B1_PER_ID2 = rv.B1_PER_ID2
	AND bp.B1_PER_ID3 = rv.B1_PER_ID3
WHERE

       bp.b1_per_type = 'Common' 
       AND  bp.b1_per_sub_type = 'Inspection'
--       AND bp.b1_appl_status <> 'Inactive'
	   AND bp.SERV_PROV_CODE = 'FDNY'
    AND apo.b1_attribute_name IN ( 'BIN', 'BLOCK','LOT' )
    AND apo.b1_apo_type IN ('ADDRESS')
	AND APO.SERV_PROV_CODE = 'FDNY'
    ) pva
PIVOT ( 
	MAX(b1_attribute_value) 
	for b1_attribute_name
       IN(
			[BIN],
			[BLOCK],
			[LOT]
		) 
	) pvb
)

    bap.attribute_value
    FROM

    INNER JOIN bappspectable_value bap ON bp.serv_prov_code = bap.serv_prov_code
                                     AND bp.b1_per_id1 = bap.b1_per_id1
                                     AND bp.b1_per_id2 = bap.b1_per_id2
                                     AND bp.b1_per_id3 = bap.b1_per_id3
    WHERE
          bap.TABLE_NAME = 'BILLING INFORMATION'

          AND  bp.b1_per_type = 'Common'
          AND  bp.b1_per_sub_type = 'Inspection'
    )    pv1 

    PIVOT (MAX (ATTRIBUTE_VALUE)
                                               FOR COLUMN_NAME
                                               IN  ([Bill Number],
                                                   [Bill Type],
                                                   [Bill Date],
                                                   [Bill Amount],
                                                   [Clock Date],
                                                   [Cycle Number],
                                                   [First Reminder],
                                                   [Lien Notice],
                                                   [Account Type])) pv2
WHERE  1=1
	   AND [Bill Type] = 'Lien Notice'
	   AND [Lien Notice] IS NOT NULL

)

WITH MAIL_ADDR AS (

        serv_prov_code,
        b1_per_id1,
