		CONCAT(COALESCE(UPPER(B1_BUSINESS_NAME), B1_FNAME),' ',B1_LNAME) AS CONTACT_NAME,
        CONCAT(MAILSTNUM,' ',MAILSTNAME,' ',MAILCITY,', ',MAILSTATE,' ',MAILZIPCD) AS CONTACT_ADDRESS,

FROM

          SUBSTRING(G7_ZIP,1,5) AS MAILZIPCD,
          g7.G7_CITY AS MAILCITY,
          G7.G7_STATE AS MAILSTATE,
		  b3c.b1_contact_type,

          ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY B.B1_ALT_ID ORDER BY B3C.B1_CONTACT_TYPE DESC) RN
     FROM b1Permit b
          JOIN B3Contact b3c
             ON     b.serv_prov_code = b3c.serv_prov_code
                AND b.b1_per_id1 = b3c.b1_per_id1
                AND b.b1_per_id2 = b3c.b1_per_id2
                AND b.b1_per_id3 = b3c.b1_per_id3
				and b3c.B1_CONTACT_TYPE IN ('Business Owner','Billing Contact')
          JOIN xrecord_contact_entity xr
             ON     b.serv_prov_code = xr.serv_prov_code
                AND b.b1_per_id1 = xr.b1_per_id1
                AND b.b1_per_id2 = xr.b1_per_id2
                AND b.b1_per_id3 = xr.b1_per_id3
                AND b3c.b1_contact_nbr = xr.b1_contact_nbr
--                AND b3c.B1_FLAG = 'Y'
                AND (B3C.G1_CONTACT_NBR IS NULL AND XR.ENT_TYPE LIKE 'CAP%CONTACT' 
                    OR B3C.G1_CONTACT_NBR IS NOT NULL AND XR.ENT_TYPE='CONTACT' )
 JOIN #TMP_Returned_Values rv ON b.SERV_PROV_CODE = rv.SERV_PROV_CODE
	AND b.B1_PER_ID1 = rv.B1_PER_ID1
	AND b.B1_PER_ID2 = rv.B1_PER_ID2
	AND b.B1_PER_ID3 = rv.B1_PER_ID3


          JOIN G7CONTACT_ADDRESS g7
             ON     g7.g7_Entity_type = xr.ENT_TYPE
                AND xr.ENT_ID1 = g7.RES_ID
                AND G7_ADDRESS_TYPE = 'Billing Address'
    WHERE  1=1  
        and   b.B1_PER_TYPE = 'Common'
          AND b.B1_PER_SUB_TYPE = 'Inspection') PV1
     WHERE RN = 1         
)
   select * INTO #TMP_MAIL_ADDR from MAIL_ADDR;

            [No Fee],

)

    ma.CONTACT_NAME ACCOUNT_NAME,
	ma.CONTACT_ADDRESS AS BILLING_ADDR,
    COALESCE(pr.BLOCK_NUM,' ') AS PROP_BLOCK,
    COALESCE(pr.LOT_NUM,' ') AS PROP_LOT,
    COALESCE(pr.BLD_STREET,' ') PROP_ADDRESS, 
    COALESCE(pr.CITY_STATE_ZIP,' ') PROP_CITY_STATE_ZIP, 
	COALESCE(pr.OWNER_NAME,' ') PROP_OWNER_NAME, 
	bp.b1_alt_id AS ACCOUNT_NO,
    COALESCE(cv.ITEMCODES,' ') ITEM_CODES,
    pd.BALANCE,
    CONCAT(COALESCE(ad.B1_HSE_NBR_ALPHA_START,''),' ',COALESCE(ad.B1_STR_NAME,'')) PREM_ADDR1,
    CONCAT(COALESCE(ad.B1_SITUS_CITY,''),' ',COALESCE(ad.B1_SITUS_STATE,''),' ',COALESCE(SUBSTRING(ad.B1_SITUS_ZIP,1,5),'')) PREM_ADDR2

FROM
         b1permit bp

                             
    LEFT OUTER JOIN #TMP_addr ad ON ad.serv_prov_code = bp.serv_prov_code
                                  AND ad.b1_per_id1 = bp.b1_per_id1
                                  AND ad.b1_per_id2 = bp.b1_per_id2
                                  AND ad.b1_per_id3 = bp.b1_per_id3   
    INNER JOIN #TMP_Returned_Values bi ON bi.serv_prov_code = bp.serv_prov_code
                                  AND bi.b1_per_id1 = bp.b1_per_id1
                                  AND bi.b1_per_id2 = bp.b1_per_id2
                                  AND bi.b1_per_id3 = bp.b1_per_id3  
    LEFT OUTER JOIN #TMP_PROPERTY pr ON pr.serv_prov_code = bp.serv_prov_code
                                   AND pr.b1_per_id1 = bp.b1_per_id1
                                   AND pr.b1_per_id2 = bp.b1_per_id2
                                   AND pr.b1_per_id3 = bp.b1_per_id3
    LEFT OUTER JOIN BPERMIT_DETAIL  pd ON pd.serv_prov_code = bp.serv_prov_code
                                   AND pd.b1_per_id1 = bp.b1_per_id1
                                   AND pd.b1_per_id2 = bp.b1_per_id2

                                   AND cv.b1_per_id3 = bp.b1_per_id3
    LEFT OUTER JOIN #TMP_MAIL_ADDR  ma ON ma.serv_prov_code = bp.serv_prov_code
                                   AND ma.b1_per_id1 = bp.b1_per_id1
                                   AND ma.b1_per_id2 = bp.b1_per_id2
                                   AND ma.b1_per_id3 = bp.b1_per_id3

                                   AND nf.b1_per_id1 = bp.b1_per_id1
                                   AND nf.b1_per_id2 = bp.b1_per_id2
                                   AND nf.b1_per_id3 = bp.b1_per_id3

													FROM SETHEADER 
													WHERE RECORD_SET_TYPE = 'LIEN_NOTICES'
													AND SET_STATUS = 'Open')
											--		AND set_date > '2026-04-01')

WHERE
    bp.b1_per_type = 'Common' 
    AND bp.b1_per_sub_type = 'Inspection'
    AND   pd.BALANCE >= 1
    AND  ( nf.EXEMPT_RECOMMEND_DATE IS NULL AND nf.NO_FEE_DATE IS NULL)

ORDER BY
    bp.b1_alt_id;

WITH Returned_Values AS(

    serv_prov_code,
    b1_per_id1,
    b1_per_id2,
    b1_per_id3,
    b1_alt_id,
    b1_per_type,
    b1_per_sub_type,
    b1_file_dd,
    rec_date,
    rec_ful_nam,
    rec_status,
    b1_appl_status,
    ROW_INDEX,
    [Bill Number] AS BILL_NUMBER,
    [Bill Type] AS BILL_TYPE,
    [Bill Date] AS BILL_DATE,
    [Bill Amount] AS BILL_AMOUNT,
    [Clock Date] AS CLOCK_DATE,

     FROM (
     SELECT 
    bp.serv_prov_code,
    bp.b1_per_id1,
    bp.b1_per_id2,
    bp.b1_per_id3,
    bp.b1_alt_id,
    bp.b1_per_type,
    bp.b1_per_sub_type,
    bp.b1_file_dd,
    bp.rec_date,
    bp.rec_ful_nam,
    bp.rec_status,
    bp.b1_appl_status,
    ROW_INDEX AS ROW_INDEX,
    bap.COLUMN_NAME,
    bap.attribute_value
    FROM
         b1permit bp
    INNER JOIN bappspectable_value bap ON bp.serv_prov_code = bap.serv_prov_code
                                     AND bp.b1_per_id1 = bap.b1_per_id1
                                     AND bp.b1_per_id2 = bap.b1_per_id2
                                     AND bp.b1_per_id3 = bap.b1_per_id3
    WHERE
          bap.TABLE_NAME = 'BILLING INFORMATION'
         AND bap.COLUMN_NAME IN ('Bill Number', 'Bill Type', 'Bill Date','Bill Amount','Clock Date','Cycle Number','First Reminder','Lien Notice','Account Type')
          AND  bp.b1_per_type = 'Common'
          AND  bp.b1_per_sub_type = 'Inspection'
    )    pv1 

    PIVOT (MAX (ATTRIBUTE_VALUE)
                                               FOR COLUMN_NAME
                                               IN  ([Bill Number],
                                                   [Bill Type],
                                                   [Bill Date],
                                                   [Bill Amount],
                                                   [Clock Date],
                                                   [Cycle Number],
                                                   [First Reminder],
                                                   [Lien Notice],
                                                   [Account Type])) pv2
WHERE  1=1
	   AND [Bill Type] = 'Lien Notice'
	   AND [Lien Notice] IS NOT NULL
--	   	AND b1_alt_id in ('21028493','21029616','24041279')
)
   select * INTO #TMP_Returned_Values from Returned_Values;

with addr AS (
    SELECT
        *
    FROM
        (
            SELECT
                b.serv_prov_code,
                b.b1_per_id1,
                b.b1_per_id2,
                b.b1_per_id3,
                b.b1_hse_nbr_alpha_start,
                b.b1_str_name,
                b.b1_situs_city,
                b.b1_situs_state,
                b.b1_situs_zip,

                ROW_NUMBER()
                OVER(PARTITION BY b.serv_prov_code, b.b1_per_id1, b.b1_per_id2, b.b1_per_id3
                     ORDER BY
                         b.B1_PRIMARY_ADDR_FLG, b.REC_DATE DESC
                ) rn
            FROM
                b3addres b
JOIN #TMP_Returned_Values rv ON b.SERV_PROV_CODE = rv.SERV_PROV_CODE
	AND b.B1_PER_ID1 = rv.B1_PER_ID1
	AND b.B1_PER_ID2 = rv.B1_PER_ID2
	AND b.B1_PER_ID3 = rv.B1_PER_ID3
        ) tr
    WHERE
        rn = 1

WITH PROPERTY AS (

	SERV_PROV_CODE,
	B1_PER_ID1,

    bc.serv_prov_code AS SERV_PROV_CODE,
    bc.b1_per_id1 AS B1_PER_ID1,
    bc.b1_per_id2 AS B1_PER_ID2,
    bc.b1_per_id3 AS B1_PER_ID3,
    bc.b1_checkbox_desc,
    bc.b1_checklist_comment
 FROM
         bchckbox bc
 JOIN #TMP_Returned_Values rv ON bc.SERV_PROV_CODE = rv.SERV_PROV_CODE
	AND bc.B1_PER_ID1 = rv.B1_PER_ID1
	AND bc.B1_PER_ID2 = rv.B1_PER_ID2
	AND bc.B1_PER_ID3 = rv.B1_PER_ID3

WHERE
    bc.b1_checkbox_desc IN ( 'Block', 'Lot', 'Building No/Street Name','City/State/ZIP', 'Owner Name' )
    AND bc.b1_checkbox_type IN ('PROPERTY OWNER INFO')
    ) pv1
PIVOT ( MAX(b1_checklist_comment) for b1_checkbox_desc
            IN([Block],
            [Lot],
            [Building No/Street Name], 
            [City/State/ZIP],
            [Owner Name])) tr
)

   select * INTO #TMP_property from property;

WHERE 
        f4.SERV_PROV_CODE='FDNY'
         GROUP BY f4.SERV_PROV_CODE,f4.B1_PER_ID1,    f4.B1_PER_ID2,    f4.B1_PER_ID3

WITH MAIL_ADDR AS (
SELECT 
        serv_prov_code,
        b1_per_id1,
        b1_per_id2,
        b1_per_id3,
		CONCAT(COALESCE(UPPER(B1_BUSINESS_NAME), B1_FNAME),' ',B1_LNAME) AS CONTACT_NAME,
        CONCAT(MAILSTNUM,' ',MAILSTNAME,' ',MAILCITY,', ',MAILSTATE,' ',MAILZIPCD) AS CONTACT_ADDRESS,
        b1_contact_nbr,
        B1_FLAG 


FROM
(SELECT 
        b.serv_prov_code,
        b.b1_per_id1,
        b.b1_per_id2,
        b.b1_per_id3,
        B3C.B1_BUSINESS_NAME,
        B3C.B1_FNAME,
        B3C.B1_LNAME,
          G7_HSE_NBR_ALPHA_START AS MAILSTNUM,
          G7_STR_NAME AS MAILSTNAME,
          G7_STR_PREFIX AS MAILSTPFX,
          CAST (NULL AS VARCHAR (1)) AS MAILSTTYP,
          G7_STR_SUFFIX AS MAILSTSFX,
          G7_ZIP AS MAILZIPCD,
          g7.G7_CITY AS MAILCITY,
          G7.G7_STATE AS MAILSTATE,
		  b3c.b1_contact_type,
          b3c.b1_contact_nbr,
          b3c.B1_FLAG,
          ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY B.B1_ALT_ID ORDER BY B3C.B1_CONTACT_TYPE DESC) RN
     FROM b1Permit b
          JOIN B3Contact b3c
             ON     b.serv_prov_code = b3c.serv_prov_code
                AND b.b1_per_id1 = b3c.b1_per_id1
                AND b.b1_per_id2 = b3c.b1_per_id2
                AND b.b1_per_id3 = b3c.b1_per_id3
				and b3c.B1_CONTACT_TYPE IN ('Business Owner','Billing Contact')
          JOIN xrecord_contact_entity xr
             ON     b.serv_prov_code = xr.serv_prov_code
                AND b.b1_per_id1 = xr.b1_per_id1
                AND b.b1_per_id2 = xr.b1_per_id2
                AND b.b1_per_id3 = xr.b1_per_id3
                AND b3c.b1_contact_nbr = xr.b1_contact_nbr
--                AND b3c.B1_FLAG = 'Y'
                AND (B3C.G1_CONTACT_NBR IS NULL AND XR.ENT_TYPE LIKE 'CAP%CONTACT' 
                    OR B3C.G1_CONTACT_NBR IS NOT NULL AND XR.ENT_TYPE='CONTACT' )
 JOIN #TMP_Returned_Values rv ON b.SERV_PROV_CODE = rv.SERV_PROV_CODE
	AND b.B1_PER_ID1 = rv.B1_PER_ID1
	AND b.B1_PER_ID2 = rv.B1_PER_ID2
	AND b.B1_PER_ID3 = rv.B1_PER_ID3


          JOIN G7CONTACT_ADDRESS g7
             ON     g7.g7_Entity_type = xr.ENT_TYPE
                AND xr.ENT_ID1 = g7.RES_ID
                AND G7_ADDRESS_TYPE = 'Billing Address'
    WHERE  1=1  
        and   b.B1_PER_TYPE = 'Common'
          AND b.B1_PER_SUB_TYPE = 'Inspection') PV1
     WHERE RN = 1         
)
   select * INTO #TMP_MAIL_ADDR from MAIL_ADDR;
--   select * from #TMP_MAIL_ADDR

WITH MAIL_ADDR AS (
SELECT

        b1_per_id1,
        b1_per_id2,
        b1_per_id3,
		CONCAT(COALESCE(UPPER(B1_BUSINESS_NAME), B1_FNAME),' ',B1_LNAME) AS CONTACT_NAME,
        CONCAT(MAILSTNUM,' ',MAILSTNAME,' ',MAILCITY,', ',MAILSTATE,' ',MAILZIPCD) AS CONTACT_ADDRESS,
        b1_contact_nbr,
        B1_FLAG 


FROM
(SELECT 
        b.serv_prov_code,
        b.b1_per_id1,
        b.b1_per_id2,
        b.b1_per_id3,
        B3C.B1_BUSINESS_NAME,
        B3C.B1_FNAME,
        B3C.B1_LNAME,

          G7_STR_NAME AS MAILSTNAME,
          G7_STR_PREFIX AS MAILSTPFX,
          CAST (NULL AS VARCHAR (1)) AS MAILSTTYP,
          G7_STR_SUFFIX AS MAILSTSFX,
          SUBSTRING(G7_ZIP,1,5) AS MAILZIPCD,
          g7.G7_CITY AS MAILCITY,
          G7.G7_STATE AS MAILSTATE,
		  b3c.b1_contact_type,
          b3c.b1_contact_nbr,
          b3c.B1_FLAG,
          ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY B.B1_ALT_ID ORDER BY B3C.B1_CONTACT_TYPE DESC) RN
     FROM b1Permit b
          JOIN B3Contact b3c
             ON     b.serv_prov_code = b3c.serv_prov_code
                AND b.b1_per_id1 = b3c.b1_per_id1
                AND b.b1_per_id2 = b3c.b1_per_id2
                AND b.b1_per_id3 = b3c.b1_per_id3
				and b3c.B1_CONTACT_TYPE IN ('Business Owner','Billing Contact')
          JOIN xrecord_contact_entity xr
             ON     b.serv_prov_code = xr.serv_prov_code
                AND b.b1_per_id1 = xr.b1_per_id1
                AND b.b1_per_id2 = xr.b1_per_id2
                AND b.b1_per_id3 = xr.b1_per_id3
                AND b3c.b1_contact_nbr = xr.b1_contact_nbr
--                AND b3c.B1_FLAG = 'Y'
                AND (B3C.G1_CONTACT_NBR IS NULL AND XR.ENT_TYPE LIKE 'CAP%CONTACT' 
                    OR B3C.G1_CONTACT_NBR IS NOT NULL AND XR.ENT_TYPE='CONTACT' )
 JOIN #TMP_Returned_Values rv ON b.SERV_PROV_CODE = rv.SERV_PROV_CODE
	AND b.B1_PER_ID1 = rv.B1_PER_ID1
	AND b.B1_PER_ID2 = rv.B1_PER_ID2
	AND b.B1_PER_ID3 = rv.B1_PER_ID3


          JOIN G7CONTACT_ADDRESS g7
             ON     g7.g7_Entity_type = xr.ENT_TYPE
                AND xr.ENT_ID1 = g7.RES_ID
                AND G7_ADDRESS_TYPE = 'Billing Address'
    WHERE  1=1  
        and   b.B1_PER_TYPE = 'Common'
          AND b.B1_PER_SUB_TYPE = 'Inspection') PV1
     WHERE RN = 1         
)

 JOIN #TMP_Returned_Values rv ON bc.SERV_PROV_CODE = rv.SERV_PROV_CODE

    ma.CONTACT_NAME ACCOUNT_NAME,
	ma.CONTACT_ADDRESS AS BILLING_ADDR,

    COALESCE(pr.LOT_NUM,' ') AS PROP_LOT,

    CONCAT(COALESCE(ad.B1_SITUS_CITY,''),' ',COALESCE(ad.B1_SITUS_STATE,''),' ',COALESCE(SUBSTRING(ad.B1_SITUS_ZIP,1,5),'')) PREM_ADDR2,
	sd.rec_date

FROM
         b1permit bp

                             
    LEFT OUTER JOIN #TMP_addr ad ON ad.serv_prov_code = bp.serv_prov_code
                                  AND ad.b1_per_id1 = bp.b1_per_id1
                                  AND ad.b1_per_id2 = bp.b1_per_id2
                                  AND ad.b1_per_id3 = bp.b1_per_id3   
    INNER JOIN #TMP_Returned_Values bi ON bi.serv_prov_code = bp.serv_prov_code
                                  AND bi.b1_per_id1 = bp.b1_per_id1
                                  AND bi.b1_per_id2 = bp.b1_per_id2
                                  AND bi.b1_per_id3 = bp.b1_per_id3  
    LEFT OUTER JOIN #TMP_PROPERTY pr ON pr.serv_prov_code = bp.serv_prov_code
                                   AND pr.b1_per_id1 = bp.b1_per_id1
                                   AND pr.b1_per_id2 = bp.b1_per_id2
                                   AND pr.b1_per_id3 = bp.b1_per_id3
    LEFT OUTER JOIN BPERMIT_DETAIL  pd ON pd.serv_prov_code = bp.serv_prov_code
                                   AND pd.b1_per_id1 = bp.b1_per_id1
                                   AND pd.b1_per_id2 = bp.b1_per_id2
                                   AND pd.b1_per_id3 = bp.b1_per_id3
    LEFT OUTER JOIN #TMP_COV_ITEM  cv ON cv.serv_prov_code = bp.serv_prov_code
                                   AND cv.b1_per_id1 = bp.b1_per_id1
                                   AND cv.b1_per_id2 = bp.b1_per_id2
                                   AND cv.b1_per_id3 = bp.b1_per_id3
    LEFT OUTER JOIN #TMP_MAIL_ADDR  ma ON ma.serv_prov_code = bp.serv_prov_code
                                   AND ma.b1_per_id1 = bp.b1_per_id1
                                   AND ma.b1_per_id2 = bp.b1_per_id2
                                   AND ma.b1_per_id3 = bp.b1_per_id3    
                                   
    LEFT OUTER JOIN #TMP_no_fee  nf ON nf.serv_prov_code = bp.serv_prov_code
                                   AND nf.b1_per_id1 = bp.b1_per_id1
                                   AND nf.b1_per_id2 = bp.b1_per_id2
                                   AND nf.b1_per_id3 = bp.b1_per_id3   
    INNER JOIN SETDETAILS sd ON sd.serv_prov_code = bp.serv_prov_code
                                  AND sd.b1_per_id1 = bp.b1_per_id1
                                  AND sd.b1_per_id2 = bp.b1_per_id2
                                  AND sd.b1_per_id3 = bp.b1_per_id3 
								  AND SD.SET_ID = (SELECT SET_ID 
													FROM SETHEADER 
													WHERE RECORD_SET_TYPE = 'LIEN_NOTICES'
												--	AND SET_STATUS = 'Open')
													AND set_date > '2025-04-01')

WHERE
    bp.b1_per_type = 'Common' 
    AND bp.b1_per_sub_type = 'Inspection'
    AND   pd.BALANCE >= 1
    AND  ( nf.EXEMPT_RECOMMEND_DATE IS NULL AND nf.NO_FEE_DATE IS NULL)

ORDER BY
    bp.b1_alt_id;

                                   AND bp.b1_per_id3 = li.b1_per_id3

       bp.b1_per_type = 'Common' 
       AND  bp.b1_per_sub_type = 'Inspection'

) 
select * 
from result_data
ORDER BY PAY_DATE DESC;

SELECT
    bp.b1_alt_id,
    bp.serv_prov_code,
    bp.b1_per_id1,
    bp.b1_per_id2,
    bp.b1_per_id3,
    f4.payment_seq_nbr, 
    f4.receipt_nbr,
    f4.payment_method,
    f4.payment_date,
    f4.payment_amount,
    f4.payment_status,
    f4.total_invoice,    
    f4.total_payment,
    f4.rec_ful_nam
   
FROM
         b1permit bp
    INNER JOIN #TMP_Returned_Values li ON bp.serv_prov_code = li.serv_prov_code
                                   AND bp.b1_per_id1 = li.b1_per_id1
                                   AND bp.b1_per_id2 = li.b1_per_id2                                   
                                   AND bp.b1_per_id3 = li.b1_per_id3  
         
     LEFT OUTER JOIN f4payment f4 ON bp.serv_prov_code = f4.serv_prov_code
                                           AND bp.b1_per_id1 = f4.b1_per_id1
                                           AND bp.b1_per_id2 = f4.b1_per_id2                                           
                                           AND bp.b1_per_id3 = f4.b1_per_id3 
                                           
  
WHERE
   bp.b1_per_type = 'Common'
    AND bp.b1_per_sub_type = 'Inspection'
group by
    bp.b1_alt_id,
    bp.serv_prov_code,
    bp.b1_per_id1,
    bp.b1_per_id2,
    bp.b1_per_id3,
    f4.payment_seq_nbr, 
    f4.receipt_nbr,
    f4.payment_method,
    f4.payment_date,
    f4.payment_amount,
    f4.payment_status,
    f4.total_invoice,    
    f4.total_payment,
    f4.rec_ful_nam
)
)
select * INTO #TMP_Payments from Payments;

SELECT 
	li.con_nbr,
	li.charge_num,
    bp.b1_alt_id AS RECORD_ID,
	li.con_typ,

    py.payment_seq_nbr,

    FORMAT(TRY_CAST(py.payment_date AS DATETIME), 'yyyy_MM_dd') AS PAY_DATE,
    py.payment_amount,
    py.payment_status,
    py.total_invoice,    
    py.total_payment,
    py.rec_ful_nam

FROM
         b1permit bp

    LEFT OUTER JOIN #TMP_Payments py ON py.serv_prov_code = bp.serv_prov_code
                                  AND py.b1_per_id1 = bp.b1_per_id1
                                  AND py.b1_per_id2 = bp.b1_per_id2
                                  AND py.b1_per_id3 = bp.b1_per_id3

    INNER JOIN #TMP_Returned_Values li ON bp.serv_prov_code = li.serv_prov_code
                                   AND bp.b1_per_id1 = li.b1_per_id1
                                   AND bp.b1_per_id2 = li.b1_per_id2                                   
                                   AND bp.b1_per_id3 = li.b1_per_id3  
		
WHERE

       AND  bp.b1_per_sub_type = 'Inspection'

from result_data

(

	b6.B1_PER_ID2,

    CONVERT(DATE,ISNULL(b6.b1_con_eff_dd1,'1970-01-01'))  AS con_eff_dd,
	b6.b1_con_comment as con_comment,
    b6.b1_con_long_comment as con_long_comment

FROM
         b6condit b6
    LEFT JOIN gtmpl_attribute     charge ON b6.b1_con_nbr = charge.entity_seq1
                                        AND b6.b1_per_id1 = charge.entity_key1
                                        AND b6.b1_per_id2 = charge.entity_key2
                                        AND b6.b1_per_id3 = charge.entity_key3
                                        AND charge.entity_type = '11'
                                        AND charge.field_name = 'Charge Number'
    LEFT JOIN gtmpl_attribute     reason ON b6.b1_con_nbr = reason.entity_seq1
                                        AND b6.b1_per_id1 = reason.entity_key1
                                        AND b6.b1_per_id2 = reason.entity_key2
                                        AND b6.b1_per_id3 = reason.entity_key3
                                        AND reason.entity_type = '11'
                                        AND reason.field_name = 'Reason'
    LEFT JOIN gtmpl_attribute     pstatus ON b6.b1_con_nbr = pstatus.entity_seq1
                                         AND b6.b1_per_id1 = pstatus.entity_key1
                                         AND b6.b1_per_id2 = pstatus.entity_key2
                                         AND b6.b1_per_id3 = pstatus.entity_key3
                                         AND pstatus.entity_type = '11'
                                         AND pstatus.field_name = 'Payment Status'
    LEFT JOIN gtmpl_attribute     cycstatus ON b6.b1_con_nbr = cycstatus.entity_seq1
                                         AND b6.b1_per_id1 = cycstatus.entity_key1
                                         AND b6.b1_per_id2 = cycstatus.entity_key2
                                         AND b6.b1_per_id3 = cycstatus.entity_key3
                                         AND cycstatus.entity_type = '11'
                                         AND cycstatus.field_name = 'Cycle Number'
WHERE
        b6.b1_con_typ = 'Lien'
    AND b6.serv_prov_code = 'FDNY'

                                  AND ap.b1_per_id3 = bp.b1_per_id3
    LEFT OUTER JOIN balance pd ON pd.serv_prov_code = bp.serv_prov_code

                                  AND pd.b1_per_id2 = bp.b1_per_id2
                                  AND pd.b1_per_id3 = bp.b1_per_id3

WITH Returned_Values AS(
SELECT 
       SERV_PROV_CODE,
       B1_PER_ID1,
	   B1_PER_ID2,
	   B1_PER_ID3,
	   con_typ,
	   con_nbr,
	   charge_num,
	   reason,
	   pay_status,
	   cycle_num,
	   con_iss_dd,
	   con_eff_dd,
	   con_long_comment,
       rec_date,
       Principal,
       PayDate,
       StatusMsg
FROM
(
 SELECT
    b6.SERV_PROV_CODE,
    b6.B1_PER_ID1,
	b6.B1_PER_ID2,
	b6.B1_PER_ID3,
    b6.b1_con_typ AS con_typ,
    RIGHT('000000' + CAST(b6.b1_con_nbr AS VARCHAR(7)), 7) AS con_nbr,
    RIGHT('000000' + CAST(charge.field_value AS VARCHAR(7)), 6) AS charge_num,
    reason.field_value   AS   reason,
    pstatus.field_value   AS  pay_status,
	cycstatus.field_value   AS  cycle_num,
    CONVERT(DATE,ISNULL(b6.b1_con_iss_dd,'1970-01-01')) AS con_iss_dd,
    CONVERT(DATE,ISNULL(b6.b1_con_eff_dd1,'1970-01-01'))  AS con_eff_dd,
	b6.b1_con_comment as con_comment,
    b6.b1_con_long_comment as con_long_comment,
    b6.rec_date,
    -- Principal extraction
    TRY_CAST(
        REPLACE(
            LTRIM(RTRIM(
                CASE 
                    WHEN CHARINDEX('Principal:', cd.b1_con_resolution_action) > 0 
                    THEN SUBSTRING(
                        cd.b1_con_resolution_action + ',',
                        CHARINDEX('Principal:', cd.b1_con_resolution_action) + LEN('Principal:'),
                        CHARINDEX(',', cd.b1_con_resolution_action + ',', CHARINDEX('Principal:', cd.b1_con_resolution_action)) 
                        - (CHARINDEX('Principal:', cd.b1_con_resolution_action) + LEN('Principal:'))
                    )
                END
            )), 
            '$', ''
        ) 
    AS DECIMAL(18,2)) AS Principal,

    -- PayDate extraction
    TRY_CONVERT(
        DATE, 
        LTRIM(RTRIM(
            CASE 
                WHEN CHARINDEX('PayDate:', cd.b1_con_resolution_action) > 0 
                THEN SUBSTRING(
                    cd.b1_con_resolution_action + ',',
                    CHARINDEX('PayDate:', cd.b1_con_resolution_action) + LEN('PayDate:'),
                    CHARINDEX(',', cd.b1_con_resolution_action + ',', CHARINDEX('PayDate:', cd.b1_con_resolution_action)) 
                    - (CHARINDEX('PayDate:', cd.b1_con_resolution_action) + LEN('PayDate:'))
                )
            END
        )), 
        101
    ) AS PayDate,

    LTRIM(RTRIM(
        CASE 
            WHEN CHARINDEX('Status:', cd.b1_con_resolution_action) > 0 
            THEN SUBSTRING(
                cd.b1_con_resolution_action + ',',
                CHARINDEX('Status:', cd.b1_con_resolution_action) + LEN('Status:'),
                CHARINDEX(',', cd.b1_con_resolution_action + ',', CHARINDEX('Status:', cd.b1_con_resolution_action)) 
                - (CHARINDEX('Status:', cd.b1_con_resolution_action) + LEN('Status:'))
            )
        END
    )) AS StatusMsg




FROM
         b6condit b6
    LEFT JOIN gtmpl_attribute     charge ON b6.b1_con_nbr = charge.entity_seq1
                                        AND b6.b1_per_id1 = charge.entity_key1
                                        AND b6.b1_per_id2 = charge.entity_key2
                                        AND b6.b1_per_id3 = charge.entity_key3
                                        AND charge.entity_type = '11'
                                        AND charge.field_name = 'Charge Number'
    LEFT JOIN gtmpl_attribute     reason ON b6.b1_con_nbr = reason.entity_seq1
                                        AND b6.b1_per_id1 = reason.entity_key1
                                        AND b6.b1_per_id2 = reason.entity_key2
                                        AND b6.b1_per_id3 = reason.entity_key3
                                        AND reason.entity_type = '11'
                                        AND reason.field_name = 'Reason'
    LEFT JOIN gtmpl_attribute     pstatus ON b6.b1_con_nbr = pstatus.entity_seq1
                                         AND b6.b1_per_id1 = pstatus.entity_key1
                                         AND b6.b1_per_id2 = pstatus.entity_key2
                                         AND b6.b1_per_id3 = pstatus.entity_key3
                                         AND pstatus.entity_type = '11'
                                         AND pstatus.field_name = 'Payment Status'
    LEFT JOIN gtmpl_attribute     cycstatus ON b6.b1_con_nbr = cycstatus.entity_seq1
                                         AND b6.b1_per_id1 = cycstatus.entity_key1
                                         AND b6.b1_per_id2 = cycstatus.entity_key2
                                         AND b6.b1_per_id3 = cycstatus.entity_key3
                                         AND cycstatus.entity_type = '11'
                                         AND cycstatus.field_name = 'Cycle Number'
    LEFT JOIN b6condit_detail     cd ON b6.b1_con_nbr = cd.b1_con_nbr
                                         AND b6.b1_per_id1 = cd.b1_per_id1
                                         AND b6.b1_per_id2 = cd.b1_per_id2
                                         AND b6.b1_per_id3 = cd.b1_per_id3



WHERE
        b6.b1_con_typ = 'Lien'
    AND b6.serv_prov_code = 'FDNY'
) tr

)
   select * INTO #TMP_Returned_Values from Returned_Values;
--   select * from #TMP_Returned_Values

WITH do_unit AS (
select SERV_PROV_CODE,
       B1_PER_ID1,
	   B1_PER_ID2,
	   B1_PER_ID3,
	   [D.O.] as ACTDO,
	   [Alpha Prefix] as ALPHAPREFIX,
	   [Account Type] as ACTTYPE,
	   [No Fee] as NO_FEE,
	   [No Fee Date] as NO_FEE_DATE,
	   [Application Type] as UNIT 
 from 
(
SELECT
    bc.serv_prov_code AS SERV_PROV_CODE,
    bc.b1_per_id1 AS B1_PER_ID1,
    bc.b1_per_id2 AS B1_PER_ID2,
    bc.b1_per_id3 AS B1_PER_ID3,
    
    bc.b1_checkbox_desc,
    bc.b1_checklist_comment
 FROM
         bchckbox bc
JOIN #TMP_Returned_Values rv ON bc.SERV_PROV_CODE = rv.SERV_PROV_CODE
	AND bc.B1_PER_ID1 = rv.B1_PER_ID1
	AND bc.B1_PER_ID2 = rv.B1_PER_ID2
	AND bc.B1_PER_ID3 = rv.B1_PER_ID3
WHERE
    bc.b1_checkbox_desc IN ( 'Alpha Prefix', 'D.O.','Account Type','Application Type','No Fee','No Fee Date' )
    AND bc.b1_checkbox_type IN ('PLAN INFORMATION', 'PERMIT REPORT INFO','FEE EXEMPTION INFORMATION')
	AND bc.SERV_PROV_CODE = 'FDNY' 
    ) pvia
PIVOT ( MAX(b1_checklist_comment) for b1_checkbox_desc
            IN([D.O.],
			[Alpha Prefix],
			[Account Type],
			[No Fee],
			[No Fee Date],

			[Application Type])) pvib
)
select * INTO #TMP_do_unit from do_unit;

 FROM

 JOIN #TMP_Returned_Values rv ON pd.SERV_PROV_CODE = rv.SERV_PROV_CODE

WITH lien AS (
SELECT 
    serv_prov_code,
	b1_per_id1,
	b1_per_id2,
	b1_per_id3,
	acct_num,
	con_typ,
    con_nbr,
	charge_num,
    reason,
    payment_status,
	cycle_num,
    con_iss_dd,
    con_eff_dd
FROM
(
SELECT
    b6.serv_prov_code,
	b6.b1_per_id1,
	b6.b1_per_id2,
	b6.b1_per_id3,
	bp.b1_alt_id AS acct_num,
    b6.b1_con_typ AS con_typ,
    b6.b1_con_nbr AS con_nbr,
	RIGHT('0' + charge.field_value, 6) charge_num,
    reason.field_value   AS   reason,
    pstatus.field_value   AS  payment_status,
    cycstatus.field_value   AS  cycle_num,
    CONVERT(DATE,ISNULL(b6.b1_con_iss_dd,'1970-01-01')) AS con_iss_dd,
    CONVERT(DATE,ISNULL(b6.b1_con_eff_dd1,'1970-01-01'))  AS con_eff_dd

FROM
         b6condit b6
JOIN #TMP_Returned_Values rv ON b6.SERV_PROV_CODE = rv.SERV_PROV_CODE
	AND b6.B1_PER_ID1 = rv.B1_PER_ID1
	AND b6.B1_PER_ID2 = rv.B1_PER_ID2
	AND b6.B1_PER_ID3 = rv.B1_PER_ID3
JOIN b1permit bp ON b6.SERV_PROV_CODE = bp.SERV_PROV_CODE
	AND b6.B1_PER_ID1 = bp.B1_PER_ID1
	AND b6.B1_PER_ID2 = bp.B1_PER_ID2
	AND b6.B1_PER_ID3 = bp.B1_PER_ID3

    LEFT JOIN gtmpl_attribute     charge ON b6.b1_con_nbr = charge.entity_seq1
                                        AND b6.b1_per_id1 = charge.entity_key1
                                        AND b6.b1_per_id2 = charge.entity_key2
                                        AND b6.b1_per_id3 = charge.entity_key3
                                        AND charge.entity_type = '11'
                                        AND charge.field_name = 'Charge Number'
    LEFT JOIN gtmpl_attribute     reason ON b6.b1_con_nbr = reason.entity_seq1
                                        AND b6.b1_per_id1 = reason.entity_key1
                                        AND b6.b1_per_id2 = reason.entity_key2
                                        AND b6.b1_per_id3 = reason.entity_key3
                                        AND reason.entity_type = '11'
                                        AND reason.field_name = 'Reason'
    LEFT JOIN gtmpl_attribute     pstatus ON b6.b1_con_nbr = pstatus.entity_seq1
                                         AND b6.b1_per_id1 = pstatus.entity_key1
                                         AND b6.b1_per_id2 = pstatus.entity_key2
                                         AND b6.b1_per_id3 = pstatus.entity_key3
                                         AND pstatus.entity_type = '11'
                                         AND pstatus.field_name = 'Payment Status'
    LEFT JOIN gtmpl_attribute     cycstatus ON b6.b1_con_nbr = cycstatus.entity_seq1
                                         AND b6.b1_per_id1 = cycstatus.entity_key1
                                         AND b6.b1_per_id2 = cycstatus.entity_key2
                                         AND b6.b1_per_id3 = cycstatus.entity_key3
                                         AND cycstatus.entity_type = '11'
                                         AND cycstatus.field_name = 'Cycle Number'
WHERE
        b6.b1_con_typ = 'Lien'
    AND b6.rec_status = 'A'
    AND b6.serv_prov_code = 'FDNY'
) tr where charge_num is not null

)
select * INTO #TMP_lien from lien;

	 b.serv_prov_code = 'FDNY'
        ) tr
    WHERE  rn = 1

WITH contact AS (
    SELECT
        serv_prov_code,
        b1_per_id1,
        b1_per_id2,
        b1_per_id3,
        contact_name,
        rec_date,
        b1_contact_type
    FROM
        (
            SELECT
            b.serv_prov_code,
            b.b1_per_id1,
            b.b1_per_id2,
            b.b1_per_id3,
			COALESCE(b.b1_full_name,b.b1_business_name,CONCAT(b1_fname,' ',b1_lname)) as contact_name,
                b.rec_date,
                b.b1_contact_type,
                ROW_NUMBER()
                OVER(PARTITION BY b.serv_prov_code, b.b1_per_id1, b.b1_per_id2, b.b1_per_id3
                     ORDER BY
                         b.rec_date DESC 
                ) rn
            FROM
                b3contact b	
JOIN #TMP_Returned_Values rv ON b.SERV_PROV_CODE = rv.SERV_PROV_CODE
	AND b.B1_PER_ID1 = rv.B1_PER_ID1
	AND b.B1_PER_ID2 = rv.B1_PER_ID2
	AND b.B1_PER_ID3 = rv.B1_PER_ID3

            WHERE
                b.b1_contact_type IN 
				('Billing Contact') 
				AND b.SERV_PROV_CODE = 'FDNY'

        ) tr
    WHERE
        rn = 1
) 
select * INTO #TMP_contact from contact;

WITH APO AS (
select SERV_PROV_CODE,
		B1_PER_ID1,
		B1_PER_ID2,
		B1_PER_ID3,
		[BIN] as BIN,
		[BLOCK] as BLOCK,
		[LOT] as LOT
from 
(
SELECT
    apo.serv_prov_code AS SERV_PROV_CODE,
    apo.b1_per_id1 AS B1_PER_ID1,
	apo.b1_per_id2 AS B1_PER_ID2,
    apo.b1_per_id3 AS B1_PER_ID3,
    apo.b1_attribute_name,
    apo.b1_attribute_value
FROM
	b3apo_attribute apo
JOIN #TMP_Returned_Values rv ON APO.SERV_PROV_CODE = rv.SERV_PROV_CODE
	AND APO.B1_PER_ID1 = rv.B1_PER_ID1
	AND APO.B1_PER_ID2 = rv.B1_PER_ID2
	AND APO.B1_PER_ID3 = rv.B1_PER_ID3

WHERE
    apo.b1_attribute_name IN ( 'BIN', 'BLOCK','LOT' )
    AND apo.b1_apo_type IN ('ADDRESS')
	and apo.serv_prov_code = 'FDNY'
    ) pva
PIVOT ( 
	MAX(b1_attribute_value) 
	for b1_attribute_name
       IN(
			[BIN],
			[BLOCK],
			[LOT]
		) 
	) pvb
)
select * INTO #TMP_APO from APO;
WITH result_data AS (
SELECT 
	RIGHT('0' + du.ACTDO, 2) AS DO,
--    du.ALPHAPREFIX AS APFX, 
    du.ACTTYPE AS ACTTYP, 
    PERMITGRP = CASE 
	WHEN du.ACTTYPE IN ('10', '15', '20', '25') AND du.ACTDO  <> '19'  THEN 'PERMIT' 
	ELSE 
	'NONPERMIT' 
	END ,
	DUEDATE =CASE 
	WHEN du.ACTTYPE IN ('10', '15', '20', '25')  AND du.ACTDO  <> '19' THEN DATEADD(day,455,CONVERT(DATE,li.F4INVOICE_UDF2)) 
	ELSE 
	DATEADD(day,120,CONVERT(DATE,li.F4INVOICE_UDF2)) 
	END,
    du.UNIT,
    bp.b1_alt_id AS RECORD_ID,
--    bp.b1_per_type AS per_type,
--    bp.b1_per_sub_type AS per_sub_type,
--    bp.b1_appl_status AS STATUS, 
--    bp.b1_appl_status_date AS STATUS_DATE,
--    bp.b1_file_dd AS file_date,                    
    cn.contact_name       AS OWNER_NAME,
--    cn.b1_contact_type AS contact_type,
    ba.b1_hse_nbr_alpha_start AS STR_NUM,
    ba.b1_str_name AS STR_NAME,
    ba.b1_situs_city AS STR_CITY,
    ba.b1_situs_state AS STR_STATE,
    ba.b1_situs_zip AS STR_ZIP,
--	ap.BIN,
    ap.BLOCK, 
    ap.LOT,
	bal.balance,
    du.NO_FEE,
    du.NO_FEE_DATE,
--    li.INVOICE_NBR,
--    li.BALANCE_DUE,
--    li.INVOICE_AMOUNT,
    li.F4INVOICE_UDF1 as CYCLE,
    li.F4INVOICE_UDF2 AS CYCLE_CLOCK
--    li.F4INVOICE_UDF3 AS FIRST_DUNNING_DATE,
--    li.F4INVOICE_UDF4 AS FIRST_LIEN_NOTICE_DATE,
--    li.REC_DATE,
--    li.INVOICE_COMMENT 

FROM
         b1permit bp

    LEFT OUTER JOIN #TMP_contact         cn ON cn.serv_prov_code = bp.serv_prov_code
                                  AND cn.b1_per_id1 = bp.b1_per_id1
                                  AND cn.b1_per_id2 = bp.b1_per_id2
                                  AND cn.b1_per_id3 = bp.b1_per_id3
    LEFT OUTER JOIN #TMP_addr ba ON ba.serv_prov_code = bp.serv_prov_code
                                  AND ba.b1_per_id1 = bp.b1_per_id1
                                  AND ba.b1_per_id2 = bp.b1_per_id2
                                  AND ba.b1_per_id3 = bp.b1_per_id3

    INNER JOIN #TMP_APO ap      ON ap.serv_prov_code = bp.serv_prov_code
                                  AND ap.b1_per_id1 = bp.b1_per_id1
                                  AND ap.b1_per_id2 = bp.b1_per_id2
                                  AND ap.b1_per_id3 = bp.b1_per_id3

    INNER JOIN #TMP_do_unit du ON bp.serv_prov_code = du.serv_prov_code
                                   AND bp.b1_per_id1 = du.b1_per_id1
                                   AND bp.b1_per_id2 = du.b1_per_id2                                   
                                   AND bp.b1_per_id3 = du.b1_per_id3  
    INNER JOIN #TMP_balance bal ON bp.serv_prov_code = bal.serv_prov_code
                                   AND bp.b1_per_id1 = bal.b1_per_id1
                                   AND bp.b1_per_id2 = bal.b1_per_id2                                   
                                   AND bp.b1_per_id3 = bal.b1_per_id3  								   
    INNER JOIN #TMP_Returned_Values li ON bp.serv_prov_code = li.serv_prov_code
                                   AND bp.b1_per_id1 = li.b1_per_id1
                                   AND bp.b1_per_id2 = li.b1_per_id2                                   
                                   AND bp.b1_per_id3 = li.b1_per_id3  
		
WHERE

       bp.b1_per_type = 'Common' 
       AND  bp.b1_per_sub_type = 'Inspection'
       AND bp.b1_appl_status <> 'Inactive'
	   AND ISDATE(li.F4INVOICE_UDF2) = 1
	   AND bp.serv_prov_code = 'FDNY'
	   AND (du.NO_FEE <> 'CHECKED' OR du.NO_FEE is null)
--	   AND bp.b1_alt_id = @ACCOUNTId
)
select distinct
	record_id,
	do,
	owner_name,
	str_num,
	str_name,
	str_city,
	str_state,
	str_zip,
	block,
	lot,
	balance,
	acttyp,
	cycle,
	cycle_clock

INTO #TMP_result_data from result_data
WHERE
   PERMITGRP = 'PERMIT'
   AND DO NOT IN ('25','33')
   AND try_convert(DATE,DUEDATE)  <= DATEADD(day,10,GETDATE())
   AND NOT exists 
   (
   select * 
   from #TMP_lien 
   WHERE 
     acct_num = RECORD_ID and CYCLE = ISNULL(CYCLE_NUM,'0000000-00')
	);

WITH lien AS (
SELECT 
    serv_prov_code,
	b1_per_id1,
	b1_per_id2,
	b1_per_id3,
	acct_num,
	con_typ,
    con_nbr,
	charge_num,
    reason,
    payment_status,
	cycle_num,
    con_iss_dd,
    con_eff_dd
FROM
(
SELECT
    b6.serv_prov_code,
	b6.b1_per_id1,
	b6.b1_per_id2,
	b6.b1_per_id3,
	bp.b1_alt_id AS acct_num,
    b6.b1_con_typ AS con_typ,
    b6.b1_con_nbr AS con_nbr,
	RIGHT('0' + charge.field_value, 6) charge_num,
    reason.field_value   AS   reason,
    pstatus.field_value   AS  payment_status,
    cycstatus.field_value   AS  cycle_num,
    CONVERT(DATE,ISNULL(b6.b1_con_iss_dd,'1970-01-01')) AS con_iss_dd,
    CONVERT(DATE,ISNULL(b6.b1_con_eff_dd1,'1970-01-01'))  AS con_eff_dd

	AND b6.B1_PER_ID1 = rv.B1_PER_ID1
	AND b6.B1_PER_ID2 = rv.B1_PER_ID2
	AND b6.B1_PER_ID3 = rv.B1_PER_ID3
JOIN b1permit bp ON b6.SERV_PROV_CODE = bp.SERV_PROV_CODE
	AND b6.B1_PER_ID1 = bp.B1_PER_ID1
	AND b6.B1_PER_ID2 = bp.B1_PER_ID2
	AND b6.B1_PER_ID3 = bp.B1_PER_ID3

    LEFT JOIN gtmpl_attribute     charge ON b6.b1_con_nbr = charge.entity_seq1
                                        AND b6.b1_per_id1 = charge.entity_key1
                                        AND b6.b1_per_id2 = charge.entity_key2
                                        AND b6.b1_per_id3 = charge.entity_key3
                                        AND charge.entity_type = '11'
                                        AND charge.field_name = 'Charge Number'
    LEFT JOIN gtmpl_attribute     reason ON b6.b1_con_nbr = reason.entity_seq1
                                        AND b6.b1_per_id1 = reason.entity_key1
                                        AND b6.b1_per_id2 = reason.entity_key2
                                        AND b6.b1_per_id3 = reason.entity_key3
                                        AND reason.entity_type = '11'
                                        AND reason.field_name = 'Reason'
    LEFT JOIN gtmpl_attribute     pstatus ON b6.b1_con_nbr = pstatus.entity_seq1
                                         AND b6.b1_per_id1 = pstatus.entity_key1
                                         AND b6.b1_per_id2 = pstatus.entity_key2
                                         AND b6.b1_per_id3 = pstatus.entity_key3
                                         AND pstatus.entity_type = '11'
                                         AND pstatus.field_name = 'Payment Status'
    LEFT JOIN gtmpl_attribute     cycstatus ON b6.b1_con_nbr = cycstatus.entity_seq1
                                         AND b6.b1_per_id1 = cycstatus.entity_key1
                                         AND b6.b1_per_id2 = cycstatus.entity_key2
                                         AND b6.b1_per_id3 = cycstatus.entity_key3
                                         AND cycstatus.entity_type = '11'
                                         AND cycstatus.field_name = 'Cycle Number'
WHERE
        b6.b1_con_typ = 'Lien'
    AND b6.rec_status = 'A'
    AND b6.serv_prov_code = 'FDNY'
) tr where charge_num is not null

)

WITH contact AS (

        serv_prov_code,
        b1_per_id1,
        b1_per_id2,
        b1_per_id3,
        contact_name,
        rec_date,
        b1_contact_type
    FROM
        (

            b.serv_prov_code,

            b.b1_per_id2,
            b.b1_per_id3,
			COALESCE(b.b1_full_name,b.b1_business_name,CONCAT(b1_fname,' ',b1_lname)) as contact_name,
                b.rec_date,
                b.b1_contact_type,
                ROW_NUMBER()
                OVER(PARTITION BY b.serv_prov_code, b.b1_per_id1, b.b1_per_id2, b.b1_per_id3
                     ORDER BY
                         b.rec_date DESC

	AND b.B1_PER_ID3 = rv.B1_PER_ID3

            WHERE
                b.b1_contact_type IN 
				('Billing Contact') 
				AND b.SERV_PROV_CODE = 'FDNY'

WITH APO AS (
select SERV_PROV_CODE,
		B1_PER_ID1,
		B1_PER_ID2,
		B1_PER_ID3,
		[BIN] as BIN,
		[BLOCK] as BLOCK,
		[LOT] as LOT
from 
(
SELECT
    apo.serv_prov_code AS SERV_PROV_CODE,
    apo.b1_per_id1 AS B1_PER_ID1,
	apo.b1_per_id2 AS B1_PER_ID2,
    apo.b1_per_id3 AS B1_PER_ID3,
    apo.b1_attribute_name,
    apo.b1_attribute_value
FROM
	b3apo_attribute apo
JOIN #TMP_Returned_Values2 rv ON APO.SERV_PROV_CODE = rv.SERV_PROV_CODE
	AND APO.B1_PER_ID1 = rv.B1_PER_ID1
	AND APO.B1_PER_ID2 = rv.B1_PER_ID2
	AND APO.B1_PER_ID3 = rv.B1_PER_ID3

WHERE
    apo.b1_attribute_name IN ( 'BIN', 'BLOCK','LOT' )
    AND apo.b1_apo_type IN ('ADDRESS')
	AND apo.serv_prov_code = 'FDNY'
    ) pva
PIVOT ( 
	MAX(b1_attribute_value) 
	for b1_attribute_name
       IN(
			[BIN],
			[BLOCK],
			[LOT]
		) 
	) pvb
)
select * INTO #TMP_APO2 from APO;
WITH result_data2 AS (
SELECT 
	RIGHT('0' + du.ACTDO, 2) AS DO,
--    du.ALPHAPREFIX AS APFX, 
    du.ACTTYPE AS ACTTYP, 
    PERMITGRP = CASE 
	WHEN du.ACTTYPE IN ('10', '15', '20', '25') AND du.ACTDO  <> '19'  THEN 'PERMIT' 
	ELSE 
	'NONPERMIT' 
	END ,
	DUEDATE =CASE 
	WHEN du.ACTTYPE IN ('10', '15', '20', '25')  AND du.ACTDO  <> '19' THEN DATEADD(day,455,CONVERT(DATE,li.F4INVOICE_UDF2)) 
	ELSE 
	DATEADD(day,120,CONVERT(DATE,li.F4INVOICE_UDF2)) 
	END,
    du.UNIT,
    bp.b1_alt_id AS RECORD_ID,
--    bp.b1_per_type AS per_type,
--    bp.b1_per_sub_type AS per_sub_type,
--    bp.b1_appl_status AS STATUS, 
--    bp.b1_appl_status_date AS STATUS_DATE,
--    bp.b1_file_dd AS file_date,                    
    cn.contact_name       AS OWNER_NAME,
--    cn.b1_contact_type AS contact_type,
    ba.b1_hse_nbr_alpha_start AS STR_NUM,
    ba.b1_str_name AS STR_NAME,
    ba.b1_situs_city AS STR_CITY,
    ba.b1_situs_state AS STR_STATE,
    ba.b1_situs_zip AS STR_ZIP,
--	ap.BIN,
    ap.BLOCK, 
    ap.LOT,
	bal.balance,
    du.NO_FEE,
    du.NO_FEE_DATE,
--    li.INVOICE_NBR,
--    li.BALANCE_DUE,
--    li.INVOICE_AMOUNT,
    li.F4INVOICE_UDF1 as CYCLE,
    li.F4INVOICE_UDF2 AS CYCLE_CLOCK
--    li.F4INVOICE_UDF3 AS FIRST_DUNNING_DATE,
--    li.F4INVOICE_UDF4 AS FIRST_LIEN_NOTICE_DATE,
--    li.REC_DATE,
--    li.INVOICE_COMMENT 

FROM
         b1permit bp

    LEFT OUTER JOIN #TMP_contact2         cn ON cn.serv_prov_code = bp.serv_prov_code
                                  AND cn.b1_per_id1 = bp.b1_per_id1
                                  AND cn.b1_per_id2 = bp.b1_per_id2
                                  AND cn.b1_per_id3 = bp.b1_per_id3
    LEFT OUTER JOIN #TMP_addr2 ba ON ba.serv_prov_code = bp.serv_prov_code
                                  AND ba.b1_per_id1 = bp.b1_per_id1
                                  AND ba.b1_per_id2 = bp.b1_per_id2
                                  AND ba.b1_per_id3 = bp.b1_per_id3

    INNER JOIN #TMP_APO2 ap      ON ap.serv_prov_code = bp.serv_prov_code
                                  AND ap.b1_per_id1 = bp.b1_per_id1
                                  AND ap.b1_per_id2 = bp.b1_per_id2
                                  AND ap.b1_per_id3 = bp.b1_per_id3

    INNER JOIN #TMP_do_unit2 du ON bp.serv_prov_code = du.serv_prov_code
                                   AND bp.b1_per_id1 = du.b1_per_id1
                                   AND bp.b1_per_id2 = du.b1_per_id2                                   
                                   AND bp.b1_per_id3 = du.b1_per_id3   
    INNER JOIN #TMP_balance2 bal ON bp.serv_prov_code = bal.serv_prov_code
                                   AND bp.b1_per_id1 = bal.b1_per_id1
                                   AND bp.b1_per_id2 = bal.b1_per_id2                                   
                                   AND bp.b1_per_id3 = bal.b1_per_id3 
    INNER JOIN #TMP_Returned_Values2 li ON bp.serv_prov_code = li.serv_prov_code
                                   AND bp.b1_per_id1 = li.b1_per_id1
                                   AND bp.b1_per_id2 = li.b1_per_id2                                   
                                   AND bp.b1_per_id3 = li.b1_per_id3  
		
WHERE

       bp.b1_per_type = 'Common' 
       AND  bp.b1_per_sub_type = 'Inspection'
       AND bp.b1_appl_status <> 'Inactive'
	   AND ISDATE(li.F4INVOICE_UDF2) = 1
	   and bp.serv_prov_code = 'FDNY'
	   AND (du.NO_FEE <> 'CHECKED' OR du.NO_FEE is null)
--	   AND bp.b1_alt_id = @ACCOUNTID
) 
select distinct
	record_id,
	do,
	owner_name,
	str_num,
	str_name,
	str_city,
	str_state,
	str_zip,
	block,
	lot,
	balance,
	acttyp,
	cycle,
	cycle_clock
INTO #TMP_result_data2 from result_data2
WHERE
   PERMITGRP = 'NONPERMIT'
   AND DO NOT IN ('25','33')
   AND try_convert(DATE,DUEDATE)  <= DATEADD(day,10,GETDATE())
   AND NOT exists 
   (
   select * 
   from #TMP_lien2 
   WHERE 
     acct_num = RECORD_ID and CYCLE = ISNULL(CYCLE_NUM,'0000000-00')
	);
WITH all_data as (
select * FROM #TMP_result_data
 UNION
select * FROM #TMP_result_data2
)
select * from all_data order by owner_name, record_id;

WITH Returned_Values AS(
SELECT *
FROM
(
SELECT
   x.SERV_PROV_CODE,
   X.B1_PER_ID1,
   X.B1_PER_ID2,
   X.B1_PER_ID3,   
   F.INVOICE_NBR,
   F.BALANCE_DUE,
   F.INVOICE_AMOUNT,
   F.F4INVOICE_UDF1,
   F.F4INVOICE_UDF2,
   F.F4INVOICE_UDF3,
   F.F4INVOICE_UDF4,
   F.REC_DATE,
   F.INVOICE_COMMENT 
FROM
   F4INVOICE F 
   INNER JOIN
      X4FEEITEM_INVOICE X 
      ON X.INVOICE_NBR = F.INVOICE_NBR 
WHERE
       F.BALANCE_DUE > 0 
   AND F.F4INVOICE_UDF1 IS NOT NULL 
   AND F.F4INVOICE_UDF2 IS NOT NULL 
   AND F.F4INVOICE_UDF3 IS NOT NULL 
   AND 
(F.INVOICE_COMMENT LIKE CONCAT('%""%','secondReminder','""',':true','%')
      AND F.INVOICE_COMMENT NOT LIKE CONCAT('%""%','doNotProcess','""',':true','%')
      AND F.INVOICE_COMMENT NOT LIKE CONCAT('%""%','lienAdded','""',':true','%')
	  AND F.INVOICE_COMMENT LIKE CONCAT('%""%','secondPenAdded','""',':true','%')
   )
   AND F.SERV_PROV_CODE = 'FDNY' 
   AND ISDATE(F.F4INVOICE_UDF2) = 1
   AND DATEADD(day,455,try_convert(DATE,F.F4INVOICE_UDF2)) <= DATEADD(day,10,GETDATE())
GROUP BY
   x.SERV_PROV_CODE,
   X.B1_PER_ID1,
   X.B1_PER_ID2,
   X.B1_PER_ID3,   
   F.INVOICE_NBR,
   F.BALANCE_DUE,
   F.INVOICE_AMOUNT,
   F.F4INVOICE_UDF1,
   F.F4INVOICE_UDF2,
   F.F4INVOICE_UDF3,
   F.F4INVOICE_UDF4,
   F.REC_DATE,
   F.INVOICE_COMMENT 
   ) TR
--   WHERE
--           try_convert(DATE,F4INVOICE_UDF2)  <= GETDATE()
) 
   select * INTO #TMP_Returned_Values from Returned_Values;
-- select * from Returned_Values

	AND bc.B1_PER_ID2 = rv.B1_PER_ID2
	AND bc.B1_PER_ID3 = rv.B1_PER_ID3

PIVOT ( MAX(b1_checklist_comment) for b1_checkbox_desc
            IN([D.O.],

			[Account Type],
			[No Fee],
			[No Fee Date],

			[Application Type])) pvib
)

WHERE
        b6.b1_con_typ = 'Lien'
    AND b6.rec_status = 'A'
    AND b6.serv_prov_code = 'FDNY'
) tr where charge_num is not null

)

--select * from contact
WITH APO AS (
select SERV_PROV_CODE,
		B1_PER_ID1,
		B1_PER_ID2,
		B1_PER_ID3,
		[BIN] as BIN,
		[BLOCK] as BLOCK,
		[LOT] as LOT
from 
(
SELECT
    apo.serv_prov_code AS SERV_PROV_CODE,
    apo.b1_per_id1 AS B1_PER_ID1,
	apo.b1_per_id2 AS B1_PER_ID2,
    apo.b1_per_id3 AS B1_PER_ID3,
    apo.b1_attribute_name,
    apo.b1_attribute_value
FROM
	b3apo_attribute apo
JOIN #TMP_Returned_Values rv ON APO.SERV_PROV_CODE = rv.SERV_PROV_CODE
	AND APO.B1_PER_ID1 = rv.B1_PER_ID1
	AND APO.B1_PER_ID2 = rv.B1_PER_ID2
	AND APO.B1_PER_ID3 = rv.B1_PER_ID3

WHERE
    apo.b1_attribute_name IN ( 'BIN', 'BLOCK','LOT' )
    AND apo.b1_apo_type IN ('ADDRESS')
	and apo.serv_prov_code = 'FDNY'
    ) pva
PIVOT ( 
	MAX(b1_attribute_value) 
	for b1_attribute_name
       IN(
			[BIN],
			[BLOCK],
			[LOT]
		) 
	) pvb
)
select * INTO #TMP_APO from APO;
WITH result_data AS (
SELECT 
	RIGHT('0' + du.ACTDO, 2) AS DO,
--    du.ALPHAPREFIX AS APFX, 
    du.ACTTYPE AS ACTTYP, 
    PERMITGRP = CASE 
	WHEN du.ACTTYPE IN ('10', '15', '20', '25') AND du.ACTDO  <> '19'  THEN 'PERMIT' 
	ELSE 
	'NONPERMIT' 
	END ,
	DUEDATE =CASE 
	WHEN du.ACTTYPE IN ('10', '15', '20', '25')  AND du.ACTDO  <> '19' THEN DATEADD(day,455,CONVERT(DATE,li.F4INVOICE_UDF2)) 
	ELSE 
	DATEADD(day,120,CONVERT(DATE,li.F4INVOICE_UDF2)) 
	END,
    du.UNIT,
    bp.b1_alt_id AS RECORD_ID,
--    bp.b1_per_type AS per_type,
--    bp.b1_per_sub_type AS per_sub_type,
--    bp.b1_appl_status AS STATUS, 
--    bp.b1_appl_status_date AS STATUS_DATE,
--    bp.b1_file_dd AS file_date,                    
    cn.contact_name       AS OWNER_NAME,
--    cn.b1_contact_type AS contact_type,
    ba.b1_hse_nbr_alpha_start AS STR_NUM,
    ba.b1_str_name AS STR_NAME,
    ba.b1_situs_city AS STR_CITY,
    ba.b1_situs_state AS STR_STATE,
    ba.b1_situs_zip AS STR_ZIP,
--	ap.BIN,
    ap.BLOCK, 
    ap.LOT,
	bal.balance,
    du.NO_FEE,
    du.NO_FEE_DATE,
--    li.INVOICE_NBR,
--    li.BALANCE_DUE,
--    li.INVOICE_AMOUNT,
    li.F4INVOICE_UDF1 as CYCLE,
    li.F4INVOICE_UDF2 AS CYCLE_CLOCK
--    li.F4INVOICE_UDF3 AS FIRST_DUNNING_DATE,
--    li.F4INVOICE_UDF4 AS FIRST_LIEN_NOTICE_DATE,
--    li.REC_DATE,
--    li.INVOICE_COMMENT 

FROM
         b1permit bp

    LEFT OUTER JOIN #TMP_contact         cn ON cn.serv_prov_code = bp.serv_prov_code
                                  AND cn.b1_per_id1 = bp.b1_per_id1
                                  AND cn.b1_per_id2 = bp.b1_per_id2
                                  AND cn.b1_per_id3 = bp.b1_per_id3
    LEFT OUTER JOIN #TMP_addr ba ON ba.serv_prov_code = bp.serv_prov_code
                                  AND ba.b1_per_id1 = bp.b1_per_id1
                                  AND ba.b1_per_id2 = bp.b1_per_id2
                                  AND ba.b1_per_id3 = bp.b1_per_id3

    INNER JOIN #TMP_APO ap      ON ap.serv_prov_code = bp.serv_prov_code
                                  AND ap.b1_per_id1 = bp.b1_per_id1
                                  AND ap.b1_per_id2 = bp.b1_per_id2
                                  AND ap.b1_per_id3 = bp.b1_per_id3

    INNER JOIN #TMP_do_unit du ON bp.serv_prov_code = du.serv_prov_code
                                   AND bp.b1_per_id1 = du.b1_per_id1
                                   AND bp.b1_per_id2 = du.b1_per_id2                                   
                                   AND bp.b1_per_id3 = du.b1_per_id3  
    INNER JOIN #TMP_balance bal ON bp.serv_prov_code = bal.serv_prov_code
                                   AND bp.b1_per_id1 = bal.b1_per_id1
                                   AND bp.b1_per_id2 = bal.b1_per_id2                                   
                                   AND bp.b1_per_id3 = bal.b1_per_id3  								   
    INNER JOIN #TMP_Returned_Values li ON bp.serv_prov_code = li.serv_prov_code
                                   AND bp.b1_per_id1 = li.b1_per_id1
                                   AND bp.b1_per_id2 = li.b1_per_id2                                   
                                   AND bp.b1_per_id3 = li.b1_per_id3  
		
WHERE

       bp.b1_per_type = 'Common' 
       AND  bp.b1_per_sub_type = 'Inspection'
       AND bp.b1_appl_status <> 'Inactive'
	   AND ISDATE(li.F4INVOICE_UDF2) = 1
	   AND bp.serv_prov_code = 'FDNY'
	   AND (du.NO_FEE <> 'CHECKED' OR du.NO_FEE is null)
--	   AND bp.b1_alt_id = @ACCOUNTId
)
select distinct
	record_id,
	do,
	owner_name,
	str_num,
	str_name,
	str_city,
	str_state,
	str_zip,
	block,
	lot,
	balance,
	acttyp,
	cycle,
	cycle_clock

INTO #TMP_result_data from result_data
WHERE
   PERMITGRP = 'PERMIT'
   AND DO NOT IN ('25','33')
   AND try_convert(DATE,DUEDATE)  <= DATEADD(day,10,GETDATE())
   AND NOT exists 
   (
   select * 
   from #TMP_lien 
   WHERE 
     acct_num = RECORD_ID and CYCLE = ISNULL(CYCLE_NUM,'0000000-00')
	);

WITH Returned_Values AS(
SELECT *
FROM
(
SELECT
   x.SERV_PROV_CODE,
   X.B1_PER_ID1,
   X.B1_PER_ID2,
   X.B1_PER_ID3,   
   F.INVOICE_NBR,
   F.BALANCE_DUE,
   F.INVOICE_AMOUNT,
   F.F4INVOICE_UDF1,
   F.F4INVOICE_UDF2,
   F.F4INVOICE_UDF3,
   F.F4INVOICE_UDF4,
   F.REC_DATE,
   F.INVOICE_COMMENT 
FROM
   F4INVOICE F 
   INNER JOIN
      X4FEEITEM_INVOICE X 
      ON X.INVOICE_NBR = F.INVOICE_NBR 
WHERE
       F.BALANCE_DUE > 0 
   AND F.F4INVOICE_UDF1 IS NOT NULL 
   AND F.F4INVOICE_UDF2 IS NOT NULL 
   AND F.F4INVOICE_UDF3 IS NOT NULL 
   AND 
(F.INVOICE_COMMENT LIKE CONCAT('%""%','secondReminder','""',':true','%')
      AND F.INVOICE_COMMENT NOT LIKE CONCAT('%""%','doNotProcess','""',':true','%')
      AND F.INVOICE_COMMENT NOT LIKE CONCAT('%""%','lienAdded','""',':true','%')
--	  AND F.INVOICE_COMMENT LIKE CONCAT('%""%','secondPenAdded','""',':true','%')
   )
   AND F.SERV_PROV_CODE = 'FDNY' 
   AND ISDATE(F.F4INVOICE_UDF2) = 1
   AND DATEADD(day,120,try_convert(DATE,F.F4INVOICE_UDF2)) <= DATEADD(day,10,GETDATE())
GROUP BY
   x.SERV_PROV_CODE,
   X.B1_PER_ID1,
   X.B1_PER_ID2,
   X.B1_PER_ID3,   
   F.INVOICE_NBR,
   F.BALANCE_DUE,
   F.INVOICE_AMOUNT,
   F.F4INVOICE_UDF1,
   F.F4INVOICE_UDF2,
   F.F4INVOICE_UDF3,
   F.F4INVOICE_UDF4,
   F.REC_DATE,
   F.INVOICE_COMMENT 
   ) TR
--   WHERE
--           try_convert(DATE,F4INVOICE_UDF2)  <= GETDATE()
) 
   select * INTO #TMP_Returned_Values2 from Returned_Values;
-- select * from Returned_Values

WITH do_unit AS (
select SERV_PROV_CODE,
       B1_PER_ID1,
	   B1_PER_ID2,
	   B1_PER_ID3,
	   [D.O.] as ACTDO,
	   [Alpha Prefix] as ALPHAPREFIX,
	   [Account Type] as ACTTYPE,
	   [No Fee] as NO_FEE,
	   [No Fee Date] as NO_FEE_DATE,
	   [Application Type] as UNIT 
 from 
(
SELECT
    bc.serv_prov_code AS SERV_PROV_CODE,
    bc.b1_per_id1 AS B1_PER_ID1,
    bc.b1_per_id2 AS B1_PER_ID2,
    bc.b1_per_id3 AS B1_PER_ID3,
    
    bc.b1_checkbox_desc,
    bc.b1_checklist_comment
 FROM
         bchckbox bc
JOIN #TMP_Returned_Values2 rv ON bc.SERV_PROV_CODE = rv.SERV_PROV_CODE
	AND bc.B1_PER_ID1 = rv.B1_PER_ID1
	AND bc.B1_PER_ID2 = rv.B1_PER_ID2
	AND bc.B1_PER_ID3 = rv.B1_PER_ID3
WHERE
    bc.b1_checkbox_desc IN ( 'Alpha Prefix', 'D.O.','Account Type','Application Type','No Fee','No Fee Date' )
    AND bc.b1_checkbox_type IN ('PLAN INFORMATION', 'PERMIT REPORT INFO','FEE EXEMPTION INFORMATION')
	AND bC.serv_prov_code = 'FDNY'
    ) pvia
PIVOT ( MAX(b1_checklist_comment) for b1_checkbox_desc
            IN([D.O.],
			[Alpha Prefix],
			[Account Type],
			[No Fee],
			[No Fee Date],

			[Application Type])) pvib
)
   select * INTO #TMP_do_unit2 from do_unit;
WITH balance AS (
	SELECT
    pd.serv_prov_code AS SERV_PROV_CODE,
    pd.b1_per_id1 AS B1_PER_ID1,
    pd.b1_per_id2 AS B1_PER_ID2,
    pd.b1_per_id3 AS B1_PER_ID3,
    pd.balance
 FROM
         bpermit_detail pd
 JOIN #TMP_Returned_Values2 rv ON pd.SERV_PROV_CODE = rv.SERV_PROV_CODE
	AND pd.B1_PER_ID1 = rv.B1_PER_ID1
	AND pd.B1_PER_ID2 = rv.B1_PER_ID2
	AND pd.B1_PER_ID3 = rv.B1_PER_ID3
WHERE 1=1
	AND pd.SERV_PROV_CODE = 'FDNY' 
)
select * INTO #TMP_balance2 from balance;
WITH lien AS (
SELECT 
    serv_prov_code,
	b1_per_id1,
	b1_per_id2,
	b1_per_id3,
	acct_num,
	con_typ,
    con_nbr,
	charge_num,
    reason,
    payment_status,
	cycle_num,
    con_iss_dd,
    con_eff_dd
FROM
(
SELECT
    b6.serv_prov_code,
	b6.b1_per_id1,
	b6.b1_per_id2,
	b6.b1_per_id3,
	bp.b1_alt_id AS acct_num,
    b6.b1_con_typ AS con_typ,
    b6.b1_con_nbr AS con_nbr,
	RIGHT('0' + charge.field_value, 6) charge_num,
    reason.field_value   AS   reason,
    pstatus.field_value   AS  payment_status,
    cycstatus.field_value   AS  cycle_num,
    CONVERT(DATE,ISNULL(b6.b1_con_iss_dd,'1970-01-01')) AS con_iss_dd,
    CONVERT(DATE,ISNULL(b6.b1_con_eff_dd1,'1970-01-01'))  AS con_eff_dd

FROM
         b6condit b6
JOIN #TMP_Returned_Values2 rv ON b6.SERV_PROV_CODE = rv.SERV_PROV_CODE
	AND b6.B1_PER_ID1 = rv.B1_PER_ID1
	AND b6.B1_PER_ID2 = rv.B1_PER_ID2
	AND b6.B1_PER_ID3 = rv.B1_PER_ID3
JOIN b1permit bp ON b6.SERV_PROV_CODE = bp.SERV_PROV_CODE
	AND b6.B1_PER_ID1 = bp.B1_PER_ID1
	AND b6.B1_PER_ID2 = bp.B1_PER_ID2
	AND b6.B1_PER_ID3 = bp.B1_PER_ID3

    LEFT JOIN gtmpl_attribute     charge ON b6.b1_con_nbr = charge.entity_seq1
                                        AND b6.b1_per_id1 = charge.entity_key1
                                        AND b6.b1_per_id2 = charge.entity_key2
                                        AND b6.b1_per_id3 = charge.entity_key3
                                        AND charge.entity_type = '11'
                                        AND charge.field_name = 'Charge Number'
    LEFT JOIN gtmpl_attribute     reason ON b6.b1_con_nbr = reason.entity_seq1
                                        AND b6.b1_per_id1 = reason.entity_key1
                                        AND b6.b1_per_id2 = reason.entity_key2
                                        AND b6.b1_per_id3 = reason.entity_key3
                                        AND reason.entity_type = '11'
                                        AND reason.field_name = 'Reason'
    LEFT JOIN gtmpl_attribute     pstatus ON b6.b1_con_nbr = pstatus.entity_seq1
                                         AND b6.b1_per_id1 = pstatus.entity_key1
                                         AND b6.b1_per_id2 = pstatus.entity_key2
                                         AND b6.b1_per_id3 = pstatus.entity_key3
                                         AND pstatus.entity_type = '11'
                                         AND pstatus.field_name = 'Payment Status'
    LEFT JOIN gtmpl_attribute     cycstatus ON b6.b1_con_nbr = cycstatus.entity_seq1
                                         AND b6.b1_per_id1 = cycstatus.entity_key1
                                         AND b6.b1_per_id2 = cycstatus.entity_key2
                                         AND b6.b1_per_id3 = cycstatus.entity_key3
                                         AND cycstatus.entity_type = '11'
                                         AND cycstatus.field_name = 'Cycle Number'
WHERE
        b6.b1_con_typ = 'Lien'
    AND b6.rec_status = 'A'
    AND b6.serv_prov_code = 'FDNY'
) tr where charge_num is not null

)
select * INTO #TMP_lien2 from lien;

    LEFT OUTER JOIN #TMP_contact2         cn ON cn.serv_prov_code = bp.serv_prov_code
                                  AND cn.b1_per_id1 = bp.b1_per_id1
                                  AND cn.b1_per_id2 = bp.b1_per_id2
                                  AND cn.b1_per_id3 = bp.b1_per_id3
    LEFT OUTER JOIN #TMP_addr2 ba ON ba.serv_prov_code = bp.serv_prov_code
                                  AND ba.b1_per_id1 = bp.b1_per_id1
                                  AND ba.b1_per_id2 = bp.b1_per_id2
                                  AND ba.b1_per_id3 = bp.b1_per_id3

    INNER JOIN #TMP_APO2 ap      ON ap.serv_prov_code = bp.serv_prov_code
                                  AND ap.b1_per_id1 = bp.b1_per_id1
                                  AND ap.b1_per_id2 = bp.b1_per_id2
                                  AND ap.b1_per_id3 = bp.b1_per_id3

    INNER JOIN #TMP_do_unit2 du ON bp.serv_prov_code = du.serv_prov_code
                                   AND bp.b1_per_id1 = du.b1_per_id1
                                   AND bp.b1_per_id2 = du.b1_per_id2                                   
                                   AND bp.b1_per_id3 = du.b1_per_id3   
    INNER JOIN #TMP_balance2 bal ON bp.serv_prov_code = bal.serv_prov_code
                                   AND bp.b1_per_id1 = bal.b1_per_id1
                                   AND bp.b1_per_id2 = bal.b1_per_id2                                   
                                   AND bp.b1_per_id3 = bal.b1_per_id3 
    INNER JOIN #TMP_Returned_Values2 li ON bp.serv_prov_code = li.serv_prov_code
                                   AND bp.b1_per_id1 = li.b1_per_id1
                                   AND bp.b1_per_id2 = li.b1_per_id2                                   
                                   AND bp.b1_per_id3 = li.b1_per_id3  
		
WHERE

       bp.b1_per_type = 'Common' 
       AND  bp.b1_per_sub_type = 'Inspection'
       AND bp.b1_appl_status <> 'Inactive'
	   AND ISDATE(li.F4INVOICE_UDF2) = 1
	   and bp.serv_prov_code = 'FDNY'
	   AND (du.NO_FEE <> 'CHECKED' OR du.NO_FEE is null)
--	   AND bp.b1_alt_id = @ACCOUNTID
) 
select distinct
	record_id,
	do,
	owner_name,
	str_num,
	str_name,
	str_city,
	str_state,
	str_zip,
	block,
	lot,
	balance,
	acttyp,
	cycle,
	cycle_clock
INTO #TMP_result_data2 from result_data2
WHERE
   PERMITGRP = 'NONPERMIT'
   AND DO NOT IN ('25','33')
   AND try_convert(DATE,DUEDATE)  <= DATEADD(day,10,GETDATE())
   AND NOT exists 
   (
   select * 
   from #TMP_lien2 
   WHERE 
     acct_num = RECORD_ID and CYCLE = ISNULL(CYCLE_NUM,'0000000-00')
	);
WITH all_data as (
select * FROM #TMP_result_data
 UNION
select * FROM #TMP_result_data2
)
select * from all_data order by owner_name, record_id;

WITH Returned_Values AS(
SELECT *
FROM
(
SELECT
   x.SERV_PROV_CODE,
   X.B1_PER_ID1,
   X.B1_PER_ID2,
   X.B1_PER_ID3,   
   F.INVOICE_NBR,
   F.BALANCE_DUE,
   F.INVOICE_AMOUNT,
   F.F4INVOICE_UDF1,
   F.F4INVOICE_UDF2,
   F.F4INVOICE_UDF3,
   F.F4INVOICE_UDF4,
   F.REC_DATE,
   F.INVOICE_COMMENT 
FROM
   F4INVOICE F 
   INNER JOIN
      X4FEEITEM_INVOICE X 
      ON X.INVOICE_NBR = F.INVOICE_NBR 
WHERE
       F.BALANCE_DUE > 0 
   AND F.F4INVOICE_UDF1 IS NOT NULL 
   AND F.F4INVOICE_UDF2 IS NOT NULL 
   AND F.F4INVOICE_UDF3 IS NOT NULL 
   AND 
(F.INVOICE_COMMENT LIKE CONCAT('%""%','secondReminder','""',':true','%')
      AND F.INVOICE_COMMENT NOT LIKE CONCAT('%""%','doNotProcess','""',':true','%')
      AND F.INVOICE_COMMENT NOT LIKE CONCAT('%""%','lienAdded','""',':true','%')
	  AND F.INVOICE_COMMENT LIKE CONCAT('%""%','secondPenAdded','""',':true','%')
   )
   AND F.SERV_PROV_CODE = 'FDNY' 
   AND ISDATE(F.F4INVOICE_UDF2) = 1
   AND DATEADD(day,455,try_convert(DATE,F.F4INVOICE_UDF2)) <= DATEADD(day,10,GETDATE())
GROUP BY
   x.SERV_PROV_CODE,
   X.B1_PER_ID1,
   X.B1_PER_ID2,
   X.B1_PER_ID3,   
   F.INVOICE_NBR,
   F.BALANCE_DUE,
   F.INVOICE_AMOUNT,
   F.F4INVOICE_UDF1,
   F.F4INVOICE_UDF2,
   F.F4INVOICE_UDF3,
   F.F4INVOICE_UDF4,
   F.REC_DATE,
   F.INVOICE_COMMENT 
   ) TR
--   WHERE
--           try_convert(DATE,F4INVOICE_UDF2)  <= GETDATE()
) 
   select * INTO #TMP_Returned_Values from Returned_Values;

WITH do_unit AS (
select SERV_PROV_CODE,
       B1_PER_ID1,
	   B1_PER_ID2,
	   B1_PER_ID3,
	   [D.O.] as ACTDO,
	   [Alpha Prefix] as ALPHAPREFIX,
	   [Account Type] as ACTTYPE,
	   [No Fee] as NO_FEE,
	   [No Fee Date] as NO_FEE_DATE,
	   [Application Type] as UNIT 
 from 
(
SELECT
    bc.serv_prov_code AS SERV_PROV_CODE,
    bc.b1_per_id1 AS B1_PER_ID1,
    bc.b1_per_id2 AS B1_PER_ID2,
    bc.b1_per_id3 AS B1_PER_ID3,
    
    bc.b1_checkbox_desc,
    bc.b1_checklist_comment
 FROM
         bchckbox bc
JOIN #TMP_Returned_Values rv ON bc.SERV_PROV_CODE = rv.SERV_PROV_CODE
	AND bc.B1_PER_ID1 = rv.B1_PER_ID1
	AND bc.B1_PER_ID2 = rv.B1_PER_ID2
	AND bc.B1_PER_ID3 = rv.B1_PER_ID3
WHERE
    bc.b1_checkbox_desc IN ( 'Alpha Prefix', 'D.O.','Account Type','Application Type','No Fee','No Fee Date' )
    AND bc.b1_checkbox_type IN ('PLAN INFORMATION', 'PERMIT REPORT INFO','FEE EXEMPTION INFORMATION')
	AND bc.SERV_PROV_CODE = 'FDNY' 
    ) pvia
PIVOT ( MAX(b1_checklist_comment) for b1_checkbox_desc
            IN([D.O.],
			[Alpha Prefix],
			[Account Type],
			[No Fee],
			[No Fee Date],

			[Application Type])) pvib
)
select * INTO #TMP_do_unit from do_unit;
WITH balance AS (
SELECT
    pd.serv_prov_code AS SERV_PROV_CODE,
    pd.b1_per_id1 AS B1_PER_ID1,
    pd.b1_per_id2 AS B1_PER_ID2,
    pd.b1_per_id3 AS B1_PER_ID3,
    pd.balance
 FROM
         bpermit_detail pd
 JOIN #TMP_Returned_Values rv ON pd.SERV_PROV_CODE = rv.SERV_PROV_CODE
	AND pd.B1_PER_ID1 = rv.B1_PER_ID1
	AND pd.B1_PER_ID2 = rv.B1_PER_ID2
	AND pd.B1_PER_ID3 = rv.B1_PER_ID3
WHERE 1=1
	AND pd.SERV_PROV_CODE = 'FDNY' 
)
select * INTO #TMP_balance from balance;

WITH lien AS (
SELECT 
    serv_prov_code,
	b1_per_id1,
	b1_per_id2,
	b1_per_id3,
	acct_num,
	con_typ,
    con_nbr,
	charge_num,
    reason,
    payment_status,
	cycle_num,
    con_iss_dd,
    con_eff_dd
FROM
(
SELECT
    b6.serv_prov_code,
	b6.b1_per_id1,
	b6.b1_per_id2,
	b6.b1_per_id3,
	bp.b1_alt_id AS acct_num,
    b6.b1_con_typ AS con_typ,
    b6.b1_con_nbr AS con_nbr,
	RIGHT('0' + charge.field_value, 6) charge_num,
    reason.field_value   AS   reason,
    pstatus.field_value   AS  payment_status,
    cycstatus.field_value   AS  cycle_num,
    CONVERT(DATE,ISNULL(b6.b1_con_iss_dd,'1970-01-01')) AS con_iss_dd,
    CONVERT(DATE,ISNULL(b6.b1_con_eff_dd1,'1970-01-01'))  AS con_eff_dd

FROM
         b6condit b6
JOIN #TMP_Returned_Values rv ON b6.SERV_PROV_CODE = rv.SERV_PROV_CODE
	AND b6.B1_PER_ID1 = rv.B1_PER_ID1
	AND b6.B1_PER_ID2 = rv.B1_PER_ID2
	AND b6.B1_PER_ID3 = rv.B1_PER_ID3
JOIN b1permit bp ON b6.SERV_PROV_CODE = bp.SERV_PROV_CODE
	AND b6.B1_PER_ID1 = bp.B1_PER_ID1
	AND b6.B1_PER_ID2 = bp.B1_PER_ID2
	AND b6.B1_PER_ID3 = bp.B1_PER_ID3

    LEFT JOIN gtmpl_attribute     charge ON b6.b1_con_nbr = charge.entity_seq1
                                        AND b6.b1_per_id1 = charge.entity_key1
                                        AND b6.b1_per_id2 = charge.entity_key2
                                        AND b6.b1_per_id3 = charge.entity_key3
                                        AND charge.entity_type = '11'
                                        AND charge.field_name = 'Charge Number'
    LEFT JOIN gtmpl_attribute     reason ON b6.b1_con_nbr = reason.entity_seq1
                                        AND b6.b1_per_id1 = reason.entity_key1
                                        AND b6.b1_per_id2 = reason.entity_key2
                                        AND b6.b1_per_id3 = reason.entity_key3
                                        AND reason.entity_type = '11'
                                        AND reason.field_name = 'Reason'
    LEFT JOIN gtmpl_attribute     pstatus ON b6.b1_con_nbr = pstatus.entity_seq1
                                         AND b6.b1_per_id1 = pstatus.entity_key1
                                         AND b6.b1_per_id2 = pstatus.entity_key2
                                         AND b6.b1_per_id3 = pstatus.entity_key3
                                         AND pstatus.entity_type = '11'
                                         AND pstatus.field_name = 'Payment Status'
    LEFT JOIN gtmpl_attribute     cycstatus ON b6.b1_con_nbr = cycstatus.entity_seq1
                                         AND b6.b1_per_id1 = cycstatus.entity_key1
                                         AND b6.b1_per_id2 = cycstatus.entity_key2
                                         AND b6.b1_per_id3 = cycstatus.entity_key3
                                         AND cycstatus.entity_type = '11'
                                         AND cycstatus.field_name = 'Cycle Number'
WHERE
        b6.b1_con_typ = 'Lien'
    AND b6.rec_status = 'A'
    AND b6.serv_prov_code = 'FDNY'
) tr where charge_num is not null

)
select * INTO #TMP_lien from lien;
 --select * from #TMP_lien
WITH addr AS (
    SELECT
                serv_prov_code,
                b1_per_id1,
                b1_per_id2,
                b1_per_id3,
                b1_hse_nbr_alpha_start,
                b1_str_name,
                b1_situs_city,
                b1_situs_state,
                b1_situs_zip
    FROM
        (
            SELECT
                b.serv_prov_code,
                b.b1_per_id1,
                b.b1_per_id2,
                b.b1_per_id3,
                b.b1_hse_nbr_alpha_start,
                b.b1_str_name,
                b.b1_situs_city,
                b.b1_situs_state,
                b.b1_situs_zip,

                ROW_NUMBER()
                OVER(PARTITION BY b.serv_prov_code, b.b1_per_id1, b.b1_per_id2, b.b1_per_id3
                     ORDER BY
                         b.b1_primary_addr_flg DESC 
                ) rn
            FROM
                b3addres b
JOIN #TMP_Returned_Values rv ON b.SERV_PROV_CODE = rv.SERV_PROV_CODE
	AND b.B1_PER_ID1 = rv.B1_PER_ID1
	AND b.B1_PER_ID2 = rv.B1_PER_ID2
	AND b.B1_PER_ID3 = rv.B1_PER_ID3
WHERE
	 b.serv_prov_code = 'FDNY'
        ) tr
    WHERE  rn = 1
)
select * INTO #TMP_addr from addr;

WITH contact AS (
    SELECT
        serv_prov_code,
        b1_per_id1,
        b1_per_id2,
        b1_per_id3,
        contact_name,
        rec_date,
        b1_contact_type
    FROM
        (
            SELECT
            b.serv_prov_code,
            b.b1_per_id1,
            b.b1_per_id2,
            b.b1_per_id3,
			COALESCE(b.b1_full_name,b.b1_business_name,CONCAT(b1_fname,' ',b1_lname)) as contact_name,
                b.rec_date,
                b.b1_contact_type,
                ROW_NUMBER()
                OVER(PARTITION BY b.serv_prov_code, b.b1_per_id1, b.b1_per_id2, b.b1_per_id3
                     ORDER BY
                         b.rec_date DESC 
                ) rn
            FROM
                b3contact b	
JOIN #TMP_Returned_Values rv ON b.SERV_PROV_CODE = rv.SERV_PROV_CODE
	AND b.B1_PER_ID1 = rv.B1_PER_ID1
	AND b.B1_PER_ID2 = rv.B1_PER_ID2
	AND b.B1_PER_ID3 = rv.B1_PER_ID3

            WHERE
                b.b1_contact_type IN 
				(
                'Billing Contact',
                'Business Contact', 
                'Business Owner', 
                'Building Representative', 
                'Building Owner',
                'Authorized Person In charge'
                ) 
				AND b.SERV_PROV_CODE = 'FDNY'

        ) tr
    WHERE
        rn = 1
) 
select * INTO #TMP_contact from contact;

WITH APO AS (
select SERV_PROV_CODE,
		B1_PER_ID1,
		B1_PER_ID2,
		B1_PER_ID3,
		[BIN] as BIN,
		[BLOCK] as BLOCK,
		[LOT] as LOT
from 
(
SELECT
    apo.serv_prov_code AS SERV_PROV_CODE,
    apo.b1_per_id1 AS B1_PER_ID1,
	apo.b1_per_id2 AS B1_PER_ID2,
    apo.b1_per_id3 AS B1_PER_ID3,
    apo.b1_attribute_name,
    apo.b1_attribute_value
FROM
	b3apo_attribute apo
JOIN #TMP_Returned_Values rv ON APO.SERV_PROV_CODE = rv.SERV_PROV_CODE
	AND APO.B1_PER_ID1 = rv.B1_PER_ID1
	AND APO.B1_PER_ID2 = rv.B1_PER_ID2
	AND APO.B1_PER_ID3 = rv.B1_PER_ID3

WHERE
    apo.b1_attribute_name IN ( 'BIN', 'BLOCK','LOT' )
    AND apo.b1_apo_type IN ('ADDRESS')
	and apo.serv_prov_code = 'FDNY'
    ) pva
PIVOT ( 
	MAX(b1_attribute_value) 
	for b1_attribute_name
       IN(
			[BIN],
			[BLOCK],
			[LOT]
		) 
	) pvb
)
select * INTO #TMP_APO from APO;
WITH result_data AS (
SELECT 
	RIGHT('0' + du.ACTDO, 2) AS DO,
--    du.ALPHAPREFIX AS APFX, 
    du.ACTTYPE AS ACTTYP, 
    PERMITGRP = CASE 
	WHEN du.ACTTYPE IN ('10', '15', '20', '25') AND du.ACTDO  <> '19'  THEN 'PERMIT' 
	ELSE 
	'NONPERMIT' 
	END ,
	DUEDATE =CASE 
	WHEN du.ACTTYPE IN ('10', '15', '20', '25')  AND du.ACTDO  <> '19' THEN DATEADD(day,455,CONVERT(DATE,li.F4INVOICE_UDF2)) 
	ELSE 
	DATEADD(day,120,CONVERT(DATE,li.F4INVOICE_UDF2)) 
	END,
    du.UNIT,
    bp.b1_alt_id AS RECORD_ID,
--    bp.b1_per_type AS per_type,
--    bp.b1_per_sub_type AS per_sub_type,
--    bp.b1_appl_status AS STATUS, 
--    bp.b1_appl_status_date AS STATUS_DATE,
--    bp.b1_file_dd AS file_date,                    
    cn.contact_name       AS OWNER_NAME,
--    cn.b1_contact_type AS contact_type,
    ba.b1_hse_nbr_alpha_start AS STR_NUM,
    ba.b1_str_name AS STR_NAME,
    ba.b1_situs_city AS STR_CITY,
    ba.b1_situs_state AS STR_STATE,
    ba.b1_situs_zip AS STR_ZIP,
--	ap.BIN,
    ap.BLOCK, 
    ap.LOT,
	bal.balance,
    du.NO_FEE,
    du.NO_FEE_DATE,
--    li.INVOICE_NBR,
--    li.BALANCE_DUE,
--    li.INVOICE_AMOUNT,
    li.F4INVOICE_UDF1 as CYCLE,
    li.F4INVOICE_UDF2 AS CYCLE_CLOCK
--    li.F4INVOICE_UDF3 AS FIRST_DUNNING_DATE,
--    li.F4INVOICE_UDF4 AS FIRST_LIEN_NOTICE_DATE,
--    li.REC_DATE,
--    li.INVOICE_COMMENT 

FROM
         b1permit bp

    LEFT OUTER JOIN #TMP_contact         cn ON cn.serv_prov_code = bp.serv_prov_code
                                  AND cn.b1_per_id1 = bp.b1_per_id1
                                  AND cn.b1_per_id2 = bp.b1_per_id2
                                  AND cn.b1_per_id3 = bp.b1_per_id3
    LEFT OUTER JOIN #TMP_addr ba ON ba.serv_prov_code = bp.serv_prov_code
                                  AND ba.b1_per_id1 = bp.b1_per_id1
                                  AND ba.b1_per_id2 = bp.b1_per_id2
                                  AND ba.b1_per_id3 = bp.b1_per_id3

    INNER JOIN #TMP_APO ap      ON ap.serv_prov_code = bp.serv_prov_code
                                  AND ap.b1_per_id1 = bp.b1_per_id1
                                  AND ap.b1_per_id2 = bp.b1_per_id2
                                  AND ap.b1_per_id3 = bp.b1_per_id3

    INNER JOIN #TMP_do_unit du ON bp.serv_prov_code = du.serv_prov_code
                                   AND bp.b1_per_id1 = du.b1_per_id1
                                   AND bp.b1_per_id2 = du.b1_per_id2                                   
                                   AND bp.b1_per_id3 = du.b1_per_id3  
    INNER JOIN #TMP_balance bal ON bp.serv_prov_code = bal.serv_prov_code
                                   AND bp.b1_per_id1 = bal.b1_per_id1
                                   AND bp.b1_per_id2 = bal.b1_per_id2                                   
                                   AND bp.b1_per_id3 = bal.b1_per_id3  								   
    INNER JOIN #TMP_Returned_Values li ON bp.serv_prov_code = li.serv_prov_code
                                   AND bp.b1_per_id1 = li.b1_per_id1
                                   AND bp.b1_per_id2 = li.b1_per_id2                                   
                                   AND bp.b1_per_id3 = li.b1_per_id3  
		
WHERE

       bp.b1_per_type = 'Common' 
       AND  bp.b1_per_sub_type = 'Inspection'
       AND bp.b1_appl_status <> 'Inactive'
	   AND ISDATE(li.F4INVOICE_UDF2) = 1
	   AND bp.serv_prov_code = 'FDNY'
	   AND (du.NO_FEE <> 'CHECKED' OR du.NO_FEE is null)
--	   AND bp.b1_alt_id = @ACCOUNTId
)
select distinct

	owner_name,

	str_city,

WITH result_data2 AS (
SELECT 
	RIGHT('0' + du.ACTDO, 2) AS DO,
--    du.ALPHAPREFIX AS APFX, 
    du.ACTTYPE AS ACTTYP, 
    PERMITGRP = CASE 
	WHEN du.ACTTYPE IN ('10', '15', '20', '25') AND du.ACTDO  <> '19'  THEN 'PERMIT' 
	ELSE 
	'NONPERMIT' 
	END ,
	DUEDATE =CASE 
	WHEN du.ACTTYPE IN ('10', '15', '20', '25')  AND du.ACTDO  <> '19' THEN DATEADD(day,455,CONVERT(DATE,li.F4INVOICE_UDF2)) 
	ELSE 
	DATEADD(day,120,CONVERT(DATE,li.F4INVOICE_UDF2)) 
	END,
    du.UNIT,
    bp.b1_alt_id AS RECORD_ID,
--    bp.b1_per_type AS per_type,
--    bp.b1_per_sub_type AS per_sub_type,
--    bp.b1_appl_status AS STATUS, 
--    bp.b1_appl_status_date AS STATUS_DATE,
--    bp.b1_file_dd AS file_date,                    
    cn.contact_name       AS OWNER_NAME,
--    cn.b1_contact_type AS contact_type,
    ba.b1_hse_nbr_alpha_start AS STR_NUM,
    ba.b1_str_name AS STR_NAME,
    ba.b1_situs_city AS STR_CITY,
    ba.b1_situs_state AS STR_STATE,
    ba.b1_situs_zip AS STR_ZIP,
--	ap.BIN,
    ap.BLOCK, 
    ap.LOT,
	bal.balance,
    du.NO_FEE,
    du.NO_FEE_DATE,
--    li.INVOICE_NBR,
--    li.BALANCE_DUE,
--    li.INVOICE_AMOUNT,
    li.F4INVOICE_UDF1 as CYCLE,
    li.F4INVOICE_UDF2 AS CYCLE_CLOCK
--    li.F4INVOICE_UDF3 AS FIRST_DUNNING_DATE,
--    li.F4INVOICE_UDF4 AS FIRST_LIEN_NOTICE_DATE,
--    li.REC_DATE,
--    li.INVOICE_COMMENT 

FROM
         b1permit bp

    LEFT OUTER JOIN #TMP_contact2         cn ON cn.serv_prov_code = bp.serv_prov_code
                                  AND cn.b1_per_id1 = bp.b1_per_id1
                                  AND cn.b1_per_id2 = bp.b1_per_id2
                                  AND cn.b1_per_id3 = bp.b1_per_id3
    LEFT OUTER JOIN #TMP_addr2 ba ON ba.serv_prov_code = bp.serv_prov_code
                                  AND ba.b1_per_id1 = bp.b1_per_id1
                                  AND ba.b1_per_id2 = bp.b1_per_id2
                                  AND ba.b1_per_id3 = bp.b1_per_id3

    INNER JOIN #TMP_APO2 ap      ON ap.serv_prov_code = bp.serv_prov_code
                                  AND ap.b1_per_id1 = bp.b1_per_id1
                                  AND ap.b1_per_id2 = bp.b1_per_id2
                                  AND ap.b1_per_id3 = bp.b1_per_id3

    INNER JOIN #TMP_do_unit2 du ON bp.serv_prov_code = du.serv_prov_code
                                   AND bp.b1_per_id1 = du.b1_per_id1
                                   AND bp.b1_per_id2 = du.b1_per_id2                                   
                                   AND bp.b1_per_id3 = du.b1_per_id3   
    INNER JOIN #TMP_balance2 bal ON bp.serv_prov_code = bal.serv_prov_code
                                   AND bp.b1_per_id1 = bal.b1_per_id1
                                   AND bp.b1_per_id2 = bal.b1_per_id2                                   
                                   AND bp.b1_per_id3 = bal.b1_per_id3 
    INNER JOIN #TMP_Returned_Values2 li ON bp.serv_prov_code = li.serv_prov_code
                                   AND bp.b1_per_id1 = li.b1_per_id1
                                   AND bp.b1_per_id2 = li.b1_per_id2                                   
                                   AND bp.b1_per_id3 = li.b1_per_id3  
		
WHERE

       bp.b1_per_type = 'Common' 
       AND  bp.b1_per_sub_type = 'Inspection'
       AND bp.b1_appl_status <> 'Inactive'
	   AND ISDATE(li.F4INVOICE_UDF2) = 1
	   and bp.serv_prov_code = 'FDNY'
	   AND (du.NO_FEE <> 'CHECKED' OR du.NO_FEE is null)
--	   AND bp.b1_alt_id = @ACCOUNTID
) 
select distinct
	record_id,
	do,
	owner_name,
	str_num,
	str_name,
	str_city,
	str_state,
	str_zip,
	block,
	lot,
	balance,
	acttyp,
	cycle,
	cycle_clock
INTO #TMP_result_data2 from result_data2
WHERE
   PERMITGRP = 'NONPERMIT'
   AND DO NOT IN ('25','33')
   AND try_convert(DATE,DUEDATE)  <= DATEADD(day,10,GETDATE())
   AND NOT exists 
   (
   select * 
   from #TMP_lien2 
   WHERE 
     acct_num = RECORD_ID and CYCLE = ISNULL(CYCLE_NUM,'0000000-00')
	);
WITH all_data as (
select * FROM #TMP_result_data
 UNION
select * FROM #TMP_result_data2
)
select * from all_data order by owner_name, record_id;

        MAX(CASE WHEN  vd.ROW_INDEX = 2 THEN vd.inf_cmnts END) OVER (PARTITION BY vd.SERV_PROV_CODE, vd.B1_PER_ID1, vd.B1_PER_ID2, vd.B1_PER_ID3) AS VC3_CMNTS,
        MAX(CASE WHEN  vd.ROW_INDEX = 3 THEN vd.inf_cmnts END) OVER (PARTITION BY vd.SERV_PROV_CODE, vd.B1_PER_ID1, vd.B1_PER_ID2, vd.B1_PER_ID3) AS VC4_CMNTS

        MAX(CASE WHEN  vd.ROW_INDEX = 3 THEN vd.inf_cmnts END) OVER (PARTITION BY vd.SERV_PROV_CODE, vd.B1_PER_ID1, vd.B1_PER_ID2, vd.B1_PER_ID3) AS VC4_CMNTS

    FROM
        vio_data vd

),

        vc.SERV_PROV_CODE,

        vc.VC3_CODE,

        vc.VC4_CODE,

        STDCHC4.VALUE_DESC AS VC4_DESC
    FROM
        VC_CODES vc

    LEFT JOIN RBIZDOMAIN_VALUE STDCHC1
        ON STDCHC1.BIZDOMAIN = 'VIOLATION_CODE_DESC_MAPPING'
        AND STDCHC1.BIZDOMAIN_VALUE = vc.VC1_CODE
    LEFT JOIN RBIZDOMAIN_VALUE STDCHC2
        ON STDCHC2.BIZDOMAIN = 'VIOLATION_CODE_DESC_MAPPING'
        AND STDCHC2.BIZDOMAIN_VALUE = vc.VC2_CODE
    LEFT JOIN RBIZDOMAIN_VALUE STDCHC3

        AND STDCHC3.BIZDOMAIN_VALUE = vc.VC3_CODE
    LEFT JOIN RBIZDOMAIN_VALUE STDCHC4
        ON STDCHC4.BIZDOMAIN = 'VIOLATION_CODE_DESC_MAPPING'
        AND STDCHC4.BIZDOMAIN_VALUE = vc.VC4_CODE
),
