	sv.VC4_DESC
  FROM SUM_VC sv

	bp.rec_date

	var result = updateNoFeeRejected(thisRec);
	if (result) {
		processedList.push(thisRec);
	}
}

aa.print("" *** Processed "" + processedList.length + "" record(s): "" + processedList);

function updateNoFeeRejected(thisAltId) {
	var capId = aa.cap.getCapID(thisAltId).getOutput();
	if (capId) { 
		editAppSpecific(""Exemption Recommendation"",""UNCHECKED"",capId);
		editAppSpecific(""Exemption Recommendation Date"","""",capId);
		updateTask(""Fee Exemption Review"", ""Rejected"", ""Updated via Batch"", """", """", capId);
		updateTask(""Inspection Revenue - Fee Exemption"", ""Rejected"", ""Updated via Batch"", """", """", capId);
		closeTaskForCapId(""Fee Exemption Review"", capId);
		closeTaskForCapId(""Inspection Revenue - Fee Exemption"", capId);
		aa.workflow.adjustTask(capId, ""Invoice Review"", ""Y"", ""N"", null, null);
		invoiceAllFees(capId);
		return true;
	}
	return false;
}","7/29/2026 3:19:54 PM"

(

    B.B1_ALT_ID ACCOUNT_NO,

        SELECT SERV_PROV_CODE, B1_PER_ID1, B1_PER_ID2, B1_PER_ID3,PREM_ADDR1,PREM_ADDR2,RN FROM 
        (    
            SELECT 
                SERV_PROV_CODE, B1_PER_ID1, B1_PER_ID2, B1_PER_ID3,

                COALESCE(B1_SITUS_CITY,'')+' '+COALESCE(B1_SITUS_STATE,'')+' '+COALESCE(B1_SITUS_ZIP,'') PREM_ADDR2,
                ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY SERV_PROV_CODE, B1_PER_ID1, B1_PER_ID2, B1_PER_ID3 ORDER BY B1_PRIMARY_ADDR_FLG, REC_DATE DESC) RN
            FROM B3ADDRES 
                     WHERE SERV_PROV_CODE='FDNY'

    ) A
    ON A.SERV_PROV_CODE= B.SERV_PROV_CODE

      FROM F4FEEITEM
         WHERE SERV_PROV_CODE='FDNY'
      GROUP BY SERV_PROV_CODE,B1_PER_ID1,    B1_PER_ID2,    B1_PER_ID3
    ) F

    AND F.B1_PER_ID1 = B.B1_PER_ID1
    AND F.B1_PER_ID2 = B.B1_PER_ID2
    AND F.B1_PER_ID3 = B.B1_PER_ID3

    ON D.SERV_PROV_CODE= B.SERV_PROV_CODE
    AND D.B1_PER_ID1 = B.B1_PER_ID1

MAIN_QUERY AS
(
SELECT 
    B.B1_ALT_ID ACCOUNT_NO,
    B.SERV_PROV_CODE,B.B1_PER_ID1,B.B1_PER_ID2,B.B1_PER_ID3,
    COALESCE(F.ITEMCODES,'') ITEMCODES, --COALESCE(F.ITEMCODES,CI.ITEMCODE) ITEMCODES,
    D.BALANCE,
    A.PREM_ADDR1,
    A.PREM_ADDR2
   -- BA.BLOCK,
   -- BA.LOT,
    --RBI.MAIL_RECIPIENT_NAME RENA_MAILING_NAME,
    --COALESCE(MAIL_ADDRESS_2,'') RENA_MAIL_ADDR1, --- COALESCE(RBI.MAIL_ADDRESS_1,'')+' '+COALESCE(MAIL_ADDRESS_2,'') RENA_MAIL_ADDR1,
    --COALESCE(MAIL_CITY,'')+' '+COALESCE(MAIL_STATE,'')+' '+COALESCE(MAIL_ZIP,'') RENA_MAIL_ADDR2

    FROM B1PERMIT B
    LEFT JOIN (
        SELECT SERV_PROV_CODE, B1_PER_ID1, B1_PER_ID2, B1_PER_ID3,PREM_ADDR1,PREM_ADDR2,RN FROM 
        (    
            SELECT 
                SERV_PROV_CODE, B1_PER_ID1, B1_PER_ID2, B1_PER_ID3,
                COALESCE(B1_HSE_NBR_ALPHA_START,'')+' ' +COALESCE(B1_STR_NAME,'') PREM_ADDR1,
                COALESCE(B1_SITUS_CITY,'')+' '+COALESCE(B1_SITUS_STATE,'')+' '+COALESCE(B1_SITUS_ZIP,'') PREM_ADDR2,
                ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY SERV_PROV_CODE, B1_PER_ID1, B1_PER_ID2, B1_PER_ID3 ORDER BY B1_PRIMARY_ADDR_FLG, REC_DATE DESC) RN
            FROM B3ADDRES 
                     WHERE SERV_PROV_CODE='FDNY'
        ) X WHERE RN = 1
    ) A
    ON A.SERV_PROV_CODE= B.SERV_PROV_CODE
    AND A.B1_PER_ID1 = B.B1_PER_ID1
    AND A.B1_PER_ID2 = B.B1_PER_ID2
    AND A.B1_PER_ID3 = B.B1_PER_ID3  
    LEFT JOIN 
       (SELECT SERV_PROV_CODE,    B1_PER_ID1,    B1_PER_ID2,    B1_PER_ID3, STRING_AGG(GF_L3,', ')   WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY FEEITEM_SEQ_NBR) ITEMCODES
      FROM F4FEEITEM
         WHERE SERV_PROV_CODE='FDNY'
      GROUP BY SERV_PROV_CODE,B1_PER_ID1,    B1_PER_ID2,    B1_PER_ID3
    ) F
    ON F.SERV_PROV_CODE= B.SERV_PROV_CODE
    AND F.B1_PER_ID1 = B.B1_PER_ID1
    AND F.B1_PER_ID2 = B.B1_PER_ID2
    AND F.B1_PER_ID3 = B.B1_PER_ID3

 
    LEFT JOIN BPERMIT_DETAIL  D
    ON D.SERV_PROV_CODE= B.SERV_PROV_CODE
    AND D.B1_PER_ID1 = B.B1_PER_ID1
    AND D.B1_PER_ID2 = B.B1_PER_ID2
    AND D.B1_PER_ID3 = B.B1_PER_ID3
   /* LEFT JOIN FPIMS.FPO_MV_RECORD_BINS  BA
    ON BA.SERV_PROV_CODE= B.SERV_PROV_CODE
    AND BA.B1_PER_ID1 = B.B1_PER_ID1
    AND BA.B1_PER_ID2 = B.B1_PER_ID2
    AND BA.B1_PER_ID3 = B.B1_PER_ID3
    LEFT JOIN FPIMS.FPO_MV_RENA_BUILDING_INFO RBI 
    ON RBI.SERV_PROV_CODE= B.SERV_PROV_CODE
    AND RBI.B1_PER_ID1 = B.B1_PER_ID1
    AND RBI.B1_PER_ID2 = B.B1_PER_ID2
    AND RBI.B1_PER_ID3 = B.B1_PER_ID3*/
    /*LEFT JOIN ITEM_CVG CI
    ON  CI.SERV_PROV_CODE= B.SERV_PROV_CODE
    AND CI.B1_PER_ID1 = B.B1_PER_ID1
    AND CI.B1_PER_ID2 = B.B1_PER_ID2
    AND CI.B1_PER_ID3 = B.B1_PER_ID3*/
    LEFT JOIN BILLING_INFO BF
    ON  BF.SERV_PROV_CODE= B.SERV_PROV_CODE
    AND BF.B1_PER_ID1 = B.B1_PER_ID1
    AND BF.B1_PER_ID2 = B.B1_PER_ID2
    AND BF.B1_PER_ID3 = B.B1_PER_ID3
    WHERE B.SERV_PROV_CODE='FDNY'
       AND BF.BILL_TYPE = 'Lien Notice'
    AND   BF.LIEN_NOTICE IS NOT NULL    
    AND   D.BALANCE >= 1
)

MAIN_QUERY AS
(
SELECT 
    B.B1_ALT_ID ACCOUNT_NO,
    B.SERV_PROV_CODE,B.B1_PER_ID1,B.B1_PER_ID2,B.B1_PER_ID3,
    COALESCE(F.ITEMCODES,'') ITEMCODES, --COALESCE(F.ITEMCODES,CI.ITEMCODE) ITEMCODES,
    D.BALANCE,
    A.PREM_ADDR1,
    A.PREM_ADDR2
   -- BA.BLOCK,
   -- BA.LOT,
    --RBI.MAIL_RECIPIENT_NAME RENA_MAILING_NAME,
    --COALESCE(MAIL_ADDRESS_2,'') RENA_MAIL_ADDR1, --- COALESCE(RBI.MAIL_ADDRESS_1,'')+' '+COALESCE(MAIL_ADDRESS_2,'') RENA_MAIL_ADDR1,
    --COALESCE(MAIL_CITY,'')+' '+COALESCE(MAIL_STATE,'')+' '+COALESCE(MAIL_ZIP,'') RENA_MAIL_ADDR2

    FROM B1PERMIT B
    LEFT JOIN (
        SELECT SERV_PROV_CODE, B1_PER_ID1, B1_PER_ID2, B1_PER_ID3,PREM_ADDR1,PREM_ADDR2,RN FROM 
        (    
            SELECT 
                SERV_PROV_CODE, B1_PER_ID1, B1_PER_ID2, B1_PER_ID3,
                COALESCE(B1_HSE_NBR_ALPHA_START,'')+' ' +COALESCE(B1_STR_NAME,'') PREM_ADDR1,
                COALESCE(B1_SITUS_CITY,'')+' '+COALESCE(B1_SITUS_STATE,'')+' '+COALESCE(B1_SITUS_ZIP,'') PREM_ADDR2,
                ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY SERV_PROV_CODE, B1_PER_ID1, B1_PER_ID2, B1_PER_ID3 ORDER BY B1_PRIMARY_ADDR_FLG, REC_DATE DESC) RN
            FROM B3ADDRES 
                     WHERE SERV_PROV_CODE='FDNY'
        ) X WHERE RN = 1
    ) A
    ON A.SERV_PROV_CODE= B.SERV_PROV_CODE
    AND A.B1_PER_ID1 = B.B1_PER_ID1
    AND A.B1_PER_ID2 = B.B1_PER_ID2
    AND A.B1_PER_ID3 = B.B1_PER_ID3  
    LEFT JOIN 
       (SELECT SERV_PROV_CODE,    B1_PER_ID1,    B1_PER_ID2,    B1_PER_ID3, STRING_AGG(GF_L3,', ')   WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY FEEITEM_SEQ_NBR) ITEMCODES
      FROM F4FEEITEM
         WHERE SERV_PROV_CODE='FDNY'
      GROUP BY SERV_PROV_CODE,B1_PER_ID1,    B1_PER_ID2,    B1_PER_ID3
    ) F
    ON F.SERV_PROV_CODE= B.SERV_PROV_CODE
    AND F.B1_PER_ID1 = B.B1_PER_ID1
    AND F.B1_PER_ID2 = B.B1_PER_ID2
    AND F.B1_PER_ID3 = B.B1_PER_ID3

 
    LEFT JOIN BPERMIT_DETAIL  D
    ON D.SERV_PROV_CODE= B.SERV_PROV_CODE
    AND D.B1_PER_ID1 = B.B1_PER_ID1
    AND D.B1_PER_ID2 = B.B1_PER_ID2
    AND D.B1_PER_ID3 = B.B1_PER_ID3
   /* LEFT JOIN FPIMS.FPO_MV_RECORD_BINS  BA
    ON BA.SERV_PROV_CODE= B.SERV_PROV_CODE
    AND BA.B1_PER_ID1 = B.B1_PER_ID1
    AND BA.B1_PER_ID2 = B.B1_PER_ID2
    AND BA.B1_PER_ID3 = B.B1_PER_ID3
    LEFT JOIN FPIMS.FPO_MV_RENA_BUILDING_INFO RBI 
    ON RBI.SERV_PROV_CODE= B.SERV_PROV_CODE
    AND RBI.B1_PER_ID1 = B.B1_PER_ID1
    AND RBI.B1_PER_ID2 = B.B1_PER_ID2
    AND RBI.B1_PER_ID3 = B.B1_PER_ID3*/
    /*LEFT JOIN ITEM_CVG CI
    ON  CI.SERV_PROV_CODE= B.SERV_PROV_CODE
    AND CI.B1_PER_ID1 = B.B1_PER_ID1
    AND CI.B1_PER_ID2 = B.B1_PER_ID2
    AND CI.B1_PER_ID3 = B.B1_PER_ID3*/
    LEFT JOIN BILLING_INFO BF
    ON  BF.SERV_PROV_CODE= B.SERV_PROV_CODE
    AND BF.B1_PER_ID1 = B.B1_PER_ID1
    AND BF.B1_PER_ID2 = B.B1_PER_ID2
    AND BF.B1_PER_ID3 = B.B1_PER_ID3
    WHERE B.SERV_PROV_CODE='FDNY'
       AND BF.BILL_TYPE = 'Lien Notice'
    AND   BF.LIEN_NOTICE IS NOT NULL    
    AND   D.BALANCE >= 1
)

select distinct * from (
SELECT B.CONTACT_NAME ACCOUNT_NAME,
   -- COALESCE(A.RENA_MAILING_NAME , B.CONTACT_NAME ,'')  MAILING_CONTACT_NAME,    
   /* CASE WHEN A.RENA_MAIL_ADDR1 IS NOT NULL AND LEN(A.RENA_MAIL_ADDR1) > 1 THEN
        A.RENA_MAIL_ADDR1+CHAR(13)+A.RENA_MAIL_ADDR2
    ELSE
        B.CONTACT_ADDRESS
    END BILLING_ADDR,*/

       [BLOCK], LOT, ISNULL(ADDRESS_1, CONTACT_ADDRESS_1) AS ADDRESS_1, ISNULL(CITY_STATE_ZIP, CONTACT_CITY_STATE_ZIP) AS CITY_STATE_ZIP, ISNULL(OWNER_NAME, CONTACT_NAME) AS OWNER_NAME,
    A.*
FROM MAIN_QUERY A
LEFT OUTER JOIN PA S ON 
        A.SERV_PROV_CODE = S.SERV_PROV_CODE
     AND A.B1_PER_ID1 = S.B1_PER_ID1
     AND A.B1_PER_ID2 = S.B1_PER_ID2
     AND A.B1_PER_ID3 = S.B1_PER_ID3
LEFT JOIN (
SELECT * FROM 
    (SELECT B1P.SERV_PROV_CODE,B1P.B1_PER_ID1,B1P.B1_PER_ID2,B1P.B1_PER_ID3,
            COALESCE(UPPER(B3CON.B1_BUSINESS_NAME), B3CON.B1_FNAME+' '+B3CON.B1_LNAME) AS CONTACT_NAME,
			CONCAT(G7A.G7_HSE_NBR_ALPHA_START, ' ', G7A.G7_STR_NAME, ' ', G7A.G7_UNIT_END) AS CONTACT_ADDRESS_1,
			CONCAT(G7A.G7_CITY, ', ', G7A.G7_STATE, ' ', G7A.G7_ZIP) AS CONTACT_CITY_STATE_ZIP,
            G7A.G7_HSE_NBR_ALPHA_START+ ' '+G7A.G7_STR_NAME+CHAR(13)+G7A.G7_CITY+', '+G7A.G7_STATE+' '+G7A.G7_ZIP CONTACT_ADDRESS,
            ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY B1P.B1_ALT_ID ORDER BY B3CON.B1_CONTACT_TYPE) RN
     FROM B1PERMIT B1P
     LEFT JOIN B3CONTACT B3CON
     ON  B1P.SERV_PROV_CODE = B3CON.SERV_PROV_CODE
     AND B1P.B1_PER_ID1 = B3CON.B1_PER_ID1
     AND B1P.B1_PER_ID2 = B3CON.B1_PER_ID2
     AND B1P.B1_PER_ID3 = B3CON.B1_PER_ID3
     and B1_CONTACT_TYPE IN ('Business Owner','Billing Contact')
     LEFT JOIN XRECORD_CONTACT_ENTITY XREC
     ON  B3CON.SERV_PROV_CODE=XREC.SERV_PROV_CODE
     AND B3CON.B1_PER_ID1=XREC.B1_PER_ID1
     AND B3CON.B1_PER_ID2=XREC.B1_PER_ID2
     AND B3CON.B1_PER_ID3=XREC.B1_PER_ID3
     AND B3CON.B1_CONTACT_NBR=XREC.B1_CONTACT_NBR
     AND (--to ensure addresses returned matches list in UI
           B3CON.G1_CONTACT_NBR IS NULL AND XREC.ENT_TYPE LIKE 'CAP%CONTACT' OR B3CON.G1_CONTACT_NBR IS NOT NULL AND XREC.ENT_TYPE='CONTACT' )
     LEFT JOIN G7CONTACT_ADDRESS G7A
     ON XREC.SERV_PROV_CODE = G7A.SERV_PROV_CODE
     AND XREC.ENT_ID1 = G7A.RES_ID
     AND XREC.ENT_TYPE = G7A.G7_ENTITY_TYPE
     AND G7A.REC_STATUS = 'A'
     --AND G7A.G7_ADDRESS_TYPE = 'Mailing Address'
	 AND G7A.G7_ADDRESS_TYPE = 'Billing Address'
     WHERE  G7A.SERV_PROV_CODE='FDNY'
       AND G7A.G7_ADDRESS_TYPE IS NOT NULL
    ) XX
    WHERE RN = 1
  ) B
  
   ON  A.SERV_PROV_CODE= B.SERV_PROV_CODE
   AND A.B1_PER_ID1 = B.B1_PER_ID1
   AND A.B1_PER_ID2 = B.B1_PER_ID2
   AND A.B1_PER_ID3 = B.B1_PER_ID3

    INNER JOIN SETDETAILS SD
    ON SD.SERV_PROV_CODE= B.SERV_PROV_CODE
    AND SD.B1_PER_ID1 = B.B1_PER_ID1
    AND SD.B1_PER_ID2 = B.B1_PER_ID2
    AND SD.B1_PER_ID3 = B.B1_PER_ID3  
    WHERE B.Serv_PROV_CODE = 'FDNY' AND SD.REC_STATUS='A'
	--	 AND TRY_CONVERT(DATE, SD.REC_DATE) = TRY_CONVERT(DATE, '2025-06-01')
    AND NOT EXISTS
    (
            SELECT 
            1            
            FROM BCHCKBOX nofee
            WHERE nofee.SERV_PROV_CODE='FDNY'
                     AND ( nofee.B1_CHECKBOX_TYPE = 'FEE EXEMPTION INFORMATION'
            AND nofee.B1_CHECKBOX_DESC = 'No Fee'
            AND (nofee.B1_CHECKLIST_COMMENT = 'CHECKED') OR ( nofee.B1_CHECKBOX_DESC ='Are you a City Agency or State Agency Employee?' AND  nofee.B1_CHECKLIST_COMMENT = 'Yes'))
            AND nofee.SERV_PROV_CODE= B.SERV_PROV_CODE
            AND nofee.B1_PER_ID1 = B.B1_PER_ID1
            AND nofee.B1_PER_ID2 = B.B1_PER_ID2
            AND nofee.B1_PER_ID3 = B.B1_PER_ID3             
    )
  AND SD.SET_ID = (SELECT SET_ID FROM SETHEADER WHERE RECORD_SET_TYPE = 'LIEN_NOTICES'
  AND SET_STATUS = 'Open' 
  )
   ) v
WHERE V.SERV_PROV_CODE='FDNY'
ORDER BY ACCOUNT_NO ASC","6/16/2026 10:33:28 AM"

MAIN_QUERY AS
(
SELECT 
    B.B1_ALT_ID ACCOUNT_NO,

    D.BALANCE,
    A.PREM_ADDR1,
    A.PREM_ADDR2
    FROM B1PERMIT B
    LEFT JOIN (

        (    
            SELECT 
                SERV_PROV_CODE, B1_PER_ID1, B1_PER_ID2, B1_PER_ID3,
                COALESCE(B1_HSE_NBR_ALPHA_START,'')+' ' +COALESCE(B1_STR_NAME,'') PREM_ADDR1,
                COALESCE(B1_SITUS_CITY,'')+' '+COALESCE(B1_SITUS_STATE,'')+' '+COALESCE(B1_SITUS_ZIP,'') PREM_ADDR2,
                ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY SERV_PROV_CODE, B1_PER_ID1, B1_PER_ID2, B1_PER_ID3 ORDER BY B1_PRIMARY_ADDR_FLG, REC_DATE DESC) RN
            FROM B3ADDRES 
                     WHERE SERV_PROV_CODE='FDNY'
        ) X WHERE RN = 1
    ) A
    ON A.SERV_PROV_CODE= B.SERV_PROV_CODE
    AND A.B1_PER_ID1 = B.B1_PER_ID1
    AND A.B1_PER_ID2 = B.B1_PER_ID2
    AND A.B1_PER_ID3 = B.B1_PER_ID3  
    LEFT JOIN 
       (SELECT SERV_PROV_CODE,    B1_PER_ID1,    B1_PER_ID2,    B1_PER_ID3, STRING_AGG(GF_L3,', ')   WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY FEEITEM_SEQ_NBR) ITEMCODES
      FROM F4FEEITEM
         WHERE SERV_PROV_CODE='FDNY'

WITH Returned_Values AS(
select 
    serv_prov_code,
    b1_per_id1,
    b1_per_id2,
    b1_per_id3,
    b1_alt_id,
    b1_per_type,
    b1_per_sub_type,
    b1_file_dd,
    rec_date,
    rec_ful_nam,
    rec_status,
    b1_appl_status,
    ROW_INDEX,
    [Bill Number] AS BILL_NUMBER,
    [Bill Type] AS BILL_TYPE,
    [Bill Date] AS BILL_DATE,
    [Bill Amount] AS BILL_AMOUNT,
    [Clock Date] AS CLOCK_DATE,
    [Cycle Number] AS CYCLE_NUMBER,
    [First Reminder] AS FIRST_REMINDER,
    [Lien Notice] AS LIEN_NOTICE,
    [Account Type] AS ACCOUNT_TYPE
     FROM (
     SELECT 
    bp.serv_prov_code,
    bp.b1_per_id1,
    bp.b1_per_id2,
    bp.b1_per_id3,
    bp.b1_alt_id,
    bp.b1_per_type,
    bp.b1_per_sub_type,
    bp.b1_file_dd,
    bp.rec_date,
    bp.rec_ful_nam,
    bp.rec_status,
    bp.b1_appl_status,
    sh.set_id,
    sh.set_status,
    CAST(sh.set_date as date) set_date,
    ROW_INDEX AS ROW_INDEX,
    bap.COLUMN_NAME,
    bap.attribute_value
    FROM
         b1permit bp
    INNER JOIN bappspectable_value bap ON bp.serv_prov_code = bap.serv_prov_code
                                     AND bp.b1_per_id1 = bap.b1_per_id1
                                     AND bp.b1_per_id2 = bap.b1_per_id2
                                     AND bp.b1_per_id3 = bap.b1_per_id3
    INNER JOIN SETDETAILS SD ON SD.SERV_PROV_CODE= bp.SERV_PROV_CODE
                            AND SD.B1_PER_ID1 = bp.B1_PER_ID1
                            AND SD.B1_PER_ID2 = bp.B1_PER_ID2
                            AND SD.B1_PER_ID3 = bp.B1_PER_ID3  
    INNER JOIN SETHEADER SH
    ON SH.SERV_PROV_CODE = SD.SERV_PROV_CODE
    AND SH.SET_ID = SD.SET_ID

    WHERE 1=1
          AND bp.Serv_PROV_CODE = 'FDNY' AND SD.REC_STATUS='A'
          AND bap.TABLE_NAME = 'BILLING INFORMATION'
          AND bap.COLUMN_NAME IN ('Bill Number', 'Bill Type', 'Bill Date','Bill Amount','Clock Date','Cycle Number','First Reminder','Lien Notice','Account Type')
          AND  bp.b1_per_type = 'Common'
          AND  bp.b1_per_sub_type = 'Inspection'
          AND SD.SET_ID = (SELECT SET_ID FROM SETHEADER WHERE RECORD_SET_TYPE = 'LIEN_NOTICES'
          AND SET_STATUS = 'Open' )
    --      AND set_date > '2026-06-01')
    )    pv1 

    PIVOT (MAX (ATTRIBUTE_VALUE)
                                               FOR COLUMN_NAME
                                               IN  ([Bill Number],
                                                   [Bill Type],
                                                   [Bill Date],
                                                   [Bill Amount],
                                                   [Clock Date],
                                                   [Cycle Number],
                                                   [First Reminder],
                                                   [Lien Notice],
                                                   [Account Type])) pv2
WHERE  1=1
	   AND [Bill Type] = 'Lien Notice'
	   AND [Lien Notice] IS NOT NULL
       AND  CAST(set_date as date) = CAST([Lien Notice] as date)
--   	AND b1_alt_id in ('00374488')
)

WITH MAIL_ADDR AS (
SELECT 
        serv_prov_code,
        b1_per_id1,
        b1_per_id2,
        b1_per_id3,
        COALESCE(UPPER(B1_BUSINESS_NAME), CONCAT(B1_FNAME,' ',B1_LNAME)) AS CONTACT_NAME,
        CONCAT(MAILSTNUM,' ',MAILSTNAME,' ',MAILCITY,', ',MAILSTATE,' ',MAILZIPCD) AS CONTACT_ADDRESS,
        b1_contact_nbr,
        B1_FLAG 


FROM
(SELECT 
        b.serv_prov_code,
        b.b1_per_id1,
        b.b1_per_id2,
        b.b1_per_id3,
        B3C.B1_BUSINESS_NAME,
        B3C.B1_FNAME,
        B3C.B1_LNAME,
          G7_HSE_NBR_ALPHA_START AS MAILSTNUM,
          G7_STR_NAME AS MAILSTNAME,
          G7_STR_PREFIX AS MAILSTPFX,
          CAST (NULL AS VARCHAR (1)) AS MAILSTTYP,
          G7_STR_SUFFIX AS MAILSTSFX,
          SUBSTRING(G7_ZIP,1,5) AS MAILZIPCD,
          g7.G7_CITY AS MAILCITY,
          G7.G7_STATE AS MAILSTATE,
		  b3c.b1_contact_type,
          b3c.b1_contact_nbr,
          b3c.B1_FLAG,
          ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY B.B1_ALT_ID ORDER BY B3C.B1_CONTACT_TYPE DESC) RN
     FROM b1Permit b
          JOIN B3Contact b3c
             ON     b.serv_prov_code = b3c.serv_prov_code
                AND b.b1_per_id1 = b3c.b1_per_id1
                AND b.b1_per_id2 = b3c.b1_per_id2
                AND b.b1_per_id3 = b3c.b1_per_id3
				and b3c.B1_CONTACT_TYPE IN ('Business Owner','Billing Contact')
          JOIN xrecord_contact_entity xr
             ON     b.serv_prov_code = xr.serv_prov_code
                AND b.b1_per_id1 = xr.b1_per_id1
                AND b.b1_per_id2 = xr.b1_per_id2
                AND b.b1_per_id3 = xr.b1_per_id3
                AND b3c.b1_contact_nbr = xr.b1_contact_nbr
--                AND b3c.B1_FLAG = 'Y'
                AND (B3C.G1_CONTACT_NBR IS NULL AND XR.ENT_TYPE LIKE 'CAP%CONTACT' 
                    OR B3C.G1_CONTACT_NBR IS NOT NULL AND XR.ENT_TYPE='CONTACT' )
 JOIN #TMP_Returned_Values rv ON b.SERV_PROV_CODE = rv.SERV_PROV_CODE
	AND b.B1_PER_ID1 = rv.B1_PER_ID1
	AND b.B1_PER_ID2 = rv.B1_PER_ID2
	AND b.B1_PER_ID3 = rv.B1_PER_ID3


          JOIN G7CONTACT_ADDRESS g7
             ON     g7.g7_Entity_type = xr.ENT_TYPE
                AND xr.ENT_ID1 = g7.RES_ID
                AND G7_ADDRESS_TYPE = 'Billing Address'
    WHERE  1=1  
        and   b.B1_PER_TYPE = 'Common'
          AND b.B1_PER_SUB_TYPE = 'Inspection') PV1
     WHERE RN = 1

WITH no_fee AS (
select 
    SERV_PROV_CODE,
    B1_PER_ID1,
    B1_PER_ID2,
    B1_PER_ID3,
    [Are you a City Agency or State Agency Employee?] as EXEMPT_AGENCY,
    [Exemption Recommendation] as EXEMPT_RECOMMEND,
    [Exemption Recommendation Date] as EXEMPT_RECOMMEND_DATE,
    [No Fee] as NO_FEE,
    [No Fee Date] as NO_FEE_DATE

from 
(
SELECT
    bc.serv_prov_code,
    bc.b1_per_id1,
    bc.b1_per_id2,
    bc.b1_per_id3,
    bc.b1_checkbox_desc,
    bc.b1_checklist_comment
 FROM
         bchckbox bc
 JOIN #TMP_Returned_Values rv ON bc.SERV_PROV_CODE = rv.SERV_PROV_CODE
	AND bc.B1_PER_ID1 = rv.B1_PER_ID1
	AND bc.B1_PER_ID2 = rv.B1_PER_ID2
	AND bc.B1_PER_ID3 = rv.B1_PER_ID3

WHERE
    bc.b1_checkbox_desc IN ('Are you a City Agency or State Agency Employee?','Exemption Recommendation','Exemption Recommendation Date','No Fee','No Fee Date')
    AND bc.b1_checkbox_type IN ('FEE EXEMPTION INFORMATION')
    ) PV1
PIVOT ( MAX(b1_checklist_comment) for b1_checkbox_desc
            IN(
            [Are you a City Agency or State Agency Employee?],
            [Exemption Recommendation],
            [Exemption Recommendation Date],
            [No Fee],
            [No Fee Date])) PV2
WHERE 1=1 
            AND ([No Fee] = 'CHECKED' OR  [Exemption Recommendation] = 'CHECKED' OR [Are you a City Agency or State Agency Employee?] = 'Yes')
)
   select * INTO #TMP_NO_FEE from NO_FEE;

SELECT distinct

    ma.CONTACT_NAME ACCOUNT_NAME,
	ma.CONTACT_ADDRESS AS BILLING_ADDR,
    COALESCE(pr.BLOCK_NUM,' ') AS BLOCK,
    COALESCE(pr.LOT_NUM,' ') AS LOT,
    COALESCE(pr.BLD_STREET,' ') ADDRESS_1, 
    COALESCE(pr.CITY_STATE_ZIP,' ') CITY_STATE_ZIP, 
	COALESCE(pr.OWNER_NAME,' ') OWNER_NAME, 
	bp.b1_alt_id AS ACCOUNT_NO,
    COALESCE(cv.ITEMCODES,' ') ITEMCODES,
    pd.Balance BALANCE,
    CONCAT(COALESCE(ad.B1_HSE_NBR_ALPHA_START,''),' ',COALESCE(ad.B1_STR_NAME,'')) PREM_ADDR1,
    CONCAT(COALESCE(ad.B1_SITUS_CITY,''),' ',COALESCE(ad.B1_SITUS_STATE,''),' ',COALESCE(SUBSTRING(ad.B1_SITUS_ZIP,1,5),'')) PREM_ADDR2

FROM
         b1permit bp

                             
    LEFT OUTER JOIN #TMP_addr ad ON ad.serv_prov_code = bp.serv_prov_code
                                  AND ad.b1_per_id1 = bp.b1_per_id1
                                  AND ad.b1_per_id2 = bp.b1_per_id2
                                  AND ad.b1_per_id3 = bp.b1_per_id3   
    INNER JOIN #TMP_Returned_Values bi ON bi.serv_prov_code = bp.serv_prov_code
                                  AND bi.b1_per_id1 = bp.b1_per_id1
                                  AND bi.b1_per_id2 = bp.b1_per_id2
                                  AND bi.b1_per_id3 = bp.b1_per_id3  
    LEFT OUTER JOIN #TMP_PROPERTY pr ON pr.serv_prov_code = bp.serv_prov_code
                                   AND pr.b1_per_id1 = bp.b1_per_id1
                                   AND pr.b1_per_id2 = bp.b1_per_id2
                                   AND pr.b1_per_id3 = bp.b1_per_id3
    LEFT OUTER JOIN BPERMIT_DETAIL  pd ON pd.serv_prov_code = bp.serv_prov_code
                                   AND pd.b1_per_id1 = bp.b1_per_id1
                                   AND pd.b1_per_id2 = bp.b1_per_id2
                                   AND pd.b1_per_id3 = bp.b1_per_id3
    LEFT OUTER JOIN #TMP_COV_ITEM  cv ON cv.serv_prov_code = bp.serv_prov_code
                                   AND cv.b1_per_id1 = bp.b1_per_id1
                                   AND cv.b1_per_id2 = bp.b1_per_id2
                                   AND cv.b1_per_id3 = bp.b1_per_id3
    LEFT OUTER JOIN #TMP_MAIL_ADDR  ma ON ma.serv_prov_code = bp.serv_prov_code
                                   AND ma.b1_per_id1 = bp.b1_per_id1
                                   AND ma.b1_per_id2 = bp.b1_per_id2
                                   AND ma.b1_per_id3 = bp.b1_per_id3    
                                   
    LEFT OUTER JOIN #TMP_no_fee  nf ON nf.serv_prov_code = bp.serv_prov_code
                                   AND nf.b1_per_id1 = bp.b1_per_id1
                                   AND nf.b1_per_id2 = bp.b1_per_id2
                                   AND nf.b1_per_id3 = bp.b1_per_id3   
    INNER JOIN SETDETAILS sd ON sd.serv_prov_code = bp.serv_prov_code
                                  AND sd.b1_per_id1 = bp.b1_per_id1
                                  AND sd.b1_per_id2 = bp.b1_per_id2
                                  AND sd.b1_per_id3 = bp.b1_per_id3 
								  AND SD.SET_ID = (SELECT SET_ID 
													FROM SETHEADER 
													WHERE RECORD_SET_TYPE = 'LIEN_NOTICES'
													AND SET_STATUS = 'Open')
												--	AND set_date > '2026-06-01')

WHERE
    bp.b1_per_type = 'Common' 
    AND bp.b1_per_sub_type = 'Inspection'
    AND   pd.BALANCE >= 1
    AND  ( nf.EXEMPT_RECOMMEND_DATE IS NULL AND nf.NO_FEE_DATE IS NULL)

ORDER BY
    bp.b1_alt_id;

WITH CUST_FIELDS AS
(
SELECT SERV_PROV_CODE,
       B1_PER_ID1,
       B1_PER_ID2,
       B1_PER_ID3,
	   [Division FP Unit] AS UNIT,
       [DBA] AS DBA,
       [Creation Date/Time] AS CREATEDATE,
       [HEARING DATE] AS HEARING_DATE,
       [HEARING TIME] AS HEARING_TIME,
       [COMPLIANCE DATE] AS COMPLIANCE_DATE,
       [INSPECTOR NAME] AS INSPECTOR_NAME,
       [INSPECTOR ID] AS INSPECTOR_ID,
	   [Advised by: Name] AS ADVISED_NAME,
	   [Advised by: Position or Relationship to building] AS ADVISED_RELA,
	   [Affixed Summons at location] AS AFFIXED_LOCA,
	   [Service Method] AS SERVICE_METHOD,
       [Description of Violation] AS VIOLATION_DESC,
       [REPEAT OFFENDER] AS MOS,
       [City Agency] AS CITY_AGENCY,                               
	   [prefix] AS DCP_ST_PFX,
	   [street_name] AS DCP_ST_NAME,
	   [ending] AS DCP_ST_TYPE,
	   [suffix] AS DCP_ST_SFX,
	   [Type] AS SYST_TYPE
  FROM 
    (SELECT C.SERV_PROV_CODE,
               C.B1_PER_ID1,
               C.B1_PER_ID2,
               C.B1_PER_ID3,
               UPPER (C.B1_CHECKLIST_COMMENT) B1_CHECKLIST_COMMENT,
               C.B1_CHECKBOX_DESC
          FROM BCHCKBOX C
   JOIN #TMP_RECORDLIST iv ON iv.serv_prov_code = C.serv_prov_code
                                  AND iv.b1_per_id1 = C.b1_per_id1
                                  AND iv.b1_per_id2 = C.b1_per_id2
                                  AND iv.b1_per_id3 = C.b1_per_id3
		  ) PV1 PIVOT (MIN (B1_CHECKLIST_COMMENT)
                           FOR B1_CHECKBOX_DESC
                           IN  ([Division FP Unit],
                               [DBA],
                               [Creation Date/Time],
                               [HEARING DATE],
                               [HEARING TIME],
                               [COMPLIANCE DATE],
                               [INSPECTOR NAME],
                               [INSPECTOR ID],
							   [Advised by: Name],
							   [Advised by: Position or Relationship to building],
							   [Affixed Summons at location],
							   [Service Method],
							   [prefix],
							   [street_name],
							   [ending],
							   [suffix],
                               [Type],
                               [REPEAT OFFENDER],
                               [City Agency],
                               [Description of Violation])) PV2
)
   select * INTO #TMP_CUST_FIELDS from CUST_FIELDS;

WITH vio_data AS (

SELECT
      SERV_PROV_CODE,
      B1_PER_ID1,
      B1_PER_ID2,
      B1_PER_ID3,
       UPPER(VO_CAT) AS VO_CAT,
       ROW_NUMBER()
        OVER(PARTITION BY SERV_PROV_CODE, B1_PER_ID1, B1_PER_ID2, B1_PER_ID3   ORDER BY   vo_cat DESC ) rn

       
     
FROM
       (

                SELECT
                       bap.SERV_PROV_CODE,
                        bap.B1_PER_ID1,
                        bap.B1_PER_ID2,
                        bap.B1_PER_ID3,
					   MAX(CASE WHEN bap.COLUMN_NAME='Violation Category' THEN bap.ATTRIBUTE_VALUE END)     AS VO_CAT


                FROM
                       BAPPSPECTABLE_VALUE bap
    JOIN #TMP_RECORDLIST iv ON iv.serv_prov_code = bap.serv_prov_code
                              AND iv.b1_per_id1 = bap.b1_per_id1
                              AND iv.b1_per_id2 = bap.b1_per_id2
                              AND iv.b1_per_id3 = bap.b1_per_id3

                WHERE 1=1
                         AND bap.TABLE_NAME    = 'LIST OF VIOLATION CODES'
                         --
                GROUP BY
                        bap.SERV_PROV_CODE,
                        bap.B1_PER_ID1,
                        bap.B1_PER_ID2,
                        bap.B1_PER_ID3,
                        bap.ROW_INDEX,
                        bap.TABLE_NAME
       ) xx
    
GROUP BY 
                       SERV_PROV_CODE,
                        B1_PER_ID1,
                        B1_PER_ID2,
                        B1_PER_ID3,
                        VO_CAT
),

VC_CODES AS (
    SELECT
        vd.SERV_PROV_CODE,
        vd.B1_PER_ID1,
        vd.B1_PER_ID2,
        vd.B1_PER_ID3,
        vd.vo_cat,
        vd.rn,

        MAX(CASE WHEN  vd.rn = 1 THEN vd.vo_cat END) OVER (PARTITION BY vd.SERV_PROV_CODE, vd.B1_PER_ID1, vd.B1_PER_ID2, vd.B1_PER_ID3) AS VC1_CODE,
        MAX(CASE WHEN  vd.rn = 2 THEN vd.vo_cat END) OVER (PARTITION BY vd.SERV_PROV_CODE, vd.B1_PER_ID1, vd.B1_PER_ID2, vd.B1_PER_ID3) AS VC2_CODE,
        MAX(CASE WHEN  vd.rn = 3 THEN vd.vo_cat END) OVER (PARTITION BY vd.SERV_PROV_CODE, vd.B1_PER_ID1, vd.B1_PER_ID2, vd.B1_PER_ID3) AS VC3_CODE,
        MAX(CASE WHEN  vd.rn = 4 THEN vd.vo_cat END) OVER (PARTITION BY vd.SERV_PROV_CODE, vd.B1_PER_ID1, vd.B1_PER_ID2, vd.B1_PER_ID3) AS VC4_CODE


    FROM
        vio_data vd


),

SUM_VC AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT
        vc.SERV_PROV_CODE,
        vc.B1_PER_ID1,
        vc.B1_PER_ID2,
        vc.B1_PER_ID3,
        vc.VC1_CODE,
        STDCHC1.VALUE_DESC AS VC1_DESC,
        vc.VC2_CODE,
        STDCHC2.VALUE_DESC AS VC2_DESC,
        vc.VC3_CODE,
        STDCHC3.VALUE_DESC AS VC3_DESC,
        vc.VC4_CODE,
        STDCHC4.VALUE_DESC AS VC4_DESC
    FROM
        VC_CODES vc

    LEFT JOIN RBIZDOMAIN_VALUE STDCHC1
        ON STDCHC1.BIZDOMAIN = 'VIOLATION_CODE_DESC_MAPPING'
        AND STDCHC1.BIZDOMAIN_VALUE = vc.VC1_CODE
    LEFT JOIN RBIZDOMAIN_VALUE STDCHC2
        ON STDCHC2.BIZDOMAIN = 'VIOLATION_CODE_DESC_MAPPING'
        AND STDCHC2.BIZDOMAIN_VALUE = vc.VC2_CODE
    LEFT JOIN RBIZDOMAIN_VALUE STDCHC3
        ON STDCHC3.BIZDOMAIN = 'VIOLATION_CODE_DESC_MAPPING'
        AND STDCHC3.BIZDOMAIN_VALUE = vc.VC3_CODE
    LEFT JOIN RBIZDOMAIN_VALUE STDCHC4
        ON STDCHC4.BIZDOMAIN = 'VIOLATION_CODE_DESC_MAPPING'
        AND STDCHC4.BIZDOMAIN_VALUE = vc.VC4_CODE
),

INFRACTION AS (
SELECT --DISTINCT
    sv.SERV_PROV_CODE, 
    sv.B1_PER_ID1,
    sv.B1_PER_ID2,
    sv.B1_PER_ID3,
    sv.VC1_code C1_VC,
	sv.VC1_DESC C1_VC_DESC,
    sv.VC2_code C2_VC,
	sv.VC2_DESC C2_VC_DESC,
    sv.VC3_code C3_VC,
	sv.VC3_DESC C3_VC_DESC,
    sv.VC4_code C4_VC,
	sv.VC4_DESC C4_VC_DESC
  FROM SUM_VC sv

),
--) SELECT * FROM INFRACTION
APO AS (
select SERV_PROV_CODE,
		B1_PER_ID1,
		B1_PER_ID2,
		B1_PER_ID3,
		[BIN] as BIN,
		[BLOCK] as BLOCK,
		[LOT] as LOT,
		[ADMIN COMPANY] as ADMIN_CO
 from 
(
SELECT
    apo.serv_prov_code AS SERV_PROV_CODE,
    apo.b1_per_id1 AS B1_PER_ID1,
	apo.b1_per_id2 AS B1_PER_ID2,
    apo.b1_per_id3 AS B1_PER_ID3,
    apo.b1_attribute_name,
    apo.b1_attribute_value
 FROM
         b3apo_attribute apo
   JOIN #TMP_RECORDLIST iv ON iv.serv_prov_code = APO.serv_prov_code
                                  AND iv.b1_per_id1 = APO.b1_per_id1
                                  AND iv.b1_per_id2 = APO.b1_per_id2
                                  AND iv.b1_per_id3 = APO.b1_per_id3

WHERE
    apo.b1_attribute_name IN ( 'BIN', 'BLOCK','LOT', 'ADMIN COMPANY' )
    AND apo.b1_apo_type IN ('ADDRESS')
    ) pva
PIVOT ( MAX(b1_attribute_value) for b1_attribute_name
            IN([BIN],
			[BLOCK],
			[LOT],
			[ADMIN COMPANY])) pvb
),
do_unit AS (
select SERV_PROV_CODE,
       B1_PER_ID1,
	   B1_PER_ID2,
	   B1_PER_ID3,
	   [D.O.] as ACTDO
 from 
(
SELECT
    bc.serv_prov_code AS SERV_PROV_CODE,
    bc.b1_per_id1 AS B1_PER_ID1,
    bc.b1_per_id2 AS B1_PER_ID2,
    bc.b1_per_id3 AS B1_PER_ID3,
    
    bc.b1_checkbox_desc,
    bc.b1_checklist_comment
 FROM
         bchckbox bc
WHERE
    bc.b1_checkbox_desc IN ('D.O.' )
    AND bc.b1_checkbox_type IN ('PERMIT REPORT INFO')
    ) pvia
PIVOT ( MAX(b1_checklist_comment) for b1_checkbox_desc
            IN([D.O.])) pvib
),
CONTACT AS (
    SELECT
        serv_prov_code,
        b1_per_id1,
        b1_per_id2,
        b1_per_id3,
        contact_name,
        rec_date,
        b1_contact_type,
        agency_code
    FROM
        (
            SELECT
            b.serv_prov_code,
            b.b1_per_id1,
            b.b1_per_id2,
            b.b1_per_id3,
               COALESCE(b.b1_full_name,b.b1_business_name,CONCAT(b1_fname,' ',b1_lname)) as contact_name,
                b.rec_date,
                b.b1_contact_type,
                substring(gt.field_value,1,3) as agency_code,
                ROW_NUMBER()
                OVER(PARTITION BY b.serv_prov_code, b.b1_per_id1, b.b1_per_id2, b.b1_per_id3
                     ORDER BY
                         b.rec_date DESC 
                ) rn
            FROM
                b3contact b
                INNER JOIN gtmpl_attribute gt ON b.b1_contact_nbr = gt.entity_seq1

            WHERE 1=1
               and  b.b1_contact_type IN ('Respondent') 
               AND gt.field_name = 'Agency Code'
--                and b.b1_contact_type_flag = 'City Agency'

        ) tr
    WHERE
        rn = 1
), 
ACCT_DATA AS
(
SELECT
    bp.serv_prov_code,
    bp.b1_per_id1,
    bp.b1_per_id2,
    bp.b1_per_id3, 
	xr.b1_master_id1,
	xr.b1_master_id2,
	xr.b1_master_id3,
	bpl.b1_alt_id AS ACCTNUM,
	du.actdo,
    bpl.b1_per_type AS ACCTPERTYPE,              
    bpl.b1_per_sub_type AS ACCTSUBTYPE,          
    bpl.b1_appl_status AS ACCTAPPSTATUS,          
    bpl.b1_appl_status_date AS ACCTAPPSTATUSDATE,  
--	bpl.REC_STATUS,
--	bp.REC_STATUS BP_REC_STATUS,
    xr.b1_relationship,
    bp.b1_alt_id                 AS ENFNUM,
    bp.b1_per_type               AS ENFPERTYPE,
    bp.b1_per_sub_type           AS ENFPERSUBTYPE,
    bp.b1_appl_status            AS ENFAPPSTATUS,
    bp.b1_appl_status_date       AS ENFAPPSTATUSDATE
FROM
         xapp2ref xr
   JOIN #TMP_RECORDLIST iv ON iv.serv_prov_code = XR.serv_prov_code
                                  AND iv.b1_per_id1 = XR.b1_per_id1
                                  AND iv.b1_per_id2 = XR.b1_per_id2
                                  AND iv.b1_per_id3 = XR.b1_per_id3

    INNER JOIN b1permit  bp ON bp.serv_prov_code = xr.serv_prov_code
                                  AND bp.b1_per_id1 = xr.b1_per_id1
                                  AND bp.b1_per_id2 = xr.b1_per_id2
                                  AND bp.b1_per_id3 = xr.b1_per_id3
    INNER JOIN b1permit  bpl ON bpl.serv_prov_code = xr.serv_prov_code
                                            AND bpl.b1_per_id1 = xr.b1_master_id1
                                            AND bpl.b1_per_id2 = xr.b1_master_id2
                                            AND bpl.b1_per_id3 = xr.b1_master_id3   
LEFT JOIN do_unit DU  ON  du.SERV_PROV_CODE = bpl.serv_prov_code
								AND du.B1_PER_ID1 = bpl.b1_per_id1
								AND du.B1_PER_ID2 = bpl.b1_per_id2
								AND du.B1_PER_ID3 = bpl.b1_per_id3


WHERE
        bpl.b1_per_type = 'Common'
        and bpl.b1_per_sub_type = 'Inspection'
		AND bpl.b1_appl_status <> 'Inactive'
),

--) SELECT * FROM ACCT_DATA WHERE ENFNUM  = '014041698H'
BOROUGH_ZIP_CODE AS (
select 
	VALUE_DESC, 
	BIZDOMAIN_VALUE as borough_zip,
	( CASE
      WHEN TRIM (UPPER (VALUE_DESC)) IN ('MANHATTAN')    THEN   '1'
                WHEN TRIM (UPPER (VALUE_DESC)) = 'BRONX' THEN '2'
                WHEN TRIM (UPPER (VALUE_DESC)) = 'BROOKLYN' THEN '3'
                WHEN TRIM (UPPER (VALUE_DESC)) = 'QUEENS' THEN '4'
                WHEN TRIM (UPPER (VALUE_DESC)) = 'STATEN ISLAND' THEN '5'  
                ELSE  ' '
             END) borough_code
from  RBIZDOMAIN_VALUE 
where BIZDOMAIN= 'REF_BORO_ZIP' 
and SERV_PROV_CODE='FDNY' 
and REC_STATUS='A'
),

LEFT JOIN PUSER PU ON PU.EMPLOYEE_ID = C.INSPECTOR_ID
LEFT JOIN G3STAFFS S ON PU.USER_NAME = S.GA_USER_ID

WITH AIMVADD AS
(
SELECT
	B1_CONTACT_NBR, 
	G7_HSE_NBR_ALPHA_START,
	G7_STR_NAME,
	G7_CITY,
	G7_STATE,
	G7_ZIP,
	G7_ADDRESS_TYPE,
	rec_date,
	RN
FROM
(
SELECT 
	XREC.B1_CONTACT_NBR, 
	G7A.G7_HSE_NBR_ALPHA_START,
	G7A.G7_STR_NAME,
	G7A.G7_CITY,
	G7A.G7_STATE,
	G7A.G7_ZIP,
	G7A.G7_ADDRESS_TYPE,
	G7A.rec_date,
	ROW_NUMBER()
       OVER(PARTITION BY XREC.B1_CONTACT_NBR
            ORDER BY   G7A.rec_date DESC ) rn
  FROM G7CONTACT_ADDRESS G7A
       LEFT JOIN XRECORD_CONTACT_ENTITY XREC
          ON     G7A.G7_ENTITY_TYPE = XREC.ENT_TYPE
             AND G7A.RES_ID = XREC.ENT_ID1
             AND G7A.SERV_PROV_CODE = XREC.SERV_PROV_CODE
             AND XREC.REC_STATUS = 'A'
	WHERE
		G7A.G7_ADDRESS_TYPE = 'Mailing Address' 
	AND XREC.B1_CONTACT_NBR IS NOT NULL
) TR
   WHERE RN = 1
),
OATH_ENTRY AS
(
SELECT SERV_PROV_CODE,
       B1_PER_ID1,
       B1_PER_ID2,
       B1_PER_ID3,
	   [Entered in OAth] AS ENTERED_IN_OATH,
       [OATH HEARING DATE] AS OATH_HRG_DATE

  FROM 
    (SELECT C.SERV_PROV_CODE,
               C.B1_PER_ID1,
               C.B1_PER_ID2,
               C.B1_PER_ID3,
               C.B1_CHECKLIST_COMMENT,
               C.B1_CHECKBOX_DESC
          FROM BCHCKBOX C
		  ) PV1 PIVOT (MIN (B1_CHECKLIST_COMMENT)
                           FOR B1_CHECKBOX_DESC
                         IN  ([Entered in OAth],
                               [OATH HEARING DATE]
)) PV2
),
GP_HIST as (
SELECT SERV_PROV_CODE,
		B1_PER_ID1,
		B1_PER_ID2,
		B1_PER_ID3,
		sd_pro_des,
		sd_app_des,
		sd_app_dd,
		rn
FROM
	(SELECT gp.SERV_PROV_CODE,
		gp.B1_PER_ID1,
		gp.B1_PER_ID2,
	    gp.B1_PER_ID3,
		gp.sd_pro_des,
		gp.sd_app_des,
		gp.sd_app_dd,
		ROW_NUMBER()
			OVER(PARTITION BY gp.SERV_PROV_CODE, gp.B1_PER_ID1, gp.B1_PER_ID2, gp.B1_PER_ID3   ORDER BY   gp.sd_app_dd DESC ) rn
	   FROM  gprocess_history gp    
--WHERE 1=1
--	   AND gp.sd_pro_des = 'Supervisor Review'
--	   AND gp.sd_app_des = 'Approved'
--	   AND gp.sd_app_dd > getdate() - 90

) TR
	WHERE RN = 1

),
SUMMONS_SET AS (
SELECT 
    sd.serv_prov_code,
    sd.b1_per_id1,
    sd.b1_per_id2,
    sd.b1_per_id3,
    sh.set_id,
    sh.set_status,
    CAST(sh.set_date as date) set_date,
	b.b1_alt_id record_id,
    sd.set_seq_nbr,
    sd.rec_date,
    sd.rec_ful_nam,
    sd.rec_status,
    sd.audit_init_by,
    sd.audit_init_date,
    sd.audit_mod_by,
    sd.audit_mod_date

FROM B1PERMIT B
    INNER JOIN SETDETAILS SD
    ON SD.SERV_PROV_CODE= B.SERV_PROV_CODE
    AND SD.B1_PER_ID1 = B.B1_PER_ID1
    AND SD.B1_PER_ID2 = B.B1_PER_ID2
    AND SD.B1_PER_ID3 = B.B1_PER_ID3  

    INNER JOIN SETHEADER SH
    ON SH.SERV_PROV_CODE = SD.SERV_PROV_CODE
    AND SH.SET_ID = SD.SET_ID

WHERE 1=1
    AND sd.set_id LIKE 'FDNY_SUMMONS_ECB%'
    AND CAST(sh.set_date as date) = CAST(DATEADD(day, -1, GETDATE()) AS DATE)
    and sd.SERV_PROV_CODE='FDNY' 
    and sd.REC_STATUS='A'
),

SUM_DATA AS (

			  AND A.B1_CONTACT_TYPE = 'Respondent'
	LEFT JOIN B3ADDRES B3A  ON  BP.SERV_PROV_CODE = B3A.SERV_PROV_CODE

LEFT JOIN AIMVADD A1 ON 
A1.B1_CONTACT_NBR = A.B1_CONTACT_NBR

CUST_FIELDS AS
(
SELECT SERV_PROV_CODE,
       B1_PER_ID1,
       B1_PER_ID2,
       B1_PER_ID3,
	   [Division FP Unit] AS UNIT,
       [DBA] AS DBA,
       [Creation Date/Time] AS CREATEDATE,
       [HEARING DATE] AS HEARING_DATE,
       [HEARING TIME] AS HEARING_TIME,
       [COMPLIANCE DATE] AS COMPLIANCE_DATE,
       [INSPECTOR NAME] AS INSPECTOR_NAME,
       [INSPECTOR ID] AS INSPECTOR_ID,
	   [Advised by: Name] AS ADVISED_NAME,
	   [Advised by: Position or Relationship to building] AS ADVISED_RELA,
	   [Affixed Summons at location] AS AFFIXED_LOCA,
	   [Service Method] AS SERVICE_METHOD,
       [Description of Violation] AS VIOLATION_DESC,
	   [prefix] AS DCP_ST_PFX,
	   [street_name] AS DCP_ST_NAME,
	   [ending] AS DCP_ST_TYPE,
	   [suffix] AS DCP_ST_SFX,
	   [Type] AS SYST_TYPE
  FROM 
    (SELECT C.SERV_PROV_CODE,
               C.B1_PER_ID1,
               C.B1_PER_ID2,
               C.B1_PER_ID3,
               UPPER (C.B1_CHECKLIST_COMMENT) B1_CHECKLIST_COMMENT,
               C.B1_CHECKBOX_DESC
          FROM BCHCKBOX C
   -- Replaced #TMP_RECORDLIST with RECORDLIST CTE
   JOIN RECORDLIST iv ON iv.serv_prov_code = C.serv_prov_code
                       AND iv.b1_per_id1 = C.b1_per_id1
                       AND iv.b1_per_id2 = C.b1_per_id2
                       AND iv.b1_per_id3 = C.b1_per_id3
		  ) PV1 PIVOT (MIN (B1_CHECKLIST_COMMENT)
                           FOR B1_CHECKBOX_DESC
                           IN  ([Division FP Unit],
                               [DBA],
                               [Creation Date/Time],
                               [HEARING DATE],
                               [HEARING TIME],
                               [COMPLIANCE DATE],
                               [INSPECTOR NAME],
                               [INSPECTOR ID],
							   [Advised by: Name],
							   [Advised by: Position or Relationship to building],
							   [Affixed Summons at location],
							   [Service Method],
							   [prefix],
							   [street_name],
							   [ending],
							   [suffix],
                               [Type],
                               [Description of Violation])) PV2
),
-- Removed: select * INTO #TMP_CUST_FIELDS from CUST_FIELDS;
-- Removed: --  SELECT * FROM #TMP_CUST_FIELDS

vio_data AS (
select 
    SERV_PROV_CODE,
    B1_PER_ID1,
    B1_PER_ID2,
    B1_PER_ID3,
    ROW_INDEX,
    [Violation Category] AS INFR,
    [Comments] AS INF_CMNTS

FROM (
     SELECT 
    bap.serv_prov_code AS SERV_PROV_CODE,
    bap.b1_per_id1 AS B1_PER_ID1,
    bap.b1_per_id2 AS B1_PER_ID2,
    bap.b1_per_id3 AS B1_PER_ID3,
    bap.ROW_INDEX AS ROW_INDEX,
    bap.COLUMN_NAME,
    bap.attribute_value
    FROM
         bappspectable_value bap
    -- Replaced #TMP_RECORDLIST with RECORDLIST CTE
    JOIN RECORDLIST iv ON iv.serv_prov_code = bap.serv_prov_code
                              AND iv.b1_per_id1 = bap.b1_per_id1
                              AND iv.b1_per_id2 = bap.b1_per_id2
                              AND iv.b1_per_id3 = bap.b1_per_id3
    WHERE
          bap.TABLE_NAME = 'LIST OF VIOLATION CODES'
         AND bap.COLUMN_NAME IN ('Violation Category', 'Comments')
		 AND bap.SERV_PROV_CODE = 'FDNY'
	--	  AND bap.ROW_INDEX = 1
    ) pva   

    PIVOT (MAX (ATTRIBUTE_VALUE)
    FOR COLUMN_NAME
    IN  ([Violation Category],
		[Comments])) pvb
WHERE
      [Violation Category] IS NOT NULL

), 
-- Removed: --select * from vio_data
-- Removed: --   select * INTO #TMP_vio_data from vio_data;
-- Removed: --  select * from #TMP_vio_data

VC_CODES AS (
    SELECT
        vd.SERV_PROV_CODE,
        vd.B1_PER_ID1,
        vd.B1_PER_ID2,
        vd.B1_PER_ID3,
        vd.ROW_INDEX,
        MAX(CASE WHEN  vd.ROW_INDEX = 0 THEN vd.infr END) OVER (PARTITION BY vd.SERV_PROV_CODE, vd.B1_PER_ID1, vd.B1_PER_ID2, vd.B1_PER_ID3) AS VC1_CODE,
        MAX(CASE WHEN  vd.ROW_INDEX = 1 THEN vd.infr END) OVER (PARTITION BY vd.SERV_PROV_CODE, vd.B1_PER_ID1, vd.B1_PER_ID2, vd.B1_PER_ID3) AS VC2_CODE,
        MAX(CASE WHEN  vd.ROW_INDEX = 2 THEN vd.infr END) OVER (PARTITION BY vd.SERV_PROV_CODE, vd.B1_PER_ID1, vd.B1_PER_ID2, vd.B1_PER_ID3) AS VC3_CODE,
        MAX(CASE WHEN  vd.ROW_INDEX = 3 THEN vd.infr END) OVER (PARTITION BY vd.SERV_PROV_CODE, vd.B1_PER_ID1, vd.B1_PER_ID2, vd.B1_PER_ID3) AS VC4_CODE,

		MAX(CASE WHEN  vd.ROW_INDEX = 0 THEN vd.inf_cmnts END) OVER (PARTITION BY vd.SERV_PROV_CODE, vd.B1_PER_ID1, vd.B1_PER_ID2, vd.B1_PER_ID3) AS VC1_CMNTS,
        MAX(CASE WHEN  vd.ROW_INDEX = 1 THEN vd.inf_cmnts END) OVER (PARTITION BY vd.SERV_PROV_CODE, vd.B1_PER_ID1, vd.B1_PER_ID2, vd.B1_PER_ID3) AS VC2_CMNTS,
        MAX(CASE WHEN  vd.ROW_INDEX = 2 THEN vd.inf_cmnts END) OVER (PARTITION BY vd.SERV_PROV_CODE, vd.B1_PER_ID1, vd.B1_PER_ID2, vd.B1_PER_ID3) AS VC3_CMNTS,
        MAX(CASE WHEN  vd.ROW_INDEX = 3 THEN vd.inf_cmnts END) OVER (PARTITION BY vd.SERV_PROV_CODE, vd.B1_PER_ID1, vd.B1_PER_ID2, vd.B1_PER_ID3) AS VC4_CMNTS

    FROM
        vio_data vd

),

SUM_VC AS (
    SELECT
        vc.SERV_PROV_CODE,
        vc.B1_PER_ID1,
        vc.B1_PER_ID2,
        vc.B1_PER_ID3,
        vc.ROW_INDEX,
        vc.VC1_CODE,
		vc.VC1_CMNTS,
        STDCHC1.VALUE_DESC AS VC1_DESC,
        vc.VC2_CODE,
		vc.VC2_CMNTS,
        STDCHC2.VALUE_DESC AS VC2_DESC,
        vc.VC3_CODE,
		vc.VC3_CMNTS,
        STDCHC3.VALUE_DESC AS VC3_DESC,
        vc.VC4_CODE,
		vc.VC4_CMNTS,
        STDCHC4.VALUE_DESC AS VC4_DESC
    FROM
        VC_CODES vc

    LEFT JOIN RBIZDOMAIN_VALUE STDCHC1
        ON STDCHC1.BIZDOMAIN = 'VIOLATION_CODE_DESC_MAPPING'
        AND STDCHC1.BIZDOMAIN_VALUE = vc.VC1_CODE
    LEFT JOIN RBIZDOMAIN_VALUE STDCHC2
        ON STDCHC2.BIZDOMAIN = 'VIOLATION_CODE_DESC_MAPPING'
        AND STDCHC2.BIZDOMAIN_VALUE = vc.VC2_CODE
    LEFT JOIN RBIZDOMAIN_VALUE STDCHC3
        ON STDCHC3.BIZDOMAIN = 'VIOLATION_CODE_DESC_MAPPING'
        AND STDCHC3.BIZDOMAIN_VALUE = vc.VC3_CODE
    LEFT JOIN RBIZDOMAIN_VALUE STDCHC4
        ON STDCHC4.BIZDOMAIN = 'VIOLATION_CODE_DESC_MAPPING'
        AND STDCHC4.BIZDOMAIN_VALUE = vc.VC4_CODE
),

INFRACTION AS (
SELECT --DISTINCT
    sv.SERV_PROV_CODE, 
    sv.B1_PER_ID1,
    sv.B1_PER_ID2,
    sv.B1_PER_ID3,
    sv.VC1_code C1_VC,
	sv.VC1_CMNTS,
	sv.VC1_DESC C1_VC_DESC,
    sv.VC2_code C2_VC,
	sv.VC2_CMNTS,
	sv.VC2_DESC C2_VC_DESC,
    sv.VC3_code C3_VC,
	sv.VC3_CMNTS,
	sv.VC3_DESC C3_VC_DESC,
    sv.VC4_code C4_VC,
	sv.VC4_CMNTS ,
	sv.VC4_DESC C4_VC_DESC
  FROM SUM_VC sv

),
--) SELECT * FROM INFRACTION
APO AS (
select SERV_PROV_CODE,
		B1_PER_ID1,
		B1_PER_ID2,
		B1_PER_ID3,
		[BIN] as BIN,
		[BLOCK] as BLOCK,
		[LOT] as LOT,
		[ADMIN COMPANY] as ADMIN_CO
 from 
(
SELECT
    apo.serv_prov_code AS SERV_PROV_CODE,
    apo.b1_per_id1 AS B1_PER_ID1,
	apo.b1_per_id2 AS B1_PER_ID2,
    apo.b1_per_id3 AS B1_PER_ID3,
    apo.b1_attribute_name,
    apo.b1_attribute_value
 FROM
         b3apo_attribute apo
   -- Replaced #TMP_RECORDLIST with RECORDLIST CTE
   JOIN RECORDLIST iv ON iv.serv_prov_code = APO.serv_prov_code
                             AND iv.b1_per_id1 = APO.b1_per_id1
                             AND iv.b1_per_id2 = APO.b1_per_id2
                             AND iv.b1_per_id3 = APO.b1_per_id3

WHERE
    apo.b1_attribute_name IN ( 'BIN', 'BLOCK','LOT', 'ADMIN COMPANY' )
    AND apo.b1_apo_type IN ('ADDRESS')
    ) pva
PIVOT ( MAX(b1_attribute_value) for b1_attribute_name
            IN([BIN],
			[BLOCK],
			[LOT],
			[ADMIN COMPANY])) pvb
),
do_unit AS (
select SERV_PROV_CODE,
       B1_PER_ID1,
	   B1_PER_ID2,
	   B1_PER_ID3,
	   [D.O.] as ACTDO
 from 
(
SELECT
    bc.serv_prov_code AS SERV_PROV_CODE,
    bc.b1_per_id1 AS B1_PER_ID1,
    bc.b1_per_id2 AS B1_PER_ID2,
    bc.b1_per_id3 AS B1_PER_ID3,
    
    bc.b1_checkbox_desc,
    bc.b1_checklist_comment
 FROM
         bchckbox bc
WHERE
    bc.b1_checkbox_desc IN ('D.O.' )
    AND bc.b1_checkbox_type IN ('PERMIT REPORT INFO')
    ) pvia
PIVOT ( MAX(b1_checklist_comment) for b1_checkbox_desc
            IN([D.O.])) pvib
),
ACCT_DATA AS
(
SELECT
    bp.serv_prov_code,
    bp.b1_per_id1,
    bp.b1_per_id2,
    bp.b1_per_id3, 
	xr.b1_master_id1,
	xr.b1_master_id2,
	xr.b1_master_id3,
	bpl.b1_alt_id AS ACCTNUM,
	du.actdo,
    bpl.b1_per_type AS ACCTPERTYPE,              
    bpl.b1_per_sub_type AS ACCTSUBTYPE,          
    bpl.b1_appl_status AS ACCTAPPSTATUS,          
    bpl.b1_appl_status_date AS ACCTAPPSTATUSDATE,  
--	bpl.REC_STATUS,
--	bp.REC_STATUS BP_REC_STATUS,
    xr.b1_relationship,
    bp.b1_alt_id                 AS ENFNUM,
    bp.b1_per_type               AS ENFPERTYPE,
    bp.b1_per_sub_type           AS ENFPERSUBTYPE,
    bp.b1_appl_status            AS ENFAPPSTATUS,
    bp.b1_appl_status_date       AS ENFAPPSTATUSDATE
FROM
         xapp2ref xr
   -- Replaced #TMP_RECORDLIST with RECORDLIST CTE
   JOIN RECORDLIST iv ON iv.serv_prov_code = XR.serv_prov_code
                             AND iv.b1_per_id1 = XR.b1_per_id1
                             AND iv.b1_per_id2 = XR.b1_per_id2
                             AND iv.b1_per_id3 = XR.b1_per_id3

    INNER JOIN b1permit  bp ON bp.serv_prov_code = xr.serv_prov_code
                             AND bp.b1_per_id1 = xr.b1_per_id1
                             AND bp.b1_per_id2 = xr.b1_per_id2
                             AND bp.b1_per_id3 = xr.b1_per_id3
    INNER JOIN b1permit  bpl ON bpl.serv_prov_code = xr.serv_prov_code
                                            AND bpl.b1_per_id1 = xr.b1_master_id1
                                            AND bpl.b1_per_id2 = xr.b1_master_id2
                                            AND bpl.b1_per_id3 = xr.b1_master_id3   
LEFT JOIN do_unit DU  ON  du.SERV_PROV_CODE = bpl.serv_prov_code
								AND du.B1_PER_ID1 = bpl.b1_per_id1
								AND du.B1_PER_ID2 = bpl.b1_per_id2
								AND du.B1_PER_ID3 = bpl.b1_per_id3

WHERE
        bpl.b1_per_type = 'Common'
        and bpl.b1_per_sub_type = 'Inspection'
		AND bpl.b1_appl_status <> 'Inactive'
),

--) SELECT * FROM ACCT_DATA WHERE ENFNUM  = '014041698H'
BOROUGH_ZIP_CODE AS (
select 
	VALUE_DESC, 
	BIZDOMAIN_VALUE as borough_zip,
	( CASE
      WHEN TRIM (UPPER (VALUE_DESC)) IN ('MANHATTAN')    THEN   '1'
                WHEN TRIM (UPPER (VALUE_DESC)) = 'BRONX' THEN '2'
                WHEN TRIM (UPPER (VALUE_DESC)) = 'BROOKLYN' THEN '3'
                WHEN TRIM (UPPER (VALUE_DESC)) = 'QUEENS' THEN '4'
                WHEN TRIM (UPPER (VALUE_DESC)) = 'STATEN ISLAND' THEN '5'  
                ELSE  ' '
             END) borough_code
from  RBIZDOMAIN_VALUE 
where BIZDOMAIN= 'REF_BORO_ZIP' 
and SERV_PROV_CODE='FDNY' 
and REC_STATUS='A'
),

RESULT_DATA AS (

CASE

    ELSE ''
  END VIOLATION_DATE,
CASE
    WHEN C.CREATEDATE IS NOT NULL THEN 
    FORMAT(TRY_CAST(C.CREATEDATE AS DATETIME), 'HHmmss')
    ELSE ''
  END VIOLATION_TIME,
'FIR' AS ISSUING_AGENCY,
C.INSPECTOR_ID ISSUING_OFFICER_ID,
C.INSPECTOR_NAME ISSUING_OFFICER_NAME,
RIGHT('0' + du.ACTDO, 2) ISSUING_UNIT,
( CASE
      WHEN TRIM (UPPER (B1P.B1_SITUS_CITY)) IN ('NY',
                                                 'NEW YORK',
                                                 'NEW YOK',
                                                 'NEW YORKQ',
                                                 'NYC',
                                                 'MANHATTAN') 
                                                 THEN   '1'
                WHEN TRIM (UPPER (B1P.B1_SITUS_CITY)) = 'BRONX' THEN '2'
                WHEN TRIM (UPPER (B1P.B1_SITUS_CITY)) = 'BROOKLYN' THEN '3'
                WHEN TRIM (UPPER (B1P.B1_SITUS_CITY)) = 'QUEENS' THEN '4'
                WHEN TRIM (UPPER (B1P.B1_SITUS_CITY)) = 'STATEN ISLAND' THEN '5' 
                ELSE  ' '
             END) ISSUING_BORO,
--B1P.B1_SITUS_CITY   ISSUING_BOROUGH,
SUBSTRING(B1P.EXT_ADDRESS_UID,CHARINDEX( '^aId=',B1P.EXT_ADDRESS_UID)+5,12) PREM_ADDRESS_ID,

B1P.EXT_ADDRESS_UID,
B1P.B1_HSE_NBR_ALPHA_START PREM_HOUSE_NUMBER, 
B1P.B1_STR_NAME  PREM_STREET_NAME,

SUBSTRING(B1P.B1_SITUS_ZIP,6,4) PREM_ZIP_4,
AO.BLOCK PREM_BLOCK,
AO.LOT PREM_LOT,
AO.BIN BIN,
  COALESCE(
    UPPER(B1P.B1_BUSINESS_NAME),
    UPPER(B1P.B1_LNAME),
    ''
  ) AS RESP_LAST_NAME,
  COALESCE(
    UPPER(B1P.B1_BUSINESS_NAME),
    UPPER(B1P.B1_FNAME),
    ''
  ) AS RESP_FIRST_NAME,
( CASE
      WHEN TRIM (UPPER (B1P.G7_CITY)) IN ('NY',
                                                 'NEW YORK',
                                                 'NEW YOK',
                                                 'NEW YORKQ',
                                                 'NYC',
                                                 'MANHATTAN')    THEN   '1'
                WHEN TRIM (UPPER (B1P.G7_CITY)) = 'BRONX' THEN '2'
                WHEN TRIM (UPPER (B1P.G7_CITY)) = 'BROOKLYN' THEN '3'
                WHEN TRIM (UPPER (B1P.G7_CITY)) = 'QUEENS' THEN '4'
                WHEN TRIM (UPPER (B1P.G7_CITY)) = 'STATEN ISLAND' THEN '5'  
                ELSE  '0'
             END) RESPONDENT_BORO,
UPPER(B1P.G7_HSE_NBR_ALPHA_START) RESPONDENT_HOUSE,
UPPER( B1P.G7_STR_NAME) RESPONDENT_STREET,
UPPER(B1P.G7_CITY) AS RESPONDENT_CITY,
UPPER(B1P.G7_STATE) AS RESPONDENT_STATE,
SUBSTRING(B1P.G7_ZIP,1,5) RESPONDENT_ZIP_5,
SUBSTRING(B1P.G7_ZIP,7,4) RESPONDENT_ZIP_4,
CONVERT(varchar, TRY_CAST(C.HEARING_DATE AS DATETIME), 112) HEARING_DATE,
CASE
    WHEN C.HEARING_TIME IS NOT NULL THEN 
	REPLACE(CONVERT(VARCHAR(8), TRY_CAST(C.HEARING_TIME AS DATETIME), 108), ':', '') 
    ELSE ''
  END HEARING_TIME,
  CONVERT(varchar, TRY_CAST(C.COMPLIANCE_DATE AS DATETIME), 112) COMPLIANCE_DATE,
( CASE
      WHEN TRIM (UPPER (B1P.B1_SITUS_CITY)) IN ('NY',
                                                 'NEW YORK',
                                                 'NEW YOK',
                                                 'NEW YORKQ',
                                                 'NYC',
                                                 'MANHATTAN')    THEN   '9'
              WHEN TRIM (UPPER (B1P.B1_SITUS_CITY)) = 'BRONX' THEN '7'
                WHEN TRIM (UPPER (B1P.B1_SITUS_CITY)) = 'BROOKLYN' THEN '4'
                WHEN TRIM (UPPER (B1P.B1_SITUS_CITY)) = 'QUEENS' THEN '8'
                WHEN TRIM (UPPER (B1P.B1_SITUS_CITY)) = 'STATEN ISLAND' THEN '2'  
                ELSE  ' '
             END) HEARING_LOCATION,


UPPER(dbo.FN_GET_STDCHOICE_VALUEDESC(
      B1P.SERV_PROV_CODE,
      'BFP_FSUM_HEARING_CENTERS',
      B1P.B1_SITUS_CITY
    )
  ) AS HEARING_CENTERS,
( CASE  WHEN TRY_CONVERT(INT,SUBSTRING(F.C1_VC,3,2)) IS NULL   THEN   ' ' ELSE concat('BF',RIGHT( '0' + CONVERT(VARCHAR,TRY_CONVERT(INT,SUBSTRING(F.C1_VC,3,2)) ),2) ) END) VC01,
( CASE  WHEN TRY_CONVERT(INT,SUBSTRING(F.C1_VC,3,2)) IS NULL   THEN   ' ' ELSE 'Y'  END) MOST01,
( CASE  WHEN TRY_CONVERT(INT,SUBSTRING(F.C2_VC,3,2)) IS NULL   THEN  ' ' ELSE concat('BF',RIGHT('0' + CONVERT(VARCHAR,TRY_CONVERT(INT,SUBSTRING(F.C2_VC,3,2))  ),2) ) END) VC02,
( CASE  WHEN TRY_CONVERT(INT,SUBSTRING(F.C2_VC,3,2)) IS NULL   THEN   ' ' ELSE 'Y'  END) MOST02,
( CASE  WHEN TRY_CONVERT(INT,SUBSTRING(F.C3_VC,3,2)) IS NULL    THEN   ' ' ELSE concat('BF',RIGHT('0' + CONVERT(VARCHAR,TRY_CONVERT(INT,SUBSTRING(F.C3_VC,3,2))  ),2) ) END) VC03,
( CASE  WHEN TRY_CONVERT(INT,SUBSTRING(F.C3_VC,3,2)) IS NULL   THEN   ' ' ELSE 'Y'  END) MOST03,
( CASE  WHEN TRY_CONVERT(INT,SUBSTRING(F.C4_VC,3,2)) IS NULL    THEN  ' ' ELSE  concat('BF',RIGHT('0' + CONVERT(VARCHAR,TRY_CONVERT(INT,SUBSTRING(F.C4_VC,3,2))  ),2) )  END) VC04,
( CASE  WHEN TRY_CONVERT(INT,SUBSTRING(F.C4_VC,3,2)) IS NULL   THEN   ' ' ELSE 'Y'  END) MOST04,

( CASE  WHEN TRY_CONVERT(INT,SUBSTRING(F.C3_VC,3,2)) IS NULL    THEN   ' ' ELSE F.VC3_CMNTS  END) VC03_CMNTS,
( CASE  WHEN TRY_CONVERT(INT,SUBSTRING(F.C4_VC,3,2)) IS NULL    THEN  ' ' ELSE  F.VC4_CMNTS  END) VC04_CMNTS,


( CASE  WHEN TRY_CONVERT(INT,SUBSTRING(F.C1_VC,3,2)) IS NULL   THEN   ' ' ELSE F.C1_VC_DESC END) VC01_DESC,
( CASE  WHEN TRY_CONVERT(INT,SUBSTRING(F.C2_VC,3,2)) IS NULL    THEN  ' ' ELSE F.C2_VC_DESC  END) VC02_DESC,
( CASE  WHEN TRY_CONVERT(INT,SUBSTRING(F.C3_VC,3,2)) IS NULL    THEN   ' ' ELSE F.C3_VC_DESC  END) VC03_DESC,
( CASE  WHEN TRY_CONVERT(INT,SUBSTRING(F.C4_VC,3,2)) IS NULL    THEN  ' ' ELSE  F.C4_VC_DESC  END) VC04_DESC,


AD.ACCTNUM FIR_ACCT,
CONVERT(varchar, TRY_CAST(C.COMPLIANCE_DATE AS DATETIME), 112) FIR_COMP,
CASE
    WHEN B1P.B1_PHONE1 IS NOT NULL
    AND LEN(B1P.B1_PHONE1) > 1 THEN  SUBSTRING(B1P.B1_PHONE1, 1, 3) +  SUBSTRING(B1P.B1_PHONE1, 4, 3)  + SUBSTRING(B1P.B1_PHONE1, 7, 4)
    WHEN B1P.B1_PHONE2 IS NOT NULL
    AND LEN(B1P.B1_PHONE2) > 1 THEN  SUBSTRING(B1P.B1_PHONE2, 1, 3) +  SUBSTRING(B1P.B1_PHONE2, 4, 3) +  SUBSTRING(B1P.B1_PHONE2, 7, 4)
    WHEN B1P.B1_PHONE3 IS NOT NULL
    AND LEN(B1P.B1_PHONE3) > 1 THEN  SUBSTRING(B1P.B1_PHONE3, 1, 3) + SUBSTRING(B1P.B1_PHONE3, 4, 3) +  SUBSTRING(B1P.B1_PHONE3, 7, 4)
    ELSE ''
  END RESPONDENT_PHONE_NUMBER,
CONVERT(varchar, B1P.B1_BIRTH_DATE, 112) RESPONDENT_DOB,
B1P.B1_GENDER RESPONDENT_GENDER,
B1P.B1_EMAIL RESPONDENT_EMAIL,
UPPER(C.UNIT) AS UNIT,
UPPER( dbo.FN_GET_STDCHOICE_VALUEDESC(B1P.SERV_PROV_CODE, 'BFP_UNIT_PHONE', C.UNIT) ) AS UNIT_PHONE,
C.DBA,
C.CREATEDATE,
CASE WHEN C.CREATEDATE IS NOT NULL THEN FORMAT(TRY_CAST(C.CREATEDATE AS DATETIME), 'yyyyMMdd') ELSE '' END CREATE_DATE,
CASE WHEN B1P.B1_FILE_DD IS NOT NULL THEN FORMAT(TRY_CAST(C.CREATEDATE AS DATETIME), 'HHmmss') ELSE '' END CREATE_TIME,
AO.ADMIN_CO,
-- S.GA_TITLE AS INSP_TITLE,

-- b1p.sd_app_des,

b1p.ENTERED_IN_OATH,
b1p.OATH_HRG_DATE,
Coalesce(TRY_CAST(C.ADVISED_NAME AS VARCHAR(25)),' ') ADVISED_NAME,
Coalesce(TRY_CAST(C.ADVISED_RELA AS VARCHAR(25)),' ') ADVISED_RELA,
Coalesce(C.AFFIXED_LOCA,' ') AFFIXED_LOCA,
Coalesce(C.SERVICE_METHOD,' ') SERVICE_METHOD,
--( CASE WHEN C.ADVISED_NAME IS NULL THEN ' ' ELSE (C.ADVISED_NAME||'/'||C.ADVISED_RELA) END) NAME_RELA,
ISNULL(CAST(bz.borough_code AS NVARCHAR(1)), '0') as borough_code,
ISNULL(CAST(bz.borough_zip AS NVARCHAR(5)), '00000') as borough_zip,
C.DCP_ST_PFX,
C.DCP_ST_NAME,
C.DCP_ST_TYPE,
C.DCP_ST_SFX,
C.SYST_TYPE
-- Replaced #TMP_RECORDLIST with RECORDLIST CTE
FROM RECORDLIST B1P 
LEFT JOIN APO AO ON B1P.SERV_PROV_CODE = AO.SERV_PROV_CODE AND B1P.B1_PER_ID1 = AO.B1_PER_ID1 AND B1P.B1_PER_ID2 = AO.B1_PER_ID2 AND B1P.B1_PER_ID3 = AO.B1_PER_ID3 
JOIN ACCT_DATA AD ON B1P.SERV_PROV_CODE = AD.SERV_PROV_CODE AND B1P.B1_PER_ID1 = AD.B1_PER_ID1 AND B1P.B1_PER_ID2 = AD.B1_PER_ID2 AND B1P.B1_PER_ID3 = AD.B1_PER_ID3 
LEFT JOIN do_unit DU ON ad.SERV_PROV_CODE = du.SERV_PROV_CODE AND ad.b1_master_id1 = du.B1_PER_ID1 AND ad.b1_master_id2 = du.B1_PER_ID2 AND ad.b1_master_id3 = du.B1_PER_ID3 
-- Replaced #TMP_CUST_FIELDS with CUST_FIELDS CTE
LEFT JOIN CUST_FIELDS C ON C.SERV_PROV_CODE = B1P.SERV_PROV_CODE AND C.B1_PER_ID1 = B1P.B1_PER_ID1 AND C.B1_PER_ID2 = B1P.B1_PER_ID2 AND C.B1_PER_ID3 = B1P.B1_PER_ID3 
LEFT JOIN RBIZDOMAIN_VALUE STDCHC1 ON STDCHC1.BIZDOMAIN = 'ENF_OATH_OFFICES_ADDRESS' AND STDCHC1.BIZDOMAIN_VALUE = B1P.B1_SITUS_CITY
LEFT JOIN RBIZDOMAIN_VALUE STDCHC2 ON STDCHC2.BIZDOMAIN = 'BFP_UNIT_PHONE' AND STDCHC2.BIZDOMAIN_VALUE = C.UNIT
LEFT JOIN RBIZDOMAIN_VALUE STDCHC3 ON STDCHC3.BIZDOMAIN = 'BFP_FSUM_HEARING_CENTERS' AND lower(STDCHC3.BIZDOMAIN_VALUE) = lower(B1P.B1_SITUS_CITY)
LEFT JOIN PUSER PU ON PU.EMPLOYEE_ID = C.INSPECTOR_ID
LEFT JOIN G3STAFFS S ON PU.USER_NAME = S.GA_USER_ID

WITH AIMVADD AS
(
SELECT
	B1_CONTACT_NBR, 
	G7_HSE_NBR_ALPHA_START,
	G7_STR_NAME,
	G7_CITY,
	G7_STATE,
	G7_ZIP,
	G7_ADDRESS_TYPE,
	rec_date,
	RN
FROM
(
SELECT 
	XREC.B1_CONTACT_NBR, 
	G7A.G7_HSE_NBR_ALPHA_START,
	G7A.G7_STR_NAME,
	G7A.G7_CITY,
	G7A.G7_STATE,
	G7A.G7_ZIP,
	G7A.G7_ADDRESS_TYPE,
	G7A.rec_date,
	ROW_NUMBER()
       OVER(PARTITION BY XREC.B1_CONTACT_NBR
            ORDER BY   G7A.rec_date DESC ) rn
  FROM G7CONTACT_ADDRESS G7A
       LEFT JOIN XRECORD_CONTACT_ENTITY XREC
          ON     G7A.G7_ENTITY_TYPE = XREC.ENT_TYPE
             AND G7A.RES_ID = XREC.ENT_ID1
             AND G7A.SERV_PROV_CODE = XREC.SERV_PROV_CODE
             AND XREC.REC_STATUS = 'A'
	WHERE
		G7A.G7_ADDRESS_TYPE = 'Mailing Address' 
	AND XREC.B1_CONTACT_NBR IS NOT NULL
) TR
   WHERE RN = 1
),
OATH_ENTRY AS
(
SELECT SERV_PROV_CODE,
       B1_PER_ID1,
       B1_PER_ID2,
       B1_PER_ID3,
	   [Entered in OAth] AS ENTERED_IN_OATH,
       [OATH HEARING DATE] AS OATH_HRG_DATE

  FROM 
    (SELECT C.SERV_PROV_CODE,
               C.B1_PER_ID1,
               C.B1_PER_ID2,
               C.B1_PER_ID3,
               C.B1_CHECKLIST_COMMENT,
               C.B1_CHECKBOX_DESC
          FROM BCHCKBOX C
		  ) PV1 PIVOT (MIN (B1_CHECKLIST_COMMENT)
                           FOR B1_CHECKBOX_DESC
                           IN  ([Entered in OAth],
                               [OATH HEARING DATE]
)) PV2
),
GP_HIST as (
SELECT SERV_PROV_CODE,
		B1_PER_ID1,
		B1_PER_ID2,
		B1_PER_ID3,
		sd_pro_des,
		sd_app_des,
		sd_app_dd,
		rn
FROM
	(SELECT gp.SERV_PROV_CODE,
		gp.B1_PER_ID1,
		gp.B1_PER_ID2,

			OVER(PARTITION BY gp.SERV_PROV_CODE, gp.B1_PER_ID1, gp.B1_PER_ID2, gp.B1_PER_ID3   ORDER BY   gp.sd_app_dd DESC ) rn
	   FROM  gprocess_history gp

	WHERE RN = 1

    AND SD.B1_PER_ID2 = B.B1_PER_ID2
    AND SD.B1_PER_ID3 = B.B1_PER_ID3

              AND A.B1_PER_ID3 = BP.B1_PER_ID3

								AND BP.B1_PER_ID1 = B3A.B1_PER_ID1
								AND BP.B1_PER_ID2 = B3A.B1_PER_ID2
								AND BP.B1_PER_ID3 = B3A.B1_PER_ID3
								AND B3A.B1_PRIMARY_ADDR_FLG = 'Y'
LEFT JOIN AIMVADD A1 ON A1.B1_CONTACT_NBR = A.B1_CONTACT_NBR


    WHERE 1=1
        AND bp.B1_PER_TYPE = 'Enforcement'
        AND bp.B1_PER_SUB_TYPE  = 'FDNY Summons'
        AND bp.REC_STATUS = 'A'
        AND bp.SERV_PROV_CODE = 'FDNY'
        AND bp.B1_PER_GROUP = 'BFP'
        AND bp.B1_PER_CATEGORY = 'NA'

-- SELECT * FROM #TMP_RECORDLIST
WITH CUST_FIELDS AS
(
SELECT SERV_PROV_CODE,
       B1_PER_ID1,
       B1_PER_ID2,
       B1_PER_ID3,
	   [Division FP Unit] AS UNIT,
       [DBA] AS DBA,
       [Creation Date/Time] AS CREATEDATE,
       [HEARING DATE] AS HEARING_DATE,
       [HEARING TIME] AS HEARING_TIME,
       [COMPLIANCE DATE] AS COMPLIANCE_DATE,
       [INSPECTOR NAME] AS INSPECTOR_NAME,
       [INSPECTOR ID] AS INSPECTOR_ID,
	   [Advised by: Name] AS ADVISED_NAME,
	   [Advised by: Position or Relationship to building] AS ADVISED_RELA,
	   [Affixed Summons at location] AS AFFIXED_LOCA,
	   [Service Method] AS SERVICE_METHOD,
       [Description of Violation] AS VIOLATION_DESC,
       [REPEAT OFFENDER] AS MOS,
       [City Agency] AS CITY_AGENCY,                               
	   [prefix] AS DCP_ST_PFX,
	   [street_name] AS DCP_ST_NAME,
	   [ending] AS DCP_ST_TYPE,
	   [suffix] AS DCP_ST_SFX,
	   [Type] AS SYST_TYPE
  FROM 
    (SELECT C.SERV_PROV_CODE,
               C.B1_PER_ID1,
               C.B1_PER_ID2,
               C.B1_PER_ID3,
               UPPER (C.B1_CHECKLIST_COMMENT) B1_CHECKLIST_COMMENT,
               C.B1_CHECKBOX_DESC
          FROM BCHCKBOX C
   JOIN #TMP_RECORDLIST iv ON iv.serv_prov_code = C.serv_prov_code
                                  AND iv.b1_per_id1 = C.b1_per_id1
                                  AND iv.b1_per_id2 = C.b1_per_id2
                                  AND iv.b1_per_id3 = C.b1_per_id3
		  ) PV1 PIVOT (MIN (B1_CHECKLIST_COMMENT)
                           FOR B1_CHECKBOX_DESC
                           IN  ([Division FP Unit],
                               [DBA],
                               [Creation Date/Time],
                               [HEARING DATE],
                               [HEARING TIME],
                               [COMPLIANCE DATE],
                               [INSPECTOR NAME],
                               [INSPECTOR ID],
							   [Advised by: Name],
							   [Advised by: Position or Relationship to building],
							   [Affixed Summons at location],
							   [Service Method],
							   [prefix],
							   [street_name],
							   [ending],
							   [suffix],
                               [Type],
                               [REPEAT OFFENDER],
                               [City Agency],
                               [Description of Violation])) PV2
)
   select * INTO #TMP_CUST_FIELDS from CUST_FIELDS;

 --  SELECT * FROM #TMP_CUST_FIELDS
WITH vio_data AS (

SELECT
      SERV_PROV_CODE,
      B1_PER_ID1,
      B1_PER_ID2,
      B1_PER_ID3,
       UPPER(VO_CAT) AS VO_CAT,
       ROW_NUMBER()
        OVER(PARTITION BY SERV_PROV_CODE, B1_PER_ID1, B1_PER_ID2, B1_PER_ID3   ORDER BY   vo_cat DESC ) rn

       
     
FROM
       (

                SELECT
                       bap.SERV_PROV_CODE,
                        bap.B1_PER_ID1,
                        bap.B1_PER_ID2,
                        bap.B1_PER_ID3,
					   MAX(CASE WHEN bap.COLUMN_NAME='Violation Category' THEN bap.ATTRIBUTE_VALUE END)     AS VO_CAT


                FROM
                       BAPPSPECTABLE_VALUE bap
    JOIN #TMP_RECORDLIST iv ON iv.serv_prov_code = bap.serv_prov_code
                              AND iv.b1_per_id1 = bap.b1_per_id1
                              AND iv.b1_per_id2 = bap.b1_per_id2
                              AND iv.b1_per_id3 = bap.b1_per_id3

                WHERE 1=1
                         AND bap.TABLE_NAME    = 'LIST OF VIOLATION CODES'
                         --
                GROUP BY
                        bap.SERV_PROV_CODE,
                        bap.B1_PER_ID1,
                        bap.B1_PER_ID2,
                        bap.B1_PER_ID3,
                        bap.ROW_INDEX,
                        bap.TABLE_NAME
       ) xx
    
GROUP BY 
                       SERV_PROV_CODE,
                        B1_PER_ID1,
                        B1_PER_ID2,
                        B1_PER_ID3,
                        VO_CAT
),

VC_CODES AS (
    SELECT
        vd.SERV_PROV_CODE,
        vd.B1_PER_ID1,
        vd.B1_PER_ID2,
        vd.B1_PER_ID3,
        vd.vo_cat,
        vd.rn,

        MAX(CASE WHEN  vd.rn = 1 THEN vd.vo_cat END) OVER (PARTITION BY vd.SERV_PROV_CODE, vd.B1_PER_ID1, vd.B1_PER_ID2, vd.B1_PER_ID3) AS VC1_CODE,
        MAX(CASE WHEN  vd.rn = 2 THEN vd.vo_cat END) OVER (PARTITION BY vd.SERV_PROV_CODE, vd.B1_PER_ID1, vd.B1_PER_ID2, vd.B1_PER_ID3) AS VC2_CODE,
        MAX(CASE WHEN  vd.rn = 3 THEN vd.vo_cat END) OVER (PARTITION BY vd.SERV_PROV_CODE, vd.B1_PER_ID1, vd.B1_PER_ID2, vd.B1_PER_ID3) AS VC3_CODE,
        MAX(CASE WHEN  vd.rn = 4 THEN vd.vo_cat END) OVER (PARTITION BY vd.SERV_PROV_CODE, vd.B1_PER_ID1, vd.B1_PER_ID2, vd.B1_PER_ID3) AS VC4_CODE


    FROM
        vio_data vd


),

SUM_VC AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT
        vc.SERV_PROV_CODE,
        vc.B1_PER_ID1,
        vc.B1_PER_ID2,
        vc.B1_PER_ID3,
        vc.VC1_CODE,
        STDCHC1.VALUE_DESC AS VC1_DESC,
        vc.VC2_CODE,
        STDCHC2.VALUE_DESC AS VC2_DESC,
        vc.VC3_CODE,
        STDCHC3.VALUE_DESC AS VC3_DESC,
        vc.VC4_CODE,
        STDCHC4.VALUE_DESC AS VC4_DESC
    FROM
        VC_CODES vc

    LEFT JOIN RBIZDOMAIN_VALUE STDCHC1
        ON STDCHC1.BIZDOMAIN = 'VIOLATION_CODE_DESC_MAPPING'
        AND STDCHC1.BIZDOMAIN_VALUE = vc.VC1_CODE
    LEFT JOIN RBIZDOMAIN_VALUE STDCHC2
        ON STDCHC2.BIZDOMAIN = 'VIOLATION_CODE_DESC_MAPPING'
        AND STDCHC2.BIZDOMAIN_VALUE = vc.VC2_CODE
    LEFT JOIN RBIZDOMAIN_VALUE STDCHC3
        ON STDCHC3.BIZDOMAIN = 'VIOLATION_CODE_DESC_MAPPING'
        AND STDCHC3.BIZDOMAIN_VALUE = vc.VC3_CODE
    LEFT JOIN RBIZDOMAIN_VALUE STDCHC4
        ON STDCHC4.BIZDOMAIN = 'VIOLATION_CODE_DESC_MAPPING'
        AND STDCHC4.BIZDOMAIN_VALUE = vc.VC4_CODE
),

INFRACTION AS (
SELECT --DISTINCT
    sv.SERV_PROV_CODE, 
    sv.B1_PER_ID1,
    sv.B1_PER_ID2,
    sv.B1_PER_ID3,
    sv.VC1_code C1_VC,
	sv.VC1_DESC C1_VC_DESC,
    sv.VC2_code C2_VC,
	sv.VC2_DESC C2_VC_DESC,
    sv.VC3_code C3_VC,
	sv.VC3_DESC C3_VC_DESC,
    sv.VC4_code C4_VC,
	sv.VC4_DESC C4_VC_DESC
  FROM SUM_VC sv

),

APO AS (
select SERV_PROV_CODE,
		B1_PER_ID1,
		B1_PER_ID2,
		B1_PER_ID3,
		[BIN] as BIN,
		[BLOCK] as BLOCK,
		[LOT] as LOT,
		[ADMIN COMPANY] as ADMIN_CO
 from 
(
SELECT
    apo.serv_prov_code AS SERV_PROV_CODE,
    apo.b1_per_id1 AS B1_PER_ID1,
	apo.b1_per_id2 AS B1_PER_ID2,
    apo.b1_per_id3 AS B1_PER_ID3,
    apo.b1_attribute_name,
    apo.b1_attribute_value
 FROM
         b3apo_attribute apo
   JOIN #TMP_RECORDLIST iv ON iv.serv_prov_code = APO.serv_prov_code
                                  AND iv.b1_per_id1 = APO.b1_per_id1
                                  AND iv.b1_per_id2 = APO.b1_per_id2
                                  AND iv.b1_per_id3 = APO.b1_per_id3

WHERE
    apo.b1_attribute_name IN ( 'BIN', 'BLOCK','LOT', 'ADMIN COMPANY' )
    AND apo.b1_apo_type IN ('ADDRESS')
    ) pva
PIVOT ( MAX(b1_attribute_value) for b1_attribute_name
            IN([BIN],
			[BLOCK],
			[LOT],
			[ADMIN COMPANY])) pvb
),
do_unit AS (
select SERV_PROV_CODE,
       B1_PER_ID1,
	   B1_PER_ID2,
	   B1_PER_ID3,
	   [D.O.] as ACTDO
 from 
(
SELECT
    bc.serv_prov_code AS SERV_PROV_CODE,
    bc.b1_per_id1 AS B1_PER_ID1,
    bc.b1_per_id2 AS B1_PER_ID2,
    bc.b1_per_id3 AS B1_PER_ID3,
    
    bc.b1_checkbox_desc,
    bc.b1_checklist_comment
 FROM
         bchckbox bc
WHERE
    bc.b1_checkbox_desc IN ('D.O.' )
    AND bc.b1_checkbox_type IN ('PERMIT REPORT INFO')
    ) pvia
PIVOT ( MAX(b1_checklist_comment) for b1_checkbox_desc
            IN([D.O.])) pvib
),
CONTACT AS (
    SELECT
        serv_prov_code,
        b1_per_id1,
        b1_per_id2,
        b1_per_id3,
        contact_name,
        rec_date,
        b1_contact_type,
        agency_code
    FROM
        (
            SELECT
            b.serv_prov_code,
            b.b1_per_id1,
            b.b1_per_id2,
            b.b1_per_id3,
               COALESCE(b.b1_full_name,b.b1_business_name,CONCAT(b1_fname,' ',b1_lname)) as contact_name,
                b.rec_date,
                b.b1_contact_type,
                substring(gt.field_value,1,3) as agency_code,
                ROW_NUMBER()
                OVER(PARTITION BY b.serv_prov_code, b.b1_per_id1, b.b1_per_id2, b.b1_per_id3
                     ORDER BY
                         b.rec_date DESC 
                ) rn
            FROM
                b3contact b
                INNER JOIN gtmpl_attribute gt ON b.b1_contact_nbr = gt.entity_seq1

            WHERE 1=1
               and  b.b1_contact_type IN ('Respondent') 
               AND gt.field_name = 'Agency Code'
--                and b.b1_contact_type_flag = 'City Agency'

        ) tr
    WHERE
        rn = 1
), 
ACCT_DATA AS
(
SELECT
    bp.serv_prov_code,
    bp.b1_per_id1,
    bp.b1_per_id2,
    bp.b1_per_id3, 
	xr.b1_master_id1,
	xr.b1_master_id2,
	xr.b1_master_id3,
	bpl.b1_alt_id AS ACCTNUM,
	du.actdo,
    bpl.b1_per_type AS ACCTPERTYPE,              
    bpl.b1_per_sub_type AS ACCTSUBTYPE,          
    bpl.b1_appl_status AS ACCTAPPSTATUS,          
    bpl.b1_appl_status_date AS ACCTAPPSTATUSDATE,  
--	bpl.REC_STATUS,
--	bp.REC_STATUS BP_REC_STATUS,
    xr.b1_relationship,
    bp.b1_alt_id                 AS ENFNUM,
    bp.b1_per_type               AS ENFPERTYPE,
    bp.b1_per_sub_type           AS ENFPERSUBTYPE,
    bp.b1_appl_status            AS ENFAPPSTATUS,
    bp.b1_appl_status_date       AS ENFAPPSTATUSDATE
FROM
         xapp2ref xr
   JOIN #TMP_RECORDLIST iv ON iv.serv_prov_code = XR.serv_prov_code
                                  AND iv.b1_per_id1 = XR.b1_per_id1
                                  AND iv.b1_per_id2 = XR.b1_per_id2
                                  AND iv.b1_per_id3 = XR.b1_per_id3

    INNER JOIN b1permit  bp ON bp.serv_prov_code = xr.serv_prov_code
                                  AND bp.b1_per_id1 = xr.b1_per_id1
                                  AND bp.b1_per_id2 = xr.b1_per_id2
                                  AND bp.b1_per_id3 = xr.b1_per_id3
    INNER JOIN b1permit  bpl ON bpl.serv_prov_code = xr.serv_prov_code
                                            AND bpl.b1_per_id1 = xr.b1_master_id1
                                            AND bpl.b1_per_id2 = xr.b1_master_id2
                                            AND bpl.b1_per_id3 = xr.b1_master_id3   
LEFT JOIN do_unit DU  ON  du.SERV_PROV_CODE = bpl.serv_prov_code
								AND du.B1_PER_ID1 = bpl.b1_per_id1
								AND du.B1_PER_ID2 = bpl.b1_per_id2
								AND du.B1_PER_ID3 = bpl.b1_per_id3


WHERE
        bpl.b1_per_type = 'Common'
        and bpl.b1_per_sub_type = 'Inspection'
		AND bpl.b1_appl_status <> 'Inactive'
),

--) SELECT * FROM ACCT_DATA WHERE ENFNUM  = '014041698H'
BOROUGH_ZIP_CODE AS (
select 
	VALUE_DESC, 
	BIZDOMAIN_VALUE as borough_zip,
	( CASE
      WHEN TRIM (UPPER (VALUE_DESC)) IN ('MANHATTAN')    THEN   '1'
                WHEN TRIM (UPPER (VALUE_DESC)) = 'BRONX' THEN '2'
                WHEN TRIM (UPPER (VALUE_DESC)) = 'BROOKLYN' THEN '3'
                WHEN TRIM (UPPER (VALUE_DESC)) = 'QUEENS' THEN '4'
                WHEN TRIM (UPPER (VALUE_DESC)) = 'STATEN ISLAND' THEN '5'  
                ELSE  ' '
             END) borough_code
from  RBIZDOMAIN_VALUE 
where BIZDOMAIN= 'REF_BORO_ZIP' 
and SERV_PROV_CODE='FDNY' 
and REC_STATUS='A'
),

RESULT_DATA AS (
SELECT DISTINCT
B1P.set_date,
'1' AS INPUT_TYPE,
B1P.B1_ALT_ID AS RECORD_ID,
CASE
    WHEN C.CREATEDATE IS NOT NULL THEN 
    FORMAT(TRY_CAST(C.CREATEDATE AS DATETIME), 'yyyyMMdd')
    ELSE ''
  END VIOLATION_DATE,
CASE
    WHEN C.CREATEDATE IS NOT NULL THEN 
    FORMAT(TRY_CAST(C.CREATEDATE AS DATETIME), 'HHmmss')
    ELSE ''
  END VIOLATION_TIME,
'FIR' AS ISSUING_AGENCY,
C.INSPECTOR_ID ISSUING_OFFICER_ID,
C.INSPECTOR_NAME ISSUING_OFFICER_NAME,
RIGHT('0' + du.ACTDO, 2) ISSUING_UNIT,
( CASE
      WHEN TRIM (UPPER (B1P.B1_SITUS_CITY)) IN ('NY',
                                                 'NEW YORK',
                                                 'NEW YOK',
                                                 'NEW YORKQ',
                                                 'NYC',
                                                 'MANHATTAN')    THEN   '1'
                WHEN TRIM (UPPER (B1P.B1_SITUS_CITY)) = 'BRONX' THEN '2'
                WHEN TRIM (UPPER (B1P.B1_SITUS_CITY)) = 'BROOKLYN' THEN '3'
                WHEN TRIM (UPPER (B1P.B1_SITUS_CITY)) = 'QUEENS' THEN '4'
                WHEN TRIM (UPPER (B1P.B1_SITUS_CITY)) = 'STATEN ISLAND' THEN '5'  
                ELSE  ' '
             END) ISSUING_BORO,
--B1P.B1_SITUS_CITY   ISSUING_BOROUGH,
SUBSTRING(B1P.EXT_ADDRESS_UID,CHARINDEX( '^aId=',B1P.EXT_ADDRESS_UID)+5,12) PREM_ADDRESS_ID,
SUBSTRING(B1P.EXT_ADDRESS_UID,CHARINDEX( '$LId=',B1P.EXT_ADDRESS_UID)+5,12) LOCATION_ID,
B1P.EXT_ADDRESS_UID,
B1P.B1_HSE_NBR_ALPHA_START PREM_HOUSE_NUMBER, 
B1P.B1_STR_NAME  PREM_STREET_NAME,
B1P.B1_SITUS_CITY  PREM_CITY,
B1P.B1_SITUS_STATE  PREM_STATE,
SUBSTRING(B1P.B1_SITUS_ZIP,1,5) PREM_ZIP_5,
SUBSTRING(B1P.B1_SITUS_ZIP,6,4) PREM_ZIP_4,
AO.BLOCK PREM_BLOCK,
AO.LOT PREM_LOT,
AO.BIN BIN,
UPPER(COALESCE(B1P.B1_BUSINESS_NAME,CONCAT(B1P.B1_FNAME,' ',B1P.B1_LNAME))) as RESP_LAST_NAME,
--  COALESCE(

                WHEN TRIM (UPPER (B1P.G7_CITY)) = 'QUEENS' THEN '4'

    WHEN TRIM (UPPER (B1P.G7_STATE)) = 'TEXAS' THEN 'TX'

    WHEN TRIM (UPPER (B1P.G7_STATE)) = 'VIRGINIA' THEN 'VA'
    WHEN TRIM (UPPER (B1P.G7_STATE)) = 'WASHINGTON' THEN 'WA'
    WHEN TRIM (UPPER (B1P.G7_STATE)) = 'WEST VIRGINIA' THEN 'WV'
    WHEN TRIM (UPPER (B1P.G7_STATE)) = 'WISCONSIN' THEN 'WI'
    WHEN TRIM (UPPER (B1P.G7_STATE)) = 'WYOMING' THEN 'WY'

UPPER(B1P.G7_STATE) AS RESPONDENT_STATE_NAME,

    WHEN C.HEARING_TIME IS NOT NULL THEN

                WHEN TRIM (UPPER (B1P.B1_SITUS_CITY)) = 'QUEENS' THEN '8'

             END) HEARING_LOCATION,


UPPER(dbo.FN_GET_STDCHOICE_VALUEDESC(
      B1P.SERV_PROV_CODE,

    )
  ) AS HEARING_CENTERS,

( CASE  WHEN TRY_CONVERT(INT,SUBSTRING(F.C1_VC,3,2)) IS NULL   THEN   ' ' 
        WHEN C.MOS = 'Yes' THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N'  END) MOST01,
( CASE  WHEN TRY_CONVERT(INT,SUBSTRING(F.C2_VC,3,2)) IS NULL    THEN  ' ' ELSE concat('BF',RIGHT('0' + CONVERT(VARCHAR,TRY_CONVERT(INT,SUBSTRING(F.C2_VC,3,2))  ),2) ) END) VC02,

( CASE  WHEN TRY_CONVERT(INT,SUBSTRING(F.C3_VC,3,2)) IS NULL   THEN   ' ' 
        WHEN C.MOS = 'Yes' THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N'  END) MOST03,
( CASE  WHEN TRY_CONVERT(INT,SUBSTRING(F.C4_VC,3,2)) IS NULL    THEN  ' ' ELSE  concat('BF',RIGHT('0' + CONVERT(VARCHAR,TRY_CONVERT(INT,SUBSTRING(F.C4_VC,3,2))  ),2) )  END) VC04,
( CASE  WHEN TRY_CONVERT(INT,SUBSTRING(F.C4_VC,3,2)) IS NULL   THEN   ' ' 
        WHEN C.MOS = 'Yes' THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N'  END) MOST04,




( CASE  WHEN TRY_CONVERT(INT,SUBSTRING(F.C1_VC,3,2)) IS NULL   THEN   ' ' ELSE F.C1_VC_DESC END) VC01_DESC,
( CASE  WHEN TRY_CONVERT(INT,SUBSTRING(F.C2_VC,3,2)) IS NULL    THEN  ' ' ELSE F.C2_VC_DESC  END) VC02_DESC,
( CASE  WHEN TRY_CONVERT(INT,SUBSTRING(F.C3_VC,3,2)) IS NULL    THEN   ' ' ELSE F.C3_VC_DESC  END) VC03_DESC,

    WHEN B1P.B1_PHONE2 IS NOT NULL
    AND LEN(B1P.B1_PHONE2) > 1 THEN  SUBSTRING(B1P.B1_PHONE2, 1, 3) +  SUBSTRING(B1P.B1_PHONE2, 4, 3) +  SUBSTRING(B1P.B1_PHONE2, 7, 4)
    WHEN B1P.B1_PHONE3 IS NOT NULL
    AND LEN(B1P.B1_PHONE3) > 1 THEN  SUBSTRING(B1P.B1_PHONE3, 1, 3) + SUBSTRING(B1P.B1_PHONE3, 4, 3) +  SUBSTRING(B1P.B1_PHONE3, 7, 4)
    ELSE ''
  END RESPONDENT_PHONE_NUMBER,
CONVERT(varchar, B1P.B1_BIRTH_DATE, 112) RESPONDENT_DOB,
B1P.B1_GENDER RESPONDENT_GENDER,

FROM #TMP_RECORDLIST B1P

LEFT JOIN APO AO  ON  B1P.SERV_PROV_CODE = AO.SERV_PROV_CODE
								AND B1P.B1_PER_ID1 = AO.B1_PER_ID1
								AND B1P.B1_PER_ID2 = AO.B1_PER_ID2
								AND B1P.B1_PER_ID3 = AO.B1_PER_ID3
JOIN ACCT_DATA AD  ON  B1P.SERV_PROV_CODE = AD.SERV_PROV_CODE
								AND B1P.B1_PER_ID1 = AD.B1_PER_ID1
								AND B1P.B1_PER_ID2 = AD.B1_PER_ID2
								AND B1P.B1_PER_ID3 = AD.B1_PER_ID3
LEFT JOIN do_unit DU  ON  ad.SERV_PROV_CODE = du.SERV_PROV_CODE
								AND ad.b1_master_id1 = du.B1_PER_ID1
								AND ad.b1_master_id2 = du.B1_PER_ID2
								AND ad.b1_master_id3 = du.B1_PER_ID3
LEFT JOIN CONTACT cn  ON  cn.SERV_PROV_CODE = B1P.serv_prov_code
								AND cn.B1_PER_ID1 = B1P.b1_per_id1
								AND cn.B1_PER_ID2 = B1P.b1_per_id2
								AND cn.B1_PER_ID3 = B1P.b1_per_id3


LEFT JOIN #TMP_CUST_FIELDS C  ON  C.SERV_PROV_CODE = B1P.SERV_PROV_CODE
								AND C.B1_PER_ID1 = B1P.B1_PER_ID1
								AND C.B1_PER_ID2 = B1P.B1_PER_ID2
								AND C.B1_PER_ID3 = B1P.B1_PER_ID3
LEFT JOIN RBIZDOMAIN_VALUE STDCHC1  ON STDCHC1.BIZDOMAIN = 'ENF_OATH_OFFICES_ADDRESS'
								AND STDCHC1.BIZDOMAIN_VALUE = B1P.B1_SITUS_CITY
LEFT JOIN RBIZDOMAIN_VALUE STDCHC2  ON STDCHC2.BIZDOMAIN = 'BFP_UNIT_PHONE'
								AND STDCHC2.BIZDOMAIN_VALUE = C.UNIT
LEFT JOIN RBIZDOMAIN_VALUE STDCHC3  ON STDCHC3.BIZDOMAIN = 'BFP_FSUM_HEARING_CENTERS'
								AND lower(STDCHC3.BIZDOMAIN_VALUE) = lower(B1P.B1_SITUS_CITY)
LEFT JOIN PUSER PU ON PU.EMPLOYEE_ID = C.INSPECTOR_ID
LEFT JOIN G3STAFFS S ON PU.USER_NAME = S.GA_USER_ID
LEFT JOIN G3DPTTYP D ON D.SERV_PROV_CODE = S.SERV_PROV_CODE
							AND S.GA_AGENCY_CODE = D.R3_AGENCY_CODE
							AND S.GA_BUREAU_CODE = D.R3_BUREAU_CODE
							AND S.GA_DIVISION_CODE = D.R3_DIVISION_CODE
							AND S.GA_SECTION_CODE = D.R3_SECTION_CODE
							AND S.GA_GROUP_CODE = D.R3_GROUP_CODE
							AND S.GA_OFFICE_CODE = D.R3_OFFICE_CODE

  LEFT OUTER JOIN borough_zip_code bz on ISNULL(CAST(bz.borough_zip AS NVARCHAR(5)), '00000') = SUBSTRING(B1P.B1_SITUS_ZIP,1,5)

LEFT JOIN INFRACTION F ON B1P.SERV_PROV_CODE = F.SERV_PROV_CODE
							AND B1P.B1_PER_ID1 = F.B1_PER_ID1
							AND B1P.B1_PER_ID2 = F.B1_PER_ID2
							AND B1P.B1_PER_ID3 = F.B1_PER_ID3
WHERE 1 = 1
							AND B1P.SERV_PROV_CODE = 'FDNY'
							AND B1P.REC_STATUS      = 'A'
							AND C.CREATEDATE IS NOT NULL
							AND C.HEARING_DATE IS NOT NULL
							AND C.HEARING_TIME IS NOT NULL

WITH AIMVADD AS
(
SELECT
	B1_CONTACT_NBR, 
	G7_HSE_NBR_ALPHA_START,
	G7_STR_NAME,
	G7_CITY,
	G7_STATE,
	G7_ZIP,
	G7_ADDRESS_TYPE,
	rec_date,
	RN
FROM
(
SELECT 
	XREC.B1_CONTACT_NBR, 
	G7A.G7_HSE_NBR_ALPHA_START,
	G7A.G7_STR_NAME,
	G7A.G7_CITY,
	G7A.G7_STATE,
	G7A.G7_ZIP,
	G7A.G7_ADDRESS_TYPE,
	G7A.rec_date,
	ROW_NUMBER()
       OVER(PARTITION BY XREC.B1_CONTACT_NBR
            ORDER BY   G7A.rec_date DESC ) rn
  FROM G7CONTACT_ADDRESS G7A
       LEFT JOIN XRECORD_CONTACT_ENTITY XREC
          ON     G7A.G7_ENTITY_TYPE = XREC.ENT_TYPE
             AND G7A.RES_ID = XREC.ENT_ID1
             AND G7A.SERV_PROV_CODE = XREC.SERV_PROV_CODE
             AND XREC.REC_STATUS = 'A'
	WHERE
		G7A.G7_ADDRESS_TYPE = 'Mailing Address' 
	AND XREC.B1_CONTACT_NBR IS NOT NULL
) TR
   WHERE RN = 1
),
OATH_ENTRY AS
(
SELECT SERV_PROV_CODE,
       B1_PER_ID1,
       B1_PER_ID2,
       B1_PER_ID3,
	   [Entered in OAth] AS ENTERED_IN_OATH,
       [OATH HEARING DATE] AS OATH_HRG_DATE

  FROM 
    (SELECT C.SERV_PROV_CODE,
               C.B1_PER_ID1,
               C.B1_PER_ID2,
               C.B1_PER_ID3,
               C.B1_CHECKLIST_COMMENT,
               C.B1_CHECKBOX_DESC
          FROM BCHCKBOX C
		  ) PV1 PIVOT (MIN (B1_CHECKLIST_COMMENT)
                           FOR B1_CHECKBOX_DESC
                           IN  ([Entered in OAth],
                               [OATH HEARING DATE]
)) PV2
),
GP_HIST as (
SELECT SERV_PROV_CODE,
		B1_PER_ID1,
		B1_PER_ID2,
		B1_PER_ID3,
		sd_pro_des,
		sd_app_des,
		sd_app_dd,
		rn
FROM
	(SELECT gp.SERV_PROV_CODE,
		gp.B1_PER_ID1,
		gp.B1_PER_ID2,
	    gp.B1_PER_ID3,
		gp.sd_pro_des,
		gp.sd_app_des,
		gp.sd_app_dd,
		ROW_NUMBER()
			OVER(PARTITION BY gp.SERV_PROV_CODE, gp.B1_PER_ID1, gp.B1_PER_ID2, gp.B1_PER_ID3   ORDER BY   gp.sd_app_dd DESC ) rn
	   FROM  gprocess_history gp    
--WHERE 1=1
--	   AND gp.sd_pro_des = 'Supervisor Review'
--	   AND gp.sd_app_des = 'Approved'
--	   AND gp.sd_app_dd > getdate() - 90

) TR
	WHERE RN = 1

),
SUMMONS_SET AS (
SELECT 
    sd.serv_prov_code,
    sd.b1_per_id1,
    sd.b1_per_id2,
    sd.b1_per_id3,
    sh.set_id,
    sh.set_status,
    CAST(sh.set_date as date) set_date,
	b.b1_alt_id record_id,
    sd.set_seq_nbr,
    sd.rec_date,
    sd.rec_ful_nam,
    sd.rec_status,
    sd.audit_init_by,
    sd.audit_init_date,
    sd.audit_mod_by,
    sd.audit_mod_date

FROM B1PERMIT B
    INNER JOIN SETDETAILS SD
    ON SD.SERV_PROV_CODE= B.SERV_PROV_CODE
    AND SD.B1_PER_ID1 = B.B1_PER_ID1
    AND SD.B1_PER_ID2 = B.B1_PER_ID2
    AND SD.B1_PER_ID3 = B.B1_PER_ID3  

    INNER JOIN SETHEADER SH
    ON SH.SERV_PROV_CODE = SD.SERV_PROV_CODE
    AND SH.SET_ID = SD.SET_ID

WHERE 1=1
    AND sd.set_id LIKE 'FDNY_SUMMONS_ECB%'
--    AND CAST(sh.set_date as date) = CAST(DATEADD(day, -1, GETDATE()) AS DATE)
    and sd.SERV_PROV_CODE='FDNY' 
    and sd.REC_STATUS='A'
),
