WITH AIMVADD AS
(
SELECT
	B1_CONTACT_NBR, 
	G7_HSE_NBR_ALPHA_START,
	G7_STR_NAME,
	G7_CITY,
	G7_STATE,
	G7_ZIP,
	G7_ADDRESS_TYPE,
	rec_date,
	RN
FROM
(
SELECT 
	XREC.B1_CONTACT_NBR, 
	G7A.G7_HSE_NBR_ALPHA_START,
	G7A.G7_STR_NAME,
	G7A.G7_CITY,
	G7A.G7_STATE,
	G7A.G7_ZIP,
	G7A.G7_ADDRESS_TYPE,
	G7A.rec_date,
	ROW_NUMBER()
       OVER(PARTITION BY XREC.B1_CONTACT_NBR
            ORDER BY   G7A.rec_date DESC ) rn
  FROM G7CONTACT_ADDRESS G7A
       LEFT JOIN XRECORD_CONTACT_ENTITY XREC
          ON     G7A.G7_ENTITY_TYPE = XREC.ENT_TYPE
             AND G7A.RES_ID = XREC.ENT_ID1
             AND G7A.SERV_PROV_CODE = XREC.SERV_PROV_CODE
             AND XREC.REC_STATUS = 'A'
	WHERE
		G7A.G7_ADDRESS_TYPE = 'Mailing Address' 
	AND XREC.B1_CONTACT_NBR IS NOT NULL
) TR
   WHERE RN = 1
),
OATH_ENTRY AS
(
SELECT SERV_PROV_CODE,
       B1_PER_ID1,
       B1_PER_ID2,
       B1_PER_ID3,
	   [Entered in OAth] AS ENTERED_IN_OATH,
       [OATH HEARING DATE] AS OATH_HRG_DATE

  FROM 
    (SELECT C.SERV_PROV_CODE,
               C.B1_PER_ID1,
               C.B1_PER_ID2,
               C.B1_PER_ID3,
               C.B1_CHECKLIST_COMMENT,
               C.B1_CHECKBOX_DESC
          FROM BCHCKBOX C
		  ) PV1 PIVOT (MIN (B1_CHECKLIST_COMMENT)
                           FOR B1_CHECKBOX_DESC
                           IN  ([Entered in OAth],
                               [OATH HEARING DATE]
)) PV2
),
GP_HIST as (
SELECT SERV_PROV_CODE,
		B1_PER_ID1,
		B1_PER_ID2,
		B1_PER_ID3,
		sd_pro_des,
		sd_app_des,
		sd_app_dd,
		rn
FROM
	(SELECT gp.SERV_PROV_CODE,
		gp.B1_PER_ID1,
		gp.B1_PER_ID2,
	    gp.B1_PER_ID3,
		gp.sd_pro_des,
		gp.sd_app_des,
		gp.sd_app_dd,
		ROW_NUMBER()
			OVER(PARTITION BY gp.SERV_PROV_CODE, gp.B1_PER_ID1, gp.B1_PER_ID2, gp.B1_PER_ID3   ORDER BY   gp.sd_app_dd DESC ) rn
	   FROM  gprocess_history gp    
--WHERE 1=1
--	   AND gp.sd_pro_des = 'Supervisor Review'
--	   AND gp.sd_app_des = 'Approved'
--	   AND gp.sd_app_dd > getdate() - 90

) TR
	WHERE RN = 1

),
SUMMONS_SET AS (
SELECT 
    sd.serv_prov_code,
    sd.b1_per_id1,
    sd.b1_per_id2,
    sd.b1_per_id3,
    sh.set_id,
    sh.set_status,
    CAST(sh.set_date as date) set_date,
	b.b1_alt_id record_id,
    sd.set_seq_nbr,
    sd.rec_date,
    sd.rec_ful_nam,
    sd.rec_status,
    sd.audit_init_by,
    sd.audit_init_date,
    sd.audit_mod_by,
    sd.audit_mod_date

FROM B1PERMIT B
    INNER JOIN SETDETAILS SD
    ON SD.SERV_PROV_CODE= B.SERV_PROV_CODE
    AND SD.B1_PER_ID1 = B.B1_PER_ID1
    AND SD.B1_PER_ID2 = B.B1_PER_ID2
    AND SD.B1_PER_ID3 = B.B1_PER_ID3  

    INNER JOIN SETHEADER SH
    ON SH.SERV_PROV_CODE = SD.SERV_PROV_CODE
    AND SH.SET_ID = SD.SET_ID

WHERE 1=1
    AND sd.set_id LIKE 'FDNY_SUMMONS_ECB%'
    AND CAST(sh.set_date as date) >= CAST(DATEADD(day, -1, @BATCHDATE) AS DATE)
    and sd.SERV_PROV_CODE='FDNY' 
    and sd.REC_STATUS='A'
),

SUM_DATA AS (

	LEFT JOIN B3ADDRES B3A  ON  BP.SERV_PROV_CODE = B3A.SERV_PROV_CODE

LEFT JOIN AIMVADD A1 ON A1.B1_CONTACT_NBR = A.B1_CONTACT_NBR


    WHERE 1=1
        AND bp.B1_PER_TYPE = 'Enforcement'

        AND bp.SERV_PROV_CODE = 'FDNY'

FROM SUM_DATA

   select * INTO #TMP_RECORDLIST from RECORDLIST;

WITH CUST_FIELDS AS
(
SELECT SERV_PROV_CODE,
       B1_PER_ID1,
       B1_PER_ID2,
       B1_PER_ID3,
	   [Division FP Unit] AS UNIT,
       [DBA] AS DBA,
       [Creation Date/Time] AS CREATEDATE,
       [HEARING DATE] AS HEARING_DATE,
       [HEARING TIME] AS HEARING_TIME,
       [COMPLIANCE DATE] AS COMPLIANCE_DATE,
       [INSPECTOR NAME] AS INSPECTOR_NAME,
       [INSPECTOR ID] AS INSPECTOR_ID,
	   [Advised by: Name] AS ADVISED_NAME,
	   [Advised by: Position or Relationship to building] AS ADVISED_RELA,
	   [Affixed Summons at location] AS AFFIXED_LOCA,
	   [Service Method] AS SERVICE_METHOD,
       [Description of Violation] AS VIOLATION_DESC,
       [REPEAT OFFENDER] AS MOS,
       [City Agency] AS CITY_AGENCY,
	   [prefix] AS DCP_ST_PFX,
	   [street_name] AS DCP_ST_NAME,
	   [ending] AS DCP_ST_TYPE,
	   [suffix] AS DCP_ST_SFX,
	   [Type] AS SYST_TYPE
  FROM 
    (SELECT C.SERV_PROV_CODE,
               C.B1_PER_ID1,
               C.B1_PER_ID2,
               C.B1_PER_ID3,
               UPPER (C.B1_CHECKLIST_COMMENT) B1_CHECKLIST_COMMENT,
               C.B1_CHECKBOX_DESC
          FROM BCHCKBOX C
   JOIN #TMP_RECORDLIST iv ON iv.serv_prov_code = C.serv_prov_code
                                  AND iv.b1_per_id1 = C.b1_per_id1
                                  AND iv.b1_per_id2 = C.b1_per_id2
                                  AND iv.b1_per_id3 = C.b1_per_id3
		  ) PV1 PIVOT (MIN (B1_CHECKLIST_COMMENT)
                           FOR B1_CHECKBOX_DESC
                           IN  ([Division FP Unit],
                               [DBA],
                               [Creation Date/Time],
                               [HEARING DATE],
                               [HEARING TIME],
                               [COMPLIANCE DATE],
                               [INSPECTOR NAME],
                               [INSPECTOR ID],
							   [Advised by: Name],
							   [Advised by: Position or Relationship to building],
							   [Affixed Summons at location],
							   [Service Method],
							   [prefix],
							   [street_name],
							   [ending],
							   [suffix],
                               [Type],
                               [REPEAT OFFENDER],
                               [City Agency],
                               [Description of Violation])) PV2
)
   select * INTO #TMP_CUST_FIELDS from CUST_FIELDS;

 --  SELECT * FROM #TMP_CUST_FIELDS

WITH vio_data AS (

SELECT
      SERV_PROV_CODE,
      B1_PER_ID1,
      B1_PER_ID2,
      B1_PER_ID3,
       UPPER(VO_CAT) AS VO_CAT,
       ROW_NUMBER()
        OVER(PARTITION BY SERV_PROV_CODE, B1_PER_ID1, B1_PER_ID2, B1_PER_ID3   ORDER BY   vo_cat DESC ) rn

       
     
FROM
       (

                SELECT
                       bap.SERV_PROV_CODE,
                        bap.B1_PER_ID1,
                        bap.B1_PER_ID2,
                        bap.B1_PER_ID3,
					   MAX(CASE WHEN bap.COLUMN_NAME='Violation Category' THEN bap.ATTRIBUTE_VALUE END)     AS VO_CAT


                FROM
                       BAPPSPECTABLE_VALUE bap
    JOIN #TMP_RECORDLIST iv ON iv.serv_prov_code = bap.serv_prov_code
                              AND iv.b1_per_id1 = bap.b1_per_id1
                              AND iv.b1_per_id2 = bap.b1_per_id2
                              AND iv.b1_per_id3 = bap.b1_per_id3

                WHERE 1=1
                         AND bap.TABLE_NAME    = 'LIST OF VIOLATION CODES'
                         --
                GROUP BY
                        bap.SERV_PROV_CODE,
                        bap.B1_PER_ID1,
                        bap.B1_PER_ID2,
                        bap.B1_PER_ID3,
                        bap.ROW_INDEX,
                        bap.TABLE_NAME
       ) xx
    
GROUP BY 
                       SERV_PROV_CODE,
                        B1_PER_ID1,
                        B1_PER_ID2,
                        B1_PER_ID3,
                        VO_CAT
),

VC_CODES AS (
    SELECT
        vd.SERV_PROV_CODE,
        vd.B1_PER_ID1,
        vd.B1_PER_ID2,
        vd.B1_PER_ID3,
        vd.vo_cat,
        vd.rn,

        MAX(CASE WHEN  vd.rn = 1 THEN vd.vo_cat END) OVER (PARTITION BY vd.SERV_PROV_CODE, vd.B1_PER_ID1, vd.B1_PER_ID2, vd.B1_PER_ID3) AS VC1_CODE,
        MAX(CASE WHEN  vd.rn = 2 THEN vd.vo_cat END) OVER (PARTITION BY vd.SERV_PROV_CODE, vd.B1_PER_ID1, vd.B1_PER_ID2, vd.B1_PER_ID3) AS VC2_CODE,
        MAX(CASE WHEN  vd.rn = 3 THEN vd.vo_cat END) OVER (PARTITION BY vd.SERV_PROV_CODE, vd.B1_PER_ID1, vd.B1_PER_ID2, vd.B1_PER_ID3) AS VC3_CODE,
        MAX(CASE WHEN  vd.rn = 4 THEN vd.vo_cat END) OVER (PARTITION BY vd.SERV_PROV_CODE, vd.B1_PER_ID1, vd.B1_PER_ID2, vd.B1_PER_ID3) AS VC4_CODE


    FROM
        vio_data vd


),

SUM_VC AS (
    SELECT
        vc.SERV_PROV_CODE,
        vc.B1_PER_ID1,
        vc.B1_PER_ID2,
        vc.B1_PER_ID3,
        vc.VC1_CODE,
        STDCHC1.VALUE_DESC AS VC1_DESC,
        vc.VC2_CODE,
        STDCHC2.VALUE_DESC AS VC2_DESC,
        vc.VC3_CODE,
        STDCHC3.VALUE_DESC AS VC3_DESC,
        vc.VC4_CODE,
        STDCHC4.VALUE_DESC AS VC4_DESC
    FROM
        VC_CODES vc

    LEFT JOIN RBIZDOMAIN_VALUE STDCHC1
        ON STDCHC1.BIZDOMAIN = 'VIOLATION_CODE_DESC_MAPPING'
        AND STDCHC1.BIZDOMAIN_VALUE = vc.VC1_CODE
    LEFT JOIN RBIZDOMAIN_VALUE STDCHC2
        ON STDCHC2.BIZDOMAIN = 'VIOLATION_CODE_DESC_MAPPING'
        AND STDCHC2.BIZDOMAIN_VALUE = vc.VC2_CODE
    LEFT JOIN RBIZDOMAIN_VALUE STDCHC3
        ON STDCHC3.BIZDOMAIN = 'VIOLATION_CODE_DESC_MAPPING'
        AND STDCHC3.BIZDOMAIN_VALUE = vc.VC3_CODE
    LEFT JOIN RBIZDOMAIN_VALUE STDCHC4
        ON STDCHC4.BIZDOMAIN = 'VIOLATION_CODE_DESC_MAPPING'
        AND STDCHC4.BIZDOMAIN_VALUE = vc.VC4_CODE
),

INFRACTION AS (
SELECT --DISTINCT
    sv.SERV_PROV_CODE, 
    sv.B1_PER_ID1,
    sv.B1_PER_ID2,
    sv.B1_PER_ID3,
    sv.VC1_code C1_VC,
	sv.VC1_DESC C1_VC_DESC,
    sv.VC2_code C2_VC,
	sv.VC2_DESC C2_VC_DESC,
    sv.VC3_code C3_VC,
	sv.VC3_DESC C3_VC_DESC,
    sv.VC4_code C4_VC,
	sv.VC4_DESC C4_VC_DESC
  FROM SUM_VC sv

),
--) SELECT * FROM INFRACTION
APO AS (
select SERV_PROV_CODE,
		B1_PER_ID1,
		B1_PER_ID2,
		B1_PER_ID3,
		[BIN] as BIN,
		[BLOCK] as BLOCK,
		[LOT] as LOT,
		[ADMIN COMPANY] as ADMIN_CO
 from 
(
SELECT
    apo.serv_prov_code AS SERV_PROV_CODE,
    apo.b1_per_id1 AS B1_PER_ID1,
	apo.b1_per_id2 AS B1_PER_ID2,
    apo.b1_per_id3 AS B1_PER_ID3,
    apo.b1_attribute_name,
    apo.b1_attribute_value
 FROM
         b3apo_attribute apo
   JOIN #TMP_RECORDLIST iv ON iv.serv_prov_code = APO.serv_prov_code
                                  AND iv.b1_per_id1 = APO.b1_per_id1
                                  AND iv.b1_per_id2 = APO.b1_per_id2
                                  AND iv.b1_per_id3 = APO.b1_per_id3

WHERE
    apo.b1_attribute_name IN ( 'BIN', 'BLOCK','LOT', 'ADMIN COMPANY' )
    AND apo.b1_apo_type IN ('ADDRESS')
    ) pva
PIVOT ( MAX(b1_attribute_value) for b1_attribute_name
            IN([BIN],
			[BLOCK],
			[LOT],
			[ADMIN COMPANY])) pvb
),
do_unit AS (
select SERV_PROV_CODE,
       B1_PER_ID1,
	   B1_PER_ID2,
	   B1_PER_ID3,
	   [D.O.] as ACTDO
 from 
(
SELECT
    bc.serv_prov_code AS SERV_PROV_CODE,
    bc.b1_per_id1 AS B1_PER_ID1,
    bc.b1_per_id2 AS B1_PER_ID2,
    bc.b1_per_id3 AS B1_PER_ID3,
    
    bc.b1_checkbox_desc,
    bc.b1_checklist_comment
 FROM
         bchckbox bc
WHERE
    bc.b1_checkbox_desc IN ('D.O.' )
    AND bc.b1_checkbox_type IN ('PERMIT REPORT INFO')
    ) pvia
PIVOT ( MAX(b1_checklist_comment) for b1_checkbox_desc
            IN([D.O.])) pvib
),
CONTACT AS (
    SELECT
        serv_prov_code,
        b1_per_id1,
        b1_per_id2,
        b1_per_id3,
        contact_name,
        rec_date,
        b1_contact_type,
        agency_code
    FROM
        (
            SELECT
            b.serv_prov_code,
            b.b1_per_id1,
            b.b1_per_id2,
            b.b1_per_id3,
               COALESCE(b.b1_full_name,b.b1_business_name,CONCAT(b1_fname,' ',b1_lname)) as contact_name,
                b.rec_date,
                b.b1_contact_type,
                substring(gt.field_value,1,3) as agency_code,
                ROW_NUMBER()
                OVER(PARTITION BY b.serv_prov_code, b.b1_per_id1, b.b1_per_id2, b.b1_per_id3
                     ORDER BY
                         b.rec_date DESC 
                ) rn
            FROM
                b3contact b
                INNER JOIN gtmpl_attribute gt ON b.b1_contact_nbr = gt.entity_seq1

            WHERE 1=1
               and  b.b1_contact_type IN ('Respondent') 
               AND gt.field_name = 'Agency Code'
--                and b.b1_contact_type_flag = 'City Agency'

        ) tr
    WHERE
        rn = 1
), 
ACCT_DATA AS
(
SELECT
    bp.serv_prov_code,
    bp.b1_per_id1,
    bp.b1_per_id2,
    bp.b1_per_id3, 
	xr.b1_master_id1,
	xr.b1_master_id2,
	xr.b1_master_id3,
	bpl.b1_alt_id AS ACCTNUM,
	du.actdo,
    bpl.b1_per_type AS ACCTPERTYPE,              
    bpl.b1_per_sub_type AS ACCTSUBTYPE,          
    bpl.b1_appl_status AS ACCTAPPSTATUS,          
    bpl.b1_appl_status_date AS ACCTAPPSTATUSDATE,  
--	bpl.REC_STATUS,
--	bp.REC_STATUS BP_REC_STATUS,
    xr.b1_relationship,
    bp.b1_alt_id                 AS ENFNUM,
    bp.b1_per_type               AS ENFPERTYPE,
    bp.b1_per_sub_type           AS ENFPERSUBTYPE,
    bp.b1_appl_status            AS ENFAPPSTATUS,
    bp.b1_appl_status_date       AS ENFAPPSTATUSDATE
FROM
         xapp2ref xr
   JOIN #TMP_RECORDLIST iv ON iv.serv_prov_code = XR.serv_prov_code
                                  AND iv.b1_per_id1 = XR.b1_per_id1
                                  AND iv.b1_per_id2 = XR.b1_per_id2
                                  AND iv.b1_per_id3 = XR.b1_per_id3

    INNER JOIN b1permit  bp ON bp.serv_prov_code = xr.serv_prov_code
                                  AND bp.b1_per_id1 = xr.b1_per_id1
                                  AND bp.b1_per_id2 = xr.b1_per_id2
                                  AND bp.b1_per_id3 = xr.b1_per_id3
    INNER JOIN b1permit  bpl ON bpl.serv_prov_code = xr.serv_prov_code
                                            AND bpl.b1_per_id1 = xr.b1_master_id1
                                            AND bpl.b1_per_id2 = xr.b1_master_id2
                                            AND bpl.b1_per_id3 = xr.b1_master_id3   
LEFT JOIN do_unit DU  ON  du.SERV_PROV_CODE = bpl.serv_prov_code
								AND du.B1_PER_ID1 = bpl.b1_per_id1
								AND du.B1_PER_ID2 = bpl.b1_per_id2
								AND du.B1_PER_ID3 = bpl.b1_per_id3

WHERE
        bpl.b1_per_type = 'Common'
        and bpl.b1_per_sub_type = 'Inspection'
		AND bpl.b1_appl_status <> 'Inactive'
),

--) SELECT * FROM ACCT_DATA WHERE ENFNUM  = '014041698H'
BOROUGH_ZIP_CODE AS (
select 
	VALUE_DESC, 
	BIZDOMAIN_VALUE as borough_zip,
	( CASE
      WHEN TRIM (UPPER (VALUE_DESC)) IN ('MANHATTAN')    THEN   '1'
                WHEN TRIM (UPPER (VALUE_DESC)) = 'BRONX' THEN '2'
                WHEN TRIM (UPPER (VALUE_DESC)) = 'BROOKLYN' THEN '3'
                WHEN TRIM (UPPER (VALUE_DESC)) = 'QUEENS' THEN '4'
                WHEN TRIM (UPPER (VALUE_DESC)) = 'STATEN ISLAND' THEN '5'  
                ELSE  ' '
             END) borough_code
from  RBIZDOMAIN_VALUE 
where BIZDOMAIN= 'REF_BORO_ZIP' 
and SERV_PROV_CODE='FDNY' 
and REC_STATUS='A'
),

RESULT_DATA AS (
SELECT DISTINCT
'1' AS INPUT_TYPE,
B1P.B1_ALT_ID AS RECORD_ID,
CASE
    WHEN C.CREATEDATE IS NOT NULL THEN 
    FORMAT(TRY_CAST(C.CREATEDATE AS DATETIME), 'yyyyMMdd')
    ELSE ''
  END VIOLATION_DATE,
CASE
    WHEN C.CREATEDATE IS NOT NULL THEN 
    FORMAT(TRY_CAST(C.CREATEDATE AS DATETIME), 'HHmmss')
    ELSE ''
  END VIOLATION_TIME,
'FIR' AS ISSUING_AGENCY,
C.INSPECTOR_ID ISSUING_OFFICER_ID,
C.INSPECTOR_NAME ISSUING_OFFICER_NAME,
RIGHT('0' + du.ACTDO, 2) ISSUING_UNIT,
( CASE
      WHEN TRIM (UPPER (B1P.B1_SITUS_CITY)) IN ('NY',
                                                 'NEW YORK',
                                                 'NEW YOK',
                                                 'NEW YORKQ',
                                                 'NYC',
                                                 'MANHATTAN')    THEN   '1'
                WHEN TRIM (UPPER (B1P.B1_SITUS_CITY)) = 'BRONX' THEN '2'
                WHEN TRIM (UPPER (B1P.B1_SITUS_CITY)) = 'BROOKLYN' THEN '3'
                WHEN TRIM (UPPER (B1P.B1_SITUS_CITY)) = 'QUEENS' THEN '4'
                WHEN TRIM (UPPER (B1P.B1_SITUS_CITY)) = 'STATEN ISLAND' THEN '5'  
                ELSE  ' '
             END) ISSUING_BORO,
--B1P.B1_SITUS_CITY   ISSUING_BOROUGH,
SUBSTRING(B1P.EXT_ADDRESS_UID,CHARINDEX( '^aId=',B1P.EXT_ADDRESS_UID)+5,12) PREM_ADDRESS_ID,
SUBSTRING(B1P.EXT_ADDRESS_UID,CHARINDEX( '$LId=',B1P.EXT_ADDRESS_UID)+5,12) LOCATION_ID,
B1P.EXT_ADDRESS_UID,
B1P.B1_HSE_NBR_ALPHA_START PREM_HOUSE_NUMBER, 
B1P.B1_STR_NAME  PREM_STREET_NAME,
B1P.B1_SITUS_CITY  PREM_CITY,
B1P.B1_SITUS_STATE  PREM_STATE,
SUBSTRING(B1P.B1_SITUS_ZIP,1,5) PREM_ZIP_5,
SUBSTRING(B1P.B1_SITUS_ZIP,6,4) PREM_ZIP_4,
AO.BLOCK PREM_BLOCK,
AO.LOT PREM_LOT,
AO.BIN BIN,
  COALESCE(
    UPPER(B1P.B1_BUSINESS_NAME),
    UPPER(B1P.B1_LNAME),
    ''
  ) AS RESP_LAST_NAME,
  COALESCE(
    UPPER(B1P.B1_BUSINESS_NAME),
    UPPER(B1P.B1_FNAME),
    ''
  ) AS RESP_FIRST_NAME,
( CASE
      WHEN TRIM (UPPER (B1P.G7_CITY)) IN ('NY',
                                                 'NEW YORK',
                                                 'NEW YOK',
                                                 'NEW YORKQ',
                                                 'NYC',
                                                 'MANHATTAN')    THEN   '1'
                WHEN TRIM (UPPER (B1P.G7_CITY)) = 'BRONX' THEN '2'
                WHEN TRIM (UPPER (B1P.G7_CITY)) = 'BROOKLYN' THEN '3'
                WHEN TRIM (UPPER (B1P.G7_CITY)) = 'QUEENS' THEN '4'
                WHEN TRIM (UPPER (B1P.G7_CITY)) = 'STATEN ISLAND' THEN '5'  
                ELSE  '0'
             END) RESPONDENT_BORO,
UPPER(B1P.G7_HSE_NBR_ALPHA_START) RESPONDENT_HOUSE,
UPPER( B1P.G7_STR_NAME) RESPONDENT_STREET,
UPPER(B1P.G7_CITY) AS RESPONDENT_CITY,
UPPER(B1P.G7_STATE) AS RESPONDENT_STATE,
SUBSTRING(B1P.G7_ZIP,1,5) RESPONDENT_ZIP_5,
SUBSTRING(B1P.G7_ZIP,7,4) RESPONDENT_ZIP_4,
CONVERT(varchar, TRY_CAST(C.HEARING_DATE AS DATETIME), 112) HEARING_DATE,
CASE
    WHEN C.HEARING_TIME IS NOT NULL THEN 
	REPLACE(CONVERT(VARCHAR(8), TRY_CAST(C.HEARING_TIME AS DATETIME), 108), ':', '') 
    ELSE ''
  END HEARING_TIME,
  CONVERT(varchar, TRY_CAST(C.COMPLIANCE_DATE AS DATETIME), 112) COMPLIANCE_DATE,
( CASE
      WHEN TRIM (UPPER (B1P.B1_SITUS_CITY)) IN ('NY',
                                                 'NEW YORK',
                                                 'NEW YOK',
                                                 'NEW YORKQ',
                                                 'NYC',
                                                 'MANHATTAN')    THEN   '9'
                WHEN TRIM (UPPER (B1P.B1_SITUS_CITY)) = 'BRONX' THEN '7'
                WHEN TRIM (UPPER (B1P.B1_SITUS_CITY)) = 'BROOKLYN' THEN '4'
                WHEN TRIM (UPPER (B1P.B1_SITUS_CITY)) = 'QUEENS' THEN '8'
                WHEN TRIM (UPPER (B1P.B1_SITUS_CITY)) = 'STATEN ISLAND' THEN '2'  
                ELSE  ' '
             END) HEARING_LOCATION,


UPPER(dbo.FN_GET_STDCHOICE_VALUEDESC(
      B1P.SERV_PROV_CODE,
      'BFP_FSUM_HEARING_CENTERS',
      B1P.B1_SITUS_CITY
    )
  ) AS HEARING_CENTERS,
( CASE  WHEN TRY_CONVERT(INT,SUBSTRING(F.C1_VC,3,2)) IS NULL   THEN   ' ' ELSE concat('BF',RIGHT( '0' + CONVERT(VARCHAR,TRY_CONVERT(INT,SUBSTRING(F.C1_VC,3,2)) ),2) ) END) VC01,
( CASE  WHEN TRY_CONVERT(INT,SUBSTRING(F.C1_VC,3,2)) IS NULL   THEN   ' ' 
        WHEN C.MOS = 'Yes' THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N'  END) MOST01,
( CASE  WHEN TRY_CONVERT(INT,SUBSTRING(F.C2_VC,3,2)) IS NULL    THEN  ' ' ELSE concat('BF',RIGHT('0' + CONVERT(VARCHAR,TRY_CONVERT(INT,SUBSTRING(F.C2_VC,3,2))  ),2) ) END) VC02,
( CASE  WHEN TRY_CONVERT(INT,SUBSTRING(F.C2_VC,3,2)) IS NULL   THEN   ' ' 
        WHEN C.MOS = 'Yes' THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N'  END) MOST02,
( CASE  WHEN TRY_CONVERT(INT,SUBSTRING(F.C3_VC,3,2)) IS NULL    THEN   ' ' ELSE concat('BF',RIGHT('0' + CONVERT(VARCHAR,TRY_CONVERT(INT,SUBSTRING(F.C3_VC,3,2))  ),2) ) END) VC03,
( CASE  WHEN TRY_CONVERT(INT,SUBSTRING(F.C3_VC,3,2)) IS NULL   THEN   ' ' 
        WHEN C.MOS = 'Yes' THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N'  END) MOST03,
( CASE  WHEN TRY_CONVERT(INT,SUBSTRING(F.C4_VC,3,2)) IS NULL    THEN  ' ' ELSE  concat('BF',RIGHT('0' + CONVERT(VARCHAR,TRY_CONVERT(INT,SUBSTRING(F.C4_VC,3,2))  ),2) )  END) VC04,
( CASE  WHEN TRY_CONVERT(INT,SUBSTRING(F.C4_VC,3,2)) IS NULL   THEN   ' ' 
        WHEN C.MOS = 'Yes' THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N'  END) MOST04,



( CASE  WHEN TRY_CONVERT(INT,SUBSTRING(F.C1_VC,3,2)) IS NULL   THEN   ' ' ELSE F.C1_VC_DESC END) VC01_DESC,
( CASE  WHEN TRY_CONVERT(INT,SUBSTRING(F.C2_VC,3,2)) IS NULL    THEN  ' ' ELSE F.C2_VC_DESC  END) VC02_DESC,
( CASE  WHEN TRY_CONVERT(INT,SUBSTRING(F.C3_VC,3,2)) IS NULL    THEN   ' ' ELSE F.C3_VC_DESC  END) VC03_DESC,
( CASE  WHEN TRY_CONVERT(INT,SUBSTRING(F.C4_VC,3,2)) IS NULL    THEN  ' ' ELSE  F.C4_VC_DESC  END) VC04_DESC,


AD.ACCTNUM FIR_ACCT,
CONVERT(varchar, TRY_CAST(C.COMPLIANCE_DATE AS DATETIME), 112) FIR_COMP,
CASE
    WHEN B1P.B1_PHONE1 IS NOT NULL
    AND LEN(B1P.B1_PHONE1) > 1 THEN  SUBSTRING(B1P.B1_PHONE1, 1, 3) +  SUBSTRING(B1P.B1_PHONE1, 4, 3)  + SUBSTRING(B1P.B1_PHONE1, 7, 4)
    WHEN B1P.B1_PHONE2 IS NOT NULL
    AND LEN(B1P.B1_PHONE2) > 1 THEN  SUBSTRING(B1P.B1_PHONE2, 1, 3) +  SUBSTRING(B1P.B1_PHONE2, 4, 3) +  SUBSTRING(B1P.B1_PHONE2, 7, 4)
    WHEN B1P.B1_PHONE3 IS NOT NULL
    AND LEN(B1P.B1_PHONE3) > 1 THEN  SUBSTRING(B1P.B1_PHONE3, 1, 3) + SUBSTRING(B1P.B1_PHONE3, 4, 3) +  SUBSTRING(B1P.B1_PHONE3, 7, 4)
    ELSE ''
  END RESPONDENT_PHONE_NUMBER,
CONVERT(varchar, B1P.B1_BIRTH_DATE, 112) RESPONDENT_DOB,
B1P.B1_GENDER RESPONDENT_GENDER,
B1P.B1_EMAIL RESPONDENT_EMAIL,

  UPPER(C.UNIT) AS UNIT,
  UPPER(
    dbo.FN_GET_STDCHOICE_VALUEDESC(B1P.SERV_PROV_CODE, 'BFP_UNIT_PHONE', C.UNIT)
  ) AS UNIT_PHONE,

  C.DBA,

LEFT JOIN APO AO  ON  B1P.SERV_PROV_CODE = AO.SERV_PROV_CODE
								AND B1P.B1_PER_ID1 = AO.B1_PER_ID1
								AND B1P.B1_PER_ID2 = AO.B1_PER_ID2
								AND B1P.B1_PER_ID3 = AO.B1_PER_ID3
JOIN ACCT_DATA AD  ON  B1P.SERV_PROV_CODE = AD.SERV_PROV_CODE
								AND B1P.B1_PER_ID1 = AD.B1_PER_ID1
								AND B1P.B1_PER_ID2 = AD.B1_PER_ID2
								AND B1P.B1_PER_ID3 = AD.B1_PER_ID3
LEFT JOIN do_unit DU  ON  ad.SERV_PROV_CODE = du.SERV_PROV_CODE
								AND ad.b1_master_id1 = du.B1_PER_ID1
								AND ad.b1_master_id2 = du.B1_PER_ID2
								AND ad.b1_master_id3 = du.B1_PER_ID3
LEFT JOIN CONTACT cn  ON  cn.SERV_PROV_CODE = B1P.serv_prov_code
								AND cn.B1_PER_ID1 = B1P.b1_per_id1
								AND cn.B1_PER_ID2 = B1P.b1_per_id2
								AND cn.B1_PER_ID3 = B1P.b1_per_id3

LEFT JOIN #TMP_CUST_FIELDS C  ON  C.SERV_PROV_CODE = B1P.SERV_PROV_CODE
								AND C.B1_PER_ID1 = B1P.B1_PER_ID1
								AND C.B1_PER_ID2 = B1P.B1_PER_ID2
								AND C.B1_PER_ID3 = B1P.B1_PER_ID3
LEFT JOIN RBIZDOMAIN_VALUE STDCHC1  ON STDCHC1.BIZDOMAIN = 'ENF_OATH_OFFICES_ADDRESS'
								AND STDCHC1.BIZDOMAIN_VALUE = B1P.B1_SITUS_CITY
LEFT JOIN RBIZDOMAIN_VALUE STDCHC2  ON STDCHC2.BIZDOMAIN = 'BFP_UNIT_PHONE'
								AND STDCHC2.BIZDOMAIN_VALUE = C.UNIT
LEFT JOIN RBIZDOMAIN_VALUE STDCHC3  ON STDCHC3.BIZDOMAIN = 'BFP_FSUM_HEARING_CENTERS'
								AND lower(STDCHC3.BIZDOMAIN_VALUE) = lower(B1P.B1_SITUS_CITY)
LEFT JOIN PUSER PU ON PU.EMPLOYEE_ID = C.INSPECTOR_ID
LEFT JOIN G3STAFFS S ON PU.USER_NAME = S.GA_USER_ID
LEFT JOIN G3DPTTYP D ON D.SERV_PROV_CODE = S.SERV_PROV_CODE
							AND S.GA_AGENCY_CODE = D.R3_AGENCY_CODE
							AND S.GA_BUREAU_CODE = D.R3_BUREAU_CODE
							AND S.GA_DIVISION_CODE = D.R3_DIVISION_CODE
							AND S.GA_SECTION_CODE = D.R3_SECTION_CODE
							AND S.GA_GROUP_CODE = D.R3_GROUP_CODE
							AND S.GA_OFFICE_CODE = D.R3_OFFICE_CODE

  LEFT OUTER JOIN borough_zip_code bz on ISNULL(CAST(bz.borough_zip AS NVARCHAR(5)), '00000') = SUBSTRING(B1P.B1_SITUS_ZIP,1,5)

LEFT JOIN INFRACTION F ON B1P.SERV_PROV_CODE = F.SERV_PROV_CODE
							AND B1P.B1_PER_ID1 = F.B1_PER_ID1
							AND B1P.B1_PER_ID2 = F.B1_PER_ID2
							AND B1P.B1_PER_ID3 = F.B1_PER_ID3
WHERE 1 = 1
							AND B1P.SERV_PROV_CODE = 'FDNY'
							AND B1P.REC_STATUS      = 'A'
							AND C.CREATEDATE IS NOT NULL
							AND C.HEARING_DATE IS NOT NULL
							AND C.HEARING_TIME IS NOT NULL
							AND C.DCP_ST_NAME is not null

SELECT
    CONCAT(
    -- DEEP-INP-TYPE (length 1)
    LEFT(CONCAT(ISNULL(tp.input_type, ''), SPACE(1)), 1),

    -- DEEP-VIO-NUMB (length 10)
    LEFT(CONCAT(ISNULL(tp.record_id, ''), SPACE(10)), 10),

    -- DEEP-VIO-DATE (length 8) - Assuming violation_date is a date/datetime and you want 'YYYYMMDD'
    LEFT(CONCAT(ISNULL(CONVERT(NVARCHAR(8), tp.violation_date, 112), ''), SPACE(8)), 8),

    -- DEEP_VIO_TIME (length 4)
    LEFT(CONCAT(ISNULL(SUBSTRING(tp.violation_time, 1, 4), ''), SPACE(4)), 4),

    -- DEEP_ISS_AGCY (length 3)
    LEFT(CONCAT('FIR', SPACE(3)), 3),

    -- DEEP_OFC_OIDN (length 10)
    LEFT(CONCAT(ISNULL(tp.issuing_officer_id, ''), SPACE(10)), 10),

    -- DEEP_OFC_NAME (length 20)
    LEFT(CONCAT(ISNULL(tp.issuing_officer_name, ''), SPACE(20)), 20),

    -- DEEP_OFC_UNIT (length 2)
    LEFT(CONCAT(ISNULL(tp.issuing_unit, ''), SPACE(2)), 2),

    -- DEEP_ISS_BORO (length 1) - Assuming dcp_boro_id is numeric, cast to string first.
    LEFT(CONCAT(ISNULL(CAST(substring(tp.bin,1,1) AS NVARCHAR(1)), ''), SPACE(1)), 1),

    -- DEEP_ISS_PREF (length 1)
    LEFT(CONCAT(' ', SPACE(1)), 1),

    -- DEEP_ISS_HOUSE (length 12)
    LEFT(CONCAT(ISNULL(tp.prem_house_number, ''), SPACE(12)), 12),

    -- DEEP_ISS_STRE (complex, needs careful handling - nested CONCAT or direct LEFT/SPACE)
    CONCAT(
        LEFT(CONCAT(ISNULL(tp.DCP_ST_PFX, ''), SPACE(2)), 2),
        ' ',
        LEFT(CONCAT(ISNULL(tp.DCP_ST_NAME, ''), SPACE(20)), 20),
        ' ',
        LEFT(CONCAT(ISNULL(tp.DCP_ST_TYPE, ''), SPACE(4)), 4),
        ' ',
        LEFT(CONCAT(ISNULL(tp.DCP_ST_SFX, ''), SPACE(2)), 2)
    ), ' ', -- The final ' ' for this block

---test
--LEFT(CONCAT(' ', SPACE(32)), 32),


    -- DEEP_ISS_2LIN (length 32)
    LEFT(CONCAT(' ', SPACE(32)), 32),

    -- DEEP_ISS_SUDT (length 12)
    LEFT(CONCAT(' ', SPACE(12)), 12),

    -- DEEP_ISS_SUDV (length 12)
    LEFT(CONCAT(' ', SPACE(12)), 12),

    -- DEEP_ISS_STAT (length 2)
    LEFT(CONCAT('NY', SPACE(2)), 2),

    -- DEEP_ISS_ZIP5 (length 5)
    LEFT(CONCAT(ISNULL(tp.prem_zip_5, ''), SPACE(5)), 5),

    -- DEEP_ISS_ZIP4 (length 4)
    LEFT(CONCAT(ISNULL(tp.prem_zip_4, ''), SPACE(4)), 4),

    -- DEEP_ISS_BLOC (length 5)
    LEFT(CONCAT(ISNULL(tp.prem_block, ''), SPACE(5)), 5),

    -- DEEP_ISS_LOTN (length 5)
    LEFT(CONCAT(ISNULL(tp.prem_lot, ''), SPACE(5)), 5),

    -- DEEP_BRD-NMBR (length 4)
    LEFT(CONCAT(' ', SPACE(4)), 4),

    -- DEEP_ISS-TYPE (length 2)
    LEFT(CONCAT(' ', SPACE(2)), 2),

    -- DEEP_ISS_BINN (length 10)
    LEFT(CONCAT(ISNULL(tp.bin, ''), SPACE(10)), 10),

    -- DEEP_ISS-FACI (length 4)
    LEFT(CONCAT(' ', SPACE(4)), 4),

    -- DEEP_RS1_LNAM (length 50)
    LEFT(CONCAT(ISNULL(tp.resp_last_name, ''), SPACE(50)), 50),

    LEFT(CONCAT(' ', SPACE(1)), 1),

    -- DEEP_RS1_BORO (length 1) - Handle numeric to string conversion and NULL.
    LEFT(CONCAT(ISNULL(CAST(tp.respondent_boro AS NVARCHAR(1)), '0'), SPACE(1)), 1),

    -- DEEP_RS1_HOUSE (length 12)
    LEFT(CONCAT(ISNULL(tp.respondent_house, ''), SPACE(12)), 12),

    -- DEEP_RS1_STRE (length 32)
    LEFT(CONCAT(ISNULL(tp.respondent_street, ''), SPACE(32)), 32),

    -- DEEP_RS1_2LIN (length 32)
    LEFT(CONCAT(' ', SPACE(32)), 32),

    -- DEEP_ISS_SUDT (length 12) - Duplicated, check if intentional
    LEFT(CONCAT(' ', SPACE(12)), 12),

    LEFT(CONCAT(' ', SPACE(12)), 12),

    -- DEEP_DOB_PROJ (length 4)
    LEFT(CONCAT(' ', SPACE(4)), 4),

    -- DEEP_DOB_INDX (length 40)
    LEFT(CONCAT(' ', SPACE(40)), 40),

    -- DEEP_DOB_UCDE (length 2)
    LEFT(CONCAT(' ', SPACE(2)), 2),

    -- DEEP_DOB_TXLI (length 1)
    LEFT(CONCAT(' ', SPACE(1)), 1),

    -- DEEP_DOB_EXHI (length 1)
    LEFT(CONCAT(' ', SPACE(1)), 1),

    -- DEEP-FIR-ACCT (length 8)
    LEFT(CONCAT(ISNULL(tp.fir_acct, ''), SPACE(8)), 8),

    -- DEEP_FIR_ITEM (length 5)
    LEFT(CONCAT(' ', SPACE(5)), 5),

    -- DEEP_FIR_DOFF (length 2)
    LEFT(CONCAT(ISNULL(tp.issuing_unit, ''), SPACE(2)), 2),

    -- DEEP_FIR_FUPI (length 4)
    LEFT(CONCAT(ISNULL(tp.admin_co, ''), SPACE(4)), 4),

    -- DEEP_MSC_POPY (length 1)
    LEFT(CONCAT(tp.CITY_AGENCY, SPACE(1)), 1),

    -- DEEP_MSC_POPA (length 3)
    LEFT(CONCAT(tp.AGENCY_CODE, SPACE(3)), 3),

    -- DEEP_MSC_COMM (length 210)
    LEFT(CONCAT(' ', SPACE(210)), 210),
--	LEFT(CONCAT(ISNULL(tp.VC01_CMNTS, ''), SPACE(50)), 50),
--	LEFT(CONCAT(ISNULL(tp.VC02_CMNTS, ''), SPACE(50)), 50),
--	LEFT(CONCAT(ISNULL(tp.VC03_CMNTS, ''), SPACE(50)), 50),
--	LEFT(CONCAT(ISNULL(tp.VC04_CMNTS, ''), SPACE(50)), 50),
--	LEFT(CONCAT(' ', SPACE(10)), 10),
    -- DEEP-FIR-COMP (length 8)
    LEFT(CONCAT(ISNULL(tp.fir_comp, ''), SPACE(8)), 8)
    ) AS CombinedFixedLengthString
FROM
    #TMP_RESULTS tp
WHERE 1=1
	AND tp.violation_date > '20210905' 
    --AND tp.record_id = '014113001Z' -- Commented out as in Oracle
    --AND tp.violation_date BETWEEN '20240930' AND '20241003'
ORDER BY
    tp.record_id;

WITH CUST_FIELDS AS

       B1_PER_ID1,
       B1_PER_ID2,
       B1_PER_ID3,
	   [Division FP Unit] AS UNIT,
       [DBA] AS DBA,
       [Creation Date/Time] AS CREATEDATE,
       [HEARING DATE] AS HEARING_DATE,
       [HEARING TIME] AS HEARING_TIME,
       [COMPLIANCE DATE] AS COMPLIANCE_DATE,
       [INSPECTOR NAME] AS INSPECTOR_NAME,
       [INSPECTOR ID] AS INSPECTOR_ID,
	   [Advised by: Name] AS ADVISED_NAME,
	   [Advised by: Position or Relationship to building] AS ADVISED_RELA,
	   [Affixed Summons at location] AS AFFIXED_LOCA,
	   [Service Method] AS SERVICE_METHOD,
       [Description of Violation] AS VIOLATION_DESC,
       [REPEAT OFFENDER] AS MOS,
       [City Agency] AS CITY_AGENCY,
	   [prefix] AS DCP_ST_PFX,
	   [street_name] AS DCP_ST_NAME,
	   [ending] AS DCP_ST_TYPE,
	   [suffix] AS DCP_ST_SFX,
	   [Type] AS SYST_TYPE
  FROM 
    (SELECT C.SERV_PROV_CODE,
               C.B1_PER_ID1,
               C.B1_PER_ID2,
               C.B1_PER_ID3,
               UPPER (C.B1_CHECKLIST_COMMENT) B1_CHECKLIST_COMMENT,
               C.B1_CHECKBOX_DESC
          FROM BCHCKBOX C
   JOIN #TMP_RECORDLIST iv ON iv.serv_prov_code = C.serv_prov_code
                                  AND iv.b1_per_id1 = C.b1_per_id1
                                  AND iv.b1_per_id2 = C.b1_per_id2
                                  AND iv.b1_per_id3 = C.b1_per_id3
		  ) PV1 PIVOT (MIN (B1_CHECKLIST_COMMENT)
                           FOR B1_CHECKBOX_DESC
                           IN  ([Division FP Unit],
                               [DBA],
                               [Creation Date/Time],
                               [HEARING DATE],
                               [HEARING TIME],
                               [COMPLIANCE DATE],
                               [INSPECTOR NAME],
                               [INSPECTOR ID],
							   [Advised by: Name],
							   [Advised by: Position or Relationship to building],
							   [Affixed Summons at location],
							   [Service Method],
							   [prefix],
							   [street_name],
							   [ending],
							   [suffix],
                               [Type],
                               [REPEAT OFFENDER],
                               [City Agency],
                               [Description of Violation])) PV2
)
   select * INTO #TMP_CUST_FIELDS from CUST_FIELDS;

WITH vio_data AS (

SELECT
      SERV_PROV_CODE,
      B1_PER_ID1,
      B1_PER_ID2,
      B1_PER_ID3,
       UPPER(VO_CAT) AS VO_CAT,
       ROW_NUMBER()
        OVER(PARTITION BY SERV_PROV_CODE, B1_PER_ID1, B1_PER_ID2, B1_PER_ID3   ORDER BY   vo_cat DESC ) rn

       
     
FROM
       (

                SELECT
                       bap.SERV_PROV_CODE,
                        bap.B1_PER_ID1,
                        bap.B1_PER_ID2,
                        bap.B1_PER_ID3,
					   MAX(CASE WHEN bap.COLUMN_NAME='Violation Category' THEN bap.ATTRIBUTE_VALUE END)     AS VO_CAT


                FROM
                       BAPPSPECTABLE_VALUE bap
    JOIN #TMP_RECORDLIST iv ON iv.serv_prov_code = bap.serv_prov_code
                              AND iv.b1_per_id1 = bap.b1_per_id1
                              AND iv.b1_per_id2 = bap.b1_per_id2
                              AND iv.b1_per_id3 = bap.b1_per_id3

                WHERE 1=1
                         AND bap.TABLE_NAME    = 'LIST OF VIOLATION CODES'
                         --
                GROUP BY
                        bap.SERV_PROV_CODE,
                        bap.B1_PER_ID1,
                        bap.B1_PER_ID2,
                        bap.B1_PER_ID3,
                        bap.ROW_INDEX,
                        bap.TABLE_NAME
       ) xx
    
GROUP BY 
                       SERV_PROV_CODE,
                        B1_PER_ID1,
                        B1_PER_ID2,
                        B1_PER_ID3,
                        VO_CAT
),

VC_CODES AS (
    SELECT
        vd.SERV_PROV_CODE,
        vd.B1_PER_ID1,
        vd.B1_PER_ID2,
        vd.B1_PER_ID3,
        vd.vo_cat,
        vd.rn,

        MAX(CASE WHEN  vd.rn = 1 THEN vd.vo_cat END) OVER (PARTITION BY vd.SERV_PROV_CODE, vd.B1_PER_ID1, vd.B1_PER_ID2, vd.B1_PER_ID3) AS VC1_CODE,
        MAX(CASE WHEN  vd.rn = 2 THEN vd.vo_cat END) OVER (PARTITION BY vd.SERV_PROV_CODE, vd.B1_PER_ID1, vd.B1_PER_ID2, vd.B1_PER_ID3) AS VC2_CODE,
        MAX(CASE WHEN  vd.rn = 3 THEN vd.vo_cat END) OVER (PARTITION BY vd.SERV_PROV_CODE, vd.B1_PER_ID1, vd.B1_PER_ID2, vd.B1_PER_ID3) AS VC3_CODE,
        MAX(CASE WHEN  vd.rn = 4 THEN vd.vo_cat END) OVER (PARTITION BY vd.SERV_PROV_CODE, vd.B1_PER_ID1, vd.B1_PER_ID2, vd.B1_PER_ID3) AS VC4_CODE


    FROM
        vio_data vd

    bp.b1_per_sub_type           AS ENFPERSUBTYPE,
    bp.b1_appl_status            AS ENFAPPSTATUS,
    bp.b1_appl_status_date       AS ENFAPPSTATUSDATE
FROM
         xapp2ref xr
   JOIN #TMP_RECORDLIST iv ON iv.serv_prov_code = XR.serv_prov_code
                                  AND iv.b1_per_id1 = XR.b1_per_id1
                                  AND iv.b1_per_id2 = XR.b1_per_id2
                                  AND iv.b1_per_id3 = XR.b1_per_id3

    INNER JOIN b1permit  bp ON bp.serv_prov_code = xr.serv_prov_code
                                  AND bp.b1_per_id1 = xr.b1_per_id1
                                  AND bp.b1_per_id2 = xr.b1_per_id2
                                  AND bp.b1_per_id3 = xr.b1_per_id3
    INNER JOIN b1permit  bpl ON bpl.serv_prov_code = xr.serv_prov_code
                                            AND bpl.b1_per_id1 = xr.b1_master_id1
                                            AND bpl.b1_per_id2 = xr.b1_master_id2
                                            AND bpl.b1_per_id3 = xr.b1_master_id3   
LEFT JOIN do_unit DU  ON  du.SERV_PROV_CODE = bpl.serv_prov_code
								AND du.B1_PER_ID1 = bpl.b1_per_id1
								AND du.B1_PER_ID2 = bpl.b1_per_id2
								AND du.B1_PER_ID3 = bpl.b1_per_id3

WHERE
        bpl.b1_per_type = 'Common'
        and bpl.b1_per_sub_type = 'Inspection'
		AND bpl.b1_appl_status <> 'Inactive'
),

--) SELECT * FROM ACCT_DATA WHERE ENFNUM  = '014041698H'
BOROUGH_ZIP_CODE AS (
select 
	VALUE_DESC, 
	BIZDOMAIN_VALUE as borough_zip,
	( CASE
      WHEN TRIM (UPPER (VALUE_DESC)) IN ('MANHATTAN')    THEN   '1'
                WHEN TRIM (UPPER (VALUE_DESC)) = 'BRONX' THEN '2'
                WHEN TRIM (UPPER (VALUE_DESC)) = 'BROOKLYN' THEN '3'
                WHEN TRIM (UPPER (VALUE_DESC)) = 'QUEENS' THEN '4'
                WHEN TRIM (UPPER (VALUE_DESC)) = 'STATEN ISLAND' THEN '5'  
                ELSE  ' '
             END) borough_code
from  RBIZDOMAIN_VALUE 
where BIZDOMAIN= 'REF_BORO_ZIP' 
and SERV_PROV_CODE='FDNY' 
and REC_STATUS='A'
),

FROM #TMP_RECORDLIST B1P

LEFT JOIN APO AO  ON  B1P.SERV_PROV_CODE = AO.SERV_PROV_CODE
								AND B1P.B1_PER_ID1 = AO.B1_PER_ID1
								AND B1P.B1_PER_ID2 = AO.B1_PER_ID2
								AND B1P.B1_PER_ID3 = AO.B1_PER_ID3
JOIN ACCT_DATA AD  ON  B1P.SERV_PROV_CODE = AD.SERV_PROV_CODE
								AND B1P.B1_PER_ID1 = AD.B1_PER_ID1
								AND B1P.B1_PER_ID2 = AD.B1_PER_ID2
								AND B1P.B1_PER_ID3 = AD.B1_PER_ID3
LEFT JOIN do_unit DU  ON  ad.SERV_PROV_CODE = du.SERV_PROV_CODE
								AND ad.b1_master_id1 = du.B1_PER_ID1
								AND ad.b1_master_id2 = du.B1_PER_ID2
								AND ad.b1_master_id3 = du.B1_PER_ID3
LEFT JOIN CONTACT cn  ON  cn.SERV_PROV_CODE = B1P.serv_prov_code
								AND cn.B1_PER_ID1 = B1P.b1_per_id1
								AND cn.B1_PER_ID2 = B1P.b1_per_id2
								AND cn.B1_PER_ID3 = B1P.b1_per_id3

LEFT JOIN #TMP_CUST_FIELDS C  ON  C.SERV_PROV_CODE = B1P.SERV_PROV_CODE
								AND C.B1_PER_ID1 = B1P.B1_PER_ID1
								AND C.B1_PER_ID2 = B1P.B1_PER_ID2
								AND C.B1_PER_ID3 = B1P.B1_PER_ID3
LEFT JOIN RBIZDOMAIN_VALUE STDCHC1  ON STDCHC1.BIZDOMAIN = 'ENF_OATH_OFFICES_ADDRESS'
								AND STDCHC1.BIZDOMAIN_VALUE = B1P.B1_SITUS_CITY
LEFT JOIN RBIZDOMAIN_VALUE STDCHC2  ON STDCHC2.BIZDOMAIN = 'BFP_UNIT_PHONE'
								AND STDCHC2.BIZDOMAIN_VALUE = C.UNIT
LEFT JOIN RBIZDOMAIN_VALUE STDCHC3  ON STDCHC3.BIZDOMAIN = 'BFP_FSUM_HEARING_CENTERS'
								AND lower(STDCHC3.BIZDOMAIN_VALUE) = lower(B1P.B1_SITUS_CITY)
LEFT JOIN PUSER PU ON PU.EMPLOYEE_ID = C.INSPECTOR_ID
LEFT JOIN G3STAFFS S ON PU.USER_NAME = S.GA_USER_ID
LEFT JOIN G3DPTTYP D ON D.SERV_PROV_CODE = S.SERV_PROV_CODE
							AND S.GA_AGENCY_CODE = D.R3_AGENCY_CODE
							AND S.GA_BUREAU_CODE = D.R3_BUREAU_CODE
							AND S.GA_DIVISION_CODE = D.R3_DIVISION_CODE
							AND S.GA_SECTION_CODE = D.R3_SECTION_CODE
							AND S.GA_GROUP_CODE = D.R3_GROUP_CODE
							AND S.GA_OFFICE_CODE = D.R3_OFFICE_CODE

  LEFT OUTER JOIN borough_zip_code bz on ISNULL(CAST(bz.borough_zip AS NVARCHAR(5)), '00000') = SUBSTRING(B1P.B1_SITUS_ZIP,1,5)

LEFT JOIN INFRACTION F ON B1P.SERV_PROV_CODE = F.SERV_PROV_CODE
							AND B1P.B1_PER_ID1 = F.B1_PER_ID1
							AND B1P.B1_PER_ID2 = F.B1_PER_ID2
							AND B1P.B1_PER_ID3 = F.B1_PER_ID3
WHERE 1 = 1
							AND B1P.SERV_PROV_CODE = 'FDNY'
							AND B1P.REC_STATUS      = 'A'
							AND C.CREATEDATE IS NOT NULL
							AND C.HEARING_DATE IS NOT NULL
							AND C.HEARING_TIME IS NOT NULL
							AND C.DCP_ST_NAME is not null
							AND B1P.G7_STR_NAME IS NOT NULL
--	AND B1_ALT_ID IN   ('014144540J')
),
RESULTS AS (
SELECT 
   od.input_type,
   od.record_id,
   od.violation_date,
   od.violation_time,
   od.issuing_agency,
   Coalesce(od.issuing_officer_id,' ') issuing_officer_id,
   Coalesce(od.issuing_officer_name,' ') issuing_officer_name,
   Coalesce(od.issuing_boro,' ') issuing_boro,   
   Coalesce(od.issuing_unit,' ') issuing_unit,   
   Coalesce(od.prem_address_id,' ') prem_address_id, 
   Coalesce(od.location_id,' ') location_id, 
   Coalesce(od.EXT_ADDRESS_UID,' ') ext_address_uid, 
   REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(Coalesce(od.prem_house_number,' '), CHAR(13)+CHAR(10), ' '), CHAR(10), ' '), CHAR(13), ' ') prem_house_number,
   REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(Coalesce(od.prem_street_name,' '), CHAR(13)+CHAR(10), ' '), CHAR(10), ' '), CHAR(13), ' ') prem_street_name, 
   REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(Coalesce(od.prem_city,' '), CHAR(13)+CHAR(10), ' '), CHAR(10), ' '), CHAR(13), ' ') prem_city, 
  
   Coalesce(od.prem_state,' ') prem_state,   
   Coalesce(od.prem_zip_4,' ') prem_zip_4,    
   Coalesce(od.prem_zip_5,' ') prem_zip_5, 
   
   Coalesce(od.prem_block,' ') prem_block, 
   Coalesce(od.bin,' ') bin,

WITH AIMVADD AS
(
SELECT
	B1_CONTACT_NBR, 
	G7_HSE_NBR_ALPHA_START,
	G7_STR_NAME,
	G7_CITY,
	G7_STATE,
	G7_ZIP,
	G7_ADDRESS_TYPE,
	rec_date,
	RN
FROM
(
SELECT 
	XREC.B1_CONTACT_NBR, 
	G7A.G7_HSE_NBR_ALPHA_START,
	G7A.G7_STR_NAME,
	G7A.G7_CITY,
	G7A.G7_STATE,
	G7A.G7_ZIP,
	G7A.G7_ADDRESS_TYPE,
	G7A.rec_date,
	ROW_NUMBER()
       OVER(PARTITION BY XREC.B1_CONTACT_NBR
            ORDER BY   G7A.rec_date DESC ) rn
  FROM G7CONTACT_ADDRESS G7A
       LEFT JOIN XRECORD_CONTACT_ENTITY XREC
          ON     G7A.G7_ENTITY_TYPE = XREC.ENT_TYPE
             AND G7A.RES_ID = XREC.ENT_ID1
             AND G7A.SERV_PROV_CODE = XREC.SERV_PROV_CODE
             AND XREC.REC_STATUS = 'A'
	WHERE
		G7A.G7_ADDRESS_TYPE = 'Mailing Address' 
	AND XREC.B1_CONTACT_NBR IS NOT NULL
) TR
   WHERE RN = 1
),
OATH_ENTRY AS
(
SELECT SERV_PROV_CODE,
       B1_PER_ID1,
       B1_PER_ID2,
       B1_PER_ID3,
	   [Entered in OAth] AS ENTERED_IN_OATH,
       [OATH HEARING DATE] AS OATH_HRG_DATE

  FROM 
    (SELECT C.SERV_PROV_CODE,
               C.B1_PER_ID1,
               C.B1_PER_ID2,
               C.B1_PER_ID3,
               C.B1_CHECKLIST_COMMENT,
               C.B1_CHECKBOX_DESC
          FROM BCHCKBOX C
		  ) PV1 PIVOT (MIN (B1_CHECKLIST_COMMENT)
                           FOR B1_CHECKBOX_DESC
                           IN  ([Entered in OAth],
                               [OATH HEARING DATE]
)) PV2
),
GP_HIST as (
SELECT SERV_PROV_CODE,
		B1_PER_ID1,
		B1_PER_ID2,
		B1_PER_ID3,
		sd_pro_des,
		sd_app_des,
		sd_app_dd,
		rn
FROM
	(SELECT gp.SERV_PROV_CODE,
		gp.B1_PER_ID1,
		gp.B1_PER_ID2,
	    gp.B1_PER_ID3,
		gp.sd_pro_des,
		gp.sd_app_des,
		gp.sd_app_dd,
		ROW_NUMBER()
			OVER(PARTITION BY gp.SERV_PROV_CODE, gp.B1_PER_ID1, gp.B1_PER_ID2, gp.B1_PER_ID3   ORDER BY   gp.sd_app_dd DESC ) rn
	   FROM  gprocess_history gp    
--WHERE 1=1
--	   AND gp.sd_pro_des = 'Supervisor Review'
--	   AND gp.sd_app_des = 'Approved'
--	   AND gp.sd_app_dd > getdate() - 90

) TR
	WHERE RN = 1

),
SUMMONS_SET AS (
SELECT 
    sd.serv_prov_code,
    sd.b1_per_id1,
    sd.b1_per_id2,
    sd.b1_per_id3,
    sh.set_id,
    sh.set_status,
    CAST(sh.set_date as date) set_date,
	b.b1_alt_id record_id,
    sd.set_seq_nbr,
    sd.rec_date,
    sd.rec_ful_nam,
    sd.rec_status,
    sd.audit_init_by,
    sd.audit_init_date,
    sd.audit_mod_by,
    sd.audit_mod_date

FROM B1PERMIT B
    INNER JOIN SETDETAILS SD
    ON SD.SERV_PROV_CODE= B.SERV_PROV_CODE
    AND SD.B1_PER_ID1 = B.B1_PER_ID1
    AND SD.B1_PER_ID2 = B.B1_PER_ID2
    AND SD.B1_PER_ID3 = B.B1_PER_ID3  

    INNER JOIN SETHEADER SH
    ON SH.SERV_PROV_CODE = SD.SERV_PROV_CODE
    AND SH.SET_ID = SD.SET_ID

WHERE 1=1
    AND sd.set_id LIKE 'FDNY_SUMMONS_ECB%'
 --   AND CAST(sh.set_date as date) = CAST(DATEADD(day, -1, @BATCHDATE) AS DATE)
    and sd.SERV_PROV_CODE='FDNY' 
    and sd.REC_STATUS='A'
    and b.b1_alt_id =@SUMNUM
),

SUM_DATA AS (
    SELECT
    bp.serv_prov_code,
    bp.b1_per_id1,
    bp.b1_per_id2,  
    bp.b1_per_id3,
    bp.b1_alt_id,
	bp.B1_FILE_DD,
	bp.rec_status,
	oe.ENTERED_IN_OATH,
    bp.rec_date,
--    gp.sd_pro_des,
--    gp.sd_app_des,
--    gp.sd_app_dd,
	A.B1_CONTACT_NBR,
	A.B1_CONTACT_TYPE,
	A.B1_PHONE1,
	A.B1_PHONE2,
	A.B1_PHONE3,
	A.B1_BIRTH_DATE,
	A.B1_GENDER,
	A.B1_EMAIL,
	A.B1_BUSINESS_NAME,
	A.B1_LNAME,
	A.B1_FNAME,
    B3A.EXT_ADDRESS_UID,
	B3A.B1_HSE_NBR_ALPHA_START , 
	B3A.B1_STR_NAME,
	B3A.B1_SITUS_CITY,
	B3A.B1_SITUS_STATE,
	B3A.B1_SITUS_ZIP,
	A1.G7_HSE_NBR_ALPHA_START,
	A1.G7_STR_NAME,
	A1.G7_CITY,
	A1.G7_STATE,
	A1.G7_ZIP,
	A1.G7_ADDRESS_TYPE,
    oe.OATH_HRG_DATE




    FROM
        b1permit bp
   JOIN OATH_ENTRY oe ON oe.serv_prov_code = bp.serv_prov_code
                                  AND oe.b1_per_id1 = bp.b1_per_id1
                                  AND oe.b1_per_id2 = bp.b1_per_id2
                                  AND oe.b1_per_id3 = bp.b1_per_id3
--   JOIN gp_hist gp    ON gp.serv_prov_code = bp.serv_prov_code
--                                  AND gp.b1_per_id1 = bp.b1_per_id1
--                                  AND gp.b1_per_id2 = bp.b1_per_id2
--                                  AND gp.b1_per_id3 = bp.b1_per_id3
  JOIN SUMMONS_SET SD  ON  bp.SERV_PROV_CODE = SD.SERV_PROV_CODE
								AND bp.B1_PER_ID1 = SD.B1_PER_ID1
								AND bp.B1_PER_ID2 = SD.B1_PER_ID2
								AND bp.B1_PER_ID3 = SD.B1_PER_ID3

  LEFT JOIN B3CONTACT AS A ON A.SERV_PROV_CODE = BP.SERV_PROV_CODE
              AND A.B1_PER_ID1 = BP.B1_PER_ID1
              AND A.B1_PER_ID2 = BP.B1_PER_ID2
              AND A.B1_PER_ID3 = BP.B1_PER_ID3
			  AND A.B1_CONTACT_TYPE = 'Respondent'
	LEFT JOIN B3ADDRES B3A  ON  BP.SERV_PROV_CODE = B3A.SERV_PROV_CODE
								AND BP.B1_PER_ID1 = B3A.B1_PER_ID1
								AND BP.B1_PER_ID2 = B3A.B1_PER_ID2
								AND BP.B1_PER_ID3 = B3A.B1_PER_ID3
								AND B3A.B1_PRIMARY_ADDR_FLG = 'Y'
LEFT JOIN AIMVADD A1 ON A1.B1_CONTACT_NBR = A.B1_CONTACT_NBR


    WHERE 1=1
        AND bp.B1_PER_TYPE = 'Enforcement'
        AND bp.B1_PER_SUB_TYPE  = 'FDNY Summons'
        AND bp.REC_STATUS = 'A'
        AND bp.SERV_PROV_CODE = 'FDNY'
        AND bp.B1_PER_GROUP = 'BFP'
        AND bp.B1_PER_CATEGORY = 'NA'
        AND (bp.B1_APPL_CLASS NOT LIKE 'INCOMPLETE%' OR bp.B1_APPL_CLASS IS NULL)
--      AND bp.B1_CREATED_BY NOT IN ('Interface','AA CONV')
--		AND bp.B1_ALT_ID LIKE '014%'
	   AND DATEADD(day,0,try_convert(DATE,bp.B1_FILE_DD)) > convert(DATE,'2021-09-05')
-- 	   AND oe.ENTERED_IN_OATH is null
--	   AND gp.sd_pro_des = 'Supervisor Review'
--	   AND gp.sd_app_des = 'Approved'
--	   AND CAST(gp.sd_app_dd as date) = CAST(DATEADD(day, -1, GETDATE()) AS DATE)
),
--) SELECT * FROM SUM_DATA

(
SELECT 
	SERV_PROV_CODE,
	B1_PER_ID1,
	B1_PER_ID2,
	B1_PER_ID3,
    b1_alt_id,
	B1_FILE_DD,
	rec_status,
--	sd_pro_des,

	B1_CONTACT_NBR,
	B1_CONTACT_TYPE,
	B1_PHONE1,
	B1_PHONE2,
	B1_PHONE3,

	B1_SITUS_CITY,

   select * INTO #TMP_RECORDLIST from RECORDLIST;
 --SELECT * FROM #TMP_RECORDLIST
WITH CUST_FIELDS AS
(
SELECT SERV_PROV_CODE,
       B1_PER_ID1,
       B1_PER_ID2,
       B1_PER_ID3,
	   [Division FP Unit] AS UNIT,
       [DBA] AS DBA,
       [Creation Date/Time] AS CREATEDATE,
       [HEARING DATE] AS HEARING_DATE,
       [HEARING TIME] AS HEARING_TIME,
       [COMPLIANCE DATE] AS COMPLIANCE_DATE,
       [INSPECTOR NAME] AS INSPECTOR_NAME,
       [INSPECTOR ID] AS INSPECTOR_ID,
	   [Advised by: Name] AS ADVISED_NAME,
	   [Advised by: Position or Relationship to building] AS ADVISED_RELA,
	   [Affixed Summons at location] AS AFFIXED_LOCA,
	   [Service Method] AS SERVICE_METHOD,
       [Description of Violation] AS VIOLATION_DESC,
       [REPEAT OFFENDER] AS MOS,
       [City Agency] AS CITY_AGENCY,
	   [prefix] AS DCP_ST_PFX,
	   [street_name] AS DCP_ST_NAME,
	   [ending] AS DCP_ST_TYPE,
	   [suffix] AS DCP_ST_SFX,
	   [Type] AS SYST_TYPE
  FROM 
    (SELECT C.SERV_PROV_CODE,
               C.B1_PER_ID1,
               C.B1_PER_ID2,
               C.B1_PER_ID3,
               UPPER (C.B1_CHECKLIST_COMMENT) B1_CHECKLIST_COMMENT,
               C.B1_CHECKBOX_DESC
          FROM BCHCKBOX C
   JOIN #TMP_RECORDLIST iv ON iv.serv_prov_code = C.serv_prov_code
                                  AND iv.b1_per_id1 = C.b1_per_id1
                                  AND iv.b1_per_id2 = C.b1_per_id2
                                  AND iv.b1_per_id3 = C.b1_per_id3
		  ) PV1 PIVOT (MIN (B1_CHECKLIST_COMMENT)
                           FOR B1_CHECKBOX_DESC
                           IN  ([Division FP Unit],
                               [DBA],
                               [Creation Date/Time],
                               [HEARING DATE],
                               [HEARING TIME],
                               [COMPLIANCE DATE],
                               [INSPECTOR NAME],
                               [INSPECTOR ID],
							   [Advised by: Name],
							   [Advised by: Position or Relationship to building],
							   [Affixed Summons at location],
							   [Service Method],
							   [prefix],
							   [street_name],
							   [ending],
							   [suffix],
                               [Type],
                               [REPEAT OFFENDER],
                               [City Agency],
                               [Description of Violation])) PV2
)
   select * INTO #TMP_CUST_FIELDS from CUST_FIELDS;

 --  SELECT * FROM #TMP_CUST_FIELDS

WITH vio_data AS (

SELECT
      SERV_PROV_CODE,
      B1_PER_ID1,
      B1_PER_ID2,
      B1_PER_ID3,
       UPPER(VO_CAT) AS VO_CAT,
       ROW_NUMBER()
        OVER(PARTITION BY SERV_PROV_CODE, B1_PER_ID1, B1_PER_ID2, B1_PER_ID3   ORDER BY   vo_cat DESC ) rn

       
     
FROM
       (

                SELECT
                       bap.SERV_PROV_CODE,
                        bap.B1_PER_ID1,
                        bap.B1_PER_ID2,
                        bap.B1_PER_ID3,
					   MAX(CASE WHEN bap.COLUMN_NAME='Violation Category' THEN bap.ATTRIBUTE_VALUE END)     AS VO_CAT


                FROM
                       BAPPSPECTABLE_VALUE bap
    JOIN #TMP_RECORDLIST iv ON iv.serv_prov_code = bap.serv_prov_code
                              AND iv.b1_per_id1 = bap.b1_per_id1
                              AND iv.b1_per_id2 = bap.b1_per_id2
                              AND iv.b1_per_id3 = bap.b1_per_id3

                WHERE 1=1
                         AND bap.TABLE_NAME    = 'LIST OF VIOLATION CODES'
                         --
                GROUP BY
                        bap.SERV_PROV_CODE,
                        bap.B1_PER_ID1,
                        bap.B1_PER_ID2,
                        bap.B1_PER_ID3,
                        bap.ROW_INDEX,
                        bap.TABLE_NAME
       ) xx
    
GROUP BY 
                       SERV_PROV_CODE,
                        B1_PER_ID1,
                        B1_PER_ID2,
                        B1_PER_ID3,
                        VO_CAT
),

VC_CODES AS (
    SELECT
        vd.SERV_PROV_CODE,
        vd.B1_PER_ID1,
        vd.B1_PER_ID2,
        vd.B1_PER_ID3,
        vd.vo_cat,
        vd.rn,

        MAX(CASE WHEN  vd.rn = 1 THEN vd.vo_cat END) OVER (PARTITION BY vd.SERV_PROV_CODE, vd.B1_PER_ID1, vd.B1_PER_ID2, vd.B1_PER_ID3) AS VC1_CODE,
        MAX(CASE WHEN  vd.rn = 2 THEN vd.vo_cat END) OVER (PARTITION BY vd.SERV_PROV_CODE, vd.B1_PER_ID1, vd.B1_PER_ID2, vd.B1_PER_ID3) AS VC2_CODE,
        MAX(CASE WHEN  vd.rn = 3 THEN vd.vo_cat END) OVER (PARTITION BY vd.SERV_PROV_CODE, vd.B1_PER_ID1, vd.B1_PER_ID2, vd.B1_PER_ID3) AS VC3_CODE,
        MAX(CASE WHEN  vd.rn = 4 THEN vd.vo_cat END) OVER (PARTITION BY vd.SERV_PROV_CODE, vd.B1_PER_ID1, vd.B1_PER_ID2, vd.B1_PER_ID3) AS VC4_CODE


    FROM
        vio_data vd


),

SUM_VC AS (
    SELECT
        vc.SERV_PROV_CODE,
        vc.B1_PER_ID1,
        vc.B1_PER_ID2,
        vc.B1_PER_ID3,
        vc.VC1_CODE,
        STDCHC1.VALUE_DESC AS VC1_DESC,
        vc.VC2_CODE,
        STDCHC2.VALUE_DESC AS VC2_DESC,
        vc.VC3_CODE,
        STDCHC3.VALUE_DESC AS VC3_DESC,
        vc.VC4_CODE,
        STDCHC4.VALUE_DESC AS VC4_DESC
    FROM
        VC_CODES vc

    LEFT JOIN RBIZDOMAIN_VALUE STDCHC1
        ON STDCHC1.BIZDOMAIN = 'VIOLATION_CODE_DESC_MAPPING'
        AND STDCHC1.BIZDOMAIN_VALUE = vc.VC1_CODE
    LEFT JOIN RBIZDOMAIN_VALUE STDCHC2
        ON STDCHC2.BIZDOMAIN = 'VIOLATION_CODE_DESC_MAPPING'
        AND STDCHC2.BIZDOMAIN_VALUE = vc.VC2_CODE
    LEFT JOIN RBIZDOMAIN_VALUE STDCHC3
        ON STDCHC3.BIZDOMAIN = 'VIOLATION_CODE_DESC_MAPPING'
        AND STDCHC3.BIZDOMAIN_VALUE = vc.VC3_CODE
    LEFT JOIN RBIZDOMAIN_VALUE STDCHC4
        ON STDCHC4.BIZDOMAIN = 'VIOLATION_CODE_DESC_MAPPING'
        AND STDCHC4.BIZDOMAIN_VALUE = vc.VC4_CODE
),

INFRACTION AS (
SELECT --DISTINCT
    sv.SERV_PROV_CODE, 
    sv.B1_PER_ID1,
    sv.B1_PER_ID2,
    sv.B1_PER_ID3,
    sv.VC1_code C1_VC,
	sv.VC1_DESC C1_VC_DESC,
    sv.VC2_code C2_VC,
	sv.VC2_DESC C2_VC_DESC,
    sv.VC3_code C3_VC,
	sv.VC3_DESC C3_VC_DESC,
    sv.VC4_code C4_VC,
	sv.VC4_DESC C4_VC_DESC
  FROM SUM_VC sv

),
--) SELECT * FROM INFRACTION
APO AS (
select SERV_PROV_CODE,
		B1_PER_ID1,
		B1_PER_ID2,
		B1_PER_ID3,
		[BIN] as BIN,
		[BLOCK] as BLOCK,
		[LOT] as LOT,
		[ADMIN COMPANY] as ADMIN_CO
 from 
(
SELECT
    apo.serv_prov_code AS SERV_PROV_CODE,
    apo.b1_per_id1 AS B1_PER_ID1,
	apo.b1_per_id2 AS B1_PER_ID2,
    apo.b1_per_id3 AS B1_PER_ID3,
    apo.b1_attribute_name,
    apo.b1_attribute_value
 FROM
         b3apo_attribute apo
   JOIN #TMP_RECORDLIST iv ON iv.serv_prov_code = APO.serv_prov_code
                                  AND iv.b1_per_id1 = APO.b1_per_id1
                                  AND iv.b1_per_id2 = APO.b1_per_id2
                                  AND iv.b1_per_id3 = APO.b1_per_id3

WHERE
    apo.b1_attribute_name IN ( 'BIN', 'BLOCK','LOT', 'ADMIN COMPANY' )
    AND apo.b1_apo_type IN ('ADDRESS')
    ) pva
PIVOT ( MAX(b1_attribute_value) for b1_attribute_name
            IN([BIN],
			[BLOCK],
			[LOT],
			[ADMIN COMPANY])) pvb
),
do_unit AS (
select SERV_PROV_CODE,
       B1_PER_ID1,
	   B1_PER_ID2,
	   B1_PER_ID3,
	   [D.O.] as ACTDO
 from 
(
SELECT
    bc.serv_prov_code AS SERV_PROV_CODE,
    bc.b1_per_id1 AS B1_PER_ID1,
    bc.b1_per_id2 AS B1_PER_ID2,
    bc.b1_per_id3 AS B1_PER_ID3,
    
    bc.b1_checkbox_desc,
    bc.b1_checklist_comment
 FROM
         bchckbox bc
WHERE
    bc.b1_checkbox_desc IN ('D.O.' )
    AND bc.b1_checkbox_type IN ('PERMIT REPORT INFO')
    ) pvia
PIVOT ( MAX(b1_checklist_comment) for b1_checkbox_desc
            IN([D.O.])) pvib
),
CONTACT AS (
    SELECT
        serv_prov_code,
        b1_per_id1,
        b1_per_id2,
        b1_per_id3,
        contact_name,
        rec_date,
        b1_contact_type,
        agency_code
    FROM
        (
            SELECT
            b.serv_prov_code,
            b.b1_per_id1,
            b.b1_per_id2,
            b.b1_per_id3,
               COALESCE(b.b1_full_name,b.b1_business_name,CONCAT(b1_fname,' ',b1_lname)) as contact_name,
                b.rec_date,
                b.b1_contact_type,
                substring(gt.field_value,1,3) as agency_code,
                ROW_NUMBER()
                OVER(PARTITION BY b.serv_prov_code, b.b1_per_id1, b.b1_per_id2, b.b1_per_id3
                     ORDER BY
                         b.rec_date DESC 
                ) rn
            FROM
                b3contact b
                INNER JOIN gtmpl_attribute gt ON b.b1_contact_nbr = gt.entity_seq1

            WHERE 1=1
               and  b.b1_contact_type IN ('Respondent') 
               AND gt.field_name = 'Agency Code'
--                and b.b1_contact_type_flag = 'City Agency'

        ) tr
    WHERE
        rn = 1
), 
ACCT_DATA AS
(
SELECT
    bp.serv_prov_code,
    bp.b1_per_id1,
    bp.b1_per_id2,
    bp.b1_per_id3, 
	xr.b1_master_id1,
	xr.b1_master_id2,
	xr.b1_master_id3,
	bpl.b1_alt_id AS ACCTNUM,
	du.actdo,
    bpl.b1_per_type AS ACCTPERTYPE,              
    bpl.b1_per_sub_type AS ACCTSUBTYPE,          
    bpl.b1_appl_status AS ACCTAPPSTATUS,          
    bpl.b1_appl_status_date AS ACCTAPPSTATUSDATE,  
--	bpl.REC_STATUS,
--	bp.REC_STATUS BP_REC_STATUS,
    xr.b1_relationship,
    bp.b1_alt_id                 AS ENFNUM,
    bp.b1_per_type               AS ENFPERTYPE,
    bp.b1_per_sub_type           AS ENFPERSUBTYPE,
    bp.b1_appl_status            AS ENFAPPSTATUS,
    bp.b1_appl_status_date       AS ENFAPPSTATUSDATE
FROM
         xapp2ref xr
   JOIN #TMP_RECORDLIST iv ON iv.serv_prov_code = XR.serv_prov_code
                                  AND iv.b1_per_id1 = XR.b1_per_id1
                                  AND iv.b1_per_id2 = XR.b1_per_id2
                                  AND iv.b1_per_id3 = XR.b1_per_id3

    INNER JOIN b1permit  bp ON bp.serv_prov_code = xr.serv_prov_code
                                  AND bp.b1_per_id1 = xr.b1_per_id1
                                  AND bp.b1_per_id2 = xr.b1_per_id2
                                  AND bp.b1_per_id3 = xr.b1_per_id3
    INNER JOIN b1permit  bpl ON bpl.serv_prov_code = xr.serv_prov_code
                                            AND bpl.b1_per_id1 = xr.b1_master_id1
                                            AND bpl.b1_per_id2 = xr.b1_master_id2
                                            AND bpl.b1_per_id3 = xr.b1_master_id3   
LEFT JOIN do_unit DU  ON  du.SERV_PROV_CODE = bpl.serv_prov_code
								AND du.B1_PER_ID1 = bpl.b1_per_id1
								AND du.B1_PER_ID2 = bpl.b1_per_id2
								AND du.B1_PER_ID3 = bpl.b1_per_id3

WHERE
        bpl.b1_per_type = 'Common'
        and bpl.b1_per_sub_type = 'Inspection'
		AND bpl.b1_appl_status <> 'Inactive'
),

--) SELECT * FROM ACCT_DATA WHERE ENFNUM  = '014041698H'
BOROUGH_ZIP_CODE AS (
select 
	VALUE_DESC, 
	BIZDOMAIN_VALUE as borough_zip,
	( CASE
      WHEN TRIM (UPPER (VALUE_DESC)) IN ('MANHATTAN')    THEN   '1'
                WHEN TRIM (UPPER (VALUE_DESC)) = 'BRONX' THEN '2'
                WHEN TRIM (UPPER (VALUE_DESC)) = 'BROOKLYN' THEN '3'
                WHEN TRIM (UPPER (VALUE_DESC)) = 'QUEENS' THEN '4'
                WHEN TRIM (UPPER (VALUE_DESC)) = 'STATEN ISLAND' THEN '5'  
                ELSE  ' '
             END) borough_code
from  RBIZDOMAIN_VALUE 
where BIZDOMAIN= 'REF_BORO_ZIP' 
and SERV_PROV_CODE='FDNY' 
and REC_STATUS='A'
),

RESULT_DATA AS (
SELECT DISTINCT
'1' AS INPUT_TYPE,
B1P.B1_ALT_ID AS RECORD_ID,
CASE
    WHEN C.CREATEDATE IS NOT NULL THEN 
    FORMAT(TRY_CAST(C.CREATEDATE AS DATETIME), 'yyyyMMdd')
    ELSE ''
  END VIOLATION_DATE,
CASE
    WHEN C.CREATEDATE IS NOT NULL THEN 
    FORMAT(TRY_CAST(C.CREATEDATE AS DATETIME), 'HHmmss')
    ELSE ''
  END VIOLATION_TIME,
'FIR' AS ISSUING_AGENCY,
C.INSPECTOR_ID ISSUING_OFFICER_ID,
C.INSPECTOR_NAME ISSUING_OFFICER_NAME,
RIGHT('0' + du.ACTDO, 2) ISSUING_UNIT,
( CASE
      WHEN TRIM (UPPER (B1P.B1_SITUS_CITY)) IN ('NY',
                                                 'NEW YORK',
                                                 'NEW YOK',
                                                 'NEW YORKQ',
                                                 'NYC',
                                                 'MANHATTAN')    THEN   '1'
                WHEN TRIM (UPPER (B1P.B1_SITUS_CITY)) = 'BRONX' THEN '2'
                WHEN TRIM (UPPER (B1P.B1_SITUS_CITY)) = 'BROOKLYN' THEN '3'
                WHEN TRIM (UPPER (B1P.B1_SITUS_CITY)) = 'QUEENS' THEN '4'
                WHEN TRIM (UPPER (B1P.B1_SITUS_CITY)) = 'STATEN ISLAND' THEN '5'  
                ELSE  ' '
             END) ISSUING_BORO,
--B1P.B1_SITUS_CITY   ISSUING_BOROUGH,
SUBSTRING(B1P.EXT_ADDRESS_UID,CHARINDEX( '^aId=',B1P.EXT_ADDRESS_UID)+5,12) PREM_ADDRESS_ID,
SUBSTRING(B1P.EXT_ADDRESS_UID,CHARINDEX( '$LId=',B1P.EXT_ADDRESS_UID)+5,12) LOCATION_ID,
B1P.EXT_ADDRESS_UID,
B1P.B1_HSE_NBR_ALPHA_START PREM_HOUSE_NUMBER, 
B1P.B1_STR_NAME  PREM_STREET_NAME,
B1P.B1_SITUS_CITY  PREM_CITY,
B1P.B1_SITUS_STATE  PREM_STATE,
SUBSTRING(B1P.B1_SITUS_ZIP,1,5) PREM_ZIP_5,
SUBSTRING(B1P.B1_SITUS_ZIP,6,4) PREM_ZIP_4,
AO.BLOCK PREM_BLOCK,
AO.LOT PREM_LOT,
AO.BIN BIN,
UPPER(COALESCE(B1P.B1_BUSINESS_NAME,CONCAT(B1P.B1_FNAME,' ',B1P.B1_LNAME))) as RESP_LAST_NAME,
  COALESCE(
    UPPER(B1P.B1_BUSINESS_NAME),
    UPPER(B1P.B1_FNAME),
    ''
  ) AS RESP_FIRST_NAME,
( CASE
      WHEN TRIM (UPPER (B1P.G7_CITY)) IN ('NY',
                                                 'NEW YORK',
                                                 'NEW YOK',
                                                 'NEW YORKQ',
                                                 'NYC',
                                                 'MANHATTAN')    THEN   '1'
                WHEN TRIM (UPPER (B1P.G7_CITY)) = 'BRONX' THEN '2'
                WHEN TRIM (UPPER (B1P.G7_CITY)) = 'BROOKLYN' THEN '3'
                WHEN TRIM (UPPER (B1P.G7_CITY)) = 'QUEENS' THEN '4'
                WHEN TRIM (UPPER (B1P.G7_CITY)) = 'STATEN ISLAND' THEN '5'  
                ELSE  '0'
             END) RESPONDENT_BORO,
UPPER(B1P.G7_HSE_NBR_ALPHA_START) RESPONDENT_HOUSE,
UPPER( B1P.G7_STR_NAME) RESPONDENT_STREET,
UPPER(B1P.G7_CITY) AS RESPONDENT_CITY,

( CASE
    WHEN TRIM (UPPER (B1P.G7_STATE)) IN ('NEW YORK',
                                         'MANHATTAN',
                                         'BROOKLYN',
                                         'N.Y.',
                                         'NY',
                                         'NYC',
                                         'N.Y')    THEN   'NY'
    WHEN TRIM (UPPER (B1P.G7_STATE)) = 'ALABAMA' THEN 'AL'
    WHEN TRIM (UPPER (B1P.G7_STATE)) = 'ALASKA' THEN 'AK'
    WHEN TRIM (UPPER (B1P.G7_STATE)) = 'ARIZONA' THEN 'AZ'
    WHEN TRIM (UPPER (B1P.G7_STATE)) = 'ARKANSAS' THEN 'AR'
    WHEN TRIM (UPPER (B1P.G7_STATE)) = 'CALIFORNIA' THEN 'CA'
    WHEN TRIM (UPPER (B1P.G7_STATE)) = 'COLORADO' THEN 'CO'
    WHEN TRIM (UPPER (B1P.G7_STATE)) = 'CONNECTICUT' THEN 'CT'
    WHEN TRIM (UPPER (B1P.G7_STATE)) = 'DELAWARE' THEN 'DE'
    WHEN TRIM (UPPER (B1P.G7_STATE)) = 'FLORIDA' THEN 'FL'

    WHEN TRIM (UPPER (B1P.G7_STATE)) = 'ILLINOIS' THEN 'IL'
    WHEN TRIM (UPPER (B1P.G7_STATE)) = 'INDIANA' THEN 'IN'
    WHEN TRIM (UPPER (B1P.G7_STATE)) = 'IOWA' THEN 'IA'
    WHEN TRIM (UPPER (B1P.G7_STATE)) = 'KANSAS' THEN 'KS'

    WHEN TRIM (UPPER (B1P.G7_STATE)) = 'MAINE' THEN 'ME'
    WHEN TRIM (UPPER (B1P.G7_STATE)) = 'MARYLAND' THEN 'MD'
    WHEN TRIM (UPPER (B1P.G7_STATE)) = 'MASSACHUSETTS' THEN 'MA'
    WHEN TRIM (UPPER (B1P.G7_STATE)) = 'MICHIGAN' THEN 'MI'
    WHEN TRIM (UPPER (B1P.G7_STATE)) = 'MINNESOTA' THEN 'MN'
    WHEN TRIM (UPPER (B1P.G7_STATE)) = 'MISSISSIPPI' THEN 'MS'
    WHEN TRIM (UPPER (B1P.G7_STATE)) = 'MISSOURI' THEN 'MO'
    WHEN TRIM (UPPER (B1P.G7_STATE)) = 'MONTANA' THEN 'MT'
    WHEN TRIM (UPPER (B1P.G7_STATE)) = 'NEBRASKA' THEN 'NE'
    WHEN TRIM (UPPER (B1P.G7_STATE)) = 'NEVADA' THEN 'NV'
    WHEN TRIM (UPPER (B1P.G7_STATE)) = 'NEW HAMPSHIRE' THEN 'NH'
    WHEN TRIM (UPPER (B1P.G7_STATE)) = 'NEW JERSEY' THEN 'NJ'
    WHEN TRIM (UPPER (B1P.G7_STATE)) = 'NEW MEXICO' THEN 'NM'
    WHEN TRIM (UPPER (B1P.G7_STATE)) = 'NORTH CAROLINA' THEN 'NC'
    WHEN TRIM (UPPER (B1P.G7_STATE)) = 'NORTH DAKOTA' THEN 'ND'
    WHEN TRIM (UPPER (B1P.G7_STATE)) = 'OHIO' THEN 'OH'
    WHEN TRIM (UPPER (B1P.G7_STATE)) = 'OKLAHOMA' THEN 'OK'
    WHEN TRIM (UPPER (B1P.G7_STATE)) = 'OREGON' THEN 'OR'
    WHEN TRIM (UPPER (B1P.G7_STATE)) = 'PENNSYLVANIA' THEN 'PA'
    WHEN TRIM (UPPER (B1P.G7_STATE)) = 'RHODE ISLAND' THEN 'RI'
    WHEN TRIM (UPPER (B1P.G7_STATE)) = 'SOUTH CAROLINA' THEN 'SC'
    WHEN TRIM (UPPER (B1P.G7_STATE)) = 'SOUTH DAKOTA' THEN 'SD'
    WHEN TRIM (UPPER (B1P.G7_STATE)) = 'TENNESSEE' THEN 'TN'
    WHEN TRIM (UPPER (B1P.G7_STATE)) = 'TEXAS' THEN 'TX'
    WHEN TRIM (UPPER (B1P.G7_STATE)) = 'UTAH' THEN 'UT'
    WHEN TRIM (UPPER (B1P.G7_STATE)) = 'VERMONT' THEN 'VT'
    WHEN TRIM (UPPER (B1P.G7_STATE)) = 'VIRGINIA' THEN 'VA'
    WHEN TRIM (UPPER (B1P.G7_STATE)) = 'WASHINGTON' THEN 'WA'
    WHEN TRIM (UPPER (B1P.G7_STATE)) = 'WEST VIRGINIA' THEN 'WV'
    WHEN TRIM (UPPER (B1P.G7_STATE)) = 'WISCONSIN' THEN 'WI'
    WHEN TRIM (UPPER (B1P.G7_STATE)) = 'WYOMING' THEN 'WY'
    ELSE  '  '

SUBSTRING(B1P.G7_ZIP,1,5) RESPONDENT_ZIP_5,

CONVERT(varchar, TRY_CAST(C.HEARING_DATE AS DATETIME), 112) HEARING_DATE,
CASE
    WHEN C.HEARING_TIME IS NOT NULL THEN 
	REPLACE(CONVERT(VARCHAR(8), TRY_CAST(C.HEARING_TIME AS DATETIME), 108), ':', '') 
    ELSE ''
  END HEARING_TIME,
  CONVERT(varchar, TRY_CAST(C.COMPLIANCE_DATE AS DATETIME), 112) COMPLIANCE_DATE,
( CASE
      WHEN TRIM (UPPER (B1P.B1_SITUS_CITY)) IN ('NY',
                                                 'NEW YORK',

                                                 'NEW YORKQ',
                                                 'NYC',
                                                 'MANHATTAN')    THEN   '9'

             END) HEARING_LOCATION,

    )
  ) AS HEARING_CENTERS,
( CASE  WHEN TRY_CONVERT(INT,SUBSTRING(F.C1_VC,3,2)) IS NULL   THEN   ' ' ELSE concat('BF',RIGHT( '0' + CONVERT(VARCHAR,TRY_CONVERT(INT,SUBSTRING(F.C1_VC,3,2)) ),2) ) END) VC01,
( CASE  WHEN TRY_CONVERT(INT,SUBSTRING(F.C1_VC,3,2)) IS NULL   THEN   ' ' 
        WHEN C.MOS = 'Yes' THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N'  END) MOST01,

    WHEN B1P.B1_PHONE2 IS NOT NULL
    AND LEN(B1P.B1_PHONE2) > 1 THEN  SUBSTRING(B1P.B1_PHONE2, 1, 3) +  SUBSTRING(B1P.B1_PHONE2, 4, 3) +  SUBSTRING(B1P.B1_PHONE2, 7, 4)
    WHEN B1P.B1_PHONE3 IS NOT NULL
    AND LEN(B1P.B1_PHONE3) > 1 THEN  SUBSTRING(B1P.B1_PHONE3, 1, 3) + SUBSTRING(B1P.B1_PHONE3, 4, 3) +  SUBSTRING(B1P.B1_PHONE3, 7, 4)
    ELSE ''

LEFT JOIN APO AO  ON  B1P.SERV_PROV_CODE = AO.SERV_PROV_CODE
								AND B1P.B1_PER_ID1 = AO.B1_PER_ID1
								AND B1P.B1_PER_ID2 = AO.B1_PER_ID2
								AND B1P.B1_PER_ID3 = AO.B1_PER_ID3

								AND ad.b1_master_id2 = du.B1_PER_ID2
								AND ad.b1_master_id3 = du.B1_PER_ID3
LEFT JOIN CONTACT cn  ON  cn.SERV_PROV_CODE = B1P.serv_prov_code
								AND cn.B1_PER_ID1 = B1P.b1_per_id1
								AND cn.B1_PER_ID2 = B1P.b1_per_id2
								AND cn.B1_PER_ID3 = B1P.b1_per_id3

LEFT JOIN #TMP_CUST_FIELDS C  ON  C.SERV_PROV_CODE = B1P.SERV_PROV_CODE
								AND C.B1_PER_ID1 = B1P.B1_PER_ID1
								AND C.B1_PER_ID2 = B1P.B1_PER_ID2
								AND C.B1_PER_ID3 = B1P.B1_PER_ID3
LEFT JOIN RBIZDOMAIN_VALUE STDCHC1  ON STDCHC1.BIZDOMAIN = 'ENF_OATH_OFFICES_ADDRESS'

LEFT JOIN RBIZDOMAIN_VALUE STDCHC3  ON STDCHC3.BIZDOMAIN = 'BFP_FSUM_HEARING_CENTERS'
								AND lower(STDCHC3.BIZDOMAIN_VALUE) = lower(B1P.B1_SITUS_CITY)
LEFT JOIN PUSER PU ON PU.EMPLOYEE_ID = C.INSPECTOR_ID
LEFT JOIN G3STAFFS S ON PU.USER_NAME = S.GA_USER_ID
LEFT JOIN G3DPTTYP D ON D.SERV_PROV_CODE = S.SERV_PROV_CODE
							AND S.GA_AGENCY_CODE = D.R3_AGENCY_CODE
							AND S.GA_BUREAU_CODE = D.R3_BUREAU_CODE
							AND S.GA_DIVISION_CODE = D.R3_DIVISION_CODE
							AND S.GA_SECTION_CODE = D.R3_SECTION_CODE
							AND S.GA_GROUP_CODE = D.R3_GROUP_CODE
							AND S.GA_OFFICE_CODE = D.R3_OFFICE_CODE

  LEFT OUTER JOIN borough_zip_code bz on ISNULL(CAST(bz.borough_zip AS NVARCHAR(5)), '00000') = SUBSTRING(B1P.B1_SITUS_ZIP,1,5)

LEFT JOIN INFRACTION F ON B1P.SERV_PROV_CODE = F.SERV_PROV_CODE
							AND B1P.B1_PER_ID1 = F.B1_PER_ID1
							AND B1P.B1_PER_ID2 = F.B1_PER_ID2
							AND B1P.B1_PER_ID3 = F.B1_PER_ID3
WHERE 1 = 1
							AND B1P.SERV_PROV_CODE = 'FDNY'
							AND B1P.REC_STATUS      = 'A'
							AND C.CREATEDATE IS NOT NULL
							AND C.HEARING_DATE IS NOT NULL
							AND C.HEARING_TIME IS NOT NULL
							AND C.DCP_ST_NAME is not null
							AND B1P.G7_STR_NAME IS NOT NULL
--	AND B1_ALT_ID IN   ('014144540J')
),
RESULTS AS (

   Coalesce(od.prem_state,' ') prem_state,

   REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(Coalesce(od.resp_last_name,' '), CHAR(13)+CHAR(10), ' '), CHAR(10), ' '), CHAR(13), ' ') resp_last_name, 
   Coalesce(od.respondent_boro,' ') respondent_boro, 
   REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(Coalesce(od.respondent_house,' '), CHAR(13)+CHAR(10), ' '), CHAR(10), ' '), CHAR(13), ' ') respondent_house,
   REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(Coalesce(od.respondent_street,' '), CHAR(13)+CHAR(10), ' '), CHAR(10), ' '), CHAR(13), ' ') respondent_street, 
   REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(Coalesce(od.respondent_city,' '), CHAR(13)+CHAR(10), ' '), CHAR(10), ' '), CHAR(13), ' ') respondent_city, 
   REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(Coalesce(od.respondent_state,' '), CHAR(13)+CHAR(10), ' '), CHAR(10), ' '), CHAR(13), ' ') respondent_state, 

   Coalesce(od.respondent_zip_4,' ') respondent_zip_4,

--
   select * INTO #TMP_RESULTS FROM RESULTS;
--   SELECT * FROM #TMP_RESULTS;
SELECT
    CONCAT(
    -- DEEP-INP-TYPE (length 1)
    LEFT(CONCAT(ISNULL(tp.input_type, ''), SPACE(1)), 1),

    -- DEEP-VIO-NUMB (length 10)
    LEFT(CONCAT(ISNULL(tp.record_id, ''), SPACE(10)), 10),

    -- DEEP-VIO-DATE (length 8) - Assuming violation_date is a date/datetime and you want 'YYYYMMDD'
    LEFT(CONCAT(ISNULL(CONVERT(NVARCHAR(8), tp.violation_date, 112), ''), SPACE(8)), 8),

    -- DEEP_VIO_TIME (length 4)
    LEFT(CONCAT(ISNULL(SUBSTRING(tp.violation_time, 1, 4), ''), SPACE(4)), 4),

    -- DEEP_ISS_AGCY (length 3)
    LEFT(CONCAT('FIR', SPACE(3)), 3),

    -- DEEP_OFC_OIDN (length 10)
    LEFT(CONCAT(ISNULL(tp.issuing_officer_id, ''), SPACE(10)), 10),

    -- DEEP_OFC_NAME (length 20)
    LEFT(CONCAT(ISNULL(tp.issuing_officer_name, ''), SPACE(20)), 20),

    -- DEEP_OFC_UNIT (length 2)
    LEFT(CONCAT(ISNULL(tp.issuing_unit, ''), SPACE(2)), 2),

    -- DEEP_ISS_BORO (length 1) - Assuming dcp_boro_id is numeric, cast to string first.
    LEFT(CONCAT(ISNULL(CAST(substring(tp.bin,1,1) AS NVARCHAR(1)), ''), SPACE(1)), 1),

    -- DEEP_ISS_PREF (length 1)
    LEFT(CONCAT(' ', SPACE(1)), 1),

    -- DEEP_ISS_HOUSE (length 12)
    LEFT(CONCAT(ISNULL(tp.prem_house_number, ''), SPACE(12)), 12),

    -- DEEP_ISS_STRE (complex, needs careful handling - nested CONCAT or direct LEFT/SPACE)
    CONCAT(
        LEFT(CONCAT(ISNULL(tp.DCP_ST_PFX, ''), SPACE(2)), 2),
        ' ',
        LEFT(CONCAT(ISNULL(tp.DCP_ST_NAME, ''), SPACE(20)), 20),
        ' ',
        LEFT(CONCAT(ISNULL(tp.DCP_ST_TYPE, ''), SPACE(4)), 4),
        ' ',
        LEFT(CONCAT(ISNULL(tp.DCP_ST_SFX, ''), SPACE(2)), 2)
    ), ' ', -- The final ' ' for this block

---test
--LEFT(CONCAT(' ', SPACE(32)), 32),


    -- DEEP_ISS_2LIN (length 32)
    LEFT(CONCAT(' ', SPACE(32)), 32),

    -- DEEP_ISS_SUDT (length 12)
    LEFT(CONCAT(' ', SPACE(12)), 12),

    -- DEEP_ISS_SUDV (length 12)
    LEFT(CONCAT(' ', SPACE(12)), 12),

    -- DEEP_OFC_UNIT (length 15) - This comment seems misplaced, likely DEEP_PREM_CITY
    LEFT(CONCAT(ISNULL(tp.prem_city, ''), SPACE(15)), 15),

    -- DEEP_ISS_STAT (length 2)
    LEFT(CONCAT('NY', SPACE(2)), 2),

    -- DEEP_ISS_ZIP5 (length 5)
    LEFT(CONCAT(ISNULL(tp.prem_zip_5, ''), SPACE(5)), 5),

    -- DEEP_ISS_ZIP4 (length 4)
    LEFT(CONCAT(ISNULL(tp.prem_zip_4, ''), SPACE(4)), 4),

    -- DEEP_ISS_BLOC (length 5)

WITH AIMVADD AS
(
SELECT
	B1_CONTACT_NBR, 
	G7_HSE_NBR_ALPHA_START,
	G7_STR_NAME,
	G7_CITY,
	G7_STATE,
	G7_ZIP,
	G7_ADDRESS_TYPE,
	rec_date,
	RN
FROM
(
SELECT 
	XREC.B1_CONTACT_NBR, 
	G7A.G7_HSE_NBR_ALPHA_START,
	G7A.G7_STR_NAME,
	G7A.G7_CITY,
	G7A.G7_STATE,
	G7A.G7_ZIP,
	G7A.G7_ADDRESS_TYPE,
	G7A.rec_date,
	ROW_NUMBER()
       OVER(PARTITION BY XREC.B1_CONTACT_NBR
            ORDER BY   G7A.rec_date DESC ) rn
  FROM G7CONTACT_ADDRESS G7A
       LEFT JOIN XRECORD_CONTACT_ENTITY XREC
          ON     G7A.G7_ENTITY_TYPE = XREC.ENT_TYPE
             AND G7A.RES_ID = XREC.ENT_ID1
             AND G7A.SERV_PROV_CODE = XREC.SERV_PROV_CODE
             AND XREC.REC_STATUS = 'A'
	WHERE
		G7A.G7_ADDRESS_TYPE = 'Mailing Address' 
	AND XREC.B1_CONTACT_NBR IS NOT NULL
) TR
   WHERE RN = 1
),
OATH_ENTRY AS
(
SELECT SERV_PROV_CODE,
       B1_PER_ID1,
       B1_PER_ID2,
       B1_PER_ID3,
	   [Entered in OAth] AS ENTERED_IN_OATH,
       [OATH HEARING DATE] AS OATH_HRG_DATE

  FROM 
    (SELECT C.SERV_PROV_CODE,
               C.B1_PER_ID1,
               C.B1_PER_ID2,
               C.B1_PER_ID3,
               C.B1_CHECKLIST_COMMENT,
               C.B1_CHECKBOX_DESC
          FROM BCHCKBOX C
		  ) PV1 PIVOT (MIN (B1_CHECKLIST_COMMENT)
                           FOR B1_CHECKBOX_DESC
                           IN  ([Entered in OAth],
                               [OATH HEARING DATE]
)) PV2
),

		B1_PER_ID1,

		rn
FROM
	(SELECT gp.SERV_PROV_CODE,
		gp.B1_PER_ID1,
		gp.B1_PER_ID2,
	    gp.B1_PER_ID3,
		gp.sd_pro_des,
		gp.sd_app_des,
		gp.sd_app_dd,
		ROW_NUMBER()
			OVER(PARTITION BY gp.SERV_PROV_CODE, gp.B1_PER_ID1, gp.B1_PER_ID2, gp.B1_PER_ID3   ORDER BY   gp.sd_app_dd DESC ) rn
	   FROM  gprocess_history gp

) TR
	WHERE RN = 1

),
SUMMONS_SET AS (
SELECT 
    sd.serv_prov_code,
    sd.b1_per_id1,
    sd.b1_per_id2,
    sd.b1_per_id3,
    sh.set_id,

	b.b1_alt_id record_id,
    sd.set_seq_nbr,

    sd.audit_mod_date

FROM B1PERMIT B
    INNER JOIN SETDETAILS SD
    ON SD.SERV_PROV_CODE= B.SERV_PROV_CODE
    AND SD.B1_PER_ID1 = B.B1_PER_ID1
    AND SD.B1_PER_ID2 = B.B1_PER_ID2
    AND SD.B1_PER_ID3 = B.B1_PER_ID3  

    INNER JOIN SETHEADER SH
    ON SH.SERV_PROV_CODE = SD.SERV_PROV_CODE
    AND SH.SET_ID = SD.SET_ID

WHERE 1=1
    AND sd.set_id LIKE 'FDNY_SUMMONS_ECB%'

),
