DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #TMP_Returned_Values;
DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #TMP_AIMVADD;
DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #TMP_CUST_FIELDS;
WITH Returned_Values AS(
SELECT
    B1P.SERV_PROV_CODE,
    B1P.B1_PER_ID1,
    B1P.B1_PER_ID2,
    B1P.B1_PER_ID3,
    B1P.B1_ALT_ID AS FDNYSMNS
  FROM
    B1PERMIT B1P
  WHERE 1=1
--    AND B1P.B1_ALT_ID = @RECORD_ID
    AND B1P.SERV_PROV_CODE = 'FDNY'
    AND B1P.REC_STATUS = 'A'
    AND B1P.B1_PER_GROUP = 'BFP'
    AND B1P.B1_PER_TYPE = 'Enforcement'
    AND B1P.B1_PER_SUB_TYPE = 'FDNY Summons'
    AND B1P.B1_PER_CATEGORY = 'NA'
)
select  * INTO #TMP_Returned_Values from Returned_Values;
  --select * from Returned_Values
  WITH AIMVADD AS (
    SELECT
      XREC.B1_PER_ID1,
      XREC.B1_PER_ID2,
      XREC.B1_PER_ID3,
      XREC.B1_CONTACT_NBR,
      G7A.*
    FROM
      G7CONTACT_ADDRESS G7A
      LEFT JOIN XRECORD_CONTACT_ENTITY XREC ON G7A.G7_ENTITY_TYPE = XREC.ENT_TYPE
      AND G7A.RES_ID = XREC.ENT_ID1
      AND G7A.SERV_PROV_CODE = XREC.SERV_PROV_CODE
      AND XREC.REC_STATUS = 'A'
      JOIN #TMP_Returned_Values rv ON XREC.SERV_PROV_CODE = rv.SERV_PROV_CODE
      AND XREC.B1_PER_ID1 = rv.B1_PER_ID1
      AND XREC.B1_PER_ID2 = rv.B1_PER_ID2
      AND XREC.B1_PER_ID3 = rv.B1_PER_ID3
    WHERE
      XREC.SERV_PROV_CODE = 'FDNY'
  )
select
  * INTO #TMP_AIMVADD from AIMVADD;
  --select * from AIMVADD
  WITH CUST_FIELDS AS (
    SELECT
      SERV_PROV_CODE,
      B1_PER_ID1,
      B1_PER_ID2,
      B1_PER_ID3,
      [Division FP Unit] UNIT,
      DBA,
      [Creation Date/Time] CREATEDATE,
      [OATH HEARING DATE] HEARING_DATE,
      [OATH HEARING TIME] HEARING_TIME,
      [COMPLIANCE DATE] COMPLIANCE_DATE,
      [INSPECTOR NAME] INSPECTOR_NAME,
      [Description of Violation] VIOLATION_DESC,
      [INSPECTOR ID] INSPECTOR_ID,
      [INSPECTION ID],
      [Division FP Unit] INSPECTOR_DEPARTMENT
    FROM
      (
        SELECT
          C.SERV_PROV_CODE,
          C.B1_PER_ID1,
          C.B1_PER_ID2,
          C.B1_PER_ID3,
          UPPER(C.B1_CHECKLIST_COMMENT) B1_CHECKLIST_COMMENT,
          C.B1_CHECKBOX_DESC
        FROM
          BCHCKBOX C
          INNER JOIN B1PERMIT ON B1PERMIT.SERV_PROV_CODE = C.SERV_PROV_CODE
          AND B1PERMIT.B1_PER_ID1 = C.B1_PER_ID1
          AND B1PERMIT.B1_PER_ID2 = C.B1_PER_ID2
          AND B1PERMIT.B1_PER_ID3 = C.B1_PER_ID3
          JOIN #TMP_Returned_Values rv ON C.SERV_PROV_CODE = rv.SERV_PROV_CODE
          AND C.B1_PER_ID1 = rv.B1_PER_ID1
          AND C.B1_PER_ID2 = rv.B1_PER_ID2
          AND C.B1_PER_ID3 = rv.B1_PER_ID3
        WHERE 1=1
--          B1PERMIT.B1_ALT_ID = @RECORD_ID
      ) B PIVOT(
        MIN(B1_CHECKLIST_COMMENT) FOR B1_CHECKBOX_DESC IN(
          [Division FP Unit],
          [DBA],
          [Creation Date/Time],
          [OATH HEARING DATE],
          [OATH HEARING TIME],
          [COMPLIANCE DATE],
          [INSPECTOR NAME],
          [INSPECTOR ID],
          [INSPECTION ID],
          --[Division FP Unit],
          [Description of Violation]
        )
      ) C
  )
select
  * INTO #TMP_CUST_FIELDS from CUST_FIELDS;
--select * from #TMP_CUST_FIELDS
SELECT TOP 1000
   B1P.B1_ALT_ID,
  [INSPECTION ID],
  UPPER(C.UNIT) AS UNIT,
  UPPER(
    dbo.FN_GET_STDCHOICE_VALUEDESC(B1P.SERV_PROV_CODE, 'BFP_UNIT_PHONE', C.UNIT)
  ) AS UNIT_PHONE,
  UPPER(
    dbo.FN_GET_STDCHOICE_VALUEDESC(
      B1P.SERV_PROV_CODE,
      'BFP_FSUM_HEARING_CENTERS',
      B3ADDR.B1_SITUS_CITY
    )
  ) AS BOROUGH_ADDR,
  B2.B1_ALT_ID ACCOUNT_NBR,
  C.DBA,
  C.CREATEDATE,
  B1P.B1_FILE_DD,
  FORMAT(CONVERT(DATE, C.CREATEDATE), 'MM/dd/yyyy') AS CREATE_DATE,
  CASE
    WHEN C.CREATEDATE IS NOT NULL THEN FORMAT(TRY_CAST(C.CREATEDATE AS DATETIME), 'hh:mm tt')
    ELSE ''
  END CREATE_TIME,
  C.HEARING_DATE,
  TRIM(C.VIOLATION_DESC) VIOLATION_DESC,
  FORMAT(CONVERT(DATETIME, C.HEARING_TIME), 'hh:mm tt') HEARING_TIME,
  C.COMPLIANCE_DATE,
  C.INSPECTOR_NAME,
  C.INSPECTOR_ID,
  C.INSPECTOR_DEPARTMENT,
  ASIT.ATTRIBUTE_VALUE AS DESC_VIO,
  COALESCE(
    UPPER(B3CON.B1_BUSINESS_NAME),
    UPPER(Concat(B3CON.B1_FNAME, ' ', B3CON.B1_LNAME)),
    ''
  ) AS RESP_NAME,
  REPLACE(
    UPPER(
      Concat(A1.G7_HSE_NBR_ALPHA_START, ' ', A1.G7_STR_NAME)
    ),
    CHAR(10),
    ''
  ) AS RESP_ADDR,
  UPPER(A1.G7_CITY) AS RESP_CITY,
  UPPER(A1.G7_STATE) AS RESP_STATE,
  LEFT(A1.G7_ZIP, 5) RESP_ZIP,
  TRIM(
    Concat(
      COALESCE(
        CONVERT(NVARCHAR(30), B1_HSE_NBR_ALPHA_START),
        CONVERT(NVARCHAR(30), B1_HSE_NBR_START)
      ),
      ' ',
      Upper(B1_STR_NAME)
    )
  ) PREMISES_ADDR,
  UPPER(B3ADDR.B1_SITUS_CITY) AS BOROUGH,
  UPPER(B3ADDR.B1_SITUS_ZIP) AS ZIP,
  UPPER(
    dbo.FN_GET_STDCHOICE_VALUEDESC(

  UPPER(A1.G7_STATE) AS RESP_STATE,
  LEFT(A1.G7_ZIP, 5) RESP_ZIP,
  TRIM(

        CONVERT(NVARCHAR(30), B1_HSE_NBR_ALPHA_START),
        CONVERT(NVARCHAR(30), B1_HSE_NBR_START)
      ),
      ' ',
      Upper(B1_STR_NAME)

    WHEN B3CON.B1_PHONE2 IS NOT NULL

    ELSE ''
  END RESP_CELL

  B1PERMIT B1P

  AND B1P.B1_PER_ID1 = B3ADDR.B1_PER_ID1

"323","permits_issued.sql","C:\FIRESSQLSVR\Backup\permits_issued.sql","DECLARE @ACCOUNTID varchar(100) = '06351084';
WITH permit_info AS
(
select 
    serv_prov_code,
    b1_per_id1,
    b1_per_id2,
    b1_per_id3,
    ROW_INDEX,
    [Control Number] AS CONTROL_NUMBER,
    [Inspection ID] AS INSPECTION_ID,
    [Permit Issuance Date] AS PERM_ISS_DATE,
    [Permit Expiration Date] AS PERM_EXP_DATE, 
    [Permit Start Date] AS PERM_START_DATE,
    [Permit Printed] AS PERM_PRINTED,
    [Is Temporary Permit?] AS IS_TEMP_PERMIT
     FROM (
     SELECT 
    ba.serv_prov_code,
    ba.b1_per_id1,
    ba.b1_per_id2,
    ba.b1_per_id3,
    ROW_INDEX AS ROW_INDEX,
    ba.COLUMN_NAME,
    ba.attribute_value
    FROM
         bappspectable_value ba

    WHERE
          ba.TABLE_NAME = 'PERMIT EXPIRATION'
         AND ba.COLUMN_NAME IN ('Control Number', 'Inspection ID', 'Permit Issuance Date','Permit Expiration Date','Permit Start Date','Permit Printed','Is Temporary Permit?')
    )    pva

    PIVOT (MAX (ATTRIBUTE_VALUE)
                                               FOR COLUMN_NAME
                                               IN ([Control Number],
                                                   [Inspection ID],
                                                   [Permit Issuance Date],
                                                   [Permit Expiration Date],
                                                   [Permit Start Date],
                                                   [Permit Printed],
                                                   [Is Temporary Permit?])) pvb
)
select 
	bp.b1_alt_id,
	bp.b1_per_type,
	bp.b1_per_sub_type,
	pf.ROW_INDEX,
    pf.INSPECTION_ID,
    pf.CONTROL_NUMBER,
    pf.PERM_ISS_DATE,
    pf.PERM_START_DATE,
    pf.PERM_EXP_DATE, 
    pf.PERM_PRINTED,
    pf.IS_TEMP_PERMIT
FROM

	b1permit bp

JOIN permit_info pf ON pf.SERV_PROV_CODE = bp.SERV_PROV_CODE
	AND pf.B1_PER_ID1 = bp.B1_PER_ID1
	AND pf.B1_PER_ID2 = bp.B1_PER_ID2
	AND pf.B1_PER_ID3 = bp.B1_PER_ID3  
WHERE
     bp.serv_prov_code = 'FDNY' 
	AND bp.b1_per_type = 'Common'
	AND bp.b1_per_sub_type = 'Inspection'
--	AND bp.b1_alt_id = @ACCOUNTID

ORDER BY
	bp.b1_alt_id, pf.ROW_INDEX

WITH corrected AS (
select  
    SERV_PROV_CODE,
	B1_PER_ID1,
	B1_PER_ID2,
	B1_PER_ID3,
	corrected_status
from 
(
SELECT
    bc.serv_prov_code AS SERV_PROV_CODE,
    bc.b1_per_id1 AS B1_PER_ID1,
    bc.b1_per_id2 AS B1_PER_ID2,
    bc.b1_per_id3 AS B1_PER_ID3,
    CASE
       WHEN ( bc.b1_checkbox_desc = 'OATH'
              AND bc.b1_checklist_comment = 'CHECKED' ) THEN
           'OATH CORRECTED'
       WHEN ( bc.b1_checkbox_desc = 'FDNY'
              AND bc.b1_checklist_comment = 'CHECKED' ) THEN
           'FDNY CORRECTED'
--       ELSE
--           'COMPLIANCE DUE'
   END         AS corrected_status,
   	                ROW_NUMBER()
                OVER(PARTITION BY bC.serv_prov_code, bC.b1_per_id1, bC.b1_per_id2, bC.b1_per_id3
                     ORDER BY
                         bC.rec_date DESC ) RN


 FROM
         bchckbox bc
	JOIN	#TMP_Returned_Values rv ON bc.SERV_PROV_CODE = rv.SERV_PROV_CODE
	AND bc.B1_PER_ID1 = rv.B1_PER_ID1
	AND bc.B1_PER_ID2 = rv.B1_PER_ID2
	AND bc.B1_PER_ID3 = rv.B1_PER_ID3

WHERE
    bc.b1_checkbox_desc IN ( 'OATH', 'FDNY' )
    AND bc.b1_checkbox_type IN ('COMPLIANCE INFORMATION')
	AND bc.b1_checklist_comment = 'CHECKED'
	AND bc.SERV_PROV_CODE = 'FDNY'
    ) pvia
	WHERE RN = 1

)
   select * INTO #TMP_corrected from corrected;
   SELECT * FROM #TMP_corrected

                  'OTHER - ' || Specify_Other
               ELSE
                  Title_Role
            END
               AS Title_Role,
            gp.B1_DUE_DD Due_Date

               ON     gp.B1_PER_ID1 = b.B1_PER_ID1
                  AND gp.B1_PER_ID2 = b.B1_PER_ID2

            JOIN

                    B1_PER_ID1,
                    B1_PER_ID2,
                    B1_PER_ID3,
                    Record_ID,
                    Reason,
                    Reason_for_requesting_refund,
                    First_Name,
                    Last_Name,
                    Title_Role,
                    Specify_Other
               FROM (SELECT bi.SERV_PROV_code,
                            bi.B1_PER_ID1,
                            bi.B1_PER_ID2,
                            bi.B1_PER_ID3,
                            UPPER (BAP.B1_CHECKLIST_COMMENT)
                               AS B1_CHECKLIST_COMMENT,
                            BAP.B1_CHECKBOX_DESC,
                            bi.b1_ALT_ID
                       FROM B1PERMIT bi
                            JOIN
                            (SELECT *
                               FROM BCHCKBOX
                              WHERE     REC_STATUS = 'A'
                                    AND B1_CHECKBOX_TYPE IN ('REFUND REQUEST INFORMATION',
                                                             'CERTIFICATION')
                                    AND B1_CHECKBOX_DESC IN ('Record ID',
                                                             'Reason',
                                                             'Reason for requesting refund',
                                                             'First Name',
                                                             'Last Name',
                                                             'Title Role',
                                                             'Specify Other'))
                            bap
                               ON     bap.SERV_PROV_CODE = bi.SERV_PROV_CODE
                                  AND bap.B1_PER_ID1 = bi.B1_PER_ID1
                                  AND bap.B1_PER_ID2 = bi.B1_PER_ID2
                                  AND bap.B1_PER_ID3 = bi.B1_PER_ID3
                                  AND bap.SERV_PROV_CODE = 'FDNY') PIVOT (MAX (
                                                                             B1_CHECKLIST_COMMENT)
                                                                   FOR B1_CHECKBOX_DESC
                                                                   IN  ('Record ID' AS Record_ID,
                                                                       'Reason' AS Reason,
                                                                       'Reason for requesting refund' AS Reason_for_requesting_refund,
                                                                       'First Name' AS First_Name,

                                                                       'Title Role' AS Title_Role,
                                                                       'Specify Other' AS Specify_Other)))
            bch

                  AND gp.B1_PER_ID2 = bch.B1_PER_ID2
                  AND gp.B1_PER_ID3 = bch.B1_PER_ID3

(

    bc.serv_prov_code AS SERV_PROV_CODE,
    bc.b1_per_id1 AS B1_PER_ID1,

    AND bc.b1_checkbox_type IN ('PLAN INFORMATION', 'PERMIT REPORT INFO','FEE EXEMPTION INFORMATION')
	AND bc.SERV_PROV_CODE = 'FDNY' 
    ) pvia
PIVOT ( MAX(b1_checklist_comment) for b1_checkbox_desc
            IN([D.O.],
			[Alpha Prefix],
			[Account Type],
			[No Fee],
			[No Fee Date],

),

(
SELECT
    bp.b1_alt_id,
    bp.serv_prov_code,
    bp.b1_per_id1,
    bp.b1_per_id2,
    bp.b1_per_id3,
    x4.invoice_nbr,
    f4.invoice_customized_nbr,
    x4.feeitem_seq_nbr,
    x4.gf_des as fee_item,
    x4.gf_unit as qty,

    x4.feeitem_invoice_status  as status,
    x4.gf_fee_apply_date  as date_accessed,

    f4.balance_due,
    f4.invoice_amount,
    f4.invoice_date,
    f4.rec_ful_nam
   
FROM
         b1permit bp
     LEFT OUTER JOIN x4feeitem_invoice x4 ON bp.serv_prov_code = x4.serv_prov_code
                                           AND bp.b1_per_id1 = x4.b1_per_id1
                                           AND bp.b1_per_id2 = x4.b1_per_id2                                           
                                           AND bp.b1_per_id3 = x4.b1_per_id3   
                                          
     LEFT OUTER JOIN f4invoice f4 ON x4.invoice_nbr = f4.invoice_nbr
                                        AND x4.serv_prov_code = f4.serv_prov_code     
    LEFT OUTER JOIN f4feeitem  f4f ON x4.feeitem_seq_nbr  = f4f.feeitem_seq_nbr 
                                         AND bp.serv_prov_code = f4f.serv_prov_code
                                           AND bp.b1_per_id1 = f4f.b1_per_id1
                                           AND bp.b1_per_id2 = f4f.b1_per_id2                                           
                                           AND bp.b1_per_id3 = f4f.b1_per_id3      
    
    
WHERE 1=1
--	AND bp.b1_alt_id = '00259846'
	AND bp.b1_per_type = 'Common'
    AND bp.b1_per_sub_type = 'Inspection'
    AND x4.feeitem_invoice_status = 'INVOICED'

),
invoice_data as
(
select 
	serv_prov_code,
	b1_per_id1,
	b1_per_id2,
	b1_per_id3,
    ACCTNUM,
    APPL_STATUS,
    ROW_INDEX,
	REC_STATUS,
    [Bill Number] AS BILL_NUMBER,
    [Bill Type] AS BILL_TYPE,
    [Bill Date] AS BILL_DATE,
    [Bill Amount] AS BILL_AMOUNT, 
    [Clock Date] AS CLOCK_DATE,
    [Cycle Number] AS CYCLE_NUMBER
FROM (
     SELECT 
	bp.serv_prov_code,
	bp.b1_per_id1,
	bp.b1_per_id2,
	bp.b1_per_id3,
    substring(bp.b1_alt_id,1,8) AS acctnum,
    bp.b1_per_type AS PER_TYPE,
    bp.b1_per_sub_type AS PER_SUB_TYPE,
    bp.b1_file_dd AS FILE_DD,
    bp.rec_date    AS rec_date1,
    bp.rec_ful_nam AS rec_ful_nam1,
    bp.rec_status  AS rec_status1,
    bp.b1_appl_status AS APPL_STATUS,
    bap.ROW_INDEX AS ROW_INDEX,
	bap.rec_status,
    bap.COLUMN_NAME,
    bap.attribute_value
    FROM
         b1permit bp
    INNER JOIN bappspectable_value bap ON bp.serv_prov_code = bap.serv_prov_code
                                     AND bp.b1_per_id1 = bap.b1_per_id1
                                     AND bp.b1_per_id2 = bap.b1_per_id2
                                     AND bp.b1_per_id3 = bap.b1_per_id3
    WHERE
          bap.TABLE_NAME = 'BILLING INFORMATION'
         AND bap.COLUMN_NAME IN ('Bill Number', 'Bill Type', 'Bill Date','Bill Amount','Clock Date','Cycle Number')
          AND  bp.b1_per_type = 'Common'
          AND  bp.b1_per_sub_type = 'Inspection'
    )   pv1 

    PIVOT (MAX (ATTRIBUTE_VALUE)
                                               FOR COLUMN_NAME
                                               IN  ([Bill Number],
                                                   [Bill Type],
                                                   [Bill Date],
                                                   [Bill Amount],
                                                   [Clock Date],
                                                   [Cycle Number]
)) PV2),
invoice_result as (
Select 
	bi.serv_prov_code,
	bi.b1_per_id1,
	bi.b1_per_id2,
	bi.b1_per_id3,
    bi.ACCTNUM,
    bi.APPL_STATUS ACCOUNT_STATUS,
    bi.ROW_INDEX,
	bi.REC_STATUS,
    bi.BILL_NUMBER,
    bi.BILL_TYPE,
    bi.BILL_DATE,
    bi.BILL_AMOUNT, 
    bi.CLOCK_DATE,
    bi.CYCLE_NUMBER

from invoice_data bi
where 1=1
--   AND DATEADD(day,730,try_convert(DATE,bi.BILL_DATE)) <= DATEADD(day,0,GETDATE())

),
do_unit AS (
select SERV_PROV_CODE,
       B1_PER_ID1,
	   B1_PER_ID2,
	   B1_PER_ID3,
	   [D.O.] as ACTDO,
	   [Alpha Prefix] as ALPHAPREFIX,
	   [Account Type] as ACTTYPE,
	   [Application Type] as UNIT 
 from 
(
SELECT
    bc.serv_prov_code AS SERV_PROV_CODE,
    bc.b1_per_id1 AS B1_PER_ID1,
    bc.b1_per_id2 AS B1_PER_ID2,
    bc.b1_per_id3 AS B1_PER_ID3,
    
    bc.b1_checkbox_desc,
    bc.b1_checklist_comment
 FROM
         bchckbox bc

WHERE
    bc.b1_checkbox_desc IN ( 'Alpha Prefix', 'D.O.','Account Type','Application Type' )
    AND bc.b1_checkbox_type IN ('PLAN INFORMATION', 'PERMIT REPORT INFO')
    ) pvia
PIVOT ( MAX(b1_checklist_comment) for b1_checkbox_desc
            IN([D.O.],
			[Alpha Prefix],
			[Account Type],
			[Application Type])) pvib
),
result_data as (
SELECT
	RIGHT('0' + do.ACTDO, 2) DO,
    x4.b1_alt_id as ACCOUNT_NUMBER,
	do.alphaprefix,
	do.acttype ACCOUNT_TYPE,
	do.unit,
    x4.invoice_customized_nbr invoice_nbr,
    x4.feeitem_seq_nbr,
    x4.fee_item,
    x4.qty,    
    x4.fees,
    x4.status,
    x4.date_accessed,
    x4.fee_notes,
    x4.balance_due,
    x4.invoice_amount,
    x4.invoice_date,
    x4.rec_ful_nam,
    bi.ACCOUNT_STATUS,
	bi.REC_STATUS,
    bi.BILL_NUMBER,
    bi.BILL_TYPE,
    bi.BILL_DATE,
    bi.BILL_AMOUNT, 
    bi.CLOCK_DATE,
    bi.CYCLE_NUMBER

    
FROM
        fee_item x4
 
    LEFT OUTER JOIN invoice_result  bi ON x4.serv_prov_code = bi.serv_prov_code
                                     AND x4.b1_per_id1 = bi.b1_per_id1
                                     AND x4.b1_per_id2 = bi.b1_per_id2
                                     AND x4.b1_per_id3 = bi.b1_per_id3
    LEFT OUTER JOIN do_unit  do ON x4.serv_prov_code = do.serv_prov_code
                                     AND x4.b1_per_id1 = do.b1_per_id1
                                     AND x4.b1_per_id2 = do.b1_per_id2
                                     AND x4.b1_per_id3 = do.b1_per_id3                                 
   WHERE
          bi.BILL_NUMBER IS NOT NULL
 --  AND x4.rec_ful_nam NOT IN ('AACONV','AA CONV')
 --  AND x4.fee_item NOT IN ('Inspection/Permit Balance Due','Penalties Balance Due','No Good Check Fee')
   AND try_cast(x4.balance_due as int) > 0
--   AND x4.balance_due > 0
   AND ISDATE(bi.BILL_DATE) = 1

   AND RIGHT('0' + do.ACTDO, 2) < '16'
   AND x4.status = 'INVOICED'

)

	DO,

                                                   [Permit Printed],
                                                   [Is Temporary Permit?])) pvb

        ) tr
    WHERE
	     SERV_PROV_CODE = 'FDNY'

),
do_unit AS (
select SERV_PROV_CODE,
	   B1_PER_ID1,
	   B1_PER_ID2,
	   B1_PER_ID3,
       [D.O.] as ACTDO,
       [Application Type] as UNIT,
	   [Alpha Prefix] as ALPHAPREFIX,
       [Account Type] as ACTTYPE,
	   [Are you a City Agency or State Agency Employee?] AS EXEMPT_AGENCY,
	   [Exemption Recommendation] AS EXEMPT_RECOMMEND,
	   [Exemption Recommendation Date] AS EXEMPT_RECOMMEND_DATE,
	   [No Fee] as NO_FEE,
	   [No Fee Date] as NO_FEE_DATE 
from 
(
SELECT
    bc.serv_prov_code AS SERV_PROV_CODE,
    bc.b1_per_id1 AS B1_PER_ID1,
    bc.b1_per_id2 AS B1_PER_ID2,
    bc.b1_per_id3 AS B1_PER_ID3,
    bc.b1_checkbox_desc,
    bc.b1_checklist_comment
 FROM
         bchckbox bc

WHERE
    bc.b1_checkbox_desc IN ( 'Alpha Prefix', 'D.O.','Account Type','Application Type','No Fee','No Fee Date','Exemption Recommendation','Exemption Recommendation Date','Are you a City Agency or State Agency Employee?' )
    AND bc.b1_checkbox_type IN ('PLAN INFORMATION', 'PERMIT REPORT INFO','FEE EXEMPTION INFORMATION')
    ) pva
PIVOT ( MAX(b1_checklist_comment) for b1_checkbox_desc
            IN([D.O.],
               [Alpha Prefix],
               [Account Type],
               [Application Type],
			   [Are you a City Agency or State Agency Employee?],
			   [Exemption Recommendation],
			   [Exemption Recommendation Date],
			   [No Fee],
			   [No Fee Date])) pvb
),

    pd.serv_prov_code AS SERV_PROV_CODE,
    pd.b1_per_id1 AS B1_PER_ID1,
    pd.b1_per_id2 AS B1_PER_ID2,
    pd.b1_per_id3 AS B1_PER_ID3,
    pd.balance
 FROM
         bpermit_detail pd
WHERE 1=1
	AND pd.SERV_PROV_CODE = 'FDNY' 
),

   du.NO_FEE,

 --  fi.FEEITEM_SEQ_NBR,

   pr.CONTROL_NUMBER,

   DATEDIFF(
        DAY,

        TRY_CONVERT(DATE, pr.PERM_EXP_DATE, 101)
    ) AS DateDifferenceInDays
--   pr.INSPECTION_ID PR_INSP_ID
    
FROM
        INSPECTION ins

    LEFT OUTER join do_unit du ON ins.serv_prov_code = du.serv_prov_code
                                   AND ins.b1_per_id1 = du.b1_per_id1
                                   AND ins.b1_per_id2 = du.b1_per_id2                                   
                                   AND ins.b1_per_id3 = du.b1_per_id3   
    LEFT OUTER JOIN balance bal ON ins.serv_prov_code = bal.serv_prov_code
                                   AND ins.b1_per_id1 = bal.b1_per_id1
                                   AND ins.b1_per_id2 = bal.b1_per_id2                                   
                                   AND ins.b1_per_id3 = bal.b1_per_id3  	
    LEFT OUTER JOIN fee_item fi ON ins.serv_prov_code = fi.serv_prov_code
                                   AND ins.b1_per_id1 = fi.b1_per_id1
                                   AND ins.b1_per_id2 = fi.b1_per_id2                                   
                                   AND ins.b1_per_id3 = fi.b1_per_id3  
 
    JOIN PERMIT  pr ON ins.serv_prov_code = pr.serv_prov_code
                                     AND ins.b1_per_id1 = pr.b1_per_id1
                                     AND ins.b1_per_id2 = pr.b1_per_id2
                                     AND ins.b1_per_id3 = pr.b1_per_id3
                                     AND TRY_CONVERT(BIGINT, ins.G6_ACT_NUM) = TRY_CONVERT(BIGINT, pr.INSPECTION_ID)                                      
                                 
   WHERE 1=1
--	and ins.G6_COMPL_DD > '2023-05-31'
--	and ins.G6_COMPL_DD < '2024-07-01'
	AND	 TRY_CONVERT(BIGINT, pr.INSPECTION_ID) IS NOT NULL
--	and du.ACTTYPE in ('10','15','20','25')
   	and du.ACTTYPE in ('10','20')
	and ins.B1_APPL_STATUS not in ('Inactive')
    AND coalesce(du.NO_FEE,'0') <> 'CHECKED' 
    AND TRY_CONVERT(BIGINT, fi.fee_notes) = TRY_CONVERT(BIGINT, ins.G6_ACT_NUM)
    AND fi.GF_ITEM_STATUS_FLAG = 'INVOICED'
--       or du.EXEMPT_AGENCY is null)
    AND DATEDIFF(
        DAY, 
        TRY_CONVERT(DATE, pr.PERM_START_DATE, 101), 
        TRY_CONVERT(DATE, pr.PERM_EXP_DATE, 101)
    ) > 730

	--AND ins.b1_alt_id = '01141100'

ORDER BY
    TRY_CONVERT(DATE, ins.G6_COMPL_DD, 101) DESC,
    ins.b1_alt_id

"379","rpt_inspection_no_permexp_041725.sql","C:\FIRESSQLSVR\Backup\rpt_inspection_no_permexp_041725.sql","WITH INSPECTION AS (
			SELECT
               I.SERV_PROV_CODE,
               I.B1_PER_ID1,
               I.B1_PER_ID2,
               I.B1_PER_ID3,
               I.G6_COMPL_DD,

			   I.G6_ACT_NUM,
			   i.G6_ACT_TYP,
               bp.b1_alt_id,
			   bp.B1_APPL_STATUS
            FROM
                  G6ACTION I 
JOIN b1permit bp ON I.SERV_PROV_CODE = bp.SERV_PROV_CODE
	AND I.B1_PER_ID1 = bp.B1_PER_ID1
	AND I.B1_PER_ID2 = bp.B1_PER_ID2
	AND I.B1_PER_ID3 = bp.B1_PER_ID3         
            WHERE
               I.SERV_PROV_CODE = 'FDNY' 
               AND I.REC_STATUS = 'A' 
			   AND bp.b1_per_type = 'Common'
               AND bp.b1_per_sub_type = 'Inspection'
--			   AND bp.b1_alt_id = '22098867'
               AND I.G6_STATUS IN 
               (
                  'Approved',
                  'In Violation'
               )
               AND I.G6_COMPL_DD IS NOT NULL
   )
,PERMIT AS (
SELECT 
    serv_prov_code,
    b1_per_id1,
    b1_per_id2,
    b1_per_id3,
    ROW_INDEX,
    CONTROL_NUMBER,
    INSPECTION_ID,
    PERM_ISS_DATE,
    PERM_EXP_DATE, 
    PERM_START_DATE,
    PERM_PRINTED,
   IS_TEMP_PERMIT
FROM (

select 
    serv_prov_code,
    b1_per_id1,
    b1_per_id2,
    b1_per_id3,
    ROW_INDEX,
    [Control Number] AS CONTROL_NUMBER,
    [Inspection ID] AS INSPECTION_ID,
    [Permit Issuance Date] AS PERM_ISS_DATE,
    [Permit Expiration Date] AS PERM_EXP_DATE, 
    [Permit Start Date] AS PERM_START_DATE,
    [Permit Printed] AS PERM_PRINTED,
    [Is Temporary Permit?] AS IS_TEMP_PERMIT,
	TRY_CONVERT(DATE,[Permit Expiration Date]) AS PERMIT_EXPIRATION

     FROM (
     SELECT 
    ba.serv_prov_code,
    ba.b1_per_id1,
    ba.b1_per_id2,
    ba.b1_per_id3,
    ROW_INDEX AS ROW_INDEX,
    ba.COLUMN_NAME,
    ba.attribute_value
    FROM
         bappspectable_value ba
JOIN B1PERMIT bp ON ba.SERV_PROV_CODE = bp.SERV_PROV_CODE
	AND ba.B1_PER_ID1 = bp.B1_PER_ID1
	AND ba.B1_PER_ID2 = bp.B1_PER_ID2
	AND ba.B1_PER_ID3 = bp.B1_PER_ID3
    WHERE 1=1
		 AND bp.b1_per_type = 'Common'
         AND bp.b1_per_sub_type = 'Inspection'
         AND ba.TABLE_NAME = 'PERMIT EXPIRATION'
         AND ba.COLUMN_NAME IN ('Control Number', 'Inspection ID', 'Permit Issuance Date','Permit Expiration Date','Permit Start Date','Permit Printed','Is Temporary Permit?')
    )    pva

    PIVOT (MAX (ATTRIBUTE_VALUE)
                                               FOR COLUMN_NAME
                                               IN ([Control Number],
                                                   [Inspection ID],
                                                   [Permit Issuance Date],
                                                   [Permit Expiration Date],
                                                   [Permit Start Date],
                                                   [Permit Printed],
                                                   [Is Temporary Permit?])) pvb

        ) tr
    WHERE
	     SERV_PROV_CODE = 'FDNY'

)
, do_unit AS (
select SERV_PROV_CODE,
       B1_PER_ID1,
	   B1_PER_ID2,
	   B1_PER_ID3,
	   [D.O.] as ACTDO,
	   [Alpha Prefix] as ALPHAPREFIX,
	   [Account Type] as ACTTYPE,
	   [No Fee] as NO_FEE,
	   [No Fee Date] as NO_FEE_DATE,
	   [Application Type] as UNIT 
 from 
(
SELECT
    bc.serv_prov_code AS SERV_PROV_CODE,
    bc.b1_per_id1 AS B1_PER_ID1,
    bc.b1_per_id2 AS B1_PER_ID2,
    bc.b1_per_id3 AS B1_PER_ID3,
    
    bc.b1_checkbox_desc,
    bc.b1_checklist_comment
 FROM
         bchckbox bc
JOIN b1permit bp ON bc.SERV_PROV_CODE = bp.SERV_PROV_CODE
	AND bc.B1_PER_ID1 = bp.B1_PER_ID1
	AND bc.B1_PER_ID2 = bp.B1_PER_ID2
	AND bc.B1_PER_ID3 = bp.B1_PER_ID3
WHERE 1=1
		 AND bp.b1_per_type = 'Common'
         AND bp.b1_per_sub_type = 'Inspection'
    AND bc.b1_checkbox_desc IN ( 'Alpha Prefix', 'D.O.','Account Type','Application Type','No Fee','No Fee Date' )
    AND bc.b1_checkbox_type IN ('PLAN INFORMATION', 'PERMIT REPORT INFO','FEE EXEMPTION INFORMATION')
	AND bc.SERV_PROV_CODE = 'FDNY' 
    ) pvia
PIVOT ( MAX(b1_checklist_comment) for b1_checkbox_desc
            IN([D.O.],
			[Alpha Prefix],
			[Account Type],
			[No Fee],
			[No Fee Date],

			[Application Type])) pvib
)

            b.b1_fname,
                b.rec_date,
                b.b1_contact_type,
                ROW_NUMBER()
                OVER(PARTITION BY b.serv_prov_code, b.b1_per_id1, b.b1_per_id2, b.b1_per_id3
                     ORDER BY
                         b.rec_date DESC 
                ) rn

    bp.b1_per_id1,
    bp.b1_per_id2,

                                           AND bp.b1_per_id2 = x4.b1_per_id2                                           
                                           AND bp.b1_per_id3 = x4.b1_per_id3   
                                          
     LEFT OUTER JOIN f4invoice f4 ON x4.invoice_nbr = f4.invoice_nbr
                                        AND x4.serv_prov_code = f4.serv_prov_code

    AND bp.rec_status = 'A'
    AND x4.feeitem_invoice_status = 'INVOICED'
	AND try_cast(f4.balance_due as int) > 0
   AND DATEADD(day,730,try_convert(DATE,f4.invoice_date)) <= DATEADD(day,0,GETDATE())


)
   select * INTO #TMP_fee_item from fee_item;

WITH invoice_data as
(
select 
	serv_prov_code,
	b1_per_id1,
	b1_per_id2,
	b1_per_id3,
    ACCTNUM,
    APPL_STATUS,
    ROW_INDEX,
	REC_STATUS,
    [Bill Number] AS BILL_NUMBER,
    [Bill Type] AS BILL_TYPE,
    [Bill Date] AS BILL_DATE,
    [Bill Amount] AS BILL_AMOUNT, 
    [Clock Date] AS CLOCK_DATE,
    [Cycle Number] AS CYCLE_NUMBER
FROM (
     SELECT 
	bp.serv_prov_code,
	bp.b1_per_id1,
	bp.b1_per_id2,
	bp.b1_per_id3,
    substring(bp.b1_alt_id,1,8) AS acctnum,
    bp.b1_per_type AS PER_TYPE,
    bp.b1_per_sub_type AS PER_SUB_TYPE,
    bp.b1_file_dd AS FILE_DD,
    bp.rec_date    AS rec_date1,
    bp.rec_ful_nam AS rec_ful_nam1,
    bp.rec_status  AS rec_status1,
    bp.b1_appl_status AS APPL_STATUS,
    bap.ROW_INDEX AS ROW_INDEX,
	bap.rec_status,
    bap.COLUMN_NAME,
    bap.attribute_value
    FROM
         b1permit bp
    INNER JOIN bappspectable_value bap ON bp.serv_prov_code = bap.serv_prov_code
                                     AND bp.b1_per_id1 = bap.b1_per_id1
                                     AND bp.b1_per_id2 = bap.b1_per_id2
                                     AND bp.b1_per_id3 = bap.b1_per_id3
 JOIN #TMP_fee_item rv ON bp.SERV_PROV_CODE = rv.SERV_PROV_CODE
	AND bp.B1_PER_ID1 = rv.B1_PER_ID1
	AND bp.B1_PER_ID2 = rv.B1_PER_ID2
	AND bp.B1_PER_ID3 = rv.B1_PER_ID3  
    WHERE
          bap.TABLE_NAME = 'BILLING INFORMATION'
         AND bap.COLUMN_NAME IN ('Bill Number', 'Bill Type', 'Bill Date','Bill Amount','Clock Date','Cycle Number')
          AND  bp.b1_per_type = 'Common'
          AND  bp.b1_per_sub_type = 'Inspection'
		  AND bp.rec_status = 'A'
    )   pv1 

    PIVOT (MAX (ATTRIBUTE_VALUE)
                                               FOR COLUMN_NAME
                                               IN  ([Bill Number],
                                                   [Bill Type],
                                                   [Bill Date],
                                                   [Bill Amount],
                                                   [Clock Date],
                                                   [Cycle Number]
)) PV2)
   select * INTO #TMP_invoice_data from invoice_data;

	AND g6.B1_PER_ID3 = rv.B1_PER_ID3

"62","rptCov_Fee_Amount.sql","C:\FIRESSQLSVR\rptCov_Fee_Amount.sql","
DECLARE @ACCOUNTID     VARCHAR(50) = '40097925'; 

WITH coverage AS (
    SELECT
        serv_prov_code,
        b1_per_id1, b1_per_id2, b1_per_id3,
        row_index,
        LTRIM(RTRIM(SUBSTRING([Coverage Item], 1, 6))) AS coverage_item,
        [Quantity]                   AS quantity_raw,
        [Status]                     AS status
    FROM (
        SELECT
            bap.serv_prov_code,
            bap.b1_per_id1, bap.b1_per_id2, bap.b1_per_id3,
            bap.row_index,
            bap.column_name,
            bap.attribute_value
        FROM BAPPSPECTABLE_VALUE AS bap
        WHERE bap.table_name    = 'COVERAGE INFORMATION'
          AND bap.serv_prov_code = 'FDNY'
          AND ISNULL(bap.rec_status, 'A') = 'A'
    ) src
    PIVOT (
        MAX(attribute_value)
        FOR column_name IN ([Coverage Item], [Quantity], [Status])
    ) p
    WHERE NULLIF([Coverage Item], '') IS NOT NULL
),

-- 2) Pull matching coverage code & amount from RFEEITEM
fee AS (
    SELECT
        rf.serv_prov_code,
        LTRIM(RTRIM(SUBSTRING(rf.R1_GF_L3, 1, 6))) AS coverage_item_code,
        TRY_CONVERT(float, rf.R1_GF_FORMULA)        AS coverage_amount
    FROM RFEEITEM AS rf
    WHERE rf.serv_prov_code = 'FDNY'
),

-- 3) Resolve Account Number from b1permit
records AS (
    SELECT
        bp.serv_prov_code,
        bp.b1_per_id1, bp.b1_per_id2, bp.b1_per_id3,
        bp.b1_alt_id AS account_number
    FROM b1permit AS bp
    WHERE bp.serv_prov_code = 'FDNY'
      AND bp.rec_status = 'A'
      AND (@ACCOUNTID IS NULL OR bp.b1_alt_id = @ACCOUNTID)
)

-- 4) Final output
SELECT
    r.account_number,
    c.coverage_item,
    TRY_CONVERT(int, NULLIF(c.quantity_raw, '')) AS quantity,
    f.coverage_amount
FROM records  AS r
JOIN coverage AS c
  ON r.serv_prov_code = c.serv_prov_code
 AND r.b1_per_id1     = c.b1_per_id1
 AND r.b1_per_id2     = c.b1_per_id2
 AND r.b1_per_id3     = c.b1_per_id3
JOIN fee      AS f
  ON f.serv_prov_code      = c.serv_prov_code
 AND f.coverage_item_code  = c.coverage_item
WHERE ISNULL(c.status, 'Active') = 'Active'
ORDER BY r.account_number, c.coverage_item;","6/16/2026 10:33:28 AM"

    r.account_number,
    c.coverage_item,
    qty.quantity                                       AS quantity,
    fee_amt.coverage_amount                            AS fee_amount,
    line.line_total                                    AS line_total,
    SUM(line.line_total) OVER (PARTITION BY r.account_number) AS account_total
FROM records  AS r
JOIN coverage AS c
  ON r.serv_prov_code = c.serv_prov_code
 AND r.b1_per_id1     = c.b1_per_id1
 AND r.b1_per_id2     = c.b1_per_id2
 AND r.b1_per_id3     = c.b1_per_id3
JOIN fee      AS f
  ON f.serv_prov_code      = c.serv_prov_code
 AND f.coverage_item_code  = c.coverage_item
CROSS APPLY (
    SELECT TRY_CONVERT(int, NULLIF(c.quantity_raw, '')) AS quantity
) AS qty
CROSS APPLY (
    SELECT CAST(ISNULL(f.coverage_amount,0) AS decimal(18,2)) AS coverage_amount
) AS fee_amt
CROSS APPLY (
    SELECT CAST(ISNULL(qty.quantity, 0) * fee_amt.coverage_amount AS decimal(18,2)) AS line_total
) AS line
WHERE ISNULL(c.status, 'Active') = 'Active'

    -- Having clause ensures we drop rows where coverage item resolves to blank or null
    HAVING NULLIF(MAX(CASE WHEN bap.column_name = 'Coverage Item' THEN bap.attribute_value END), '') IS NOT NULL

(

    B.B1_ALT_ID ACCOUNT_NO,

    FROM B1PERMIT B
    LEFT JOIN (
        SELECT SERV_PROV_CODE, B1_PER_ID1, B1_PER_ID2, B1_PER_ID3,PREM_ADDR1,PREM_ADDR2,RN FROM 
        (    
            SELECT 
                SERV_PROV_CODE, B1_PER_ID1, B1_PER_ID2, B1_PER_ID3,
                COALESCE(B1_HSE_NBR_ALPHA_START,'')+' ' +COALESCE(B1_STR_NAME,'') PREM_ADDR1,
                COALESCE(B1_SITUS_CITY,'')+' '+COALESCE(B1_SITUS_STATE,'')+' '+COALESCE(B1_SITUS_ZIP,'') PREM_ADDR2,
                ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY SERV_PROV_CODE, B1_PER_ID1, B1_PER_ID2, B1_PER_ID3 ORDER BY B1_PRIMARY_ADDR_FLG, REC_DATE DESC) RN
            FROM B3ADDRES 
                     WHERE SERV_PROV_CODE='FDNY'
        ) X WHERE RN = 1
    ) A
    ON A.SERV_PROV_CODE= B.SERV_PROV_CODE
    AND A.B1_PER_ID1 = B.B1_PER_ID1
    AND A.B1_PER_ID2 = B.B1_PER_ID2
    AND A.B1_PER_ID3 = B.B1_PER_ID3  
    LEFT JOIN 
       (SELECT SERV_PROV_CODE,    B1_PER_ID1,    B1_PER_ID2,    B1_PER_ID3, STRING_AGG(GF_L3,', ')   WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY FEEITEM_SEQ_NBR) ITEMCODES
      FROM F4FEEITEM
         WHERE SERV_PROV_CODE='FDNY'
      GROUP BY SERV_PROV_CODE,B1_PER_ID1,    B1_PER_ID2,    B1_PER_ID3
    ) F
    ON F.SERV_PROV_CODE= B.SERV_PROV_CODE
    AND F.B1_PER_ID1 = B.B1_PER_ID1
    AND F.B1_PER_ID2 = B.B1_PER_ID2
    AND F.B1_PER_ID3 = B.B1_PER_ID3

 
    LEFT JOIN BPERMIT_DETAIL  D
    ON D.SERV_PROV_CODE= B.SERV_PROV_CODE
    AND D.B1_PER_ID1 = B.B1_PER_ID1
    AND D.B1_PER_ID2 = B.B1_PER_ID2
    AND D.B1_PER_ID3 = B.B1_PER_ID3
   /* LEFT JOIN FPIMS.FPO_MV_RECORD_BINS  BA

callPOSTApiRemoveDuplicates();

function callPOSTApiRemoveDuplicates() {
	try {
		var accelawsUrl = lookup(""URLs"", ""INTERFACE_URL_REST"") + ""/invoiceremovedup"";
		var apikey = lookup(""URLs"", ""INTERFACE_URL_REST_API_KEY"");
		aa.print(""accelawsUrl: "" + accelawsUrl);
		aa.print(""apikey: "" + apikey);
		var put = new org.apache.commons.httpclient.methods.PostMethod(accelawsUrl);
		var client = new org.apache.commons.httpclient.HttpClient();
		put.setRequestHeader(""apikey"", apikey);
		var status = client.executeMethod(put);
		logDebug(""The Status From Web Logic Server "" + status);
	} catch (apiErr) {
		aa.print(""Failed to trigger RAS Stored Procedure API"");
	}
}

function runSQLinEMSE(sql) {
	var conn = aa.db.getConnection();
	var sStmt = conn.prepareStatement(sql);
	var rSet = sStmt.executeQuery();
	closeDBQueryObject(rSet, sStmt, conn);
}

function closeDBQueryObject(rSet, sStmt, conn) {
	try {
		if (rSet) {
			rSet.close();
			rSet = null;
		}
	} catch (vError) {
		aa.print(""Failed to close the database result set object."" + vError);
	}
	try {
		if (sStmt) {
			sStmt.close();
			sStmt = null;
		}
	} catch (vError) {
		aa.print(""Failed to close the database prepare statement object."" + vError);
	}
	try {
		if (conn) {
			conn.close();
			conn = null;
		}
	} catch (vError) {
		aa.print(""Failed to close the database connection."" + vError);
	}
}

                                         AND b6.b1_per_id1 = cycstatus.entity_key1
                                         AND b6.b1_per_id2 = cycstatus.entity_key2
                                         AND b6.b1_per_id3 = cycstatus.entity_key3
                                         AND cycstatus.entity_type = '11'
                                         AND cycstatus.field_name = 'Cycle Number'
WHERE
        b6.b1_con_typ = 'Lien'

, 
APO AS (
select SERV_PROV_CODE,
		B1_PER_ID1,
		B1_PER_ID2,
		B1_PER_ID3,
		[BIN] as BIN,
		[BLOCK] as BLOCK,
		[LOT] as LOT
from 
(
SELECT
    apo.serv_prov_code AS SERV_PROV_CODE,
    apo.b1_per_id1 AS B1_PER_ID1,
	apo.b1_per_id2 AS B1_PER_ID2,
    apo.b1_per_id3 AS B1_PER_ID3,
    apo.b1_attribute_name,
    apo.b1_attribute_value
FROM
	b3apo_attribute apo
JOIN Returned_Values rv ON APO.SERV_PROV_CODE = rv.SERV_PROV_CODE
	AND APO.B1_PER_ID1 = rv.B1_PER_ID1
	AND APO.B1_PER_ID2 = rv.B1_PER_ID2
	AND APO.B1_PER_ID3 = rv.B1_PER_ID3

WHERE
    apo.b1_attribute_name IN ( 'BIN', 'BLOCK','LOT' )
    AND apo.b1_apo_type IN ('ADDRESS')
    ) pva
PIVOT ( 
	MAX(b1_attribute_value) 
	for b1_attribute_name
       IN(
			[BIN],
			[BLOCK],
			[LOT]
		) 
	) pvb
),result_data AS (
SELECT 
	RIGHT('0' + du.ACTDO, 2) AS DO,
    du.ALPHAPREFIX AS APFX, 
    du.ACTTYPE AS ACTTYP, 
    CASE WHEN du.ACTTYPE IN ('10', '15', '20', '25') THEN 'PERMIT' 
	ELSE 
	'NONPERMIT' 
	END AS PERMITGRP,
	CASE WHEN du.ACTTYPE IN ('10', '15', '20', '25') THEN DATEADD(day,455,CONVERT(DATE,li.F4INVOICE_UDF2)) 
	ELSE 
	DATEADD(day,120,CONVERT(DATE,li.F4INVOICE_UDF2))

    du.UNIT,

    li.REC_DATE,

    ln.con_nbr,
	ln.charge_num,
    ln.reason,
    ln.payment_status,
	ln.cycle_num,
    ln.con_iss_dd,
    ln.con_eff_dd
FROM
         b1permit bp

    LEFT OUTER JOIN contact         cn ON cn.serv_prov_code = bp.serv_prov_code
                                  AND cn.b1_per_id1 = bp.b1_per_id1
                                  AND cn.b1_per_id2 = bp.b1_per_id2
                                  AND cn.b1_per_id3 = bp.b1_per_id3
    LEFT OUTER JOIN addr ba ON ba.serv_prov_code = bp.serv_prov_code
                                  AND ba.b1_per_id1 = bp.b1_per_id1
                                  AND ba.b1_per_id2 = bp.b1_per_id2
                                  AND ba.b1_per_id3 = bp.b1_per_id3

    INNER JOIN APO ap      ON ap.serv_prov_code = bp.serv_prov_code
                                  AND ap.b1_per_id1 = bp.b1_per_id1
                                  AND ap.b1_per_id2 = bp.b1_per_id2
                                  AND ap.b1_per_id3 = bp.b1_per_id3

    INNER JOIN do_unit du ON bp.serv_prov_code = du.serv_prov_code
                                   AND bp.b1_per_id1 = du.b1_per_id1
                                   AND bp.b1_per_id2 = du.b1_per_id2                                   
                                   AND bp.b1_per_id3 = du.b1_per_id3   
    INNER JOIN Returned_Values li ON bp.serv_prov_code = li.serv_prov_code
                                   AND bp.b1_per_id1 = li.b1_per_id1
                                   AND bp.b1_per_id2 = li.b1_per_id2                                   
                                   AND bp.b1_per_id3 = li.b1_per_id3  
    LEFT OUTER JOIN lien ln ON ln.serv_prov_code = bp.serv_prov_code
                                  AND ln.b1_per_id1 = bp.b1_per_id1
                                  AND ln.b1_per_id2 = bp.b1_per_id2
                                  AND ln.b1_per_id3 = bp.b1_per_id3					
WHERE

       bp.b1_per_type = 'Common' 
       AND  bp.b1_per_sub_type = 'Inspection'
       AND bp.b1_appl_status <> 'Inactive'
	   AND ISDATE(li.F4INVOICE_UDF2) = 1
--	   AND bp.b1_alt_id = @ACCOUNTID
)

 ACTTYP, 
 PERMITGRP,
 DUEDATE,
 UNIT,
 RECORD_ID,

 INVOICE_COMMENT

 from result_data
